translation_en: Thus the word of your Lord has come into effect upon those who defiantly disobeyed - that they will not believe.

arabic_text: قُلْ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Je! Yupo katika miungu yenu ya ushirikina aliye anzisha kuumba viumbe, na kisha akavirejesha? Huwaje, basi, mkadanganywa?
translation_en: Say, "Are there of your 'partners' any who begins creation and then repeats it?" Say, "Allah begins creation and then repeats it, so how are you deluded?"

arabic_text: قُلْ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يَهْدِى لِلْحَقِّ ۗ أَفَمَن يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ أَحَقُّ أَن يُتَّبَعَ أَمَّن لَّا يَهِدِّىٓ إِلَّآ أَن يُهْدَىٰ ۖ فَمَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Je! Yupo katika miungu yenu ya ushirikina anaye ongoa kwendea Haki? Sema: Mwenyezi Mungu anaongoa kwendea Haki. Basi, je, anaye stahiki kufuatwa ni yule Mwenye kuongoa kwendea Haki au asiye ongoa ila aongozwe yeye? Basi nyinyi mna nini? Mnahukumu namna gani?
translation_en: Say, "Are there of your 'partners' any who guides to the truth?" Say, "Allah guides to the truth. So is He who guides to the truth more worthy to be followed or he who guides not unless he is guided? Then what is [wrong] with you - how do you judge?"

arabic_text: وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ إِلَّا ظَنًّا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na wengi wao hawafuati ila dhana tu. Na dhana haifai kitu mbele ya haki. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anajua yote wanayo yatenda.
translation_en: And most of them follow not except assumption. Indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what they do.

arabic_text: وَمَا كَانَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ أَن يُفْتَرَىٰ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na haiwezekani Qur'ani hii kuwa imetungwa na haitoki kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Lakini hii inasadikisha yaliyo tangulia, na ni mfafanuo wa Kitabu kisicho na shaka ndani yake, kutokana na Mola Mlezi wa viumbe vyote.
translation_en: And it was not [possible] for this Qur'an to be produced by other than Allah, but [it is] a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of the [former] Scripture, about which there is no doubt, from the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِسُورَةٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ وَٱدْعُوا۟ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Je! Ndiyo wanasema ameizua? Sema: Hebu leteni sura moja mfano wake na muwaite (kukusaidieni) muwawezao, isipo kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu, ikiwa nyinyi mnasema kweli.
translation_en: Or do they say [about the Prophet], "He invented it?" Say, "Then bring forth a surah like it and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allah, if you should be truthful."

arabic_text: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِمَا لَمْ يُحِيطُوا۟ بِعِلْمِهِۦ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِهِمْ تَأْوِيلُهُۥ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Bali wameyakanusha wasio yaelewa ilimu yake kabla hayajawajia maelezo yake. Kadhaalika walio kabla yao walikanusha vile vile. Basi angalia jinsi ulivyo kuwa mwisho wa madhaalimu hao.
translation_en: Rather, they have denied that which they encompass not in knowledge and whose interpretation has not yet come to them. Thus did those before them deny. Then observe how was the end of the wrongdoers.

arabic_text: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ ۚ وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
translation_sw: Na miongoni mwao wapo wanao iamini, na miongoni mwao wapo wasio iamini. Na Mola wako Mlezi anawajua vyema mafisadi.
translation_en: And of them are those who believe in it, and of them are those who do not believe in it. And your Lord is most knowing of the corrupters

arabic_text: وَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل لِّى عَمَلِى وَلَكُمْ عَمَلُكُمْ ۖ أَنتُم بَرِيٓـُٔونَ مِمَّآ أَعْمَلُ وَأَنَا۠ بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na wakikukanusha wewe, sema: Mimi nina a'mali yangu, na nyinyi mna a'mali yenu. Nyinyi hamna jukumu kwa niyatendayo, wala mimi sina jukumu kwa myatendayo.
translation_en: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad], then say, "For me are my deeds, and for you are your deeds. You are disassociated from what I do, and I am disassociated from what you do."

arabic_text: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ ۚ أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na wapo miongoni mwao wanao kusikiliza. Je, wewe unaweza kuwafanya viziwi wasikie ijapo kuwa hawafahamu?
translation_en: And among them are those who listen to you. But can you cause the deaf to hear, although they will not use reason?

arabic_text: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنظُرُ إِلَيْكَ ۚ أَفَأَنتَ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wapo miongoni mwao wanao kutazama. Je, wewe utawaongoa vipofu ingawa hawaoni?
translation_en: And among them are those who look at you. But can you guide the blind although they will not [attempt to] see?

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ ٱلنَّاسَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu hawadhulumu watu kitu chochote; lakini watu wenyewe wanajidhulumu nafsi zao.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah does not wrong the people at all, but it is the people who are wronging themselves.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ كَأَن لَّمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا سَاعَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّهَارِ يَتَعَارَفُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
translation_sw: Na Siku atakapo wakusanya, itakuwa kama kwamba hawakukaa ila saa moja tu ya mchana! Watatambuana. Hakika wamekhasirika walio kanusha kukutana na Mwenyezi Mungu, wala hawakuwa wenye kuongoka.
translation_en: And on the Day when He will gather them, [it will be] as if they had not remained [in the world] but an hour of the day, [and] they will know each other. Those will have lost who denied the meeting with Allah and were not guided

arabic_text: وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na vyovyote vile, tukikuonyesha baadhi ya tunayo waahidi, au tukakufisha kabla yake, marejeo yao ni kwetu. Kisha Mwenyezi Mungu ni Shahidi wa wanayo yafanya.
translation_en: And whether We show you some of what We promise them, [O Muhammad], or We take you in death, to Us is their return; then, [either way], Allah is a witness concerning what they are doing

arabic_text: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ رَّسُولٌۭ ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na kila umma una Mtume. Alipo wajia Mtume wao walihukumiwa baina yao kwa uadilifu, wala hawakudhulumiwa.
translation_en: And for every nation is a messenger. So when their messenger comes, it will be judged between them in justice, and they will not be wronged

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanasema: Lini ahadi hii, ikiwa mnasema kweli?
translation_en: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"

arabic_text: قُل لَّآ أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِى ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًا إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۗ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ ۚ إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةًۭ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Sijimilikii nafsi yangu shari wala kheri ila apendavyo Mwenyezi Mungu. Kila umma una muda wao walio wekewa. Ukifika muda wao hawakawii hata saa moja wala hawatangulii.
translation_en: Say, "I possess not for myself any harm or benefit except what Allah should will. For every nation is a [specified] term. When their time has come, then they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]."

arabic_text: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُهُۥ بَيَٰتًا أَوْ نَهَارًۭا مَّاذَا يَسْتَعْجِلُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Mwaonaje ikikufikieni hiyo adhabu yake usiku au mchana, sehemu gani ya adhabu wanaihimiza wakosefu?
translation_en: Say, "Have you considered: if His punishment should come to you by night or by day - for which [aspect] of it would the criminals be impatient?"

arabic_text: أَثُمَّ إِذَا مَا وَقَعَ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦٓ ۚ ءَآلْـَٰٔنَ وَقَدْ كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_sw: Tena je! Ikisha tokea mtaiamini? Je! Ndio sasa tena? Na nyinyi mlikuwa mkiihimiza.
translation_en: Then is it that when it has [actually] occurred you will believe in it? Now? And you were [once] for it impatient

arabic_text: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
translation_sw: Kisha walio dhulumu wataambiwa: Onjeni adhabu ya kudumu. Kwani mtalipwa isipo kuwa yale mliyo kuwa mkiyachuma?
translation_en: Then it will be said to those who had wronged, "Taste the punishment of eternity; are you being recompensed except for what you used to earn?"

arabic_text: ۞ وَيَسْتَنۢبِـُٔونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَ ۖ قُلْ إِى وَرَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanakuuliza: Je! Ni kweli hayo? Sema: Ehe! Naapa kwa Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika hayo ni kweli, na wala nyinyi hamshindi!
translation_en: And they ask information of you, [O Muhammad], "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to Allah]."

arabic_text: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفْسٍۢ ظَلَمَتْ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَٱفْتَدَتْ بِهِۦ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۖ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na lau kuwa kila nafsi iliyo dhulumu inamiliki kila kiliomo duniani, bila ya shaka ingeli toa vyote kujikombolea. Na watakapo iona adhabu wataficha majuto. Na patahukumiwa baina yao kwa uadilifu, nao hawatadhulumiwa.
translation_en: And if each soul that wronged had everything on earth, it would offer it in ransom. And they will confide regret when they see the punishment; and they will be judged in justice, and they will not be wronged

arabic_text: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Jueni kuwa hakika vyote viliomo katika mbingu na katika ardhi ni vya Mwenyezi Mungu. Jueni kuwa hakika ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni ya haki. Lakini wengi wao hawajui.
translation_en: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Unquestionably, the promise of Allah is truth, but most of them do not know

arabic_text: هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye anaye fufua na anaye fisha. Na kwake mtarejeshwa.
translation_en: He gives life and causes death, and to Him you will be returned

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُم مَّوْعِظَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَشِفَآءٌۭ لِّمَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Enyi watu! Yamekujieni mawaidha kutoka kwa Mola wenu Mlezi, na poza kuponyesha yaliyomo vifuani, na uwongofu, na rehema kwa Waumini.
translation_en: O mankind, there has to come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers.

arabic_text: قُلْ بِفَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِۦ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا۟ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Kwa fadhila ya Mwenyezi Mungu na rehema yake! Basi nawafurahi kwa hayo. Haya ni bora kuliko hayo wanayo yakusanya.
translation_en: Say, "In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate."

arabic_text: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ فَجَعَلْتُم مِّنْهُ حَرَامًۭا وَحَلَٰلًۭا قُلْ ءَآللَّهُ أَذِنَ لَكُمْ ۖ أَمْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَفْتَرُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Je! Mwaonaje zile riziki alizo kuteremshieni Mwenyezi Mungu, nanyi mkafanya katika hizo nyengine haramu na nyengine halali. Sema: Je! Mwenyezi Mungu amekuruhusuni, au mnamzulia Mwenyezi Mungu tu?
translation_en: Say, "Have you seen what Allah has sent down to you of provision of which you have made [some] lawful and [some] unlawful?" Say, "Has Allah permitted you [to do so], or do you invent [something] about Allah?"

arabic_text: وَمَا ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na nini dhana ya wanao mzulia Mwenyezi Mungu kwa Siku ya Kiyama? Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ana fadhila juu ya watu, lakini wengi wao hawashukuru.
translation_en: And what will be the supposition of those who invent falsehood about Allah on the Day of Resurrection? Indeed, Allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of them are not grateful."

arabic_text: وَمَا تَكُونُ فِى شَأْنٍۢ وَمَا تَتْلُوا۟ مِنْهُ مِن قُرْءَانٍۢ وَلَا تَعْمَلُونَ مِنْ عَمَلٍ إِلَّا كُنَّا عَلَيْكُمْ شُهُودًا إِذْ تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَا يَعْزُبُ عَن رَّبِّكَ مِن مِّثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرَ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرَ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
translation_sw: Na huwi katika jambo lolote, wala husomi sehemu yoyote katika Qur'ani, wala hamtendi kitendo chochote ila Sisi huwa ni mashahidi juu yenu mnapo shughulika nayo. Na hakifichikani kwa Mola wako Mlezi chenye uzito hata wa chembe katika ardhi na katika mbingu, wala kidogo kuliko hicho wala kikubwa ila kimo katika Kitabu kilicho wazi.
translation_en: And, [O Muhammad], you are not [engaged] in any matter or recite any of the Qur'an and you [people] do not do any deed except that We are witness over you when you are involved in it. And not absent from your Lord is any [part] of an atom's weight within the earth or within the heaven or [anything] smaller than that or greater but that it is in a clear register.

arabic_text: أَلَآ إِنَّ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
translation_sw: Jueni kuwa vipenzi vya Mwenyezi Mungu hawatakuwa na khofu wala hawatahuzunika.
translation_en: Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Hao ni ambao wameamini na wakawa wanamcha Mungu.
translation_en: Those who believed and were fearing Allah

arabic_text: لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_sw: Wao wana bishara njema katika maisha ya dunia na katika Akhera. Hapana mabadiliko katika maneno ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Huko ndiko kufuzu kukubwa.
translation_en: For them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. No change is there in the words of Allah. That is what is the great attainment.

arabic_text: وَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّ ٱلْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا ۚ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Wala yasikuhuzunishe maneno yao. Hakika utukufu wote ni wa Mwenyezi Mungu. Yeye ndiye Mwenye kusikia Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to Allah entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

arabic_text: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
translation_sw: Jueni kuwa ni vya Mwenyezi Mungu vyote viliomo mbinguni na ardhinii. Na wala hawawafuati hao wanao waomba badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu kuwa ni washirika wake. Wao hawafuati ila dhana tu, na hawasemi ila uwongo.
translation_en: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. And those who invoke other than Allah do not [actually] follow [His] "partners." They follow not except assumption, and they are not but falsifying

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَسْمَعُونَ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye aliye kujaalieni usiku mpate kutulia humo, na mchana wa kuonea. Hakika katika haya zipo Ishara kwa watu wanao sikia.
translation_en: It is He who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنْ عِندَكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Wamesema: Mwenyezi Mungu ana mwana. Subhanahu, Aliye takasika! Yeye ni Mkwasi, Mwenye Kujitosheleza. Vyote viliomo katika mbingu na katika ardhi ni vyake peke yake. Nyinyi hamna uthibitisho wowote wa haya! Mnamzulia Mwenyezi Mungu msiyo yajua?
translation_en: They have said, "Allah has taken a son." Exalted is He; He is the [one] Free of need. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. You have no authority for this [claim]. Do you say about Allah that which you do not know?

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Hao wanao mzulia uwongo Mwenyezi Mungu hawatafanikiwa.
translation_en: Say, "Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allah will not succeed."

arabic_text: مَتَٰعٌۭ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ نُذِيقُهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلشَّدِيدَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ
translation_sw: Hiyo ni starehe ya katika dunia tu, kisha marejeo yao ni kwetu. Tena tutawaonjesha adhabu kali kwa sababu ya kukufuru kwao.
translation_en: [For them is brief] enjoyment in this world; then to Us is their return; then We will make them taste the severe punishment because they used to disbelieve

arabic_text: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ نُوحٍ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَٰقَوْمِ إِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكُم مَّقَامِى وَتَذْكِيرِى بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ فَأَجْمِعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَكُمْ وَشُرَكَآءَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُنْ أَمْرُكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ غُمَّةًۭ ثُمَّ ٱقْضُوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ وَلَا تُنظِرُونِ
translation_sw: Wasomee khabari za Nuhu alipo waambia watu wake: Enyi watu wangu! Ikiwa kukaa kwangu nanyi na kukumbusha kwangu kwa Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu kunakutieni mashaka basi mimi namtegemea Mwenyezi Mungu. Nanyi tengezeni mambo yenu pamoja na washirika wenu, na wala mambo yenu yasifichikane kwenu. Kisha nihukumuni, wala msinipe muhula.
translation_en: And recite to them the news of Noah, when he said to his people, "O my people, if my residence and my reminding of the signs of Allah has become burdensome upon you - then I have relied upon Allah. So resolve upon your plan and [call upon] your associates. Then let not your plan be obscure to you. Then carry it out upon me and do not give me respite.

arabic_text: فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَمَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Lakini mkigeuka, basi mimi sikukuombeni ujira. Ujira wangu hauko ila kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Na nimeamrishwa niwe miongoni mwa Waislamu.
translation_en: And if you turn away [from my advice] then no payment have I asked of you. My reward is only from Allah, and I have been commanded to be of the Muslims."

arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ خَلَٰٓئِفَ وَأَغْرَقْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_sw: Wakamkanusha. Basi tukamwokoa, pamoja na walio kuwa naye, katika jahazi. Na tukawafanya wao ndio walio bakia, na tukawazamisha walio zikanusha Ishara zetu. Basi angalia vipi ulikuwa mwisho wa walio onywa.
translation_en: And they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship and made them successors, and We drowned those who denied Our signs. Then see how was the end of those who were warned.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِمَا كَذَّبُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَطْبَعُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha baada yake tukawatuma Mitume kwa watu wao. Nao wakawajia kwa Ishara zilizo wazi. Lakini hawakuwa wenye kuyaamini waliyo yakanusha kabla yake. Ndio kama hivyo tunapiga muhuri juu ya nyoyo za warukao mipaka.
translation_en: Then We sent after him messengers to their peoples, and they came to them with clear proofs. But they were not to believe in that which they had denied before. Thus We seal over the hearts of the transgressors

arabic_text: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha baada yao tukamtuma Musa na Haruni kwa Firauni na waheshimiwa wake, kwa Ishara zetu. Wakajivuna, na wakawa watu wakosefu.
translation_en: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi ilipo wajia Haki kutoka kwetu walisema: Hakika huu ni uchawi dhaahiri.
translation_en: So when there came to them the truth from Us, they said, "Indeed, this is obvious magic."

arabic_text: قَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَتَقُولُونَ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَكُمْ ۖ أَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَا وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّٰحِرُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema Musa: Mnasema hivi juu ya Haki ilipo kujieni? Huu ni uchawi? Na wachawi hawafanikiwi!
translation_en: Moses said, "Do you say [thus] about the truth when it has come to you? Is this magic? But magicians will not succeed."

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَلْفِتَنَا عَمَّا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَا وَتَكُونَ لَكُمَا ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكُمَا بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Je! Umetujia ili utuachishe tuliyo wakuta nayo baba zetu, na mpate nyinyi wawili ukubwa katika nchi? Wala sisi hatukuaminini nyinyi.
translation_en: They said, "Have you come to us to turn us away from that upon which we found our fathers and so that you two may have grandeur in the land? And we are not believers in you."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱئْتُونِى بِكُلِّ سَٰحِرٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Na Firauni akasema: Nileteeni kila mchawi mjuzi!
translation_en: And Pharaoh said, "Bring to me every learned magician."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
translation_sw: Basi walipo kuja wachawi, Musa aliwaambia: Tupeni mnavyo tupa!
translation_en: So when the magicians came, Moses said to them, "Throw down whatever you will throw."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ أَلْقَوْا۟ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئْتُم بِهِ ٱلسِّحْرُ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُۥٓ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
translation_sw: Walipo tupa, Musa alisema: Mliyo leta ni uchawi. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu haitengenezi kazi ya waharibifu.
translation_en: And when they had thrown, Moses said, "What you have brought is [only] magic. Indeed, Allah will expose its worthlessness. Indeed, Allah does not amend the work of corrupters.

arabic_text: وَيُحِقُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu huhakikisha Haki kwa maneno yake, hata wanga chukia wakosefu
translation_en: And Allah will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it."

arabic_text: فَمَآ ءَامَنَ لِمُوسَىٰٓ إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌۭ مِّن قَوْمِهِۦ عَلَىٰ خَوْفٍۢ مِّن فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِمْ أَن يَفْتِنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَعَالٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_sw: Basi hawakumuamini Musa isipo kuwa baadhi ya vijana vya kaumu yake, kwa kumwogopa Firauni na wakuu wao wasiwatese. Kwani hakika Firauni alikuwa jeuri katika nchi. Na kwa yakini alikuwa miongoni mwa walio pita kiasi.
translation_en: But no one believed Moses, except [some] youths among his people, for fear of Pharaoh and his establishment that they would persecute them. And indeed, Pharaoh was haughty within the land, and indeed, he was of the transgressors

arabic_text: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ يَٰقَوْمِ إِن كُنتُمْ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na Musa alisema: Enyi watu wangu! Ikiwa nyinyi mmemuamini Mwenyezi Mungu, basi mtegemeeni Yeye, ikiwa nyinyi ni Waislamu.
translation_en: And Moses said, "O my people, if you have believed in Allah, then rely upon Him, if you should be Muslims."

arabic_text: فَقَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Tunamtegemea Mwenyezi Mungu. Ewe Mola wetu Mlezi! Usitufanye wenye kutiwa misukosuko na hao watu madhaalimu.
translation_en: So they said, "Upon Allah do we rely. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people

arabic_text: وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na utuokoe kwa rehema yako na watu makafiri.
translation_en: And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people."

arabic_text: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَأَخِيهِ أَن تَبَوَّءَا لِقَوْمِكُمَا بِمِصْرَ بُيُوتًۭا وَٱجْعَلُوا۟ بُيُوتَكُمْ قِبْلَةًۭ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukampelekea Musa na ndugu yake wahyi huu: Watengenezeeni majumba watu wenu katika Misri na zifanyeni nyumba zenu ndio mwahali mwa ibada, na mshike Sala, na wabashirie Waumini.
translation_en: And We inspired to Moses and his brother, "Settle your people in Egypt in houses and make your houses [facing the] qiblah and establish prayer and give good tidings to the believers."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ ءَاتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُۥ زِينَةًۭ وَأَمْوَٰلًۭا فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِكَ ۖ رَبَّنَا ٱطْمِسْ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَٱشْدُدْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_sw: Na Musa akasema: Mola wetu Mlezi! Hakika wewe umempa Firauni na wakuu wake mapambo na mali katika maisha ya dunia. Hivyo wanapoteza watu na Njia yako. Mola wetu Mlezi! Yafutilie mbali mali yao na zifunge nyoyo zao, wasiamini mpaka waione adhabu chungu.
translation_en: And Moses said, "Our Lord, indeed You have given Pharaoh and his establishment splendor and wealth in the worldly life, our Lord, that they may lead [men] astray from Your way. Our Lord, obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts so that they will not believe until they see the painful punishment."

arabic_text: قَالَ قَدْ أُجِيبَت دَّعْوَتُكُمَا فَٱسْتَقِيمَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعَآنِّ سَبِيلَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu akasema: Maombi yenu yamekubaliwa. Basi simameni sawa sawa, wala msifuate njia za wale wasio jua.
translation_en: [Allah] said, "Your supplication has been answered." So remain on a right course and follow not the way of those who do not know."

arabic_text: ۞ وَجَٰوَزْنَا بِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ بَغْيًۭا وَعَدْوًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَدْرَكَهُ ٱلْغَرَقُ قَالَ ءَامَنتُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَتْ بِهِۦ بَنُوٓا۟ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Tukawavusha bahari Wana wa Israili, na Firauni na askari wake wakawafuatia kwa dhulma na uadui. Hata Firauni alipo kuwa anataka kuzama akasema: Naamini kuwa hapana mungu ila yule waliye muamini Wana wa Israili, na mimi ni miongoni mwa walio nyenyekea!
translation_en: And We took the Children of Israel across the sea, and Pharaoh and his soldiers pursued them in tyranny and enmity until, when drowning overtook him, he said, "I believe that there is no deity except that in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims."

arabic_text: ءَآلْـَٰٔنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
translation_sw: Ala! Sasa? Na hali uliasi kabla yake na ukawa miongoni mwa mafisadi!
translation_en: Now? And you had disobeyed [Him] before and were of the corrupters?

arabic_text: فَٱلْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا لَغَٰفِلُونَ
translation_sw: Leo, basi, tutakuokoa kwa mwili wako, ili uwe Ishara kwa ajili ya walio nyuma yako. Na hakika watu wengi wameghafilika na Ishara zetu.
translation_en: So today We will save you in body that you may be to those who succeed you a sign. And indeed, many among the people, of Our signs, are heedless

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ بَوَّأْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مُبَوَّأَ صِدْقٍۢ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tuliwaweka Wana wa Is raili kikao chema, na tukawaruzuku vitu vizuri. Nao hawakukhitalifiana mpaka ilipo wafikia ilimu. Hakika Mola wako Mlezi atahukumu baina yao Siku ya Kiyama katika yale waliyo kuwa wakikhitalifiana.
translation_en: And We had certainty settled the Children of Israel in an agreeable settlement and provided them with good things. And they did not differ until [after] knowledge had come to them. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

arabic_text: فَإِن كُنتَ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقْرَءُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ لَقَدْ جَآءَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
translation_sw: Na ikiwa unayo shaka katika tuliyo kuteremshia, basi waulize wasomao Kitabu kabla yako. Kwa yakini imekwisha kujia Haki kutoka kwa Mola wako Mlezi. Basi usiwe miongoni mwa wenye shaka.
translation_en: So if you are in doubt, [O Muhammad], about that which We have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the Scripture before you. The truth has certainly come to you from your Lord, so never be among the doubters.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na kabisa usiwe miongoni mwa wale wanao zikanusha Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu, usije kuwa katika walio khasiri.
translation_en: And never be of those who deny the signs of Allah and [thus] be among the losers.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika wale ambao neno la Mola wako Mlezi limekwisha thibitika juu yao, hawataamini,
translation_en: Indeed, those upon whom the word of your Lord has come into effect will not believe,

arabic_text: وَلَوْ جَآءَتْهُمْ كُلُّ ءَايَةٍ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_sw: Ijapo kuwa itawajia kila Ishara, mpaka waione adhabu iliyo chungu.
translation_en: Even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful punishment.

arabic_text: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwa nini usiwepo mji mmoja ukaamini na Imani yake ikawafaa - isipo kuwa kaumu Yunus? Waliamini na Sisi tukawaondolea adhabu ya hizaya katika maisha ya dunia, na tukawastarehesha kwa muda.
translation_en: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment for a time.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَءَامَنَ مَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ كُلُّهُمْ جَمِيعًا ۚ أَفَأَنتَ تُكْرِهُ ٱلنَّاسَ حَتَّىٰ يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Angeli taka Mola wako Mlezi wangeli amini wote waliomo katika ardhi. Je, wewe utawalazimisha watu kwa nguvu mpaka wawe Waumini?
translation_en: And had your Lord willed, those on earth would have believed - all of them entirely. Then, [O Muhammad], would you compel the people in order that they become believers?

arabic_text: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَن تُؤْمِنَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَيَجْعَلُ ٱلرِّجْسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na hawezi mtu kuamini ila kwa idhini ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Naye hujaalia adhabu iwafike wasio tumia akili zao.
translation_en: And it is not for a soul to believe except by permission of Allah, and He will place defilement upon those who will not use reason.

arabic_text: قُلِ ٱنظُرُوا۟ مَاذَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَا تُغْنِى ٱلْءَايَٰتُ وَٱلنُّذُرُ عَن قَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Angalieni yaliomo mbinguni na kwenye ardhi! Na Ishara zote na maonyo hayawafai kitu watu wasio amini.
translation_en: Say, "Observe what is in the heavens and earth." But of no avail will be signs or warners to a people who do not believe

arabic_text: فَهَلْ يَنتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ قُلْ فَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُنتَظِرِينَ
translation_sw: Basi, je! Wanangojea jingine ila kama yaliyo tokea siku za watu walio pita kabla yao? Ngojeni! Nami ni pamoja nanyi katika wanao ngoja.
translation_en: So do they wait except for like [what occurred in] the days of those who passed on before them? Say, "Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait."

arabic_text: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نُنجِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha Sisi huwaokoa Mitume wetu na walio amini. Ndio kama hivyo, inatustahiki kuwaokoa Waumini.
translation_en: Then We will save our messengers and those who have believed. Thus, it is an obligation upon Us that We save the believers

arabic_text: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن دِينِى فَلَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِنْ أَعْبُدُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Enyi watu! Ikiwa nyinyi mnayo shaka katika Dini yangu, basi mimi siwaabudu mnao waabudu nyinyi badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Lakini mimi namuabudu Mwenyezi Mungu anaye kufisheni. Na nimeamrishwa niwe miongoni mwa Waumini.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "O people, if you are in doubt as to my religion - then I do not worship those which you worship besides Allah; but I worship Allah, who causes your death. And I have been commanded to be of the believers

arabic_text: وَأَنْ أَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًۭا وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
translation_sw: Na uelekeze uso wako kwenye Dini ya Kweli, wala usiwe katika washirikina.
translation_en: And [commanded], 'Direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth, and never be of those who associate others with Allah;

arabic_text: وَلَا تَدْعُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكَ وَلَا يَضُرُّكَ ۖ فَإِن فَعَلْتَ فَإِنَّكَ إِذًۭا مِّنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na wala usiwaombe wasio kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu ambao hawakufai kitu wala hawakudhuru. Ukifanya hivyo basi utakuwa miongoni mwa walio dhulumu.
translation_en: And do not invoke besides Allah that which neither benefits you nor harms you, for if you did, then indeed you would be of the wrongdoers.'"

arabic_text: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّۢ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍۢ فَلَا رَآدَّ لِفَضْلِهِۦ ۚ يُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu akikugusisha madhara, basi hapana wa kukuondolea ila Yeye. Na akikutakia kheri, basi hapana awezaye kurudisha fadhila yake. Huifikisha kwa amtakaye katika waja wake, na Yeye ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him; and if He intends for you good, then there is no repeller of His bounty. He causes it to reach whom He wills of His servants. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful

arabic_text: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيلٍۢ
translation_sw: Sema: Enyi watu! Haki imekwisha kukujieni kutoka kwa Mola wenu Mlezi. Basi anaye ongoka anaongoka kwa faida ya nafsi yake, na anaye potea anapotea kwa khasara ya nafsi yake. Na mimi si mwakilishi juu yenu.
translation_en: Say, "O mankind, the truth has come to you from your Lord, so whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever goes astray only goes astray [in violation] against it. And I am not over you a manager."

arabic_text: وَٱتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَٱصْبِرْ حَتَّىٰ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na wewe fuata yanayo funuliwa kwako kwa wahyi. Na vumilia mpaka Mwenyezi Mungu ahukumu, na Yeye ndiye mbora wa mahakimu.
translation_en: And follow what is revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and be patient until Allah will judge. And He is the best of judges.

arabic_text: الٓر ۚ كِتَٰبٌ أُحْكِمَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ
translation_sw: Alif Lam Ra. Hiki ni Kitabu ambacho Aya zake zimewekwa wazi, kisha zikapambanuliwa, kilicho toka kwa Mwenye Hikima na Mwenye Khabari,
translation_en: Alif, Lam, Ra. [This is] a Book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] Wise and Acquainted.

arabic_text: أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّنِى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ وَبَشِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Ili msimuabudu isipo kuwa Allah, Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika mimi kwenu ni mwonyaji na mbashiri nitokae kwake.
translation_en: [Through a messenger, saying], "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings,"

arabic_text: وَأَنِ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يُمَتِّعْكُم مَّتَٰعًا حَسَنًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِى فَضْلٍۢ فَضْلَهُۥ ۖ وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍۢ كَبِيرٍ
translation_sw: Na ili mumwombe msamaha Mola wenu Mlezi, kisha mtubie kwake. Atakustarehesheni starehe nzuri mpaka muda maalumu. Na atampa kila mwenye fadhila, fadhila yake. Na ikiwa mtakengeuka basi mimi nakukhofieni adhabu ya hiyo Siku Kubwa.
translation_en: And [saying], "Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him, [and] He will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor. But if you turn away, then indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a great Day.

arabic_text: إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
translation_sw: Marejeo yenu ni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu tu. Naye ni Muweza wa kila kitu.
translation_en: To Allah is your return, and He is over all things competent."

arabic_text: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ يَثْنُونَ صُدُورَهُمْ لِيَسْتَخْفُوا۟ مِنْهُ ۚ أَلَا حِينَ يَسْتَغْشُونَ ثِيَابَهُمْ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_sw: Hebu angalia! Ati wanafunika vilivyomo vifuani mwao ili wamfiche Mwenyezi Mungu! Jueni kuwa wanapo jigubika nguo zao Yeye anajua wanayo yaficha na wanayo yatangaza. Hakika Yeye ni Mjuzi wa yaliyomo vifuani.
translation_en: Unquestionably, they the disbelievers turn away their breasts to hide themselves from Him. Unquestionably, [even] when they cover themselves in their clothing, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

arabic_text: ۞ وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا ۚ كُلٌّۭ فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: NA HAKUNA mnyama yoyote katika ardhi ila riziki yake iko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Naye anajua makao yake na mapitio yake. Yote yamo katika Kitabu chenye kubainisha.
translation_en: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَكَانَ عَرْشُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْمَآءِ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۗ وَلَئِن قُلْتَ إِنَّكُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلْمَوْتِ لَيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Na Yeye ndiye aliye ziumba mbingu na ardhi katika siku sita. Na Kiti chake cha Enzi kilikuwa juu ya maji, ili akufanyieni mtihani ajuulikane ni nani miongoni mwenu mzuri zaidi wa vitendo. Na wewe ukisema: Nyinyi hakika mtafufuliwa baada ya kufa; wale walio kufuru husema: Hayakuwa haya ila ni uchawi uliyo wazi.
translation_en: And it is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and His Throne had been upon water - that He might test you as to which of you is best in deed. But if you say, "Indeed, you are resurrected after death," those who disbelieve will surely say, "This is not but obvious magic."

arabic_text: وَلَئِنْ أَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ مَّعْدُودَةٍۢ لَّيَقُولُنَّ مَا يَحْبِسُهُۥٓ ۗ أَلَا يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمْ لَيْسَ مَصْرُوفًا عَنْهُمْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation_sw: Na tukiwacheleweshea adhabu mpaka muda ulio kwisha hisabiwa wao husema: Nini kinacho izuia hiyo adhabu? Jueni! Siku itakapo wajia basi haitoondolewa hiyo kwao. Na yatawazunguka yale waliyo kuwa wakiyafanyia mzaha.
translation_en: And if We hold back from them the punishment for a limited time, they will surely say, "What detains it?" Unquestionably, on the Day it comes to them, it will not be averted from them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

arabic_text: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةًۭ ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَٰهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَـُٔوسٌۭ كَفُورٌۭ
translation_sw: Na tukimwonjesha mtu rehema inayo toka kwetu, kisha tukamwondolea, hukata tamaa akakufuru.
translation_en: And if We give man a taste of mercy from Us and then We withdraw it from him, indeed, he is despairing and ungrateful.

arabic_text: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَٰهُ نَعْمَآءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتُ عَنِّىٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَفَرِحٌۭ فَخُورٌ
translation_sw: Na tukimwonjesha neema baada ya madhara yaliyo mpata husema: Taabu zimekwisha niondokea. Hakika yeye hujitapa na kutafakhari.
translation_en: But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me." Indeed, he is exultant and boastful -

arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Ila wale walio subiri wakatenda mema. Hao watapata msamaha na ujira mkubwa.
translation_en: Except for those who are patient and do righteous deeds; those will have forgiveness and great reward.

arabic_text: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۢ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَضَآئِقٌۢ بِهِۦ صَدْرُكَ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُۥ مَلَكٌ ۚ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ نَذِيرٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَكِيلٌ
translation_sw: Basi labda utaacha baadhi ya yale yaliyo funuliwa kwako, na kifua kitaona dhiki kwa hayo, kwa sababu wanasema: Mbona hakuteremshiwa khazina, au wakaja naye Malaika? Wewe ni mwonyaji tu, na Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mlinzi wa kila kitu.
translation_en: Then would you possibly leave [out] some of what is revealed to you, or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "Why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?" But you are only a warner. And Allah is Disposer of all things.

arabic_text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ مُفْتَرَيَٰتٍۢ وَٱدْعُوا۟ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Au wanasema: Ameizua? Sema: Basi leteni Sura kumi zilizo zuliwa mfano wa hii, na waiteni muwawezao badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu, ikiwa mnasema kweli.
translation_en: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Say, "Then bring ten surahs like it that have been invented and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allah, if you should be truthful."

arabic_text: فَإِلَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ بِعِلْمِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na wasipo kuitikieni, basi jueni ya kwamba (hii Qur'ani) imeteremshwa kwa ujuzi wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na kwamba hapana mungu ila Yeye. Basi je! Nyinyi ni Waislamu?
translation_en: And if they do not respond to you - then know that the Qur'an was revealed with the knowledge of Allah and that there is no deity except Him. Then, would you [not] be Muslims?

arabic_text: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فِيهَا وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يُبْخَسُونَ
translation_sw: Wanao taka maisha ya dunia na pumbao lake tutawalipa humo vitendo vyao kaamili. Na wao humo hawatopunjwa.
translation_en: Whoever desires the life of this world and its adornments - We fully repay them for their deeds therein, and they therein will not be deprived.

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِلَّا ٱلنَّارُ ۖ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوا۟ فِيهَا وَبَٰطِلٌۭ مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Hao ndio ambao hawatakuwa na kitu Akhera ila Moto, na yataharibika waliyo yafanya, na yatapotea bure waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda.
translation_en: Those are the ones for whom there is not in the Hereafter but the Fire. And lost is what they did therein, and worthless is what they used to do.

arabic_text: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌۭ مِّنْهُ وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًۭا وَرَحْمَةً ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ فَٱلنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُۥ ۚ فَلَا تَكُ فِى مِرْيَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Basi je, mtu aliye na dalili wazi itokayo kwa Mola wake Mlezi, inayo fuatwa na shahidi anaye toka kwake, na kabla yake kilikuwa Kitabu cha Musa kilicho kuwa mwongozi na rehema - hao wanamuamini, na anaye mkataa katika makundi, basi Moto ndio pahala pa miadi yao. Basi usiwe na shaka juu ya hayo. Hii ni Haki itokayo kwa Mola wako Mlezi; lakini watu wengi hawaamini.
translation_en: So is one who [stands] upon a clear evidence from his Lord [like the aforementioned]? And a witness from Him follows it, and before it was the Scripture of Moses to lead and as mercy. Those [believers in the former revelations] believe in the Qur'an. But whoever disbelieves in it from the [various] factions - the Fire is his promised destination. So be not in doubt about it. Indeed, it is the truth from your Lord, but most of the people do not believe.

arabic_text: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ أَلَا لَعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na nani aliye dhaalimu mkubwa kuliko yule anaye mzulia Mwenyezi Mungu uwongo? Hao watahudhurishwa mbele ya Mola wao Mlezi, na mashahidi watasema: Hawa ndio walio mtungia uwongo Mola wao Mlezi. Laana ya Mwenyezi Mungu iwapate walio dhulumu,
translation_en: And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah? Those will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, "These are the ones who lied against their Lord." Unquestionably, the curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers.

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًۭا وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao wanazuilia Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu, na wanaitakia ipotoke, na wanaikataa Akhera.
translation_en: Who averted [people] from the way of Allah and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they, concerning the Hereafter, were disbelievers.

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ مُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۘ يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۚ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Hao hawawezi kushinda katika ardhi, wala hawana walinzi isipo kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Watazidishiwa adhabu. Hawakuwa wakiweza kusikia wala hawakuwa wakiona.
translation_en: Those were not causing failure [to Allah] on earth, nor did they have besides Allah any protectors. For them the punishment will be multiplied. They were not able to hear, nor did they see.

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
translation_sw: Hao ndio walio zikhasiri nafsi zao, na yakawapotea waliyo kuwa wakiyazua.
translation_en: Those are the ones who will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.

arabic_text: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
translation_sw: Bila ya shaka hakika wao ndio wenye kukhasiri huko Akhera.
translation_en: Assuredly, it is they in the Hereafter who will be the greatest losers.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَأَخْبَتُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika wale walio amini, na wakatenda mema, na wakanyenyekea kwa Mola wao Mlezi, hao ndio watu wa Peponi, na humo watadumu.
translation_en: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds and humbled themselves to their Lord - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide eternally therein.

arabic_text: ۞ مَثَلُ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ كَٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْأَصَمِّ وَٱلْبَصِيرِ وَٱلسَّمِيعِ ۚ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Mfano wa makundi mawili ni kama kipofu kiziwi, na mwenye kuona na anasikia. Je, wawili hawa wanakuwa sawa kwa kufananishwa? Basi, je, hamfikiri?
translation_en: The example of the two parties is like the blind and deaf, and the seeing and hearing. Are they equal in comparison? Then, will you not remember?

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
translation_sw: Na Sisi tulimtuma Nuhu kwa watu wake, akawaambia: Hakika mimi ni mwonyaji kwenu ninaye bainisha,
translation_en: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Indeed, I am to you a clear warner

arabic_text: أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Ya kwamba msimuabudu isipo kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu tu. Hakika mimi ninakukhofieni adhabu ya Siku Chungu.
translation_en: That you not worship except Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a painful day."

arabic_text: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا نَرَىٰكَ إِلَّا بَشَرًۭا مِّثْلَنَا وَمَا نَرَىٰكَ ٱتَّبَعَكَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِىَ ٱلرَّأْىِ وَمَا نَرَىٰ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِن فَضْلٍۭ بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كَٰذِبِينَ
translation_sw: Na wakasema wakuu walio kufuru katika kaumu yake: Hatukuoni wewe ila ni mtu tu kama sisi, wala hatukuoni wamekufuata ila wale walio kuwa kwetu watu duni, wasio kuwa na akili. Wala hatukuoneni kuwa mna ubora wowote kutushinda sisi. Bali tuna hakika nyinyi ni waongo.
translation_en: So the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "We do not see you but as a man like ourselves, and we do not see you followed except by those who are the lowest of us [and] at first suggestion. And we do not see in you over us any merit; rather, we think you are liars."

arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّى وَءَاتَىٰنِى رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِهِۦ فَعُمِّيَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنُلْزِمُكُمُوهَا وَأَنتُمْ لَهَا كَٰرِهُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Enyi watu wangu! Hebu fikirini! Ikiwa mimi ninayo hoja wazi iliyo toka kwa Mola wangu Mlezi, na amenipa rehema kutoka kwake, nayo ikakufichikieni; je, tukulazimisheni kuikubali hali nyinyi mnaichukia?
translation_en: He said, "O my people have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord while He has given me mercy from Himself but it has been made unapparent to you, should we force it upon you while you are averse to it?

arabic_text: وَيَٰقَوْمِ لَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مَالًا ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُوا۟ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَٰكِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُمْ قَوْمًۭا تَجْهَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na enyi watu wangu! Mimi sikuombeni mali kwa ajili ya haya. Mimi sina ujira ila kwa Mwenyezi Mungu; na mimi sitawafukuza walio amini. Hakika wao watakutana na Mola wao Mlezi, lakini mimi nakuoneni mnafanya ujinga.
translation_en: And O my people, I ask not of you for it any wealth. My reward is not but from Allah. And I am not one to drive away those who have believed. Indeed, they will meet their Lord, but I see that you are a people behaving ignorantly.

arabic_text: وَيَٰقَوْمِ مَن يَنصُرُنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِن طَرَدتُّهُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Na enyi watu wangu! Ni nani atakaye nisaidia kwa Mwenyezi Mungu nikiwafukuza hawa? Basi je, hamfikiri?
translation_en: And O my people, who would protect me from Allah if I drove them away? Then will you not be reminded?

arabic_text: وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِى خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ إِنِّى مَلَكٌۭ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِىٓ أَعْيُنُكُمْ لَن يُؤْتِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرًا ۖ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Wala sikwambiini kuwa nina khazina za Mwenyezi Mungu; wala kuwa mimi najua mambo ya ghaibu; wala sisemi: Mimi ni Malaika. Wala siwasemi wale ambao yanawadharau macho yenu kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu hatawapa kheri - Mwenyezi Mungu anajua yaliomo katika nafsi zao - hapo bila ya shaka ninge kuwa miongoni mwa wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: And I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allah or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel, nor do I say of those upon whom your eyes look down that Allah will never grant them any good. Allah is most knowing of what is within their souls. Indeed, I would then be among the wrongdoers."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ يَٰنُوحُ قَدْ جَٰدَلْتَنَا فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَٰلَنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ewe Nuhu! Umejadiliana, na umekithirisha kutujadili. Basi tuletee hayo unayo tuahidi, ukiwa miongoni mwa wasemao kweli.
translation_en: They said, "O Noah, you have disputed us and been frequent in dispute of us. So bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful."

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ إِن شَآءَ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mwenyezi Mungu atakuleteeni akipenda. Wala nyinyi si wenye kumshinda.
translation_en: He said, "Allah will only bring it to you if He wills, and you will not cause [Him] failure.

arabic_text: وَلَا يَنفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِىٓ إِنْ أَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَنصَحَ لَكُمْ إِن كَانَ ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَن يُغْوِيَكُمْ ۚ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Wala nasaha yangu haikufaini kitu nikitaka kukunasihini, ikiwa Mwenyezi Mungu anataka kukuachieni mpotee. Yeye ndiye Mola wenu Mlezi; na kwake mtarejeshwa.
translation_en: And my advice will not benefit you - although I wished to advise you - If Allah should intend to put you in error. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned."

arabic_text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ إِنِ ٱفْتَرَيْتُهُۥ فَعَلَىَّ إِجْرَامِى وَأَنَا۠ بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ
translation_sw: Au ndio wanasema: Ameizua? Sema: Ikiwa nimeizua, basi kosa hilo ni juu yangu, na mimi sikhusiki na makosa myatendayo.
translation_en: Or do they say [about Prophet Muhammad], "He invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but I am innocent of what [crimes] you commit."

arabic_text: وَأُوحِىَ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ أَنَّهُۥ لَن يُؤْمِنَ مِن قَوْمِكَ إِلَّا مَن قَدْ ءَامَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na akafunuliwa Nuhu akaambiwa: Hataamini yeyote katika watu wako ila wale walio kwisha amini. Basi usisikitike kwa waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda.
translation_en: And it was revealed to Noah that, "No one will believe from your people except those who have already believed, so do not be distressed by what they have been doing.

arabic_text: وَٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
translation_sw: Na unda jahazi mbele ya macho yetu na kwa mujibu wa ufunuo wetu. Wala usinisemeze kuwatetea walio dhulumu. Kwani hao bila ya shaka watazamishwa.
translation_en: And construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration and do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are [to be] drowned."

arabic_text: وَيَصْنَعُ ٱلْفُلْكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌۭ مِّن قَوْمِهِۦ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُ ۚ قَالَ إِن تَسْخَرُوا۟ مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na akawa anaunda jahazi, na kila wakipita wakuu wa kaumu yake wakimkejeli. Yeye akasema: Ikiwa nyinyi mnatukejeli na sisi tunakukejelini kama mnavyo tukejeli.
translation_en: And he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said, "If you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule.

arabic_text: فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌۭ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌۭ مُّقِيمٌ
translation_sw: Nanyi mtakuja jua ni nani itakaye mfikia adhabu ya kumhizi, na itakaye mteremkia adhabu ya kudumu.
translation_en: And you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the Hereafter]."

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا ٱحْمِلْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ وَمَنْ ءَامَنَ ۚ وَمَآ ءَامَنَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌۭ
translation_sw: Hata ilipo kuja amri yetu, na tanuri ikafoka maji, tulisema: Pakia humo wawili wawili, dume na jike, kutoka kila aina, na ahali zako, isipo kuwa wale ambao imekwisha wapitia hukumu; na watu walio amini. Na hawakuamini pamoja naye ila wachache tu.
translation_en: [So it was], until when Our command came and the oven overflowed, We said, "Load upon the ship of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." But none had believed with him, except a few.

arabic_text: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱرْكَبُوا۟ فِيهَا بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ مَجْر۪ىٰهَا وَمُرْسَىٰهَآ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَغَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na akasema: Pandeni humo kwa Bismillahi, Kwa Jina la Mwenyezi Mungu, kwenda kwake na kusimama kwake. Hakika Mola wangu Mlezi ni Mwenye kusamehe Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And [Noah] said, "Embark therein; in the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."

arabic_text: وَهِىَ تَجْرِى بِهِمْ فِى مَوْجٍۢ كَٱلْجِبَالِ وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ ٱبْنَهُۥ وَكَانَ فِى مَعْزِلٍۢ يَٰبُنَىَّ ٱرْكَب مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُن مَّعَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Ikawa inakwenda nao katika mawimbi kama milima. Na Nuhu akamwita mwanawe naye alikuwa mbali: Ewe mwanangu! Panda pamoja nasi, wala usiwe pamoja na makafiri.
translation_en: And it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and Noah called to his son who was apart [from them], "O my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers."

arabic_text: قَالَ سَـَٔاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ جَبَلٍۢ يَعْصِمُنِى مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ ۚ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ۚ وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُغْرَقِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Nitakimbilia mlimani unilinde na maji. (Nuhu) akasema: Leo hapana wa kulindwa na amri ya Mwenyezi Mungu ila aliye mrehemu mwenyewe. Na wimbi likawatenganisha, akawa katika walio zama.
translation_en: [But] he said, "I will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water." [Noah] said, "There is no protector today from the decree of Allah, except for whom He gives mercy." And the waves came between them, and he was among the drowned.

arabic_text: وَقِيلَ يَٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na ikasemwa: Ewe ardhi! Meza maji yako. Na Ewe mbingu! Jizuie. Basi maji yakadidimia chini, na amri ikapitishwa, na (jahazi) likasimama juu ya (mlima) wa Al Juudiy. Na ikasemwa: Wapotelee mbali watu walio dhulumu!
translation_en: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] Judiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people."

arabic_text: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na Nuhu alimwomba Mola wake Mlezi: Ee Mola Mlezi wangu! Hakika mwanangu ni katika ahali zangu, na hakika ahadi yako ni haki. Na Wewe ni Mwenye haki kuliko mahakimu wote.
translation_en: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!"

arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰنُوحُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَٰلِحٍۢ ۖ فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَعِظُكَ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Ewe Nuhu! Huyu si katika ahali zako. Mwendo wake si mwema. Basi usiniombe jambo usio na ujuzi nalo. Mimi nakuwaidhi usije ukawa miongoni mwa wajinga.
translation_en: He said, "O Noah, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is [one whose] work was other than righteous, so ask Me not for that about which you have no knowledge. Indeed, I advise you, lest you be among the ignorant."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِى وَتَرْحَمْنِىٓ أَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
translation_sw: Nuhu akasema: Ewe Mola wangu Mlezi! Mimi najikinga kwako nisikuombe nisio na ujuzi nalo. Na kama hunisamehe na ukanirehemu, nitakuwa katika walio khasiri.
translation_en: [Noah] said, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers."

arabic_text: قِيلَ يَٰنُوحُ ٱهْبِطْ بِسَلَٰمٍۢ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكَٰتٍ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍۢ مِّمَّن مَّعَكَ ۚ وَأُمَمٌۭ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Ikasemwa: Ewe Nuhu! Shuka kwa salama itokayo kwetu, na baraka nyingi juu yako na juu ya watu walio pamoja nawe. Na zitakuwapo kaumu tutakazo zistarehesha, na kisha zitashikwa na adhabu chungu itokayo kwetu.
translation_en: It was said, "O Noah, disembark in security from Us and blessings upon you and upon nations [descending] from those with you. But other nations [of them] We will grant enjoyment; then there will touch them from Us a painful punishment."

arabic_text: تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَآ إِلَيْكَ ۖ مَا كُنتَ تَعْلَمُهَآ أَنتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِن قَبْلِ هَٰذَا ۖ فَٱصْبِرْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلْعَٰقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_sw: Hizi ni katika khabari za ghaibu tunazo kufunulia. Hukuwa ukizijua wewe, wala watu wako, kabla ya hii. Basi subiri! Hakika Mwisho ni wa wachamngu.
translation_en: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muhammad]. You knew it not, neither you nor your people, before this. So be patient; indeed, the [best] outcome is for the righteous.

arabic_text: وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na kwa kina A'adi tulimtuma ndugu yao Hud. Akasema: Enyi watu wangu! Muabuduni Mwenyezi Mungu! Nyinyi hamna mungu isipo kuwa Yeye. Nyinyi si chochote ila ni wazushi tu.
translation_en: And to 'Aad [We sent] their brother Hud. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. You are not but inventors [of falsehood].

arabic_text: يَٰقَوْمِ لَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِىٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Enyi watu wangu! Sikuombeni ujira kwa ajili ya haya. Haukuwa ujira wangu ila kwa Yule aliye niumba. Basi hamtumii akili?
translation_en: O my people, I do not ask you for it any reward. My reward is only from the one who created me. Then will you not reason?

arabic_text: وَيَٰقَوْمِ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na enyi watu wangu! Muombeni msamaha Mola wenu Mlezi, kisha mtubie kwake. Atakuleteeni mbingu zenye kunyesha mvua ya kumiminika, na atakuzidishieni nguvu juu ya nguvu zenu. Wala msigeuke mkawa wakosefu.
translation_en: And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in showers and increase you in strength [added] to your strength. And do not turn away, [being] criminals."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ يَٰهُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍۢ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِىٓ ءَالِهَتِنَا عَن قَوْلِكَ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ewe Hud! Hujatuletea dalili wazi. Wala sisi hatuiachi miungu yetu kwa kufuata kauli yako. Na wala sisi hatukuamini wewe.
translation_en: They said, "O Hud, you have not brought us clear evidence, and we are not ones to leave our gods on your say-so. Nor are we believers in you.

arabic_text: إِن نَّقُولُ إِلَّا ٱعْتَرَىٰكَ بَعْضُ ءَالِهَتِنَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ ۗ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ وَٱشْهَدُوٓا۟ أَنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Sisi tunasema: Baadhi katika miungu yetu imekusibu kwa baa. Akasema: Hakika mimi namshuhudisha Mwenyezi Mungu, na nyinyi shuhudieni, ya kwamba mimi najitenga mbali na hao mnao wafanya washirika,
translation_en: We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil." He said, "Indeed, I call Allah to witness, and witness [yourselves] that I am free from whatever you associate with Allah

arabic_text: مِن دُونِهِۦ ۖ فَكِيدُونِى جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ لَا تُنظِرُونِ
translation_sw: Mkamwacha Yeye. Basi nyote nyinyi nipangieni vitimbi, na kisha msinipe muhula!
translation_en: Other than Him. So plot against me all together; then do not give me respite.

arabic_text: إِنِّى تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم ۚ مَّا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذٌۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika mimi nimemtegemea Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wangu na Mola Mlezi wenu. Hapana kiumbe yeyote ila Yeye anamwendesha atakavyo. Hakika Mola wangu Mlezi yuko juu ya Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: Indeed, I have relied upon Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds its forelock. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight."

arabic_text: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّى قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُۥ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌۭ
translation_sw: Na ikiwa watarudi nyuma, basi mimi nimekwisha kufikishieni niliyo tumwa kwenu. Na Mola wangu Mlezi atawaleta watu wengine badala yenu, wala nyinyi hamumdhuru kitu Yeye. Hakika Mola wangu Mlezi ni Mwenye kuhifadhi kila kitu.
translation_en: But if they turn away, [say], "I have already conveyed that with which I was sent to you. My Lord will give succession to a people other than you, and you will not harm Him at all. Indeed my Lord is, over all things, Guardian."

arabic_text: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍۢ
translation_sw: Ilipo fika amri yetu, tulimwokoa Hud na walio amini pamoja naye, kwa rehema itokayo kwetu. Na tukawaokoa na adhabu ngumu.
translation_en: And when Our command came, We saved Hud and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us; and We saved them from a harsh punishment.

arabic_text: وَتِلْكَ عَادٌۭ ۖ جَحَدُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا۟ رُسُلَهُۥ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Na hao ndio kina A'adi. Walizikanusha Ishara za Mola wao Mlezi, na wakawaasi Mitume wake, na wakafuata amri ya kila jabari mwenye inda.
translation_en: And that was 'Aad, who rejected the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant.

arabic_text: وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةًۭ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ عَادًۭا كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًۭا لِّعَادٍۢ قَوْمِ هُودٍۢ
translation_sw: Na wakafuatishiwa laana katika dunia hii na Siku ya Kiyama. Basi tambueni mtanabahi! Hakika kina A'adi walimkufuru Mola wao Mlezi. Na tambueni mtanabahi kuwa hakika waliangamizwa kina A'adi, kaumu ya Hud.
translation_en: And they were [therefore] followed in this world with a curse and [as well] on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, 'Aad denied their Lord; then away with 'Aad, the people of Hud.

arabic_text: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى قَرِيبٌۭ مُّجِيبٌۭ
translation_sw: Na kina Thamud tuliwapelekea ndugu yao Saleh. Akasema: Enyi watu wangu! Muabuduni Mwenyezi Mungu. Nyinyi hamna Mungu ila Yeye. Yeye ndiye aliye kuumbeni katika ardhi, na akakuwekeni humo. Basi mwombeni msamaha, kisha mtubu kwake. Hakika Mola wangu Mlezi yupo karibu, anaitikia maombi.
translation_en: And to Thamud [We sent] their brother Salih. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ يَٰصَٰلِحُ قَدْ كُنتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّۭا قَبْلَ هَٰذَآ ۖ أَتَنْهَىٰنَآ أَن نَّعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍۢ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ewe Saleh! Hakika kabla ya haya ulikuwa unatarajiwa kheri kwetu. Je, unatukataza tusiwaabudu waliyo kuwa wakiwaabudu baba zetu? Na hakika sisi tuna shaka na wasiwasi kwa hayo unayo tuitia.
translation_en: They said, "O Salih, you were among us a man of promise before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? And indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."

arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّى وَءَاتَىٰنِى مِنْهُ رَحْمَةًۭ فَمَن يَنصُرُنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ عَصَيْتُهُۥ ۖ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِى غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Akasema: Enyi watu wangu! Mwaonaje ikiwa ninazo dalili zilizo wazi kutokana na Mola wangu Mlezi, naye akawa kanipa rehema kutoka kwake - je, ni nani atakaye ninusuru kwa Mwenyezi Mungu nikimuasi? Basi nyinyi hamtanizidishia ila khasara tu.
translation_en: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has given me mercy from Himself, who would protect me from Allah if I disobeyed Him? So you would not increase me except in loss.

arabic_text: وَيَٰقَوْمِ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةُ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ ءَايَةًۭ فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِىٓ أَرْضِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌۭ قَرِيبٌۭ
translation_sw: Enyi watu wangu! Huyu ngamia wa Mwenyezi Mungu ni Ishara kwenu. Basi mwacheni ale katika ardhi ya Mwenyezi Mungu; wala msimguse kwa ubaya, isije ikakuangamizeni adhabu iliyo karibu.
translation_en: And O my people, this is the she-camel of Allah - [she is] to you a sign. So let her feed upon Allah 's earth and do not touch her with harm, or you will be taken by an impending punishment."

arabic_text: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فِى دَارِكُمْ ثَلَٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍۢ
translation_sw: Wakamchinja. Basi (Saleh) akasema: Stareheni katika mji wenu muda wa siku tatu. Hiyo ni ahadi isiyo kuwa ya uwongo.
translation_en: But they hamstrung her, so he said, "Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. That is a promise not to be denied."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَٰلِحًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَمِنْ خِزْىِ يَوْمِئِذٍ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
translation_sw: Basi ilipo kuja amri yetu tulimwokoa Saleh na wale walio amini pamoja naye kwa rehema yetu kutokana na hizaya ya siku ile. Hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye Mwenye nguvu Mwenye kushinda.
translation_en: So when Our command came, We saved Salih and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and [saved them] from the disgrace of that day. Indeed, it is your Lord who is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.

arabic_text: وَأَخَذَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَٰرِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na ukelele uliwaangamiza wale walio dhulumu, wakapambazukiwa nao ni maiti majumbani mwao.
translation_en: And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone

arabic_text: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَآ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ثَمُودَا۟ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًۭا لِّثَمُودَ
translation_sw: Kama kwamba hawakuwako huko. Hebu zingatieni! Hakika kina Thamud walimkufuru Mola wao Mlezi. Hebu zingatieni! Thamud wamepotelea mbali!
translation_en: As if they had never prospered therein. Unquestionably, Thamud denied their Lord; then, away with Thamud.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ ۖ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَن جَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍۢ
translation_sw: Na wajumbe wetu walimjia Ibrahim kwa bishara njema, wakasema: Salama! Naye akasema: Salama! Hakukaa ila mara akaleta ndama wa kuchoma.
translation_en: And certainly did Our messengers come to Abraham with good tidings; they said, "Peace." He said, "Peace," and did not delay in bringing [them] a roasted calf.

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَءَآ أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۚ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِ لُوطٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi alipoona mikono yao haimfikilii aliwatilia shaka, na akawaogopa. Wakasema: Usiogope! Hakika sisi tumetumwa kwa kaumu ya Lut'.
translation_en: But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not. We have been sent to the people of Lot."

arabic_text: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ قَآئِمَةٌۭ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَٰهَا بِإِسْحَٰقَ وَمِن وَرَآءِ إِسْحَٰقَ يَعْقُوبَ
translation_sw: Na mkewe alikuwa kasimama wima, akacheka. Basi tukambashiria (kuzaliwa) Is-haq, na baada ya Is-haq Yaaqub.
translation_en: And his Wife was standing, and she smiled. Then We gave her good tidings of Isaac and after Isaac, Jacob.

arabic_text: قَالَتْ يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰٓ ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا۠ عَجُوزٌۭ وَهَٰذَا بَعْلِى شَيْخًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌۭ
translation_sw: Akasema: Je, hivyo mimi nizae, na hali yangu ni kikongwe na huyu mume wangu ni kizee? Hakika haya ni mambo ya ajabu!
translation_en: She said, "Woe to me! Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing!"

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ رَحْمَتُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَٰتُهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَمِيدٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Je, unastaajabia amri ya Mwenyezi Mungu? Rehema ya Mwenyezi Mungu na baraka zake ziko juu yenu, enyi watu wa nyumba hii! Hakika Yeye ndiye Msifiwa wa kutukuzwa.
translation_en: They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلرَّوْعُ وَجَآءَتْهُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ يُجَٰدِلُنَا فِى قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
translation_sw: Basi khofu ilipo mwondoka Ibrahim, na ikawa ile bishara imemfikia, alianza kujadiliana nasi juu ya kaumu ya Lut'.
translation_en: And when the fright had left Abraham and the good tidings had reached him, he began to argue with Us concerning the people of Lot.

arabic_text: إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّٰهٌۭ مُّنِيبٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika Ibrahim alikuwa mpole, ana huruma, na mwepesi wa kurejea kwa Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: Indeed, Abraham was forbearing, grieving and [frequently] returning [to Allah].

arabic_text: يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَٰذَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ قَدْ جَآءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَإِنَّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍۢ
translation_sw: (Akaambiwa): Ewe Ibrahim! Wachilia mbali haya! Kwa hakika amri ya Mola wako Mlezi imekwisha kuja, na hakika hao itawafikia adhabu isiyo rudi nyuma.
translation_en: [The angels said], "O Abraham, give up this [plea]. Indeed, the command of your Lord has come, and indeed, there will reach them a punishment that cannot be repelled."

arabic_text: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًۭا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًۭا وَقَالَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌۭ
translation_sw: Na wajumbe wetu walipo kuja kwa Lut' aliwahuzunukia na akawaonea dhiki. Akasema: Hii leo ni siku ngumu!
translation_en: And when Our messengers, [the angels], came to Lot, he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort and said, "This is a trying day."

arabic_text: وَجَآءَهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِى هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِى ضَيْفِىٓ ۖ أَلَيْسَ مِنكُمْ رَجُلٌۭ رَّشِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Wakamjia kaumu yake mbio mbio. Na kabla ya haya walikuwa wakitenda maovu. Yeye akasema: Enyi watu wangu! Hawa binti zangu, ndio wametakasika zaidi kwenu. Basi mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu, wala msinihizi mbele ya wageni wangu. Hivyo, hamna hata mtu mmoja miongoni mwenu aliye ongoka?
translation_en: And his people came hastening to him, and before [this] they had been doing evil deeds. He said, "O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. So fear Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِى بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّۢ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Bila shaka umekwisha jua hatuna haki juu ya binti zako, na unayajua tunayo yataka.
translation_en: They said, "You have already known that we have not concerning your daughters any claim, and indeed, you know what we want."

arabic_text: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Akasema: Laiti ningeli kuwa na nguvu kwenu, au nategemea kwenye nguzo yenye nguvu!
translation_en: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ يَٰلُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكَ ۖ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مُصِيبُهَا مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ ٱلصُّبْحُ ۚ أَلَيْسَ ٱلصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍۢ
translation_sw: (Wajumbe) wakasema: Ewe Lut'! Sisi ni wajumbe wa Mola wako Mlezi. Hawa hawatakufikia. Na wewe ondoka pamoja na ahali zako usiku ungalipo. Wala yeyote miongoni mwenu asitazame nyuma, isipo kuwa mkeo, kwani yeye utamfika msiba utakao wafika hao. Hakika miadi yao ni asubuhi. Je, asubuhi si karibu?
translation_en: The angels said, "O Lot, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; [therefore], they will never reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night and let not any among you look back - except your wife; indeed, she will be struck by that which strikes them. Indeed, their appointment is [for] the morning. Is not the morning near?"

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
