arabic_text: ۞ وَإِن تَعْجَبْ فَعَجَبٌۭ قَوْلُهُمْ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًا أَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍ ۗ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَغْلَٰلُ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation_sw: Na kama ukistaajabu, basi cha ajabu zaidi ni huo usemi wao: Ati tukisha kuwa mchanga kweli tutakuwa katika umbo jipya? Hao ndio walio mkufuru Mola wao Mlezi. Na hao ndio watao kuwa na makongwa shingoni mwao, na hao ndio watu wa Motoni. Humo watadumu.
translation_en: And if you are astonished, [O Muhammad] - then astonishing is their saying, "When we are dust, will we indeed be [brought] into a new creation?" Those are the ones who have disbelieved in their Lord, and those will have shackles upon their necks, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

arabic_text: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِمُ ٱلْمَثُلَٰتُ ۗ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍۢ لِّلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ ظُلْمِهِمْ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
translation_sw: Na wanakuhimiza ulete maovu kabla ya mema, hali ya kuwa zimekwisha pita kabla yao adhabu za kupigiwa mfano. Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi ni Mwenye msamaha kwa watu juu ya udhalimu wao. Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi ni Mkali wa kuadhibu.
translation_en: They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. And indeed, your Lord is full of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty.

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَلِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ هَادٍ
translation_sw: Na wale walio kufuru husema: Mbona hakuteremshiwa muujiza kutoka kwa Mola wake Mlezi? Hakika wewe ni Mwonyaji, na kila kaumu ina wa kuwaongoa.
translation_en: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" You are only a warner, and for every people is a guide.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنثَىٰ وَمَا تَغِيضُ ٱلْأَرْحَامُ وَمَا تَزْدَادُ ۖ وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ عِندَهُۥ بِمِقْدَارٍ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu anajua mimba abebayo kila mwanamke, na kinacho punguka na kuzidi matumboni. Na kila kitu kwake ni kwa kipimo.
translation_en: Allah knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed. And everything with Him is by due measure.

arabic_text: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ٱلْمُتَعَالِ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye Mwenye kujua yanayo onekana na yasio onekana; Mkuu Aliye tukuka.
translation_en: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.

arabic_text: سَوَآءٌۭ مِّنكُم مَّنْ أَسَرَّ ٱلْقَوْلَ وَمَن جَهَرَ بِهِۦ وَمَنْ هُوَ مُسْتَخْفٍۭ بِٱلَّيْلِ وَسَارِبٌۢ بِٱلنَّهَارِ
translation_sw: Ni sawa anaye ficha kauli yake kati yenu na anaye idhihirisha, na anaye jibanza usiku na anaye tembea jahara mchana.
translation_en: It is the same [to Him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or one publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day.

arabic_text: لَهُۥ مُعَقِّبَٰتٌۭ مِّنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ يَحْفَظُونَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا۟ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ ۗ وَإِذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍۢ سُوٓءًۭا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَالٍ
translation_sw: Kila mtu analo kundi la malaika mbele yake na nyuma yake linamlinda kwa amri ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu habadili yaliyoko kwa watu mpaka wabadili wao yaliyomo naf- sini mwao. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anapo watakia watu adhabu hakuna cha kuzuia wala hawana mlinzi yeyote badala yake.
translation_en: For each one are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allah. Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allah intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron.

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًۭا وَيُنشِئُ ٱلسَّحَابَ ٱلثِّقَالَ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye anaye kuonyesheni umeme kwa khofu na tamaa, na huyaleta mawingu mazito.
translation_en: It is He who shows you lightening, [causing] fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds.

arabic_text: وَيُسَبِّحُ ٱلرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِۦ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقَ فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُمْ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْمِحَالِ
translation_sw: Na radi inamtakasa Mwenyezi Mungu kwa kumhimidi, na Malaika pia, kwa kumkhofu. Naye hupeleka mapigo ya radi yakampata amtakaye. Nao wanabishana juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na Yeye ni Mwenye adhabu kali!
translation_en: And the thunder exalts [Allah] with praise of Him - and the angels [as well] from fear of Him - and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills while they dispute about Allah; and He is severe in assault.

arabic_text: لَهُۥ دَعْوَةُ ٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُونَ لَهُم بِشَىْءٍ إِلَّا كَبَٰسِطِ كَفَّيْهِ إِلَى ٱلْمَآءِ لِيَبْلُغَ فَاهُ وَمَا هُوَ بِبَٰلِغِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا دُعَآءُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ
translation_sw: Wa kuombwa kweli ni Yeye tu. Na hao wanao waomba badala yake hawawajibu chochote; bali ni kama mwenye kunyoosha viganja vyake kwenye maji ili yafike kinywani mwake, lakini hayafiki. Na maombi ya makafiri hayako ila katika upotovu.
translation_en: To Him [alone] is the supplication of truth. And those they call upon besides Him do not respond to them with a thing, except as one who stretches his hands toward water [from afar, calling it] to reach his mouth, but it will not reach it [thus]. And the supplication of the disbelievers is not but in error [i.e. futility].

arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ طَوْعًۭا وَكَرْهًۭا وَظِلَٰلُهُم بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلْءَاصَالِ ۩
translation_sw: Na viliomo mbinguni na katika ardhi vinamsujudia Mwenyezi Mungu tu vikitaka visitake. Na pia vivuli vyao asubuhi na jioni.
translation_en: And to Allah prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons.

arabic_text: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًۭا وَلَا ضَرًّۭا ۚ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ أَمْ هَلْ تَسْتَوِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَٱلنُّورُ ۗ أَمْ جَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ خَلَقُوا۟ كَخَلْقِهِۦ فَتَشَٰبَهَ ٱلْخَلْقُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّٰرُ
translation_sw: Sema: Ni nani Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na ardhi? Sema: Mwenyezi Mungu. Sema: Basi je, mnawafanya wenginewe badala yake kuwa ni walinzi, nao hawajifai wenyewe kwa jema wala baya? Sema: Hebu kipofu na mwenye kuona huwa sawa? Au hebu huwa sawa giza na mwangaza? Au wamemfanyia Mwenyezi Mungu washirika walio umba kama alivyo umba Yeye, na viumbe hivyo vikawadanganyikia? Sema: Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Muumba wa kila kitu. Na Yeye ni Mmoja Mwenye kushinda!
translation_en: Say, "Who is Lord of the heavens and earth?" Say, "Allah." Say, "Have you then taken besides Him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Or is darkness equivalent to light? Or have they attributed to Allah partners who created like His creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?" Say, "Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Prevailing."

arabic_text: أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌۢ بِقَدَرِهَا فَٱحْتَمَلَ ٱلسَّيْلُ زَبَدًۭا رَّابِيًۭا ۚ وَمِمَّا يُوقِدُونَ عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلنَّارِ ٱبْتِغَآءَ حِلْيَةٍ أَوْ مَتَٰعٍۢ زَبَدٌۭ مِّثْلُهُۥ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَٱلْبَٰطِلَ ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلزَّبَدُ فَيَذْهَبُ جُفَآءًۭ ۖ وَأَمَّا مَا يَنفَعُ ٱلنَّاسَ فَيَمْكُثُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ
translation_sw: Ameteremsha maji kutoka mbinguni. Na mabonde yakamiminika maji kwa kadiri yake. Na mafuriko yakachukua mapovu yaliyo kusanyika juu yake. Na kutokana na wanavyo yayusha katika moto kwa kutaka mapambo au vyombo hutokea povu vile vile. Namna hivyo Mwenyezi Mungu ndivyo anavyo piga mifano ya Haki na baat'ili. Basi lile povu linapita kama takataka tu basi. Ama kinacho wafaa watu hubakia kwenye ardhi. Hivi ndivyo Mwenyezi Mungu anavyo piga mifano.
translation_en: He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. And from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. Thus Allah presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. Thus does Allah present examples.

arabic_text: لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُۥ لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْحِسَابِ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
translation_sw: Walio muitikia Mola wao Mlezi watapata wema. Na wasio muitikia, hata wangeli kuwa navyo vyote viliomo katika ardhi na mfano wa hivyo, bila ya shaka wangeli vitoa kujikombolea! Hao watapata hisabu mbaya kabisa, na makao yao ni Jahannamu. Na hapo ni pahala pabaya mno!
translation_en: For those who have responded to their Lord is the best [reward], but those who did not respond to Him - if they had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby. Those will have the worst account, and their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place.

arabic_text: ۞ أَفَمَن يَعْلَمُ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ٱلْحَقُّ كَمَنْ هُوَ أَعْمَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
translation_sw: Je! Anaye jua ya kwamba yaliyo teremshwa kwako kutoka kwa Mola wako Mlezi ni Haki ni sawa na aliye kipofu? Wenye akili ndio wanao zingatia,
translation_en: Then is he who knows that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth like one who is blind? They will only be reminded who are people of understanding -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُوفُونَ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَنقُضُونَ ٱلْمِيثَٰقَ
translation_sw: Wale ambao wanatimiza ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu, wala hawavunji maagano.
translation_en: Those who fulfill the covenant of Allah and do not break the contract,

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ وَيَخَافُونَ سُوٓءَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_sw: Na wale ambao huyaunga aliyo amrisha Mwenyezi Mungu yaungwe, na wanaikhofu hisabu mbaya.
translation_en: And those who join that which Allah has ordered to be joined and fear their Lord and are afraid of the evil of [their] account,

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ
translation_sw: Na ambao husubiri kwa kutaka radhi ya Mola wao Mlezi, na wakashika Sala, na wakatoa, kwa siri na kwa uwazi, katika tulivyo wapa; na wakayaondoa maovu kwa wema. Hao ndio watakao pata malipo ya Nyumba ya Akhera.
translation_en: And those who are patient, seeking the countenance of their Lord, and establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them secretly and publicly and prevent evil with good - those will have the good consequence of [this] home -

arabic_text: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن كُلِّ بَابٍۢ
translation_sw: Nayo ni Bustani za milele, wataziingia wao na walio wema miongoni mwa baba zao, na wake zao, na vizazi vyao. Na Malaika wanawaingilia katika kila mlango.
translation_en: Gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their descendants. And the angels will enter upon them from every gate, [saying],

arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُم بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ ۚ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ
translation_sw: (Wakiwaambia) Assalamu Alaikum! Amani iwe juu yenu, kwa sababu ya mlivyo subiri! Basi ni mema mno malipo ya Nyumba ya Akhera.
translation_en: "Peace be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home."

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مِيثَٰقِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۙ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ
translation_sw: Na wale wanao vunja ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu baada ya kuzifunga, na wanakata aliyo amrisha Mwenyezi Mungu yaungwe, na wanafanya fisadi katika nchi: hao ndio watakao pata laana, na watapata Nyumba mbaya.
translation_en: But those who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ وَفَرِحُوا۟ بِٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَٰعٌۭ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu humkunjulia riziki amtakaye, na humkunjia kwa kipimo. Na wamefurahia maisha ya dunia. Na uhai wa dunia kwa kulingana na Akhera si kitu ila ni starehe ndogo.
translation_en: Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment.

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَنْ أَنَابَ
translation_sw: Na wanasema walio kufuru: Kwa nini hakuteremshiwa muujiza kutoka kwa Mola wake Mlezi. Sema: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu humwacha kupotea amtakaye, na humwongoa anaye elekea kwake,
translation_en: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, Allah leaves astray whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him] -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ
translation_sw: Wale walio amini na zikatua nyoyo zao kwa kumkumbuka Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika kwa kumkumbuka Mwenyezi Mungu ndio nyoyo hutua!
translation_en: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured."

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ طُوبَىٰ لَهُمْ وَحُسْنُ مَـَٔابٍۢ
translation_sw: Wale walio amini na wakatenda mema watakuwa na raha na marejeo mazuri.
translation_en: Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return.

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ فِىٓ أُمَّةٍۢ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهَآ أُمَمٌۭ لِّتَتْلُوَا۟ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ قُلْ هُوَ رَبِّى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ مَتَابِ
translation_sw: Ndio kama hivi tumekutuma kwa umma ambao wamekwsiha pita kabla yao umati nyengine, ili uwasomee tunayo kufunulia, na wao wanamkufuru Rahmani, Mwingi wa Rehema! Sema: Yeye ndiye Mola wangu Mlezi. Hapana mungu isipo kuwa Yeye. Juu yake nimetegemea, na kwake ndio marejeo yangu!
translation_en: Thus have We sent you to a community before which [other] communities have passed on so you might recite to them that which We revealed to you, while they disbelieve in the Most Merciful. Say, "He is my Lord; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and to Him is my return."

arabic_text: وَلَوْ أَنَّ قُرْءَانًۭا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ ٱلْجِبَالُ أَوْ قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۗ بَل لِّلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ جَمِيعًا ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَا۟يْـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًۭا ۗ وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ تُصِيبُهُم بِمَا صَنَعُوا۟ قَارِعَةٌ أَوْ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبًۭا مِّن دَارِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِىَ وَعْدُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
translation_sw: Na kama ingeli kuwako Qur'ani ndiyo inayo endeshewa milima, na kupasuliwa ardhi, na kusemeshewa wafu, (basi ingeli kuwa Qur'ani hii). Bali mambo yote ni ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Je, hawajajua walio amini kwamba lau kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu ange penda bila ya shaka angeli waongoa watu wote? Wala walio kufuru hawaachi kusibiwa na balaa kwa waliyo yatenda, au ikawateremkia karibu na nyumbani kwao, mpaka ifike ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu havunji miadi yake.
translation_en: And if there was any qur'an by which the mountains would be removed or the earth would be broken apart or the dead would be made to speak, [it would be this Qur'an], but to Allah belongs the affair entirely. Then have those who believed not accepted that had Allah willed, He would have guided the people, all of them? And those who disbelieve do not cease to be struck, for what they have done, by calamity - or it will descend near their home - until there comes the promise of Allah. Indeed, Allah does not fail in [His] promise.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
translation_sw: Na hakika walifanyiwa kejeli Mitume walio kuwa kabla yako. Na nikawapururia wale walio kufuru, kisha nikawashika! Basi ilikuwaje adhabu yangu!
translation_en: And already were [other] messengers ridiculed before you, and I extended the time of those who disbelieved; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.

arabic_text: أَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَآئِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۗ وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ قُلْ سَمُّوهُمْ ۚ أَمْ تُنَبِّـُٔونَهُۥ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَم بِظَٰهِرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ ۗ بَلْ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مَكْرُهُمْ وَصُدُّوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍۢ
translation_sw: Je! Anaye isimamia kila nafsi kwa yale iliyo yachuma...? Na wamemfanyia Mwenyezi Mungu kuwa na washirika! Sema watajeni. Au ndio mnampa khabari ya yale asiyo yajua katika ardhi; au ni maneno matupu? Bali walio kufuru wamepambiwa vitimbi vyao na wamezuiliwa njia. Na ambaye Mwenyezi Mungu amemwacha apotee basi hana wa kumwongoa.
translation_en: Then is He who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? But to Allah they have attributed partners. Say, "Name them. Or do you inform Him of that which He knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent of speech?" Rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. And whomever Allah leaves astray - there will be for him no guide.

arabic_text: لَّهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَشَقُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍۢ
translation_sw: Wanayo adhabu katika maisha ya dunia, na adhabu ya Akhera hapana shaka ina mashaka zaidi. Na wala hawatakuwa na wa kuwalinda na Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: For them will be punishment in the life of [this] world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe. And they will not have from Allah any protector.

arabic_text: ۞ مَّثَلُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ أُكُلُهَا دَآئِمٌۭ وَظِلُّهَا ۚ تِلْكَ عُقْبَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ ۖ وَّعُقْبَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ ٱلنَّارُ
translation_sw: Mfano wa Bustani waliyo ahidiwa wachamngu, kati yake inapita mito, matunda yake ni ya daima, na pia kivuli chake. Huu ndio mwisho wa wale walio walio jilinda. Na mwisho wa makafiri ni Moto.
translation_en: The example of Paradise, which the righteous have been promised, is [that] beneath it rivers flow. Its fruit is lasting, and its shade. That is the consequence for the righteous, and the consequence for the disbelievers is the Fire.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ مَن يُنكِرُ بَعْضَهُۥ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ وَلَآ أُشْرِكَ بِهِۦٓ ۚ إِلَيْهِ أَدْعُوا۟ وَإِلَيْهِ مَـَٔابِ
translation_sw: Na tulio wapa Kitabu wanafurahia uliyo teremshiwa. Na katika makundi mengine wapo wanao yakataa baadhi ya haya. Sema: Nimeamrishwa nimuabudu Mwenyezi Mungu, na wala nisimshirikishe. Kuendea kwake Yeye ndiyo ninaita, na kwake Yeye ndio marejeo yangu.
translation_en: And [the believers among] those to whom We have given the [previous] Scripture rejoice at what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], but among the [opposing] factions are those who deny part of it. Say, "I have only been commanded to worship Allah and not associate [anything] with Him. To Him I invite, and to Him is my return."

arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ حُكْمًا عَرَبِيًّۭا ۚ وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَآءَهُم بَعْدَمَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا وَاقٍۢ
translation_sw: Na ndio kama hivi tumeiteremsha Qur'ani kuwa ni hukumu kwa lugha ya Kiarabu. Na ukifuata matamanio yao baada ya kukujia ilimu hii, hutakuwa na rafiki wala mlinzi mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: And thus We have revealed it as an Arabic legislation. And if you should follow their inclinations after what has come to you of knowledge, you would not have against Allah any ally or any protector.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًۭا مِّن قَبْلِكَ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا وَذُرِّيَّةًۭ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍۢ كِتَابٌۭ
translation_sw: Na hakika Sisi tulikwisha watuma Mitume kabla yako, na tukajaalia wawe na wake na dhuriya. Na haiwi kwa Mtume kuleta miujiza isipo kuwa kwa idhini ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Kila kipindi kina hukumu yake.
translation_en: And We have already sent messengers before you and assigned to them wives and descendants. And it was not for a messenger to come with a sign except by permission of Allah. For every term is a decree.

arabic_text: يَمْحُوا۟ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيُثْبِتُ ۖ وَعِندَهُۥٓ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu hufuta na huthibitisha ayatakayo. Na asili ya hukumu zote iko kwake.
translation_en: Allah eliminates what He wills or confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.

arabic_text: وَإِن مَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَٰغُ وَعَلَيْنَا ٱلْحِسَابُ
translation_sw: Na ikiwa tukikuonyesha baadhi ya tuliyo waahidi au tukakufisha kabla yake, juu yako wewe ni kufikisha ujumbe na juu yetu ni hisabu.
translation_en: And whether We show you part of what We promise them or take you in death, upon you is only the [duty of] notification, and upon Us is the account.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكْمِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_sw: Je! Hawakuona kwamba tunaifikia ardhi tukiipunguza nchani mwake? Na Mwenyezi Mungu huhukumu, na hapana wa kupinga hukumu yake, naye ni Mwepesi wa kuhisabu.
translation_en: Have they not seen that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? And Allah decides; there is no adjuster of His decision. And He is swift in account.

arabic_text: وَقَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَكْرُ جَمِيعًۭا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلْكُفَّٰرُ لِمَنْ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ
translation_sw: Na walipanga walio kuwa kabla yao, lakini Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mwenye mipango yote. Yeye anajua inayo chuma kila nafsi. Na makafiri watajua ni ya nani nyumba ya mwisho Akhera!
translation_en: And those before them had plotted, but to Allah belongs the plan entirely. He knows what every soul earns, and the disbelievers will know for whom is the final home.

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَسْتَ مُرْسَلًۭا ۚ قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru wanasema: Wewe hukutumwa. Sema: Mwenyezi Mungu anatosha kuwa shahidi baina yangu na nyinyi, na pia yule mwenye ilimu ya Kitabu.
translation_en: And those who have disbelieved say, "You are not a messenger." Say, [O Muhammad], "Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you, and [the witness of] whoever has knowledge of the Scripture."

arabic_text: الٓر ۚ كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ ٱلنَّاسَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation_sw: Alif Lam Ra. (A. L. R.) Hichi ni Kitabu tulicho kiteremsha kwako ili uwatowe watu kwenye giza uwapeleke kwenye muwangaza, kwa idhini ya Mola wao Mlezi, uwafikishe kwenye Njia ya Mwenye nguvu, Msifiwa,
translation_en: Alif, Lam, Ra. [This is] a Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that you might bring mankind out of darknesses into the light by permission of their Lord - to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy -

arabic_text: ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ
translation_sw: Naye ni Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye ni vyake Yeye vyote viliomo katika mbingu na ardhi. Na ole wao makafiri kwa adhabu kali!
translation_en: Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And woe to the disbelievers from a severe punishment

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَحِبُّونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا عَلَى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Wale wanao fadhilisha maisha ya dunia kuliko Akhera, na wanawazuilia watu wasifuate Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu, na wanataka kuipotosha. Hao wamepotelea mbali.
translation_en: The ones who prefer the worldly life over the Hereafter and avert [people] from the way of Allah, seeking to make it (seem) deviant. Those are in extreme error.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِۦ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ ۖ فَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Na hatukumtuma Mtume ila kwa ulimi wa kaumu yake ili apate kuwabainishia. Basi Mwenyezi Mungu humuacha akapotea amtakaye, na akamwongoa amtakaye. Naye ni Mtukufu Mwenye nguvu na Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: And We did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and Allah sends astray [thereby] whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أَنْ أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَذَكِّرْهُم بِأَيَّىٰمِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍۢ
translation_sw: Na tulimtuma Musa pamoja na miujiza yetu, tukamwambia: Watoe watu wako kwenye giza uwapeleke kwenye mwangaza. Na uwakumbushe siku za Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika katika hayo zipo ishara kwa kila mwenye kusubiri akashukuru.
translation_en: And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs, [saying], "Bring out your people from darknesses into the light and remind them of the days of Allah." Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ أَنجَىٰكُم مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na Musa alipo waambia watu wake: Kumbukeni neema ya Mwenyezi Mungu aliyo kujaalieni, pale alipo kuokoeni kutokana na watu wa Firauni walio kupeni adhabu mbaya kabisa, wakiwachinja wenenu wanaume, na wakiwawacha hai wanawake. Na katika hayo ulikuwa mtihani mkubwa unao toka kwa Mola wenu Mlezi.
translation_en: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when Moses said to His people, "Remember the favor of Allah upon you when He saved you from the people of Pharaoh, who were afflicting you with the worst torment and were slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِى لَشَدِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Na alipo tangaza Mola wenu Mlezi: Mkishukuru nitakuzidishieni; na mkikufuru, basi adhabu yangu ni kali.
translation_en: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe.' "

arabic_text: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِن تَكْفُرُوٓا۟ أَنتُمْ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ
translation_sw: Na Musa alisema: Mkikufuru nyinyi na wote waliomo duniani, hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mkwasi, Anajitosha, Msifiwa.
translation_en: And Moses said, "If you should disbelieve, you and whoever is on the earth entirely - indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy."

arabic_text: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٍۢ وَثَمُودَ ۛ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۛ لَا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرَدُّوٓا۟ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِىٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كَفَرْنَا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَفِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَنَآ إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍۢ
translation_sw: Je! Hazikukufikieni khabari za walio kabla yenu? Kaumu ya Nuhu, na A'adi, na Thamud, na walio baada yao, ambao hapana awajuaye ila Mwenyezi Mungu? Mitume wao waliwajia kwa hoja zilizo wazi, na wao wakarudisha mikono yao kwenye vinywa vyao, wakasema: Hakika sisi tumeyakataa hayo mliyo tumwa, na hakika sisi tuna shaka kubwa na mnayo tuitia.
translation_en: Has there not reached you the news of those before you - the people of Noah and 'Aad and Thamud and those after them? No one knows them but Allah. Their messengers brought them clear proofs, but they returned their hands to their mouths and said, "Indeed, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent, and indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."

arabic_text: ۞ قَالَتْ رُسُلُهُمْ أَفِى ٱللَّهِ شَكٌّۭ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِيَغْفِرَ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَصُدُّونَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا فَأْتُونَا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Mitume wao wakasema: Ati pana shaka na Mwenyezi Mungu, Muumba mbingu na ardhi? Yeye anakuiteni apate kukufutieni madhambi yenu, na akupeni muhula mpaka muda ulio wekwa. Wakasema: Nyinyi si chochote ila ni wanaadamu kama sisi. Mnataka kutuzuilia na waliyo kuwa wakiabudu baba zetu. Basi tuleteeni hoja ilio wazi.
translation_en: Their messengers said, "Can there be doubt about Allah, Creator of the heavens and earth? He invites you that He may forgive you of your sins, and He delays your death for a specified term." They said, "You are not but men like us who wish to avert us from what our fathers were worshipping. So bring us a clear authority."

arabic_text: قَالَتْ لَهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ إِن نَّحْنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَآ أَن نَّأْتِيَكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Mitume wao wakawaambia: Sisi kweli si chochote ila ni wanaadamu kama nyinyi. Lakini Mwenyezi Mungu humfanyia hisani amtakaye katika waja wake. Wala sisi hatuwezi kuleta uthibitisho ila kwa idhini ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu ndio wategemee Waumini.
translation_en: Their messengers said to them, "We are only men like you, but Allah confers favor upon whom He wills of His servants. It has never been for us to bring you evidence except by permission of Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely.

arabic_text: وَمَا لَنَآ أَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَىٰنَا سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَلَنَصْبِرَنَّ عَلَىٰ مَآ ءَاذَيْتُمُونَا ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
translation_sw: Na tuna nini hata tusimtegemee Mwenyezi Mungu, na hali Yeye ametuongoa kwenye Njia zetu. Na hapana shaka sisi tutayavumilia hayo maudhi mnayo tuudhi. Na juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu wategemee wanao tegemea.
translation_en: And why should we not rely upon Allah while He has guided us to our [good] ways. And we will surely be patient against whatever harm you should cause us. And upon Allah let those who would rely [indeed] rely."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِرُسُلِهِمْ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِنَآ أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِى مِلَّتِنَا ۖ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ لَنُهْلِكَنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru wakawaambia Mitume wao: Tutakutoeni katika nchi yetu, au mrudi katika mila yetu. Basi Mola wao Mlezi aliwaletea wahyi: Hakika tutawaangamiza walio dhulumu!
translation_en: And those who disbelieved said to their messengers, "We will surely drive you out of our land, or you must return to our religion." So their Lord inspired to them, "We will surely destroy the wrongdoers.

arabic_text: وَلَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامِى وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ
translation_sw: Na tutakuwekeni katika ardhi baada yao. Haya ni kwa anaye ogopa kusimamishwa mbele yangu, na akaogopa maonyo yangu.
translation_en: And We will surely cause you to dwell in the land after them. That is for he who fears My position and fears My threat."

arabic_text: وَٱسْتَفْتَحُوا۟ وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Na wakaomba ushindi, na akashindwa kila jabari mkaidi,
translation_en: And they requested victory from Allah, and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.

arabic_text: مِّن وَرَآئِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسْقَىٰ مِن مَّآءٍۢ صَدِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Ambaye nyuma yake ipo Jahannamu, na atanywishwa maji ya usaha.
translation_en: Before him is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water.

arabic_text: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأْتِيهِ ٱلْمَوْتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍۢ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍۢ ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌۭ
translation_sw: Awe anayagugumia, wala hawezi kuyameza. Na mauti yawe yanamjia kutoka kila upande, naye wala hafi. Na zaidi ya hayo ipo adhabu nyengine kali vile vile.
translation_en: He will gulp it but will hardly [be able to] swallow it. And death will come to him from everywhere, but he is not to die. And before him is a massive punishment.

arabic_text: مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ كَرَمَادٍ ٱشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَقْدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلْبَعِيدُ
translation_sw: Mfano wa walio mkufuru Mola wao Mlezi - vitendo vyao ni kama jivu linalo peperushwa kwa nguvu za upepo katika siku ya mdharba. Hawawezi kupata chochote katika waliyo yafanya. Huko ndiko kupotelea mbali!
translation_en: The example of those who disbelieve in their Lord is [that] their deeds are like ashes which the wind blows forcefully on a stormy day; they are unable [to keep] from what they earned a [single] thing. That is what is extreme error.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Huoni kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu ameziumba mbingu na ardhi kwa Haki? Akitaka atakuondoeni na alete viumbe wapya!
translation_en: Have you not seen that Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth? If He wills, He can do away with you and produce a new creation.

arabic_text: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍۢ
translation_sw: Na hilo kwa Mwenyezi Mungu si jambo gumu.
translation_en: And that is not difficult for Allah.

arabic_text: وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًۭا فَقَالَ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًۭا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَيْنَٰكُمْ ۖ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَجَزِعْنَآ أَمْ صَبَرْنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٍۢ
translation_sw: Na wote watahudhuria mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Wanyonge watawaambia walio takabari: Sisi tulikuwa wafwasi wenu; basi hebu hamtuondolei kidogo hivi katika adhabu ya Mwenyezi Mungu? Watasema: Lau Mwenyezi Mungu angeli tuongoa basi hapana shaka nasi tungeli kuongoeni. Ni mamoja kwetu tukipapatika au tukisubiri; hatuna pa kukimbilia.
translation_en: And they will come out [for judgement] before Allah all together, and the weak will say to those who were arrogant, "Indeed, we were your followers, so can you avail us anything against the punishment of Allah?" They will say, "If Allah had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we show intolerance or are patient: there is for us no place of escape."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِى ۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِى وَلُومُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُم ۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصْرِخِىَّ ۖ إِنِّى كَفَرْتُ بِمَآ أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ مِن قَبْلُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na Shet'ani atasema itapo katwa hukumu: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu alikuahidini ahadi ya kweli. Nami nalikuahidini; lakini sikukutimizieni. Na sikuwa na mamlaka juu yenu, isipo kuwa nilikuiteni, nanyi mkaniitikia. Basi msinilaumu mimi, bali jilaumuni wenyewe. Mimi siwezi kuwa mtetezi wenu, wala nyinyi hamwezi kuwa watetezi wangu. Hakika mimi nilikataa tangu zamani kunishirikisha na Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika madhaalimu watakuwa na adhabu chungu.
translation_en: And Satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "Indeed, Allah had promised you the promise of truth. And I promised you, but I betrayed you. But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with Allah] before. Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment."

arabic_text: وَأُدْخِلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ تَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٌ
translation_sw: Na walio amini na wakatenda mema wataingizwa katika Mabustani yapitayo mito kati yake, wadumu humo kwa idhini ya Mola wao Mlezi. Maamkio yao humo yatakuwa: Salaam!
translation_en: And those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their Lord; and their greeting therein will be, "Peace!"

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا كَلِمَةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ كَشَجَرَةٍۢ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌۭ وَفَرْعُهَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
translation_sw: Hebu hukuona vipi Mwenyezi Mungu alivyo piga mfano wa neno zuri? Ni kama mti mzuri, mizizi yake ni imara, na matawi yake yako mbinguni.
translation_en: Have you not considered how Allah presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?

arabic_text: تُؤْتِىٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍۭ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا ۗ وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Hutoa matunda yake kila wakati kwa idhini ya Mola wake Mlezi. Na Mwenyezi Mungu huwapigia watu mifano ili wapate kukumbuka.
translation_en: It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And Allah presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.

arabic_text: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍۢ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجْتُثَّتْ مِن فَوْقِ ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٍۢ
translation_sw: Na mfano wa neno ovu ni kama mti muovu, ulio ng'olewa juu ya ardhi. Hauna imara.
translation_en: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.

arabic_text: يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْقَوْلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ۚ وَيَفْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu huwatia imara wenye kuamini kwa kauli ya imara katika maisha ya dunia na katika Akhera. Na Mwenyezi Mungu huwaacha kupotea hao wenye kudhulumu. Na Mwenyezi Mungu hufanya apendavyo.
translation_en: Allah keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the Hereafter. And Allah sends astray the wrongdoers. And Allah does what He wills.

arabic_text: ۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفْرًۭا وَأَحَلُّوا۟ قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ ٱلْبَوَارِ
translation_sw: Hebu hukuwaona wale walio badilisha neema ya Mwenyezi Mungu kwa kufuru, na wakawafikisha watu wao kwenye nyumba ya maangamizo?
translation_en: Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allah for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?

arabic_text: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
translation_sw: Nayo ni Jahannamu! Maovu yaliyoje makaazi hayo!
translation_en: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
translation_sw: Na walimfanyia Mwenyezi Mungu washirika ili wapoteze watu kwenye Njia yake. Sema: Stareheni! Kwani marejeo yenu ni Motoni!
translation_en: And they have attributed to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire."

arabic_text: قُل لِّعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا بَيْعٌۭ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَٰلٌ
translation_sw: Waambie waja wangu walio amini, washike Sala, na watoe katika tulivyo waruzuku, kwa siri na dhaahiri, kabla haijafika Siku isiyo kuwa na biashara wala urafiki.
translation_en: [O Muhammad], tell My servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there will be no exchange, nor any friendships.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًۭا لَّكُمْ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ لِتَجْرِىَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye aliye ziumba mbingu na ardhi, na akateremsha maji kutoka mbinguni. Na kwa hayo akatoa matunda kuwa ni riziki yenu. Na akafanya yakutumikieni majahazi yanayo pita baharini kwa amri yake, na akaifanya mito ikutumikieni.
translation_en: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you the ships to sail through the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers.

arabic_text: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيْنِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ
translation_sw: Na akalifanya jua na mwezi kwa manufaa yenu daima dawamu, na akaufanya usiku na mchana kwa manufaa yenu.
translation_en: And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.

arabic_text: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ
translation_sw: Na akakupeni kila mlicho muomba. Na mkihisabu neema za Mwenyezi Mungu hamwezi kuzidhibiti. Hakika mwanaadamu ni dhaalimu mkubwa, mwenye kuzikufuru neema.
translation_en: And He gave you from all you asked of Him. And if you should count the favor of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًۭا وَٱجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلْأَصْنَامَ
translation_sw: Na Ibrahim alipo sema: Ewe Mola wangu Mlezi! Ujaalie mji huu uwe wa amani, na uniepushe mimi na wanangu na kuabudu masanamu.
translation_en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.

arabic_text: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّى ۖ وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Ewe Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika hayo yamewapoteza watu wengi. Basi aliye nifuata mimi huyo ni wangu, na aliye niasi, hakika Wewe ni Mwenye kusamehe Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: My Lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. So whoever follows me - then he is of me; and whoever disobeys me - indeed, You are [yet] Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّىٓ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ وَٱرْزُقْهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Mola wetu Mlezi! Hakika mimi nimewaweka baadhi ya dhuriya zangu katika bonde lisilo kuwa na mimea, kwenye Nyumba yako Takatifu, ewe Mola wetu Mlezi, ili washike Sala. Basi zijaalie nyoyo za watu zielekee kwao, na waruzuku matunda, ili wapata kushukuru.
translation_en: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.

arabic_text: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِى وَمَا نُعْلِنُ ۗ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
translation_sw: Ewe Mola wetu Mlezi! Hakika Wewe unajua tunayo yaficha na tunayo yatangaza. Na hapana kitu kinacho fichikana kwa Mwenyezi Mungu katika ardhi wala katika mbingu.
translation_en: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allah on the earth or in the heaven.

arabic_text: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
translation_sw: Alhamdulillahi! Himdi zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu aliye nipa juu ya uzee wangu Ismail na Is-haq. Hakika Mola wangu Mlezi ni Mwenye kusikia maombi.
translation_en: Praise to Allah, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.

arabic_text: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ
translation_sw: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nijaalie niwe mwenye kushika Sala, na katika dhuriya zangu pia. Ewe Mola wetu Mlezi, na ipokee dua yangu.
translation_en: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

arabic_text: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
translation_sw: Mola wetu! Unighufirie mimi na wazazi wangu wote wawili, na Waumini, siku ya kusimama hisabu.
translation_en: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."

arabic_text: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍۢ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
translation_sw: Wala usidhani Mwenyezi Mungu ameghafilika na wanayo yafanya madhaalimu. Hakika Yeye anawaakhirisha tu mpaka siku yatapo kodoka macho yao.
translation_en: And never think that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror].

arabic_text: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِى رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ ۖ وَأَفْـِٔدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌۭ
translation_sw: Nao wako mbioni, vichwa juu, na macho hayapepesi, na nyoyo zao tupu.
translation_en: Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void.

arabic_text: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَ ۗ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَقْسَمْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٍۢ
translation_sw: Na waonye watu siku itapo wajia adhabu, na walio dhulumu waseme: Ewe Mola wetu Mlezi! Tuakhirishe muda kidogo tuitikie wito wako na tuwafuate Mitume. Kwani nyinyi si mliapa zamani kwamba hamtaondokewa?
translation_en: And, [O Muhammad], warn the people of a Day when the punishment will come to them and those who did wrong will say, "Our Lord, delay us for a short term; we will answer Your call and follow the messengers." [But it will be said], "Had you not sworn, before, that for you there would be no cessation?

arabic_text: وَسَكَنتُمْ فِى مَسَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ
translation_sw: Na mkakaa katika maskani zile zile za walio zidhulumu nafsi zao. Na ikakudhihirikieni jinsi tulivyo watendea. Nasi tukakupigieni mifano mingi.
translation_en: And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples."

arabic_text: وَقَدْ مَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ ٱلْجِبَالُ
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika walifanya vitimbi vyao, na vitimbi vyao anavijua Mwenyezi Mungu. Wala vitimbi vyao si vya kuondosha milima.
translation_en: And they had planned their plan, but with Allah is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains.

arabic_text: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلَهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌۭ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi usimdhanie Mwenyezi Mungu kuwa ni mwenye kuwavunjia ahadi yake Mitume wake. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kushinda, na ni Mwenye kulipiza.
translation_en: So never think that Allah will fail in His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ۖ وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ
translation_sw: Siku itapo geuzwa ardhi iwe ardhi nyengine, na mbingu pia. Nao watahudhuria mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja, Mwenye nguvu.
translation_en: [It will be] on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and all creatures will come out before Allah, the One, the Prevailing.

arabic_text: وَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
translation_sw: Na utaona wakhalifu siku hiyo wamefungwa katika minyororo;
translation_en: And you will see the criminals that Day bound together in shackles,

arabic_text: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍۢ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ
translation_sw: Nguo zao zitakuwa za lami, na Moto utazigubika nyuso zao.
translation_en: Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire.

arabic_text: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_sw: Ili Mwenyezi Mungu ailipe kila nafsi kwa yale iliyo yachuma. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwepesi wa kuhisabu.
translation_en: So that Allah will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allah is swift in account.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٌۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
translation_sw: Hili ni Tangazo liwafikie watu, liwaonye, na wapate kujua kuwa hakika Yeye ni Mungu Mmoja, na wapate kukumbuka wenye akili.
translation_en: This [Qur'an] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded.

arabic_text: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Alif Lam Ra. (A. L. R). Hizi ni Aya za Kitabu na Qur'ani inayo bainisha.
translation_en: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.

arabic_text: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: HUENDA ikawa walio kufuru wakatamani wange kuwa Waislamu.
translation_en: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.

arabic_text: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Waache wale, na wastarehe, na iwazuge tamaa. Watakuja jua.
translation_en: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
translation_sw: Na hatukuuangamiza mji wowote ule ila ulikuwa na muda wake maalumu.
translation_en: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.

arabic_text: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
translation_sw: Hawawezi watu wowote kuitangulia ajali yao, wala kuchelewa.
translation_en: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
translation_sw: Na walisema: Ewe uliyeteremshiwa Ukumbusho! Hakika wewe ni mwendawazimu.
translation_en: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.

arabic_text: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Mbona hutuletei Malaika ikiwa wewe ni miongoni mwa wasemao kweli?
translation_en: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"

arabic_text: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ
translation_sw: Sisi hatuwateremshi Malaika ila kwa sababu ya haki, na hapo hawatapewa muhula.
translation_en: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.

arabic_text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi ndio tulio teremsha Ukumbusho huu, na hakika Sisi ndio tutao ulinda.
translation_en: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tulikwisha watumia Mitume mataifa ya mwanzo.
translation_en: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.

arabic_text: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakuwafikia Mtume ila walimkejeli.
translation_en: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na kama hivi ndivyo tunavyo ingiza katika nyoyo za wakosefu.
translation_en: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.

arabic_text: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Hawayaamini haya, na hali ya kuwa umekwisha wapitia mfano wa watu wa kale.
translation_en: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
translation_sw: Na lau tungeli wafungulia mlango wa mbingu, wakawa wanapanda,
translation_en: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,

arabic_text: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ
translation_sw: Basi wangeli sema: Macho yetu yamelevywa, bali sisi wenyewe tumerogwa.
translation_en: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tumeweka katika mbingu vituo vya sayari, na tumezipamba kwa wenye kuangalia.
translation_en: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.

arabic_text: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍ
translation_sw: Na tumezilinda na kila shetani afukuzwaye.
translation_en: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]

arabic_text: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa mwenye kusikiliza kwa kuibia, naye hufuatwa na kijinga cha moto kinacho onekana.
translation_en: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.

arabic_text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مَّوْزُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Na ardhi tumeitandaza na humo tumeweka milima, na tumeotesha kila kitu kwa kiasi chake.
translation_en: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na tumekujaalieni humo vitu vya maisha yenu, na ya hao ambao nyinyi sio wenye kuwaruzuku.
translation_en: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.

arabic_text: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
translation_sw: Na hakuna chochote ila asili yake inatokana na Sisi; wala hatukiteremshi ila kwa kipimo maalumu.
translation_en: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.

arabic_text: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na tunazipeleka pepo za kupandishia, na tunateremsha kutoka mbinguni maji, kisha tukakunywesheni maji hayo. Wala si nyinyi mnayo yaweka.
translation_en: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
translation_sw: Na Sisi ndio tunao huisha na tunao fisha. Na Sisi ndio Warithi.
translation_en: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na tunawajua walio tangulia katika nyinyi, na tunawajua walio taakhari.
translation_en: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye atakaye wakusanya. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye hikima na Mjuzi.
translation_en: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Na tulimuumba mtu kwa udongo unao toa sauti, unao tokana na matope yaliyo tiwa sura.
translation_en: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.

arabic_text: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
translation_sw: Na majini tuliwaumba kabla kwa moto wa upepo umoto.
translation_en: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Na Mola wako Mlezi alipo waambia Malaika: Hakika Mimi nitamuumba mtu kwa udongo unao toa sauti, unao tokana na matope yaliyo tiwa sura.
translation_en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
translation_sw: Basi nitakapo mkamilisha na nikampulizia roho yangu, basi mumwangukie kumsujudia.
translation_en: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

arabic_text: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation_sw: Basi Malaika wote pamoja walimsujudia,
translation_en: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

arabic_text: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa Iblisi. Yeye alikataa kuwa pamoja na walio sujudu.
translation_en: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.

arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
translation_sw: (Mwenyezi Mungu) akasema: Ewe Iblisi! Una nini hata hukuwa pamoja na walio sujudu?
translation_en: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"

arabic_text: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Akasema: Haiwi mimi nimsujudie mtu uliye muumba kwa udongo unao toa sauti, unao tokana na matope yenye sura.
translation_en: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."

arabic_text: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: (Mwenyezi Mungu) akasema: Basi toka humo, kwani hakika wewe ni maluuni!
translation_en: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Na hakika juu yako ipo laana mpaka Siku ya Malipo.
translation_en: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema (Iblisi): Mola wangu Mlezi! Nipe muhula mpaka siku watapo fufuliwa.
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

arabic_text: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
translation_sw: (Mwenyezi Mungu) akasema: Hakika wewe ni katika walio pewa muhula
translation_en: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

arabic_text: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
translation_sw: Mpaka siku ya wakati maalumu.
translation_en: Until the Day of the time well-known."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Ilivyo kuwa umenitia makosani, basi nahakikisha nitawazaini hapa duniani na nitawapoteza wote,
translation_en: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all

arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_sw: Ila waja wako walio safika.
translation_en: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

arabic_text: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hii Njia ya kujia kwangu Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.

arabic_text: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika waja wangu, wewe hutakuwa na mamlaka juu yao, isipo kuwa wale wapotofu walio kufuata.
translation_en: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Na bila shaka Jahannamu ndipo pahali pao walipo ahidiwa wote.
translation_en: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.

arabic_text: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ
translation_sw: Ina milango saba; na kwa kila mlango iko sehemu walio tengewa.
translation_en: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated."

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_sw: Hakika wachamngu watakuwa katika Mabustani na chemchem.
translation_en: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs.

arabic_text: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_sw: (Wataambiwa:) Ingieni kwa salama na amani.
translation_en: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."

arabic_text: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
translation_sw: Na tutaondoa chuki iliyo kuwamo vifuani mwao, wawe ndugu juu ya viti vya enzi wameelekeana.
translation_en: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.

arabic_text: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
translation_sw: Humo hayatawagusa machofu, wala hawatatolewa humo.
translation_en: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.

arabic_text: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Waambie waja wangu ya kwamba Mimi ndiye Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Na kwamba adhabu yangu ndio adhabu iliyo chungu!
translation_en: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.

arabic_text: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_sw: Na uwape khabari za wageni wa Ibrahim.
translation_en: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,

arabic_text: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
translation_sw: Walipo ingia kwake na wakasema: Salama! Yeye akasema: Hakika sisi tunakuogopeni.
translation_en: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Usiogope. Sisi tunakubashiria kijana mwenye ujuzi.
translation_en: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."

arabic_text: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mnanibashiria nami uzee umenishika! Basi kwa njia gani mnanibashiria?
translation_en: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Tunakubashiria kwa haki; basi usiwe miongoni mwa wanao kata tamaa.
translation_en: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."

arabic_text: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Na nani anaye kata tamaa na rehema ya Mola wake Mlezi ila wale walio potea?
translation_en: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"

arabic_text: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hebu nini amri yenu, enyi wajumbe?
translation_en: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Hakika sisi tumetumwa kwa kaumu ya wakosefu!
translation_en: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,

arabic_text: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa walio mfuata Luut'i. Bila ya shaka sisi tutawaokoa hao wote.
translation_en: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all

arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Ila mkewe. Tunakadiria huyo atakuwa miongoni watao bakia nyuma.
translation_en: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind.

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_sw: Basi wale wajumbe walipo fika kwa Luut'i,
translation_en: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation_sw: Alisema (Luut'i): Hakika nyinyi ni watu msio juulikana.
translation_en: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Bali sisi tumekuletea yale waliyo kuwa wakiyafanyia shaka.
translation_en: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,

arabic_text: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
translation_sw: Na tumefika kwako kwa Haki, na hakika sisi tunasema kweli.
translation_en: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.

arabic_text: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
translation_sw: Basi ondoka na ahli zako usiku ungalipo, nawe ufuate nyuma yao, wala yeyote kati yenu asigeuke nyuma. Na mwende mnapo amrishwa.
translation_en: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."

arabic_text: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukamfunulia hukumu hiyo, ya kwamba hata wa mwisho wao hao ikifika asubuhi atakuwa kesha katiliwa mbali.
translation_en: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.

arabic_text: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wakaja watu wa mji ule nao furahani.
translation_en: And the people of the city came rejoicing.

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hakika hawa wageni wangu, basi msinifedheheshe.
translation_en: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.

arabic_text: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
translation_sw: Na mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu, wala msinihizi.
translation_en: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me."

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Sisi hatukukukataza usimkaribishe yeyote?
translation_en: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"

arabic_text: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hawa binti zangu, ikiwa nyinyi ni watendaji.
translation_en: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."

arabic_text: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa umri wako! Hakika hao walikuwa katika ulevi wao, wakihangaika ovyo.
translation_en: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.

arabic_text: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
translation_sw: Ukelele ukawatwaa wakipambaukiwa.
translation_en: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.

arabic_text: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
translation_sw: Na tukaigeuza nchi juu chini, na tukawanyeshea mvua ya mawe ya udongo wa Motoni.
translation_en: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika katika hayo zipo ishara kwa waaguzi.
translation_en: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ
translation_sw: Na miji hii ipo kwenye njia inayo pitiwa.
translation_en: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road.

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika katika hayo ipo ishara kwa Waumini.
translation_en: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.

arabic_text: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika watu wa Kichakani walikuwa wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers.

arabic_text: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwa hivyo tukawaadhibu. Na nchi mbili hizi ziko kwenye njia ilio wazi.
translation_en: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka wakaazi wa Hijr waliwakanusha Mitume.
translation_en: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers.

arabic_text: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
translation_sw: Na tuliwapa ishara zetu, nao wakazipuuza.
translation_en: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.

arabic_text: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
translation_sw: Nao walikuwa wakichonga majumba katika milima kwa amani.
translation_en: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.

arabic_text: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_sw: Basi ukelele ukawatwaa asubuhi.
translation_en: But the shriek seized them at early morning.

arabic_text: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_sw: Hayakuwafaa waliyo kuwa wakiyachuma.
translation_en: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.

arabic_text: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
translation_sw: Na hatukuziumba mbingu na ardhi na vilivyomo ndani yake ila kwa ajili ya Haki. Na hakika Kiyama kitafika. Basi samehe msamaha mzuri.
translation_en: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye Muumbaji Mjuzi.
translation_en: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
translation_sw: Na tumekupa Aya saba zinazo somwa mara kwa mara, na Qur'ani Tukufu.
translation_en: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.

arabic_text: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Usivitumbulie macho yako vitu tulivyo waneemesha makundi fulani kati yao, wala usiwahuzunikie. Na wainamishie bawa lako (la huruma) Waumini.
translation_en: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers

arabic_text: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Na sema: Hakika mimi ni mwonyaji mwenye kubainisha.
translation_en: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -

arabic_text: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
translation_sw: Kama hivyo tuliwateremshia walio gawa,
translation_en: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
translation_sw: Ambao wakaifanya Qur'ani vipande vipande.
translation_en: Who have made the Qur'an into portions.

arabic_text: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Basi Naapa kwa Mola wako Mlezi! Tutawahoji wote,
translation_en: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all

arabic_text: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda.
translation_en: About what they used to do.

arabic_text: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
translation_sw: Basi wewe yatangaze uliyo amrishwa, na jitenge na washirikina.
translation_en: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.

arabic_text: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tunatosha kukukinga na wanao kejeli.
translation_en: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Hao wanao fanya kuwa pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu yupo mungu mwingine. Basi, watakuja jua!
translation_en: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
translation_sw: Na Sisi tunajua kwa hakika kuwa wewe kifua chako kinaona dhiki kwa hayo wayasemayo.
translation_en: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.

arabic_text: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
translation_sw: Basi mtakase Mola wako Mlezi kwa kumhimidi, na uwe miongoni wanao msujudia.
translation_en: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].

arabic_text: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
translation_sw: Na muabudu Mola wako Mlezi mpaka ikufikie Yakini.
translation_en: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).

arabic_text: أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Amri ya Mwenyezi Mungu itafika tu. Basi msiihimize. Ametakasika na Ametukuka na wanayo mshirikisha nayo.
translation_en: The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

arabic_text: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ
translation_sw: Huwateremsha Malaika na Roho kwa amri yake juu ya amtakaye katika waja wake ili nyinyi muonye kwamba hapana mungu ila Mimi, basi nicheni Mimi.
translation_en: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."

arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Ameziumba mbingu na ardhi kwa Haki. Ametukuka na wanayo shirikisha.
translation_en: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.

arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Amemuumba mtu kwa tone la manii. Naye mara amekuwa mshindani dhaahiri.
translation_en: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary.

arabic_text: وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَا ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌۭ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_sw: Na nyama hoa amekuumbieni. Katika hao mna vifaa vya kutia joto, na manufaa mengineyo, na baadhi yao mnawala.
translation_en: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.

arabic_text: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanakupeni furaha pale mnapo warudisha jioni na mnapo wapeleka malishoni asubuhi.
translation_en: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].

arabic_text: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍۢ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ بَٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلْأَنفُسِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na hubeba mizigo yenu kupeleka kwenye miji msiyo weza kuifikia ila kwa mashaka ya nafsi. Hakika Mola wenu Mlezi ni Mpole na Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.

arabic_text: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةًۭ ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na farasi, na nyumbu, na punda ili muwapande, na kuwa ni pambo. Na ataumba msivyo vijua.
translation_en: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.

arabic_text: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌۭ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
