translation_sw: Na ni juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu kuelekeza Njia. Na zipo njia za upotovu. Na angeli penda angeli kuongoeni nyote.
translation_en: And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌۭ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌۭ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye anaye kuteremshieni maji kutoka mbinguni. Katika hayo nyinyi mnapata ya kunywa, na miti ya kulishia.
translation_en: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].

arabic_text: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلْأَعْنَٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa hayo Yeye anaizalisha kwa ajili yenu mimea, na mizaituni, na mitende, na mizabibu, na kila namna ya matunda. Hakika katika haya zipo ishara kwa watu wanao fikiri.
translation_en: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and from all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.

arabic_text: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتٌۢ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na amefanya ukutumikieni usiku na mchana, na jua na mwezi, na nyota zikutumikieni kwa amri yake. Hakika katika hayo zipo ishara kwa watu wenye akili.
translation_en: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.

arabic_text: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Na hivi alivyo vieneza katika ardhi vya rangi mbali mbali. Hakika katika hayo ipo ishara kwa watu wanao waidhika.
translation_en: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنْهُ لَحْمًۭا طَرِيًّۭا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا۟ مِنْهُ حِلْيَةًۭ تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye aliye ifanya bahari ikutumikieni, ili kutokana na humo mpate kula nyama laini, na mtoe humo mapambo mnayo yavaa. Na unaona marikebu zikikata maji humo, ili mtafute fadhila yake, na mpate kushukuru.
translation_en: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

arabic_text: وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَٰرًۭا وَسُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Na kaweka katika ardhi milima ili ardhi isiyumbe yumbe nanyi. Na mito, na njia ili mpate kuongoka.
translation_en: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,

arabic_text: وَعَلَٰمَٰتٍۢ ۚ وَبِٱلنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Na alama nyengine. Na kwa nyota wao wanajiongoza.
translation_en: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.

arabic_text: أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخْلُقُ ۗ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Ati anaye umba ni kama asiye umba? Basi hebu, hamkumbuki?
translation_en: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?

arabic_text: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na mkizihisabu neema za Mwenyezi Mungu, hamwezi kuzidhibiti. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye maghfira, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu anayajua mnayo yaficha na mnayo yatangaza.
translation_en: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you declare.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
translation_sw: Na wale wanao waomba wasio kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu hawaumbi kitu, bali wao wameumbwa.
translation_en: And those they invoke other than Allah create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.

arabic_text: أَمْوَٰتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَآءٍۢ ۖ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_sw: Ni wafu si wahai, na wala hawajui watafufuliwa lini.
translation_en: They are, [in fact], dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.

arabic_text: إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌۭ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
translation_sw: Mungu wenu ni Mungu Mmoja. Lakini wasio iamini Akhera nyoyo zao zinakataa, nao wanajivuna.
translation_en: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.

arabic_text: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Hapana shaka kuwa hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anayajua wanayo yaficha na wanayo yatangaza. Kwa hakika Yeye hawapendi wanao jivuna.
translation_en: Assuredly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۙ قَالُوٓا۟ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo ambiwa: Kateremsha nini Mola wenu Mlezi? Husema: Hadithi za kubuni za watu wa kale!
translation_en: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" They say, "Legends of the former peoples,"

arabic_text: لِيَحْمِلُوٓا۟ أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةًۭ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
translation_sw: Ili wabebe mizigo yao kwa ukamilifu Siku ya Kiyama, na sehemu ya mizigo ya wale wanao wapoteza bila ya kujua. Angalia, ni maovu mno hayo wanayo yabeba!
translation_en: That they may bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.

arabic_text: قَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنْيَٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Walipanga vitimbi walio kuwa kabla yao, Mwenyezi Mungu akayasukua majengo yao kwenye misingi, dari zikawaporomokea juu yao, na adhabu ikawajia kutoka wasipo kujua.
translation_en: Those before them had already plotted, but Allah came at their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them, and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تُشَٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمْ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ إِنَّ ٱلْخِزْىَ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَٱلسُّوٓءَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha Siku ya Kiyama atawahizi na atasema: Wako wapi hao washirika wangu ambao kwao mkiwakutisha (Manabii) mashaka? Watasema walio pewa ilimu: Hakika leo ndiyo hizaya na adhabu itawashukia makafiri,
translation_en: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers" -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ فَأَلْقَوُا۟ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوٓءٍۭ ۚ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao Malaika waliwafisha nao wamejidhulumu nafsi zao! Basi watasalimu amri, waseme: Hatukuwa tukifanya uovu wowote. (Wataambiwa): Kwani! Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anajua sana mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda.
translation_en: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves, and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what you used to do.

arabic_text: فَٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
translation_sw: Basi ingieni milango ya Jahannamu, humo mdumu. Ni maovu mno makaazi ya wafanyao kiburi!
translation_en: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.

arabic_text: ۞ وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا ۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌۭ ۚ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌۭ ۚ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_sw: Na wataambiwa walio mcha Mungu: Mola wenu Mlezi kateremsha nini? Watasema: Kheri. Walio fanya wema katika dunia hii watapata wema. Na nyumba ya Akhera ni bora zaidi, na njema mno nyumba ya wachamngu.
translation_en: And it will be said to those who feared Allah, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -

arabic_text: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_sw: Bustani za milele wataziingia; iwe inapita kati yake mito. Humo watapata watakacho. Hivi ndivyo Mwenyezi Mungu awalipavyo wenye kumcha.
translation_en: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allah reward the righteous -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ ۙ يَقُولُونَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Wale ambao Malaika huwafisha katika hali njema, wanawaambia: Amani iwe juu yenu! Ingieni Peponi kwa sababu ya yale mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda.
translation_en: The ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do."

arabic_text: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Wanangojea jengine hawa ila Malaika wawafikie, au iwafikie amri ya Mola wako Mlezi? Kama hivyo walitenda walio kuwa kabla yao. Na Mwenyezi Mungu hakuwadhulumu, lakini walijidhulumu wenyewe.
translation_en: Do the disbelievers await [anything] except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allah wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves.

arabic_text: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation_sw: Basi ukawafikia uovu wa waliyo yatenda, na waliyo kuwa wakiyakejeli yakawazunguka.
translation_en: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍۢ نَّحْنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ فَهَلْ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Na washirikina wanasema: Mwenyezi Mungu angeli taka tusingeli abudu chochote badala yake, sisi wala baba zetu, wala tusingeli harimisha chochote bila ya Yeye. Kama hivyo walifanya walio kuwa kabla yao. Basi lipo lolote juu ya Mitume isipo kuwa kubalighisha kwa uwazi?
translation_en: And those who associate others with Allah say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification?

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةُ ۚ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika kwa kila umma tuliutumia Mtume kwamba: Muabuduni Mwenyezi Mungu, na muepukeni Shetani. Basi kati yao wapo alio waongoa Mwenyezi Mungu. Na kati yao wapo ambao ulio wathibitikia upotovu. Basi tembeeni katika ardhi, muangalie ulikuwaje mwisho wa wanao kanusha.
translation_en: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allah and avoid Taghut." And among them were those whom Allah guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.

arabic_text: إِن تَحْرِصْ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَن يُضِلُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
translation_sw: Hata ukiwa na pupa ya kutaka kuwaongoa, lakini Mwenyezi Mungu hamwongoi yule anaye shikilia kupotea. Wala hawatapata wa kuwanusuru.
translation_en: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muhammad], indeed, Allah does not guide those He sends astray, and they will have no helpers.

arabic_text: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ ۙ لَا يَبْعَثُ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُ ۚ بَلَىٰ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّۭا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanaapa kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ukomo wa viapo vyao kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu hatomfufua aliye kufa. Kwani! Ni ahadi iliyo juu yake kikweli; lakini watu wengi hawajui.
translation_en: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths [that] Allah will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon Him, but most of the people do not know.

arabic_text: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَٰذِبِينَ
translation_sw: Ili kuwabainishia yale waliyo khitalifiana, na ili wajue walio kufuru kwamba wao walikuwa ni waongo.
translation_en: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ إِذَآ أَرَدْنَٰهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation_sw: Kauli yetu kwa kitu tunacho kitaka kiwe, ni kukiambia: Kuwa! Basi kinakuwa.
translation_en: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًۭ ۖ وَلَأَجْرُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na wale walio hama kwa ajili ya Mwenyezi Mungu baada ya kudhulumiwa, bila ya shaka tutawaweka duniani kwa wema; na ujira wa Akhera ni mkubwa zaidi; laiti kuwa wanajua!
translation_en: And those who emigrated for [the cause of] Allah after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know.

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
translation_sw: Wale wanao subiri na wakamtegemea Mola wao Mlezi.
translation_en: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Nasi hatukuwatuma kabla yako ila watu wanaume tulio wapa Wahyi (Ufunuo). Basi waulizeni wenye ukumbusho kama nyinyi hamjui
translation_en: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message if you do not know.

arabic_text: بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِ ۗ وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa Ishara wazi na Vitabu. Nasi tumekuteremshia wewe Ukumbusho ili uwabainishie watu yaliyo teremshwa kwao, wapate kufikiri.
translation_en: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.

arabic_text: أَفَأَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَكَرُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَخْسِفَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Wameaminisha wanao fanya vitimbi vya uovu kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu hatawadidimiza katika ardhi, na haitawafika adhabu kutoka wasipo pajua?
translation_en: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?

arabic_text: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِى تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
translation_sw: Au hatawashika katika nyendo zao, na wala hawataponyoka?
translation_en: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure?

arabic_text: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٍۢ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
translation_sw: Au hatawashika kwa kitisho na kuwapunguza kidogo kidogo? Hakika Mola wenu Mlezi ni Mwenye huruma, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍۢ يَتَفَيَّؤُا۟ ظِلَٰلُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَٱلشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدًۭا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Hawavioni vitu alivyo viumba Mwenyezi Mungu - vivuli vyao vinaelekea kushotoni na kuliani, kumsujudia Mwenyezi Mungu na vikinyenyekea?
translation_en: Have they not considered what things Allah has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allah, while they are humble.

arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na vyote viliomo katika mbingu na katika ardhi, tangu wanyama mpaka Malaika, vinamsujuidia Mwenyezi Mungu, na wala havitakabari.
translation_en: And to Allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant.

arabic_text: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ ۩
translation_sw: Vinamkhofu Mola wao Mlezi aliye juu yao, na vinafanya vinavyo amrishwa.
translation_en: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.

arabic_text: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ إِلَٰهَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ ۖ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu amesema: Msiwe na miungu wawili! Hakika Yeye ni Mungu Mmoja. Basi niogopeni Mimi tu!
translation_en: And Allah has said, "Do not take for yourselves two deities. He is but one God, so fear only Me."

arabic_text: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًا ۚ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Na ni vyake Yeye viliomo katika mbingu na ardhi. Na Dini ni yake Yeye daima. Je! Mtamcha mwengine asiye kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu?
translation_en: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is [due] worship constantly. Then is it other than Allah that you fear?

arabic_text: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍۢ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُونَ
translation_sw: Na neema yoyote mliyo nayo inatoka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Kisha yakikuguseni madhara mnamyayatikia Yeye.
translation_en: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allah. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ ٱلضُّرَّ عَنكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Na anapo kuondosheeni madhara mara kundi moja miongoni mwenu linamshirikisha Mola wao Mlezi,
translation_en: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord

arabic_text: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Wakizikataa neema tulizo wapa. Basi stareheni. Mtakuja jua!
translation_en: So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.

arabic_text: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًۭا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ ۗ تَٱللَّهِ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na hao ambao hata hawawajui wanawawekea sehemu ya tunavyo waruzuku. Wallahi! Bila ya shaka mtasailiwa kwa hayo mliyo kuwa mnayazua!
translation_en: And they assign to what they do not know a portion of that which We have provided them. By Allah, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent.

arabic_text: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْبَنَٰتِ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۙ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanamfanyia Mwenyezi Mungu ati ana mabinti, Subhanahu, Aliye takasika! Na wao wenyewe, ati ndio wawe na hayo wanayo yatamani!
translation_en: And they attribute to Allah daughters - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلْأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na mmoja wao akibashiriwa kwa msichana, uso wake unasawijika, naye kajaa chuki.
translation_en: And when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.

arabic_text: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ مِن سُوٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِۦٓ ۚ أَيُمْسِكُهُۥ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُۥ فِى ٱلتُّرَابِ ۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
translation_sw: Anajificha asionekane na watu kwa ubaya wa aliyo bashiriwa! Je, akae naye juu ya fedheha hiyo au amfukie udongoni? Tazama uovu wa wanavyo hukumu!
translation_en: He hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. Should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? Unquestionably, evil is what they decide.

arabic_text: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مَثَلُ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۖ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Hali ya wasio iamini Akhera ni ovu; na Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mwenye sifa tukufu. Naye ni Mwenye nguvu na Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description of evil; and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةًۭ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na lau kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu angeli wachukulia watu kwa mujibu wa dhulma zao, basi asingeli mwacha hapa hata mnyama mmoja. Lakini anawaakhirisha mpaka muda ulio wekwa. Na unapo fika muda wao hawatakawilia hata saa moja wala hawatatangulia.
translation_en: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon the earth any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].

arabic_text: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanampa Mwenyezi Mungu wanavyo vichukia wao, na ndimi zao zinasema uwongo kwamba wao watapata mema. Hapana shaka hakika wamewekewa Moto, nao wataachwa humo.
translation_en: And they attribute to Allah that which they dislike, and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected.

arabic_text: تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Wallahi! Sisi tulituma Mitume kwa umati zilizo kuwa kabla yako, lakini Shetani aliwapambia vitendo vyao. Kwa hivyo leo yeye ndiye rafiki yao; nao watapata adhabu chungu.
translation_en: By Allah, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is the disbelievers' ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۙ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Na hatukukuteremshia Kitabu isipo kuwa uwabainishie yale ambayo wanakhitalifiana, na kiwe Uwongofu na Rehema kwa watu wanao amini.
translation_en: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَسْمَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu ameteremsha maji kutoka mbinguni na kwa hayo akaihuisha ardhi baada ya kufa kwake. Kwa hakika katika hayo imo Ishara kwa watu wanao sikia.
translation_en: And Allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍۢ وَدَمٍۢ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًۭا سَآئِغًۭا لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika katika nyama hoa nyinyi mna mazingatio. Tunakunywesheni katika vile viliomo matumboni mwao, vikatoka baina ya mavi na damu, maziwa safi mazuri kwa wanywao.
translation_en: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.

arabic_text: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلْأَعْنَٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًۭا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na kutokana na matunda ya mitende na mizabibu mnatengeneza ulevi na riziki nzuri. Hakika katika hayo ipo Ishara kwa wanao tumia akili.
translation_en: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.

arabic_text: وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحْلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِى مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًۭا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mola wako Mlezi amemfunulia nyuki: Jitengenezee majumba yako katika milima, na katika miti, na katika wanayo jenga watu.
translation_en: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ كُلِى مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسْلُكِى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًۭا ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌۭ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٌۭ لِّلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Kisha kula katika kila matunda, na upite katika njia za Mola wako Mlezi zilizo fanywa nyepesi kuzipita. Na kutoka matumbo yao kinatoka kinywaji chenye rangi mbali mbali; ndani yake kina matibabu kwa wanaadamu. Hakika katika haya ipo Ishara kwa watu wanao fikiri.
translation_en: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَىْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍۢ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۭ قَدِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu amekuumbeni; kisha anakufisheni. Na miongoni mwenu wapo wanao rudishwa kwenye umri mbaya kabisa, hata akawa asijue kitu baada ya ujuzi alio kuwa nao. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mjuzi na Mweza.
translation_en: And Allah created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Competent.

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فِى ٱلرِّزْقِ ۚ فَمَا ٱلَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوا۟ بِرَآدِّى رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ ۚ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu amewafadhilisha baadhi yenu kuliko wengine katika riziki. Na wale walio fadhilishwa hawarudishi riziki zao kwa wale ilio wamiliki mikono yao ya kulia ili wawe sawa katika riziki hiyo. Basi je, wanazikataa neema za Mwenyezi Mungu?
translation_en: And Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess so they would be equal to them therein. Then is it the favor of Allah they reject?

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةًۭ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ ۚ أَفَبِٱلْبَٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu amekuumbieni wake katika jinsi yenu, na akakujaalieni kutoka kwa wake zenu wana na wajukuu, na akakuruzukuni vitu vizuri vizuri. Basi je, wanaamini upotovu na wanazikataa neema za Mwenyezi Mungu?
translation_en: And Allah has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve?

arabic_text: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_sw: Na badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu wanawaabudu wasio wamilikia riziki kutoka mbinguni wala kwenye ardhi, wala hawawezi kitu.
translation_en: And they worship besides Allah that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable.

arabic_text: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Basi msimpigie Mwenyezi Mungu mifano. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anajua, na nyinyi hamjui.
translation_en: So do not assert similarities to Allah. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know.

arabic_text: ۞ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًۭا مَّمْلُوكًۭا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ وَمَن رَّزَقْنَٰهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًۭا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّۭا وَجَهْرًا ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوُۥنَ ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu anapiga mfano wa mtumwa aliye milikiwa, asiye weza kitu, na mwingine tuliye mruzuku riziki njema inayo toka kwetu, naye akawa anatoa katika riziki hiyo kwa siri na dhaahiri. Je, hao watakuwa sawa? Alhamdu Lillahi! Kuhimidiwa kote ni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Lakini wengi wao hawajui.
translation_en: Allah presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allah! But most of them do not know.

arabic_text: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا رَّجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوْلَىٰهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى هُوَ وَمَن يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۙ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu anapiga mfano wa watu wawili. Mmoja wao ni bubu, hawezi chochote, naye ni mzigo kwa bwana wake. Popote anapo muelekeza haleti kheri. Je! Huyo anaweza kuwa sawa na yule anaye amrisha uadilifu, naye yuko juu ya Njia Iliyo Nyooka?
translation_en: And Allah presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?

arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَآ أَمْرُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ ٱلْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Na siri zote za katika mbingu na ardhi ziko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Wala halikuwa jambo la Saa (ya Kiyama) ila kama kupepesa kwa jicho, au akali ya hivyo. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Muweza wa kila kitu.
translation_en: And to Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu amekutoeni matumboni mwa mama zenu, hali ya kuwa hamjui kitu, na amekujaalieni masikio na macho na nyoyo ili mpate kushukuru.
translation_en: And Allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and intellect that perhaps you would be grateful.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍۢ فِى جَوِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Hawawaoni ndege walivyo wat'iifu katika anga la mbingu? Hapana mwenye kuwashika isipo kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika katika haya zipo ishara kwa watu wanao amini.
translation_en: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allah. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ بُيُوتًۭا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ ۙ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَآ أَثَٰثًۭا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu amekujaalieni majumba yenu yawe ni maskani yenu, na amekujaalieni kutokana na ngozi za wanyama nyumba mnazo ziona nyepesi wakati wa safari zenu na wakati wa kutua kwenu. Na kutokana na sufi zao na manyoya yao na nywele zao mnafanya matandiko na mapambo ya kutumia kwa muda.
translation_en: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment for a time.

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَٰلًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ أَكْنَٰنًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ ٱلْحَرَّ وَسَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأْسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu amekufanyieni vivuli katika vitu alivyo viumba, na amekufanyieni maskani milimani, na amekufanyieni nguo za kukingeni na joto, na nguo za kukingeni katika vita vyenu. Ndio hivyo anakutimizieni neema zake ili mpate kut'ii.
translation_en: And Allah has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit [to Him].

arabic_text: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Basi wakikengeuka lilio juu yako wewe ni kufikisha ujumbe wazi wazi.
translation_en: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.

arabic_text: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Wanazijua neema za Mwenyezi Mungu, kisha wanazikanusha; na wengi wao ni makafiri.
translation_en: They recognize the favor of Allah; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ شَهِيدًۭا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
translation_sw: Na siku tutakapo wainua kutokana na kila umma shahidi, kisha hawataruhusiwa walio kufuru wala hawataachiliwa kutaka radhi.
translation_en: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].

arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na walio dhulumu watakapo iona adhabu hawatapunguziwa hiyo adhabu, wala hawatapewa muhula.
translation_en: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ شُرَكَآءَهُمْ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُرَكَآؤُنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِكَ ۖ فَأَلْقَوْا۟ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ إِنَّكُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
translation_sw: Na walio shirikisha watakapo waona hao walio washirikisha na Mwenyezi Mungu, watasema: Mola wetu Mlezi! Hawa ndio washirikishwa wetu ambao tulikuwa tukiwaabudu badala yako. Ndipo wale watakapo watupia kauli: Hakika nyinyi ni waongo!
translation_en: And when those who associated others with Allah see their "partners," they will say," Our Lord, these are our partners [to You] whom we used to invoke besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars."

arabic_text: وَأَلْقَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلسَّلَمَ ۖ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na siku hiyo watasalimu amri mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu, na yatapotea waliyo kuwa wakiyazua.
translation_en: And they will impart to Allah that Day [their] submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent.

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ زِدْنَٰهُمْ عَذَابًۭا فَوْقَ ٱلْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يُفْسِدُونَ
translation_sw: Wale walio kufuru na kuzuilia Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu tutawazidishia adhabu juu ya adhabu, kwa walivyo kuwa wakifisidi.
translation_en: Those who disbelieved and averted [others] from the way of Allah - We will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ۚ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ تِبْيَٰنًۭا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na (waonye) siku tutakapo wainua mashahidi katika kila umma wakiwashuhudia kwa yanayo tokana na wao, na tutakuleta wewe uwe shahidi juu ya hao. Na tumekuteremshia Kitabu hiki kinacho bainisha kila kitu, na ni uwongofu, na rehema, na bishara kwa Waislamu.
translation_en: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over your nation. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.

arabic_text: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ وَإِيتَآئِ ذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْبَغْىِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anaamrisha kufanya uadilifu, na hisani, na kuwapa jamaa; na anakataza uchafu, na uovu, na dhulma. Anakuwaidhini ili mpate kukumbuka.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

arabic_text: وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا عَٰهَدتُّمْ وَلَا تَنقُضُوا۟ ٱلْأَيْمَٰنَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na timizeni ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu mnapo ahidi, wala msivunje viapo baada ya kuvithibitisha, ilihali mmekwisha mfanya Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye mdhamini wenu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anayajua myatendayo.
translation_en: And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have taken it, [O believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made Allah, over you, a witness. Indeed, Allah knows what you do.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّتِى نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَٰثًۭا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِىَ أَرْبَىٰ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ ۚ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
translation_sw: Wala msiwe kama mwanamke anaye uzongoa uzi wake baada ya kwisha usokota ukawa mgumu. Mnavifanya viapo vyenu kuwa ni njia ya kudanganyana baina yenu kwa kuwa ati taifa moja lina nguvu zaidi kuliko jengine? Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anakujaribuni kwa njia hiyo. Na bila ya shaka atakubainishieni Siku ya Kiyama mliyo kuwa mkikhitalifiana.
translation_en: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allah only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَلَٰكِن يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَلَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu angeli taka, kwa yakini angeli kufanyeni umma mmoja. Lakini anamwachia kupotea anaye mtaka, na anamwongoa amtakaye. Na hakika mtaulizwa kwa yale mliyo kuwa mkiyafanya.
translation_en: And if Allah had willed, He could have made you [of] one religion, but He causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌۢ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِمَا صَدَدتُّمْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Wala msifanye viapo vyenu ni njia ya kudanganyana baina yenu. Usije mguu ukateleza badala ya kuthibiti, na mkaonja maovu kwa sababu ya kule kuzuilia Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu, na mkapata adhabu kubwa.
translation_en: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allah, and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنًۭا قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Wala msinunue ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu kwa thamani ndogo. Hakika kilichoko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ndicho bora kwenu, ikiwa mnajua.
translation_en: And do not exchange the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is best for you, if only you could know.

arabic_text: مَا عِندَكُمْ يَنفَدُ ۖ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ بَاقٍۢ ۗ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Mlivyo navyo vitakwisha na vilivyoko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ndivyo vitakavyo bakia. Na kwa yakini Sisi tutawapa walio subiri ujira wao kwa bora ya waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda.
translation_en: Whatever you have will end, but what Allah has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do.

arabic_text: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُۥ حَيَوٰةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ ۖ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenye kutenda mema, mwanamume au mwanamke, naye akawa ni Muumini, tutamhuisha maisha mema; na tutawapa ujira wao kwa bora ya waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda.
translation_en: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
translation_sw: Na ukisoma Qur'ani mwombe Mwenyezi Mungu akulinde na Shetani maluuni.
translation_en: So when you recite the Qur'an, [first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ سُلْطَٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika yeye hana madaraka juu ya walio amini na wakamtegemea Mola wao Mlezi.
translation_en: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا سُلْطَٰنُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِهِۦ مُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika madaraka yake ni juu ya wanao mfanya rafiki yao, na wale wanao fanya ushirika naye.
translation_en: His authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with Allah.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا بَدَّلْنَآ ءَايَةًۭ مَّكَانَ ءَايَةٍۢ ۙ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُفْتَرٍۭ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na tunapo badilisha Ishara pahala pa Ishara nyengine, na Mwenyezi Mungu anajua anayo teremsha, wao husema: Wewe ni mzushi. Bali wengi wao hawajui kitu.
translation_en: And when We substitute a verse in place of a verse - and Allah is most knowing of what He sends down - they say, "You, [O Muhammad], are but an inventor [of lies]." But most of them do not know.

arabic_text: قُلْ نَزَّلَهُۥ رُوحُ ٱلْقُدُسِ مِن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهُدًۭى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Ameiteremsha hii Roho takatifu kutokana na Mola wako Mlezi kwa haki, ili awathibitishe wale walio amini, na kuwa ni uwongofu, na ni bishara kwa Waislamu.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "The Pure Spirit has brought it down from your Lord in truth to make firm those who believe and as guidance and good tidings to the Muslims."

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُۥ بَشَرٌۭ ۗ لِّسَانُ ٱلَّذِى يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِىٌّۭ وَهَٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِىٌّۭ مُّبِينٌ
translation_sw: Na Sisi hakika tunajua kwamba wanasema: Yuko mtu anaye mfundisha. Lugha ya huyo wanaye muelekezea ni ya kigeni, na hii ni lugha ya Kiarabu mbayana.
translation_en: And We certainly know that they say, "It is only a human being who teaches the Prophet." The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this Qur'an is [in] a clear Arabic language.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَهْدِيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_sw: Hakika wasio ziamini Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu, Mwenyezi Mungu hawaongoi, nao watapata adhabu chungu.
translation_en: Indeed, those who do not believe in the verses of Allah - Allah will not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِى ٱلْكَذِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَٰذِبُونَ
translation_sw: Wanao zua uwongo ni wale tu wasio ziamini Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu. Na hao ndio waongo.
translation_en: They only invent falsehood who do not believe in the verses of Allah, and it is those who are the liars.

arabic_text: مَن كَفَرَ بِٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ إِيمَٰنِهِۦٓ إِلَّا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُۥ مُطْمَئِنٌّۢ بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ وَلَٰكِن مَّن شَرَحَ بِٱلْكُفْرِ صَدْرًۭا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Anaye mkataa Mwenyezi Mungu baada ya kuamini kwake - isipo kuwa aliye lazimishwa na hali ya kuwa moyo wake umetua juu ya Imani, lakini aliye kifungulia kifua chake kukataa - basi hao ghadhabu ya Mwenyezi Mungu ipo juu yao, na wao watapata adhabu kubwa.
translation_en: Whoever disbelieves in Allah after his belief... except for one who is forced [to renounce his religion] while his heart is secure in faith. But those who [willingly] open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from Allah, and for them is a great punishment;

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا عَلَى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa sababu wameyapenda zaidi maisha ya duniani kuliko ya Akhera, na kwa sababu Mwenyezi Mungu hawaongoi watu makafiri.
translation_en: That is because they preferred the worldly life over the Hereafter and that Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰفِلُونَ
translation_sw: Hao ndio Mwenyezi Mungu ameziziba nyoyo zao na masikio yao na macho yao. Na hao ndio walio ghafilika.
translation_en: Those are the ones over whose hearts and hearing and vision Allah has sealed, and it is those who are the heedless.

arabic_text: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
translation_sw: Hapana shaka ya kwamba hao ndio wenye kukhasiri Akhera.
translation_en: Assuredly, it is they, in the Hereafter, who will be the losers.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوا۟ ثُمَّ جَٰهَدُوا۟ وَصَبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Kisha hakika Mola wako Mlezi, kwa wale walio hama makwao baada ya kuteswa, kisha wakapigania Dini na wakasubiri, bila ya shaka Mola wako Mlezi baada ya hayo ni Mwenye kusamehe Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled [to renounce their religion] and thereafter fought [for the cause of Allah] and were patient - indeed, your Lord, after that, is Forgiving and Merciful

arabic_text: ۞ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ تُجَٰدِلُ عَن نَّفْسِهَا وَتُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Siku ambayo kila nafsi itakuja jitetea, na kila nafsi italipwa sawa sawa na a'mali ilizo zifanya, nao hawatadhulumiwa.
translation_en: On the Day when every soul will come disputing for itself, and every soul will be fully compensated for what it did, and they will not be wronged.

arabic_text: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا قَرْيَةًۭ كَانَتْ ءَامِنَةًۭ مُّطْمَئِنَّةًۭ يَأْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًۭا مِّن كُلِّ مَكَانٍۢ فَكَفَرَتْ بِأَنْعُمِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَذَٰقَهَا ٱللَّهُ لِبَاسَ ٱلْجُوعِ وَٱلْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْنَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu amepiga mfano wa mji ulio kuwa na amani na utulivu, riziki yake ikiufikia kwa nafasi kutoka kila mahali. Lakini ukazikufuru neema za Mwenyezi Mungu; kwa hivyo Mwenyezi Mungu akauvika vazi la njaa na khofu kwa sababu ya yale waliyo kuwa wakiyafanya.
translation_en: And Allah presents an example: a city which was safe and secure, its provision coming to it in abundance from every location, but it denied the favors of Allah. So Allah made it taste the envelopment of hunger and fear for what they had been doing.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na alikwisha wajia Mjumbe wa miongoni mwao wenyewe. Lakini wakamkanusha; basi iliwafika adhabu hali ya kuwa wamedhulumu.
translation_en: And there had certainly come to them a Messenger from among themselves, but they denied him; so punishment overtook them while they were wrongdoers.

arabic_text: فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ حَلَٰلًۭا طَيِّبًۭا وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_sw: Basi kuleni katika vile alivyo kupeni Mwenyezi Mungu, vilivyo halali na vizuri. Na shukuruni neema za Mwenyezi Mungu, ikiwa kweli mnamuabudu Yeye.
translation_en: Then eat of what Allah has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. And be grateful for the favor of Allah, if it is [indeed] Him that you worship.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةَ وَٱلدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍۢ وَلَا عَادٍۢ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Amekuharimishieni nyamafu tu, na damu, na nyama ya nguruwe, na mnyama aliye chinjwa kwa ajili isiyo kuwa ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Lakini anaye lazimishwa bila ya kuasi, wala kuruka mipaka, basi hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusamehe na Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit] - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ لِمَا تَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُكُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ هَٰذَا حَلَٰلٌۭ وَهَٰذَا حَرَامٌۭ لِّتَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ
translation_sw: Wala msiseme uwongo, kwa kuropokwa na ndimi zenu: Hichi halali, na hichi haramu - mkimzulia uwongo Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika wanao mzulia uwongo Mwenyezi Mungu hawatafanikiwa.
translation_en: And do not say about what your tongues assert of untruth, "This is lawful and this is unlawful," to invent falsehood about Allah. Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allah will not succeed.

arabic_text: مَتَٰعٌۭ قَلِيلٌۭ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Ni starehe ndogo, nao watapata adhabu chungu.
translation_en: [It is but] a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment.

arabic_text: وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ حَرَّمْنَا مَا قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mayahudi tuliwaharimishia yale tuliyo kuhadithia zamani. Na Sisi hatukuwadhulumu, bali walikuwa wakijudhulumu wenyewe.
translation_en: And to those who are Jews We have prohibited that which We related to you before. And We did not wrong them [thereby], but they were wronging themselves.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِجَهَٰلَةٍۢ ثُمَّ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوٓا۟ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
translation_sw: Kisha hakika Mola wako Mlezi kwa walio tenda uovu kwa ujinga, kisha wakatubia baada ya hayo na wakatenda mema; bila ya shaka Mola wako Mlezi baada ya hayo ni Mwenye kusamehe na Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who have done wrong out of ignorance and then repent after that and correct themselves - indeed, your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ كَانَ أُمَّةًۭ قَانِتًۭا لِّلَّهِ حَنِيفًۭا وَلَمْ يَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika Ibrahim alikuwa mfano mwema, mnyenyekevu kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, mwongofu, wala hakuwa miongoni mwa washirikina.
translation_en: Indeed, Abraham was a [comprehensive] leader, devoutly obedient to Allah, inclining toward truth, and he was not of those who associate others with Allah.

arabic_text: شَاكِرًۭا لِّأَنْعُمِهِ ۚ ٱجْتَبَىٰهُ وَهَدَىٰهُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Mwenye kuzishukuru neema zake, Mwenyezi Mungu. Yeye kamteuwa, na akamwongoa kwenye Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: [He was] grateful for His favors. Allah chose him and guided him to a straight path.

arabic_text: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًۭ ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukampa wema duniani, na hakika Akhera atakuwa miongoni mwa watu wema.
translation_en: And We gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ أَنِ ٱتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukakufunulia ya kwamba ufuate mila ya Ibrahim, mwongofu, wala hakuwa miongoni mwa washirikina.
translation_en: Then We revealed to you, [O Muhammad], to follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of those who associate with Allah.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ ٱلسَّبْتُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika siku ya Sabato (Jumaamosi) waliwekewa wale walio khitalifiana kwa ajili yake. Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi bila ya shaka atahukumu baina yao Siku ya Kiyama katika yale waliyo kuwa wakikhitalifiana.
translation_en: The sabbath was only appointed for those who differed over it. And indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

arabic_text: ٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ۖ وَجَٰدِلْهُم بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۖ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
translation_sw: Waite waelekee kwenye Njia ya Mola wako Mlezi kwa hikima na mawaidha mema, na ujadiliane nao kwa namna iliyo bora. Hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye anaye mjua zaidi aliye ipotea Njia yake, na Yeye ndiye anaye wajua zaidi walio ongoka.
translation_en: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in a way that is best. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has strayed from His way, and He is most knowing of who is [rightly] guided.

arabic_text: وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُم بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَئِن صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لِّلصَّٰبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na mkilipiza basi lipizeni sawa na vile mlivyo adhibiwa. Na ikiwa mtasubiri, basi hakika hivyo ni bora zaidi kwa wanao subiri.
translation_en: And if you punish [an enemy, O believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. But if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient.

arabic_text: وَٱصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِى ضَيْقٍۢ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na subiri. Na kusubiri kwako kusiwe ila kwa sababu ya Mwenyezi Mungu tu. Wala usiwahuzunikie; wala usiwe katika dhiki kwa hila wanazo zifanya.
translation_en: And be patient, [O Muhammad], and your patience is not but through Allah. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu yu pamoja na wenye kumcha, na watendao mema.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.

arabic_text: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
translation_sw: SUBHANA, Ametakasika aliye mchukua mja wake usiku mmoja kutoka Msikiti Mtukufu mpaka Msikiti wa Mbali, ambao tumevibariki vilivyo uzunguka, ili tumuonyeshe baadhi ya Ishara zetu. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kusikia na Mwenye kuona.
translation_en: Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

arabic_text: وَءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هُدًۭى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن دُونِى وَكِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Na tukampa Musa Kitabu, na tukakifanya uwongofu kwa Wana wa Israili. (Tukawambia): Msiwe na mtegemewa ila Mimi!
translation_en: And We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel that you not take other than Me as Disposer of affairs,

arabic_text: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَبْدًۭا شَكُورًۭا
translation_sw: Enyi kizazi tuliyo wachukua pamoja na Nuhu! Hakika yeye alikuwa mja mwenye shukrani.
translation_en: O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah. Indeed, he was a grateful servant.

arabic_text: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na tukawahukumia Wana wa Israili katika Kitabu kwamba: Hakika nyinyi mtafanya fisadi katika nchi mara mbili, na kwa yakini mtapanda kiburi, kiburi kikubwa.
translation_en: And We conveyed to the Children of Israel in the Scripture that, "You will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ أُولَىٰهُمَا بَعَثْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ عِبَادًۭا لَّنَآ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ فَجَاسُوا۟ خِلَٰلَ ٱلدِّيَارِ ۚ وَكَانَ وَعْدًۭا مَّفْعُولًۭا
translation_sw: Basi itapo fika ahadi ya kwanza yake tutakupelekeeni waja wetu wa kali kwa vita. Watakuingilieni ndani ya majumba. Na hii ilikuwa ahadi iliyo timizwa.
translation_en: So when the [time of] promise came for the first of them, We sent against you servants of Ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْكَرَّةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَمْدَدْنَٰكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ أَكْثَرَ نَفِيرًا
translation_sw: Kisha tukakurudishieni nguvu zenu dhidi yao, na tukakusaidieni kwa mali na wana, na tukakujaalieni mkawa wengi zaidi.
translation_en: Then We gave back to you a return victory over them. And We reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower

arabic_text: إِنْ أَحْسَنتُمْ أَحْسَنتُمْ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ ۖ وَإِنْ أَسَأْتُمْ فَلَهَا ۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لِيَسُۥٓـُٔوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ وَلِيَدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ كَمَا دَخَلُوهُ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ وَلِيُتَبِّرُوا۟ مَا عَلَوْا۟ تَتْبِيرًا
translation_sw: Basi mkifanya wema, mnajifanyia wema nafsi zenu. Na mkifanya ubaya, mnajifanyia wenyewe. Na ikifika ahadi ya mwisho ili waziharibu nyuso zenu, na waingie Msikitini kama walivyo ingia mara ya kwanza, na waharibu kila walicho kiteka kwa uharibifu mkubwa.
translation_en: [And said], "If you do good, you do good for yourselves; and if you do evil, [you do it] to yourselves." Then when the final promise came, [We sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the temple in Jerusalem, as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction.

arabic_text: عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يَرْحَمَكُمْ ۚ وَإِنْ عُدتُّمْ عُدْنَا ۘ وَجَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ حَصِيرًا
translation_sw: Huenda Mola wenu Mlezi akakurehemuni. Na mkirudia na Sisi tutarudia. Na tumeifanya Jahannamu kuwa ni gereza kwa ajili ya makafiri.
translation_en: [Then Allah said], "It is expected, [if you repent], that your Lord will have mercy upon you. But if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment]. And We have made Hell, for the disbelievers, a prison-bed."

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَهْدِى لِلَّتِى هِىَ أَقْوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًۭا كَبِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika hii Qur'ani inaongoa kwenye ya yaliyo nyooka kabisa, na inawabashiria Waumini ambao wanatenda mema ya kwamba watapata malipo makubwa.
translation_en: Indeed, this Qur'an guides to that which is most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Na yakwamba wale wasio iamini Akhera tumewaandalia adhabu chungu.
translation_en: And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter - We have prepared for them a painful punishment.

arabic_text: وَيَدْعُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ بِٱلشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهُۥ بِٱلْخَيْرِ ۖ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَجُولًۭا
translation_sw: Na mwanaadamu huomba shari kama vile aombavyo kheri, kwani mwanaadamu ni mwenye pupa.
translation_en: And man supplicates for evil as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ءَايَتَيْنِ ۖ فَمَحَوْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَجَعَلْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلنَّهَارِ مُبْصِرَةًۭ لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلِتَعْلَمُوا۟ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلْحِسَابَ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ فَصَّلْنَٰهُ تَفْصِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Na tumefanya usiku na mchana kuwa ishara mbili. Tena tukaifuta ishara ya usiku, na tukaifanya ishara ya mchana ni yenye mwangaza ili mtafute fadhila itokayo kwa Mola wenu Mlezi, na mpate kujua idadi ya miaka na hisabu. Na kila kitu tumekifafanua waziwazi.
translation_en: And We have made the night and day two signs, and We erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your Lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time]. And everything We have set out in detail.

arabic_text: وَكُلَّ إِنسَٰنٍ أَلْزَمْنَٰهُ طَٰٓئِرَهُۥ فِى عُنُقِهِۦ ۖ وَنُخْرِجُ لَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ كِتَٰبًۭا يَلْقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا
translation_sw: Na kila mtu tumemfungia a'mali yake shingoni mwake. Na Siku ya Kiyama tutamtolea kitabu atakacho kikuta kiwazi kimekunjuliwa.
translation_en: And [for] every person We have imposed his fate upon his neck, and We will produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open.

arabic_text: ٱقْرَأْ كِتَٰبَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفْسِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيبًۭا
translation_sw: Ataambiwa: Soma kitabu chako! Nafsi yako inakutosha leo kukuhisabu.
translation_en: [It will be said], "Read your record. Sufficient is yourself against you this Day as accountant."

arabic_text: مَّنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبْعَثَ رَسُولًۭا
translation_sw: Anaye ongoka basi anaongoka kwa ajili ya nafsi yake. Na anaye potea basi anapotea kwa khasara yake mwenyewe. Wala habebi mbebaji mzigo wa mwengine. Wala Sisi hatuadhibu mpaka tumpeleke Mtume.
translation_en: Whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul. And whoever errs only errs against it. And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And never would We punish until We sent a messenger.

arabic_text: وَإِذَآ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُوا۟ فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْقَوْلُ فَدَمَّرْنَٰهَا تَدْمِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na pindi tukitaka kuuteketeza mji huwaamrisha wale wenye starehe na taanusi, lakini wao huendelea kutenda maovu humo. Basi hapo kauli huthibiti juu ya mji huo, nasi tukauangamiza kwa maangamizo makubwa.
translation_en: And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction.

arabic_text: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ نُوحٍۢ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na kaumu ngapi tumeziangamiza baada ya Nuhu! Na Mola wako Mlezi anatosha kabisa kuwa ni Mwenye kuzijua na kuziona dhambi za waja wake.
translation_en: And how many have We destroyed from the generations after Noah. And sufficient is your Lord, concerning the sins of His servants, as Acquainted and Seeing.

arabic_text: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهُۥ فِيهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَىٰهَا مَذْمُومًۭا مَّدْحُورًۭا
translation_sw: Anaye taka yapitayo upesi upesi, tutafanya haraka kumletea hapa hapa tunayo yataka kwa tumtakaye. Kisha tumemwekea Jahannamu; ataingia humo hali ya kuwa ni mwenye kulaumiwa na kufurushwa.
translation_en: Whoever should desire the immediate - We hasten for him from it what We will to whom We intend. Then We have made for him Hell, which he will [enter to] burn, censured and banished.

arabic_text: وَمَنْ أَرَادَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na anaye itaka Akhera, na akazifanyia juhudi a'mali zake, naye ni Muumini, basi hao juhudi yao itakuwa ni ya kushukuriwa.
translation_en: But whoever desires the Hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by Allah].

arabic_text: كُلًّۭا نُّمِدُّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مِنْ عَطَآءِ رَبِّكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ عَطَآءُ رَبِّكَ مَحْظُورًا
translation_sw: Wote hao tunawakunjulia - hawa na hao - katika neema za Mola wako Mlezi. Wala neema za Mola wako Mlezi hazizuiliki.
translation_en: To each [category] We extend - to these and to those - from the gift of your Lord. And never has the gift of your Lord been restricted.

arabic_text: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ وَأَكْبَرُ تَفْضِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Angalia vipi tulivyo wafadhili baadhi yao kuliko wenginewe. Na hakika Akhera ni yenye daraja kubwa zaidi na fadhila kubwa zaidi.
translation_en: Look how We have favored [in provision] some of them over others. But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction.

arabic_text: لَّا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُومًۭا مَّخْذُولًۭا
translation_sw: Usimfanye mungu mwengine pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu, usije ukawa wa kulaumiwa uliye tupika.
translation_en: Do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken.

arabic_text: ۞ وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّۢ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًۭا كَرِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Na Mola wako Mlezi ameamrisha kuwa msimuabudu yeyote ila Yeye tu, na wazazi wawili muwatendee wema. Mmoja wao akifikia uzee, naye yuko kwako, au wote wawili, basi usimwambie hata: Ah! Wala usiwakemee. Na sema nao kwa msemo wa hishima.
translation_en: And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff," and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word.

arabic_text: وَٱخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na uwainamishie bawa la unyenyekevu kwa kuwaonea huruma. Na useme: Mola wangu Mlezi! Warehemu kama walivyo nilea utotoni.
translation_en: And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small."

arabic_text: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِى نُفُوسِكُمْ ۚ إِن تَكُونُوا۟ صَٰلِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِلْأَوَّٰبِينَ غَفُورًۭا
translation_sw: Mola wenu anajua kabisa yaliyo nyoyoni mwenu. Ikiwa nyinyi mtakuwa wema, basi hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kuwaghufiria wanao tubia kwake.
translation_en: Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. If you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed He is ever, to the often returning [to Him], Forgiving.

arabic_text: وَءَاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا
translation_sw: Na mpe aliye jamaa yako haki yake, na masikini, na msafiri; wala usitumie ovyo kwa fujo.
translation_en: And give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveler, and do not spend wastefully.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوٓا۟ إِخْوَٰنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِرَبِّهِۦ كَفُورًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika wabadhirifu ni ndugu wa Mashet'ani. Na Shet'ani ni mwenye kumkufuru Mola wake Mlezi.
translation_en: Indeed, the wasteful are brothers of the devils, and ever has Satan been to his Lord ungrateful.

arabic_text: وَإِمَّا تُعْرِضَنَّ عَنْهُمُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ رَحْمَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ تَرْجُوهَا فَقُل لَّهُمْ قَوْلًۭا مَّيْسُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na ikiwa unajikurupusha nao, nawe unatafuta rehema ya Mola wako Mlezi unayo itaraji, basi sema nao maneno laini.
translation_en: And if you [must] turn away from the needy awaiting mercy from your Lord which you expect, then speak to them a gentle word.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ ٱلْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُومًۭا مَّحْسُورًا
translation_sw: Wala usiufanye mkono wako kama ulio fungwa shingoni mwako, wala usiukunjue wote kabisa, utabaki ukilaumiwa muflisi.
translation_en: And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent.

arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika Mola wako Mlezi humkunjulia riziki amtakaye, na humpimia amtakaye. Hakika Yeye kwa waja wake ni Mwenye kuwajua na kuwaona.
translation_en: Indeed, your Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلَٰقٍۢ ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْـًۭٔا كَبِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Wala msiwauwe wana wenu kwa kuogopa umasikini. Sisi tunawaruzuku wao na nyinyi. Hakika kuwaua hao ni khatia kubwa.
translation_en: And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلزِّنَىٰٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَٰحِشَةًۭ وَسَآءَ سَبِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Wala msikaribie uzinzi. Hakika huo ni uchafu na njia mbaya.
translation_en: And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَمَن قُتِلَ مَظْلُومًۭا فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِوَلِيِّهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًۭا فَلَا يُسْرِف فِّى ٱلْقَتْلِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مَنصُورًۭا
translation_sw: Wala msiuwe nafsi ambayo Mwenyezi Mungu amekataza isipo kuwa kwa haki. Na aliye uliwa kwa kudhulumiwa basi tumempa madaraka mrithi wake. Lakini asipite mpaka katika kuuwa. Kwani yeye anasaidiwa.
translation_en: And do not kill the soul which Allah has forbidden, except by right. And whoever is killed unjustly - We have given his heir authority, but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. Indeed, he has been supported [by the law].

arabic_text: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ مَالَ ٱلْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعَهْدِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلْعَهْدَ كَانَ مَسْـُٔولًۭا
translation_sw: Wala msiyakaribie mali ya yatima, isipo kuwa kwa njia iliyo bora, mpaka afike utuuzimani. Na timizeni ahadi. Kwa hakika ahadi itasailiwa.
translation_en: And do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned.

arabic_text: وَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ إِذَا كِلْتُمْ وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Na timizeni kipimo mpimapo. Na pimeni kwa mizani zilizo sawa. Hayo ni wema kwenu na khatimaye ndio bora.
translation_en: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْبَصَرَ وَٱلْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْـُٔولًۭا
translation_sw: Wala usiyafuate usiyo na ujuzi nayo. Hakika masikio, na macho, na moyo - hivyo vyote vitasailiwa.
translation_en: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّكَ لَن تَخْرِقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَن تَبْلُغَ ٱلْجِبَالَ طُولًۭا
translation_sw: Wala usitembee katika ardhi kwa maringo. Hakika wewe huwezi kuipasua ardhi wala kufikia urefu wa milima.
translation_en: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.

arabic_text: كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّكَ مَكْرُوهًۭا
translation_sw: Haya yote ubaya wake ni wenye kuchukiza kwa Mola wako Mlezi.
translation_en: All that - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّآ أَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ ۗ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتُلْقَىٰ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَلُومًۭا مَّدْحُورًا
translation_sw: Haya ni katika hikima alizo kufunulia Mola wako Mlezi. Wala usimweke pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu mungu mwengine, usije ukatupwa katika Jahannamu ukilaumiwa na kufurushwa.
translation_en: That is from what your Lord has revealed to you, [O Muhammad], of wisdom. And, [O mankind], do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity, lest you be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished.

arabic_text: أَفَأَصْفَىٰكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱتَّخَذَ مِنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنَٰثًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَقُولُونَ قَوْلًا عَظِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Je! Mola wenu Mlezi amekuteulieni wavulana, na Yeye akawafanya Malaika ni banati zake? Kwa hakika nyinyi mnasema usemi mkubwa.
translation_en: Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ وَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na tumekwisha bainisha katika Qur'ani hii ili wapate kukumbuka. Lakini haikuwazidisha ila kuwa mbali nayo.
translation_en: And We have certainly diversified [the contents] in this Qur'an that mankind may be reminded, but it does not increase the disbelievers except in aversion.

arabic_text: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ مَعَهُۥٓ ءَالِهَةٌۭ كَمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذًۭا لَّٱبْتَغَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ سَبِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Sema: Lau kuwa wangeli kuwa pamoja naye miungu mingine kama wasemavyo, basi wangeli tafuta njia ya kumfikia Mwenye Kiti cha Enzi.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "If there had been with Him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the Owner of the Throne a way."

arabic_text: سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Subhanahu Wa Taa'la, Ametakasika na Ametukuka juu kabisa na hayo wanayo yasema.
translation_en: Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.

arabic_text: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ٱلسَّبْعُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِيحَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًۭا
translation_sw: Zinamtakasa zote mbingu saba na ardhi na vyote viliomo ndani yake. Na hapana kitu ila kinamtakasa kwa sifa zake. Lakini nyinyi hamfahamu kutakasa kwake. Hakika Yeye ni Mpole na Mwenye maghfira.
translation_en: The seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt Him. And there is not a thing except that it exalts [Allah] by His praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. Indeed, He is ever Forbearing and Forgiving.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ حِجَابًۭا مَّسْتُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na unapo soma Qur'ani tunaweka baina yako na wale wasio iamini Akhera pazia linalo wafunika.
translation_en: And when you recite the Qur'an, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًۭا ۚ وَإِذَا ذَكَرْتَ رَبَّكَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَلَّوْا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَٰرِهِمْ نُفُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na tunaweka vifuniko juu ya nyoyo zao wasije wakaifahamu, na tunaweka kwenye masikio yao uziwi. Na unapo mtaja katika Qur'ani Mola wako Mlezi peke yake, basi wao hugeuka nyuma wakenda zao.
translation_en: And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur'an, they turn back in aversion.

arabic_text: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِذْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَىٰٓ إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًۭا مَّسْحُورًا
