translation_en: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.

arabic_text: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَٰلًا
translation_sw: Sema: Je, tukutajieni wenye khasara mno katika vitendo vyao?
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا
translation_sw: Ni wale ambao juhudi yao katika maisha ya dunia imepotea bure, nao wanadhani kwamba wanafanya kazi nzuri.
translation_en: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَزْنًۭا
translation_sw: Hao ni wale walio zikanusha Ishara za Mola wao Mlezi na kukutana naye. Kwa hivyo vitendo vyao vimepotea bure, na wala Siku ya Kiyama hatutawathamini kitu.
translation_en: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِى وَرُسُلِى هُزُوًا
translation_sw: Hiyo Jahannamu ni malipo yao kwa walivyo kufuru na wakafanyia kejeli Ishara zangu na Mitume wangu.
translation_en: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا
translation_sw: Hakika wale walio amini na wakatenda mema mashukio yao yatakuwa kwenye Pepo za Firdausi.
translation_en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,

arabic_text: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًۭا
translation_sw: Watadumu humo; hawatataka kuondoka.
translation_en: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.

arabic_text: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ ٱلْبَحْرُ مِدَادًۭا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّى لَنَفِدَ ٱلْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّى وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِۦ مَدَدًۭا
translation_sw: Sema: Lau kuwa bahari ndio wino kwa maneno ya Mola wangu Mlezi, basi bahari ingeli malizika kabla ya kumalizika maneno ya Mola wangu Mlezi, hata tungeli ileta mfano wa hiyo kuongezea.
translation_en: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement."

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا
translation_sw: Sema: Mimi ni mwanaadamu kama nyinyi. Ninaletewa Wahyi kwamba Mungu wenu ni Mungu Mmoja. Mwenye kutaraji kukutana na Mola wake Mlezi basi naatende vitendo vyema, wala asimshirikishe yeyote katika ibada ya Mola wake Mlezi.
translation_en: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."

arabic_text: كٓهيعٓصٓ
translation_sw: Kaf Ha Ya A'yn S'ad
translation_en: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad.

arabic_text: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
translation_sw: Huu ni Ukumbusho wa rehema ya Mola wako Mlezi kwa mja wake, Zakariya.
translation_en: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah

arabic_text: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Alipo mwita Mola wake Mlezi kwa siri.
translation_en: When he called to his Lord a private supplication.

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًۭا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Mafupa yangu yamedhoofika, na kichwa kinameremeta kwa mvi; wala, Mola wangu Mlezi, sikuwa mwenye bahati mbaya kwa kukuomba Wewe.
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.

arabic_text: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na hakika mimi nawakhofia jamaa zangu baada yangu. Na mke wangu ni tasa. Basi nipe mrithi kutoka kwako.
translation_en: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir

arabic_text: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Atakaye nirithi mimi na awarithi ukoo wa Yaaqub. Ewe Mola wangu Mlezi! Na umjaalie awe mwenye kuridhisha.
translation_en: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."

arabic_text: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّۭا
translation_sw: (Akaambiwa): Ewe Zakariya! Hakika Sisi tunakubashiria mwana; jina lake ni Yahya. Hatujapata kumpa jina hilo yeyote kabla yake.
translation_en: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Akasema: Ewe Mola wangu Mlezi! Vipi nitakuwa na mwana na hali mke wangu ni tasa, na mimi nimesha fikia ukongwe katika uzee?
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"

arabic_text: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
translation_sw: Akasema: Ndio hivyo hivyo amesema Mola wako Mlezi: Haya ni mepesi kwangu. Na hakika Mimi nilikwisha kuumba wewe zamani na hali hukuwa kitu.
translation_en: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.' "

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٍۢ سَوِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi nijaalie Ishara. Akasema Ishara yako ni kuwa hutasema na watu kwa masiku matatu, na hali ni mzima.
translation_en: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."

arabic_text: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Basi akawatokea watu wake kutoka mihirabuni. Akawaashiria: Msabihini Mwenyezi Mungu asubuhi na jioni.
translation_en: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon.

arabic_text: يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Ewe Yahya! Kishike Kitabu kwa nguvu! Nasi tulimpa hikima angali mtoto.
translation_en: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy

arabic_text: وَحَنَانًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةًۭ ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na tukampa huruma itokayo kwetu, na utakaso, na akawa mchamungu.
translation_en: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah

arabic_text: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na akawa mwema kwa wazazi wake, wala hakuwa jabari mua'si.
translation_en: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.

arabic_text: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na amani iwe juu yake siku ya kuzaliwa, na siku ya kufa, na siku ya kufufuliwa.
translation_en: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.

arabic_text: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na mtaje Maryamu katika Kitabu, pale alipo jitenga na jamaa zake mahali upande wa mashariki;
translation_en: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.

arabic_text: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًۭا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na akaweka pazia kujikinga nao. Tukampelekea Roho wetu, akajifananisha kwake sawa na mtu.
translation_en: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.

arabic_text: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا
translation_sw: (Maryamu) akasema: Hakika mimi najikinga kwa Mwingi wa Rehema aniepushe nawe, ukiwa ni mchamngu.
translation_en: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah."

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًۭا زَكِيًّۭا
translation_sw: (Malaika) akasema: Hakika mimi ni mwenye kutumwa na Mola wako Mlezi ili nikubashirie tunu ya mwana aliye takasika.
translation_en: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."

arabic_text: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Akasema: Nitampataje mwana hali mwanaadamu yeyote hajanigusa, wala mimi si kahaba?
translation_en: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"

arabic_text: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
translation_sw: (Malaika) akasema: Ndio hivyo hivyo! Mola wako Mlezi amesema: Haya ni mepesi kwangu! Na ili tumfanye kuwa ni Ishara kwa watu, na Rehema itokayo kwetu, na hilo ni jambo lilio kwisha hukumiwa.
translation_en: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.' "

arabic_text: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًۭا قَصِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Basi akachukua mimba yake, na akaondoka nayo mpaka mahali pa mbali.
translation_en: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

arabic_text: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًۭا مَّنسِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Kisha uchungu ukampeleka kwenye shina la mtende; akasema: Laiti ningeli kufa kabla ya haya, na nikawa niliye sahaulika kabisa!
translation_en: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."

arabic_text: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Pakatangazwa kutoka chini yake: Usihuzunike! Hakika Mola wako Mlezi amejaalia chini yako kijito kidogo cha maji!
translation_en: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.

arabic_text: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na litikise kwako hilo shina la mtende, utakuangushia tende nzuri zilizo mbivu.
translation_en: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.

arabic_text: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًۭا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًۭا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Basi kula, na kunywa, na litue jicho lako. Na pindi ukimwona mtu yeyote basi sema: Hakika mimi nimeweka nadhiri kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ya kufunga; kwa hivyo leo sitasema na mtu.
translation_en: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "

arabic_text: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Akenda naye (mwanawe) kwa jamaa zake amembeba. Wakasema: Ewe Maryamu! Hakika umeleta kitu cha ajabu!
translation_en: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍۢ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Ewe dada yake Harun! Baba yako hakuwa mtu muovu, wala mama yako hakuwa kahaba.
translation_en: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."

arabic_text: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Akawaashiria (mtoto). Wakasema: Vipi tumsemeze aliye bado mdogo yumo katika mlezi?
translation_en: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّۭا
translation_sw: (Mtoto) akasema: Hakika mimi ni mtumwa wa Mwenyezi Mungu. Amenipa Kitabu, na amenifanya Nabii.
translation_en: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na amenijaalia ni mwenye kubarikiwa popote pale niwapo. Na ameniusia Sala na Zaka maadamu ni hai,
translation_en: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive

arabic_text: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na nimtendee wema mama yangu. Wala hakunifanya niwe jeuri, mwovu.
translation_en: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.

arabic_text: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na amani iko juu yangu siku niliyo zaliwa, na siku nitakayo kufa, na siku nitakayo fufuliwa kuwa hai.
translation_en: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
translation_sw: Huyo ndiye Isa mwana wa Maryamu. Ndiyo kauli ya haki ambayo wanaifanyia shaka.
translation_en: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.

arabic_text: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation_sw: Haiwi kwa Mwenyezi Mungu kuwa na mwana, Subhanahu, Yeye ametakasika! Anapo lihukumia jambo basi huliambia tu: Kuwa! Likawa.
translation_en: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mola wangu Mlezi, na Mola wenu Mlezi. Basi muabuduni Yeye. Hii ndiyo Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."

arabic_text: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_sw: Lakini makundi yakakhitalifiana wao kwa wao. Basi ole wao hao walio kufuru kwa kuhudhuria Siku iliyo kuu!
translation_en: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.

arabic_text: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Watasikia na wataona vizuri vilioje Siku watakayo tufikia! Lakini madhaalimu sasa wamo katika upotofu ulio dhaahiri.
translation_en: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.

arabic_text: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Na waonye siku ya majuto itapo katwa amri. Nao wamo katika ghafla, wala hawaamini.
translation_en: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.

arabic_text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tutairithi ardhi na walio juu yake. Na kwetu watarejeshwa.
translation_en: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.

arabic_text: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّا
translation_sw: Na mtaje katika Kitabu Ibrahim. Hakika yeye alikuwa mkweli, Nabii.
translation_en: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًۭٔا
translation_sw: Alipo mwambia baba yake: Ewe baba yangu! Kwa nini unaabudu visivyo sikia, na visivyo ona, na visivyo kufaa chochote?
translation_en: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Ewe baba yangu! Kwa yakini imenifikia ilimu isiyo kufikia wewe. Basi nifuate mimi, nami nitakuongoza Njia Iliyo Sawa.
translation_en: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Ewe baba yangu! Usimuabudu Shet'ani. Hakika Shet'ani ni mwenye kumuasi Mwingi wa Rehema.
translation_en: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Ewe baba yangu! Hakika mimi naogopa isikupate adhabu inayo toka kwa Mwingi wa Rehema ukaja kuwa mwenziwe Shet'ani.
translation_en: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."

arabic_text: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّۭا
translation_sw: (Baba) akasema: Unaichukia miungu yangu, ewe Ibrahim? Kama huachi, basi lazima nitakupiga mawe. Na niondokelee mbali kwa muda!
translation_en: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."

arabic_text: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّۭا
translation_sw: (Ibrahim) akasema: Salamun a'laika! Amani iwe juu yako! Mimi nitakuombea msamaha kwa Mola wangu Mlezi. Hakika Yeye ananihurumia sana.
translation_en: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.

arabic_text: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Nami najitenga nanyi na hayo mnayo yaabudu badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na ninamwomba Mola wangu Mlezi; asaa nisiwe mwenye kukosa bahati kwa kumwomba Mola wangu Mlezi.
translation_en: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Basi alipo jitenga nao na yale waliyo kuwa wakiyaabudu badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu, tulimpa Is-haq na Yaaqub, na kila mmoja tukamfanya Nabii.
translation_en: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.

arabic_text: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na tukawapa rehema zetu na tukawajaalia kupewa sifa za kweli tukufu.
translation_en: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.

arabic_text: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًۭا وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na mtaje Musa katika Kitabu. Hakika yeye alikuwa ni mwenye kuchaguliwa, na alikuwa Mtume, Nabii.
translation_en: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

arabic_text: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na tulimwita upande wa kulia wa mlima na tukamsogeza kunong'ona naye.
translation_en: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].

arabic_text: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Nasi kwa rehema zetu tukampa nduguye, Harun, awe Nabii.
translation_en: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.

arabic_text: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na mtaje katika Kitabu Ismail. Bila ya shaka yeye alikuwa ni mkweli wa ahadi, na alikuwa Mtume, Nabii.
translation_en: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

arabic_text: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na alikuwa akiwaamrisha watu wake Sala na Zaka, na alikuwa mbele ya Mola wake Mlezi mwenye kuridhiwa.
translation_en: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing.

arabic_text: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na mtaje katika Kitabu Idris. Hakika yeye alikuwa ni mkweli Nabii.
translation_en: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

arabic_text: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
translation_sw: Na tulimuinua daraja ya juu.
translation_en: And We raised him to a high station.

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۢ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَبُكِيًّۭا ۩
translation_sw: Hao ndio alio waneemesha Mwenyezi Mungu miongoni mwa Manabii katika uzao wa Adam, na katika uzao wa wale tulio wapandisha pamoja na Nuhu, na katika uzao wa Ibrahim na Israil, na katika wale tulio waongoa na tukawateuwa. Wanapo somewa Aya za Mwingi wa Rehema huanguka kusujudu na kulia.
translation_en: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.

arabic_text: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
translation_sw: Lakini wakaja baada yao walio wabaya, wakaacha Sala, na wakafuata matamanio. Basi watakuja kuta malipo ya ubaya.
translation_en: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -

arabic_text: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa walio tubu, wakaamini, na wakatenda mema. Hao, basi, wataingia Peponi wala hawatadhulumiwa chochote.
translation_en: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.

arabic_text: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Bustani za milele alizo waahidi Rahmani waja wake katika siri. Hakika ahadi yake hapana shaka itafika.
translation_en: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.

arabic_text: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Humo hawatasikia upuuzi, ila Salama tu. Na watapata humo riziki zao asubuhi na jioni.
translation_en: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.

arabic_text: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Hiyo ndiyo Pepo tutayo warithisha katika waja wetu walio kuwa wachamngu.
translation_en: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.

arabic_text: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا
translation_sw: (Nao watasema:) Wala hatuteremki ila kwa amri ya Mola wako Mlezi. Ni yake Yeye yaliyoko mbele yetu na yaliyoko nyuma yetu, na yaliyomo katikati ya hayo. Na Mola wako Mlezi si mwenye kusahau.
translation_en: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -

arabic_text: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na ardhi na vilivyo baina yake. Basi muabudu Yeye tu, na udumu katika ibada yake. Je, mnamjua mwenye jina kama lake?
translation_en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
translation_sw: Na mwanaadamu husema: Hivyo, nitakapo kufa, ni kweli nitafufuliwa niwe hai tena?
translation_en: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"

arabic_text: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
translation_sw: Je! Hakumbuki mwanaadamu ya kwamba tulimuumba kabla, na hali hakuwa chochote?
translation_en: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?

arabic_text: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Basi naapa kwa Mola wako Mlezi! Kwa yakini tutawakusanya wao pamoja na mashet'ani; kisha tutawahudhurisha kuizunguka Jahannamu, nao wamepiga magoti!
translation_en: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Kisha kwa yakini tutawatoa katika kila kundi wale miongoni mwao walio zidi kumuasi Arrahmani, Mwingi wa Rahema..
translation_en: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Tena hakika Sisi tunawajua vyema zaidi wanao stahiki kuunguzwa humo.
translation_en: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.

arabic_text: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Wala hapana yeyote katika nyinyi ila ni mwenye kuifikia. Hiyo ni hukumu ya Mola wako Mlezi ambayo lazima itimizwe.
translation_en: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Kisha tutawaokoa wale walio mchamngu; na tutawaacha madhaalimu humo wamepiga magoti.
translation_en: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌۭ مَّقَامًۭا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّۭا
translation_sw: Na wanapo somewa Aya zetu zilizo wazi, walio kufuru huwaambia walio amini: Lipi katika makundi mawili lenye cheo kizuri na lilio bora barazani?
translation_en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"

arabic_text: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًۭا وَرِءْيًۭا
translation_sw: Na kaumu ngapi tuliziangamiza zilizo kuwa na mapambo mazuri zaidi na wazuri zaidi kwa kuwatazama!
translation_en: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?

arabic_text: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًۭا
translation_sw: Sema: Walio katika upotofu basi Arrahmani Mwingi wa Rahema atawapururia muda mpaka wayaone waliyo onywa - ama ni adhabu au ni Saa. Hapo ndipo watapo jua ni nani mwenye makao mabaya na mwenye askari dhaifu.
translation_en: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."

arabic_text: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًۭى ۗ وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌۭ مَّرَدًّا
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu huwazidishia uwongofu wenye kushika uwongofu. Na mema yenye kudumu ni bora katika malipo mbele ya Mola wako Mlezi na yana mwisho mwema.
translation_en: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.

arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًا
translation_sw: Je, umemwona aliye zikanya Ishara zetu na akasema: Kwa hakika mimi nitapewa mali na wana!
translation_en: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"

arabic_text: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
translation_sw: Kwani yeye amepata khabari za ghaibu, au amechukua ahadi kwa Arrahmani Mwingi wa Rehema?
translation_en: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?

arabic_text: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّۭا
translation_sw: Hasha! Tutaandika anayo yasema, tutamkunjulia muda wa adhabu.
translation_en: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.

arabic_text: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًۭا
translation_sw: Na tutamrithi hayo anayo yasema, na atatufikia mtupu peke yake!
translation_en: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.

arabic_text: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّۭا
translation_sw: Na wamechukua miungu mingine badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu ili ati iwape nguvu.
translation_en: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.

arabic_text: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
translation_sw: Sivyo kabisa! Wataikataa hiyo ibada yao, na watakuwa ndio dhidi yao.
translation_en: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّۭا
translation_sw: Kwani huoni ya kwamba tumewatuma mashet'ani kwa makafiri wawachochee kwa uchochezi?
translation_en: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?

arabic_text: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّۭا
translation_sw: Basi usiwafanyie haraka. Sisi tunawahisabia idadi ya siku zao.
translation_en: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًۭا
translation_sw: Siku tutayo wakusanya wachamngu kuwapeleka kwa Arrahmani Mwingi wa Rehema kuwa ni wageni wake.
translation_en: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation

arabic_text: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًۭا
translation_sw: Na tukawachunga wakhalifu kuwapeleka Jahannamu hali ya kuwa wana kiu.
translation_en: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst

arabic_text: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
translation_sw: Hawatakuwa na mamlaka ya uombezi ila wale walio chukua ahadi kwa Arrahmani Mwingi wa Rehema..
translation_en: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا
translation_sw: Na wao ati husema kuwa Arrahmani Mwingi wa Rehema ana mwana!
translation_en: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."

arabic_text: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّۭا
translation_sw: Hakika mmeleta jambo la kuchusha mno!
translation_en: You have done an atrocious thing.

arabic_text: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
translation_sw: Zinakaribia mbingu kutatuka kwa hilo, na ardhi kupasuka, na milima kuanguka vipande vipande.
translation_en: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation

arabic_text: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًۭا
translation_sw: Kwa kudai kwao kuwa Arrahmani Mwingi wa Rehema ana mwana.
translation_en: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.

arabic_text: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
translation_sw: Wala hahitajii Arrahmani Mwingi wa Rehema kuwa na mwana.
translation_en: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.

arabic_text: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًۭا
translation_sw: Hapana yeyote aliomo mbinguni na ardhini ila atafika kwa Arrahmani Mwingi wa Rehema kuwa ni mtumwa wake.
translation_en: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.

arabic_text: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّۭا
translation_sw: Yeye hakika amewadhibiti na amewahisabu sawa sawa.
translation_en: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.

arabic_text: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
translation_sw: Na kila mmoja katika wao atamfikia Siku ya Kiyama peke yake.
translation_en: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّۭا
translation_sw: Hakika walio amini na wakatenda mema Arrahmani Mwingi wa Rehema atawajaalia mapenzi.
translation_en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.

arabic_text: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا لُّدًّۭا
translation_sw: Na hakika tumeifanya nyepesi (Qur'ani) kwa ulimi wako, ili uwabashirie kwayo wachamngu, na uwaonye kwayo watu wabishi.
translation_en: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.

arabic_text: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
translation_sw: Na kaumu ngapi tumezihiliki kabla yao. Je! Unawaona hata mmoja katika wao au unasikia hata mchakato wao?
translation_en: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?

arabic_text: طه
translation_sw: T'AHA!
translation_en: Ta, Ha.

arabic_text: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Hatukukuteremshia Qur'ani ili upate mashaka.
translation_en: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed

arabic_text: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
translation_sw: Bali ni mawaidha kwa wenye kunyenyekea.
translation_en: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -

arabic_text: تَنزِيلًۭا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
translation_sw: Materemsho yatokayo kwa aliye umba ardhi na mbingu zilizo juu.
translation_en: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,

arabic_text: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
translation_sw: Arrahmani, Mwingi wa Rehema, aliye tawala juu ya Kiti cha Enzi.
translation_en: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.

arabic_text: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
translation_sw: Ni vyake vyote viliomo mbinguni na viliomo katika ardhi, na viliomo baina yao, na viliomo chini ya ardhi.
translation_en: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.

arabic_text: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
translation_sw: Na ukinyanyua sauti kwa kusema... basi hakika Yeye anajua siri na duni kuliko siri.
translation_en: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu! Hapana mungu isipo kuwa Yeye. Yeye ana majina mazuri kabisa.
translation_en: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.

arabic_text: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na je! Imekufikia hadithi ya Musa?
translation_en: And has the story of Moses reached you? -

arabic_text: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًۭا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًۭى
translation_sw: Alipo uona moto, akawaambia watu wake: Ngojeni! Mimi nimeuona moto, huenda nikakuleteeni kijinga kutoka huo moto, au nikapata uongofu kwenye moto.
translation_en: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Basi alipo ufikia akaitwa: Ewe Musa!
translation_en: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,

arabic_text: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًۭى
translation_sw: Hakika Mimi ndiye Mola wako Mlezi! Basi vua viatu vyako. Kwani upo katika bonde takatifu la T'uwa.
translation_en: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.

arabic_text: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Nami nimekuteua wewe; basi sikiliza unayo funuliwa.
translation_en: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].

arabic_text: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
translation_sw: Hakika Mimi ndiye Mwenyezi Mungu. Hapana mungu ila Mimi tu. Basi niabudu Mimi, na ushike Sala kwa ajili ya kunikumbuka Mimi.
translation_en: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
translation_sw: Hakika Saa itakuja bila ya shaka. Nimekaribia kuificha, ili kila nafsi ilipwe kwa iliyo yafanya.
translation_en: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.

arabic_text: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
translation_sw: Kwa hivyo asikukengeushe nayo yule ambaye haiamini na akafuata pumbao lake ukaja kuhiliki.
translation_en: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.

arabic_text: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
translation_sw: Na nini hicho kilichomo mkononi mwako wa kulia, ewe Musa?
translation_en: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"

arabic_text: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hii ni fimbo yangu; naiegemea na ninawaangushia majani kondoo na mbuzi wangu. Tena inanifaa kwa matumizi mengine.
translation_en: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."

arabic_text: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
translation_sw: Akasema: Itupe, ewe Musa!
translation_en: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."

arabic_text: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌۭ تَسْعَىٰ
translation_sw: Akaitupa. Mara ikawa nyoka anaye kwenda mbio.
translation_en: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.

arabic_text: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_sw: Akasema: Ikamate, wala usiogope! Tutairudisha hali yake ya kwanza.
translation_en: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.

arabic_text: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Na uambatishe mkono wako kwenye ubavu. Utatoka mweupe pasipo kuwa na madhara yoyote. Hiyo ni ishara nyengine.
translation_en: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,

arabic_text: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
translation_sw: Ili tukuonyeshe baadhi ya ishara zetu kubwa.
translation_en: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.

arabic_text: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
translation_sw: Nenda kwa Firauni; kwani hakika yeye amepindukia mipaka.
translation_en: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
translation_sw: (Musa) akasema: Ewe Mola wangu Mlezi! Nikunjulie kifua changu,
translation_en: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]

arabic_text: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
translation_sw: Na unifanyie nyepesi kazi yangu,
translation_en: And ease for me my task

arabic_text: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى
translation_sw: Na ulifungue fundo lililo katika ulimi wangu,
translation_en: And untie the knot from my tongue

arabic_text: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
translation_sw: Wapate kufahamu maneno yangu.
translation_en: That they may understand my speech.

arabic_text: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًۭا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
translation_sw: Na nipe waziri katika watu wangu,
translation_en: And appoint for me a minister from my family -

arabic_text: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى
translation_sw: Harun, ndugu yangu.
translation_en: Aaron, my brother.

arabic_text: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
translation_sw: Kwake yeye niongeze nguvu zangu.
translation_en: Increase through him my strength

arabic_text: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
translation_sw: Na umshirikishe katika kazi yangu.
translation_en: And let him share my task

arabic_text: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Ili tukutakase sana.
translation_en: That we may exalt You much

arabic_text: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
translation_sw: Na tukukumbuke sana.
translation_en: And remember You much.

arabic_text: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika Wewe unatuona.
translation_en: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."

arabic_text: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hakika Umepewa maombi yako, ewe Musa!
translation_en: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na hakika tulikwisha kufanyia hisani mara nyengine...
translation_en: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,

arabic_text: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Pale tulipo mfunulia mama yako yaliyo funuliwa,
translation_en: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,

arabic_text: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
translation_sw: Ya kuwa mtie katika kisanduku, na kisha kitie mtoni, na mto utamfikisha ufukweni. Atamchukua adui yangu naye ni adui yake. Na nimekutilia mapenzi yanayo tokana kwangu, na ili ulelewe machoni mwangu.
translation_en: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.

arabic_text: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًۭا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
translation_sw: Dada yako alipo kwenda na akasema: Je! Nikujuulisheni mtu wa kuweza kumlea? Basi tukakurejesha kwa mama yako ili macho yake yaburudike, wala asihuzunike. Na ulimuuwa mtu, nasi tukakuokoa katika dhiki, na tukakujaribu kwa majaribio mengi. Ukakaa miaka kwa watu wa Madyana. Kisha ukaja kama ilivyo kadiriwa, ewe Musa!
translation_en: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.

arabic_text: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
translation_sw: Na nimekuteuwa kwa ajili ya nafsi yangu.
translation_en: And I produced you for Myself.

arabic_text: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
translation_sw: Nenda, wewe na ndugu yako, pamoja na ishara zangu, wala msichoke kunikumbuka.
translation_en: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.

arabic_text: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
translation_sw: Nendeni kwa Firauni. Hakika yeye amepindukia mipaka.
translation_en: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

arabic_text: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا لَّيِّنًۭا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
translation_sw: Mwambieni maneno laini, huenda akazingatia au akaogopa.
translation_en: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]."

arabic_text: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ewe Mola wetu Mlezi! Hakika sisi tunaogopa asije akapindukia mipaka juu yetu au kufanya jeuri.
translation_en: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."

arabic_text: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
translation_sw: Akasema: Msiogope! Hakika Mimi ni pamoja nanyi. Nasikia na ninaona.
translation_en: [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

arabic_text: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Basi mwendeeni, na mwambieni: Hakika sisi ni Mitume wa Mola wako Mlezi! Basi waache Wana wa Israili watoke nasi, wala usiwaadhibu. Sisi tumekuletea ishara itokayo kwa Mola wako Mlezi. Na amani itakuwa juu ya aliye fuata uwongofu.
translation_en: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.

arabic_text: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_sw: Hakika tumefunuliwa sisi kwamba hapana shaka adhabu itamsibu anaye kadhibisha na akapuuza.
translation_en: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' "

arabic_text: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
translation_sw: (Firauni) akasema: Basi Mola wenu Mlezi ni nani, ewe Musa?
translation_en: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mola wetu Mlezi ni yule aliye kipa kila kitu umbo lake, kisha akakiongoa.
translation_en: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."

arabic_text: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_sw: Akasema: Nini hali ya karne za kwanza?
translation_en: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"

arabic_text: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى
translation_sw: Akasema: Ilimu yake iko kwa Mola wangu Mlezi katika Kitabu. Mola wangu Mlezi hapotei wala hasahau.
translation_en: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّن نَّبَاتٍۢ شَتَّىٰ
translation_sw: Ambaye amekufanyieni ardhi kuwa tandiko, na akakupitishieni humo njia, na akakuteremshieni kutoka mbinguni maji. Na kwa hayo tukatoa namna mbali mbali za mimema.
translation_en: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.

arabic_text: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَٰمَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
translation_sw: Kuleni, na mchunge wanyama wenu. Hakika katika hayo zipo ishara kwa wenye akili.
translation_en: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.

arabic_text: ۞ مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Kutokana nayo (ardhi) tumekuumbeni, na humo tunakurudisheni, na kutoka humo tutakutoeni mara nyengine.
translation_en: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
translation_sw: Na hakika tulimwonyesha ishara zetu zote. Lakini alikadhibisha na akakataa.
translation_en: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.

arabic_text: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
translation_sw: Akasema: Ewe Musa! Hivyo umetujia kututoa katika nchi yetu kwa uchawi wako?
translation_en: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?

arabic_text: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًۭا سُوًۭى
translation_sw: Basi sisi hakika tutakueletea uchawi kama huo. Basi weka miadi baina yetu na wewe, ambayo tusiivunje sisi wala wewe, mahali patapo kuwa sawa.
translation_en: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."

arabic_text: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًۭى
translation_sw: Akasema: Miadi yenu ni siku ya Sikukuu; na watu wakusanywe kabla ya adhuhuri.
translation_en: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."

arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
translation_sw: Basi Firauni akarudi na akatengeneza hila yake, kisha akaja.
translation_en: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].

arabic_text: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍۢ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ
translation_sw: Musa akamwambia: Ole wenu! Msimzulie Mwenyezi Mungu uwongo, asije akakufutilieni mbali kwa adhabu. Na mwenye kuzua lazima ashindwe!
translation_en: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."

arabic_text: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ
translation_sw: Basi wakazozana kwa shauri yao wenyewe kwa wenyewe, na wakanong'ona kwa siri.
translation_en: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Hakika hawa wawili ni wachawi, wanataka kukutoeni katika nchi yenu kwa uchawi wao, na waondoe mila zenu zilizo bora kabisa.
translation_en: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.

arabic_text: فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّۭا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ
translation_sw: Kwa hivyo kusanyeni hila zenu zote, kisha mfike kwa kujipanga safu, na kwa yakini atafuzu kweli kweli leo atakaye shinda.
translation_en: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ewe Musa! Je! Utatupa wewe, au tutakuwa sisi wa kwanza kutupa?
translation_en: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."

arabic_text: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
translation_sw: Akasema: Bali tupeni nyinyi! Tahamaki kamba zao na fimbo zao zikaonekana mbele yake, kwa uchawi wao, kuwa zinapiga mbio.
translation_en: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].

arabic_text: فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةًۭ مُّوسَىٰ
translation_sw: Basi Musa akaingia khofu nafsi yake.
translation_en: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.

arabic_text: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_sw: Tukasema: Usikhofu! Hakika wewe ndiye utakaye shinda.
translation_en: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.

arabic_text: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَٰحِرٍۢ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
translation_sw: Na kitupe kilicho katika mkono wako wa kulia; kitavimeza walivyo viunda. Hakika walivyo unda ni hila za mchawi tu, na mchawi hafanikiwi popote afikapo.
translation_en: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."

arabic_text: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
translation_sw: Basi wachawi wakaangushwa wanasujudu. Wakasema: Tumemuamini Mola Mlezi wa Harun na Musa!
translation_en: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."

arabic_text: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ ۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًۭا وَأَبْقَىٰ
translation_sw: (Firauni) akasema: Oh! Mnamuamini kabla sijakupeni ruhusa? Hakika yeye ndiye mkubwa wenu aliye kufundisheni uchawi. Basi kwa yakini nitakukateni mikono yenu na miguu yenu kwa kutafautisha. Na nitakutundikeni misalabani katika vigogo vya mitende, na hapo kwa yakini mtajua ni nani katika sisi aliye mkali wa kuadhibu na kuiendeleza adhabu yake.
translation_en: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Hatutokukhiari wewe kuliko ishara waziwazi zilizo tujia, na kuliko yule aliye tuumba. Basi hukumu utavyo hukumu; kwani wewe unahukumu haya ya maisha ya duniani tu.
translation_en: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Hakika sisi tumemuamini Mola wetu Mlezi ili atusamehe makosa yetu na uchawi ulio tulazimisha kuufanya. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mbora na Mwenye kudumu zaidi.
translation_en: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring."

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجْرِمًۭا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
translation_sw: Hakika ataye mjia Mola wake Mlezi naye ni mkhalifu, basi kwa yakini, yake huyo ni Jahannamu. Hafi humo wala haishi.
translation_en: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.

arabic_text: وَمَن يَأْتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنًۭا قَدْ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلْعُلَىٰ
translation_sw: Na atakaye mjia naye ni Muumini aliye tenda mema, basi hao ndio wenye vyeo vya juu.
translation_en: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:

arabic_text: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_sw: Bustani za milele zipitazo mito kati yake, wadumu humo. Na hayo ni malipo ya mwenye kujitakasa.
translation_en: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
translation_sw: Na tulimfunulia Musa: Toka usiku na waja wangu, na uwapigie njia kavu baharini. Usikhofu kukamatwa, wala usiogope.
translation_en: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."

arabic_text: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
translation_sw: Firauni akawafuata pamoja na majeshi yake. Basi kiliwafudikiza humo baharini kilicho wafudikiza.
translation_en: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,

arabic_text: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
translation_sw: Na Firauni aliwapoteza watu wake wala hakuwaongoa.
translation_en: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].

arabic_text: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَٰكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَٰعَدْنَٰكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ
translation_sw: Enyi Wana wa Israili! Hakika tulikuokoeni na adui yenu, na tukakuahidini upande wa kulia wa mlima. Na tulikuteremshieni Manna na Salwa.
translation_en: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,

arabic_text: كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِى ۖ وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِى فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ
translation_sw: Kuleni katika vitu vizuri hivyo tulivyo kuruzukuni, wala msiruke mipaka katika hayo, isije ikakushukieni ghadhabu yangu. Na inaye mshukia ghadhabu yangu basi huyo ameangamia.
translation_en: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen."

arabic_text: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌۭ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
translation_sw: Na hakika Mimi ni Mwingi wa Kusamehe kwa anaye tubia, na akaamini, na akatenda mema, tena akaongoka.
translation_en: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.

arabic_text: ۞ وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
translation_sw: Na nini kilicho kutia haraka ukawaacha watu wako, ewe Musa?
translation_en: [Allah] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"

arabic_text: قَالَ هُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hao wapo nyuma yangu wananifuatia. Na nimefanya haraka kukujia, Mola wangu Mlezi, ili uridhike.
translation_en: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."

arabic_text: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
translation_sw: (Mwenyezi Mungu) akasema: Sisi tumewatia mtihani watu wako baada yako, na Msamaria amewapoteza.
translation_en: [Allah] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Samiri has led them astray."

arabic_text: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ غَضْبَٰنَ أَسِفًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا ۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِى
translation_sw: Musa akarudi kwa watu wake kwa ghadhabu na kusikitika. Akasema: Enyi watu wangu! Kwani Mola wenu Mlezi hakukuahidini ahadi nzuri? Je, umekuwa muda mrefu kwenu au mmetaka ikushukieni ghadhabu ya Mola wenu Mlezi, ndio maana mkavunja miadi yangu?
translation_en: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَآ أَوْزَارًۭا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Sisi hatukuvunja miadi yako kwa khiari yetu, lakini tulibebeshwa mizigo ya mapambo ya watu, basi tukaitupa. Na hivyo ndivyo alivyo toa shauri Msamaria.
translation_en: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri throw."

arabic_text: فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًۭا جَسَدًۭا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌۭ فَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِىَ
translation_sw: Na akawaundia ndama, kiwiliwili chenye sauti. Na wakasema: Huyu ndiye mungu wenu, na mungu wa Musa, lakini alisahau.
translation_en: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."

arabic_text: أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًۭا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًۭا
translation_sw: Je! Hawakuona kuwa hakuwarudishia neno, wala hakuweza kuwadhuru wala kuwafaa?
translation_en: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَٰرُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى وَأَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرِى
translation_sw: Na hakika Harun alikwisha waambia kabla yake: Enyi watu wangu! Hakika nyinyi mmetiwa mtihanini tu kwa kitu hiki. Na kwa yakini Mola wenu Mlezi ni Arrahmani, Mwingi wa Rehema. Basi nifuateni mimi, na t'iini amri yangu!
translation_en: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Hatutaacha kumuabudu mpaka Musa atapo rejea kwetu.
translation_en: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us."

arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوٓا۟
translation_sw: (Musa) akasema: Ewe Harun! Ni nini kilicho kuzuia, ulipo waona wamepotea,
translation_en: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,

arabic_text: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ ۖ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِى
translation_sw: Hata usinifuate? Je, umeasi amri yangu?
translation_en: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"

arabic_text: قَالَ يَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِى وَلَا بِرَأْسِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِى
translation_sw: Akasema: Ewe mwana wa mama yangu! Usinishike ndevu zangu, wala kichwa changu. Kwa hakika naliogopa usije sema: Umewafarikisha Wana wa Israil, na hukungojea kauli yangu.
translation_en: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.' "

arabic_text: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَٰسَٰمِرِىُّ
translation_sw: (Musa) akasema: Ewe Msamaria! Unataka nini?
translation_en: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri?"

arabic_text: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةًۭ مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِى نَفْسِى
translation_sw: Akasema: Niliona wasiyo yaona wao, nikashika gao katika unyao wa Mtume. Kisha nikalitupa. Na hivi ndivyo ilivyo nielekeza nafsi yangu.
translation_en: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."

arabic_text: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
translation_sw: (Musa) akasema: Basi ondoka! Na kwa yakini utakuwa katika maisha ukisema: Usiniguse. Na hakika una ahadi kwako isiyo vunjwa. Na mtazame huyo mungu wako uliye endelea kumuabudu - Sisi kwa hakika tutamchoma moto, kisha tutamtawanya baharini atawanyike.
translation_en: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika Mungu wenu ni Allah, Mwenyezi Mungu, tu. Hapana Mungu isipo kuwa Yeye. Ujuzi wake umeenea kila kitu.
translation_en: Your god is only Allah, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ ۚ وَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًۭا
translation_sw: Namna hivi tunakuhadithia katika khabari za yaliyo tangulia. Na hakika tumekuletea kutoka kwetu mawaidha ya kukumbukwa.
translation_en: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an.

arabic_text: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وِزْرًا
translation_sw: Atakaye jitenga nayo, basi kwa yakini Siku ya Kiyama atabeba mzigo.
translation_en: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden,

arabic_text: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهِ ۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ حِمْلًۭا
translation_sw: Wadumu humo. Na ni mzigo muovu kwao kuubeba Siku ya Kiyama!
translation_en: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ وَنَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ زُرْقًۭا
translation_sw: Siku litakapo pulizwa barugumu, na tukawakusanya wakhalifu Siku hiyo, hali macho yao ya kibuluu.
translation_en: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.

arabic_text: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًۭا
translation_sw: Watanong'onezana wao kwa wao: Hamkukaa ila siku kumi tu.
translation_en: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."

arabic_text: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًۭا
translation_sw: Sisi tunajua zaidi watakayo yasema, atakapo sema mbora wao katika mwendo: Nyinyi hamkukaa ila siku moja tu.
translation_en: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."

arabic_text: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّى نَسْفًۭا
translation_sw: Na wanakuuliza khabari za milima. Waambie: Mola wangu Mlezi ataivuruga vuruga.
translation_en: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.

arabic_text: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًۭا صَفْصَفًۭا
translation_sw: Na ataiacha tambarare, uwanda.
translation_en: And He will leave the earth a level plain;

arabic_text: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًۭا وَلَآ أَمْتًۭا
translation_sw: Hutaona humo mdidimio wala muinuko.
translation_en: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."

arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِىَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥ ۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًۭا
translation_sw: Siku hiyo watamfuata muitaji asiye na upotofu. Na sauti zote zitamnyenyekea Arrahmani Mwingi wa Rahema. Basi husikii ila mchakato na mnong'ono.
translation_en: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].

arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا
translation_sw: Siku hiyo uombezi haufai kitu, ila wa aliye mruhusu Arrahmani Mwingi wa Rehema na akamridhia kusema.
translation_en: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.

arabic_text: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلْمًۭا
translation_sw: Yeye anajua yaliyo mbele yao, na yaliyo nyuma yao. Wala wao hawawezi kumjua Yeye vilivyo.
translation_en: Allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge.

arabic_text: ۞ وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًۭا
translation_sw: Na zitadhalilika nyuso mbele ya Aliye Hai Milele, Mwangalizi Mkuu. Na atakuwa ameharibikiwa mwenye kubeba dhulma.
translation_en: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice.

arabic_text: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًۭا وَلَا هَضْمًۭا
translation_sw: Na anaye tenda mema, naye ni Muumini, basi hatakhofu kudhulumiwa wala kupunjwa.
translation_en: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.

arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًۭا
translation_sw: Na namna hivi tumeiteremsha Qur'ani kwa Kiarabu, na tumekariri humo maonyo ili wapate kuogopa na kujilinda na iwaletee makumbusho.
translation_en: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.

arabic_text: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًۭا
translation_sw: Ametukuka Mwenyezi Mungu, Mfalme wa Haki. Wala usiifanyie haraka hii Qur'ani, kabla haujamalizika ufunuo wake. Na sema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nizidishie ilimu.
translation_en: So high [above all] is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُۥ عَزْمًۭا
translation_sw: Na hapo zamani tuliagana na Adam, lakini alisahau, wala hatukuona kwake azma kubwa.
translation_en: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
translation_sw: Na tulipo waambia Malaika: Msujudieni Adam! Wakasujudu, isipo kuwa Iblisi, alikataa.
translation_en: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.

arabic_text: فَقُلْنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوٌّۭ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Tukasema: Ewe Adam! Hakika huyu ni adui yako na wa mkeo. Basi asikutoeni katika Bustani hii, mkaingia mashakani.
translation_en: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.

arabic_text: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Hakika humo hutakuwa na njaa wala hutakuwa uchi.
translation_en: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ
translation_sw: Na hakika hutapata kiu humo wala hutapata joto.
translation_en: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."

arabic_text: فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍۢ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ
translation_sw: Lakini Shet'ani alimtia wasiwasi, akamwambia: Ewe Adam! Nikujuulishe mti wa kuishi milele na ufalme usio koma?
translation_en: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"

arabic_text: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ
translation_sw: Basi wakaula wote wawili, na uchi wao ukawadhihirikia na wakaanza kujibandika majani ya Bustani. Na Adam akamuasi Mola wake Mlezi, na akapotea njia.
translation_en: And Adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ ٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ
translation_sw: Kisha Mola wake Mlezi akamteuwa, naye akamkubalia toba yake, naye akamwongoa.
translation_en: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].

arabic_text: قَالَ ٱهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۢا ۖ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّۭ ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًۭى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ
translation_sw: Akasema: Ondokeni humu nyote, hali ya kuwa ni maadui nyinyi kwa nyinyi. Na ukikufikieni uwongofu kutoka kwangu basi atakaye ufuata uwongofu wangu, hatapotea wala hatataabika.
translation_en: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].

arabic_text: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةًۭ ضَنكًۭا وَنَحْشُرُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَعْمَىٰ
translation_sw: Na atakaye jiepusha na mawaidha yangu, basi kwa yakini atapata maisha yenye dhiki, na Siku ya Kiyama tutamfufua hali ya kuwa kipofu.
translation_en: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِىٓ أَعْمَىٰ وَقَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Aseme: Ewe Mola wangu Mlezi! Mbona umenifufua kipofu, nami nilikuwa nikiona?
translation_en: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"

arabic_text: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ ءَايَٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ
translation_sw: (Mwenyezi Mungu) atasema: Ndivyo vivyo hivyo. Zilikufikia ishara zetu, nawe ukazisahau; na kadhaalika leo unasahauliwa.
translation_en: [Allah] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."

arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ۚ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na hivi ndivyo tutakavyo mlipa kila apitaye kiasi, na asiye amini ishara za Mola wake Mlezi. Na hakika adhabu ya Akhera ni kali zaidi, na inadumu zaidi.
translation_en: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.

arabic_text: أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
translation_sw: Je! Haikuwabainikia tu; vizazi vingapi tuliviangamiza kabla yao, nao wanatembea katika maskani zao? Hakika katika hayo zimo ishara kwa wenye akili.
translation_en: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.

arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌۭ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًۭا وَأَجَلٌۭ مُّسَمًّۭى
