translation_sw: Na lau kuwa si neno lililo kwisha tangulia kutoka kwa Mola wako Mlezi na muda ulio wekwa, bila ya shaka inge fika adhabu (hapa hapa).
translation_en: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].

arabic_text: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ۖ وَمِنْ ءَانَآئِ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ
translation_sw: Yavumilie haya wayasemayo. Na umtakase Mola wako Mlezi kwa kumsifu kabla ya kuchomoza jua, na kabla halijachwa, na nyakati za usiku pia umtakase, na ncha za mchana ili upate ya kukuridhisha.
translation_en: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰ
translation_sw: Wala usivikodolee macho tulivyo wastareheshea baadhi ya watu miongoni mwao, kwa ajili ya mapambo ya duniani, ili tuwajaribu. Na riziki ya Mola wako Mlezi ni bora na inadumu zaidi.
translation_en: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.

arabic_text: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۖ لَا نَسْـَٔلُكَ رِزْقًۭا ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ ۗ وَٱلْعَٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
translation_sw: Na waamrishe watu wako kusali, na uendelee mwenyewe kwa hayo. Sisi hatukuombi wewe riziki, bali Sisi ndio tunakuruzuku. Na mwisho mwema ni kwa mchamngu.
translation_en: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_sw: Na walisema: Kwa nini hakutuletea muujiza kutoka kwa Mola wake Mlezi? Je! Haikuwafikilia dalili wazi ya yaliyomo katika Vitabu vya kale?
translation_en: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?

arabic_text: وَلَوْ أَنَّآ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِعَذَابٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًۭا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
translation_sw: Na lau kuwa tuliwaangamiza kwa adhabu kabla yake, wangeli sema: Ewe Mola wetu Mlezi! Kwa nini usituletee Mtume tukazifuata ishara zako kabla hatujadhilika na kuhizika.
translation_en: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced?"

arabic_text: قُلْ كُلٌّۭ مُّتَرَبِّصٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
translation_sw: Sema: Kila mmoja anangoja. Basi ngojeni! Hivi karibuni mtajua nani mwenye njia sawa na nani aliye ongoka.
translation_en: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."

arabic_text: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مُّعْرِضُونَ
translation_sw: IMEWAKARIBIA watu hisabu yao, nao wamo katika mghafala wanapuuza.
translation_en: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.

arabic_text: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
translation_sw: Hayawafikilii mawaidha mapya kutoka kwa Mola wao Mlezi ila huyasikiliza na huku wanafanya mchezo.
translation_en: No mention comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play

arabic_text: لَاهِيَةًۭ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Zimeghafilika nyoyo zao. Na wale walio dhulumu hunong'onezana kwa siri: Ni nani ati huyu isipo kuwa ni binaadamu tu kama nyinyi! Mnauwendea uchawi hali nanyi mnaona?
translation_en: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Alisema: Mola wangu Mlezi anayajua yasemwayo mbinguni na katika ardhi. Na Yeye ni Mwenye kusikia Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."

arabic_text: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌۭ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini wao walisema: Hizo ni ndoto za ovyo ovyo, bali amezizua tu, bali huyo ni mtunga mashairi. Basi atuletee miujiza kama walivyo tumwa wale wa mwanzo.
translation_en: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."

arabic_text: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Hawakuamini kabla yao watu wa mji tulio uangamiza. Basi, je, wataamini hawa?
translation_en: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na kabla yako hatukuwatuma ila watu wanaume tulio wapa wahyi (ufunuo). Basi waulizeni wenye ilimu ikiwa nyinyi hamjui.
translation_en: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.

arabic_text: وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ جَسَدًۭا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰلِدِينَ
translation_sw: Wala hatukuwafanya miili isiyo kula chakula, wala hawakuwa wenye kuishi milele.
translation_en: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].

arabic_text: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukawatimizia miadi, na tukawaokoa wao na tulio wataka, na tukawateketeza walio pita mipaka.
translation_en: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.

arabic_text: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tumekuteremshieni Kitabu ambacho ndani yake yamo makumbusho yenu. Je! Hamzingatii?
translation_en: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?

arabic_text: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍۢ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةًۭ وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation_sw: Na mingapi katika miji iliyo kuwa ikidhulumu tumeiteketeza, na tukawasimamisha baada yao watu wengine.
translation_en: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.

arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
translation_sw: Basi walipo ihisi adhabu yetu, mara wakaanza kukimbia.
translation_en: And when its inhabitants perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.

arabic_text: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
translation_sw: Msikimbie! Na rejeeni kwenye zile zile starehe zenu, na maskani zenu, mpate kusailiwa!
translation_en: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ole wetu! Hakika sisi tulikuwa madhaalimu.
translation_en: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

arabic_text: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ
translation_sw: Hakikuacha hicho kuwa kilio chao mpaka tukawafanya kama walio fyekwa, wamezimika.
translation_en: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].

arabic_text: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
translation_sw: Na hatukuziumba mbingu na ardhi na vilivyo baina yao kwa mchezo.
translation_en: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.

arabic_text: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًۭا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
translation_sw: Kama tungeli taka kufanya mchezo tunge jifanyia Sisi wenyewe, lau kwamba tungeli kuwa ni wafanyao mchezo.
translation_en: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.

arabic_text: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌۭ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
translation_sw: Bali tunaitupa kweli juu ya uwongo ikauvunja na mara ukatoweka. Na ole wenu kwa mnayo yazua.
translation_en: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.

arabic_text: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na ni vyake Yeye tu Mwenyezi Mungu vilivyomo mbinguni na katika ardhi. Na walioko kwake hawafanyi kiburi wakaacha kumuabudu, wala hawachoki.
translation_en: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.

arabic_text: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
translation_sw: Wanamtakasa usiku na mchana, wala hawanyong'onyei.
translation_en: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.

arabic_text: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
translation_sw: Au wamepata miungu katika ardhi inayo fufua?
translation_en: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?

arabic_text: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_sw: Lau wangeli kuwamo humo miungu wengine isipo kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu basi bila ya shaka hizo mbingu na ardhi zingeli fisidika. Subahana 'Llah Ametakasika Mwenyezi Mungu, Bwana wa A'rshi (Kiti cha Enzi), na hayo wanayo yazua.
translation_en: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

arabic_text: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ
translation_sw: Yeye hahojiwi kwa ayatendayo, na wao ndio wanao hojiwa kwa wayatendayo.
translation_en: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.

arabic_text: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
translation_sw: Au wanawaabudu miungu mingine badala yake? Sema: Leteni ushahidi wenu! Haya ni ukumbusho wa hawa walio nami, na ukumbusho wa walio kabla yangu. Lakini wengi wao hawaijui kweli, na kwa hivyo wanapuuza.
translation_en: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
translation_sw: Na hatukumtuma kabla yako Mtume yeyote ila tulimfunulia ya kwamba hapana mungu isipo kuwa Mimi. Basi niabuduni Mimi tu.
translation_en: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌۭ مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanasema: Arrahman, Mwingi wa Rehema, ana mwana! Subhanahu, Ametakasika na hayo! Bali hao (wanao waita wana) ni watumwa walio tukuzwa.
translation_en: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.

arabic_text: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Hawamtangulii kwa neno, nao wanafanya amri zake.
translation_en: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.

arabic_text: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ
translation_sw: Anayajua yaliyo mbele yao na yaliyo nyuma yao. Wala hawamwombei yeyote ila yule anaye mridhia Yeye, nao kwa ajili ya kumwogopa wananyenyekea.
translation_en: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.

arabic_text: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَٰهٌۭ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na yeyote kati yao atakaye sema: Mimi ni mungu, badala yake, basi huyo tutamlipa malipo yake Jahannamu. Hivyo ndivyo tuwalipavyo wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًۭا فَفَتَقْنَٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Hao walio kufuru hawakuona kwamba mbingu na ardhi zilikuwa zimeambatana, kisha Sisi tukazibabandua? Na tukajaalia kwa maji kila kilicho hai? Basi je, hawaamini?
translation_en: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًۭا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Na tukaweka katika ardhi milima iliyo thibiti ili isiwayumbishe, na tukaweka humo njia pana ili wapate kuongoka.
translation_en: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًۭا مَّحْفُوظًۭا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
translation_sw: Na tukaifanya mbingu kuwa dari iliyo hifadhiwa, lakini wanazipuuza Ishara zake.
translation_en: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
translation_sw: Na Yeye ndiye aliye umba usiku na mchana na jua na mwezi, vyote katika anga vinaogelea.
translation_en: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.

arabic_text: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِدُونَ
translation_sw: Nasi hatukumjaalia mwanaadamu yeyote kabla yako kuwa na maisha ya milele. Basi je! Ukifa wewe, wao wataishi milele?
translation_en: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?

arabic_text: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةًۭ ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Kila nafsi itaonja mauti; na tunakujaribuni kwa mtihani wa shari na kheri. Na kwetu Sisi mtarejeshwa.
translation_en: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wakikuona walio kufuru hawakufanyi wewe ila ni kitu cha maskhara tu, (wakisema): Je! Ndiye huyu anaye itaja miungu yenu? Na hali wao wanakataa kumkumbuka Arrahman, Mwingi wa Rehema!
translation_en: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.

arabic_text: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍۢ ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
translation_sw: Mwanaadamu ameumbwa na haraka. Nitakuonyesheni Ishara zangu. Basi msinihimize.
translation_en: Man was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not impatiently urge Me.

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanasema: Ahadi hii itatokea lini, ikiwa nyinyi mnasema kweli?
translation_en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

arabic_text: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_sw: Lau wangeli jua wale walio kufuru wakati ambao hawatauzuia Moto kwenye nyuso zao wala migongo yao, na wala hawatanusuriwa!
translation_en: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...

arabic_text: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةًۭ فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
translation_sw: Bali utawafikia kwa ghafla, na utawashitua na wala hawataweza kuurudisha, wala hawatapewa muhula!
translation_en: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mitume walio kabla yako walikwisha dhihakiwa. Kwa hivyo wale walio wafanyia maskhara yaliwafika yale waliyo kuwa wakiyafanyia dhihaka.
translation_en: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

arabic_text: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Nani anaye kulindeni usiku na mchana na Arrahmani Mwingi wa Rehema? Bali wao wanapuuza kumkumbuka Mola wao Mlezi.
translation_en: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.

arabic_text: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌۭ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
translation_sw: Au wao wanao miungu watao weza kuwakinga nasi? Hao hawawezi kujinusuru nafsi zao, wala hawatalindwa nasi!
translation_en: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.

arabic_text: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
translation_sw: Bali tuliwastarehesha hawa na baba zao mpaka umri ukawa mrefu kwao. Je, hawaoni ya kwamba Sisi tunaifikia ardhi tukiipunguza ncha zake? Basi je! Hao ni wenye kushinda?
translation_en: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome?

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Mimi nakuonyeni kwa Wahyi. Na viziwi hawasikii wito wanapo onywa.
translation_en: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.

arabic_text: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌۭ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo guswa na mpulizo mmoja tu wa adhabu itokayo kwa Mola wako Mlezi, bila ya shaka wao husema: Ole wetu! Hakika tulikuwa wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."

arabic_text: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍۢ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَٰسِبِينَ
translation_sw: Nasi tutaweka mizani za uadilifu kwa Siku ya Kiyama. Basi nafsi haitadhulumiwa kitu chochote. Hata ikiwa ni uzito wa chembe ya khardali tutaileta. Nasi tunatosha kuwa washika hisabu.
translation_en: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءًۭ وَذِكْرًۭا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_sw: Na kwa yakini tuliwapa Musa na Haaruni kipambanuzi, na mwangaza, na makumbusho kwa wachamngu,
translation_en: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao wanamkhofu Mola wao Mlezi faraghani, na wanaiogopa Saa ya Kiyama.
translation_en: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.

arabic_text: وَهَٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na haya ni makumbusho yaliyo barikiwa, tuliyo yateremsha. Basi je! Mnayakataa?
translation_en: And this [Qur'an] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?

arabic_text: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tulikwisha mpa Ibrahim uwongofu wake zamani, na tulikuwa tunamjua.
translation_en: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَٰكِفُونَ
translation_sw: Alipo mwambia baba yake na watu wake: Ni nini haya masanamu mnayo yashughulikia kuyaabudu?
translation_en: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَٰبِدِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Tumewakuta baba zetu wakiyaabudu.
translation_en: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."

arabic_text: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Akasema: Bila ya shaka nyinyi na baba zenu mmekuwa katika upotofu ulio dhaahiri.
translation_en: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّٰعِبِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Je! Umetujia kwa maneno ya kweli au wewe ni katika wachezao tu?
translation_en: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"

arabic_text: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Bali Mola wenu Mlezi ni Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na ardhi ambaye ndiye aliye ziumba. Na mimi ni katika wenye kuyashuhudia hayo.
translation_en: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.

arabic_text: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na Wallahi! Nitayafanyia vitimbi masanamu yenu haya baada ya mkisha geuka kwenda zenu.
translation_en: And [I swear] by Allah, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."

arabic_text: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًۭا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_sw: Basi akayavunja vipande vipande, ila kubwa lao, ili wao walirudie.
translation_en: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Nani aliye ifanyia haya miungu yetu? Hakika huyu ni katika walio dhulumu.
translation_en: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًۭى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Tumemsikia kijana mmoja akiwataja. Anaitwa Ibrahim.
translation_en: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Mleteni mbele ya macho ya watu, wapate kumshuhudia!
translation_en: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Je! Wewe umeifanyia haya miungu yetu, ewe Ibrahim?
translation_en: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"

arabic_text: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Bali amefanya hayo huyu mkubwa wao. Basi waulizeni ikiwa wanaweza kutamka.
translation_en: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."

arabic_text: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Basi wakajirudi nafsi zao, wakasema: Hakika nyinyi mlikuwa madhaalimu!
translation_en: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."

arabic_text: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
translation_sw: Kisha wakarejea kwenye ule ule upotovu wao wakasema: Wewe unajua kwamba hawa hawesemi.
translation_en: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"

arabic_text: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
translation_sw: Akasema: Basi nyinyi mnawaabudu asiye kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu wasio kufaini kitu wala kukudhuruni?
translation_en: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allah that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?

arabic_text: أُفٍّۢ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Aibu yenu nyinyi na hivyo mnavyo viabudu badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu! Basi nyinyi hamtii akilini?
translation_en: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allah. Then will you not use reason?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Mchomeni moto, na muinusuru miungu yenu, ikiwa nyinyi ni watendao jambo!
translation_en: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."

arabic_text: قُلْنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_sw: Sisi tukasema: Ewe moto! Kuwa baridi na salama kwa Ibrahim!
translation_en: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."

arabic_text: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًۭا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ
translation_sw: Wao walimkusudia maovu, lakini Sisi tukawafanya wao ndio walio khasiri.
translation_en: And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers.

arabic_text: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukamwokoa yeye na Luut'i tukawapeleka kwenye nchi tulio ibariki kwa ajili ya walimwengu wote.
translation_en: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds.

arabic_text: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةًۭ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا صَٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Naye tukampa Is-haq, na Yaaqub kuwa ni ziada. Na wote tukawajaalia wawe watu wema.
translation_en: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةًۭ يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَٰبِدِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukawafanya maimamu wakiongoa watu kwa amri yetu. Na tukawafunulia watende kheri, na washike Sala, na watoe Zaka; na walikuwa wanatuabudu Sisi tu.
translation_en: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of Us.

arabic_text: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَٰٓئِثَ ۗ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍۢ فَٰسِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na Luut'i tukampa hukumu na ilimu na tukamwokoa na ule mji ulio kuwa ukifanya maovu. Hakika hao walikuwa watu wabaya, wachafu.
translation_en: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.

arabic_text: وَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukamuingiza katika rehema yetu. Hakika yeye ni miongoni mwa watenda mema.
translation_en: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.

arabic_text: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_sw: Na Nuhu alipo ita zamani, nasi tukamuitikia, na tukamwokoa yeye na watu wake kutokana na shida kubwa.
translation_en: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allah] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great flood.

arabic_text: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍۢ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukamnusuru na watu walio zikanusha Ishara zetu. Hakika hao walikuwa watu wabaya. Basi tukawazamisha wote.
translation_en: And We saved him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.

arabic_text: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَٰهِدِينَ
translation_sw: Na Daud na Suleiman walipo kata hukumu katika kadhiya ya konde walipo lisha humo mbuzi wa watu usiku. Na Sisi tulikuwa wenye kushuhudia hukumu yao hiyo.
translation_en: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.

arabic_text: فَفَهَّمْنَٰهَا سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
translation_sw: Tukamfahamisha Suleiman. Na kila mmoja wao tulimpa hukumu na ilimu. Na tuliifanya milima na ndege kuwa pamoja na Daud imnyenyekee na imtakase Mwenyezi Mungu. Na Sisi ndio tulio fanya hayo.
translation_en: And We gave understanding of the case to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].

arabic_text: وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍۢ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَٰكِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na tukamfundisha kuunda mavazi ya vita kwa ajili yenu ili yakuhifadhini katika kupigana kwenu. Je! Mtakuwa wenye kushukuru?
translation_en: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?

arabic_text: وَلِسُلَيْمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukamsahilishia Suleiman upepo wa kimbunga wendao kwa amri yake kwenye ardhi tuliyo ibarikia. Na Sisi ndio tunao jua kila kitu.
translation_en: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.

arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
translation_sw: Na pia mashet'ani wanao mpigia mbizi na kufanya kazi nyenginezo. Na Sisi tulikuwa walinzi wao.
translation_en: And of the devils were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.

arabic_text: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na Ayyubu, alipo mwita Mola wake Mlezi, akasema: Mimi yamenipata madhara. Na Wewe ndiye unaye rehemu kuliko wote wanao rehemu.
translation_en: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful."

arabic_text: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَٰبِدِينَ
translation_sw: Basi tukamwitikia, na tukamwondolea madhara aliyo kuwa nayo, na tukampa watu wake na mfano wao pamoja nao kuwa ni rehema inayo toka kwetu, na ukumbusho kwa wafanyao ibada.
translation_en: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allah].

arabic_text: وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na Ismail, na Idris, na Dhulkifli - wote walikuwa miongoni mwa wanao subiri.
translation_en: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.

arabic_text: وَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukawaingiza katika rehema yetu. Hakika wao walikuwa katika watu wema.
translation_en: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.

arabic_text: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًۭا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na Dhun-Nun alipoondoka hali ameghadhibika, na akadhani ya kwamba hatutakuwa na uwezo juu yake. Basi aliita katika giza: Hapana mungu isipo kuwa Wewe Subhanaka Uliye takasika. Hakika mimi nilikuwa miongoni mwa wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."

arabic_text: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Basi tukamwitikia na tukamwokoa kutokana na dhiki. Na hivyo ndivyo tunavyo waokoa Waumini.
translation_en: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.

arabic_text: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
translation_sw: Na Zakariya alipo mwita Mola wake Mlezi: Mola wangu Mlezi! Usiniache peke yangu, na Wewe ndiye Mbora wa wanao rithi.
translation_en: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors."

arabic_text: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًۭا وَرَهَبًۭا ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَٰشِعِينَ
translation_sw: Basi tukamwitikia, na tukampa Yahya na tukamponyeshea mkewe. Hakika wao walikuwa wepesi wa kutenda mema, na wakituomba kwa shauku na khofu. Nao walikuwa wakitunyenyekea.
translation_en: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na mwanamke aliye linda uke wake, na tukampulizia katika roho yetu, na tukamfanya yeye na mwanawe kuwa ni Ishara kwa walimwengu.
translation_en: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika huu umma wenu ni umma mmoja, na Mimi ni Mola wenu Mlezi. Kwa hivyo niabuduni Mimi.
translation_en: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.

arabic_text: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ
translation_sw: Nao wakalikata jambo lao hili mapande mapande baina yao. Wote watarudi kwetu.
translation_en: And [yet] they divided their affair among themselves, [but] all to Us will return.

arabic_text: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَٰتِبُونَ
translation_sw: Na atendaye mema naye ni Muumini basi haitakataliwa juhudi yake. Na hakika Sisi tunamwandikia.
translation_en: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We, of it, are recorders.

arabic_text: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_sw: Na haiwi kwa wana-mji tulio uangamiza, ya kwamba hawatarejea,
translation_en: And there is prohibition upon [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍۢ يَنسِلُونَ
translation_sw: Mpaka watapo funguliwa Juju na Maajuju wakawa wanateremka kutoka kila mlima;
translation_en: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend

arabic_text: وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na miadi ya haki ikakaribia. Hapo ndipo yatapo kodoka macho ya walio kufuru (na watasema:) Ole wetu! Bila ya shaka tulikuwa tumeghafilika na haya, bali tulikuwa wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: And [when] the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."

arabic_text: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika nyinyi na hao mnao waabudu badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni kuni za Jahannamu; huko mtaingia tu.
translation_en: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allah are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.

arabic_text: لَوْ كَانَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةًۭ مَّا وَرَدُوهَا ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation_sw: Lau kuwa hawa ni miungu, wasingeli ingia. Na wote watadumu humo.
translation_en: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.

arabic_text: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌۭ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
translation_sw: Lao wao humo ni kupiga mayowe, na wala hawatasikia (jenginelo).
translation_en: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Ama wale ambao wema wetu umewatangulia, hao watatenganishwa na hayo.
translation_en: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.

arabic_text: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا ۖ وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَٰلِدُونَ
translation_sw: Hawatausikia mvumo wake, na wao watadumu katika yale zinayo yatamani nafsi zao.
translation_en: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.

arabic_text: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ هَٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Hicho Kitisho Kikubwa hakito wahuzunisha. Na Malaika watawapokea (kwa kuwaambia): Hii ndiyo Siku yenu mliyo kuwa mkiahidiwa!
translation_en: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ ۚ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍۢ نُّعِيدُهُۥ ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
translation_sw: Siku tutakapo zikunja mbingu kama mkunjo wa karatasi za vitabu. Kama tulivyo anza umbo la mwanzo tutalirudisha tena. Ni ahadi iliyo juu yetu. Hakika Sisi ni watendao.
translation_en: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tulikwisha andika katika Zaburi baada ya Kumbukumbu, ya kwamba nchi watairithi waja wangu walio wema.
translation_en: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى هَٰذَا لَبَلَٰغًۭا لِّقَوْمٍ عَٰبِدِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika katika haya yapo mawaidha kwa watu wafanyao ibada.
translation_en: Indeed, in this [Qur'an] is notification for a worshipping people.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Nasi hatukukutuma ila uwe ni Rehema kwa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Hakika imefunuliwa kwangu ya kwamba hakika Mungu wenu ni Mungu Mmoja tu. Je! Mmesilimu?
translation_en: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"

arabic_text: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍۢ ۖ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Na kama wakigeuka, basi sema: Nimekutangazieni sawa sawa, wala sijui yako karibu au mbali hayo mliyo ahidiwa.
translation_en: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Yeye anajua kauli ya dhaahiri na anajua myafichayo.
translation_en: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.

arabic_text: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌۭ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Wala sijui pengine huu ni mtihani tu kwenu na starehe mpaka muda kidogo.
translation_en: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."

arabic_text: قَٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Hukumu kwa haki. Na Mola wetu Mlezi ni Mwingi wa Rehema, aombwaye msaada juu ya mnayo yazua.
translation_en: [The Prophet] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ شَىْءٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Enyi watu! Mcheni Mola wenu Mlezi. Hakika tetemeko la Saa (ya Kiyama) ni jambo kuu.
translation_en: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلنَّاسَ سُكَٰرَىٰ وَمَا هُم بِسُكَٰرَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ ٱللَّهِ شَدِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Siku mtapo iona, kila mwenye kunyonyesha atamsahau amnyonyeshaye, na kila mwenye mimba ataharibu mimba yake. Na utaona watu wamelewa, na kumbe hawakulewa. Lakini adhabu ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni kali.
translation_en: On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allah is severe.

arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ مَّرِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Na miongoni mwa watu wapo wanao bishana juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu bila ya ilimu, na wanamfuata kila shet'ani aliye asi.
translation_en: And of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil.

arabic_text: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ مَن تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُۥ يُضِلُّهُۥ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation_sw: Ameandikiwa kwamba anaye mfanya kuwa rafiki, basi huyo hakika atampoteza na atamwongoza kwenye adhabu ya Moto mkali.
translation_en: It has been decreed for every devil that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍۢ مُّخَلَّقَةٍۢ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍۢ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ ۚ وَنُقِرُّ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًۭا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ۖ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَتَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةًۭ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنۢبَتَتْ مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ
translation_sw: Enyi watu! Ikiwa nyinyi mna shaka ya kufufuliwa basi kwa hakika Sisi tulikuumbeni kutokana na udongo, kisha kutokana na manii, kisha kutokana na kipande cha damu ilio gandana, kisha kutokana na kipande cha nyama chenye umbo na kisicho kuwa na umbo, ili tukubainishieni. Nasi tunakiweka katika matumbo ya uzazi tunacho kitaka mpaka muda ulio wekwa. Kisha tunakutoeni kwa hali ya mtoto mchanga, kisha mfikie kutimia akili. Na wapo katika nyinyi wanao kufa, na wapo katika nyinyi wanao rudishwa kwenye umri wa unyonge kabisa, hata mtu awe hajui kitu baada ya kuwa anakijua. Na unaiona ardhi imetulia kimya, lakini tunapo yateremsha maji juu yake husisimka na kututumka, na kumea kila namna ya mimea mizuri.
translation_en: O People, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that We may show you. And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُۥ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَأَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa sababu hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Haki, na kwamba hakika Yeye ndiye mwenye kuhuisha wafu, na kwamba hakika Yeye ni Muweza wa kila kitu.
translation_en: That is because Allah is the Truth and because He gives life to the dead and because He is over all things competent

arabic_text: وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌۭ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation_sw: Na kwamba hakika Saa itakuja hapana shaka kwa hilo, na kwamba hakika Mwenyezi Mungu atawafufua walio makaburini.
translation_en: And [that they may know] that the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that Allah will resurrect those in the graves.

arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا هُدًۭى وَلَا كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّنِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na katika watu wapo wanao bishana juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu bila ya ilimu, wala uwongofu, wala Kitabu chenye nuru.
translation_en: And of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from Him],

arabic_text: ثَانِىَ عِطْفِهِۦ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌۭ ۖ وَنُذِيقُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation_sw: Anaye geuza shingo yake ili kupoteza watu waache Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Duniani atapata hizaya, na Siku ya Kiyama tutamwonjesha adhabu ya kuungua.
translation_en: Twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of Allah. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said],

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
translation_sw: (Ataambiwa): Hayo ni kwa sababu ya iliyo tanguliza mikono yako. Na hakika Mwenyezi Mungu si dhaalimu kwa waja.
translation_en: "That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allah is not ever unjust to [His] servants."

arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَعْبُدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍۢ ۖ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُۥ خَيْرٌ ٱطْمَأَنَّ بِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ خَسِرَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Na katika watu wapo wanao muabudu Mwenyezi Mungu kwa ukingoni. Ikimfikia kheri hutulia kwayo, na ukimfikia msukosuko hugeuza uso wake. Amekhasiri dunia na Akhera; hiyo ndiyo khasara iliyo wazi.
translation_en: And of the people is he who worships Allah on an edge. If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to the other direction]. He has lost [this] world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss.

arabic_text: يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُۥ وَمَا لَا يَنفَعُهُۥ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلْبَعِيدُ
translation_sw: Badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu, yeye huomba kisicho mdhuru wala kumnufaisha. Huko ndiko kupotolea mbali!
translation_en: He invokes instead of Allah that which neither harms him nor benefits him. That is what is the extreme error.

arabic_text: يَدْعُوا۟ لَمَن ضَرُّهُۥٓ أَقْرَبُ مِن نَّفْعِهِۦ ۚ لَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْعَشِيرُ
translation_sw: Humuomba yule ambaye bila ya shaka dhara yake ipo karibu zaidi kuliko nafuu yake. Kwa hakika huyo ni mlinzi muovu, na rafiki muovu.
translation_en: He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ
translation_sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu atawaingiza walio amini na wakatenda mema katika Bustani zipitazo mito kati yake. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu hutenda atakayo.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. Indeed, Allah does what He intends.

arabic_text: مَن كَانَ يَظُنُّ أَن لَّن يَنصُرَهُ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ فَلْيَنظُرْ هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهُۥ مَا يَغِيظُ
translation_sw: Anaye dhani kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu hatamnusuru (Mtume) katika dunia na Akhera na afunge kamba kwenye dari kisha aikate. Atazame je hila yake itaondoa hayo yaliyo mkasirisha?
translation_en: Whoever should think that Allah will not support [Prophet Muhammad] in this world and the Hereafter - let him extend a rope to the ceiling, then cut off [his breath], and let him see: will his effort remove that which enrages [him]?

arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يُرِيدُ
translation_sw: Na namna hivi tumeiteremsha (Qur'ani) kuwa ni Aya zilizo wazi, na hakika Mwenyezi Mungu humwongoa amtakaye.
translation_en: And thus have We sent the Qur'an down as verses of clear evidence and because Allah guides whom He intends.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلْمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
translation_sw: Hakika walio amini, na ambao ni Mayahudi na Wasabai na Wakristo na Majusi na wale walio shiriki - hakika Mwenyezi Mungu atawapambanua baina yao Siku ya Kiyama. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Shahidi wa kila kitu.
translation_en: Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allah - Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, over all things, Witness.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ وَٱلنُّجُومُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ وَٱلدَّوَآبُّ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ وَمَن يُهِنِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّكْرِمٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۩
translation_sw: Je! Huoni kwamba vinamsujudia Mwenyezi Mungu viliomo mbinguni na viliomo katika ardhi, na jua, na mwezi, na nyota, na milima, na miti, na wanyama, na wengi miongoni mwa watu. Na wengi imewastahiki adhabu. Na anaye fedheheshwa na Mwenyezi Mungu hana wa kumhishimu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu hutenda apendayo.
translation_en: Do you not see that to Allah prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? But upon many the punishment has been justified. And he whom Allah humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honor. Indeed, Allah does what He wills.

arabic_text: ۞ هَٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ ٱخْتَصَمُوا۟ فِى رَبِّهِمْ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ يُصَبُّ مِن فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيمُ
translation_sw: Hawa wagomvi wawili walio gombana kwa ajili ya Mola wao Mlezi. Basi walio kufuru watakatiwa nguo za moto, na yatamiminwa juu ya vichwa vyao maji yanayo chemka.
translation_en: These are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord. But those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. Poured upon their heads will be scalding water

arabic_text: يُصْهَرُ بِهِۦ مَا فِى بُطُونِهِمْ وَٱلْجُلُودُ
translation_sw: Kwa maji hayo vitayayushwa viliomo matumboni mwao, na ngozi zao pia.
translation_en: By which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins.

arabic_text: وَلَهُم مَّقَٰمِعُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Na kwa ajili yao yatakuwapo marungu ya chuma.
translation_en: And for [striking] them are maces of iron.

arabic_text: كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation_sw: Kila wakitaka kutoka humo kwa sababu ya uchungu watarudishwa humo humo, na wataambiwa: Onjeni adhabu ya kuungua!
translation_en: Every time they want to get out of Hellfire from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!"

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍۢ وَلُؤْلُؤًۭا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu atawaingiza walio amini na wakatenda mema katika Bustani zipitiwazo na mito kati yake. Watapambwa humo kwa mapambo ya mikononi ya dhahabu na lulu. Na mavazi yao humo ni hariri.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk.

arabic_text: وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيِّبِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation_sw: Na wataongozwa kwenye maneno mazuri, na wataongozwa kwenye Njia ya Msifiwa.
translation_en: And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلْنَٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءً ٱلْعَٰكِفُ فِيهِ وَٱلْبَادِ ۚ وَمَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحَادٍۭ بِظُلْمٍۢ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika wale walio kufuru na wakazuilia Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu na Msikiti Mtakatifu, ambao tumeufanya kwa ajili ya watu wote sawasawa, kwa wakaao humo na wageni. Na kila atakaye taka kufanya upotofu humo kwa dhulma, basi tutamwonjesha adhabu chungu.
translation_en: Indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of Allah and [from] al-Masjid al-Haram, which We made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside; and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein of deviation [in religion] or wrongdoing - We will make him taste of a painful punishment.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنَا لِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَكَانَ ٱلْبَيْتِ أَن لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِى شَيْـًۭٔا وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْقَآئِمِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ
translation_sw: Na pale tulipomweka Ibrahim pahala penye ile Nyumba tukamwambia: Usinishirikishe na chochote; na isafishe Nyumba yangu kwa ajili ya wanao izunguka kwa kut'ufu, na wanao kaa hapo kwa ibada, na wanao rukuu, na wanao sujudu.
translation_en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying], "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform Tawaf and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate.

arabic_text: وَأَذِّن فِى ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًۭا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍۢ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍۢ
translation_sw: Na watangazie watu Hija; watakujia kwa miguu na juu ya kila ngamia aliye konda, wakija kutoka katika kila njia ya mbali.
translation_en: And proclaim to the people the Hajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass -

arabic_text: لِّيَشْهَدُوا۟ مَنَٰفِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ فِىٓ أَيَّامٍۢ مَّعْلُومَٰتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ۖ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْبَآئِسَ ٱلْفَقِيرَ
translation_sw: Ili washuhudie manufaa yao na walitaje jina la Mwenyezi Mungu katika siku maalumu juu ya nyama hoa alio waruzuku. Basi kuleni katika hao na mlisheni mwenye shida aliye fakiri.
translation_en: That they may witness benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allah on known days over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. So eat of them and feed the miserable and poor.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا۟ تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا۟ نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا۟ بِٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ
translation_sw: Kisha wajisafishe taka zao, na waondoe nadhiri zao, na waizunguke Nyumba ya Kale.
translation_en: Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform Tawaf around the ancient House."

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ حُرُمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ وَأُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمُ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلرِّجْسَ مِنَ ٱلْأَوْثَٰنِ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ قَوْلَ ٱلزُّورِ
translation_sw: Ndio hivyo iwe! Na anaye vitukuza vitakatifu vya Mwenyezi Mungu basi hayo ndiyo kheri yake mbele ya Mola wake Mlezi. Na mmehalalishiwa nyama hoa ila wale mlio somewa. Basi jiepusheni na uchafu wa masanamu, na jiepusheni na usemi wa uwongo.
translation_en: That [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allah - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you. So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement,

arabic_text: حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ ٱلطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِى بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى مَكَانٍۢ سَحِيقٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwa kumtakasikia Imani Mwenyezi Mungu, bila ya kumshirikisha. Na anaye mshirikisha Mwenyezi Mungu ni kama kwamba ameporomoka kutoka mbinguni, kisha ndege wakamnyakua au upepo ukamtupa pahala mbali.
translation_en: Inclining [only] to Allah, not associating [anything] with Him. And he who associates with Allah - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَى ٱلْقُلُوبِ
translation_sw: Ndio hivyo! Na anayetukuza ibada za Mwenyezi Mungu, basi hayo ni katika unyenyekevu wa nyoyo.
translation_en: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols of Allah - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.

arabic_text: لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ
translation_sw: Katika hao nyinyi mna manufaa mpaka muda maalumu. Kisha pahala pa kuchinjiwa kwake ni kwenye Nyumba ya Kale.
translation_en: For you the animals marked for sacrifice are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.

arabic_text: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًۭا لِّيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ۗ فَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ فَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُخْبِتِينَ
translation_sw: Na kila umma tumewafanyia mahala pa kuchinjia mihanga ya ibada ili walitaje jina la Mwenyezi Mungu juu ya vile walivyo ruzukiwa katika wanyama wa mifugo. Basi Mungu wenu ni Mungu Mmoja tu. Jisalimishieni kwake tu, na wabashirie wanyenyekevu,
translation_en: And for all religion We have appointed a rite [of sacrifice] that they may mention the name of Allah over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, [O Muhammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their Lord]

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ وَٱلْمُقِيمِى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao, anapo tajwa Mwenyezi Mungu nyoyo zao hutetemeka, na wanao vumilia kwa yanao wasibu, na wanao shika Sala, na wanatoa katika tulivyo waruzuku.
translation_en: Who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them.

arabic_text: وَٱلْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَٰٓئِرِ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرٌۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَآفَّ ۖ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْقَانِعَ وَٱلْمُعْتَرَّ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنَٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na ngamia wa sadaka tumekufanyieni kuwa ni kudhihirisha matukuzo kwa Mwenyezi Mungu; kwa hao mna kheri nyingi. Basi litajeni jina la Mwenyezi Mungu juu yao wanapo simama kwa safu. Na waangukapo ubavu kuleni katika hao na walisheni walio kinai na wanao lazimika kuomba. Ndio kama hivi tumewafanya hawa wanyama dhalili kwenu ili mpate kushukuru.
translation_en: And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols of Allah; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allah upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful.

arabic_text: لَن يَنَالَ ٱللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَٰكِن يَنَالُهُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ مِنكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Nyama zao hazimfikii Mwenyezi Mungu wala damu zao, lakini unamfikia uchamngu wenu. Namna hivi tumewadhalilisha kwenu ili mumtukuze Mwenyezi Mungu kwa alivyo kuongoeni. Na wabashirie wafanyao mema.
translation_en: Their meat will not reach Allah, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allah for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good.

arabic_text: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍۢ كَفُورٍ
translation_sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu huwakinga walio amini. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu hampendi kila khaini mwingi wa kukanya mema.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful.

arabic_text: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا۟ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ
translation_sw: Wameruhusiwa kupigana wale wanao pigwa vita kwa sababu wamedhulumiwa - na kwa yakini Mwenyezi Mungu ni Muweza wa kuwasaidia -
translation_en: Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory.

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍۢ لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٌۭ وَصَلَوَٰتٌۭ وَمَسَٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرًۭا ۗ وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
translation_sw: Wale ambao wametolewa majumbani mwao pasipo haki, ila kwa kuwa wanasema: Mola wetu Mlezi ni Mwenyezi Mungu! Na lau kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu hawakingi watu kwa watu, basi hapana shaka zingeli vunjwa nymba za wat'awa, na makanisa, na masinagogi, na misikiti, ambamo ndani yake jina la Mwenyezi Mungu linatajwa kwa wingi. Na bila ya shaka Mwenyezi Mungu humsaidia yule anaye msaidia Yeye. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye nguvu Mtukufu.
translation_en: [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allah." And were it not that Allah checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allah is much mentioned. And Allah will surely support those who support Him. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُوا۟ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا۟ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ
translation_sw: Wale ambao tukiwapa madaraka katika nchi husimamisha Sala, na wakatoa Zaka, na wakaamrisha mema, na wakakataza mabaya. Na kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ndio marejeo ya mambo yote.
translation_en: [And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakah and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allah belongs the outcome of [all] matters.

arabic_text: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
translation_sw: Na wakikukanusha basi walikwisha kanusha kabla yao watu wa Nuhu, na kina A'ad na kina Thamud,
translation_en: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and 'Aad and Thamud deny [their prophets],

arabic_text: وَقَوْمُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ
translation_sw: Na watu wa Ibrahim na watu wa Lut'i
translation_en: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot

arabic_text: وَأَصْحَٰبُ مَدْيَنَ ۖ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
translation_sw: Na watu wa Madiana. Na Musa pia alikanushwa. Nikawapa muda makafiri, kisha nikawatia mkononi. Basi ilikuwaje adhabu yangu!
translation_en: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

arabic_text: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌۭ فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍۢ مُّعَطَّلَةٍۢ وَقَصْرٍۢ مَّشِيدٍ
translation_sw: Miji mingapi tuliiangamiza iliyo kuwa ikidhulumu, ikawa imebaki magofu, na visima vilivyo achwa, na majumba yaliyo kuwa madhubuti?
translation_en: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.

arabic_text: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌۭ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوْ ءَاذَانٌۭ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا ۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَلَٰكِن تَعْمَى ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_sw: Je! Hawatembei katika ardhi ili wapate kuwa na nyoyo zao za kuzingatia, au masikio ya kusikilia? Kwani hakika si macho yanayo pofuka, lakini zinazo pofuka ni nyoyo ziliomo vifuani.
translation_en: So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.

arabic_text: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ ۚ وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍۢ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
translation_sw: Na wanakuhimiza ulete adhabu, lakini Mwenyezi Mungu hatakwenda kinyume na ahadi yake kabisa. Na hakika siku moja kwa Mola wako Mlezi ni kama miaka elfu mnavyo hisabu nyinyi.
translation_en: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allah will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count.

arabic_text: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌۭ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Na miji mingapi niliipa muda na hali ilikuwa imedhulumu, na kisha nikaitia mkononi? Na kwangu Mimi ndio marudio yote.
translation_en: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.

arabic_text: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Sema: Enyi watu! Hakika mimi ni mwonyaji kwenu niliye dhaahiri.
translation_en: Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner."

arabic_text: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi walio amini na wakatenda mema watapata maghfira na riziki za ukarimu.
translation_en: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْا۟ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_sw: Na wanao jitahidi kuzipinga Aya zetu hao ndio watu wa Motoni.
translation_en: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ وَلَا نَبِىٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلْقَى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِىٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na hatukumtuma kabla yako Mtume wala Nabii ila anapo soma, Shet'ani hutumbukiza katika masomo yake. Lakini Mwenyezi Mungu huyaondoa anayo yatia Shet'ani; kisha Mwenyezi Mungu huzithibitisha Aya zake. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mjuzi Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allah abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allah makes precise His verses. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.

arabic_text: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Hayo ni ili alifanye lile analo litia Shet'ani liwe ni fitna kwa wale wenye maradhi ndani ya nyoyo zao, na wale ambao nyoyo zao ni ngumu. Na hakika madhaalimu wamo katika mfarakano wa mbali.
translation_en: [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.

arabic_text: وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Na ili walio pewa ilimu wajue kuwa hayo ni Haki itokayo kwa Mola wako Mlezi na waamini, na zipate kutua nyoyo zao. Na hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye anaye waongoa wenye kuamini kwenye Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allah the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path.

arabic_text: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى مِرْيَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru hawatoacha kuwa katika wasiwasi kwa hilo mpaka Saa iwafikie ghafla, au iwafikie adhabu ya Siku Tasa.
translation_en: But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day.

arabic_text: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_sw: Ufalme wote siku hiyo utakuwa wa Mwenyezi Mungu. Atahukumu baina yao. Basi walio amini na wakatenda mema watakuwa katika Bustani zenye neema.
translation_en: [All] sovereignty that Day is for Allah; He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru na kuzikanusha Ishara zetu, basi hao watapata adhabu ya kufedhehesha.
translation_en: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓا۟ أَوْ مَاتُوا۟ لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na walio hama kwa ajili ya Mwenyezi Mungu, kisha wakauwawa au wakafa, bila ya shaka Mwenyezi Mungu atawaruzuku riziki njema. Na hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mbora wa wanao ruzuku.
translation_en: And those who emigrated for the cause of Allah and then were killed or died - Allah will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allah who is the best of providers.

arabic_text: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًۭا يَرْضَوْنَهُۥ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: BIla ya shaka atawaingiza pahala watakapo paridhia. Na hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mjuzi na Mpole.
translation_en: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allah is Knowing and Forbearing.

arabic_text: ۞ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِىَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌۭ
translation_sw: Ndio namna hivi. Na anaye lipiza mfano wa alivyo adhibiwa, kisha akadhulumiwa, basi hapana shaka Mwenyezi Mungu atamsaidia. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Msamehevu Mwenye maghfira.
translation_en: That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allah will surely aid him. Indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu huingiza usiku katika mchana, na huuingiza mchana katika usiku, na ya kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusikia Mwenye kuona.
translation_en: That is because Allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allah is Hearing and Seeing.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Wa Kweli, na kwamba wale wanao waomba badala yake, ni baat'ili, na hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Aliye Juu na ndiye Mkubwa.
translation_en: That is because Allah is the Truth, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the Most High, the Grand.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَتُصْبِحُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Je! Huoni kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu huteremsha maji kutoka mbinguni, na mara ardhi inakuwa chanikiwiti? Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mpole na Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: Do you not see that Allah has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted.

arabic_text: لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
translation_sw: Ni vyake viliomo mbinguni na viliomo katika ardhi. Na hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kujitosha na Mwenye kusifiwa.
translation_en: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَيُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Je! Huoni kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu amevidhalilisha kwenu viliomo katika ardhi, na marikebu zipitazo baharini kwa amri yake, na amezishika mbingu zisianguke juu ya ardhi ila kwa idhini yake. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye huruma kwa watu, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Do you not see that Allah has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed Allah, to the people, is Kind and Merciful.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌۭ
translation_sw: Na Yeye ndiye aliye kuhuisheni kisha akakufisheni, na kisha atakufufueni. Hakika mwanaadamu hana fadhila.
translation_en: And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful.

arabic_text: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ ۖ فَلَا يُنَٰزِعُنَّكَ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ ۚ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Kila umma tumewajaalia na ibada zao wanazo zishika. Basi wasizozane nawe katika jambo hili. Na waite watu kwendea kwa Mola wako Mlezi. Hakika wewe uko kwenye Uwongofu Ulio Nyooka.
translation_en: For every religion We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muhammad], let the disbelievers not contend with you over the matter but invite them to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.

arabic_text: وَإِن جَٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
