translation_sw: Na wakikujadili basi sema: Mwenyezi Mungu anajua zaidi mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allah is most knowing of what you do.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu atahukumu baina yenu Siku ya Kiyama katika hayo mnayo khitalifiana.
translation_en: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِى كِتَٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Je! Hujui kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu anayajua yaliomo mbinguni na katika ardhi? Hakika hayo yamo Kitabuni. Hakika hayo kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ni mepesi.
translation_en: Do you not know that Allah knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed that, for Allah, is easy.

arabic_text: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًۭا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ ۗ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na wanaabudu badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu ambavyo hakuviteremshia ushahidi, na ambavyo hawana ujuzi navyo. Na madhaalimu hawatakuwa na wa kuwasaidia.
translation_en: And they worship besides Allah that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ۗ قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّۢ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ ۗ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Na wanapo somewa Aya zetu zilizo wazi utaona chuki katika nyuso za walio kufuru. Hukaribia kuwavamia wale wanao wasomea hizo Aya zetu. Sema: Je! Nikwambieni yaliyo mabaya zaidi kuliko haya? Ni Moto. Mwenyezi Mungu amewaahidi walio kufuru, na ni marudio mabaya hayo.
translation_en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that? [It is] the Fire which Allah has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌۭ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًۭا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۖ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًۭٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ
translation_sw: Enyi watu! Unapigwa mfano, basi usikilizeni. Hakika wale mnao waomba badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu, hawatoumba hata nzi ijapo kuwa watajumuika kwa hilo. Na nzi akiwapokonya kitu hawawezi kukipata kwake. Amedhoofika kweli huyo mwenye kutaka na mwenye kutakiwa.
translation_en: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allah will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for that purpose. And if the fly should steal away from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.

arabic_text: مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
translation_sw: Hawakumuadhimisha Mwenyezi Mungu anavyo stahiki kuadhimishwa. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu bila ya shaka ni Mwenye kushinda.
translation_en: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى مِنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًۭا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu huteuwa Wajumbe miongoni mwa Malaika na miongoni mwa watu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusikia, Mwenye kuona.
translation_en: Allah chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.

arabic_text: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
translation_sw: Anayajua yaliyo mbele yao na yaliyo nyuma yao. Na kwa Mwenyezi Mungu yatarejeshwa mambo yote.
translation_en: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. And to Allah will be returned [all] matters.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱفْعَلُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ۩
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Rukuuni na msujudu, na muabuduni Mola wenu Mlezi, na tendeni mema, ili mfanikiwe.
translation_en: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.

arabic_text: وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ ۚ هُوَ ٱجْتَبَىٰكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍۢ ۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِى هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
translation_sw: Na fanyeni juhudi kwa ajili ya Mwenyezi Mungu kama inavyo stahiki jihadi yake. Yeye amekuteueni. Wala hakuweka juu yenu mambo mazito katika Dini. Nayo ni mila ya baba yenu Ibrahim. Yeye (Mwenyezi Mungu) alikuiteni Waislamu tangu zamani, na katika hii (Qur'ani) pia, ili awe Mtume shahidi juu yenu, na nyinyi muwe mashahidi kwa watu. Basi shikeni Sala na toeni Zaka na shikamaneni na Mwenyezi Mungu. Yeye ndiye Mlinzi wenu, Mlinzi bora kabisa, na Msaidizi bora kabisa.
translation_en: And strive for Allah with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. Allah named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.

arabic_text: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: HAKIKA wamefanikiwa Waumini,
translation_en: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَٰشِعُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao ni wanyenyekevu katika Sala zao,
translation_en: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambao hujiepusha na mambo ya upuuzi,
translation_en: And they who turn away from ill speech

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambao wanatoa Zaka,
translation_en: And they who are observant of zakah

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambao wanazilinda tupu zao,
translation_en: And they who guard their private parts

arabic_text: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa kwa wake zao au kwa iliyo wamiliki mikono yao ya kulia. Kwani hao si wenye kulaumiwa.
translation_en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -

arabic_text: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini anaye taka kinyume cha haya, basi hao ndio warukao mipaka.
translation_en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambao wanazitimiza amana zao na ahadi zao,
translation_en: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambao Sala zao wanazihifadhi -
translation_en: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
translation_sw: Hao ndio warithi,
translation_en: Those are the inheritors

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao watairithi Pepo ya Firdausi, wadumu humo.
translation_en: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍۢ مِّن طِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Na kwa yakini tumemuumba mtu kutokana na asli ya udongo.
translation_en: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُطْفَةًۭ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Kisha tukamjaalia awe tone ya mbegu ya uzazi katika kalio madhubuti.
translation_en: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَٰمًۭا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَٰمَ لَحْمًۭا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukaiumba tone kuwa damu iliyo ganda, na tukaiumba damu kuwa pande la nyama, kisha tukaliumba pande la nyama kuwa mifupa, na mifupa tukaivika nyama. Kisha tukamfanya kiumbe mwengine. Basi ametukuka Mwenyezi Mungu Mbora wa waumbaji.
translation_en: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
translation_sw: Kisha hakika nyinyi baada ya hayo mtakufa.
translation_en: Then indeed, after that you are to die.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
translation_sw: Kisha hakika nyinyi Siku ya Kiyama mtafufuliwa.
translation_en: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَٰفِلِينَ
translation_sw: Na kwa yakini tumeziumba juu yenu njia saba. Nasi hatukuwa wenye kughafilika na viumbe.
translation_en: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.

arabic_text: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَسْكَنَّٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na tumeteremsha kutoka mbinguni maji kwa kiasi na tukayatuliza katika ardhi. Na hakika Sisi tunaweza kuyaondoa.
translation_en: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.

arabic_text: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa maji hayo tukakufanyieni bustani za mitende na mizabibu, mnapata humo matunda mengi, na katika hayo mnakula;
translation_en: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.

arabic_text: وَشَجَرَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍۢ لِّلْءَاكِلِينَ
translation_sw: Na mti utokao katika mlima wa Sinai, unatoa mafuta na kuwa kitoweo kwa walao.
translation_en: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika mnayo mazingatio makubwa katika nyama hoa - tunakunywesheni katika vile viliomo matumboni mwao, na nyinyi mnapata katika hao manufaa mengi, na pia mnawala.
translation_en: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.

arabic_text: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na juu yao na juu ya marikebu mnabebwa.
translation_en: And upon them and on ships you are carried.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tulimtuma Nuhu kwa watu wake, akasema: Enyi watu wangu! Muabuduni Mwenyezi Mungu. Nyinyi hamna mungu asiye kuwa Yeye. Basi je! Hamwogopi?
translation_en: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

arabic_text: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Walisema wale wakuu walio kufuru katika watu wake: Huyu si chochote ila ni mtu tu kama nyinyi. Anataka kujipa ubora juu yenu. Na lau kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu amependa basi yakini angeli teremsha Malaika. Hatukusikia haya kwa baba zetu wa zamani.
translation_en: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.

arabic_text: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Huyu si lolote ila ni mtu mwenye wazimu. Basi mngojeeni tu kwa muda.
translation_en: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
translation_sw: Akasema (Nuhu): Mola wangu Mlezi! Ninusuru kwa kuwa wamenikanusha.
translation_en: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

arabic_text: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
translation_sw: Tukampa wahyi: Unda jahazi mbele ya macho yetu na uwongozi wetu! Basi itapo fika amri yetu na ikafurika tanuri, hapo waingize ndani yake wa kila namna dume na jike, na ahali zako, isipo kuwa yule ambaye katika wao juu yake imekwisha tangulia kauli. Wala usinitajie hao walio dhulumu. Kwani hao bila ya shaka watazamishwa.
translation_en: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Basi utakapo tulia wewe na walio pamoja nawe humo marikebuni, sema: Alhamdulillahi Sifa zote njema ni za Mwenyezi Mungu, aliye tuokoa na watu madhaalimu!
translation_en: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'

arabic_text: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًۭا مُّبَارَكًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
translation_sw: Na sema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Niteremshe mteremsho wenye baraka, na Wewe ni Mbora wa wateremshaji.
translation_en: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika katika hayo yapo mazingatio. Na kwa yakini Sisi ni wenye kuwafanyia mtihani.
translation_en: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha baada yao tukaanzisha kizazi kingine.
translation_en: Then We produced after them a generation of others.

arabic_text: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Tukawapelekea Mtume miongoni mwao, kuwaambia: Muabuduni Mwenyezi Mungu! Hamna mungu asiye kuwa Yeye. Jee, hamwogopi?
translation_en: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
translation_sw: Na wakubwa katika watu wake walio kufuru na wakakanusha mkutano wa Akhera, na tukawadekeza kwa starehe katika maisha ya dunia, walisema: Huyu si chochote ila ni binaadamu kama nyinyi; anakula mlacho, na anakunywa mnywacho.
translation_en: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.

arabic_text: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًۭا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na nyinyi mkimt'ii mtu kama nyinyi basi hakika mtakuwa khasarani.
translation_en: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.

arabic_text: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
translation_sw: Hivyo anakuahidini ati ya kwamba mtakapo kufa na mkawa udongo na mifupa kuwa mtatolewa?
translation_en: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?

arabic_text: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Hayawi! Hayawi hayo mnayo ahidiwa.
translation_en: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.

arabic_text: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
translation_sw: Hapana ila uhai wetu wa duniani tu, tunakufa na kuishi basi. Wala sisi hatutafufuliwa.
translation_en: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.

arabic_text: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Huyu si lolote ila ni mtu anaye mzulia Mwenyezi Mungu uwongo, wala sisi sio wa kumuamini.
translation_en: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Ninusuru kwa sababu wananikanusha.
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

arabic_text: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍۢ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ
translation_sw: (Mwenyezi Mungu) akasema: Baada ya muda mchache watakuwa wenye kujuta.
translation_en: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."

arabic_text: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءًۭ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Basi ukawanyakua ukelele kwa haki, na tukawafanya kama takataka zinazo elea juu ya maji. Ikapotelea mbali kaumu ya madhaalimu!
translation_en: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukaleta baada yao vizazi vingine.
translation_en: Then We produced after them other generations.

arabic_text: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
translation_sw: Hapana umma uwezao kutanguliza ajali yake wala kuikawiza.
translation_en: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةًۭ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًۭا وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukawatuma Mitume wetu, mmoja baada ya mmoja. Kila umma alipo wafikia Mtume wao walimkanusha. Tukawafuatanisha hawa baada ya hawa, na tukawafanya ni hadithi za kusimuliwa. Wakapotelea mbali watu wasio amini.
translation_en: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
translation_sw: Kisha tukamtuma Musa na nduguye, Haaruni, pamoja na ishara zetu na hoja zilizo wazi.
translation_en: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority

arabic_text: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
translation_sw: Kumwendea Firauni na wakuu wake. Lakini walijivuna, nao walikuwa watu majeuri.
translation_en: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.

arabic_text: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Je, tuwaamini wanaadamu wawili hawa kama sisi, na ambao watu wao ni watumwa wetu?
translation_en: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"

arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
translation_sw: Basi wakawakanusha, na wakawa miongoni mwa walio angamizwa.
translation_en: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tulimpa Musa Kitabu ili wapate kuongoka.
translation_en: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Na tukamfanya mwana wa Mariamu na mama yake kuwa ni Ishara, na tukawapa makimbilio kwenda mahali palipo inuka penye utulivu na chemchem za maji.
translation_en: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Enyi Mitume! Kuleni vyakula vizuri na tendeni mema. Hakika Mimi ni Mjuzi wa mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
translation_sw: Na kwa yakini huu Umma wenu ni Umma mmoja, na Mimi ni Mola wenu Mlezi, basi nicheni Mimi.
translation_en: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."

arabic_text: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini walikatiana jambo lao mapande mbali mbali. Kila kundi likifurahia kwa waliyo nayo.
translation_en: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.

arabic_text: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_sw: Basi waache katika ghafla yao kwa muda.
translation_en: So leave them in their confusion for a time.

arabic_text: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
translation_sw: Je! Wanadhani ya kuwa kwa vile tunavyo wapa mali na watoto
translation_en: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children

arabic_text: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Ndio tunawahimizia kheri? Lakini wenyewe hawatambui.
translation_en: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika hao ambao kwa kumwogopa Mola wao Mlezi wananyenyekea,
translation_en: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Na wale ambao Ishara za Mola wao Mlezi wanaziamini,
translation_en: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Na wale ambao Mola wao Mlezi hawamshirikishi,
translation_en: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
translation_sw: Na wale ambao wanatoa walicho pewa, na hali nyoyo zao zinagopa kwa kuwa watarejea kwa Mola wao Mlezi,
translation_en: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ
translation_sw: Basi wote hao ndio wanao kimbilia katika mambo ya kheri, na ndio watakao tangulia kuyafikia.
translation_en: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.

arabic_text: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَٰبٌۭ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na hatuilazimishi nafsi ila kwa kadri ya uwezo wake. Na tunacho kitabu kisemacho kweli. Nao hawatadhulumiwa.
translation_en: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.

arabic_text: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلٌۭ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini nyoyo zao zimeghafilika na hayo, na wanavyo vitendo vinginevyo wanavyo vifanya.
translation_en: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
translation_sw: Hata tutakapo watia katika adhabu wale walio dekezwa kwa starehe kati yao, hapo ndipo watapo yayatika.
translation_en: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help.

arabic_text: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
translation_sw: Msiyayatike leo! Hakika nyinyi hamtanusurika nasi.
translation_en: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.

arabic_text: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika zilikuwa Aya zangu mkisomewa, nanyi mkirudi nyuma juu ya visigino vyenu,
translation_en: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels

arabic_text: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرًۭا تَهْجُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na huku mkitakabari na usiku mkiizungumza (Qur'ani) kwa dharau.
translation_en: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.

arabic_text: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Je, hawakuifikiri kauli, au yamewajia yasiyo wafikia baba zao wa zamani?
translation_en: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?

arabic_text: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
translation_sw: Au hawakumjua Mtume wao, ndio maana wanamkataa?
translation_en: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?

arabic_text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
translation_sw: Au wanasema: Ana wazimu? Bali amewajia kwa Haki, na wengi wao wanaichukia Haki.
translation_en: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.

arabic_text: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
translation_sw: Na lau kuwa Haki ingeli fuata matamanio yao, basi zingeli haribika mbingu na ardhi na waliomo ndani. Bali tumewaletea ukumbusho wao, nao wanajitenga mbali na ukumbusho wao.
translation_en: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.

arabic_text: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًۭا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
translation_sw: Au unawaomba ujira? Lakini ujira wa Mola wako Mlezi ni bora, na Yeye ndiye Mbora wa wanao ruzuku.
translation_en: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Na kwa yakini wewe unawaita kwenye Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika wale wasio iamini Akhera wanajitenga na Njia hiyo.
translation_en: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.

arabic_text: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّۢ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
translation_sw: Na lau tungeli warehemu na tukawaondolea shida waliyo nayo bila ya shaka wangeli endelea katika upotofu wao vile vile, wakitangatanga.
translation_en: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tuliwatia adhabu kali; lakini hawakuelekea kwa Mola wao Mlezi wala hawakunyenyekea.
translation_en: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا ذَا عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
translation_sw: Mpaka tulipo wafungulia mlango wa adhabu kali, hapo ndipo wakawa wenye kukata tamaa.
translation_en: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na Yeye ndiye aliye kuumbieni kusikia na kuona na nyoyo za kufahamu. Ni kuchache mno kushukuru kwenu.
translation_en: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na Yeye ndiye aliye kuenezeni katika ardhi, na kwake Yeye mtakusanywa.
translation_en: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na Yeye ndiye anaye huisha na kufisha, na yake Yeye mabadiliko ya usiku na mchana. Basi je! Hamfahamu?
translation_en: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?

arabic_text: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
translation_sw: Bali wanasema kama walivyo sema watu wa kwanza.
translation_en: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_sw: Walisema: Je! Tukisha kufa tukawa udongo na mifupa ndio tutafufuliwa?
translation_en: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

arabic_text: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Tuliahidiwa haya sisi na baba zetu zamani. Hayakuwa haya ila ni visa vya uwongo vya watu wa zamani.
translation_en: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."

arabic_text: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Ni ya nani ardhi na viliomo ndani yake, kama nyinyi mnajua?
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"

arabic_text: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Watasema: Ni vya Mwenyezi Mungu! Sema: Basi, je, hamkumbuki?
translation_en: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?"

arabic_text: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_sw: Sema: Ni nani Mola Mlezi wa mbingu saba na Mola Mlezi wa A'rshi Kuu?
translation_en: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"

arabic_text: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Watasema: Ni vya Mwenyezi Mungu. Sema: Basi je, hamwogopi?
translation_en: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"

arabic_text: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Ni nani mkononi mwake umo Ufalme wa kila kitu, naye ndiye anaye linda, wala hakilindwi asicho taka, kama mnajua?
translation_en: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"

arabic_text: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
translation_sw: Watasema: (Ufalme huo) ni wa Mwenyezi Mungu. Sema: Basi vipi mnadanganyika?
translation_en: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"

arabic_text: بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
translation_sw: Bali tumewaletea Haki, na kwa yakini hao ni waongo.
translation_en: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.

arabic_text: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍۢ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ ۚ إِذًۭا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu hana mwana yeyote, wala hanaye mungu mwengine. Inge kuwa hivyo basi kila mungu angeli chukua alivyo umba, na baadhi yao wangeli washinda wengine. Mwenyezi Mungu ameepukana na sifa wanazo msifu.
translation_en: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him].

arabic_text: عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Mjuzi wa siri na dhaahiri, na ametukuka juu ya hayo wanayo mshirikisha nayo.
translation_en: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].

arabic_text: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Ukinionyesha adhabu waliyo ahidiwa,
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,

arabic_text: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Mola wangu Mlezi! Usinijaalie katika watu madhaalimu hao.
translation_en: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."

arabic_text: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika Sisi ni waweza wa kukuonyeshsa tuliyo waahidi.
translation_en: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them.

arabic_text: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
translation_sw: Kinga maovu kwa kutenda yaliyo mema zaidi. Sisi tunajua wayasemayo.
translation_en: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.

arabic_text: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
translation_sw: Na sema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Najikinga kwako na wasiwasi wa mashet'ani.
translation_en: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,

arabic_text: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
translation_sw: Na najikinga kwako, Mola wangu Mlezi, wasinikaribie.
translation_en: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
translation_sw: Mpaka yanapo mfikia mmoja wao mauti, husema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nirudishe.
translation_en: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back

arabic_text: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَٰلِحًۭا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_sw: Ili nitende mema sasa badala ya yale niliyo yaacha. Wapi! Hii ni kauli aisemayo yeye tu. Na nyuma yao kipo kizuizi mpaka siku watapo fufuliwa.
translation_en: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_sw: Basi litapo pulizwa baragumu hapo hautakuwapo ujamaa baina yao siku hiyo, wala hawataulizana.
translation_en: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.

arabic_text: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
translation_sw: Ama wale ambao mizani zao zitakuwa nzito, hao ndio wenye kufanikiwa.
translation_en: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.

arabic_text: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
translation_sw: Na wale ambao mizani zao zitakuwa nyepesi, hao ndio walio zitia khasarani nafsi zao, na katika Jahannamu watadumu.
translation_en: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.

arabic_text: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
translation_sw: Moto utababua nyuso zao, nao watakuwa na nyuso zilizo kunjana.
translation_en: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Hazikuwa Aya zangu mkisomewa, na nyinyi mkizikanusha?
translation_en: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًۭا ضَآلِّينَ
translation_sw: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tulizidiwa na uovu wetu na tukawa watu tulio potea.
translation_en: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.

arabic_text: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tutoe humu Motoni. Na tufanyapo tena basi kweli sisi ni wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."

arabic_text: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
translation_sw: Atasema Mwenyezi Mungu: Tokomeeni humo, wala msinisemeze.
translation_en: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
translation_sw: Bila ya shaka lilikuwapo kundi katika waja wangu likisema: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tumeamini; basi tusamehe na uturehemu, nawe ndiwe Mbora wa wanao rehemu.
translation_en: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'

arabic_text: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini nyinyi mliwakejeli hata wakakusahaulisheni kunikumbuka, na mlikuwa mkiwacheka.
translation_en: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.

arabic_text: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Mimi leo nimewalipa kwa vile walivyo subiri. Bila ya shaka hao ndio wenye kufuzu.
translation_en: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."

arabic_text: قَٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
translation_sw: Atasema: Mlikaa muda gani katika ardhi kwa hisabu ya miaka?
translation_en: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
translation_sw: Watasema: Tulikaa siku moja au sehemu ya siku. Basi waulize wanao weka hisabu.
translation_en: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."

arabic_text: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Atasema: Nyinyi hamkukaa huko duniani ila kidogo, laiti ingeli kuwa mnajua.
translation_en: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.

arabic_text: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Mlidhani ya kwamba tulikuumbeni bure na ya kwamba nyinyi kwetu hamtarudishwa?
translation_en: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"

arabic_text: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
translation_sw: Ametukuka Mwenyezi Mungu, Mfalme wa Haki, hapana mungu ila Yeye, Mola Mlezi wa A'rshi Tukufu.
translation_en: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.

arabic_text: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na anaye muomba - pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu - mungu mwenginewe hana ushahidi wa hili; basi bila ya shaka hisabu yake iko kwa Mola wake Mlezi. Kwa hakika makafiri hawafanikiwi.
translation_en: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.

arabic_text: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
translation_sw: Nawe sema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Samehe na urehemu nawe ni Mbora wa wanao rehemu.
translation_en: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."

arabic_text: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهَا وَفَرَضْنَٰهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: HII NI SURA Tuliyo iteremsha na tukailazimisha; tukateremsha ndani yake Aya zilizo wazi ili mkumbuke.
translation_en: [This is] a surah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.

arabic_text: ٱلزَّانِيَةُ وَٱلزَّانِى فَٱجْلِدُوا۟ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٍۢ مِّنْهُمَا مِا۟ئَةَ جَلْدَةٍۢ ۖ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌۭ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۖ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Mzinifu mwanamke na mzinifu mwanamume, mtandikeni kila mmoja katika wao bakora mia. Wala isikushikeni huruma kwa ajili yao katika hukumu ya Mwenyezi Mungu, ikiwa nyinyi mnamuamini Mwenyezi Mungu na Siku ya Mwisho. Na lishuhudie adhabu yao kundi la Waumini.
translation_en: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion of Allah, if you should believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.

arabic_text: ٱلزَّانِى لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةًۭ وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌۭ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Mwanamume mzinifu hamwoi ila mwanamke mzinifu au mwanamke mshirikina. Na mwanamke mzinifu haolewi ila na mwanamume mzinifu au mshirikina. Na hayo yameharimishwa kwa Waumini.
translation_en: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that has been made unlawful to the believers.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَٰنِينَ جَلْدَةًۭ وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَهَٰدَةً أَبَدًۭا ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanao wasingizia wanawake mahashumu, kisha wasilete mashahidi wane, basi watandikeni bakora thamanini, na msiwakubalie ushahidi wao tena. Na hao ndio wapotovu.
translation_en: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,

arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa wale walio tubu baada ya hayo na wakatengenea; kwani bila ya shaka Mwenyezi Mungu ni Msamehevu, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na wale wanao wasingizia wake zao na hawana mashahidi ila nafsi zao, basi ushahidi wa mmoja wao utakuwa kushuhudilia mara nne kwa kiapo cha Mwenyezi Mungu ya kwamba hakika yeye ni katika wasema kweli.
translation_en: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allah that indeed, he is of the truthful.

arabic_text: وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
translation_sw: Na mara ya tano kwamba laana ya Mwenyezi Mungu iwe juu yake ikiwa ni miongoni mwa waongo.
translation_en: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allah be upon him if he should be among the liars.

arabic_text: وَيَدْرَؤُا۟ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
translation_sw: Na mke itamwondokea adhabu kwa kutoa shahada mara nne kwa kiapo cha Mwenyezi Mungu ya kwamba huyu mume ni miongoni mwa waongo.
translation_en: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allah that indeed, he is of the liars.

arabic_text: وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na mara ya tano ya kwamba ghadhabu ya Mwenyezi Mungu iwe juu yake kama mumewe yu miongoni mwa wanao sema kweli.
translation_en: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he was of the truthful.

arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ
translation_sw: Na lau kuwa si fadhila ya Mwenyezi Mungu juu yenu na rehema yake, na ya kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mpokeaji toba....
translation_en: And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy... and because Allah is Accepting of repentance and Wise.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو بِٱلْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌۭ مِّنكُمْ ۚ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّۭا لَّكُم ۖ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۚ لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُم مَّا ٱكْتَسَبَ مِنَ ٱلْإِثْمِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ كِبْرَهُۥ مِنْهُمْ لَهُۥ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika wale walio leta uwongo ni kundi miongoni mwenu. Msifikiri ni shari kwenu, bali hiyo ni kheri kwenu. Kila mtu katika wao atapata aliyo yachuma katika madhambi. Na yule aliyejitwika sehemu yake kubwa miongoni mwao, atapata adhabu kubwa.
translation_en: Indeed, those who came with falsehood are a group among you. Do not think it bad for you; rather it is good for you. For every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof - for him is a great punishment.

arabic_text: لَّوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتُ بِأَنفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًۭا وَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَآ إِفْكٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Kwa nini mlipo sikia khabari hii, wanaume Waumini na wanawake Waumini hawakuwadhania wenzao mema, na kusema: Huu ni uzushi dhaahiri?
translation_en: Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of one another and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?

arabic_text: لَّوْلَا جَآءُو عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ ۚ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلشُّهَدَآءِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْكَٰذِبُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa nini hawakuleta mashahidi wane? Na ilivyo kuwa hawakuleta mashahidi wane basi hao mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni waongo.
translation_en: Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of Allah, who are the liars.

arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِى مَآ أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
translation_sw: Na lau kuwa si fadhila ya Mwenyezi Mungu juu yenu na rehema yake katika dunia na Akhera, bila ya shaka ingeli kupateni adhabu kubwa kwa sababu ya yale mliyo jiingiza.
translation_en: And if it had not been for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment

arabic_text: إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُۥ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُۥ هَيِّنًۭا وَهُوَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Mlipo yapokea kwa ndimi zenu na mkasema kwa vinywa vyenu msiyo yajua, na mlifikiri ni jambo dogo, kumbe mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni kubwa.
translation_en: When you received it with your tongues and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of Allah, tremendous.

arabic_text: وَلَوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَٰذَا سُبْحَٰنَكَ هَٰذَا بُهْتَٰنٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na kwa nini mlipo yasikia msiseme: Haitufalii kuzungumza haya. Subhanak Umetakasika! Huu ni uzushi mkubwa!
translation_en: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, "It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O Allah]; this is a great slander"?

arabic_text: يَعِظُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُوا۟ لِمِثْلِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu anakuonyeni msirejee tena kufanya kama haya kabisa, ikiwa nyinyi ni Waumini!
translation_en: Allah warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.

arabic_text: وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu anakubainisheni Aya. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mjuzi Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: And Allah makes clear to you the verses, and Allah is Knowing and Wise.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةُ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika wale wanao penda uenee uchafu kwa walio amini, watapata adhabu chungu katika dunia na Akhera. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anajua na nyinyi hamjui.
translation_en: Indeed, those who like that immorality should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And Allah knows and you do not know.

arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na lau kuwa si fadhila ya Mwenyezi Mungu juu yenu na rehema yake, na kuwa hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mpole, Mwenye kurehemu....
translation_en: And if it had not been for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy... and because Allah is Kind and Merciful.

arabic_text: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًۭا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزَكِّى مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Msizifuate nyayo za Shet'ani. Na atakaye fuata nyayo za Shet'ani basi yeye huamrisha machafu na maovu. Na lau kuwa si fadhila ya Mwenyezi Mungu na rehema yake juu yenu, asingeli takasika miongoni mwenu kabisa hata mmoja. Lakini Mwenyezi Mungu humtakasa amtakaye, na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusikia, Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allah purifies whom He wills, and Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

arabic_text: وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟ ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
translation_sw: Na wale katika nyinyi wenye fadhila na wasaa wasiape kutowapa jamaa zao na masikini na walio hama kwa Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na wasamehe, na waachilie mbali. Je! Nyinyi hampendi Mwenyezi Mungu akusameheni? Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusamehe Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allah, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتِ ٱلْغَٰفِلَٰتِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ لُعِنُوا۟ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika wanao wasingizia wanawake, wanao jihishimu, walio ghafilika, Waumini, wamelaaniwa duniani na Akhera, nao watapata adhabu kubwa.
translation_en: Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment

arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Siku ambayo zitawashuhudia ndimi zao na mikono yao na miguu yao kwa waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda.
translation_en: On a Day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.

arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يُوَفِّيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo Mwenyezi Mungu atawapa sawa sawa malipo yao ya haki, na watajua kwamba hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Haki Iliyo Wazi.
translation_en: That Day, Allah will pay them in full their deserved recompense, and they will know that it is Allah who is the perfect in justice.

arabic_text: ٱلْخَبِيثَٰتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَٱلْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَٰتِ ۖ وَٱلطَّيِّبَٰتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَٱلطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَٰتِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ ۖ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Wanawake waovu ni wa wanaume waovu, na wanaume waovu ni wa wanawake waovu. Na wanawake wema ni wa wanaume wema, na wanaume wema ni wa wanawake wema. Hao wameepushwa na hayo wanayo yasema; wao watapata msamaha na riziki ya ukarimu.
translation_en: Evil words are for evil men, and evil men are [subjected] to evil words. And good words are for good men, and good men are [an object] of good words. Those [good people] are declared innocent of what the slanderers say. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَأْنِسُوا۟ وَتُسَلِّمُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Msiingie nyumba zisio nyumba zenu mpaka mwombe ruhusa, na mwatolee salamu wenyewe. Hayo ni bora kwenu mpate kukumbuka.
translation_en: O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded.

arabic_text: فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا۟ فِيهَآ أَحَدًۭا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّىٰ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِن قِيلَ لَكُمُ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟ ۖ هُوَ أَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na msip o mkuta mtu humo basi msiingie mpaka mruhusiwe. Na mkiambiwa: Rudini! Basi rudini. Hivi ni usafi zaidi kwenu. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anajua mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, "Go back," then go back; it is purer for you. And Allah is Knowing of what you do.

arabic_text: لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍۢ فِيهَا مَتَٰعٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ
translation_sw: Si vibaya kwenu kuingia nyumba zisio kaliwa ambazo ndani yake yamo manufaa yenu. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anajua mnayo yadhihirisha na mnayo yaficha.
translation_en: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience for you. And Allah knows what you reveal and what you conceal.

arabic_text: قُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَغُضُّوا۟ مِنْ أَبْصَٰرِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُوا۟ فُرُوجَهُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَزْكَىٰ لَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
translation_sw: Waambie Waumini wanaume wainamishe macho yao, na wazilinde tupu zao. Hili ni takaso bora kwao. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anazo khabari za wanayo yafanya.
translation_en: Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with what they do.

arabic_text: وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَٰرِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّ ۖ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُنَّ أَوِ ٱلتَّٰبِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُو۟لِى ٱلْإِرْبَةِ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ أَوِ ٱلطِّفْلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَوْرَٰتِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۖ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّ ۚ وَتُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
translation_sw: Na waambie Waumini wanawake wainamishe macho yao, na wazilinde tupu zao, wala wasionyeshe uzuri wao isipo kuwa unao dhihirika. Na waangushe shungi zao juu ya vifua vyao, wala wasionyeshe uzuri wao ila kwa waume zao, au baba zao, au baba wa waume zao, au watoto wao, au watoto wa waume zao, au kaka zao, au wana wa kaka zao, au wana wa dada zao, au wanawake wenzao, au iliyo wamiliki mikono yao ya kuume, au wafwasi wanaume wasio na matamanio, au watoto ambao hawajajua mambo yaliyo khusu uke. Wala wasipige chini miguu yao ili yajuulikane mapambo waliyo yaficha. Na tubuni nyote kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, enyi Waumini, ili mpate kufanikiwa.
translation_en: And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which [necessarily] appears thereof and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess, or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allah in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.

arabic_text: وَأَنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْأَيَٰمَىٰ مِنكُمْ وَٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَآئِكُمْ ۚ إِن يَكُونُوا۟ فُقَرَآءَ يُغْنِهِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na waozeni wajane miongoni mwenu na wema katika watumwa wenu na wajakazi wenu. Wakiwa mafakiri Mwenyezi Mungu atawatajirisha kwa fadhila yake. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye wasaa Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they should be poor, Allah will enrich them from His bounty, and Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

arabic_text: وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتَّىٰ يُغْنِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبْتَغُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوهُمْ إِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًۭا ۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مِّن مَّالِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۚ وَلَا تُكْرِهُوا۟ فَتَيَٰتِكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْبِغَآءِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًۭا لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ عَرَضَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَمَن يُكْرِههُّنَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ إِكْرَٰهِهِنَّ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na wajizuilie na machafu wale wasio pata cha kuolea, mpaka Mwenyezi Mungu awatajirishe kwa fadhila yake. Na wanao taka kuandikiwa uhuru katika wale ambao mikono yenu ya kulia imewamiliki, basi waandikieni kama mkiona wema kwao. Na wapeni katika mali ya Mwenyezi Mungu aliyo kupeni. Wala msiwashurutishe vijakazi vyenu kufanya zina kwa ajili ya kutafuta pato la maisha ya dunia, ilhali wao wanataka kujihishimu. Na atakaye walazimisha basi Mwenyezi Mungu baada ya kulazimishwa kwao huko, atawasamehe, kwani Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: But let them who find not [the means for] marriage abstain [from sexual relations] until Allah enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek a contract [for eventual emancipation] from among whom your right hands possess - then make a contract with them if you know there is within them goodness and give them from the wealth of Allah which He has given you. And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, to seek [thereby] the temporary interests of worldly life. And if someone should compel them, then indeed, Allah is [to them], after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتٍۢ مُّبَيِّنَٰتٍۢ وَمَثَلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةًۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_sw: Na kwa yakini tumekuteremshieni Ishara zilizo wazi na mifano kutokana na walio tangulia kabla yenu na mawaidha kwa wachamngu.
translation_en: And We have certainly sent down to you distinct verses and examples from those who passed on before you and an admonition for those who fear Allah.

arabic_text: ۞ ٱللَّهُ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِۦ كَمِشْكَوٰةٍۢ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ ۖ ٱلْمِصْبَاحُ فِى زُجَاجَةٍ ۖ ٱلزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌۭ دُرِّىٌّۭ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۢ زَيْتُونَةٍۢ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍۢ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍۢ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِىٓءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌۭ ۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٍۢ ۗ يَهْدِى ٱللَّهُ لِنُورِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلَ لِلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ni Nuru ya Mbingu na Ardhi. Mfano wa Nuru yake ni kama shubaka lenye kuwekwa ndani yake taa. Taa ile imo katika tungi. Tungi lile ni kama nyota inayo meremeta, inayo washwa kwa mafuta yanayo toka katika mti ulio barikiwa, mzaituni. Si wa mashariki wala magharibi. Yanakaribia mafuta yake kung'aa wenyewe ingawa moto haujayagusa - Nuru juu ya Nuru. Mwenyezi Mungu humwongoa kwenye Nuru yake amtakaye. Na Mwenyezi Mungu huwapigia watu mifano. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kujua kila kitu.
translation_en: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche within which is a lamp, the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allah guides to His light whom He wills. And Allah presents examples for the people, and Allah is Knowing of all things.

arabic_text: فِى بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ ٱللَّهُ أَن تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسْمُهُۥ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ فِيهَا بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلْءَاصَالِ
translation_sw: Katika Nyumba ambazo Mwenyezi Mungu ameamrisha zitukuzwe, na humo litajwe jina lake, wanamtakasa humo asubuhi na jioni
translation_en: [Such niches are] in mosques which Allah has ordered to be raised and that His name be mentioned therein; exalting Him within them in the morning and the evenings

arabic_text: رِجَالٌۭ لَّا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَٰرَةٌۭ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءِ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۙ يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
translation_sw: Watu ambao biashara wala kuuza hakuwashughulishi na kumdhukuru Mwenyezi Mungu, na kushika Sala, na kutoa Zaka. Wanaikhofu Siku ambayo nyoyo na macho yatageuka.
translation_en: [Are] men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of Allah and performance of prayer and giving of zakah. They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will [fearfully] turn about -

arabic_text: لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
translation_sw: Ili Mwenyezi Mungu awalipe bora ya waliyo yatenda, na awazidishie katika fadhila zake. Na Mwenyezi Mungu humruzuku amtakaye bila ya hisabu.
translation_en: That Allah may reward them [according to] the best of what they did and increase them from His bounty. And Allah gives provision to whom He wills without account.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ كَسَرَابٍۭ بِقِيعَةٍۢ يَحْسَبُهُ ٱلظَّمْـَٔانُ مَآءً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَهُۥ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْـًۭٔا وَوَجَدَ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ فَوَفَّىٰهُ حِسَابَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru vitendo vyao ni kama sarabi (mazigazi) uwandani. Mwenye kiu huyadhania ni maji. Hata akiyaendea hapati chochote. Na atamkuta Mwenyezi Mungu hapo naye amlipe hisabu yake sawa sawa. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwepesi wa kuhisabu.
translation_en: But those who disbelieved - their deeds are like a mirage in a lowland which a thirsty one thinks is water until, when he comes to it, he finds it is nothing but finds Allah before Him, and He will pay him in full his due; and Allah is swift in account.

arabic_text: أَوْ كَظُلُمَٰتٍۢ فِى بَحْرٍۢ لُّجِّىٍّۢ يَغْشَىٰهُ مَوْجٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ مَوْجٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ سَحَابٌۭ ۚ ظُلُمَٰتٌۢ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ إِذَآ أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُۥ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَىٰهَا ۗ وَمَن لَّمْ يَجْعَلِ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ نُورًۭا فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن نُّورٍ
translation_sw: Au ni kama giza katika bahari kuu, iliyo funikwa na mawimbi juu ya mawimbi, na juu yake yapo mawingu. Giza juu ya giza. Akiutoa mtu mkono wake anakaribia asiuone. Na ambaye Mwenyezi Mungu hakumjaalia kuwa na nuru hawi na nuru.
translation_en: Or [they are] like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, upon which are waves, over which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand [therein], he can hardly see it. And he to whom Allah has not granted light - for him there is no light.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلطَّيْرُ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ ۖ كُلٌّۭ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُۥ وَتَسْبِيحَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Huoni kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu vinamtakasa vilivyomo katika mbingu na ardhi, na ndege wakikunjua mbawa zao? Kila mmoja amekwisha jua Sala yake na namna ya kumtakasa kwake. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kuyajua wayatendayo.
translation_en: Do you not see that Allah is exalted by whomever is within the heavens and the earth and [by] the birds with wings spread [in flight]? Each [of them] has known his [means of] prayer and exalting [Him], and Allah is Knowing of what they do.

arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Na ni wa Mwenyezi Mungu ufalme wa mbingu na ardhi, na kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ndio marejeo ya wote.
translation_en: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah is the destination.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزْجِى سَحَابًۭا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ رُكَامًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَٰلِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن جِبَالٍۢ فِيهَا مِنۢ بَرَدٍۢ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُۥ عَن مَّن يَشَآءُ ۖ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِۦ يَذْهَبُ بِٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
translation_sw: Je! Huoni ya kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu huyasukuma mawingu, kisha huyaambatisha, kisha huyafanya mirundi? Basi utaona mvua ikitoka kati yake. Na huteremsha kutoka juu kwenye milima ya mawingu mvua ya mawe, akamsibu nayo amtakaye na akamuepusha nayo amtakaye. Hukurubia mmetuko wa umeme wake kupofua macho.
translation_en: Do you not see that Allah drives clouds? Then He brings them together, then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightening almost takes away the eyesight.

arabic_text: يُقَلِّبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu hubadilisha usiku na mchana. Hakika katika hayo yapo mazingatio kwa wenye kuona.
translation_en: Allah alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٍۢ مِّن مَّآءٍۢ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰٓ أَرْبَعٍۢ ۚ يَخْلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu ameumba kila kinyama kutokana na maji. Wengine katika wao huenda kwa matumbo yao, na wengine huenda kwa miguu miwili, na wengine huenda kwa miguu mine. Mwenyezi Mungu huumba ayatakayo. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Muweza wa kila kitu.
translation_en: Allah has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allah creates what He wills. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

arabic_text: لَّقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَٰتٍۢ مُّبَيِّنَٰتٍۢ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwa yakini tumeteremsha Ishara zinazo bainisha. Na Mwenyezi Mungu hummwongoa amtakaye kwenye Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allah guides whom He wills to a straight path.

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanasema: Tumemuamini Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume, na tumet'ii. Kisha kikundi katika hao hugeuka baada ya hayo. Wala hao si wenye kuamini.
translation_en: But the hypocrites say, "We have believed in Allah and in the Messenger, and we obey"; then a party of them turns away after that. And those are not believers.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا دُعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo itwa kumuendea Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake ili ahukumu baina yao, kipo kikundi katika wao kinakataa.
translation_en: And when they are called to [the words of] Allah and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside [in refusal].

arabic_text: وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ يَأْتُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na ikiwa haki ni yao, wanamjia kwa kut'ii.
translation_en: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience.

arabic_text: أَفِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ٱرْتَابُوٓا۟ أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ۚ بَلْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Wana maradhi katika nyoyo zao, au wanaona shaka, au wanaogopa ya kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake watawadhulumu? Bali hao ndio madhaalimu.
translation_en: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allah will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
translation_sw: Haiwi kauli ya Waumini wanapo itwa kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake ili ahukumu baina yao, ila ni kusema: Tumesikia, na tumet'ii! Na hao ndio wenye kufanikiwa.
translation_en: The only statement of the [true] believers when they are called to Allah and His Messenger to judge between them is that they say, "We hear and we obey." And those are the successful.

arabic_text: وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَيَخْشَ ٱللَّهَ وَيَتَّقْهِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
translation_sw: Na wenye kumt'ii Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake, na wakamwogopa Mwenyezi Mungu na wakamcha, basi hao ndio wenye kufuzu.
translation_en: And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger and fears Allah and is conscious of Him - it is those who are the attainers.

arabic_text: ۞ وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِنْ أَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّ ۖ قُل لَّا تُقْسِمُوا۟ ۖ طَاعَةٌۭ مَّعْرُوفَةٌ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanaapa kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ukomo wa kiapo chao ya kwamba ukiwaamrisha kwa yakini watatoka. Sema: Msiape! Ut'iifu unajuulikana. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anazo khabari za mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths that if you ordered them, they would go forth [in Allah 's cause]. Say, "Do not swear. [Such] obedience is known. Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with that which you do."

arabic_text: قُلْ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُم مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوا۟ ۚ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Sema: Mt'iini Mwenyezi Mungu, na mt'iini Mtume. Na mkigeuka, basi yaliyo juu yake ni aliyo bebeshwa, na yaliyo juu yenu ni mliyo bebshwa nyinyi. Na mkimt'ii yeye mtaongoka. Na hapana juu ya Mtume ila kufikisha Ujumbe wazi wazi.
translation_en: Say, "Obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be [rightly] guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the [responsibility for] clear notification."

arabic_text: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمَا ٱسْتَخْلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱرْتَضَىٰ لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًۭا ۚ يَعْبُدُونَنِى لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِى شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu amewaahidi wale walio amini miongoni mwenu na wakatenda mema, ya kwamba atawafanya makhalifa katika ardhi kama alivyo wafanya makhalifa wa kabla yao, na kwa yakini atawasimamishia Dini yao aliyo wapendelea, na atawabadilishia amani baada ya khofu yao. Wawe wananiabudu Mimi, wala wasinishirikishe na chochote. Na watao kufuru baada ya hayo, basi hao ndio wapotovu.
translation_en: Allah has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.

arabic_text: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na shikeni Sala, na toeni Zaka, na mt'iini Mtume, ili mpate kurehemewa.
translation_en: And establish prayer and give zakah and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.

arabic_text: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Msiwadhanie walio kufuru kwamba watashinda katika nchi. Na makaazi yao ni Motoni, na hakika ni maovu kweli marejeo yao.
translation_en: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allah] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِيَسْتَـْٔذِنكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا۟ ٱلْحُلُمَ مِنكُمْ ثَلَٰثَ مَرَّٰتٍۢ ۚ مِّن قَبْلِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنۢ بَعْدِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلْعِشَآءِ ۚ ثَلَٰثُ عَوْرَٰتٍۢ لَّكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا عَلَيْهِمْ جُنَاحٌۢ بَعْدَهُنَّ ۚ طَوَّٰفُونَ عَلَيْكُم بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Nawakutakeni idhini iliyo wamiliki mikono yenu ya kulia na walio bado kubaalighi miongoni mwenu mara tatu - kabla ya Sala ya alfajiri, na wakati mnapo vua nguo zenu adhuhuri, na baada ya Sala ya isha. Hizi ni nyakati tatu za faragha kwenu. Si vibaya kwenu wala kwao baada ya nyakati hizi, kuzungukiana nyinyi kwa nyinyi. Hivyo ndivyo Mwenyezi Mungu anavyo kuelezeni Aya zake, na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mjuzi Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allah make clear to you the verses; and Allah is Knowing and Wise.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا بَلَغَ ٱلْأَطْفَٰلُ مِنكُمُ ٱلْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَـْٔذِنُوا۟ كَمَا ٱسْتَـْٔذَنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na watoto wanapo fikilia umri wa kubaalighi basi nawatake ruhusa, kama walivyo taka ruhusa wa kabla yao. Hivyo ndivyo anavyo kubainishieni Mwenyezi Mungu Aya zake, na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mjuzi Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does Allah make clear to you His verses; and Allah is Knowing and Wise.

arabic_text: وَٱلْقَوَٰعِدُ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ٱلَّٰتِى لَا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحًۭا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ أَن يَضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجَٰتٍۭ بِزِينَةٍۢ ۖ وَأَن يَسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّهُنَّ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na wanawake wazee wasio taraji kuolewa, si vibaya kwao kupunguza nguo zao, bila ya kujishaua kwa mapambo. Na wakijihishimu ni bora kwao. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusikia, Mwenye kujua.
