translation_en: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments [but] not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain [from that] is better for them. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

arabic_text: لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَن تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ ءَابَآئِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ إِخْوَٰنِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَعْمَٰمِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخْوَٰلِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ خَٰلَٰتِكُمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُۥٓ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَأْكُلُوا۟ جَمِيعًا أَوْ أَشْتَاتًۭا ۚ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُم بُيُوتًۭا فَسَلِّمُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ تَحِيَّةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَٰرَكَةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Si vibaya kwa kipofu, wala si vibaya kwa kiguru, wala si vibaya kwa mgonjwa, wala kwenu nyinyi, mkila katika nyumba zenu, au nyumba za baba zenu, au nyumba za mama zenu, au nyumba za kaka zenu, au nyumba za dada zenu, au nyumba za ami zenu, au nyumba za shangazi zenu, au nyumba za wajomba zenu, au nyumba za dada wa mama zenu, au za mlio washikia funguo zao, au rafiki yenu. Si vibaya kwenu mkila pamoja au mbali mbali. Na mkiingia katika nyumba, toleaneni salamu, kuwa ni maamkio yanayo toka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, yenye baraka na mema. Hivyo ndivyo Mwenyezi Mungu anavyo kubainishieni Aya zake mpate kuelewa.
translation_en: There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace upon each other - a greeting from Allah, blessed and good. Thus does Allah make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَإِذَا كَانُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ جَامِعٍۢ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُوهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُونَكَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ فَإِذَا ٱسْتَـْٔذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika Waumini wa kweli ni walio muamini Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake; na wanapo kuwa pamoja naye kwa jambo la kuwakhusu wote hawaondoki mpaka wamtake ruhusa. Kwa hakika wale wanao kuomba ruhusa, hao ndio wanao muamini Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake. Na wakikuomba ruhusa kwa baadhi ya kazi zao, mruhusu umtakaye miongoni mwao, uwaombee msamaha kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemmu.
translation_en: The believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muhammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allah and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission for something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: لَّا تَجْعَلُوا۟ دُعَآءَ ٱلرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَآءِ بَعْضِكُم بَعْضًۭا ۚ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمْ لِوَاذًۭا ۚ فَلْيَحْذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِۦٓ أَن تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ أَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_sw: Msifanye wito wa Mtume baina yenu kama wito wa nyinyi kwa nyinyi. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anawajua miongoni mwenu wanao ondoka kwa uficho. Basi nawatahadhari wanao khalifu amri yake, usije ukawapata msiba au ikawapata adhabu chungu.
translation_en: Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allah knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from the Prophet's order, lest fitnah strike them or a painful punishment.

arabic_text: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ
translation_sw: Jueni kuwa hakika ni vya Mwenyezi Mungu vilivyomo mbinguni na ardhini. Hakika Yeye anajua mlio nayo. Na siku mtapo rudishwa kwake atawaeleza waliyo yafanya. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mjuzi wa kila kitu.
translation_en: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Already He knows that upon which you [stand] and [knows] the Day when they will be returned to Him and He will inform them of what they have done. And Allah is Knowing of all things.

arabic_text: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا
translation_sw: Ametukuka aliye teremsha Furqani kwa mja wake, ili awe mwonyaji kwa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًۭا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌۭ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقْدِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Ambaye ni wake ufalme wa mbingu na ardhi, wala hakuwa na mwana, wala hakuwa na mshirika katika ufalme, na akaumba kila kitu na akakikadiria kwa kipimo.
translation_en: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.

arabic_text: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًۭا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًۭا وَلَا حَيَوٰةًۭ وَلَا نُشُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na wamechukua badala yake miungu ambayo haiumbi chochote, bali hiyo inaumbwa, haijimilikii nafsi zao madhara wala manufaa, wala haimiliki mauti, wala uhai, wala kufufuka.
translation_en: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْمًۭا وَزُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na wamesema walio kufuru: Haya si chochote ila ni uzushi alio uzua, na wamemsaidia kwa haya watu wengine! Hakika hawa wamekuja na dhulma na uwongo.
translation_en: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur'an] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ٱكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Na wakasema: Hivi ni visa vya watu wa kale alivyo viandikisha, anavyo somewa asubuhi na jioni.
translation_en: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."

arabic_text: قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِى يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Sema: Ameyateremsha haya ajuaye siri za katika mbingu na ardhi. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kusamehe Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِى فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۙ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌۭ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيرًا
translation_sw: Na wakasema: Ana nini Mtume huyu? Anakula chakula, na anatembea masokoni! Mbona hakuteremshiwa Malaika akawa mwonyaji pamoja naye?
translation_en: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?

arabic_text: أَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌۭ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًۭا مَّسْحُورًا
translation_sw: Au akaangushiwa khazina juu yake, au akawa na bustani ale katika hiyo? Wakasema madhaalimu: Nyinyi hamumfuati ila mtu aliye rogwa.
translation_en: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."

arabic_text: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Tazama jinsi wanavyo kupigia mifano. Basi wamepotea, wala hawataiweza Njia.
translation_en: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.

arabic_text: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًۭا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًۢا
translation_sw: Ametukuka ambaye akitaka atakujaalia yaliyo bora kuliko hayo, nayo ni mabustani yapitayo mito kati yao, na atakujaalia majumba ya fakhari.
translation_en: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.

arabic_text: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
translation_sw: Bali wanaikanusha Saa (ya Kiyama). Na Sisi tumemuandalia Moto mkali kabisa huyo mwenye kuikanusha Saa..
translation_en: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.

arabic_text: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًۭا وَزَفِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Ule Moto ukiwaona tangu mahali mbali wao watasikia hasira yake na mngurumo wake.
translation_en: When the Hellfire sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.

arabic_text: وَإِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مَكَانًۭا ضَيِّقًۭا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا۟ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na watakapo tupwa humo mahali dhiki, hali wamefungwa, wataomba wafe.
translation_en: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.

arabic_text: لَّا تَدْعُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًۭا وَٰحِدًۭا وَٱدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا كَثِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Msiombe kufa mara moja tu, bali mfe mara nyingi!
translation_en: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."

arabic_text: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَمَصِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Sema: Je! Haya ni bora au Pepo ya milele, ambayo wameahidiwa wachamngu, iwe kwao malipo na marejeo?
translation_en: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.

arabic_text: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَٰلِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًۭا مَّسْـُٔولًۭا
translation_sw: Watayapata humo wayatakayo daima dawamu. Hii ni ahadi juu ya Mola wako Mlezi, inayo ombwa.
translation_en: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا۟ ٱلسَّبِيلَ
translation_sw: Na siku atakapo wakusanya wao na hao wanao waabudu, na akasema: Je! Ni nyinyi mlio wapoteza waja wangu hawa, au wao wenyewe walipotea njia?
translation_en: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allah and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِى لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بُورًۭا
translation_sw: Watasema: Subhanak, Umetakasika na upungufu! Haikutupasia sisi kuchukulia walinzi badala yako, lakini Wewe uliwastarehesha wao na baba zao hata wakasahau kukumbuka, na wakawa watu walio angamia.
translation_en: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."

arabic_text: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًۭا وَلَا نَصْرًۭا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًۭا كَبِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Basi walikukanusheni kwa mliyo yasema. Kwa hivyo hamwezi kujiondolea wala kujisaidia. Na atakaye dhulumu miongoni mwenu tutamwonjesha adhabu kubwa.
translation_en: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍۢ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na hatukuwatuma kabla yako Mitume wowote ila kwa hakika na yakini walikuwa wakila chakula, na wakenda masokoni. Na tumewajaalia baadhi yenu wawe ni majaribio kwa wengine; je! Mtasubiri? Na Mola wako Mlezi ni Mwenye kuona.
translation_en: And We did not send before you, [O Muhammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.

arabic_text: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا
translation_sw: NA WALISEMA wale wasio taraji kukutana nasi: Mbona sisi hatuteremshiwi Malaika au hatumwoni Mola wetu Mlezi? Kwa yakini hawa wamejiona bora nafsi zao, na wamepanda kichwa vikubwa mno!
translation_en: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًۭا مَّحْجُورًۭا
translation_sw: Siku watakayo waona Malaika haitakuwa furaha siku hiyo kwa wakosefu. Na watasema: Mungu apishe mbali!
translation_en: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."

arabic_text: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍۢ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هَبَآءًۭ مَّنثُورًا
translation_sw: Na tutayaendea yale waliyo yatenda katika vitendo vyao, tuvifanye kama mavumbi yaliyo tawanyika.
translation_en: And We will regard what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.

arabic_text: أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌۭ مُّسْتَقَرًّۭا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Watu wa Peponi siku hiyo watakuwa katika makaazi bora na mahali penye starehe nzuri.
translation_en: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
translation_sw: Na siku zitapo funguka mbingu kwa mawingu, na wateremshwe Malaika kwa wingi,
translation_en: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.

arabic_text: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Ufalme wa haki siku hiyo utakuwa wa Arrahman, Mwingi wa Rehema, na itakuwa siku ngumu kwa makafiri.
translation_en: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Na siku ambayo mwenye kudhulumu atajiuma mikono yake, na huku anasema: Laiti ningeli shika njia pamoja na Mtume!
translation_en: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.

arabic_text: يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Ee Ole wangu! Laiti nisingeli mfanya fulani kuwa rafiki!
translation_en: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.

arabic_text: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ خَذُولًۭا
translation_sw: Amenipoteza, nikaacha Ukumbusho, baada ya kwisha nijia, na kweli Shet'ani ni khaini kwa mwanaadamu.
translation_en: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na Mtume alikuwa akisema: Ee Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika watu wangu wameifanya hii Qur'ani ni kihame.
translation_en: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."

arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًۭا وَنَصِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na vivi hivi tumemfanyia kila Nabii adui miongoni mwa wakosefu, na Mola wako Mlezi anatosha kuwa Mwenye kuongoa na Mwenye kunusuru.
translation_en: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَٰهُ تَرْتِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Na wakasema walio kufuru: Kwa nini hakuteremshiwa Qur'ani kwa jumla moja? Hayo ni hivyo ili tuuthibitishe moyo wako, na ndio tumeisoma kwa mafungu.
translation_en: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.

arabic_text: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
translation_sw: Wala hawatakuletea mfano wowote, ila na Sisi tutakuletea (jawabu) kwa haki, na tafsiri iliyo bora.
translation_en: And they do not come to you with an argument except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Wale ambao watakao kusanywa na kubururwa kifudifudi mpaka kwenye Jahannamu, hao watakuwa na mahali pabaya, ndio wenye kuipotea sana njia.
translation_en: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na hakika tulimpa Musa Kitabu na tukamweka pamoja naye nduguye, Harun, kuwa waziri.
translation_en: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.

arabic_text: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Tukawaambia: Nendeni kwa watu walio kanusha Ishara zetu. Basi tukawateketeza kabisa.
translation_en: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.

arabic_text: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Na watu wa Nuhu, walipo wakanusha Mitume, tuliwazamisha, na tukawafanya ni Ishara kwa watu. Na tumewaandalia wenye kudhulumu adhabu chungu.
translation_en: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.

arabic_text: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na tuliwaangamiza kina A'di na Thamudi na watu wa Rass na vizazi vingi vilivyo kuwa kati yao.
translation_en: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud and the companions of the well and many generations between them.

arabic_text: وَكُلًّۭا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na wote tuliwapigia mifano, na wote tuliwaangamiza kabisa kabisa.
translation_en: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na kwa yakini wao wanafika kwenye nchi ilio teremshiwa mvua mbaya. Basi, je, hawakuwa wakiiona? Bali walikuwa hawataraji kufufuliwa.
translation_en: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
translation_sw: Na wanapo kuona hawakuchukulii ila ni mzaha tu, na (wanasema): Ati ndiye huyu Mwenyezi Mungu aliye mtuma kuwa Mtume?
translation_en: And when they see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?

arabic_text: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
translation_sw: Kwa hakika alikuwa karibu kutupoteza tuiache miungu yetu, ingeli kuwa hatukushikamana nayo kwa kuvumilia. Bado watakuja jua, watakapo iona adhabu, ni nani aliye potea njia.
translation_en: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.

arabic_text: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
translation_sw: Je! Umemwona aliye yafanya matamanio yake kuwa ndio mungu wake? Basi je, wewe utakuwa ni wakili wake?
translation_en: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?

arabic_text: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
translation_sw: Au wewe unadhani kwamba wengi wao wanasikia au wanaelewa? Hao hawakuwa ila ni kama nyama hoa tu, bali wao wamepotea zaidi njia.
translation_en: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًۭا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Je! Huoni jinsi Mola wako Mlezi anavyo kitandaza kivuli. Na angeli taka angeli kifanya kikatulia tu. Kisha tumelifanya jua kuwa ni kiongozi wake.
translation_en: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Kisha tunakivutia kwetu kidogo kidogo.
translation_en: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًۭا
translation_sw: Naye ndiye aliye kufanyieni usiku kuwa ni vazi, na usingizi kuwa mapumziko, na akakufanyieni mchana ni kufufuka.
translation_en: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ طَهُورًۭا
translation_sw: Naye ndiye anaye zituma pepo kuwa bishara njema kabla ya rehema yake, na tunayateremsha kutoka mbinguni maji safi.
translation_en: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water

arabic_text: لِّنُحْۦِىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Ili kwa hayo tuihuishe nchi iliyo kufa, na tuwanyweshe wanyama na watu wengi tulio waumba.
translation_en: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na kwa yakini tumeisarifu kati yao wapate kukumbuka. Lakini watu wengi wanakataa ila kukufuru.
translation_en: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍۢ نَّذِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na tungeli taka tungeli peleka katika kila mji Mwonyaji.
translation_en: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.

arabic_text: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًۭا كَبِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Basi usiwat'ii makafiri. Na pambana nao kwayo kwa Jihadi kubwa.
translation_en: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with the Qur'an a great striving.

arabic_text: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌۭ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًۭا وَحِجْرًۭا مَّحْجُورًۭا
translation_sw: Naye ndiye aliye zipeleka bahari mbili, hii tamu mno, na hii ya chumvi chungu. Na akaweka baina yao kinga na kizuizi kizuiacho.
translation_en: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًۭا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًۭا وَصِهْرًۭا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Naye ndiye aliye muumba mwanaadamu kutokana na maji, akamjaalia kuwa na nasaba na ushemeji. Na Mola wako Mlezi ni Muweza.
translation_en: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].

arabic_text: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na wanayaabudu badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu yasiyo wafaa wala yasiyo wadhuru. Na kafiri daima ni msaidizi wa kumpinga Mola wake Mlezi.
translation_en: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Nasi hatukukutuma ila kuwa ni Mbashiri na Mwonyaji.
translation_en: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

arabic_text: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Sema: Sikukuombeni ujira juu yake; ila atakaye na ashike njia iendayo kwa Mola wake Mlezi.
translation_en: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."

arabic_text: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
translation_sw: Na mtegemee Aliye Hai, ambaye hafi. Na umtukuze kwa sifa zake. Na yatosha kwake kuwa yeye ni Mwenye khabari za dhambi za waja wake.
translation_en: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Ambaye ameziumba mbingu na ardhi, na viliomo ndani yake kwa siku sita. Kisha akatawala juu ya A'rshi, Arrahman, Mwingi wa Rehema! Uliza khabari zake kwa wamjuaye.
translation_en: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًۭا ۩
translation_sw: Na wanapo ambiwa: Msujudieni Arrahman! Wao husema: Ni nani Arrahman? Je! Tumsujudie unaye tuamrisha wewe tu? Na huwazidishia chuki.
translation_en: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.

arabic_text: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًۭا وَقَمَرًۭا مُّنِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Ametukuka aliye zijaalia nyota mbinguni, na akajaalia humo taa na mwezi unao ng'ara.
translation_en: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةًۭ لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًۭا
translation_sw: Naye ndiye aliye fanya usiku na mchana kufuatana kwa nafuu ya anaye taka kukumbuka, au anaye taka kushukuru.
translation_en: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.

arabic_text: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًۭا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا
translation_sw: Na waja wa Arrahman Mwingi wa Rehema ni wale wanao tembea ulimwenguni kwa staha, na wajinga wakiwasemeza hujibu: Salama!
translation_en: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًۭا وَقِيَٰمًۭا
translation_sw: Na wale wanao kesha kwa ajili ya Mola wao Mlezi kwa kusujudu na kusimama.
translation_en: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
translation_sw: Na wale wanao sema: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tuondolee adhabu ya Jahannamu. Hakika adhabu yake ikimpata mtu haimwachi.
translation_en: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;

arabic_text: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika hiyo ni kituo na makao mabaya.
translation_en: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًۭا
translation_sw: Na wale ambao wanapo tumia hawatumii kwa fujo wala hawafanyi ubakhili, bali wanakuwa katikati baina ya hayo.
translation_en: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًۭا
translation_sw: Na wale wasio mwomba mungu mwengine pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu, wala hawaui nafsi aliyo iharimisha Mwenyezi Mungu isipo kuwa kwa haki, wala hawazini - na atakaye fanya hayo atapata madhara,
translation_en: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.

arabic_text: يُضَٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
translation_sw: Atazidishiwa adhabu Siku ya Kiyama, na atadumu humo kwa kufedheheka.
translation_en: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -

arabic_text: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَٰتٍۢ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa atakaye tubu, na akaamini, na akatenda vitendo vyema. Basi hao Mwenyezi Mungu atayabadilisha maovu yao yawe mema. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًۭا
translation_sw: Na aliye tubu na akafanya mema, basi hakika huyo ametubu kweli kweli kwa Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًۭا
translation_sw: Na wale ambao hawatoi ushahidi wa uwongo, na pindi wapitapo penye upuuzi, hupita kwa hishima yao.
translation_en: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّۭا وَعُمْيَانًۭا
translation_sw: Na wale ambao wanapo kumbushwa Ishara za Mola wao Mlezi hawajifanyi viziwi nazo, na vipofu.
translation_en: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
translation_sw: Na wale wanao sema: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tupe katika wake zetu na wenetu yaburudishayo macho, na utujaalie tuwe waongozi kwa wachamngu.
translation_en: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةًۭ وَسَلَٰمًا
translation_sw: Hao ndio watakao lipwa makao ya juu kwa kuwa walisubiri, na watakuta humo maamkio na salamu.
translation_en: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.

arabic_text: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
translation_sw: Wadumu humo - kituo na makao mazuri kabisa.
translation_en: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.

arabic_text: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
translation_sw: Sema: Mola wangu Mlezi asinge kujalini lau kuwa si kuomba kwenu. Lakini nyinyi mmemkadhibisha. Basi adhabu lazima iwe.
translation_en: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.

arabic_text: طسٓمٓ
translation_sw: T'aa Siin Miim. (T'. S. M.)
translation_en: Ta, Seen, Meem.

arabic_text: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_sw: Hizi ni Aya za Kitabu kinacho bainisha.
translation_en: These are the verses of the clear Book.

arabic_text: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Huenda labda ukajikera nafsi yako kwa kuwa hawawi Waumini.
translation_en: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.

arabic_text: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
translation_sw: Tunge penda tungeli wateremshia kutoka mbinguni Ishara zikanyenyekea shingo zao.
translation_en: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.

arabic_text: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
translation_sw: Wala hauwafikii ukumbusho mpya kutoka kwa Arrahman ila wao hujitenga nao.
translation_en: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.

arabic_text: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa yakini wamekanusha; kwa hivyo zitakuja wafikia khabari za yale waliyo kuwa wakiyafanyia mzaha.
translation_en: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
translation_sw: Je! Hawakuiona ardhi, mimea mingapi tumeiotesha humo, ya kila namna nzuri?
translation_en: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika katika haya zipo Ishara. Lakini wengi wao hawakuwa wenye kuamini.
translation_en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye Yeye Mwenye nguvu Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na Mola wako Mlezi, alipo mwita Musa, akamwambia: Fika kwa watu madhaalimu,
translation_en: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -

arabic_text: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Watu wa Firauni. Hawaogopi?
translation_en: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hakika mimi nachelea wasinikanushe.
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me

arabic_text: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
translation_sw: Na kifua changu kina dhiki, na ulimi wangu haukunjuki vyema. Basi mtumie ujumbe Harun.
translation_en: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.

arabic_text: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
translation_sw: Na wao wana kisasi juu yangu, kwa hivyo naogopa wasije kuniuwa.
translation_en: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."

arabic_text: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Siyo hivyo kabisa! Nendeni na miujiza yetu. Hakika Sisi tu pamoja nanyi, tunasikiliza.
translation_en: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.

arabic_text: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Basi mfikieni Firauni na mwambieni: Hakika sisi ni Mitume wa Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,

arabic_text: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_sw: Waachilie Wana wa Israili wende nasi.
translation_en: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"

arabic_text: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
translation_sw: (Firauni) akasema: Sisi hatukukulea wewe utotoni, na ukakaa kwetu katika umri wako miaka mingi?
translation_en: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?

arabic_text: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na ukatenda kitendo chako ulicho tenda, nawe ukawa miongoni mwa wasio na shukrani?
translation_en: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."

arabic_text: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation_sw: (Musa) akasema: Nilitenda hayo hapo nilipo kuwa miongoni mwa wale walio potea.
translation_en: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.

arabic_text: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Basi nikakukimbieni nilipo kuogopeni, tena Mola wangu Mlezi akanitunukia hukumu, na akanijaalia niwe miongoni mwa Mitume.
translation_en: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.

arabic_text: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_sw: Na hiyo ndiyo neema ya kunisumbulia, na wewe umewatia utumwani Wana wa Israili?
translation_en: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"

arabic_text: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Firauni akasema: Na nani huyo Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote?
translation_en: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Ndiye Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na ardhi, na viliomo baina yao, ikiwa nyinyi ni wenye yakini.
translation_en: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."

arabic_text: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ
translation_sw: (Firauni) akawaambia walio mzunguka: Hamsikilizi?
translation_en: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: (Musa) akasema: Ndiye Mola wenu Mlezi, na Mola Mlezi wa baba zenu wa kwanza.
translation_en: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
translation_sw: (Firauni) akasema: Hakika huyu Mtume wenu aliye tumwa kwenu ni mwendawazimu.
translation_en: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: (Musa) akasema: Ndiye Mola Mlezi wa Mashariki na Magharibi na viliomo baina yao, ikiwa nyinyi mnatia akilini.
translation_en: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."

arabic_text: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
translation_sw: (Firauni) akasema: Ukimfuata mungu mwengine asiye kuwa mimi, basi bila ya shaka nitakufunga gerezani.
translation_en: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."

arabic_text: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Akasema: Je! Ijapo kuwa nitakuletea kitu cha kubainisha wazi?
translation_en: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"

arabic_text: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Kilete basi, kama wewe ni katika wasemao kweli.
translation_en: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."

arabic_text: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi akaitupa fimbo yake, mara ikawa nyoka wa kuonekana dhaahiri.
translation_en: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.

arabic_text: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na akautoa mkono wake, na mara ukawa mweupe kwa watazamao.
translation_en: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.

arabic_text: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: (Firauni) akawaambia waheshimiwa walio mzunguka: Hakika huyu ni mchawi mtaalamu.
translation_en: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.

arabic_text: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
translation_sw: Anataka kukutoeni katika nchi yenu kwa uchawi wake. Basi mna shauri gani?
translation_en: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Mpe muda yeye na nduguye na uwatume mijini wapigao mbiu ya mgambo.
translation_en: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

arabic_text: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Wakuletee kila mchawi bingwa mtaalamu.
translation_en: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."

arabic_text: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi wakakusanywa wachawi wakati na siku maalumu.
translation_en: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.

arabic_text: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
translation_sw: Na watu wakaambiwa: Je! Mtakusanyika?
translation_en: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate

arabic_text: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
translation_sw: Huenda tutawafuata wachawi wakiwa wao ndio watakao shinda.
translation_en: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
translation_sw: Basi walipo kuja wachawi wakamwambia Firauni: Je! Tutapata ujira tukiwa sisi ndio tulio shinda?
translation_en: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"

arabic_text: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation_sw: Naam! Na hakika mtakuwa katika watu wa mbele.
translation_en: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

arabic_text: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
translation_sw: Musa akwaambia: Tupeni mnavyo taka kutupa.
translation_en: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."

arabic_text: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
translation_sw: Basi wakatupa kamba zao na fimbo zao, na wakasema: Kwa nguvu za Firauni hakika sisi hapana shaka ni wenye kushinda.
translation_en: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."

arabic_text: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
translation_sw: Musa tena akatupa fimbo yake, nayo mara ikavimeza walivyo vizua.
translation_en: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.

arabic_text: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ
translation_sw: Hapo wachawi walipinduka wakasujudu.
translation_en: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Tunamuamini Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

arabic_text: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
translation_sw: Mola Mlezi wa Musa na Harun.
translation_en: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

arabic_text: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: (Firauni) akasema: Je! Mmemuamini kabla sijakuruhusuni? Bila ya shaka yeye basi ndiye mkubwa wenu aliye kufunzeni uchawi. Basi mtakuja jua! Nitakata mikono yenu na miguu yenu kwa kutafautisha. Na nitakubandikeni misalabani nyote.
translation_en: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Haidhuru, kwani sisi ni wenye kurejea kwa Mola wetu Mlezi.
translation_en: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

arabic_text: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika sisi tunatumai Mola wetu Mlezi atatusamehe makosa yetu, kwa kuwa ndio wa kwanza wa kuamini.
translation_en: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."

arabic_text: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na tulimuamrisha Musa kwa wahyi: Nenda na waja wangu wakati wa usiku. Kwa hakika mtafuatwa.
translation_en: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."

arabic_text: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
translation_sw: Basi Firauni akawatuma mijini wapiga mbiu za mgambo.
translation_en: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌۭ قَلِيلُونَ
translation_sw: (Wakieneza): Hakika hawa ni kikundi kidogo.
translation_en: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
translation_sw: Nao wanatuudhi.
translation_en: And indeed, they are enraging us,

arabic_text: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na sisi ni wengi, wenye kuchukua hadhari.
translation_en: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "

arabic_text: فَأَخْرَجْنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi tukawatoa katika mabustani na chemchem,
translation_en: So We removed them from gardens and springs

arabic_text: وَكُنُوزٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Na makhazina, na vyeo vya hishima,
translation_en: And treasures and honorable station -

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_sw: Kadhaalika; na tukawarithisha hayo Wana wa Israili.
translation_en: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.

arabic_text: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
translation_sw: Basi wakawafuata lilipo chomoza jua.
translation_en: So they pursued them at sunrise.

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
translation_sw: Na yalipo onana majeshi mawili haya, watu wa Musa wakasema: Hakika sisi bila ya shaka tumepatikana!
translation_en: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

arabic_text: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_sw: (Musa) akasema: Hasha! Hakika yu pamoja nami Mola wangu Mlezi. Yeye ataniongoa!
translation_en: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

arabic_text: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_sw: Tulimletea wahyi Musa tukamwambia: Piga bahari kwa fimbo yako. Basi ikatengana, na kila sehemu ikawa kama mlima mkubwa.
translation_en: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.

arabic_text: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukawajongeza hapo wale wengine.
translation_en: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.

arabic_text: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Tukawaokoa Musa na walio kuwa pamoja naye wote.
translation_en: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukawazamisha hao wengine.
translation_en: Then We drowned the others.

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika bila ya shaka katika hayo ipo Ishara; lakini wengi wao si katika wenye kuamini.
translation_en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye Mwenye nguvu Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

arabic_text: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_sw: Na wasomee khabari za Ibrahim.
translation_en: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_sw: Alipo mwambia baba yake na kaumu yake: Mnaabudu nini?
translation_en: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Tunaabudu masanamu, daima tunayanyenyekea.
translation_en: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."

arabic_text: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Je! Yanakusikieni mnapo yaita?
translation_en: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?

arabic_text: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
translation_sw: Au yanakufaeni, au yanakudhuruni?
translation_en: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Bali tumewakuta baba zetu wakifanya hivyo hivyo.
translation_en: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."

arabic_text: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Mmewaona hawa mnao waabudu-
translation_en: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,

arabic_text: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
translation_sw: Nyinyi na baba zenu wa zamani?
translation_en: You and your ancient forefathers?

arabic_text: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Kwani hakika hao ni adui zangu, isipo kuwa Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
translation_sw: Ambaye ndiye aliye niumba, na Yeye ndiye ananiongoa,
translation_en: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
translation_sw: Na ambaye ndiye ananilisha na kuninywesha.
translation_en: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
translation_sw: Na ninapo ugua ni Yeye ndiye anaye niponesha.
translation_en: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
translation_sw: Na ambaye atanifisha, na kisha atanihuisha.
translation_en: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Na ambaye ndiye ninaye mtumai kunisamehe makosa yangu Siku ya Malipo.
translation_en: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

arabic_text: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nitunukie hukumu na uniunganishe na watendao mema.
translation_en: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

arabic_text: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na unijaalie nitajwe kwa wema na watu watakao kuja baadaye.
translation_en: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.

arabic_text: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_sw: Na unijaalie katika warithi wa Bustani za neema.
translation_en: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

arabic_text: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation_sw: Na umsamehe baba yangu, kwani hakika alikuwa miongoni mwa wapotovu.
translation_en: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.

arabic_text: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_sw: Wala usinihizi Siku watapo fufuliwa.
translation_en: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ
translation_sw: Siku ambayo kwamba mali hayato faa kitu wala wana.
translation_en: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

arabic_text: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa mwenye kumjia Mwenyezi Mungu na moyo safi.
translation_en: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."

arabic_text: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_sw: Na Pepo itasogezwa kwa wachamngu.
translation_en: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

arabic_text: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
translation_sw: Na Jahannamu itadhihirishwa kwa wapotovu.
translation_en: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

arabic_text: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_sw: Na wataambiwa: Wako wapi mlio kuwa mkiwaabudu
translation_en: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

arabic_text: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu? Je! Wanakusaidieni, au wanajisaidia wenyewe?
translation_en: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"

arabic_text: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
translation_sw: Basi watavurumizwa humo wao na hao wakosefu,
translation_en: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators

arabic_text: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na majeshi ya Ibilisi yote.
translation_en: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation_sw: Watasema, na hali ya kuwa wanazozana humo:
translation_en: They will say while they dispute therein,

arabic_text: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
translation_sw: Wallahi! Kwa yakini tulikuwa katika upotovu ulio dhaahiri,
translation_en: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error

arabic_text: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Tulipo kufanyeni ni sawa na Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na hawakutupoteza ila wale wakosefu.
translation_en: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

arabic_text: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ
translation_sw: Basi hatuna waombezi.
translation_en: So now we have no intercessors

arabic_text: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Wala rafiki wa dhati.
translation_en: And not a devoted friend.

arabic_text: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Laiti tungeli pata kurejea tena tungeli kuwa katika Waumini.
translation_en: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika katika haya ipo Ishara, lakini wengi wao hawakuwa wenye kuamini.
translation_en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye Mwenye nguvu Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Kaumu ya Nuhu waliwakadhibisha Mitume.
translation_en: The people of Noah denied the messengers

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Alipo waambia ndugu yao, Nuhu: Je! Hamchimngu?
translation_en: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

arabic_text: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika mimi kwenu ni Mtume muaminifu.
translation_en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_sw: Basi Mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu, na nit'iini mimi.
translation_en: So fear Allah and obey me.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na sikutakini juu yake ujira, kwani ujira wangu hauko ila kwa Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_sw: Basi Mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu, na nit'iini mimi.
translation_en: So fear Allah and obey me."

arabic_text: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Je! Tukuamini wewe, hali wanao kufuata ni watu wa chini?
translation_en: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"

arabic_text: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Nayajuaje waliyo kuwa wakiyafanya?
translation_en: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?

arabic_text: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Hisabu yao haiko ila kwa Mola wao Mlezi, laiti mngeli tambua!
translation_en: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Wala mimi si wa kuwafukuza Waumini.
translation_en: And I am not one to drive away the believers.

arabic_text: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Mimi si cho chote ila ni Mwonyaji wa dhaahiri shaahiri.
translation_en: I am only a clear warner."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ikiwa huachi, ewe Nuhu, bila ya shaka utapigwa mawe.
translation_en: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika watu wangu wamenikanusha.
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

arabic_text: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Basi hukumu baina yangu na wao kwa hukumu yako, na uniokoe mimi na walio pamoja nami, Waumini.
translation_en: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."

arabic_text: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_sw: Kwa hivyo tukamwokoa yeye na walio kuwa pamoja naye katika marikebu iliyo sheheni.
translation_en: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukawazamisha baadaye walio bakia.
translation_en: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika katika haya ipo Ishara, lakini si wengi wao walio kuwa Waumini.
translation_en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye Yeye Mwenye nguvu Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Kina A'd waliwakanusha Mitume.
translation_en: 'Aad denied the messengers

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Alipo waambia ndugu yao, Hud: Je! Hamchimngu?
translation_en: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

arabic_text: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika mimi kwenu ni Mtume muaminifu.
translation_en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_sw: Basi mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu, na nit'iini mimi.
translation_en: So fear Allah and obey me.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Wala sikutakeni juu yake ujira, kwani ujira wangu hauko ila kwa Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةًۭ تَعْبَثُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Mnajenga juu ya kila mnyanyuko kumbusho la kufanyia upuuzi?
translation_en: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,

arabic_text: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
translation_sw: Na mnajenga majengo ya fakhari kama kwamba mtaishi milele!
translation_en: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?

arabic_text: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
translation_sw: Na mnapo tumia nguvu mnatumia nguvu kwa ujabari.
translation_en: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.

arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_sw: Basi mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu, na nit'iini.
translation_en: So fear Allah and obey me.

arabic_text: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na mcheni aliye kupeni haya mnayo yajua.
translation_en: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,

arabic_text: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَٰمٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
translation_sw: Amekupeni wanyama wa kufuga na wana.
translation_en: Provided you with grazing livestock and children

arabic_text: وَجَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_sw: Na mabustani na chemchem.
translation_en: And gardens and springs.

arabic_text: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika mimi ninakukhofieni adhabu ya Siku Kubwa.
translation_en: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ni mamoja kwetu, ukitupa mawaidha au hukuwa miongoni mwa watoao mawaidha.
translation_en: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.

arabic_text: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Haya si chochote ila ni mtindo wa watu wa tokea zamani.
translation_en: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,

arabic_text: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_sw: Wala sisi hatutaadhibiwa.
translation_en: And we are not to be punished."

arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Wakamkanusha; nasi tukawaangamiza. Hakika bila ya shaka katika haya ipo Ishara. Lakini hawakuwa wengi wao wenye kuamini.
translation_en: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye Mwenye nguvu Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Kina Thamud waliwakanusha Mitume.
translation_en: Thamud denied the messengers

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Alipo waambia ndugu yao Saleh: Je! Hamumchimngu?
translation_en: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

arabic_text: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika mimi kwenu ni Mtume muaminifu.
translation_en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_sw: Basi mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu, na nit'iini.
translation_en: So fear Allah and obey me.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Wala sikutakini ujira juu yake. Ujira wangu hauko ila kwa Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_sw: Je! Mtaachwa salama usalimina katika haya yaliyopo hapa?
translation_en: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

arabic_text: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Katika mabustani, na chemchem?
translation_en: Within gardens and springs

arabic_text: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَنَخْلٍۢ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na konde na mitende yenye makole yaliyo wiva.
translation_en: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

arabic_text: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًۭا فَٰرِهِينَ
translation_sw: Na mnachonga milimani majumba kwa ustadi.
translation_en: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.

arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_sw: Basi mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu, na nit'iini mimi.
translation_en: So fear Allah and obey me.

arabic_text: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_sw: Wala msit'ii amri za walio pindukia mipaka,
translation_en: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao wanafanya ufisadi katika nchi, wala hawatengenezi.
translation_en: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Hakika wewe ni miongoni mwa walio rogwa.
translation_en: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

arabic_text: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Wewe si chochote ila ni mtu kama sisi. Basi lete Ishara ukiwa wewe ni miongoni mwa wasemao kweli.
translation_en: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."

arabic_text: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
translation_sw: Akasema: Huyu ngamia jike; awe na zamu yake ya kunywa, na nyinyi muwe na zamu yenu ya kunywa katika siku maalumu.
translation_en: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Wala msimguse kwa uwovu, isije ikakushikeni adhabu ya Siku Kubwa.
translation_en: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."

arabic_text: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَٰدِمِينَ
translation_sw: Lakini wakamuuwa, na wakawa wenye kujuta.
translation_en: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

arabic_text: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Basi ikawapata adhabu. Hakika katika hayo ipo Ishara. Lakini hawakuwa wengi wao wenye kuamini.
translation_en: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye Mwenye nguvu Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Watu wa Lut'i waliwakanusha Mitume.
translation_en: The people of Lot denied the messengers

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Alipo waambia ndugu yao, Lut'i: Je! Hamumchimngu?
translation_en: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

arabic_text: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika mimi kwenu ni Mtume muaminifu kwenu.
translation_en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_sw: Basi mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu na nit'iini mimi.
translation_en: So fear Allah and obey me.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Wala mimi sikutakini ujira juu yake; ujira wangu hauko ila kwa Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Je! Katika viumbe vyote mnawaingilia wanaume?
translation_en: Do you approach males among the worlds

arabic_text: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
translation_sw: Na mnaacha alicho kuumbieni Mola wenu Mlezi katika wake zenu? Ama kweli nyinyi ni watu mnao ruka mipaka!
translation_en: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ewe Lut'i! Usipo acha, hapana shaka utakuwa miongoni mwa wanao tolewa mji!
translation_en: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنِّى لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَالِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hakika mimi ni katika wanao kichukia hichi kitendo chenu.
translation_en: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].

arabic_text: رَبِّ نَجِّنِى وَأَهْلِى مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Mola wangu Mlezi! Niokoe mimi na ahali zangu na haya wayatendayo.
translation_en: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."

arabic_text: فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Basi tukamwokoa yeye na ahali zake wote,
translation_en: So We saved him and his family, all,

arabic_text: إِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa kikongwe katika walio kaa nyuma.
translation_en: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukawaangamiza wale wengine.
translation_en: Then We destroyed the others.

arabic_text: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukawanyeshea mvua, basi ni ovu mno mvua ya waliyo onywa.
translation_en: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika katika hayo ipo Ishara. Na hawakuwa wengi wao wenye kuamini.
translation_en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi bila ya shaka ndiye Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

arabic_text: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Watu wa Machakani waliwakanusha Mitume.
translation_en: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Shuaibu alipo waambia: Je! Hamfanyi mkamchamngu?
translation_en: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

arabic_text: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika mimi kwenu ni Mtume muaminifu.
translation_en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_sw: Basi mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu, na nit'iini mimi.
translation_en: So fear Allah and obey me.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Wala sikutakini ujira juu yake. Ujira wangu hauko ila kwa Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
translation_sw: Timizeni kipimo sawa sawa, wala msiwe katika wanao punja.
translation_en: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.

arabic_text: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
translation_sw: Na pimeni kwa haki iliyo nyooka;
translation_en: And weigh with an even balance.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
translation_sw: Wala msiwapunje watu vitu vyao, wala msifanye jeuri kwa ufisadi.
translation_en: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.

arabic_text: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Na mcheni aliye kuumbeni nyinyi na vizazi vilivyo tangulia.
translation_en: And fear He who created you and the former creation."

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Hakika wewe ni katika walio rogwa.
translation_en: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
translation_sw: Na wewe si chochote ila ni mtu tu kama sisi, na kwa yakini tunakuona wewe ni katika waongo.
translation_en: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.

arabic_text: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Hebu tuangushie vipande kutoka mbinguni ikiwa wewe ni miongoni mwa wasemao kweli.
translation_en: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi anajua zaidi mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_sw: Basi walimkanusha, na ikawashika adhabu ya siku ya kivuli. Hakika hiyo ilikuwa adhabu ya siku kubwa.
translation_en: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika katika hayo ipo Ishara, lakini hawakuwa wengi wao wenye kuamini.
translation_en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi bila ya shaka ndiye Yeye Mwenye nguvu Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka hii ni Uteremsho wa Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
translation_sw: Ameuteremsha Roho muaminifu,
translation_en: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down

arabic_text: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
translation_sw: Juu ya moyo wako, ili uwe katika Waonyaji,
translation_en: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -

arabic_text: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwa ulimi wa Kiarabu ulio wazi.
translation_en: In a clear Arabic language.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika bila ya shaka haya yamo katika Vitabu vya kale.
translation_en: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_sw: Je! Haikuwa kwao ni Ishara kwamba wanayajua haya wanazuoni wa Wana wa Israili?
translation_en: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?

arabic_text: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na lau kuwa tungeli iteremsha juu ya mmoja wa wasio kuwa Waarabu,
translation_en: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners

arabic_text: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na akawasomea, wasingeli kuwa wenye kuamini.
