translation_en: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Namna hivi tunaingiza katika nyoyo za wakosefu.
translation_en: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.

arabic_text: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_sw: Hawataiamini mpaka waione adhabu chungu.
translation_en: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.

arabic_text: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Basi itawafikia kwa ghafla, na hali hawana khabari.
translation_en: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.

arabic_text: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na watasema: Je, tutapewa muhula?
translation_en: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"

arabic_text: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_sw: Basi, je, wanaihimiza adhabu yetu?
translation_en: So for Our punishment are they impatient?

arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
translation_sw: Waonaje kama tukiwastarehesha kwa miaka,
translation_en: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years

arabic_text: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Kisha yakawafikia waliyo kuwa wakiahidiwa,
translation_en: And then there came to them that which they were promised?

arabic_text: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
translation_sw: Yatawafaa nini yale waliyo stareheshewa?
translation_en: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
translation_sw: Wala hatukuangamiza mji wo wote ila ulikuwa na waonyaji -
translation_en: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners

arabic_text: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Kuwa ni ukumbusho. Wala Sisi hatukuwa wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.

arabic_text: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
translation_sw: Wala Mashet'ani hawakuteremka nayo,
translation_en: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.

arabic_text: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_sw: Wala haitakiwi kwao, na wala hawawezi.
translation_en: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika hao wametengwa na kusikia.
translation_en: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.

arabic_text: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_sw: Basi usimwombe mungu mwingine pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu ukawa miongoni mwa watakao adhibiwa.
translation_en: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.

arabic_text: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
translation_sw: Na uwaonye jamaa zako walio karibu nawe.
translation_en: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.

arabic_text: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na watwae kwa upole wanao kufuata miongoni mwa Waumini.
translation_en: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.

arabic_text: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na ikiwa watakuasi basi sema: Mimi najitenga mbali na hayo mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."

arabic_text: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_sw: Na umtegemee Mtukufu Mwenye nguvu Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_sw: Ambaye anakuona unapo simama,
translation_en: Who sees you when you arise

arabic_text: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
translation_sw: Na mageuko yako kati ya wanao sujudu.
translation_en: And your movement among those who prostrate.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Hakika Yeye ndiye Mwenye kusikia Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

arabic_text: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
translation_sw: Je! Nikwambieni nani wanawashukia Mashet'ani?
translation_en: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Wanamshukia kila mzushi mkubwa mwingi wa dhambi.
translation_en: They descend upon every sinful liar.

arabic_text: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَٰذِبُونَ
translation_sw: Wanawapelekea yale wanayo yasikia; na wengi wao ni waongo.
translation_en: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.

arabic_text: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
translation_sw: Na watungaji mashairi ni wapotofu ndio wanawafuata.
translation_en: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Huwaoni kwamba wao wanatangatanga katika kila bonde?
translation_en: Do you not see that in every valley they roam

arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na kwamba wao husema wasiyo yatenda?
translation_en: And that they say what they do not do? -

arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa wale walio amini, na wakatenda mema, na wakamkumbuka Mwenyezi Mungu kwa wingi, na wakajitetea wanapo dhulumiwa. Na wanao dhulumu watakuja jua mgeuko gani watakao geuka.
translation_en: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.

arabic_text: طسٓ ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
translation_sw: T'aa Siin. (T'. S.), Hizi ni Aya za Qur'ani na Kitabu kinacho bainisha;
translation_en: Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book

arabic_text: هُدًۭى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Uwongofu na bishara kwa Waumini,
translation_en: As guidance and good tidings for the believers

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao wanashika Sala, na wanatoa Zaka, na Akhera wana yakini nayo.
translation_en: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika wale wasio iamini Akhera tumewapambia vitendo vyao, kwa hivyo wanatangatanga ovyo.
translation_en: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
translation_sw: Hao ndio watapata adhabu mbaya kabisa, na hao katika Akhera ndio watapata khasara zaidi.
translation_en: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_sw: Na hakika wewe unafundishwa Qur'ani inayo tokana kwake Mwenye hikima Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: And indeed, [O Muhammad], you receive the Qur'an from one Wise and Knowing.

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍۢ قَبَسٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
translation_sw: (Kumbuka) Musa alipo waambia ahali zake: Hakika nimeona moto, nitakwenda nikuleteeni khabari, au nitakuleteeni kijinga kinacho waka ili mpate kuota moto.
translation_en: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Basi alipo fika ilinadiwa: Amebarikiwa aliomo katika moto huu na walioko pembezoni mwake. Na ametakasika Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allah, Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Ewe Musa! Hakika Mimi ndiye Mwenyezi Mungu, Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

arabic_text: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّۭ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًۭا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na itupe fimbo yako! Alipo iona ikitikisika kama nyoka, aligeuka nyuma wala hakungoja. Ewe Musa! Usikhofu! Hakika hawakhofu mbele yangu Mitume.
translation_en: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.

arabic_text: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍۢ فَإِنِّى غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Lakini aliye dhulumu, kisha akabadilisha wema baada ya ubaya, basi Mimi ni Mwenye kusamehe Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍۢ ۖ فِى تِسْعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na ingiza mkono wako katika mfuko wako, utatoka mweupe bila ya maradhi. Ni katika Ishara tisa za kumpelekea Firauni na kaumu yake. Hakika hao walikuwa watu waovu.
translation_en: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةًۭ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi zilipo wafikia Ishara zetu hizo zenye kuonyesha, wakasema: Huu ni uchawi dhaahiri.
translation_en: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."

arabic_text: وَجَحَدُوا۟ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًۭا وَعُلُوًّۭا ۚ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
translation_sw: Na wakazikataa kwa dhulma na kujivuna, na hali ya kuwa nafsi zao zina yakini nazo. Basi angalia ulikuwaje mwisho wa mafisadi!
translation_en: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ عِلْمًۭا ۖ وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tuliwapa Daudi na Sulaiman ilimu, na wakasema: Alhamdu Lillahi, Kuhimidiwa kote ni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu aliye tufadhilisha kuliko wengi katika waja wake Waumini.
translation_en: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."

arabic_text: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Na Sulaiman alimrithi Daudi, na akasema: Enyi watu! Tumefunzwa usemi wa ndege, na tumepewa kila kitu. Hakika hii ni fadhila iliyo dhaahiri.
translation_en: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."

arabic_text: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na alikusanyiwa Sulaiman majeshi yake ya majini, na watu, na ndege; nayo yakapangwa kwa nidhamu.
translation_en: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows.

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌۭ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Mpaka walipo fika kwenye bonde la wadudu chungu, alisema mdudu chungu mmoja: Enyi wadudu chungu! Ingieni majumbani mwenu, asikupondeni Sulaiman na majeshi yake bila ya wao kutambua.
translation_en: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."

arabic_text: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًۭا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Basi (Sulaiman) akatabasamu akacheka kwa neno hili, na akasema: Ee Mola wangu Mlezi! Nizindue niishukuru neema yako uliyo nineemesha mimi na wazazi wangu, na nipate kutenda mema uyapendayo, na uniingize kwa rehema yako katika waja wako wema.
translation_en: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."

arabic_text: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ
translation_sw: Na akawakagua ndege, na akasema: Imekuwaje, mbona simwoni Hud-hud, au amekuwa miongoni mwa walio ghibu?
translation_en: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?

arabic_text: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَا۟ذْبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّى بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwa yakini nitamuadhibu kwa adhabu kali, au nitamchinja, au aniletee hoja ya kutosha.
translation_en: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."

arabic_text: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍۢ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍۭ بِنَبَإٍۢ يَقِينٍ
translation_sw: Basi (Hud-hud) akakaa si mbali na akasema: Nimegundua usilo gundua wewe, na ninakujia hivi kutoka nchi ya Sabai, na nakuletea khabari za yakini.
translation_en: But the hoopoe stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.

arabic_text: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika mimi nimemkuta mwanamke anawatawala, naye amepewa kila kitu, na anacho kiti cha enzi kikubwa.
translation_en: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.

arabic_text: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Nimemkuta yeye na watu wake wanalisujudia jua badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu; na Shet'ani amewapambia vitendo vyao na akawazuilia Njia. Kwa hivyo hawakuongoka,
translation_en: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,

arabic_text: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
translation_sw: Na hawamsujudii Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye huyatoa yaliyo fichikana katika mbingu na ardhi, na anayajua mnayo yaficha na mnayo yatangaza.
translation_en: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allah, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۩
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu - hapana mungu ila Yeye, Mola Mlezi wa A'rshi tukufu..
translation_en: Allah - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."

arabic_text: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema (Sulaiman): Tutatazama umesema kweli au wewe ni miongoni mwa waongo.
translation_en: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.

arabic_text: ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَٰبِى هَٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_sw: Nenda na barua yangu hii na uwafikishie, kisha waache na utazame watarejesha nini.
translation_en: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."

arabic_text: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ إِنِّىٓ أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتَٰبٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
translation_sw: (Malkia) akasema: Enyi wahishimiwa! Hakika nimeletewa barua tukufu.
translation_en: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_sw: Imetoka kwa Sulaiman nayo ni: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu, Mwingi wa rehema, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it reads: 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

arabic_text: أَلَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَىَّ وَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Msinifanyie jeuri, na fikeni kwangu nanyi mmekwisha kuwa wenye kusalimu amri.
translation_en: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].' "

arabic_text: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَفْتُونِى فِىٓ أَمْرِى مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ
translation_sw: Akasema: Enyi wahishimiwa! Nipeni shauri katika jambo langu hili, kwani mimi sikati shauri yoyote mpaka mhudhurie.
translation_en: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أُو۟لُوا۟ قُوَّةٍۢ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ وَٱلْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِى مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Sisi ni wenye nguvu na wakali kwa vita; na amri iko kwako, basi tazama ni nini unaamrisha.
translation_en: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."

arabic_text: قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا۟ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓا۟ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hakika wafalme wanapo uingia mji wanauharibu, na wanawafanya wale watukufu wake kuwa wanyonge. Na hivyo ndivyo watendavyo.
translation_en: She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.

arabic_text: وَإِنِّى مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِم بِهَدِيَّةٍۢ فَنَاظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini mimi nitawapelekea zawadi, nami nitangoja watakayo rudi nayo wajumbe.
translation_en: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍۢ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُم بَلْ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ
translation_sw: Basi alipo fika (mjumbe) kwa Sulaiman, alisema (Sulaiman): Hivyo ndio nyinyi mnanisaidia kwa mali? Aliyo nipa Mwenyezi Mungu ni bora zaidi kuliko aliyo kupeni nyinyi. Lakini nyinyi mnafurahia hii zawadi yenu.
translation_en: So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allah has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.

arabic_text: ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍۢ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةًۭ وَهُمْ صَٰغِرُونَ
translation_sw: Rejea kwao! Kwa yakini sisi tutawajia kwa majeshi wasio yaweza kuyakabili. Na hakika tutawatoa humo na hali wao wamekuwa madhalili na wanyonge.
translation_en: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."

arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Enyi wahishimiwa! Ni nani kati yenu atakaye niletea kiti chake cha enzi kabla hawajanijia nao wamekwisha salimu amri.
translation_en: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"

arabic_text: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ ۖ وَإِنِّى عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِىٌّ أَمِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Akasema: Afriti, katika majini: Mimi nitakuletea kabla hujainuka pahala pako hapo. Na mimi kwa hakika nina nguvu na muaminifu.
translation_en: A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."

arabic_text: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Akasema mwenye ilimu ya Kitabu: Mimi nitakuletea kabla ya kupepesa jicho lako. Basi alipo kiona kimewekwa mbele yake, akasema: Haya ni katika fadhila zake Mola wangu Mlezi, ili anijaribu nitashukuru au nitakufuru. Na mwenye kushukuru, kwa hakika, anashukuru kwa manufaa ya nafsi yake; na anaye kufuru, kwa hakika Mola wangu Mlezi ni Mkwasi na Karimu.
translation_en: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."

arabic_text: قَالَ نَكِّرُوا۟ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِىٓ أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mgeuzieni kiti chake cha enzi hiki, tuone ataongoka, au atakuwa miongoni mwa wasio ongoka.
translation_en: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Basi (Malkia) alipo fika akaambiwa: Je! Kiti chako cha enzi ni kama hiki? Akasema: Kama kwamba ndicho hichi. (Sulaiman na watu wake wakasema): Na sisi tumepewa ilimu kabla yake (Malkia), na tukawa Waislamu.
translation_en: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allah].

arabic_text: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍۢ كَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na yale aliyo kuwa akiyaabudu badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu yalimzuilia. Hakika yeye (Malkia) alikuwa katika kaumu ya makafiri.
translation_en: And that which she was worshipping other than Allah had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."

arabic_text: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Akaambiwa: Liingie behewa la hili jumba. Alipo liona alidhani ni maji, na akapandisha nguo mpaka kwenye miundi yake. (Sulaiman) akasema: Hakika hilo ni behewa lilio sakafiwa kwa viyoo! Akasema (Malkia): Mola wangu Mlezi! Mimi nimejidhulumu nafsi yangu, na sasa nanyenyekea pamoja na Sulaiman kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds."

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na kwa kina Thamud tulimtuma ndugu yao Saleh kuwaambia: Muabuduni Mwenyezi Mungu. Basi wakawa makundi mawili yanayo gombana.
translation_en: And We had certainly sent to Thamud their brother Salih, [saying], "Worship Allah," and at once they were two parties conflicting.

arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ۖ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Enyi watu wangu! Kwa nini mnauhimiza uwovu kabla ya wema? Kwa nini hamuombi msamaha kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ili mrehemewe?
translation_en: He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil instead of good? Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allah that you may receive mercy?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ ٱطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَ ۚ قَالَ طَٰٓئِرُكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ تُفْتَنُونَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Tuna kisirani nawe na wale walio pamoja nawe. Yeye akasema: Uaguzi wa ukorofi wenu uko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu; lakini nyinyi ni watu mnao jaribiwa.
translation_en: They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen is with Allah. Rather, you are a people being tested."

arabic_text: وَكَانَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍۢ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
translation_sw: Na walikuwamo mjini watu tisa wakifanya ufisadi katika nchi wala hawafanyi la maslaha.
translation_en: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ تَقَاسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Apishaneni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu tutamshambulia usiku yeye na ahali zake; kisha tutamwambia mrithi wake: Sisi hatukuona maangamizo ya watu wake, na sisi bila ya shaka tunasema kweli.
translation_en: They said, "Take a mutual oath by Allah that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor, 'We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.' "

arabic_text: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًۭا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Basi wakapanga mipango yao, na Sisi tukapanga mipango yetu, na wao hawatambui.
translation_en: And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.

arabic_text: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Basi angalia ulivyo kuwa mwisho wa mipango yao, ya kwamba tuliwaangamiza wao pamoja na watu wao wote.
translation_en: Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.

arabic_text: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Basi hizo nyumba zao ni tupu kwa sababu ya walivyo dhulumu. Hakika bila ya shaka katika hayo ipo Ishara kwa watu wanao jua.
translation_en: So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.

arabic_text: وَأَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Na tukawaokoa wale walio amini na walio kuwa wanamchamngu.
translation_en: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah.

arabic_text: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na Lut'i alipo waambia watu wake: Je! Mnafanya uchafu nanyi mnaona?
translation_en: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality while you are seeing?

arabic_text: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةًۭ مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ تَجْهَلُونَ
translation_sw: Hivyo nyinyi mnawaingilia wanaume kwa matamanio badala ya wanawake? Hakika nyinyi ni watu mnao fanya ujinga kabisa!
translation_en: Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."

arabic_text: ۞ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌۭ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Basi haikuwa jawabu ya watu wake ila ni kusema: Wafukuzeni wafwasi wa Lut'i katika mji wenu. Hao ni watu wanao jitia usafi.
translation_en: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."

arabic_text: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَٰهَا مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Basi tukamwokoa yeye na ahali zake, isipo kuwa mkewe; tukamkadiria katika walio baki nyuma.
translation_en: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.

arabic_text: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukawanyeshea mvua. Ni ovu kweli kweli hiyo mvua ya walio kwisha onywa.
translation_en: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

arabic_text: قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ۗ ءَآللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Alhamdu Lillahi! Kuhimidiwa ni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu! Na amani ishuke juu ya waja wake alio wateuwa. Je! Mwenyezi Mungu ni bora, au wale wanao washirikisha naye?
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Praise be to Allah, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allah better or what they associate with Him?"

arabic_text: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍۢ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنۢبِتُوا۟ شَجَرَهَآ ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ يَعْدِلُونَ
translation_sw: AU NANI yule aliye ziumba mbingu na ardhi, na akakuteremshieni maji kutoka mbinguni, na kwa hayo tukaziotesha bustani zenye kupendeza? Nyinyi hamna uwezo wa kuiotesha miti yake. Je! Yupo mungu pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu? Bali hao ni watu walio potoka.
translation_en: [More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allah? [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].

arabic_text: أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًۭا وَجَعَلَ خِلَٰلَهَآ أَنْهَٰرًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Au nani yule aliye ifanya ardhi mahali pa kutua, na akajaalia ndani yake mito, na akaweka milima? Na akaweka baina ya bahari mbili kiziwizi? Je! Yupo mungu pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu? Bali wengi wao hawajui.
translation_en: Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allah? [No], but most of them do not know.

arabic_text: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Au nani yule anaye mjibu mwenye shida pale anapo mwomba, na akaiondoa dhiki, na akakufanyeni warithi wa ardhi? Je! Yupo mungu pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu? Ni machache mnayo yazingatia.
translation_en: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is there a deity with Allah? Little do you remember.

arabic_text: أَمَّن يَهْدِيكُمْ فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَن يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦٓ ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ تَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Au nani yule anaye kuongoeni katika giza la bara na bahari, na akazipeleka pepo kuleta bishara kabla ya rehema zake? Je! Yupo mungu pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu? Ametukuka Mwenyezi Mungu juu ya wanao washirikisha naye.
translation_en: Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allah? High is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

arabic_text: أَمَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Au nani anaye uanzisha uumbaji, kisha akaurejesha? Na nani anaye kuruzukuni kutoka mbinguni na kwenye ardhi? Je! Yupo mungu pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu? Sema: Leteni hoja zenu kama nyinyi ni wasema kweli.
translation_en: Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allah? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."

arabic_text: قُل لَّا يَعْلَمُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْغَيْبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Hapana katika mbingu na ardhi ajuaye ya ghaibu isipo kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Wala wao hawajui lini watafufuliwa.
translation_en: Say, "None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allah, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected."

arabic_text: بَلِ ٱدَّٰرَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّنْهَا ۖ بَلْ هُم مِّنْهَا عَمُونَ
translation_sw: Kwani huo ujuzi wao umefikilia kuijua Akhera? Bali wao wamo katika shaka nayo tu, bali wao ni vipofu nayo.
translation_en: Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًۭا وَءَابَآؤُنَآ أَئِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ
translation_sw: Na wakasema walio kufuru: Tutapo kuwa mchanga, sisi na baba zetu, hivyo kweli tutakuja tolewa?
translation_en: And those who disbelieve say, "When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?

arabic_text: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَٰذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Haya haya tuliahidiwa sisi na baba zetu zamani. Hayakuwa haya ila ni hadithi za uwongo za watu wa kale.
translation_en: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."

arabic_text: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Nendeni katika ardhi, na tazameni ulikuwaje mwisho wa wakosefu.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."

arabic_text: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُن فِى ضَيْقٍۢ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Wala usiwahuzunukie wala usiwe katika dhiki kwa sababu ya hila zao wanazo zifanya.
translation_en: And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanasema: Ahadi hii itatokea lini, ikiwa mnasema kweli?
translation_en: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"

arabic_text: قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Asaa ni karibu kukufikieni sehemu ya yale mnayo yahimiza.
translation_en: Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you - some of that for which you are impatient.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi ni Mwenye fadhila kwa watu, lakini wengi wao hawashukuru.
translation_en: And indeed, your Lord is full of bounty for the people, but most of them do not show gratitude."

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika Mola wako Mlezi anayajua yanayo ficha vifua vyao na wanayo yatangaza.
translation_en: And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.

arabic_text: وَمَا مِنْ غَآئِبَةٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
translation_sw: Na hakuna siri katika mbingu na ardhi ila imo katika Kitabu kinacho bainisha.
translation_en: And there is nothing concealed within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَكْثَرَ ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Qur'ani hii inawasimulia Wana wa Israili mengi wanayo khitalifiana nayo.
translation_en: Indeed, this Qur'an relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Nayo hakika ni Uwongofu na Rehema kwa Waumini.
translation_en: And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers.

arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُم بِحُكْمِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Hakika Mola wako Mlezi atawahukumu kwa hukumu yake, naye ni Mwenye nguvu Mjuzi.
translation_en: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

arabic_text: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَى ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_sw: Basi mtegemee Mweneyezi Mungu; hakika wewe uko juu ya Haki iliyo wazi.
translation_en: So rely upon Allah; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.

arabic_text: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika wewe huwezi kuwafanya maiti wasikie, wala kuwafanya viziwi wasikie wito, wanapo kwisha geuka kwenda zao.
translation_en: Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَٰدِى ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Wala huwezi kuwaongoa vipofu waache upotovu wao. Huwezi kuwafanya wasikie isipo kuwa wenye kuziamini Ishara zetu; na hao ndio wat'iifu.
translation_en: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [submitting to Allah].

arabic_text: ۞ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَآبَّةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ
translation_sw: Na itapo waangukia kauli juu yao, tutawatolea mnyama katika ardhi atakaye wasemeza, ya kuwa watu walikuwa hawana na yakini na Ishara zetu.
translation_en: And when the word befalls them, We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ فَوْجًۭا مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na Siku tutapo kusanya kutoka kila umma kundi katika wanao kadhibisha Ishara zetu, nao watagawanywa mafungu mafungu.
translation_en: And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُم بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوا۟ بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Hata watakapo fika, atasema (Mwenyezi Mungu): Je! Nyinyi si mlizikanusha Ishara zangu pasipo kuzijua vyema? Au mlikuwa mkifanya nini?
translation_en: Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?"

arabic_text: وَوَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُوا۟ فَهُمْ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
translation_sw: Na kauli itawaangukia juu yao kwa vile walivyo dhulumu. Basi hao hawatasema lolote.
translation_en: And the decree will befall them for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Hawaoni kwamba sisi tumeufanya usiku ili watulie, na mchana wa kuangaza. Hakika katika hayo zipo Ishara kwa watu wanao amini.
translation_en: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَٰخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na Siku litapo pulizwa baragumu, watahangaika waliomo mbinguni na katika ardhi, ila amtakaye Mwenyezi Mungu. Na wote watamfikia nao ni wanyonge.
translation_en: And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allah wills. And all will come to Him humbled.

arabic_text: وَتَرَى ٱلْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةًۭ وَهِىَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِ ۚ صُنْعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na unaiona milima unaidhunia imetulia; nayo inakwenda kama mwendo wa mawingu. Huo ndio ufundi wa Mwenyezi Mungu aliye tengeneza vilivyo kila kitu. Hakika Yeye anazo khabari za yote myatendayo.
translation_en: And you see the mountains, thinking them rigid, while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of Allah, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Acquainted with that which you do.

arabic_text: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعٍۢ يَوْمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ
translation_sw: Watakao kuja na mema, watapata bora kuliko hayo. Nao watasalimika na mahangaiko ya Siku hiyo.
translation_en: Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.

arabic_text: وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na watakao kuja na uovu, basi zitasunukishwa nyuso zao Motoni. Je! Kwani mnalipwa isipo kuwa mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda?
translation_en: And whoever comes with an evil deed - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"

arabic_text: إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْبَلْدَةِ ٱلَّذِى حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُۥ كُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Ama mimi nimeamrishwa nimuabudu Mola Mlezi wa mji huu aliye ufanya ni mtakatifu; na ni vyake Yeye tu vitu vyote. Na nimeamrishwa niwe miongoni mwa Waislamu, wenye kunyenyekea.
translation_en: [Say, O Muhammad], "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city, who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [those who submit to Allah]

arabic_text: وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na niisome Qur'ani. Na mwenye kuongoka, basi ameongoka kwa faida ya nafsi yake; na aliye potea - basi sema: Hakika mimi ni miongoni mwa waonyaji.
translation_en: And to recite the Qur'an." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."

arabic_text: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na sema: Alhamdu Lillahi, Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu. Yeye atakuonyesheni Ishara zake, na mtazijua. Na Mola wako Mlezi si mwenye kughafilika na myatendayo.
translation_en: And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allah. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."

arabic_text: طسٓمٓ
translation_sw: T'A SIN MIM, (T'. S. M.)
translation_en: Ta, Seen, Meem.

arabic_text: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_sw: Hizi ni Aya za Kitabu kinacho bainisha.
translation_en: These are the verses of the clear Book.

arabic_text: نَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكَ مِن نَّبَإِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Tunakusomea khabari za Musa na Firauni kwa Haki kwa ajili ya watu wanao amini.
translation_en: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًۭا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَآئِفَةًۭ مِّنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْىِۦ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika Firauni alitakabari katika nchi, na akawagawa wananchi makundi mbali mbali. Akalidhoofisha taifa moja miongoni mwao, akiwachinja watoto wao wanaume na akiwaacha watoto wao wanawake. Hakika yeye alikuwa katika mafisadi.
translation_en: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters.

arabic_text: وَنُرِيدُ أَن نَّمُنَّ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ أَئِمَّةًۭ وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukataka kuwafadhili walio dhoofishwa katika nchi hiyo na kuwafanya wawe waongozi na kuwafanya ni warithi.
translation_en: And We wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors

arabic_text: وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنُرِىَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَحْذَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na kuwapa nguvu katika nchi, na kutokana na wao kuwaonyesha kina Firauni na Hamana na majeshi yao mambo yale waliyo kuwa wakiyaogopa.
translation_en: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Haman and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.

arabic_text: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Tulimfunulia mama yake Musa kwa kumwambia: Mnyonyeshe. Na utakapo mkhofia basi mtie mtoni, na usikhofu wala usihuzunike. Hakika Sisi tutamrudisha kwako na tutamfanya miongoni mwa Mitume.
translation_en: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers."

arabic_text: فَٱلْتَقَطَهُۥٓ ءَالُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّۭا وَحَزَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰطِـِٔينَ
translation_sw: Basi wakamwokota watu wa Firauni, aje kuwa adui kwao na huzuni. Hakika Firauni na Hamana na majeshi yao walikuwa wenye makosa.
translation_en: And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief. Indeed, Pharaoh and Haman and their soldiers were deliberate sinners.

arabic_text: وَقَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍۢ لِّى وَلَكَ ۖ لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na mkewe Firauni alisema: Atakuwa kiburudisho cha macho kwangu na kwako. Msimuuwe! Huenda akatufaa, au tumpange kuwa mwenetu. Wala wao hawakutambua.
translation_en: And the wife of Pharaoh said, "[He will be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he may benefit us, or we may adopt him as a son." And they perceived not.

arabic_text: وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَٰرِغًا ۖ إِن كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِى بِهِۦ لَوْلَآ أَن رَّبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na moyo wa mama yake Musa ukawa mtupu. Alikuwa karibu kumdhihirisha, ingeli kuwa hatukumtia nguvu moyo wake ili awe miongoni mwa Waumini.
translation_en: And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.

arabic_text: وَقَالَتْ لِأُخْتِهِۦ قُصِّيهِ ۖ فَبَصُرَتْ بِهِۦ عَن جُنُبٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Naye akamwambia dada yake Musa: Mfuatie. Basi naye akawa anamuangalia kwa mbali bila ya wao kujua.
translation_en: And she said to his sister, "Follow him"; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.

arabic_text: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَٰصِحُونَ
translation_sw: Na tukamjaalia awakatae wanyonyeshaji wote tangu mwanzo, mpaka dada yake akasema: Je! Nikuonyesheni watu wa nyumba watakao mlea kwa ajili yenu, nao pia watakuwa wema kwake?
translation_en: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"

arabic_text: فَرَدَدْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّهِۦ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَلِتَعْلَمَ أَنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Basi tukamrudisha kwa mama yake ili macho yake yaburudike, wala asihuzunike. Na ajue ya kwamba ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni ya kweli, lakini wengi wao hawajui.
translation_en: So We restored him to his mother that she might be content and not grieve and that she would know that the promise of Allah is true. But most of the people do not know.

arabic_text: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَٱسْتَوَىٰٓ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na Musa alipo fika utu-uzima baraabara, tulimpa akili na ilimu. Na hivi ndivyo tunavyo walipa walio wema.
translation_en: And when he attained his full strength and was [mentally] mature, We bestowed upon him judgement and knowledge. And thus do We reward the doers of good.

arabic_text: وَدَخَلَ ٱلْمَدِينَةَ عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ أَهْلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيْنِ يَقْتَتِلَانِ هَٰذَا مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ وَهَٰذَا مِنْ عَدُوِّهِۦ ۖ فَٱسْتَغَٰثَهُ ٱلَّذِى مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ عَلَى ٱلَّذِى مِنْ عَدُوِّهِۦ فَوَكَزَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ۖ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّضِلٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Na akaingia mjini wakati wa kughafilika wenyeji wake, na akakuta humo watu wawili wanapigana - mmoja ni katika wenzake, na mwengine katika maadui zake. Yule mwenzake alimtaka msaada kumpiga adui yake. Musa akampiga ngumi, akamuuwa. Akasema: Hiki ni kitendo cha Shet'ani; hakika yeye ni adui, mpotezaji dhaahiri.
translation_en: And he entered the city at a time of inattention by its people and found therein two men fighting: one from his faction and one from among his enemy. And the one from his faction called for help to him against the one from his enemy, so Moses struck him and [unintentionally] killed him. [Moses] said, "This is from the work of Satan. Indeed, he is a manifest, misleading enemy."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَٱغْفِرْ لِى فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika mimi nimejidhulumu nafsi yangu; basi nisamehe. Akamsamehe; hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kusamehe Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًۭا لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Kwa ulivyo nineemesha, basi mimi sitakuwa kabisa msaidizi wa wakosefu.
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."

arabic_text: فَأَصْبَحَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ خَآئِفًۭا يَتَرَقَّبُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَنصَرَهُۥ بِٱلْأَمْسِ يَسْتَصْرِخُهُۥ ۚ قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّكَ لَغَوِىٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Akapambazukiwa mjini asubuhi naye ana khofu, akiangalia huku na huku. Mara yule yule aliye mtaka msaada jana akawa anampigia kelele amsaidie. Musa akamwambia: Hakika wewe ni mgomvi kweli kweli.
translation_en: And he became inside the city fearful and anticipating [exposure], when suddenly the one who sought his help the previous day cried out to him [once again]. Moses said to him, "Indeed, you are an evident, [persistent] deviator."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ أَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَبْطِشَ بِٱلَّذِى هُوَ عَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُمَا قَالَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ أَتُرِيدُ أَن تَقْتُلَنِى كَمَا قَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۢا بِٱلْأَمْسِ ۖ إِن تُرِيدُ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ جَبَّارًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُرِيدُ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُصْلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Basi alipo taka kumshika kwa nguvu yule aliye adui wao wote wawili, akasema: Ewe Musa! Unataka kuniuwa kama ulivyo muuwa mtu jana? Wewe hutaki ila kuwa jabari katika nchi, wala hutaki kuwa miongoni mwa wenye maslaha..
translation_en: And when he wanted to strike the one who was an enemy to both of them, he said, "O Moses, do you intend to kill me as you killed someone yesterday? You only want to be a tyrant in the land and do not want to be of the amenders."

arabic_text: وَجَآءَ رَجُلٌۭ مِّنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱلْمَلَأَ يَأْتَمِرُونَ بِكَ لِيَقْتُلُوكَ فَٱخْرُجْ إِنِّى لَكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّٰصِحِينَ
translation_sw: Na akaja mtu kutoka mwisho wa mji akipiga mbio, akasema: Ewe Musa! Wakubwa wanashauriana kukuuwa. Basi toka! Hakika mimi ni katika wanao kupa nasaha.
translation_en: And a man came from the farthest end of the city, running. He said, "O Moses, indeed the eminent ones are conferring over you [intending] to kill you, so leave [the city]; indeed, I am to you of the sincere advisors."

arabic_text: فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَآئِفًۭا يَتَرَقَّبُ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Basi akatoka, naye ana khofu, akiangalia huku na huku. Akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Niokoe na watu madhaalimu.
translation_en: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people."

arabic_text: وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلْقَآءَ مَدْيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِى سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
translation_sw: Na alipo elekea upande wa Madyana alisema: Asaa Mola wangu Mlezi akaniongoa njia iliyo sawa.
translation_en: And when he directed himself toward Madyan, he said, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way."

arabic_text: وَلَمَّا وَرَدَ مَآءَ مَدْيَنَ وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ أُمَّةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْقُونَ وَوَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمُ ٱمْرَأَتَيْنِ تَذُودَانِ ۖ قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُمَا ۖ قَالَتَا لَا نَسْقِى حَتَّىٰ يُصْدِرَ ٱلرِّعَآءُ ۖ وَأَبُونَا شَيْخٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Na alipo yafikia maji ya Madyana alikuta umati wa watu wananywesha (wanyama wao), na akakuta karibu yao wanawake wawili wanawazuia wanyama wao. Akasema: Mna nini? Wakasema: Hatunyweshi sisi mpaka wamalize hao wachunga. Na baba yetu ni mzee sana.
translation_en: And when he came to the well of Madyan, he found there a crowd of people watering [their flocks], and he found aside from them two women driving back [their flocks]. He said, "What is your circumstance?" They said, "We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks]; and our father is an old man."

arabic_text: فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ فَقِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi Musa akawanyweshea; kisha akarudi kivulini, na akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika mimi ni mhitaji wa kheri utakayo niteremshia.
translation_en: So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."

arabic_text: فَجَآءَتْهُ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا تَمْشِى عَلَى ٱسْتِحْيَآءٍۢ قَالَتْ إِنَّ أَبِى يَدْعُوكَ لِيَجْزِيَكَ أَجْرَ مَا سَقَيْتَ لَنَا ۚ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُۥ وَقَصَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَصَصَ قَالَ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ نَجَوْتَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Basi mmoja katika wale wanawake wawili akamjia, naye anaona haya. Akasema: Baba yangu anakwita akulipe ujira wa kutunyweshea. Basi alipo mjia na akamsimulia visa vyake, alisema: Usiogope; umekwisha okoka kwenye watu madhaalimu.
translation_en: Then one of the two women came to him walking with shyness. She said, "Indeed, my father invites you that he may reward you for having watered for us." So when he came to him and related to him the story, he said, "Fear not. You have escaped from the wrongdoing people."

arabic_text: قَالَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱسْتَـْٔجِرْهُ ۖ إِنَّ خَيْرَ مَنِ ٱسْتَـْٔجَرْتَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْأَمِينُ
translation_sw: Akasema mmoja katika wale wanawake: Ewe baba yetu! Muajiri huyu. Hakika mbora wa kumuajiri ni mwenye nguvu na muaminifu.
translation_en: One of the women said, "O my father, hire him. Indeed, the best one you can hire is the strong and the trustworthy."

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُنكِحَكَ إِحْدَى ٱبْنَتَىَّ هَٰتَيْنِ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَأْجُرَنِى ثَمَٰنِىَ حِجَجٍۢ ۖ فَإِنْ أَتْمَمْتَ عَشْرًۭا فَمِنْ عِندِكَ ۖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَيْكَ ۚ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mimi nataka kukuoza mmojawapo katika binti zangu hawa wawili kwa kunitumikia miaka minane. Ukitimiza kumi, khiari yako; lakini mimi sitaki kukutaabisha. Inshallah utanikuta miongoni mwa watu wema.
translation_en: He said, "Indeed, I wish to wed you one of these, my two daughters, on [the condition] that you serve me for eight years; but if you complete ten, it will be [as a favor] from you. And I do not wish to put you in difficulty. You will find me, if Allah wills, from among the righteous."

arabic_text: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ ۖ أَيَّمَا ٱلْأَجَلَيْنِ قَضَيْتُ فَلَا عُدْوَٰنَ عَلَىَّ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌۭ
translation_sw: Musa akasema: Hayo yamekwisha kuwa baina yangu na wewe. Muda mmojapo nikiumaliza sitiwi ubayani. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mlinzi juu ya haya tunayo yasema.
translation_en: [Moses] said, "That is [established] between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I complete - there is no injustice to me, and Allah, over what we say, is Witness."

arabic_text: ۞ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلْأَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِأَهْلِهِۦٓ ءَانَسَ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ نَارًۭا قَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ جَذْوَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
translation_sw: Basi alipo timiza muda wake na akasafiri na ahali zake, aliona moto upande wa Mlima T'uri. Akawaambia ahali zake: Ngojeni! Mimi nimeona moto, labda nitakuleteeni kutoka huko khabari au kijinga cha moto ili mpate kuota moto.
translation_en: And when Moses had completed the term and was traveling with his family, he perceived from the direction of the mount a fire. He said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire. Perhaps I will bring you from there [some] information or burning wood from the fire that you may warm yourselves."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ مِن شَٰطِئِ ٱلْوَادِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ فِى ٱلْبُقْعَةِ ٱلْمُبَٰرَكَةِ مِنَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ أَن يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Basi alipo ufikia aliitwa kutoka ng'ambo ya bonde la kuliani katika eneo lilio barikiwa kutoka kwenye mti: Ewe Musa! Hakika Mimi ni Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: But when he came to it, he was called from the right side of the valley in a blessed spot - from the tree, "O Moses, indeed I am Allah, Lord of the worlds."

arabic_text: وَأَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّۭ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًۭا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ أَقْبِلْ وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْءَامِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na tupa chini fimbo yako. Basi alipo iona ikitikisika kama nyoka, akarudi nyuma wala hakutazama. (Akaambiwa): Ewe Musa! Njoo mbele wala usiogope. Hakika wewe ni miongoni mwa walio salimika.
translation_en: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it was a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, approach and fear not. Indeed, you are of the secure.

arabic_text: ٱسْلُكْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍۢ وَٱضْمُمْ إِلَيْكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ ٱلرَّهْبِ ۖ فَذَٰنِكَ بُرْهَٰنَانِ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
translation_sw: Ingiza mkono wako kwenye mfuko wako, utatoka mweupe pasipo na ubaya. Na jiambatishe mkono wako ukihisi khofu. Basi hizi ni dalili mbili zitokazo kwa Mola wako Mlezi kumpelekea Firauni na wakuu wa umma wake. Hakika hao walikuwa watu mafaasiki.
translation_en: Insert your hand into the opening of your garment; it will come out white, without disease. And draw in your arm close to you [as prevention] from fear, for those are two proofs from your Lord to Pharaoh and his establishment. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى قَتَلْتُ مِنْهُمْ نَفْسًۭا فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika mimi nilimuuwa mtu katika wao, kwa hivyo naogopa wataniuwa.
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, indeed, I killed from among them someone, and I fear they will kill me.

arabic_text: وَأَخِى هَٰرُونُ هُوَ أَفْصَحُ مِنِّى لِسَانًۭا فَأَرْسِلْهُ مَعِىَ رِدْءًۭا يُصَدِّقُنِىٓ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
translation_sw: Na ndugu yangu Harun ni fasihi zaidi ulimi wake kuliko mimi. Basi mtume ende nami kunisaidia, ili anisadikishe. Hakika mimi nina khofu watanikadhibisha.
translation_en: And my brother Aaron is more fluent than me in tongue, so send him with me as support, verifying me. Indeed, I fear that they will deny me."

arabic_text: قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِأَخِيكَ وَنَجْعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلْطَٰنًۭا فَلَا يَصِلُونَ إِلَيْكُمَا ۚ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أَنتُمَا وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكُمَا ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
translation_sw: (Mwenyezi Mungu) akasema: Tutautia nguvu mkono wako kwa nduguyo, na tutakupeni madaraka, hata wasikufikilieni. Kwa sababu ya Ishara zetu nyinyi na watakao kufuateni mtashinda.
translation_en: [Allah] said, "We will strengthen your arm through your brother and grant you both supremacy so they will not reach you. [It will be] through Our signs; you and those who follow you will be the predominant."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّفْتَرًۭى وَمَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Basi alipo wafikia Musa na Ishara zetu, walisema: Haya si chochote ila ni uchawi ulio zuliwa. Na hatukuyasikia haya kwa baba zetu wa zamani.
translation_en: But when Moses came to them with Our signs as clear evidences, they said, "This is not except invented magic, and we have not heard of this [religion] among our forefathers."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن جَآءَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ مِنْ عِندِهِۦ وَمَن تَكُونُ لَهُۥ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلدَّارِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na Musa akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi ni Mwenye kujua kabisa nani anaye kuja na uwongofu unao toka kwake, na nani atakaye kuwa na mwisho mwema wa makaazi. Hakika wenye kudhulumu hawatafanikiwa.
translation_en: And Moses said, "My Lord is more knowing [than we or you] of who has come with guidance from Him and to whom will be succession in the home. Indeed, wrongdoers do not succeed."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَأُ مَا عَلِمْتُ لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرِى فَأَوْقِدْ لِى يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلطِّينِ فَٱجْعَل لِّى صَرْحًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ أَطَّلِعُ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
translation_sw: Na Firauni akasema: Enyi waheshimiwa! Sijui kama mnaye mungu asiye kuwa mimi. Ewe Haman! Niwashie moto unichomee udongo, unijengee mnara nipate kumchungulia mungu wa Musa. Na hakika mimi namwona yeye ni katika waongo.
translation_en: And Pharaoh said, "O eminent ones, I have not known you to have a god other than me. Then ignite for me, O Haman, [a fire] upon the clay and make for me a tower that I may look at the God of Moses. And indeed, I do think he is among the liars."

arabic_text: وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ هُوَ وَجُنُودُهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا يُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na alipanda kiburi yeye na majeshi yake katika nchi bila ya haki, na wakadhania kuwa hawatarudishwa kwetu.
translation_en: And he was arrogant, he and his soldiers, in the land, without right, and they thought that they would not be returned to Us.

arabic_text: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Basi tukamshika yeye na majeshi yake, na tukawatupa baharini. Basi hebu angalia ulikuwaje mwisho wa wenye kudhulumu?
translation_en: So We took him and his soldiers and threw them into the sea. So see how was the end of the wrongdoers.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةًۭ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na tuliwafanya ni waongozi waitao kwenye Moto. Na Siku ya Kiyama hawatanusuriwa.
translation_en: And We made them leaders inviting to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.

arabic_text: وَأَتْبَعْنَٰهُمْ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةًۭ ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ هُم مِّنَ ٱلْمَقْبُوحِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukawafuatishia laana katika dunia hii, na Siku ya Kiyama watakuwa miongoni mwa wanao chusha.
translation_en: And We caused to overtake them in this world a curse, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be of the despised.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ أَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْقُرُونَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ بَصَآئِرَ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika bila ya shaka tulimpa Musa Kitabu baada ya kwisha ziangamiza kaumu za mwanzo, ili kiwafumbue macho watu, na kiwe uwongofu, na rehema, ili wapate kukumbuka.
translation_en: And We gave Moses the Scripture, after We had destroyed the former generations, as enlightenment for the people and guidance and mercy that they might be reminded.

arabic_text: وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلْغَرْبِىِّ إِذْ قَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلْأَمْرَ وَمَا كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
translation_sw: Wala wewe hukuwa upande wa magharibi tulipo mpa Musa amri, wala hukuwa katika walio hudhuria.
translation_en: And you, [O Muhammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when We revealed to Moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that].

arabic_text: وَلَٰكِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَا قُرُونًۭا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۚ وَمَا كُنتَ ثَاوِيًۭا فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ تَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
translation_sw: Lakini Sisi tuliziumba kaumu, na ukawa mrefu umri juu yao. Wala hukuwa mkaazi na watu wa Madyana ukiwasomea Aya zetu. Lakini ni Sisi tulio kuwa tukiwatuma Mitume.
translation_en: But We produced [many] generations [after Moses], and prolonged was their duration. And you were not a resident among the people of Madyan, reciting to them Our verses, but We were senders [of this message].

arabic_text: وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ إِذْ نَادَيْنَا وَلَٰكِن رَّحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Wala hukuwa kando ya mlima tulipo nadi. Lakini ni rehema itokayo kwa Mola wako Mlezi ili uwaonye watu wasio pata kufikiwa na mwonyaji kabla yako, huenda wakakumbuka.
translation_en: And you were not at the side of the mount when We called [Moses] but [were sent] as a mercy from your Lord to warn a people to whom no warner had come before you that they might be reminded.

arabic_text: وَلَوْلَآ أَن تُصِيبَهُم مُّصِيبَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًۭا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na usije kuwasibu msiba kwa iliyo yatanguliza mikono yao, wakasema: Ewe Mola wetu Mlezi! Mbona hukututumia Mtume nasi, tukafuata Ishara zako, na tukawa miongoni mwa Waumini?
translation_en: And if not that a disaster should strike them for what their hands put forth [of sins] and they would say, "Our Lord, why did You not send us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses and been among the believers?"...

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُوتِىَ مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ قَالُوا۟ سِحْرَانِ تَظَٰهَرَا وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِكُلٍّۢ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Ilipo wajia Haki kutoka kwetu walisema: Mbona hakupewa kama aliyo pewa Musa? Je! Kwani wao hawakuyakataa aliyo pewa Musa zamani? Walisema: Ni wachawi wawili wanasaidiana. Na wakasema: Hakika sisi tunawakataa wote.
translation_en: But when the truth came to them from Us, they said, "Why was he not given like that which was given to Moses?" Did they not disbelieve in that which was given to Moses before? They said, "[They are but] two works of magic supporting each other, and indeed we are, in both, disbelievers."

arabic_text: قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَٰبٍۢ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْهُمَآ أَتَّبِعْهُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Basi leteni Kitabu kinacho toka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu chenye kuongoka zaidi kuliko hivi viwili tukifuate, kama nyinyi mnasema kweli.
translation_en: Say, "Then bring a scripture from Allah which is more guiding than either of them that I may follow it, if you should be truthful."

arabic_text: فَإِن لَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَكَ فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّمَا يَتَّبِعُونَ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ بِغَيْرِ هُدًۭى مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na ikiwa hawakuitikii, basi jua kuwa wanafuata pumbao lao tu. Na nani aliye potea zaidi kumshinda anaye fuata pumbao lake bila ya uwongofu utokao kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu hawaongoi watu wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: But if they do not respond to you - then know that they only follow their [own] desires. And who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from Allah? Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

arabic_text: ۞ وَلَقَدْ وَصَّلْنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Na sasa kwa yakini tumewafikishia Neno ili wapate kukumbuka.
translation_en: And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the Qur'an that they might be reminded.

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ هُم بِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Wale tulio wapa Kitabu kabla yake wanakiamini hiki.
translation_en: Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it - they are believers in it.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo somewa wanasema: Tunaiamini. Hakika hii ni Haki inayo toka kwa Mola wetu Mlezi. Hakika sisi kabla yake tulikuwa ni Waislamu, tulio nyenyekea.
translation_en: And when it is recited to them, they say, "We have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our Lord. Indeed we were, [even] before it, Muslims [submitting to Allah]."

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُؤْتَوْنَ أَجْرَهُم مَّرَّتَيْنِ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
translation_sw: Basi hao watapewa ujira wao mara mbili kwa walivyo vumilia, na wakaondoa ubaya kwa wema, na wakatoa katika tuliyo waruzuku.
translation_en: Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱللَّغْوَ أَعْرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ لَنَآ أَعْمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا نَبْتَغِى ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo sikia upuuzi hujitenga nao na husema: Sisi tuna vitendo vyetu, na nyinyi mna vitendo vyenu. Salamun Alaikum, Amani juu yenu! Sisi hatutaki kujibizana na wajinga.
translation_en: And when they hear ill speech, they turn away from it and say, "For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. Peace will be upon you; we seek not the ignorant."

arabic_text: إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِى مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika wewe humwongoi umpendaye, lakini Mwenyezi Mungu humwongoa amtakaye. Na Yeye ndiye anawajua zaidi waongokao.
translation_en: Indeed, [O Muhammad], you do not guide whom you like, but Allah guides whom He wills. And He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِن نَّتَّبِعِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ مَعَكَ نُتَخَطَّفْ مِنْ أَرْضِنَآ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّهُمْ حَرَمًا ءَامِنًۭا يُجْبَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ ثَمَرَٰتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ رِّزْقًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na wakasema: Tukiufuata uwongofu huu pamoja nawe tutanyakuliwa kutoka nchi yetu. Je! Kwani Sisi hatukuwaweka imara katika pahala patakatifu, penye amani, ambapo huletewa matunda ya kila aina kuwa ni riziki itokayo kwetu? Lakini wengi wao hawajui.
translation_en: And they say, "If we were to follow the guidance with you, we would be swept from our land." Have we not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from Us? But most of them do not know.

arabic_text: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍۭ بَطِرَتْ مَعِيشَتَهَا ۖ فَتِلْكَ مَسَٰكِنُهُمْ لَمْ تُسْكَن مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ وَكُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
translation_sw: Na miji mingapi iliyo jifakharisha tumeiangamiza! Na hayo maskani yao hayakukaliwa tena baada yao, ila kwa uchache tu. Na Sisi ndio tumekuwa warithi wao.
translation_en: And how many a city have We destroyed that was insolent in its [way of] living, and those are their dwellings which have not been inhabited after them except briefly. And it is We who were the inheritors.

arabic_text: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يَبْعَثَ فِىٓ أُمِّهَا رَسُولًۭا يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ۚ وَمَا كُنَّا مُهْلِكِى ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا وَأَهْلُهَا ظَٰلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mola wako Mlezi haangamizi miji mpaka ampeleke Mtume katika miji yake mikuu awasomee Ishara zetu. Wala hatuiangamizi miji mpaka watu wake wawe madhaalimu.
translation_en: And never would your Lord have destroyed the cities until He had sent to their mother a messenger reciting to them Our verses. And We would not destroy the cities except while their people were wrongdoers.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتُهَا ۚ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na chochote mlicho pewa ni matumizi ya maisha ya dunia na pambo lake. Na yaliyoko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ndio bora na yatakayo baki zaidi. Basi je, hamfahamu?
translation_en: And whatever thing you [people] have been given - it is [only for] the enjoyment of worldly life and its adornment. And what is with Allah is better and more lasting; so will you not use reason?

arabic_text: أَفَمَن وَعَدْنَٰهُ وَعْدًا حَسَنًۭا فَهُوَ لَٰقِيهِ كَمَن مَّتَّعْنَٰهُ مَتَٰعَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ هُوَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
translation_sw: Je! Yule tuliye muahidi ahadi nzuri, tena naye akayapata, ni kama tuliye mstarehesha kwa starehe za maisha ya duniani, na kisha Siku ya Kiyama akawa miongoni mwa wanao hudhurishwa?
translation_en: Then is he whom We have promised a good promise which he will obtain like he for whom We provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the Day of Resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in Hell]?

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
translation_sw: Na siku atakapo waita na akasema: Wako wapi mlio kuwa mkidai kuwa ni washirika wangu?
translation_en: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are My 'partners' which you used to claim?"

arabic_text: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ رَبَّنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَغْوَيْنَآ أَغْوَيْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا غَوَيْنَا ۖ تَبَرَّأْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ۖ مَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِيَّانَا يَعْبُدُونَ
translation_sw: Watasema wale iliyo thibiti juu yao kauli: Mola wetu Mlezi! Hawa ndio tulio wapoteza. Tuliwapoteza kama tulivyo potea sisi. Tunajitenga nao mbele yako. Hawakuwa wakituabudu sisi.
translation_en: Those upon whom the word will have come into effect will say, "Our Lord, these are the ones we led to error. We led them to error just as we were in error. We declare our disassociation [from them] to You. They did not used to worship us."

arabic_text: وَقِيلَ ٱدْعُوا۟ شُرَكَآءَكُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُمْ وَرَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۚ لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَهْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Na itasemwa: Waiteni hao miungu wa kishirikina wenu! Basi watawaita, lakini hawatawaitikia, na wataiona adhabu; laiti wangeli kuwa wameongoka!
translation_en: And it will be said, "Invoke your 'partners' " and they will invoke them; but they will not respond to them, and they will see the punishment. If only they had followed guidance!

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ أَجَبْتُمُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Na siku atapo waita na akasema: Mliwajibu nini Mitume?
translation_en: And [mention] the Day He will call them and say, "What did you answer the messengers?"

arabic_text: فَعَمِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فَهُمْ لَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_sw: Basi zitawapotea khabari siku hiyo, nao hawataulizana.
translation_en: But the information will be unapparent to them that Day, so they will not [be able to] ask one another.

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَعَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Ama mwenye kutubu na akaamini na akatenda mema, huyo atakuwa miongoni mwa wenye kufanikiwa.
translation_en: But as for one who had repented, believed, and done righteousness, it is promised by Allah that he will be among the successful.

arabic_text: وَرَبُّكَ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيَخْتَارُ ۗ مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ ٱلْخِيَرَةُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mola wako Mlezi huumba na huteuwa atakavyo. Viumbe hawana khiari. Mwenyezi Mungu ametukuka na ametakasika na hao wanao washirikisha naye.
translation_en: And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses; not for them was the choice. Exalted is Allah and high above what they associate with Him.

arabic_text: وَرَبُّكَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mola wako Mlezi anayajua yaliyo ficha vifua vyao, na wanayo yatangaza.
translation_en: And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Naye ni Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye hapana mungu isipo kuwa Yeye. Sifa zote njema ni zake Yeye, mwanzo na mwisho. Na hukumu ni yake Yeye. Na kwake Yeye mtarejeshwa.
