translation_en: And He is Allah; there is no deity except Him. To Him is [due all] praise in the first [life] and the Hereafter. And His is the [final] decision, and to Him you will be returned.

arabic_text: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مَنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِضِيَآءٍ ۖ أَفَلَا تَسْمَعُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Mwaonaje, Mwenyezi Mungu angeli ufanya usiku umekukalieni moja kwa moja mpaka Siku ya Kiyama, mungu gani asiye kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu atakaye kuleteeni mwangaza? Basi je, hamsikii?
translation_en: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should make for you the night continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allah could bring you light? Then will you not hear?"

arabic_text: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلنَّهَارَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مَنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِلَيْلٍۢ تَسْكُنُونَ فِيهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Mwaonaje, Mwenyezi Mungu angeli ufanya mchana umekukalieni moja kwa moja mpaka Siku ya Kiyama, mungu gani asiye kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu ataye kuleteeni usiku mkapumzika humo? Basi je, hamwoni?
translation_en: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should make for you the day continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allah could bring you a night in which you may rest? Then will you not see?"

arabic_text: وَمِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na ni katika rehema zake amekufanyieni usiku na mchana mpate kupumzika humo na mtafute fadhila zake, na ili mpate kushukuru.
translation_en: And out of His mercy He made for you the night and the day that you may rest therein and [by day] seek from His bounty and [that] perhaps you will be grateful.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
translation_sw: Na siku atakapo waita na akasema: Wako wapi hao mlio kuwa mkidai kuwa ni washirika wangu?
translation_en: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are my 'partners' which you used to claim?"

arabic_text: وَنَزَعْنَا مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ شَهِيدًۭا فَقُلْنَا هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ فَعَلِمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلْحَقَّ لِلَّهِ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na tutatoa shahidi katika kila umma, na tutasema: Leteni hoja zenu! Hapo watajua kwamba hakika kweli ni ya Mwenyezi Mungu, na yatawapotea yale waliyo kuwa wakiyazua.
translation_en: And We will extract from every nation a witness and say, "Produce your proof," and they will know that the truth belongs to Allah, and lost from them is that which they used to invent.

arabic_text: ۞ إِنَّ قَٰرُونَ كَانَ مِن قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰ فَبَغَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْكُنُوزِ مَآ إِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهُۥ لَتَنُوٓأُ بِٱلْعُصْبَةِ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُوَّةِ إِذْ قَالَ لَهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ لَا تَفْرَحْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْفَرِحِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika Qaruni alikuwa katika watu wa Musa, lakini aliwafanyia dhulma. Na tulimpa khazina ambazo funguo zake zinawatopeza watu wenye nguvu kuzichukua. Walipo mwambia watu wake: Usijigambe! Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu hawapendi wanao jigamba.
translation_en: Indeed, Qarun was from the people of Moses, but he tyrannized them. And We gave him of treasures whose keys would burden a band of strong men; thereupon his people said to him, "Do not exult. Indeed, Allah does not like the exultant.

arabic_text: وَٱبْتَغِ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ ۖ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَأَحْسِن كَمَآ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَلَا تَبْغِ ٱلْفَسَادَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
translation_sw: Na utafute, kwa aliyo kupa Mwenyezi Mungu, makaazi ya Akhera. Wala usisahau fungu lako la dunia. Nawe fanya wema kama Mwenyezi Mungu alivyo kufanyia wema wewe. Wala usitafute kufanya ufisadi katika ardhi. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu hawapendi mafisadi.
translation_en: But seek, through that which Allah has given you, the home of the Hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world. And do good as Allah has done good to you. And desire not corruption in the land. Indeed, Allah does not like corrupters."

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عِندِىٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَهْلَكَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مَنْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُ قُوَّةًۭ وَأَكْثَرُ جَمْعًۭا ۚ وَلَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذُنُوبِهِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Kwa hakika nimepewa haya kwa sababu ya ilimu niliyo nayo. Je! Hakujua kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu kesha waangamiza, katika vizazi vya walio kabla yake, watu walio kuwa wenye ngubvu zaidi kuliko yeye, na wenye makundi makubwa zaidi kuliko yake. Na wakosefu hawataulizwa khabari ya dhambi zao.
translation_en: He said, "I was only given it because of knowledge I have." Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? But the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked.

arabic_text: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi akawatokea watu wake katika pambo lake. Wakasema wale walio kuwa wanataka maisha ya duniani: Laiti tungeli kuwa tunayo kama aliyo pewa Qaruni! Hakika yeye ni mwenye bahati kubwa.
translation_en: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qarun. Indeed, he is one of great fortune."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَيْلَكُمْ ثَوَابُ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌۭ لِّمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا وَلَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wakasema wale walio pewa ilimu: Ole wenu! Malipo ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni bora kwa mwenye kuamini na akatenda mema. Wala hawatapewa hayo isipo kuwa wenye subira.
translation_en: But those who had been given knowledge said, "Woe to you! The reward of Allah is better for he who believes and does righteousness. And none are granted it except the patient."

arabic_text: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
translation_sw: Basi tukamdidimiza yeye na nyumba yake katika ardhi; wala halikuwepo kundi lolote la kumnusuru kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, wala hakuwa miongoni mwa wanao jitetea.
translation_en: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves.

arabic_text: وَأَصْبَحَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَمَنَّوْا۟ مَكَانَهُۥ بِٱلْأَمْسِ يَقُولُونَ وَيْكَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ ۖ لَوْلَآ أَن مَّنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا لَخَسَفَ بِنَا ۖ وَيْكَأَنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wale walio tamani kuwa pahala pake jana, wakawa wanasema: Kumbe Mwenyezi Mungu humkunjulia riziki amtakaye katika waja wake, na humdhikisha amtakaye. Ingeli kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu hakutufanyia hisani angeli tudidimiza. Kumbe makafiri hawafanikiwi!
translation_en: And those who had wished for his position the previous day began to say, "Oh, how Allah extends provision to whom He wills of His servants and restricts it! If not that Allah had conferred favor on us, He would have caused it to swallow us. Oh, how the disbelievers do not succeed!"

arabic_text: تِلْكَ ٱلدَّارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ نَجْعَلُهَا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُرِيدُونَ عُلُوًّۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فَسَادًۭا ۚ وَٱلْعَٰقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_sw: Hayo ndiyo makaazi ya Akhera, tumewafanyia wale wasio taka kujitukuza duniani wala ufisadi. Na mwisho mwema ni wa wachamngu.
translation_en: That home of the Hereafter We assign to those who do not desire exaltedness upon the earth or corruption. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous.

arabic_text: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهَا ۖ وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَى ٱلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Atakaye tenda wema atapata malipo bora kuliko huo wema alio utenda. Na atakaye tenda uovu, hawalipwi watendao uovu ila waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda.
translation_en: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it; and whoever comes with an evil deed - then those who did evil deeds will not be recompensed except [as much as] what they used to do.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِى فَرَضَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لَرَآدُّكَ إِلَىٰ مَعَادٍۢ ۚ قُل رَّبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَمَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika aliye kulazimisha kuifuata Qur'ani hapana shaka atakurudisha pahala pa marejeo. Sema: Mola wangu Mlezi ndiye anaye mjua zaidi mwenye kuja na uwongofu, na nani aliyomo katika upotofu ulio dhaahiri.
translation_en: Indeed, [O Muhammad], He who imposed upon you the Qur'an will take you back to a place of return. Say, "My Lord is most knowing of who brings guidance and who is in clear error."

arabic_text: وَمَا كُنتَ تَرْجُوٓا۟ أَن يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ ظَهِيرًۭا لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Nawe hukuwa unataraji kuletewa Kitabu; lakini ni rehema tu ya Mola wako Mlezi. Basi usiwe msaidizi wa makafiri.
translation_en: And you were not expecting that the Book would be conveyed to you, but [it is] a mercy from your Lord. So do not be an assistant to the disbelievers.

arabic_text: وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أُنزِلَتْ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
translation_sw: Wala wasikuzuie kuzifuata Aya za Mwenyezi Mungu baada ya kuteremshiwa wewe. Na lingania kwa Mola wako Mlezi, wala usiwe miongoni mwa washirikina.
translation_en: And never let them avert you from the verses of Allah after they have been revealed to you. And invite [people] to your Lord. And never be of those who associate others with Allah.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۘ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجْهَهُۥ ۚ لَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Wala usimwombe pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu mungu mwenginewe. Hapana mungu ila Yeye. Kila kitu kitaangamia isipo kuwa Yeye. Hukumu iko kwake, na kwake mtarejezwa.
translation_en: And do not invoke with Allah another deity. There is no deity except Him. Everything will be destroyed except His Face. His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned.

arabic_text: الٓمٓ
translation_sw: Alif Lam Mim (A. L. M.)
translation_en: Alif, Lam, Meem

arabic_text: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Wanadhani watu wataachwa kwa kuwa wanasema: Tumeamini. Nao wasijaribiwe?
translation_en: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried?

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika tuliwajaribu walio kuwa kabla yao, na kwa yakini Mwenyezi Mungu atawatambulisha walio wa kweli na atawatambulisha walio waongo.
translation_en: But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allah will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.

arabic_text: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَسْبِقُونَا ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
translation_sw: Au wanadhani wanao tenda maovu kwamba watatushinda? Hukumu mbaya hiyo wanayo hukumu.
translation_en: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun Us? Evil is what they judge.

arabic_text: مَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ لَءَاتٍۢ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Mwenye kutaraji kukutana na Mwenyezi Mungu, basi hakika miadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu itafika bila ya shaka. Naye ni Mwenye kusikia, Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allah - indeed, the term decreed by Allah is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

arabic_text: وَمَن جَٰهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَٰهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na anaye fanya juhudi basi bila ya shaka anafanya juhudi kwa ajili ya nafsi yake. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu si mhitaji wa walimwengu.
translation_en: And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na walio amini na wakatenda mema, kwa yakini tutawafutia makosa yao, na tutawalipa bora ya waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda.
translation_en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do.

arabic_text: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حُسْنًۭا ۖ وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَآ ۚ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na tumemuusia mwanaadamu kuwafanyia wema wazazi wake. Na ikiwa watakushikilia unishirikishe Mimi na usiyo kuwa na ujuzi nayo, basi usiwat'ii. Kwangu Mimi ndio marejeo yenu, na nitakwambieni mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda.
translation_en: And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Na walio amini na wakatenda mema, bila ya shaka tutawatia miongoni mwa watu wema.
translation_en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].

arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِىَ فِى ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ ۚ أَوَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِى صُدُورِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na katika watu wapo wanao sema: Tumemuamini Mwenyezi Mungu. Lakini wanapo pewa maudhi kwa ajili ya Mwenyezi Mungu, wanayafanya mateso ya watu kama ni adhabu ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na inapo kuja nusura kutoka kwa Mola wako Mlezi husema: Hakika sisi tulikuwa pamoja nanyi. Kwani Mwenyezi Mungu hayajui yaliomo vifuani mwa walimwengu?
translation_en: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allah, they consider the trial of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, "Indeed, We were with you." Is not Allah most knowing of what is within the breasts of all creatures?

arabic_text: وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na hapana shaka Mwenyezi Mungu atawatambulisha walio amini, na atawatambulisha wanaafiki.
translation_en: And Allah will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَٰيَٰكُمْ وَمَا هُم بِحَٰمِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَٰيَٰهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru waliwaambia walio amini: Fuateni njia yetu, nasi tutayabeba makosa yenu. Wala wao hawatabeba katika makosa yao chochote kile. Hakika hao ni waongo.
translation_en: And those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Follow our way, and we will carry your sins." But they will not carry anything of their sins. Indeed, they are liars.

arabic_text: وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًۭا مَّعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ ۖ وَلَيُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na hapana shaka wataibeba mizigo yao na mizigo mingine pamoja na mizigo yao. Na kwa yakini wataulizwa Siku ya Kiyama juu ya waliyo kuwa wakiyazua.
translation_en: But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًۭا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tulimtuma Nuhu kwa watu wake, na akakaa nao miaka elfu kasoro miaka khamsini. Basi tufani liliwachukua, nao ni madhaalimu.
translation_en: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.

arabic_text: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَأَصْحَٰبَ ٱلسَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Nasi tukamwokoa yeye na wenziwe wa katika safina, na tukaifanya kuwa ni Ishara kwa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it a sign for the worlds.

arabic_text: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ ۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na Ibrahim pale alipo waambia watu wake: Muabuduni Mwenyezi Mungu, na mcheni Yeye. Hiyo ndiyo kheri yenu, ikiwa nyinyi mnajua.
translation_en: And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship Allah and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَٰنًۭا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًۭا فَٱبْتَغُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزْقَ وَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۖ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika nyinyi mnaabudu masanamu badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu, na mnazua uzushi. Hakika hao mnao waabudu badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu hawakumilikiini riziki yoyote. Takeni riziki kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, na mumuabudu Yeye, na mumshukuru Yeye. Kwake Yeye ndio mtarudishwa.
translation_en: You only worship, besides Allah, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides Allah do not possess for you [the power of] provision. So seek from Allah provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned."

arabic_text: وَإِن تُكَذِّبُوا۟ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ۖ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Na mkikadhibisha, basi kaumu kadhaa wa kadhaa za kabla yenu zilikwisha kadhibisha. Na si juu ya Mtume ila kufikisha Ujumbe waziwazi.
translation_en: And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Je! Wao hawaoni jinsi Mwenyezi Mungu anavyo anzisha uumbaji, na kisha akarudisha tena. Hakika hayo kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ni mepesi.
translation_en: Have they not considered how Allah begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allah, is easy.

arabic_text: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ ۚ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ يُنشِئُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Sema: Tembeeni katika ardhi na tazameni jinsi alivyo anzisha uumbaji; kisha Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye anaye umba umbo la baadaye. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Muweza juu ya kila kitu.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allah will produce the final creation. Indeed Allah, over all things, is competent."

arabic_text: يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ
translation_sw: Humuadhibu amtakaye, na humrehemu amtakaye. Na kwake Yeye mtapelekwa.
translation_en: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na nyinyi si wenye kushinda katika ardhi wala katika mbingu. Wala nyinyi hamna mlinzi wala msaidizi isipo kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allah any protector or any helper.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَتِى وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na walio zikanusha Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu na kukutana naye, hao ndio wenye kukata tamaa na rehema yangu, na hao ndio wenye kupata adhabu chungu.
translation_en: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.

arabic_text: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Basi haikuwa jawabu ya watu wake ila ni kusema: Muuweni au mchomeni moto! Mwenyezi Mungu akamwokoa na moto. Hakika katika hayo zipo Ishara kwa watu wanao amini.
translation_en: And the answer of Abraham's people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allah saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَٰنًۭا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍۢ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًۭا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na alisema: Hakika nyinyi mmeyashika masanamu badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu kwa mapenzi yaliyo baina yenu katika uhai wa duniani. Kisha Siku ya Kiyama mtakataana nyinyi kwa nyinyi, na mtalaaniana nyinyi kwa nyinyi. Na makaazi yenu ni Motoni. Wala hamtapata wa kukunusuruni.
translation_en: And [Abraham] said, "You have only taken, other than Allah, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."

arabic_text: ۞ فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُۥ لُوطٌۭ ۘ وَقَالَ إِنِّى مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Lut'i akamuamini, na akasema: Mimi nahamia kwa Mola wangu Mlezi. Hakika Yeye ndiye Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

arabic_text: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ أَجْرَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Na tulimtunukia (Ibrahim) Is-haq na Yaa'qub. Na tukajaalia katika dhuriya zake Unabii na Kitabu, na tukampa ujira wake katika dunia; naye hakika katika Akhera bila ya shaka ni katika watu wema.
translation_en: And We gave to Him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous.

arabic_text: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na pale Lut'i alipo waambia watu wake: Hakika nyinyi mnafanya uchafu, ambao hapana mmoja katika walimwengu aliye kutangulieni kwa hayo.
translation_en: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.

arabic_text: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِى نَادِيكُمُ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Je! Nyinyi mnawaingilia wanaume, na mnaikata njia? Na katika mikutano yenu mnafanya maovu? Basi haikuwa jawabu ya watu wake isipo kuwa kusema: Tuletee hiyo adhabu ya Mwenyezi Mungu ikiwa wewe ni katika wasemao kweli.
translation_en: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allah, if you should be of the truthful."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Ewe Mola wangu Mlezi! Ninusuru na watu mafisadi hawa!
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people."

arabic_text: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُهْلِكُوٓا۟ أَهْلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ۖ إِنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَانُوا۟ ظَٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na wajumbe wetu walipo mjia Ibrahim na bishara, walisema: Hakika sisi hapana shaka tutawahiliki watu wa mji huu, kwani watu wake hakika wamekuwa madhaalimu.
translation_en: And when Our messengers came to Abraham with the good tidings, they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that Lot's city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers."

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًۭا ۚ قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَا ۖ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hakika humo yumo Lut'i. Wao wakasema: Sisi tunajua zaidi nani yumo humo. Hapana shaka tutamwokoa yeye na ahali zake, isipo kuwa mkewe aliye miongoni mwa watao kaa nyuma.
translation_en: [Abraham] said, "Indeed, within it is Lot." They said, "We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind."

arabic_text: وَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًۭا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًۭا وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ ۖ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na wajumbe wetu walipo mfikia Lut'i, alihuzunika kwa ajili yao, na moyo uliona dhiki kwa ajili yao. Wakasema: Usiogope, wala usihuzunike. Hakika sisi tutakuokoa wewe na ahali zako, ila mkeo aliye miongoni mwa watao kaa nyuma.
translation_en: And when Our messengers came to Lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort. They said, "Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind.

arabic_text: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa yakini sisi tutawateremshia watu wa mji huu adhabu kutoka mbinguni kwa sababu ya uchafu wanao ufanya.
translation_en: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient."

arabic_text: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na tumeacha katika mji huo Ishara ilio wazi kwa watu wanao tumia akili zao.
translation_en: And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.

arabic_text: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْءَاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
translation_sw: Na kwa Madyana tulimtuma ndugu yao Shuaibu, naye akasema: Enyi watu wangu! Muabuduni Mwenyezi Mungu na iogopeni Siku ya Akhera, wala msende katika ardhi mkifisidi.
translation_en: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."

arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
translation_sw: Lakini walimkanusha basi ukawatwaa mtikiso wa ardhi, wakapambazukiwa ndani ya nyumba zao nao wamefudikia.
translation_en: But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.

arabic_text: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na pia kina A'di na Thamud. Nanyi yamekwisha kubainikieni kutokana na maskani zao. Na Shet'ani aliwapambia vitendo vyao, na akawazuilia Njia, na hali walikuwa wenye kuona.
translation_en: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception.

arabic_text: وَقَٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَٰبِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na pia Qaruni na Firauni na Hamana! Na Musa aliwajia kwa Ishara waziwazi, lakini walijivuna katika nchi, wala hawakuweza kushinda.
translation_en: And [We destroyed] Qarun and Pharaoh and Haman. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment].

arabic_text: فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًۭا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَغْرَقْنَا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Basi kila mmoja tulimtesa kwa mujibu wa makosa yake. Kati yao wapo tulio wapelekea kimbunga cha changarawe; na kati yao wapo walio nyakuliwa na ukelele; na kati yao wapo ambao tulio wadidimiza katika ardhi; na kati yao wapo tulio wazamisha. Wala Mwenyezi Mungu hakuwa mwenye kuwadhulumu, lakini walikuwa wenyewe wakijidhulumu nafsi zao.
translation_en: So each We seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And Allah would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves.

arabic_text: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًۭا ۖ وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ ٱلْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ۖ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Mfano wa walio wafanya walinzi badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu, ni mfano wa buibui alivyo jitandia nyumba. Na hakika nyumba dhaifu mno kuliko zote ni jumba la buibui, laiti kuwa wanajua.
translation_en: The example of those who take allies other than Allah is like that of the spider who takes a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anajua kila kitu wanacho kiomba badala yake Yeye. Na Yeye ndiye Mtukufu Mwenye nguvu Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah knows whatever thing they call upon other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ ۖ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْعَٰلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na hiyo ni mifano tunawapigia watu, na hawaifahamu ila wenye ilimu.
translation_en: And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge.

arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ameumba mbingu na ardhi kwa Haki. Kwa hakika katika hayo ipo Ishara kwa Waumini.
translation_en: Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.

arabic_text: ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ
translation_sw: SOMA uliyo funuliwa katika Kitabu, na ushike Sala. Hakika Sala inazuilia mambo machafu na maovu. Na kwa yakini kumdhukuru Mwenyezi Mungu ndilo jambo kubwa kabisa. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anayajua mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: Recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater. And Allah knows that which you do.

arabic_text: ۞ وَلَا تُجَٰدِلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُنَا وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Wala msijadiliane na Watu wa Kitabu ila kwa njia iliyo nzuri kabisa, isipo kuwa wale walio dhulumu miongoni mwao. Na semeni: Tumeyaamini yaliyo teremshwa kwetu na yaliyo teremshwa kwenu. Na Mungu wetu na Mungu wenu ni Mmoja. Na sisi ni wenye kusilimu kwake.
translation_en: And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."

arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَمِنْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na namna hivi tumekuteremshia Kitabu (cha Qur'ani). Basi wale tulio wapa Kitabu (cha Biblia) wataiamini (Qur'ani), na miongoni mwa hawa (washirikina) wapo watakao iamini. Na hawazikatai Ishara zetu isipo kuwa makafiri.
translation_en: And thus We have sent down to you the Qur'an. And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture believe in it. And among these [people of Makkah] are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers.

arabic_text: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na wewe hukuwa kabla yake unasoma kitabu chochote, wala hukukiandika kwa mkono wako wa kulia. Ingeli kuwa hivyo wangeli fanya shaka wavunjifu.
translation_en: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Otherwise the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt.

arabic_text: بَلْ هُوَ ءَايَٰتٌۢ بَيِّنَٰتٌۭ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Bali hii (Qur'ani) ni Ishara zilizo wazi katika vifua vya walio pewa ilimu. Na hawazikatai Ishara zetu isipo kuwa wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: Rather, the Qur'an is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۖ قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْءَايَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
translation_sw: Na walisema: Mbona hakuteremshiwa Ishara kutoka kwa Mola wake Mlezi? Sema: Ishara ziko kwake Mwenyezi Mungu; ama mimi kwa hakika ni mwonyaji mwenye kubainisha tu.
translation_en: But they say, "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The signs are only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Kwani hayakuwatosha ya kwamba tumekuteremshia Kitabu hiki wanacho somewa? Hakika katika hayo zipo rehema na mawaidha kwa watu wanao amini.
translation_en: And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe.

arabic_text: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًۭا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ وَكَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Mwenyezi Mungu anatosha kuwa ni Shahidi baina yangu na nyinyi. Anayajua yaliomo katika mbingu na ardhi. Na wale wanao amini upotovu na wakamkataa Mwenyezi Mungu, hao ndio walio khasiri.
translation_en: Say, "Sufficient is Allah between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allah - it is those who are the losers."

arabic_text: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ ۚ وَلَوْلَآ أَجَلٌۭ مُّسَمًّۭى لَّجَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanakuhimiza waletewe adhabu kwa haraka. Na lau kuwa hapana wakati maalumu ulio wekwa, basi adhabu ingeli wajia, na ingeli watokea kwa ghafla, na hali wao hawana khabari.
translation_en: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not.

arabic_text: يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Wanakuhimiza waletewe adhabu kwa haraka, na hali Jahannamu kwa hakika imewazunguka makafiri!
translation_en: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَغْشَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Siku itapo wafunika adhabu hiyo kutoka juu yao na chini ya miguu yao, na atasema: Onjeni hayo mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda!
translation_en: On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste [the result of] what you used to do."

arabic_text: يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ أَرْضِى وَٰسِعَةٌۭ فَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
translation_sw: Enyi waja wangu mlio amini! Kwa hakika ardhi yangu ina wasaa. Basi niabuduni Mimi peke yangu.
translation_en: O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.

arabic_text: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Kila nafsi itaonja mauti. Kisha mtarudishwa kwetu.
translation_en: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًۭا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ نِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ
translation_sw: Na ambao wameamini na wakatenda mema, bila ya shaka tutawaweka katika maghorofa ya Peponi yenye kupitiwa chini yake mito, wakidumu humo. Ni mwema ulioje huo ujira wa watendao, Â
translation_en: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao walisubiri, na wakamtegemea Mola wao Mlezi.
translation_en: Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely.

arabic_text: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٍۢ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Na wanyama wangapi hawawezi kujimilikia riziki zao! Mwenyezi Mungu anawaruzuku hao na nyinyi pia. Na Yeye ndiye Mwenye kusikia Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allah provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

arabic_text: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
translation_sw: Na ukiwauliza; Nani aliye umba mbingu na ardhi na akafanya jua na mwezi kuti'ii amri yake? Bila ya shaka, watasema: Mwenyezi Mungu. Wapi basi wanako geuzwa?
translation_en: If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "Allah." Then how are they deluded?

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu humkunjulia, na humdhikishia, riziki amtakaye katika waja wake. Kwa hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mjuzi wa kila kitu.
translation_en: Allah extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing.

arabic_text: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّن نَّزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na ukiwauliza: Ni nani anaye teremsha maji kutoka mbinguni, na akaihuisha ardhi baada ya kufa kwake? Bila ya shaka watasema: Ni Mwenyezi Mungu. Sema: Alhamdu Lillahi, Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu. Bali wengi katika wao hawafahamu.
translation_en: And if you asked them, "Who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say " Allah." Say, "Praise to Allah "; but most of them do not reason.

arabic_text: وَمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَهْوٌۭ وَلَعِبٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ لَهِىَ ٱلْحَيَوَانُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na haya maisha ya dunia si chochote ila ni pumbao na mchezo. Na nyumba ya Akhera ndiyo maisha khasa; laiti wangeli kuwa wanajua!
translation_en: And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo panda katika marikebu, humwomba Mwenyezi Mungu kwa kumsafia ut'iifu. Lakini anapo wavua wakafika nchi kavu, mara wanamshirikisha.
translation_en: And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him

arabic_text: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Wapate kuyakanya tuliyo wapa, na wajistareheshe. Lakini watakuja jua!
translation_en: So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنًۭا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ ٱلنَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ ۚ أَفَبِٱلْبَٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Hawaoni ya kwamba tumeifanya nchi takatifu ina amani, na hali watu wengine wananyakuliwa kote kwa majirani zao? Je! Wanaamini upotovu, na neema za Mwenyezi Mungu wanazikataa?
translation_en: Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve?

arabic_text: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُۥٓ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًۭى لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na nani dhaalimu mkubwa kuliko yule anaye mzulia uwongo Mwenyezi Mungu au anaye kanusha Haki inapo mjia? Je! Si katika Jahannamu ndio yatakuwa makaazi ya makafiri?
translation_en: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers?

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanao fanya juhudi kwa ajili yetu, Sisi tutawaongoa kwenye njia zetu. Na hakika Mwenyezi Mungu yu pamoja na watu wema.
translation_en: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.

arabic_text: الٓمٓ
translation_sw: Alif Lam Mim (A. L. M.)
translation_en: Alif, Lam, Meem.

arabic_text: غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ
translation_sw: Warumi wameshindwa,
translation_en: The Byzantines have been defeated

arabic_text: فِىٓ أَدْنَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ
translation_sw: Katika nchi iliyo karibu. Nao baada ya kushindwa kwao watashinda
translation_en: In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome.

arabic_text: فِى بِضْعِ سِنِينَ ۗ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِنۢ بَعْدُ ۚ وَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَفْرَحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Katika miaka michache. Amri ni ya Mwenyezi Mungu kabla yake na baada yake. Na siku hiyo Waumini watafurahi.
translation_en: Within three to nine years. To Allah belongs the command before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice

arabic_text: بِنَصْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Kwa nusura ya Mwenyezi Mungu humnusuru amtakaye. Naye ndiye Mwenye nguvu Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: In the victory of Allah. He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

arabic_text: وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Ni ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Mwenyezi Mungu havunji ahadi yake. Lakini watu wengi hawajui.
translation_en: [It is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know.

arabic_text: يَعْلَمُونَ ظَٰهِرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
translation_sw: Wanajua hali ya dhaahiri ya maisha ya dunia, na wameghafilika na Akhera.
translation_en: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم ۗ مَّا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Hawajifikirii nafsi zao? Mwenyezi Mungu hakuumba mbingu na ardhi na viliomo ndani yake ila kwa Haki na kwa muda maalumu. Na hakika watu wengi bila ya shaka ni wenye kukataa kuwa watakutana na Mola wao Mlezi.
translation_en: Do they not contemplate within themselves? Allah has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in [the matter of] the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ وَأَثَارُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Hawatembei katika ardhi wakaona ulivyo kuwa mwisho wa walio kuwa kabla yao? Nao walikuwa na nguvu zaidi kuliko wao, na wakaitimbua ardhi na wakaistawisha zaidi kuliko walivyo istawisha wao. Na Mitume wao wakawajia na dalili zilizo wazi. Basi hakuwa Mwenyezi Mungu ni mwenye kuwadhulumu, lakini walikuwa wakijidhulumu nafsi zao.
translation_en: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed the earth and built it up more than they have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allah would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُوا۟ بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation_sw: Kisha ulikuwa mwisho wa walio fanya ubaya ni kuzikanusha Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu, na wakawa wanazifanyia maskhara.
translation_en: Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of Allah and used to ridicule them.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu huanzisha uumbaji, tena akaurudisha mara ya pili, na kisha mtarejeshwa kwake.
translation_en: Allah begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na itapo simama Saa wakosefu watakata tamaa.
translation_en: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.

arabic_text: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمْ شُفَعَٰٓؤُا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ كَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Wala hawatakuwa na waombezi miongoni mwa walio kuwa wakiwashirikisha na Mungu; na wao wenyewe watawakataa hao washirikishwa wao.
translation_en: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Na siku itapo simama Saa, siku hiyo watagawanyika.
translation_en: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍۢ يُحْبَرُونَ
translation_sw: Ama walio amini na wakatenda mema watafurahishwa katika Bustani.
translation_en: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na ama walio kufuru na wakazikanusha Ishara zetu na mkutano wa Akhera, hao basi watahudhurishwa katika adhabu.
translation_en: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].

arabic_text: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
translation_sw: Basi Subhanallah! Mtakaseni Mwenyezi Mungu jioni na asubuhi,
translation_en: So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.

arabic_text: وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّۭا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na sifa zote njema ni zake katika mbingu na ardhi, na alasiri na adhuhuri.
translation_en: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.

arabic_text: يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَيُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
translation_sw: Hukitoa kilicho hai kutokana na kilicho kufa, na hukitoa kilicho kufa kutokana na kilicho hai. Na huihuisha ardhi baada ya kufa kwake. Na kama hivyo ndivyo mtavyo fufuliwa.
translation_en: He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.

arabic_text: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٌۭ تَنتَشِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na katika Ishara zake ni kuwa kakuumbeni kwa udongo. Kisha mmekuwa watu mlio tawanyika kote kote.
translation_en: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].

arabic_text: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةًۭ وَرَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Na katika Ishara zake ni kuwa amekuumbieni wake zenu kutokana na nafsi zenu ili mpate utulivu kwao. Naye amejaalia mapenzi na huruma baina yenu. Hakika katika haya bila ya shaka zipo Ishara kwa watu wanao fikiri.
translation_en: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquillity in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

arabic_text: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْعَٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na katika Ishara zake ni kuumba mbingu na ardhi, na kutafautiana ndimi zenu na rangi zenu. Hakika katika hayo zipo Ishara kwa wajuzi.
translation_en: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.

arabic_text: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبْتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَسْمَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na katika Ishara zake ni kulala kwenu usiku na mchana, na kutafuta kwenu fadhila zake. Hakika katika haya bila ya shaka zipo Ishara kwa watu wanao sikia.
translation_en: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.

arabic_text: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًۭا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَيُحْىِۦ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na katika Ishara zake hukuonyesheni umeme kwa kukutieni khofu na tamaa. Na hukuteremshieni maji kutoka mbinguni, na kwa hayo huifufua ardhi baada ya kufa kwake. Hakika katika hayo zipo Ishara kwa watu wanao zingatia.
translation_en: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.

arabic_text: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ
translation_sw: Na katika Ishara zake ni kuwa mbingu na ardhi zimesimama kwa amri yake. Kisha atakapo kuiteni mwito mmoja tu, hapo mtatoka kwenye ardhi.
translation_en: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth remain by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.

arabic_text: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ
translation_sw: Na vyake Yeye vilivyo mbinguni na katika ardhi. Vyote vinamt'ii Yeye.
translation_en: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَلَهُ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Na Yeye ndiye anaye anzisha uumbaji, kisha ataurudisha mara nyengine. Na jambo hili ni jepesi zaidi kwake. Naye ndiye mwenye mfano bora katika mbingu na ardhi. Na Yeye ndiye Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest attribute in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلًۭا مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۖ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُكُم مِّن شُرَكَآءَ فِى مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ فَأَنتُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌۭ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Amekupigieni mfano kutokana na nafsi zenu. Je! Katika hao iliyo wamiliki mikono yenu ya kulia mnao washirika katika hivyo tulivyo kuruzukuni, mkawa nyinyi katika hivyo ni sawasawa, mnawaogopa kama mnavyo ogopana wenyewe kwa wenyewe? Namna hivi tunazipambanua Aya zetu kwa watu wenye akili.
translation_en: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]? Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.

arabic_text: بَلِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ ۖ فَمَن يَهْدِى مَنْ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
translation_sw: Bali walio dhulumu wamefuata mapendo ya nafsi zao pasina kujua. Basi nani atamwongoa ambaye Mwenyezi Mungu amemuacha apotee? Wala hao hawatakuwa na wa kuwanusuru.
translation_en: But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allah has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.

arabic_text: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًۭا ۚ فِطْرَتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا ۚ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Basi uelekeze uso wako sawasawa kwenye Dini - ndilo umbile la Mwenyezi Mungu alilo waumbia watu. Hapana mabadiliko katika uumbaji wa Mwenyezi Mungu. Hiyo ndiyo Dini iliyo nyooka sawa. Lakini watu wengi hawajui.
translation_en: So direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fitrah of Allah upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allah. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.

arabic_text: ۞ مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
translation_sw: Muwe wenye kutubia kwake, na mcheni Yeye, na shikeni Sala, na wala msiwe katika washirikina.
translation_en: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allah

arabic_text: مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ شِيَعًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
translation_sw: Katika wale ambao kwamba wameigawanya dini yao, na wakawa makundi makundi, kila kikundi kinafurahia kilicho nacho.
translation_en: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَوْا۟ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Yakiwapata watu madhara humwomba Mola wao Mlezi nao wametubu kwake. Kisha akiwaonjesha rehema itokayo kwake, mara kikundi miongoni mwao humshirikisha Mola wao Mlezi,
translation_en: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,

arabic_text: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa kuyakataa tuliyo wapa. Basi stareheni. Mtakuja jua!
translation_en: So that they will deny what We have granted them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.

arabic_text: أَمْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنًۭا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Au tumewateremshia hoja ambayo kwayo ndio wanafanya ushirikina?
translation_en: Or have We sent down to them an authority, and it speaks of what they were associating with Him?

arabic_text: وَإِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحْمَةًۭ فَرِحُوا۟ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ
translation_sw: Na watu tunapo waonjesha rehema huifurahia, na ukiwasibu uovu kwa iliyo yatanguliza mikono yao wenyewe, mara wanakata tamaa.
translation_en: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Kwani hawaoni kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu humkunjulia riziki amtakaye na humdhikisha amtakaye? Hakika katika hayo zipo Ishara kwa watu wanao amini.
translation_en: Do they not see that Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed, in that are signs for a people who believe.

arabic_text: فَـَٔاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
translation_sw: Basi mpe jamaa haki yake, na masikini, na msafiri. Hayo ni kheri kwa watakao radhi ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na hao ndio wenye kufanikiwa.
translation_en: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the countenance of Allah, and it is they who will be the successful.

arabic_text: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن رِّبًۭا لِّيَرْبُوَا۟ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٍۢ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُضْعِفُونَ
translation_sw: Na mnacho kitoa kwa riba ili kiongezeke katika mali ya watu, basi hakiongezeki mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Lakini mnacho kitoa kwa Zaka kwa kutaka radhi ya Mwenyezi Mungu, basi hao ndio watao zidishiwa.
translation_en: And whatever you give for interest to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with Allah. But what you give in zakah, desiring the countenance of Allah - those are the multipliers.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۖ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَفْعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye aliye kuumbeni, kisha akakuruzukuni, kisha anakufisheni, na kisha anakufufueni. Je! Yupo yeyote katika hao mnao washirikisha na Mwenyezi Mungu afanyae lolote katika hayo? Yeye ametakasika, na ametukuka na hayo mnayo mshirikisha naye.
translation_en: Allah is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

arabic_text: ظَهَرَ ٱلْفَسَادُ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِى ٱلنَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_sw: Ufisadi umedhihiri bara na baharini kwa iliyo yafanya mikono ya watu, ili Mwenyezi Mungu awaonyeshe baadhi ya waliyo yatenda. Huenda wakarejea kwa kutubu.
translation_en: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].

arabic_text: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّشْرِكِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Safirini duniani muangalie ulikuwaje mwisho wa walio tangulia. Wengi wao walikuwa washirikina.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allah].

arabic_text: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصَّدَّعُونَ
translation_sw: Basi uelekeze uso wako kwenye Dini Iliyo Nyooka kabla ya kufika Siku hiyo isiyo zuilika, inayo toka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Siku hiyo watu watatengana.
translation_en: So direct your face toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.

arabic_text: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ
translation_sw: Anaye kufuru basi ukafiri wake utakuwa juu yake mwenyewe, na anaye tenda mema, basi wanazitengezea nafsi zao.
translation_en: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,

arabic_text: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Ili awalipe walio amini na wakatenda mema kutokana na fadhila yake. Hakika Yeye hawapendi makafiri.
translation_en: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers.

arabic_text: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن يُرْسِلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٍۢ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَلِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na katika Ishara zake ni kuzituma pepo ziletazo bishara njema, na ili kukuonjesheni baadhi ya rehema zake, na ili majahazi yende kwa amri yake; na mtafute kutokana na fadhila yake, na ili mumshukuru.
translation_en: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ ۖ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tulikwisha watuma Mitume kwa kaumu zao, na wakawajia kwa hoja zilizo wazi. Tukawaadhibu wale walio fanya ukosefu. Na ilikuwa ni haki juu yetu kuwanusuru Waumini.
translation_en: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support of the believers.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًۭا فَيَبْسُطُهُۥ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُۥ كِسَفًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَٰلِهِۦ ۖ فَإِذَآ أَصَابَ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye anaye zituma pepo zikayatimua mawingu, kisha akayatandaza mbinguni kama apendavyo. Na akayafanya mapande mapande, basi ukaiona mvua inatoka ndani yake. Anapo wafikishia awatakao katika waja wake, mara hao huwa na furaha.
translation_en: It is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice

arabic_text: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمُبْلِسِينَ
translation_sw: Na ingawa kabla ya kuteremshiwa walikuwa wenye kukata tamaa.
translation_en: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.

arabic_text: فَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِ رَحْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi ziangalie athari za rehema ya Mwenyezi Mungu, jinsi anavyo ihuisha ardhi baada ya kufa kwake. Basi hakika huyo ndiye bila ya shaka Mwenye kuhuisha wafu. Na Yeye ni Muweza wa kila kitu.
translation_en: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allah - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

arabic_text: وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًۭا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا لَّظَلُّوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ يَكْفُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na tunge utuma upepo na wakauona umekuwa rangi ya manjano, juu ya hayo wange endelea kukufuru.
translation_en: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.

arabic_text: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Kwani wewe hakika huwafanyi maiti wakasikia, wala viziwi wakasikia wito wakisha geuka kukupa mgongo.
translation_en: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَٰدِ ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Wala wewe huwaongoi vipofu na upotovu wao. Huwasikilizishi ila wanao ziamini Aya zetu. Hao ndio Waislamu, walio nyenyekea.
translation_en: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allah].

arabic_text: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍۢ قُوَّةًۭ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍۢ ضَعْفًۭا وَشَيْبَةًۭ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye aliye kuumbeni kutokana na udhaifu kisha akajaalia nguvu baada ya unyonge, kisha akajaalia baada ya nguvu unyonge tena na ukongwe. Anaumba atakavyo. Naye ndiye Mjuzi, Mwenye uweza.
translation_en: Allah is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍۢ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْفَكُونَ
translation_sw: Na siku itapo simama Saa wakosefu wataapa kwamba hawakukaa duniani ila saa moja tu. Hivyo ndivyo walivyo kuwa wakipotozwa.
translation_en: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَٱلْإِيمَٰنَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْبَعْثِ ۖ فَهَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْبَعْثِ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na walio pewa ilimu na Imani watasema: Hakika nyinyi mlikwisha kaa katika hukumu ya Mwenyezi Mungu mpaka Siku ya kufufuliwa. Basi hii ndiyo Siku ya kufufuliwa! Lakini nyinyi mlikuwa hamuijui.
translation_en: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allah 's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."

arabic_text: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
translation_sw: Basi Siku hiyo hautawafaa walio dhulumu udhuru wao, wala haitotakiwa toba yao.
translation_en: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ ۚ وَلَئِن جِئْتَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍۢ لَّيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tulikwisha wapigia watu kila mfano katika hii Qur'ani. Na ukiwaletea Ishara yoyote hapana shaka walio kufuru watasema: Nyinyi si chochote ila ni waongo.
translation_en: And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muhammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers."

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Hivi ndivyo Mwenyezi Mungu anavyo piga muhuri kwenye nyoyo za wasio jua.
translation_en: Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who do not know.

arabic_text: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
translation_sw: Basi subiri. Hakika ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni ya haki. Wala wasikupaparishe hao wasio kuwa na yakini.
translation_en: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].

arabic_text: الٓمٓ
translation_sw: Alif Lam Mim (A. L. M.)
translation_en: Alif, Lam, Meem.

arabic_text: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
translation_sw: Hizi ni Aya za Kitabu chenye hikima.
translation_en: These are verses of the wise Book,

arabic_text: هُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ لِّلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Kuwa ni Uwongofu na Rehema kwa wafanyao wema,
translation_en: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
translation_sw: Wanao shika Sala, na wanatoa Zaka, nao wana yakini na Akhera.
translation_en: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith].

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
translation_sw: Hao ndio walio na uwongofu utokao kwa Mola wao Mlezi, na hao ndio wenye kufanikiwa.
translation_en: Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشْتَرِى لَهْوَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Na miongoni mwa watu wapo wanao nunua maneno ya upuuzi, ili wawapoteze watu na njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu pasipo kujua, na wanaichukulia ni maskhara. Hao watapata adhabu ya kuwafedhehesha.
translation_en: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of Allah without knowledge and who takes it in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسْتَكْبِرًۭا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا كَأَنَّ فِىٓ أُذُنَيْهِ وَقْرًۭا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_sw: Na (mtu kama huyo) anapo somewa Aya zetu huzipa mgongo kwa kujivuna, kama kwamba hakuzisikia, kama kwamba masikioni mwake mna uziwi. Basi mbashirie kuwa atapata adhabu chungu.
translation_en: And when our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_sw: Hakika walio amini na wakatenda mema watakuwa nazo Bustani za neema.
translation_en: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure.

arabic_text: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقًّۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Watadumu humo - ni ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu ya kweli. Na Yeye ndiye Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allah [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍۢ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٍۢ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
translation_sw: Ameziumba mbingu bila ya nguzo mnazo ziona; na ameweka katika ardhi milima ili ardhi isikuyumbisheni; na ametawanya humo kila namna ya wanyama; na tumeteremsha maji kutoka mbinguni, na tukaotesha katika ardhi mimea mizuri ya kila namna.
translation_en: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا خَلْقُ ٱللَّهِ فَأَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ بَلِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Huu ni uumbaji wa Mwenyezi Mungu. Basi nionyesheni wameumba nini hao wasio kuwa Yeye! Lakini madhaalimu wamo katika upotovu uliyo dhaahiri.
translation_en: This is the creation of Allah. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Na tulimpa Luqman hikima, tukamwambia: Mshukuru Mwenyezi Mungu. Na mwenye kushukuru basi hakika anashukuru kwa manufaa ya nafsi yake. Na aliye kufuru, basi Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mkwasi, Msifiwa.
translation_en: And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allah." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَٰنُ لِٱبْنِهِۦ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُۥ يَٰبُنَىَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na Luqman alipo mwambia mwanawe kwa kumpa mawaidha: Ewe mwanangu! Usimshirikishe Mwenyezi Mungu. Kwani hakika ushirikina bila ya shaka ni dhulma iliyo kubwa.
translation_en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Luqman said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allah. Indeed, association [with him] is great injustice."

arabic_text: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍۢ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ فِى عَامَيْنِ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَيْكَ إِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Na tumemuusia mtu kwa wazazi wake wawili. Mama yake ameichukua mimba yake kwa udhaifu juu ya udhaifu, na kumwachisha ziwa baada ya miaka miwili. (Tumemuusia): Nishukuru Mimi na wazazi wako. Ni kwangu Mimi ndiyo marudio.
translation_en: And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.

arabic_text: وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا ۖ وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًۭا ۖ وَٱتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَىَّ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na pindi wakikushikilia kunishirikisha na ambayo huna ilimu nayo, basi usiwat'ii. Lakini kaa nao kwa wema duniani, nawe ishike njia ya anaye elekea kwangu. Kisha marejeo yenu ni kwangu Mimi, na Mimi nitakuambieni mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda.
translation_en: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me [in repentance]. Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.

arabic_text: يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍۢ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍۢ فَتَكُن فِى صَخْرَةٍ أَوْ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَوْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَأْتِ بِهَا ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Ewe mwanangu! Kikiwapo kitu cha uzito wa chembe ya khardali kikawa ndani ya jabali au ndani ya mbingu au ndani ya ardhi, basi Mwenyezi Mungu atakileta. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mjuzi wa yaliyo fichika, Mwenye khabari za yote.
translation_en: [And Luqman said], "O my son, indeed if wrong should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted.

arabic_text: يَٰبُنَىَّ أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَٱنْهَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَكَ ۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
translation_sw: Ewe mwanangu! Shika Sala, na amrisha mema, na kataza maovu, na subiri kwa yanayo kupata. Hayo ni katika mambo ya kuazimiwa..
translation_en: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] determination.

arabic_text: وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍۢ فَخُورٍۢ
translation_sw: Wala usiwabeuwe watu, wala usitembee katika nchi kwa maringo. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu hampendi kila anaye jivuna na kujifakhirisha.
translation_en: And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful.

arabic_text: وَٱقْصِدْ فِى مَشْيِكَ وَٱغْضُضْ مِن صَوْتِكَ ۚ إِنَّ أَنكَرَ ٱلْأَصْوَٰتِ لَصَوْتُ ٱلْحَمِيرِ
translation_sw: Na ushike mwendo wa katikati, na teremsha sauti yako. Hakika katika sauti mbaya zote bila ya shaka iliyo zidi ni sauti ya punda.
translation_en: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُۥ ظَٰهِرَةًۭ وَبَاطِنَةًۭ ۗ وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا هُدًۭى وَلَا كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّنِيرٍۢ
