translation_en: Say, "For you is the appointment of a Day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَلَا بِٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ٱلْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أَنتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na walisema walio kufuru: Hatutaiamini Qur'ani hii, wala yaliyo kuwa kabla yake. Na ungeli waona madhaalimu watapo simamishwa mbele ya Mola wao Mlezi, wakirudishiana maneno wao kwa wao! Wanyonge wakiwaambia walio takabari: Lau kuwa si nyinyi, bila ya shaka tungeli kuwa Waumini sisi.
translation_en: And those who disbelieve say, "We will never believe in this Qur'an nor in that before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, refuting each other's words... Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "If not for you, we would have been believers."

arabic_text: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟ أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَكُم ۖ بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Walio takabari watawaambia wanyonge: Kwani sisi ndio tulio kuzuieni na uwongofu baada ya kukujieni? Bali nyinyi wenyewe ni wakosefu.
translation_en: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ بَلْ مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَآ أَن نَّكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًۭا ۚ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَغْلَٰلَ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanyonge wakawaambia walio takabari: Bali ni vitimbi vyenu vya usiku na mchana, mlipo kuwa mkituamrisha tumkufuru Mwenyezi Mungu, na tumfanyie washirika. Nao wataficha majuto watakapo iona adhabu. Na tutaweka makongwa shingoni mwao walio kufuru. Kwani wanalipwa ila kwa waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda?
translation_en: Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "Rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allah and attribute to Him equals." But they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do?

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na hatukumtuma mwonyaji yeyote kwenye mji, ila walisema walio jidekeza kwa starehe zao wa mji huo: Hakika sisi tunayakataa hayo mliyo tumwa nayo.
translation_en: And We did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَٰلًۭا وَأَوْلَٰدًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_sw: Na wakasema: Sisi tuna mali mengi zaidi na watoto, wala sisi hatutaadhibiwa.
translation_en: And they said, "We are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Hakika Mola wangu Mlezi humkunjulia riziki na humdhikisha amtakaye. Lakini watu wengi hawajui.
translation_en: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know."

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِى تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغُرُفَٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ
translation_sw: Na si mali yenu wala watoto wenu watakao kukaribisheni kwetu muwe karibu, isipo kuwa aliye amini na akatenda mema. Hao basi watapata malipo mardufu kwa walio yafanya. Nao watakuwa salama katika maghorofa.
translation_en: And it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to Us in position, but it is [by being] one who has believed and done righteousness. For them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers [of Paradise], safe [and secure].

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanao jitahidi kuzipinga Ishara zetu, wakaona watashinda, hao watahudhurishwa kwenye adhabu.
translation_en: And the ones who strive against Our verses to cause [them] failure - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥ ۚ وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُۥ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Kwa hakika Mola wangu Mlezi humkunjulia riziki na humdhikisha amtakaye katika waja wake. Na chochote mtakacho kitoa Yeye atakilipa. Naye ni Mbora wa wanao ruzuku.
translation_en: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts [it] for him. But whatever thing you spend [in His cause] - He will compensate it; and He is the best of providers."

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
translation_sw: Na siku atakayo wakusanya wote, kisha atawaambia Malaika: Je! Hawa walikuwa wakikuabuduni?
translation_en: And [mention] the Day when He will gather them all and then say to the angels, "Did these [people] used to worship you?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم ۖ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ ۖ أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Waseme: Subhanak, Umetakasika. Wewe ndiye kipenzi chetu si hao. Bali wao walikuwa wakiwaabudu majini; wengi wao wakiwaamini hao.
translation_en: They will say, "Exalted are You! You, [O Allah], are our benefactor not them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."

arabic_text: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍۢ نَّفْعًۭا وَلَا ضَرًّۭا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_sw: Hii leo hataweza yeyote kumletea nafuu wala madhara mwenzie. Na tutawaambia walio dhulumu: Onjeni adhabu ya Moto mlio kuwa mkiukanusha.
translation_en: But today you do not hold for one another [the power of] benefit or harm, and We will say to those who wronged, "Taste the punishment of the Fire, which you used to deny."

arabic_text: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۭ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌۭ مُّفْتَرًۭى ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Na wanapo somewa Aya zetu zilizo wazi wanasema: Huyu si chochote ila ni mtu anaye taka kukuzuieni na waliyo kuwa wakiabudu baba zenu. Na wakasema: Haya si chochote ila ni uwongo ulio zuliwa. Na walio kufuru waliiambia Haki ilipo wajia: Haya si chochote ila ni uchawi ulio dhaahiri.
translation_en: And when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."

arabic_text: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّن كُتُبٍۢ يَدْرُسُونَهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Wala hatukuwapa Vitabu wavisome, wala hatukuwatumia Mwonyaji kabla yako wewe.
translation_en: And We had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and We had not sent to them before you, [O Muhammad], any warner.

arabic_text: وَكَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوا۟ مِعْشَارَ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ رُسُلِى ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
translation_sw: Na walikadhibisha walio kuwa kabla yao. Na hawakufikilia hata sehemu moja katika kumi ya tulivyo wapa hao. Nao waliwakadhibisha Mitume wangu. Basi kuangamiza kwangu kulikuwa namna gani!
translation_en: And those before them denied, and the people of Makkah have not attained a tenth of what We had given them. But the former peoples denied My messengers, so how [terrible] was My reproach.

arabic_text: ۞ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍ ۖ أَن تَقُومُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ ۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ لَّكُم بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Sema: Mimi nakunasihini kwa jambo moja tu - ya kwamba msimame kwa ajili ya Mwenyezi Mungu, wawili-wawili na mmoja-mmoja; kisha mfikiri. Mwenzenu huyu hana wazimu. Yeye si chochote ila ni Mwonyaji kwenu kabla ya kufika adhabu kali.
translation_en: Say, "I only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for Allah, [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." There is not in your companion any madness. He is only a warner to you before a severe punishment.

arabic_text: قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍۢ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Sema: Ujira nilio kuombeni ni wenu nyinyi. Sina ujira ila kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Na Yeye ni Shahidi juu ya kila kitu.
translation_en: Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allah, and He is, over all things, Witness."

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
translation_sw: Sema: Hakika Mola wangu Mlezi anaondoa upotovu kwa Haki. Yeye ndiye Mwenye kujua vyema yaliyo ghaibu.
translation_en: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth. Knower of the unseen."

arabic_text: قُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ
translation_sw: Sema: Kweli imefika, na uwongo haujitokezi, wala haurudi.
translation_en: Say, "The truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]."

arabic_text: قُلْ إِن ضَلَلْتُ فَإِنَّمَآ أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِى ۖ وَإِنِ ٱهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِىٓ إِلَىَّ رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌۭ قَرِيبٌۭ
translation_sw: Sema: Ikiwa mimi nimepotea, basi nimepotea kwa kudhuru nafsi yangu mwenyewe. Na ikiwa nimeongoka, basi ni kwa sababu ya kunifunulia Mola wangu Mlezi. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kusikia, Aliye karibu.
translation_en: Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near."

arabic_text: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ فَزِعُوا۟ فَلَا فَوْتَ وَأُخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
translation_sw: Na lau ungeli ona watapo babaika, basi hapana pa kukimbilia! Na watakamatwa mahala pa karibu.
translation_en: And if you could see when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Na watasema: Tunaiamini! Lakini wataipata wapi kutoka huko mahala mbali?
translation_en: And they will [then] say, "We believe in it!" But how for them will be the taking [of faith] from a place far away?

arabic_text: وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Na hapo kabla yake waliikataa, na wakiyatupilia mbali maneno ya ghaibu kutoka mahali mbali.
translation_en: And they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault the unseen from a place far away.

arabic_text: وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ فِى شَكٍّۢ مُّرِيبٍۭ
translation_sw: Na watatiliwa kizuizi baina yao na hayo wanayo yatamani, kama walivyo fanyiwa wenzao zamani. Hakika hao walikuwa na shaka ya kutia wasiwasi.
translation_en: And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting denial.

arabic_text: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُو۟لِىٓ أَجْنِحَةٍۢ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَٰثَ وَرُبَٰعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Sifa zote njema ni za Mwenyezi Mungu, Muumba wa mbingu na ardhi, aliye wafanya Malaika kuwa wajumbe wenye mbawa, mbili-mbili, na tatu- tatu, na nne-nne. Huzidisha katika kuumba apendavyo. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Muweza juu ya kila kitu.
translation_en: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, [who] made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four. He increases in creation what He wills. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

arabic_text: مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍۢ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Rehema ambayo Mwenyezi Mungu anawafungulia watu hapana wa kuizuia. Na anayo izuia hapana wa kuipeleka isipo kuwa Yeye. Naye ndiye Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ هَلْ مِنْ خَٰلِقٍ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
translation_sw: Enyi watu! Kumbukeni neema za Mwenyezi Mungu juu yenu. Ati yupo muumba mwengine asiye kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu anaye kupeni riziki kutoka mbinguni na kwenye ardhi? Hapana mungu ila Yeye tu. Basi wapi mnako geuzwa?
translation_en: O mankind, remember the favor of Allah upon you. Is there any creator other than Allah who provides for you from the heaven and earth? There is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?

arabic_text: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
translation_sw: Na wakikukanusha, basi walikwisha kanushwa Mitume kabla yako. Na mambo yote yatarudishwa kwa Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad] - already were messengers denied before you. And to Allah are returned [all] matters.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
translation_sw: Enyi watu! Hakika ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni ya kweli. Basi yasikudanganyeni maisha ya dunia, wala mdanganyifu asikudanganyeni juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: O mankind, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ فَٱتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا ۚ إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوا۟ حِزْبَهُۥ لِيَكُونُوا۟ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation_sw: Hakika Shet'ani ni adui yenu, basi mfanyeni kuwa ni adui. Kwani yeye analiita kundi lake liwe katika watu wa Motoni.
translation_en: Indeed, Satan is an enemy to you; so take him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be among the companions of the Blaze.

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌ
translation_sw: Walio kufuru watakuwa na adhabu kali; na walio amini na wakatenda mema watapata msamaha na ujira mkubwa.
translation_en: Those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward.

arabic_text: أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًۭا ۖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَٰتٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Yule aliye pambiwa a'mali zake mbaya na akaziona ni njema - basi hakika Mwenyezi Mungu humwacha akapotea amtakaye, na humwongoa amtakaye. Basi nafsi yako isijihiliki kwa kuwasikitikia. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anajua wanayo yafanya.
translation_en: Then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]? For indeed, Allah sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. So do not let yourself perish over them in regret. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what they do.

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًۭا فَسُقْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍۢ مَّيِّتٍۢ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلنُّشُورُ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye anaye zituma Pepo ziyatimue mawingu, nasi tukayafikisha kwenye nchi iliyo kufa, tukaifufua ardhi baada ya kufa kwake. Ndivyo kama hivyo kutakavyo kuwa kufufuliwa.
translation_en: And it is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds, and We drive them to a dead land and give life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Thus is the resurrection.

arabic_text: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ ٱلْكَلِمُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ وَٱلْعَمَلُ ٱلصَّٰلِحُ يَرْفَعُهُۥ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَمَكْرُ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ
translation_sw: Mwenye kutaka utukufu basi utukufu wote uko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Kwake Yeye hupanda neno zuri, na a'mali njema Yeye huitukuza. Na wanao panga vitimbi vya maovu watapata adhabu kali. Na vitimbi vya hao vitaondokea patupu.
translation_en: Whoever desires honor [through power] - then to Allah belongs all honor. To Him ascends good speech, and righteous work raises it. But they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish.

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ۚ وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍۢ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِۦٓ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu amekuumbeni kutokana na udongo. Kisha kwa tone la manii. Kisha akakufanyeni mwanamume na mwanamke. Na mwanamke yeyote hachukui mimba, wala hazai, ila kwa ilimu yake. Na wala hapewi umri mwenye umri mrefu, wala hapunguziwi katika umri wake, ila yamo hayo katika Kitabu. Hakika hayo ni mepesi kwa Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: And Allah created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop; then He made you mates. And no female conceives nor does she give birth except with His knowledge. And no aged person is granted [additional] life nor is his lifespan lessened but that it is in a register. Indeed, that for Allah is easy.

arabic_text: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْبَحْرَانِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ سَآئِغٌۭ شَرَابُهُۥ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌۭ ۖ وَمِن كُلٍّۢ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًۭا طَرِيًّۭا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةًۭ تَلْبَسُونَهَا ۖ وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na bahari mbili haziwi sawa; haya ni matamu yenye ladha, mazuri kunywa. Na haya ni ya chumvi, machungu. Na kutokana na bahari zote mnakula nyama mpya (isiyo chacha). Na mnatoa mapambo mnayo yavaa. Na unaona ndani yake marikebu zinakata maji ili mtafute fadhila zake, na ili mpate kushukuru.
translation_en: And not alike are the two bodies of water. One is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter. And from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through [them] that you might seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

arabic_text: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ
translation_sw: Anauingiza usiku katika mchana, na anauingiza mchana katika usiku. Na amelifanya jua na mwezi kutumikia. Kila kimojapo kinakwenda kwa muda maalumu. Huyo ndiye Mwenyezi Mungu Mola wenu Mlezi. Ufalme ni wake. Na hao mnao waomba badala yake hawamiliki hata ugozi wa kokwa ya tende.
translation_en: He causes the night to enter the day, and He causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running [its course] for a specified term. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty. And those whom you invoke other than Him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed.

arabic_text: إِن تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوا۟ دُعَآءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوا۟ مَا ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Mkiwaomba hawasikii maombi yenu; na hata wakisikia hawakujibuni. Na Siku ya Kiyama watakataa ushirikina wenu. Na hapana atakaye kupa khabari vilivyo kama Yeye Mwenye khabari.
translation_en: If you invoke them, they do not hear your supplication; and if they heard, they would not respond to you. And on the Day of Resurrection they will deny your association. And none can inform you like [one] Acquainted [with all matters].

arabic_text: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
translation_sw: Enyi watu! Nyinyi ndio wenye haja kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, na Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mwenye kujitosha, Msifiwa.
translation_en: O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

arabic_text: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Akitaka atakuondoeni na alete viumbe vipya.
translation_en: If He wills, He can do away with you and bring forth a new creation.

arabic_text: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍۢ
translation_sw: Na hilo si gumu kwa Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: And that is for Allah not difficult.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌۭ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰٓ ۗ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Na mbebaji habebi mzigo wa mwingine. Na aliye topewa na mzigo wake akiomba uchukuliwe hautachukuliwa hata kidogo, na angamwomba jamaa yake. Hakika wewe unawaonya wale wanao mcha Mola wao Mlezi kwa ghaibu, na wanashika Sala. Na anaye jitakasa, basi anajitakasa kwa ajili ya nafsi yake. Na marejeo ni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And if a heavily laden soul calls [another] to [carry some of] its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if he should be a close relative. You can only warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer. And whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul. And to Allah is the [final] destination.

arabic_text: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Na kipofu na mwenye kuona hawalingani.
translation_en: Not equal are the blind and the seeing,

arabic_text: وَلَا ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَلَا ٱلنُّورُ
translation_sw: Wala giza na mwangaza.
translation_en: Nor are the darknesses and the light,

arabic_text: وَلَا ٱلظِّلُّ وَلَا ٱلْحَرُورُ
translation_sw: Wala kivuli na joto.
translation_en: Nor are the shade and the heat,

arabic_text: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَحْيَآءُ وَلَا ٱلْأَمْوَٰتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍۢ مَّن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation_sw: Wala hawalingani walio hai na maiti. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu humsikilizisha amtakaye. Wala wewe si wa kuwasikilizisha walio makaburini.
translation_en: And not equal are the living and the dead. Indeed, Allah causes to hear whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.

arabic_text: إِنْ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ
translation_sw: Hukuwa wewe ila ni mwonyaji.
translation_en: You, [O Muhammad], are not but a warner.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumekutuma wewe kwa Haki, kuwa ni mbashiri na mwonyaji. Na hapana umma wowote ila ulipata mwonyaji kati yao.
translation_en: Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner.

arabic_text: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَبِٱلزُّبُرِ وَبِٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُنِيرِ
translation_sw: Na wakikukanusha basi walikwisha wakanusha walio kuwa kabla yao. Mitume wao waliwajia kwa dalili wazi wazi na kwa maandiko na Kitabu chenye nuru.
translation_en: And if they deny you - then already have those before them denied. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs and written ordinances and with the enlightening Scripture.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
translation_sw: Kisha nikawakamata walio kufuru. Basi kuchukia kwangu kulikuwaje?
translation_en: Then I seized the ones who disbelieved, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌۢ بِيضٌۭ وَحُمْرٌۭ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌۭ
translation_sw: Je! Huoni kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu ameteremsha maji kutoka mbinguni, na kwayo tumeyatoa matunda yenye rangi mbali mbali. Na katika milima imo mistari myeupe na myekundu yenye rangi mbali mbali, na myeusi sana.
translation_en: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby fruits of varying colors? And in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and [some] extremely black.

arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ
translation_sw: Na katika watu, na wanyama, na mifugo, pia rangi zao zinakhitalifiana. Kwa hakika wanao mcha Mwenyezi Mungu miongoni mwa waja wake ni wanazuoni. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye kusamehe.
translation_en: And among people and moving creatures and grazing livestock are various colors similarly. Only those fear Allah, from among His servants, who have knowledge. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Forgiving.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ يَرْجُونَ تِجَٰرَةًۭ لَّن تَبُورَ
translation_sw: Hakika wale wanao soma Kitabu cha Mwenyezi Mungu, na wakashika Sala, na wakatoa kwa siri na kwa dhaahiri katika tulivyo waruzuku, hao hutaraji biashara isiyo bwaga.
translation_en: Indeed, those who recite the Book of Allah and establish prayer and spend [in His cause] out of what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, [can] expect a profit that will never perish -

arabic_text: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌۭ
translation_sw: Ili Yeye awalipe ujira wao kwa ukamilifu, na awazidishie kutokana na fadhila zake. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kusamehe Mwenye shukrani.
translation_en: That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Na hayo tuliyo kufunulia kutoka Kitabuni ni Kweli yenye kusadikisha yaliyo kuwa kabla yake. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu kwa waja wake ni Mwenye khabari na Mwenye kuona.
translation_en: And that which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], of the Book is the truth, confirming what was before it. Indeed, Allah, of His servants, is Acquainted and Seeing.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌۭ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation_sw: Kisha tumewarithisha Kitabu hao ambao tuliwateuwa miongoni mwa waja wetu. Kati yao yupo aliye jidhulumu nafsi yake, na yupo wa katikati, na yupo aliye tangulia katika mambo ya kheri, kwa idhini ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Hiyo ndiyo fadhila kuu.
translation_en: Then we caused to inherit the Book those We have chosen of Our servants; and among them is he who wrongs himself, and among them is he who is moderate, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by permission of Allah. That [inheritance] is what is the great bounty.

arabic_text: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍۢ وَلُؤْلُؤًۭا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Mabustani ya milele watayaingia. Huko watavikwa vikuku vya dhahabu, na lulu, na nguo zao humo ni za hariri.
translation_en: [For them are] gardens of perpetual residence which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌ
translation_sw: Na watasema: Alhamdulillahi, Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu aliye tuondolea huzuni zote. Hakika Mola wetu Mlezi bila ya shaka ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye shukrani.
translation_en: And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌۭ
translation_sw: Ambaye kwa fadhila yake ametuweka makao ya kukaa daima; humu haitugusi taabu wala humu hakutugusi kuchoka.
translation_en: He who has settled us in the home of duration out of His bounty. There touches us not in it any fatigue, and there touches us not in it weariness [of mind]."

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا۟ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى كُلَّ كَفُورٍۢ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru watakuwa na Moto wa Jahannamu, hawahukumiwi wakafa, wala hawatapunguziwa adhabu yake. Hivyo ndivyo tunavyo mlipa kila mwenye kuzidi ukafiri.
translation_en: And for those who disbelieve will be the fire of Hell. [Death] is not decreed for them so they may die, nor will its torment be lightened for them. Thus do we recompense every ungrateful one.

arabic_text: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُوا۟ فَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
translation_sw: Na humo watapiga makelele: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tutoe tufanye mema sio yale tuliyo kuwa tukiyafanya. Kwani hatukukupeni umri wa kutosha kukumbuka mwenye kukumbuka? Na akakujieni Mwonyaji? Basi onjeni! Kwani walio dhulumu hawana wa kuwanusuru.
translation_en: And they will cry out therein, "Our Lord, remove us; we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!" But did We not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember, and the warner had come to you? So taste [the punishment], for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَٰلِمُ غَيْبِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mjuzi wa siri za mbinguni na ardhi. Hakika Yeye ni Mjuzi wa yaliomo vifuani.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah is Knower of the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَٰٓئِفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًۭا ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye aliye kufanyeni manaibu katika ardhi. Na anaye kufuru, basi kufuru yake ni juu yake; na kufuru za makafiri haziwazidishii kwa Mola wao Mlezi ila kuchukiwa. Wala kufuru za makafiri haziwazidishii ila khasara.
translation_en: It is He who has made you successors upon the earth. And whoever disbelieves - upon him will be [the consequence of] his disbelief. And the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them in the sight of their Lord except in hatred; and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them except in loss.

arabic_text: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌۭ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا
translation_sw: Sema: Mnawaona hawa miungu wenu wa kishirikina mnao waomba badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu! Nionyesheni wameumba sehemu gani katika ardhi? Au wana ushirika wowote katika mbingu? Au tumewapa Kitabu nao kwa hicho wakawa na hoja zilizo wazi? Lakini madhaalimu hawaahidiani wao kwa wao ila udanganyifu tu.
translation_en: Say, "Have you considered your 'partners' whom you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership [with Him] in the heavens? Or have We given them a book so they are [standing] on evidence therefrom? [No], rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion."

arabic_text: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا ۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye anaye zuilia mbingu na ardhi zisiondoke. Na zikiondoka hapana yeyote wa kuzizuia isipo kuwa Yeye. Hakika Yeye ni Mpole Mwenye kusamehe.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing and Forgiving.

arabic_text: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى ٱلْأُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
translation_sw: Na waliapa kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ukomo wa kuapa kwao, kwamba akiwajia mwonyaji bila ya shaka watakuwa waongofu zaidi kuliko taifa jingine lolote. Lakini alipo wajia mwonyaji hakuwazidishia ila kuikimbia hiyo Haki,
translation_en: And they swore by Allah their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than [any] one of the [previous] nations. But when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion.

arabic_text: ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ ٱلسَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلْمَكْرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِۦ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا
translation_sw: Kwa kutakabari kwao katika nchi, na kufanya vitimbi vya uovu. Na vitimbi viovu havimsibu ila mwenyewe aliye vifanya. Hebu hawangojei yalio wasibu watu wa kale? Basi hutapata mabadiliko katika mtindo wa Mwenyezi Mungu. Wala hutapata mageuko katika mwendo wa Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: [Due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. Then do they await except the way of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way of Allah any change, and you will never find in the way of Allah any alteration.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمًۭا قَدِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Je! Hawakusafiri katika ardhi wakaona vipi ulikuwa mwisho wa walio kuwa kabla yao? Na hao walikuwa wana nguvu zaidi kuliko wao. Na hapana kitu kinacho weza kumshinda Mwenyezi Mungu mbinguni wala katika ardhi. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kujua, Mwenye uweza.
translation_en: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allah is not to be caused failure by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرًۢا
translation_sw: Na lau kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu angeli wachukulia watu kwa waliyo yachuma, basi asingeli muacha juu ya ardhi hata mnyama mmoja. Lakini Yeye anawachukulia mpaka ufike muda maalumu. Basi ukifika muda wao basi hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kuwaona waja wake baraabara.
translation_en: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon the earth any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allah has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.

arabic_text: يسٓ
translation_sw: Ya-Sin (Y. S.).
translation_en: Ya, Seen.

arabic_text: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
translation_sw: Kwa Haki ya Qur'ani yenye hikima!
translation_en: By the wise Qur'an.

arabic_text: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika wewe ni miongoni mwa walio tumwa,
translation_en: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,

arabic_text: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Juu ya Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: On a straight path.

arabic_text: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_sw: Uteremsho wa Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

arabic_text: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
translation_sw: Ili uwaonye watu ambao baba zao hawakuonywa, basi wao wamekuwa wenye kughafilika.
translation_en: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.

arabic_text: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Bila ya shaka kauli imekwisha thibiti juu ya wengi katika wao, kwa hivyo hawaamini.
translation_en: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

arabic_text: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًۭا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
translation_sw: Tumeweka makongwa shingoni mwao, yakawafika videvuni. Kwa hivyo vichwa vyao viko juu tu.
translation_en: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّۭا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّۭا فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Tumeweka kizuizi mbele yao, na kizuizi nyuma yao, na tumewafunika macho yao; kwa hivyo hawaoni.
translation_en: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.

arabic_text: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Ni sawa sawa kwao ukiwaonya au usiwaonye, hawataamini.
translation_en: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَأَجْرٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
translation_sw: Hakika wewe unamwonya mwenye kufuata ukumbusho, na akamcha Arrahman, Mwingi wa Rehema, kwa ghaibu. Basi mbashirie huyo msamaha na ujira mwema.
translation_en: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.

arabic_text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tunawafufua wafu, na tunayaandika wanayo yatanguliza, na wanayo yaacha nyuma. Na kila kitu tumekihifadhi katika daftari asli lenye kubainisha.
translation_en: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.

arabic_text: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na wapigie mfano wa wakaazi wa mji walipo wafikia walio tumwa.
translation_en: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -

arabic_text: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
translation_sw: Tulipo watumia wawili, wakawakanusha. Basi tukawazidishia nguvu kwa mwingine wa tatu. Wakasema: Hakika sisi tumetumwa kwenu.
translation_en: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Nyinyi si chochote ila ni watu kama sisi. Na Mwingi wa Rehema hakuteremsha kitu. Nyinyi mnasema uwongo tu.
translation_en: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Mola wetu Mlezi anajua kwamba hakika sisi tumetumwa kwenu.
translation_en: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,

arabic_text: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Wala si juu yetu ila kufikisha ujumbe ulio wazi.
translation_en: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Sisi tumeagua kuwa nyinyi ni wakorofi. Ikiwa hamtaacha basi kwa yakini tutakupigeni mawe, na mtapata adhabu chungu kutoka kwetu.
translation_en: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ukorofi wenu mnao wenyewe! Je! Ni kwa kuwa mnakumbushwa? Ama nyinyi ni watu walio pindukia mipaka.
translation_en: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."

arabic_text: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Na akaja mtu mbio kutokea upande wa mbali wa mjini, akasema: Enyi watu wangu! Wafuateni hawa walio tumwa.
translation_en: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

arabic_text: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًۭا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Wafuateni ambao hawakutakini ujira, hali ya kuwa wenyewe wameongoka.
translation_en: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.

arabic_text: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: NA KWA NINI nisimuabudu yule aliye niumba na kwake mtarejeshwa?
translation_en: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?

arabic_text: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
translation_sw: Je! Niishike miungu mingine badala yake? Arrahmani, Mwingi wa Rehema, akinitakia madhara uombezi wa hao hautanifaa kitu, wala hawataniokoa.
translation_en: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?

arabic_text: إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
translation_sw: Basi hakika mimi hapo nitakuwa katika upotovu ulio dhaahiri.
translation_en: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

arabic_text: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
translation_sw: Hakika mimi nimemuamini Mola wenu Mlezi, basi nisikilizeni!
translation_en: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."

arabic_text: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Akaambiwa: Ingia Peponi! Akasema: Laiti kuwa watu wangu wangeli jua
translation_en: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know

arabic_text: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
translation_sw: Jinsi Mola wangu Mlezi alivyo nisamehe, na akanifanya miongoni mwa walio hishimiwa.
translation_en: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."

arabic_text: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
translation_sw: Na hatukuwateremshia kaumu yake baada yake jeshi kutoka mbinguni, wala si wenye kuteremsha.
translation_en: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

arabic_text: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ
translation_sw: Hakukuwa ila ukelele mmoja tu; na mara walizimwa!
translation_en: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.

arabic_text: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation_sw: Nawasikitikia waja wangu. Hawajii Mtume ila wao humkejeli.
translation_en: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Hawaoni umma ngapi tulizo ziangamiza kabla yao? Hakika hao hawarejei tena kwao.
translation_en: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?

arabic_text: وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na hapana mmoja ila wote watakusanywa waletwe mbele yetu.
translation_en: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

arabic_text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
translation_sw: Na Ishara hiyo kwao - ardhi iliyo kufa, nasi tukaifufua, na tukatoa ndani yake nafaka, wakawa wanazila!
translation_en: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
translation_sw: Na tukafanya ndani yake mabustani ya mitende na mizabibu, na tukatimbua chemchem ndani yake,
translation_en: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -

arabic_text: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Ili wale matunda yake, na hayo hayakufanywa na mikono yao! Basi je, hawashukuru?
translation_en: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?

arabic_text: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Subhana, Ametakasika, aliye umba dume na jike vyote katika vinavyo mea katika ardhi na katika nafsi zao, na katika wasivyo vijua.
translation_en: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.

arabic_text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na usiku ni Ishara kwao. Tunauvua humo mchana, mara wao wanakuwa gizani.
translation_en: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.

arabic_text: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
translation_sw: Na jua linakwenda kwa kiwango chake. Hayo ni makadirio ya Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

arabic_text: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
translation_sw: Na mwezi tumeupimia vituo, mpaka unakuwa kama karara kongwe.
translation_en: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

arabic_text: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
translation_sw: Haliwi jua kuufikia mwezi, wala usiku kuupita mchana. Na vyote vinaogelea katika njia zao.
translation_en: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

arabic_text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_sw: Na ni Ishara kwao kwamba Sisi tuliwapakia dhuriya zao katika jahazi ilio sheheni.
translation_en: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.

arabic_text: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
translation_sw: Na tukawaumbia kutoka mfano wake wanavyo vipanda.
translation_en: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

arabic_text: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
translation_sw: Na tukitaka tunawazamisha, wala hapana wa kuwasaidia, wala hawaokolewi,
translation_en: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

arabic_text: إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa kwa rehema zitokazo kwetu na starehe kwa muda.
translation_en: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo ambiwa: Jilindeni na yalioko mbele yenu na yalioko nyuma yenu, ili mpate kurehemewa...
translation_en: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "

arabic_text: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
translation_sw: Na haiwafikii Ishara yoyote katika Ishara za Mola wao Mlezi ila wao huwa ni wenye kuipuuza.
translation_en: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Na wanapo ambiwa: Toeni katika aliyo kupeni Mwenyezi Mungu, walio kufuru huwaambia walio amini: Je! Tuwalishe ambao Mwenyezi Mungu angependa angeli walisha mwenyewe? Nyinyi hammo ila katika upotofu ulio dhaahiri.
translation_en: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanasema: Ahadi hii itatokea lini, ikiwa nyinyi ni wakweli?
translation_en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

arabic_text: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
translation_sw: Hawangojei ila ukelele mmoja tu utakao wachukua nao wamo kuzozana.
translation_en: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.

arabic_text: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_sw: Basi hawataweza kuusia, wala kwa watu wao hawarejei.
translation_en: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.

arabic_text: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na litapulizwa barugumu, mara watatoka makaburini wakikimbilia kwa Mola wao Mlezi.
translation_en: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_sw: Watasema: Ole wetu! Nani aliye tufufua kwenye malazi yetu? Haya ndiyo aliyo yaahidi Mwingi wa Rehema na wakasema kweli Mitume.
translation_en: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

arabic_text: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
translation_sw: Haitakuwa ila ukelele mmoja tu, mara wote watahudhuruishwa mbele yetu.
translation_en: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.

arabic_text: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Basi leo nafsi yoyote haitadhulumiwa kitu, wala hamtalipwa ila yale mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda.
translation_en: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.

arabic_text: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika watu wa Peponi leo wamo shughulini, wamefurahi.
translation_en: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -

arabic_text: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
translation_sw: Wao na wake zao wamo katika vivuli wameegemea juu ya viti vya fakhari.
translation_en: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

arabic_text: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
translation_sw: Watapata humo kila namna ya matunda na watapata kila watakacho kitaka.
translation_en: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: "Salama!" Hiyo ndiyo kauli itokayo kwa Mola Mlezi Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

arabic_text: وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na enyi wakosefu! Jitengeni leo!
translation_en: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.

arabic_text: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Je! Sikuagana nanyi, enyi wanaadamu, kuwa msimuabudu Shet'ani? Hakika yeye ni adui dhaahiri kwenu.
translation_en: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

arabic_text: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na ya kwamba mniabudu Mimi? Hii ndiyo Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka yeye amekwisha lipoteza kundi kubwa miongoni mwenu. Je, hamkuwa mkifikiri?
translation_en: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?

arabic_text: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Hii basi ndiyo Jahannamu mliyo kuwa mkiahidiwa.
translation_en: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.

arabic_text: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
translation_sw: Ingieni leo kwa vile mlivyo kuwa mkikufuru.
translation_en: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."

arabic_text: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_sw: Leo tunaviziba vinywa vyao, na iseme nasi mikono yao, na itoe ushahidi miguu yao kwa waliyo kuwa wakiyachuma.
translation_en: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na tungeli penda tungeli yafutilia mbali macho yao, wakawa wanaiwania njia. Lakini wange ionaje?
translation_en: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?

arabic_text: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_sw: Na tungeli taka tunge wageuza sura hapo hapo walipo, basi wasinge weza kwenda wala kurudi.
translation_en: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.

arabic_text: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na tunaye mzeesha tunamrudisha nyuma katika umbo. Basi je! hawazingatii?
translation_en: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?

arabic_text: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Wala hatukumfundisha (Muhammad) mashairi, wala hayatakikani kwake hayo. Haukuwa huu ila ni ukumbusho na Qur'ani inayo bainisha.
translation_en: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an

arabic_text: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Ili imwonye aliye hai, na neno litimie juu ya makafiri.
translation_en: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Hawaoni kwamba tumewaumbia kutokana na iliyo fanya mikono yetu wanyama wa mifugo, na wao wakawa wenye kuwamiliki.
translation_en: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?

arabic_text: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
translation_sw: Na Sisi tukawadhalilishia. Basi baadhi yao wako wanao wapanda, na baadhi yao wanawala.
translation_en: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.

arabic_text: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wao wanapata kwao manufaa na vinywaji. Basi je, hawashukuru?
translation_en: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?

arabic_text: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wameishika miungu mingine badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu ili ati wapate kusaidiwa!
translation_en: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.

arabic_text: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ
translation_sw: Hawataweza kuwasaidia. Bali hao ndio watakuwa askari wao watakao hudhurishwa.
translation_en: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.

arabic_text: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
translation_sw: Basi maneno yao yasikuhuzunishe. Hakika Sisi tunayajua wanayo yaweka siri na wanayo yatangaza.
translation_en: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Kwani mwanaadamu haoni ya kwamba Sisi tumemuumba yeye kutokana na tone la manii? Kisha sasa yeye ndio amekuwa ndiye mgomvi wa dhaahiri!
translation_en: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?

arabic_text: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na akatupigia mfano, na akasahau kuumbwa kwake, akasema: Ni nani huyo atakaye ihuisha mifupa nayo imekwisha mung'unyika?
translation_en: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"

arabic_text: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
translation_sw: Sema: Ataihuisha huyo huyo aliye iumba hapo mara ya mwanzo. Na Yeye ni Mjuzi wa kila kuumba.
translation_en: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
translation_sw: Aliye kujaalieni kupata moto kutokana na mti wa kijani nanyi mkawa kwa huo mnawasha.
translation_en: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.

arabic_text: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Kwani aliye ziumba mbingu na ardhi hawezi kuwaumba mfano wao? Kwani! Naye ndiye Muumbaji Mkuu, Mjuzi.
translation_en: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation_sw: Hakika amri yake anapo taka kitu ni kukiambia tu: Kuwa! Na kikawa.
translation_en: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.

arabic_text: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Basi Ametakasika yule ambaye mkononi mwake umo Ufalme wa kila kitu; na kwake Yeye mtarejeshwa.
translation_en: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.

arabic_text: وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفًّۭا
translation_sw: Naapa kwa wanao jipanga kwa safu.
translation_en: By those [angels] lined up in rows

arabic_text: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًۭا
translation_sw: Na kwa wenye kukataza mabaya.
translation_en: And those who drive [the clouds]

arabic_text: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_sw: Na kwa wenye kusoma Ukumbusho.
translation_en: And those who recite the message,

arabic_text: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika Mungu wenu bila ya shaka ni Mmoja.
translation_en: Indeed, your God is One,

arabic_text: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ
translation_sw: Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na ardhi, na yaliyomo kati yao, na ni Mola Mlezi wa mashariki zote.
translation_en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.

arabic_text: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumeipamba mbingu ya karibu kwa pambo la nyota.
translation_en: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

arabic_text: وَحِفْظًۭا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ مَّارِدٍۢ
translation_sw: Na kulinda na kila shet'ani a'si.
translation_en: And as protection against every rebellious devil

arabic_text: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍۢ
translation_sw: Wasiweze kuwasikiliza viumbe watukufu. Na wanafukuzwa huko kila upande.
translation_en: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,

arabic_text: دُحُورًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ وَاصِبٌ
translation_sw: Wakifurushwa. Na wanayo adhabu ya kudumu.
translation_en: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

arabic_text: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ ثَاقِبٌۭ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa anaye nyakua kitu kidogo, na mara humfwatia kimondo kinacho ng'ara.
translation_en: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].

arabic_text: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ
translation_sw: Hebu waulize: Je! Wao ni wenye umbo gumu zaidi au hao wengine tulio waumba. Hakika Sisi tuliwaumba wao kwa udongo unao nata.
translation_en: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.

arabic_text: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
translation_sw: Bali unastaajabu, na wao wanafanya maskhara.
translation_en: But you wonder, while they mock,

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo kumbushwa hawakumbuki.
translation_en: And when they are reminded, they remember not.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo ona Ishara, wanafanya maskhara.
translation_en: And when they see a sign, they ridicule

arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
translation_sw: Na husema: Haya si chochote ila ni uchawi tu ulio dhaahiri.
translation_en: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.

arabic_text: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_sw: Ati tukisha kufa na tukawa udongo na mifupa ndio kweli tutafufuliwa?
translation_en: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

arabic_text: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
translation_sw: Hata baba zetu wa zamani?
translation_en: And our forefathers [as well]?"

arabic_text: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Naam! Hali nanyi ni madhalili.
translation_en: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

arabic_text: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_sw: Huko utapigwa ukelele mmoja tu! Na hapo ndio wataona!
translation_en: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Watasema: Ole wetu! Hii ndiyo Siku ya Malipo.
translation_en: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."

arabic_text: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_sw: Hii ndiyo Siku ya Hukumu mliyo kuwa mkiikadhibisha.
translation_en: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

arabic_text: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
translation_sw: Wakusanyeni walio dhulumu, na wake zao, na hao walio kuwa wakiwaabudu -
translation_en: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship

arabic_text: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_sw: Badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Waongozeni njia ya Jahannamu!
translation_en: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire

arabic_text: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
translation_sw: Na wasimamisheni. Hakika hao watasailiwa:
translation_en: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."

arabic_text: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
translation_sw: Mna nini? Mbona hamsaidiani?
translation_en: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"

arabic_text: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Bali hii leo, watasalimu amri.
translation_en: But they, that Day, are in surrender.

arabic_text: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_sw: Watakabiliana wao kwa wao kuulizana.
translation_en: And they will approach one another blaming each other.

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_sw: Watasema: Kwa hakika nyinyi mlikuwa mkitujia upande wa kulia.
translation_en: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Watasema (wakubwa): Bali nyinyi wenyewe hamkuwa Waumini.
translation_en: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

arabic_text: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَٰغِينَ
translation_sw: Sisi hatukuwa na mamlaka juu yenu, bali nyinyi wenyewe mlikuwa wapotovu.
translation_en: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.

arabic_text: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
translation_sw: Basi hukumu ya Mola wetu Mlezi imekwisha tuthibitikia. Hakika bila ya shaka tutaonja tu adhabu.
translation_en: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].

arabic_text: فَأَغْوَيْنَٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ
translation_sw: Tulikupotezeni kwa sababu sisi wenyewe tulikuwa wapotovu.
translation_en: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."

arabic_text: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Basi wao kwa hakika siku hiyo watashirikiana katika adhabu pamoja.
translation_en: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.

arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Hivyo ndivyo tutakavyo wafanyia wakosefu.
translation_en: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
translation_sw: Wao walipo kuwa wakiambiwa La ilaha illa 'Llahu Hapana mungu ila Mwenyezi Mungu tu, wakijivuna.
translation_en: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
translation_sw: Na wakisema: Hivyo sisi tuiache miungu yetu kwa ajili ya huyu mtunga mashairi mwendawazimu?
translation_en: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"

arabic_text: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Bali huyu amekuja kwa Haki, na amewasadikisha Mitume.
translation_en: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.

arabic_text: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
translation_sw: Hakika nyinyi bila ya shaka mtaionja adhabu chungu.
translation_en: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,

arabic_text: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Wala hamlipwi ila hayo mliyo kuwa mkiyafanya.
translation_en: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -

arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa waja wa Mwenyezi Mungu walio khitariwa.
translation_en: But not the chosen servants of Allah.

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
translation_sw: Hao ndio watakao pata riziki maalumu,
translation_en: Those will have a provision determined -

arabic_text: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_sw: Matunda, nao watahishimiwa.
translation_en: Fruits; and they will be honored

arabic_text: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_sw: Katika Bustani za neema.
translation_en: In gardens of pleasure

arabic_text: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
translation_sw: Wako juu ya viti wamekabiliana.
translation_en: On thrones facing one another.

arabic_text: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_sw: Wanazungushiwa kikombe chenye kinywaji cha chemchem
translation_en: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,

arabic_text: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍۢ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
translation_sw: Kinywaji cheupe, kitamu kwa wanywao.
translation_en: White and delicious to the drinkers;

arabic_text: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
translation_sw: Hakina madhara, wala hakiwaleweshi.
translation_en: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.

arabic_text: وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Na watakuwa nao wanawake wenye macho ya staha mazuri.
translation_en: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,

arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
translation_sw: Hao wanawake kama mayai yaliyo hifadhika.
translation_en: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.

arabic_text: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_sw: Waingie kuulizana wenyewe kwa wenyewe.
translation_en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

arabic_text: قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Aseme msemaji mmoja miongoni mwao: Hakika mimi nalikuwa na rafiki
translation_en: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]

arabic_text: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
translation_sw: Aliye kuwa akinambia: Hivyo wewe ni katika wanao sadiki
translation_en: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

arabic_text: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
translation_sw: Ati tukisha kufa tukawa udongo na mafupa, ndio tutalipwa na kuhisabiwa?
translation_en: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"

arabic_text: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
translation_sw: Atasema: Je! Nyie mnawaona?
translation_en: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"

arabic_text: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_sw: Basi atachungulia amwone katikati ya Jahannamu.
translation_en: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.

arabic_text: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
translation_sw: Atasema: Wallahi! Ulikaribia kunipoteza.
translation_en: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me.

arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
translation_sw: Na lau kuwa si neema ya Mola wangu Mlezi bila ya shaka ningeli kuwa miongoni mwa walio hudhurishwa.
translation_en: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].

arabic_text: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
translation_sw: Je! Sisi hatutakufa,
translation_en: Then, are we not to die

arabic_text: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa kifo chetu cha kwanza? Wala sisi hatutaadhibiwa.
translation_en: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_sw: Hakika huku bila ya shaka ndiko kufuzu kukubwa.
translation_en: Indeed, this is the great attainment.

arabic_text: لِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَٰمِلُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa mfano wa haya nawatende watendao.
translation_en: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

arabic_text: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_sw: Je! Kukaribishwa hivi si ndio bora, au mti wa Zaqqum?
translation_en: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?

arabic_text: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumeufanya huo kuwa ni mateso kwa walio dhulumu.
translation_en: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

arabic_text: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_sw: Hakika huo ni mti unao toka katikati ya Jahannamu.
translation_en: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,

arabic_text: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
translation_sw: Mashada ya matunda yake kama kwamba vichwa vya mashet'ani.
translation_en: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

arabic_text: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
translation_sw: Basi hakika bila ya shaka hao watayala hayo, na wajaze matumbo.
translation_en: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًۭا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Kisha juu yake wanyweshwe mchanganyo wa maji yamoto yaliyo chemka.
translation_en: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_sw: Kisha hakika marejeo yao bila ya shaka yatakuwa kwenye Jahannamu.
translation_en: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
translation_sw: Hakika waliwakuta baba zao wamepotea.
translation_en: Indeed they found their fathers astray.

arabic_text: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na wao wakafanya haraka kufuata nyayo zao.
translation_en: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka walikwisha potea kabla yao wengi wa watu wa zamani.
translation_en: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na Sisi hakika tuliwapelekea waonyaji.
translation_en: And We had already sent among them warners.

arabic_text: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_sw: Basi hebu angalia ulikuwaje mwisho wa walio onywa.
translation_en: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -

arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa waja wa Mwenyezi Mungu walio khitariwa.
translation_en: But not the chosen servants of Allah.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌۭ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika Nuhu alitwita, na Sisi ni bora wa waitikiaji.
translation_en: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.

arabic_text: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_sw: Na tulimwokoa yeye na ahali zake kutokana na msiba mkubwa.
translation_en: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_sw: Na tuliwajaalia dhuriya zake ndio wenye kubakia.
translation_en: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

arabic_text: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukamwachia (sifa njema) kwa walio kuja baadaye.
translation_en: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Iwe salama kwa Nuhu ulimwenguni kote!
translation_en: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."

arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika hivi ndivyo tunavyo walipa wanao fanya mema.
translation_en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika yeye ni katika waja wetu walio amini.
translation_en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukawazamisha wale wengine.
translation_en: Then We drowned the disbelievers.

arabic_text: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_sw: Na hakika Ibrahim alikuwa katika kundi lake,
translation_en: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,

arabic_text: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍ
translation_sw: Alipo mjia Mola wake Mlezi kwa moyo mzima.
translation_en: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_sw: Alimwambia baba yake na watu wake: Mnaabudu nini?
translation_en: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?

arabic_text: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةًۭ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa kuzua tu mnataka miungu mingine badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu?
translation_en: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?

arabic_text: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Mnamdhania nini Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote?
translation_en: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
