arabic_text: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةًۭ فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_sw: Kisha akapiga jicho kutazama nyota.
translation_en: And he cast a look at the stars

arabic_text: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hakika mimi ni mgonjwa!
translation_en: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."

arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Nao wakamwacha, wakampa kisogo.
translation_en: So they turned away from him, departing.

arabic_text: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_sw: Basi akaiendea miungu yao kwa siri, akaiambia: Mbona hamli?
translation_en: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?

arabic_text: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
translation_sw: Mna nini hata hamsemi?
translation_en: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"

arabic_text: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_sw: Kisha akaigeukia kuipiga kwa mkono wa kulia.
translation_en: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.

arabic_text: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
translation_sw: Basi wakamjia upesi upesi.
translation_en: Then the people came toward him, hastening.

arabic_text: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hivyo mnaviabudu vitu mnavyo vichonga wenyewe?
translation_en: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na hali Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye aliye kuumbeni nyinyi na hivyo mnavyo vifanya!
translation_en: While Allah created you and that which you do?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Mjengeeni jengo, na kisha mtupeni motoni humo!
translation_en: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."

arabic_text: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًۭا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
translation_sw: Basi walitaka kumfanyia vitimbi, lakini tukawafanya wao ndio wa chini.
translation_en: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_sw: Na akasema: Hakika mimi nahama, nakwenda kwa Mola wangu Mlezi; Yeye ataniongoa.
translation_en: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.

arabic_text: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Ewe Mola wangu Mlezi! Nitunukie aliye miongoni mwa watenda mema.
translation_en: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

arabic_text: فَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi tukambashiria mwana aliye mpole.
translation_en: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Basi alipo fika makamo ya kwenda na kurudi pamoja naye, alimwambia: Ewe mwanangu! Hakika mimi nimeona usingizini kuwa ninakuchinja. Basi angalia wewe, waonaje? Akasema: Ewe baba yangu! Tenda unavyo amrishwa, utanikuta mimi, Inshallah, katika wanao subiri.
translation_en: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
translation_sw: Basi wote wawili walipo jisalimisha, na akamlaza juu ya kipaji.
translation_en: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,

arabic_text: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
translation_sw: Tulimwita: Ewe Ibrahim!
translation_en: We called to him, "O Abraham,

arabic_text: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Umekwisha itimiliza ndoto. Hakika hivi ndivyo tunavyo walipa wanao tenda mema.
translation_en: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Hakika haya ni majaribio yaliyo dhaahiri.
translation_en: Indeed, this was the clear trial.

arabic_text: وَفَدَيْنَٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi tukamtolea fidia kwa dhabihu mtukufu.
translation_en: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,

arabic_text: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukamwachia (sifa njema) kwa watu walio kuja baadaye.
translation_en: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_sw: Iwe salama kwa Ibrahim!
translation_en: "Peace upon Abraham."

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hivi ndivyo tunavyo walipa wanao fanya mema.
translation_en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika yeye ni katika waja wetu walio amini.
translation_en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

arabic_text: وَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِإِسْحَٰقَ نَبِيًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukambashiria kuzaliwa Is-haqa, naye ni Nabii miongoni mwa watu wema.
translation_en: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.

arabic_text: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌۭ وَظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Na tukambarikia yeye na Is-haqa. Na miongoni mwa dhuriya zao walitokea wema na wenye kudhulumu nafsi zao waziwazi.
translation_en: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika tuliwafanyia hisani Musa na Haruni.
translation_en: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.

arabic_text: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_sw: Na tukawaokoa wao na watu wao kutokana na dhiki kubwa.
translation_en: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,

arabic_text: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukawanusuru; na wakawa wao ndio wenye kushinda.
translation_en: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.

arabic_text: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukawapa wawili hao Kitabu kinacho bainisha.
translation_en: And We gave them the explicit Scripture,

arabic_text: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
translation_sw: Na tukawaongoa kwenye Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: And We guided them on the straight path.

arabic_text: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukawaachia (sifa njema) katika watu walio kuja baadaye.
translation_en: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:

arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
translation_sw: Iwe salama kwa Musa na Haruni!
translation_en: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."

arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika hivyo ndivyo tunavyo walipa walio wema.
translation_en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika wawili hao ni katika waja wetu walio amini.
translation_en: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika Ilyas bila ya shaka alikuwa miongoni mwa Mitume.
translation_en: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Alipo waambia watu wake: Hamwogopi?
translation_en: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah?

arabic_text: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًۭا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
translation_sw: Mnamwomba Baa'li na mnamwacha Mbora wa waumbaji,
translation_en: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -

arabic_text: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wenu na Mola Mlezi wa baba zenu wa zamani?
translation_en: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"

arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_sw: Wakamkadhibisha. Basi kwa hakika watahudhurishwa;
translation_en: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],

arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa waja wa Mwenyezi Mungu walio safishwa.
translation_en: Except the chosen servants of Allah.

arabic_text: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na tumemwachia (sifa nzuri) kwa walio kuja baadaye.
translation_en: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
translation_sw: Iwe salama kwa Ilyas.
translation_en: "Peace upon Elias."

arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika hivyo ndivyo tunavyo walipa walio wema.
translation_en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika yeye ni katika waja wetu walio amini.
translation_en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لُوطًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika Lut'i bila ya shaka ni miongoni mwa Mitume.
translation_en: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.

arabic_text: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Tulipo mwokoa yeye na ahali zake wote,
translation_en: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,

arabic_text: إِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa mwanamke mkongwe katika wale walio bakia nyuma.
translation_en: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].

arabic_text: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukawaangamiza wale wengineo.
translation_en: Then We destroyed the others.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika nyinyi mnawapitia wakati wa asubuhi,
translation_en: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning

arabic_text: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na usiku. Basi je! Hamyatii akilini?
translation_en: And at night. Then will you not use reason?

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika Yunus alikuwa miongoni mwa Mitume.
translation_en: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.

arabic_text: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_sw: Alipo kimbia katika jahazi lilio sheheni.
translation_en: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

arabic_text: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
translation_sw: Akaingia katika kupigiwa kura, na akawa katika walio shindwa.
translation_en: And he drew lots and was among the losers.

arabic_text: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Samaki akammeza hali ya kuwa ni mwenye kulaumiwa.
translation_en: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.

arabic_text: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
translation_sw: Na ingeli kuwa hakuwa katika wanao mtakasa Mwenyezi Mungu,
translation_en: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah,

arabic_text: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_sw: Bila ya shaka angeli kaa ndani yake mpaka siku ya kufufuliwa.
translation_en: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.

arabic_text: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Lakini tulimtupa ufukweni patupu, hali yu mgonjwa.
translation_en: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.

arabic_text: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةًۭ مِّن يَقْطِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Na tukauotesha juu yake mmea wa kabila ya mung'unye.
translation_en: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.

arabic_text: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
translation_sw: Na tulimtuma kwa watu laki moja au zaidi.
translation_en: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.

arabic_text: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi wakaamini, na tukawastarehesha kwa muda.
translation_en: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.

arabic_text: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
translation_sw: Basi waulize: Ati Mola wako Mlezi ndiye mwenye watoto wa kike, na wao wanao watoto wa kiume?
translation_en: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?

arabic_text: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًۭا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ
translation_sw: Au tumewaumba Malaika kuwa ni wanawake, na wao wakashuhudia?
translation_en: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"

arabic_text: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_sw: Ati ni kwa uzushi wao ndio wanasema:
translation_en: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,

arabic_text: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu amezaa! Ama hakika bila ya shaka hao ni waongo!
translation_en: " Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.

arabic_text: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
translation_sw: Ati amekhiari watoto wa kike kuliko wanaume?
translation_en: Has He chosen daughters over sons?

arabic_text: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_sw: Mna nini? Mnahukumu vipi nyinyi?
translation_en: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?

arabic_text: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Hamkumbuki?
translation_en: Then will you not be reminded?

arabic_text: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَٰنٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Au mnayo hoja iliyo wazi?
translation_en: Or do you have a clear authority?

arabic_text: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Basi leteni Kitabu chenu kama mnasema kweli.
translation_en: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wameweka makhusiano ya nasaba baina yake na majini; na majini wamekwisha jua bila ya shaka kuwa wao watahudhurishwa.
translation_en: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].

arabic_text: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_sw: Subhana 'Llah Ametakasika Mwenyezi Mungu na hayo wanayo msingizia.
translation_en: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,

arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa waja wa Mwenyezi Mungu walio safishwa.
translation_en: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].

arabic_text: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_sw: Basi hakika nyinyi na mnao waabudu
translation_en: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,

arabic_text: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hamwezi kuwapoteza
translation_en: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him

arabic_text: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa yule atakaye ingia Motoni.
translation_en: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.

arabic_text: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
translation_sw: Na hapana katika sisi ila anapo mahali pake maalumu.
translation_en: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika bila ya shaka sisi ndio wajipangao safu.
translation_en: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].

arabic_text: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika sisi ndio wenye kusabihi kutakasa.
translation_en: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah."

arabic_text: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_sw: Na walikuwapo walio kuwa wakisema:
translation_en: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,

arabic_text: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Tungeli kuwa na Ukumbusho kama wa watu wa zamani,
translation_en: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,

arabic_text: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_sw: Bila ya shaka tungeli kuwa ni waja wa Mwenyezi Mungu wenye ikhlasi.
translation_en: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah."

arabic_text: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini waliukataa. Basi watakuja jua.
translation_en: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka neno letu lilikwisha tangulia kwa waja wetu walio tumwa.
translation_en: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,

arabic_text: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
translation_sw: Ya kuwa wao bila ya shaka ndio watakao nusuriwa.
translation_en: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
translation_sw: Na kwamba jeshi letu ndilo litakalo shinda.
translation_en: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.

arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi waachilie mbali kwa muda.
translation_en: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.

arabic_text: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na watazame, nao wataona.
translation_en: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.

arabic_text: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Wanaihimiza adhabu yetu?
translation_en: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?

arabic_text: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_sw: Basi itakapo shuka uwanjani kwao, itakuwa asubuhi mbaya kwa walio onywa.
translation_en: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.

arabic_text: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Na waache kwa muda.
translation_en: And leave them for a time.

arabic_text: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na tazama, na wao wataona.
translation_en: And see, for they are going to see.

arabic_text: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_sw: Subhana Rabbi'l'Izzat Ametakasika Mola Mlezi Mwenye enzi na yale wanayo mzulia.
translation_en: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.

arabic_text: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_sw: Na Salamu juu ya Mitume.
translation_en: And peace upon the messengers.

arabic_text: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
translation_sw: S'ad, Naapa kwa Qur'ani yenye mawaidha.
translation_en: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...

arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ
translation_sw: Lakini walio kufuru wamo katika majivuno na upinzani
translation_en: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

arabic_text: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ
translation_sw: Mataifa mangapi tumeyaangamiza kabla yao, na wakapiga kelele, lakini wakati wa kuokoka ulikwisha pita.
translation_en: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.

arabic_text: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌ
translation_sw: Na walistaajabu kuwajia mwonyaji anaye tokana nao wenyewe, na makafiri wakasema: Huyu ni mchawi, mwongo.
translation_en: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

arabic_text: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْءَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌۭ
translation_sw: Amewafanya miungu wote kuwa ni Mungu Mmoja tu? Hakika hili ni jambo la ajabu.
translation_en: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."

arabic_text: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌۭ يُرَادُ
translation_sw: Na wakaondoka wakubwa wao wakiwaambia: Nendeni zenu na dumuni na miungu yenu, kwani hili ni jambo lililo pangwa.
translation_en: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.

arabic_text: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ
translation_sw: Sisi hatukusikia haya katika mila hii ya mwisho. Haya si chochote ila ni uzushi tu.
translation_en: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.

arabic_text: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
translation_sw: Ati yeye tu ndiye aliye teremshiwa mawaidha peke yake katika sisi? Lakini hao wana shaka na mawaidha yangu, bali hawajaionja adhabu yangu.
translation_en: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

arabic_text: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
translation_sw: Au wanazo wao khazina za rehema za Mola wako Mlezi, Mwenye nguvu, Mpaji?
translation_en: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?

arabic_text: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ
translation_sw: Au wao wana ufalme wa mbingu na ardhi na viliomo kati yao? Basi nawazipande njia za kwendea huko!
translation_en: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.

arabic_text: جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
translation_sw: Hao ni askari watao shindwa miongoni mwa makundi yatayo shindwa.
translation_en: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].

arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
translation_sw: Walikanusha kabla yao kaumu ya Nuhu, na kina A'adi na Firauni mwenye majengo.
translation_en: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,

arabic_text: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
translation_sw: Na Thamud na kaumu Lut'i na watu wa Machakani. Hayo ndiyo makundi.
translation_en: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.

arabic_text: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
translation_sw: Hao wote waliwakadhibisha Mitume; basi wakastahiki adhabu yangu.
translation_en: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.

arabic_text: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ
translation_sw: Na hawa hawangojei ila ukelele mmoja tu usio na muda.
translation_en: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_sw: Na wao husema: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tuletee upesi sehemu yetu ya adhabu kabla ya Siku ya Hisabu.
translation_en: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"

arabic_text: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_sw: Subiri kwa hayo wayasemayo, na umkumbuke mja wetu Daudi, mwenye nguvu. Hakika yeye alikuwa mwingi wa kutubia.
translation_en: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].

arabic_text: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
translation_sw: Hakika tuliidhalilisha milima pamoja naye ikisabihi jioni na asubuhi pamoja naye.
translation_en: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.

arabic_text: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةًۭ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
translation_sw: Na pia ndege walio kusanywa makundi kwa makundi; wote walikuwa wanyenyekevu kwake.
translation_en: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].

arabic_text: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
translation_sw: Na tukautia nguvu ufalme wake, na tukampa hikima, na kukata hukumu.
translation_en: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.

arabic_text: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
translation_sw: Na je! Imekufikia khabari ya wagombanao walipo pindukia ukuta kuingia chumbani?
translation_en: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -

arabic_text: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
translation_sw: Walipo muingilia Daudi, naye akawaogopa. Wakasema: Usiogope! Sisi ni wagombanao wawili, mmoja wetu amemdhulumu mwenziwe. Basi tuhukumu kwa haki, wala usipendelee. Na utuongoe kwenye njia iliyo sawa.
translation_en: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
translation_sw: Hakika huyu ndugu yangu ana kondoo wa kike tisiini na tisa; na mimi ninaye kondoo mke mmoja. Akasema: Nipe huyo nikufugie! Na amenishinda kwa maneno.
translation_en: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."

arabic_text: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًۭا وَأَنَابَ ۩
translation_sw: Akasema: Kweli amekudhulumu kwa kumtaka kondoo wako mmoja kuongezea kwenye kondoo wake. Na hakika washirika wengi hudhulumiana wao kwa wao, isipo kuwa walio amini na wakatenda mema. Na hao ni wachache. Na Daudi akajua kuwa tumemfanyia mtihani. Basi akamwomba msamaha Mola wake Mlezi, na akaanguka kusujudu na kutubia.
translation_en: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].

arabic_text: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi tukamsamehe kwa hayo. Naye kwa hakika anao mkaribisho mkubwa na marejeo mazuri kwetu.
translation_en: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

arabic_text: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_sw: Ewe Daudi! Hakika Sisi tumekufanya wewe uwe Khalifa katika nchi. Basi wahukumu watu kwa haki, wala usifuate matamanio yakakupoteza kwenye Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika wanao ipotea Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu wakaiacha, watapata adhabu kali kwa sababu ya kusahau kwao Siku ya Hisabu.
translation_en: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.

arabic_text: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
translation_sw: Na hatukuziumba mbingu na ardhi na viliomo ndani yao bure. Hiyo ni dhana ya walio kufuru. Ole wao walio kufuru kwa Moto utao wapata.
translation_en: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.

arabic_text: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
translation_sw: Je! Tuwafanye walio amini na wakatenda mema kama wafanyao uharibifu katika nchi? Au tuwafanye wachamngu kama waovu?
translation_en: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?

arabic_text: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
translation_sw: Na hiki Kitabu, tumekuteremshia wewe, kimebarikiwa, ili wazizingatie Aya zake, na wawaidhike wenye akili.
translation_en: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.

arabic_text: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_sw: Na Daudi tukamtunukia Suleiman. Alikuwa mja mwema. Na hakika alikuwa mwingi wa kutubia.
translation_en: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].

arabic_text: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
translation_sw: Alipo pelekewa jioni farasi wasimamao kidete, tayari kutoka shoti;
translation_en: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.

arabic_text: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
translation_sw: Basi akasema: Navipenda vitu vizuri kwa kumkumbuka Mola wangu Mlezi. Kisha wakafichikana nyuma ya boma.
translation_en: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."

arabic_text: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
translation_sw: (Akasema:) Nirudishieni! Akaanza kuwapapasa miguu na shingo.
translation_en: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًۭا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
translation_sw: Na tulimtia mtihanini Suleiman, na tukauweka mwili juu ya kiti chake, kisha akarejea kwa kutubu.
translation_en: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًۭا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nisamehe na unipe ufalme usio mwelekea yeyote baada yangu. Hakika Wewe ndiye Mpaji.
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."

arabic_text: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
translation_sw: Basi tukaufanya upepo umtumikie, ukenda kwa amri yake, popote alipo taka kufika.
translation_en: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,

arabic_text: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍۢ وَغَوَّاصٍۢ
translation_sw: Na tukayafanya mashet'ani yamtumikie, wote wajenzi na wapiga mbizi.
translation_en: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver

arabic_text: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
translation_sw: Na wengine wafungwao kwa minyororo.
translation_en: And others bound together in shackles.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
translation_sw: Hichi ndicho kipawa chetu. Basi toa au zuia, bila ya hisabu.
translation_en: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
translation_sw: Na hakika yeye kwetu Sisi ana cheo cha kukaribishwa kwetu, na pahala pazuri pa kurejea.
translation_en: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

arabic_text: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
translation_sw: Na mkumbuke mja wetu Ayubu alipo mwita Mola wake Mlezi akasema: Kwa hakika Shet'ani amenifikishia udhia na adhabu.
translation_en: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."

arabic_text: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
translation_sw: (Akaambiwa:) Piga-piga ardhi kwa mguu wako! Basi haya maji baridi ya kuogea na ya kunywa.
translation_en: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."

arabic_text: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
translation_sw: Na tukampa ahali zake na wengine kama wao pamoja nao, kuwa ni rehema itokayo kwetu, na iwe kumbusho kwa watu wenye akili.
translation_en: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.

arabic_text: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًۭا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًۭا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
translation_sw: Na shika kicha cha vijiti tu mkononi mwako, kisha ndio upigie nacho, wala usivunje kiapo. Hakika tulimkuta mwenye subira, mbora wa waja, kwa hakika alikuwa mwingi wa kutubu.
translation_en: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].

arabic_text: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
translation_sw: Na wakumbuke waja wetu, Ibrahim na Is-haqa na Yaa'qubu walio kuwa na nguvu na busara.
translation_en: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍۢ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
translation_sw: Sisi tumewakhusisha wao kwa sifa ya ukumbusho wa Akhera.
translation_en: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
translation_sw: Na hakika wao kwetu sisi ni wateuliwa walio bora.
translation_en: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.

arabic_text: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
translation_sw: Na mkumbuke Ismail na Alyasaa na Dhulkifli, na wote hao ni katika walio bora.
translation_en: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
translation_sw: Huu ni ukumbusho. Na hakika wachamngu wana marudio mazuri.
translation_en: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return

arabic_text: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ مُّفَتَّحَةًۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
translation_sw: Bustani za milele zitazo funguliwa milango yao kwa ajili yao.
translation_en: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.

arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ وَشَرَابٍۢ
translation_sw: Humo wataegemea matakia, wawe wanaagiza humo matunda mengi na vinywaji.
translation_en: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.

arabic_text: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
translation_sw: Na pamoja nao wake zao wenye kutuliza macho, hirimu zao.
translation_en: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_sw: Haya ndiyo mliyo ahidiwa kwa Siku ya Hisabu.
translation_en: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
translation_sw: Hakika hii ndiyo riziki yetu isiyo malizika.
translation_en: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍۢ
translation_sw: Ndio hivi! Na hakika wenye kuasi bila ya shaka watapata marudio maovu kabisa;
translation_en: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -

arabic_text: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
translation_sw: Nayo ni Jahannamu! Wataingia humo. Nacho hicho ni kitanda kiovu mno cha kulalia.
translation_en: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌۭ وَغَسَّاقٌۭ
translation_sw: Ndio hivi! Basi na wayaonje maji ya moto na ya usaha!
translation_en: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.

arabic_text: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
translation_sw: Na adhabu nyenginezo za namna hii.
translation_en: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌۭ مُّقْتَحِمٌۭ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
translation_sw: Hili ndilo kundi litakalo ingia pamoja nanyi. Hapana makaribisho mema kwao. Hakika hao wanaingia Motoni.
translation_en: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
translation_sw: Waseme: Lakini nyinyi! Hamna mapokezi mazuri! Nyinyi ndio mlio tusabibisha haya, napo ni pahala paovu kabisa!
translation_en: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًۭا ضِعْفًۭا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
translation_sw: Waseme: Mola wetu Mlezi! Aliye tusabibisha haya mzidishie adhabu mara mbili Motoni.
translation_en: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًۭا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
translation_sw: Watasema: Tuna nini hata hatuwaoni wale watu ambao tukiwahisabu ndio katika waovu?
translation_en: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?

arabic_text: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
translation_sw: Tulikosea tulipo wafanyia maskhara, au macho yetu tu hayawaoni?
translation_en: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"

arabic_text: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّۭ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
translation_sw: Hakika hayo bila ya shaka ndiyo makhasimiano ya watu wa Motoni.
translation_en: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
translation_sw: Sema: Hakika mimi ni mwonyaji tu; na hapana mungu ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja, Mtenda nguvu,
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.

arabic_text: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
translation_sw: Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na ardhi na viliomo baina yake, Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye kusamehe.
translation_en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."

arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
translation_sw: Sema: Hii ni khabari kubwa kabisa.
translation_en: Say, "It is great news

arabic_text: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
translation_sw: Ambayo nyinyi mnaipuuza.
translation_en: From which you turn away.

arabic_text: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation_sw: Sikuwa na ilimu ya mambo ya viumbe wakuu watukufu walipo kuwa wakishindana.
translation_en: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].

arabic_text: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
translation_sw: Haikufunuliwa kwangu isipo kuwa ya kwamba hakika mimi ni mwonyaji dhaahiri.
translation_en: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن طِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Mola wako Mlezi alipo waambia Malaika: Hakika Mimi nitaumba mtu kutokana na udongo.
translation_en: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
translation_sw: Na nitakapo mkamilisha na kumpulizia roho inayo tokana nami, basi muangukieni kwa kumt'ii.
translation_en: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

arabic_text: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation_sw: Basi Malaika wakat'ii wote pamoja.
translation_en: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.

arabic_text: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa Iblisi; alijivuna na akawa katika makafiri.
translation_en: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.

arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu akamwambia: Ewe Iblisi! Kipi kilicho kuzuia kumt'ii yule niliye muumba kwa mikono yangu? Je! Umejiona mkubwa, au umekuwa katika wakuu kweli?
translation_en: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"

arabic_text: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mimi ni bora kuliko yeye. Umeniumba kwa moto, na yeye umemuumba kwa udongo.
translation_en: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."

arabic_text: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Akasema: Basi toka humo, kwani hakika wewe umelaanika.
translation_en: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Na hakika laana yangu itakuwa juu yako mpaka Siku ya Malipo.
translation_en: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nipe muhula mpaka siku watayo fufuliwa viumbe.
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

arabic_text: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu akasema: Basi umekwisha kuwa miongoni mwa walio pewa muhula,
translation_en: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

arabic_text: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
translation_sw: Mpaka siku ya wakati maalumu.
translation_en: Until the Day of the time well-known."

arabic_text: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Akasema (Iblisi): Naapa kwa utukufu wako, bila ya shaka nitawapoteza wote,
translation_en: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all

arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa wale waja wako miongoni mwao walio khitariwa.
translation_en: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

arabic_text: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
translation_sw: Akasema: Haki! Na haki ninaisema.
translation_en: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -

arabic_text: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Bila ya shaka nitaijaza Jahannamu kwa wewe na kwa hao wote wenye kukufuata miongoni mwao.
translation_en: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."

arabic_text: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍۢ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
translation_sw: Sema (Ewe Mtume): Sikuombeni ujira juu ya haya, wala mimi si katika wadanganyifu.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious

arabic_text: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Hayakuwa haya ila ni mawaidha kwa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: It is but a reminder to the worlds.

arabic_text: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka mtajua khabari zake baada ya muda.
translation_en: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."

arabic_text: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
translation_sw: Mteremsho wa Kitabu hiki umetokana na Mwenyezi Mungu, Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumekuteremshia Kitabu hiki kwa Haki. Basi muabudu Mwenyezi Mungu ukimsafia Dini Yeye tu.
translation_en: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.

arabic_text: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَٰذِبٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika Dini Safi ni ya Mwenyezi Mungu tu. Na wale wanao wafanya wenginewe kuwa ni walinzi wakisema: Sisi hatuwaabudu ila wapate kutujongeza tu kumkaribia Mwenyezi Mungu - Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu atahukumu baina yao katika wanayo khitalifiana. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu hamwongoi aliye mwongo kafiri.
translation_en: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.

arabic_text: لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًۭا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
translation_sw: Lau kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu angeli taka kuwa na mwana, basi bila ya shaka angeli teua amtakaye katika alio waumba. Subhanahu, Ametakasika na hayo! Yeye ni Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja, Mtenda atakalo.
translation_en: If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Prevailing.

arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
translation_sw: Ameumba mbingu na ardhi kwa Haki. Hufunika usiku juu ya mchana, na hufunika mchana juu ya usiku. Na amefanya jua na mwezi vitumike. Kila kimojapo kinakwenda kwa kipindi kilicho wekewa. Jueni mtanabahi! Yeye ndiye Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye kusamehe!
translation_en: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

arabic_text: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍۢ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًۭا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍۢ فِى ظُلُمَٰتٍۢ ثَلَٰثٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
translation_sw: Amekuumbeni kutokana na nafsi moja. Kisha akamfanya mwenziwe katika nafsi ile ile. Na akakuleteeni wanyama wa mifugo jozi nane. Anakuumbeni katika matumbo ya mama zenu, umbo baada ya umbo, katika viza vitatu. Huyu ndiye Mwenyezi Mungu Mola wenu Mlezi. Ufalme ni wake. Hapana mungu isipo kuwa Yeye. Basi nyinyi mnageuzwa wapi?
translation_en: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?

arabic_text: إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_sw: Mkikufuru basi Mwenyezi Mungu si mwenye haja nanyi, lakini hafurahii kufuru kwa waja wake. Na mkishukuru Yeye hufurahika nanyi. Wala mbebaji habebi mzigo wa mwingine. Kisha marejeo yenu ni kwa Mola wenu Mlezi. Hapo atakwambieni mliyo kuwa mkiyafanya. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kuyajua vyema yaliyomo vifuani.
translation_en: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allah is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

arabic_text: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
translation_sw: Na taabu inapo mfikia mtu humwomba Mola wake Mlezi naye ameelekea kwake. Kisha akimpa neema kutoka kwake, husahau yale aliyo kuwa akimwitia zamani, na akamfanyia Mwenyezi Mungu washirika ili apoteze watu njia yake. Sema: Starehe na ukafiri wako kwa muda mchache. Kwani hakika wewe utakuwa miongoni mwa watu wa Motoni.
translation_en: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."

arabic_text: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًۭا وَقَآئِمًۭا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
translation_sw: Je! Afanyae ibada nyakati za usiku kwa kusujudu na kusimama akitahadhari na Akhera, na akitaraji rehema za Mola wake Mlezi... Sema: Ati watakuwa sawa wale wanao jua na wale wasio jua? Hakika wanao kumbuka ni watu wenye akili.
translation_en: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.

arabic_text: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌۭ ۗ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
translation_sw: Sema: Enyi waja wangu mlio amini! Mcheni Mola wenu Mlezi. Wale wafanyao wema katika dunia hii watapata wema. Na ardhi ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni kunjufu. Hakika wenye subira watapewa ujira wao bila ya hisabu.
translation_en: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account."

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Hakika mimi nimeamrishwa nimuabudu Mwenyezi Mungu kwa kumsafishia Dini Yeye tu.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.

arabic_text: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na nimeamrishwa niwe wa mwanzo wa Waislamu.
translation_en: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Sema: Hakika mimi ninaogopa adhabu ya Siku Kubwa nikimuasi Mola wangu Mlezi.
translation_en: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."

arabic_text: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُۥ دِينِى
translation_sw: Sema: Mwenyezi Mungu tu namuabudu kwa kumsafishia Yeye tu Dini yangu.
translation_en: Say, "Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,

arabic_text: فَٱعْبُدُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Basi nyinyi abuduni mpendacho badala yake Yeye. Sema: Hakika walio khasirika ni wale walio jikhasiri nafsi zao na ahali zao Siku ya Kiyama. Tambueni kuwa hiyo ndiyo khasara iliyo dhaahiri.
translation_en: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."

arabic_text: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥ ۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
translation_sw: Yatawekwa juu yao mat'abaka ya moto, na chini yao mat'abaka. Kwa hayo Mwenyezi Mungu anawakhofisha waja wake. Enyi waja wangu! Nicheni Mimi!
translation_en: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ
translation_sw: Na wale wanao jiepusha na ibada potovu, na wakarejea kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, watapata bishara njema. Basi wabashirie waja wangu.
translation_en: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُۥٓ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
translation_sw: Ambao husikiliza maneno, wakafuata lilio bora yao. Hao ndio alio waongoa Mwenyezi Mungu, na hao ndio wenye akili.
translation_en: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding.

arabic_text: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ
translation_sw: Je! Yule mwenye kustahiki hukumu ya adhabu, je, wewe unaweza kumwokoa aliyomo katika Moto?
translation_en: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?

arabic_text: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌۭ مَّبْنِيَّةٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
translation_sw: Lakini walio mcha Mola wao Mlezi watapata ghorofa zilizo jengwa juu ya ghorofa; chini yake hupita mito. Ndiyo ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Mwenyezi Mungu havunji ahadi yake.
translation_en: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in [His] promise.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًۭا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
translation_sw: Je! Huoni kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu ameteremsha maji kutoka mbinguni. Kisha akayapitisha kwenye chemchem katika ardhi, kisha kwa maji hayo akatoa mimea yenye rangi mbali mbali? Kisha hunyauka ukaiona imekuwa kimanjano, na kisha huifanya mapepe. Bila ya shaka katika hayo upo ukumbusho kwa wenye akili.
translation_en: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.

arabic_text: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
translation_sw: Je! Yule ambaye Mwenyezi Mungu amemfungulia kifua chake kwa Uislamu, na akawa yuko kwenye nuru itokayo kwa Mola wake Mlezi (ni sawa na mwenye moyo mgumu?) Basi ole wao wenye nyoyo ngumu zisio mkumbuka Mwenyezi Mungu! Hao wamo katika upotofu wa dhaahiri.
translation_en: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبًۭا مُّتَشَٰبِهًۭا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ameteremsha hadithi nzuri kabisa, Kitabu chenye kufanana na kukaririwa; husisimua kwacho ngozi za wenye kumkhofu Mola wao Mlezi. Kisha ngozi zao na nyoyo zao hulainika kwa kumkumbuka Mwenyezi Mungu. Huo ndio uwongofu wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na kwa huo humwongoa amtakaye. Na ambaye ameachwa na Mwenyezi Mungu kupotea, basi hapana wa kumwongoa.
translation_en: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.

arabic_text: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِى بِوَجْهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Atakaye kuwa anapambana kwa uso wake na adhabu mbaya kabisa Siku ya Kiyama (ni sawa na watenda wema?) Na wataambiwa wenye kudhulumu: Onjeni hayo mliyo kuwa mkiyachuma!
translation_en: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."

arabic_text: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Walio kuwa kabla yao walikadhibisha, na ikawajia adhabu kutoka pahala wasipo patambua.
translation_en: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.

arabic_text: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخِزْىَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Basi Mwenyezi Mungu akawaonjesha hizaya katika uhai wa duniani. Na bila ya shaka adhabu ya Akhera ni kubwa zaidi; laiti wangeli jua!
translation_en: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka tumewapigia watu mifano ya kila namna katika hii Qur'ani ili wapate kukumbuka.
translation_en: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.

arabic_text: قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِى عِوَجٍۢ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Qur'ani ya Kiarabu isiyo na upogo, ili wamche Mungu.
translation_en: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous.

arabic_text: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا رَّجُلًۭا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًۭا سَلَمًۭا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu amepiga mfano wa mtu mwenye mabwana washirika wanao gombana, na wa mtu mwengine aliye khusika na bwana mmoja tu. Je! Wako sawa katika hali zao? Alhamdulillahi, Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu! Lakini wengi wao hawajui.
translation_en: Allah presents an example: a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! But most of them do not know.

arabic_text: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌۭ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika wewe utakufa, na wao watakufa.
translation_en: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation_sw: Kisha bila ya shaka mtagombana Siku ya Kiyama mbele ya Mola wenu Mlezi.
translation_en: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.

arabic_text: ۞ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَآءَهُۥٓ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًۭى لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: BASI NI NANI dhaalimu mkubwa kuliko yule aliye msingizia uwongo Mwenyezi Mungu na kuikanusha kweli imfikiapo? Je! Siyo katika Jahannamu makaazi ya hao makafiri?
translation_en: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ ۙ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Na aliye ileta Kweli na akaithibitisha - hao ndio wachamngu.
translation_en: And the one who has brought the truth and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.

arabic_text: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Watapata watakacho taka kwa Mola wao Mlezi. Hayo ndiyo malipo ya watendao mema.
translation_en: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -

arabic_text: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Ili Mwenyezi Mungu awafutie ukomo wa uovu walio ufanya na awalipe ujira wao kwa mujibu wa ukomo wa wema walio kuwa wakiutenda.
translation_en: That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.

arabic_text: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍۢ
translation_sw: Je! Mwenyezi Mungu si wa kumtosheleza mja wake? Na ati wanakutishia kwa hao wenginewe wasio kuwa Yeye! Na aliye hukumiwa na Mwenyezi Mungu kupotea hana wa kumwongoa.
translation_en: Is not Allah sufficient for His Servant [Prophet Muhammad]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.

arabic_text: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّ ۗ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍۢ ذِى ٱنتِقَامٍۢ
translation_sw: Na ambaye Mwenyezi Mungu anamwongoa hana wa kumpotoa. Je! Mwenyezi Mungu si Mwenye nguvu anaye weza kulipiza?
translation_en: And whoever Allah guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allah Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?

arabic_text: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوْ أَرَادَنِى بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَٰتُ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
translation_sw: Na ukiwauliza: Ni nani aliye ziumba mbingu na ardhi. Bila ya shaka watasema: Mwenyezi Mungu. Sema: Je! Mnawaonaje wale mnao waomba badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu, ikiwa Mwenyezi Mungu akitaka kunidhuru, wao wanaweza kuniondolea dhara yake? Au akitaka kunirehemu, je, wao wanaweza kuzuia rehema yake? Sema: Mwenyezi Mungu ananitosheleza. Kwake Yeye wategemee wanao tegemea.
translation_en: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."

arabic_text: قُلْ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَٰمِلٌۭ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Enyi watu wangu! Fanyeni mwezavyo, mimi pia nafanya. Basi mtakuja ona
translation_en: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know

arabic_text: مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌۭ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌۭ مُّقِيمٌ
translation_sw: Ni nani itakaye mfikia adhabu ya kumhizi, na itakaye mshukia adhabu ya daima.
translation_en: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumekuteremshia Kitabu kwa ajili ya watu wote kwa Haki. Basi mwenye kuongoka ni kwa nafsi yake, na mwenye kupotoka bila ya shaka amepotoka kwa khasara yake. Na wewe si mlinzi juu yao.
translation_en: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager over them.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَٱلَّتِى لَمْ تَمُتْ فِى مَنَامِهَا ۖ فَيُمْسِكُ ٱلَّتِى قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: MWENYEZI MUNGU huzipokea roho zinapo kufa. Na zile zisio kufa wakati wa kulala kwake, huzishika zilizo hukumiwa kufa, na huzirudisha nyengine mpaka ufike wakati uliowekwa. Hakika katika hayo bila ya shaka zipo Ishara kwa watu wanao fikiri.
translation_en: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

arabic_text: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَ ۚ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Au ndio wanachukua waombezi badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu? Sema: Ingawa hawana mamlaka juu ya kitu chochote, wala hawatambui lolote?
translation_en: Or have they taken other than Allah as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"

arabic_text: قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ جَمِيعًۭا ۖ لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Uombezi wote uko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Ni wake Yeye tu ufalme wa mbingu na ardhi. Kisha mtarejeshwa kwake.
translation_en: Say, "To Allah belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ ٱشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na anapo tajwa Mwenyezi Mungu peke yake nyoyo za wasio iamini Akhera huchafuka. Na wanapo tajwa wenginewe asiye kuwa Yeye basi wao hufurahi.
translation_en: And when Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.

arabic_text: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ عَٰلِمَ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِى مَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu! Muumba mbingu na ardhi! Mjuzi wa yasiyo onekana na yanayo onekana! Wewe utahukumu baina ya waja wako katika waliyo kuwa wakikhitalifiana.
translation_en: Say, "O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."

arabic_text: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَحْتَسِبُونَ
translation_sw: Na lau kuwa walio dhulumu wangeli kuwa na vyote viliomo duniani na pamoja navyo vingine kama hivyo, bila ya shaka wangeli vitoa kujikomboa katika adhabu mbaya hiyo Siku ya Kiyama. Na yatawadhihirikia kwa Mwenyezi Mungu wasiyo kuwa wakiyatarajia.
translation_en: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allah that which they had not taken into account.

arabic_text: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation_sw: Na utawadhihirikia ubaya wa waliyo yachuma, yatawazunguka waliyo kuwa wakiyafanyia mzaha.
translation_en: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَٰهُ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هِىَ فِتْنَةٌۭ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na dhara inapo mgusa mtu hutuomba. Kisha tunapo mpa neema zitokazo kwetu, husema: Nimepewa haya kwa sababu ya ilimu yangu. Sio! Huo ni mtihani! Lakini wengi wao hawajui!
translation_en: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.

arabic_text: قَدْ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_sw: Waliyasema haya waliyo kuwa kabla yao, lakini hayakuwafaa waliyo kuwa wakiyachuma.
translation_en: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.

arabic_text: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
translation_sw: Basi ukawasibu uovu wa waliyo yachuma. Na wale walio dhulumu miongoni mwa hawa utawasibu uovu wa waliyo yachuma vile vile. Nao si wenye kushinda.
translation_en: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be afflicted by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Kwani wao hawajui kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu humkunjulia riziki amtakaye na akamkadiria? Hakika katika haya bila ya shaka zipo Ishara kwa watu wanao amini.
translation_en: Do they not know that Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

arabic_text: ۞ قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Sema: Enyi waja wangu walio jidhulumu nafsi zao! Msikate tamaa na rehema ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu husamehe dhambi zote. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

arabic_text: وَأَنِيبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na rejeeni kwa Mola wenu Mlezi, na silimuni kwake, kabla ya kukujieni adhabu. Kisha hapo hamtanusuriwa.
translation_en: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.

arabic_text: وَٱتَّبِعُوٓا۟ أَحْسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةًۭ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na fuateni yaliyo bora kabisa katika yale yaliyo teremshwa kwenu kutoka kwa Mola wenu Mlezi, kabla haijakujieni adhabu kwa ghafla, na hali hamtambui.
translation_en: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,

arabic_text: أَن تَقُولَ نَفْسٌۭ يَٰحَسْرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِى جَنۢبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّٰخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Isije ikasema nafsi: Ee majuto yangu kwa yale niliyo poteza upande wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na hakika nilikuwa miongoni mwa wanao fanya maskhara!
translation_en: Lest a soul should say, "Oh [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allah and that I was among the mockers."

arabic_text: أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_sw: Au ikasema: Ingeli kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu ameniongoa, bila ya shaka ningeli kuwa miongoni mwa wenye kumchamngu.
translation_en: Or [lest] it say, "If only Allah had guided me, I would have been among the righteous."

arabic_text: أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى كَرَّةًۭ فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Au ikasema inapo ona adhabu: Lau kuwa ningeli pata fursa nyengine, ningeli kuwa miongoni mwa wafanya mema.
translation_en: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."

arabic_text: بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَتْكَ ءَايَٰتِى فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Wapi! Bila ya shaka zilikujia Ishara zangu, nawe ukazikadhibisha, na ukajivuna, na ukawa miongoni mwa makafiri!
translation_en: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًۭى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
translation_sw: Na Siku ya Kiyama utawaona walio msingizia uwongo Mwenyezi Mungu nyuso zao zimesawijika. Je! Si katika Jahannamu makaazi ya wanao takabari?
translation_en: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allah [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?

arabic_text: وَيُنَجِّى ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu atawaokoa wenye kujikinga kwa ajili ya kufuzu kwao. Hapana uovu utao wagusa, wala hawatahuzunika.
translation_en: And Allah will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَكِيلٌۭ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Muumba wa kila kitu, na Yeye ndiye Mlinzi juu ya kila kitu.
translation_en: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.

arabic_text: لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
translation_sw: Yeye anazo funguo za mbingu na ardhi. Na wale walio zikataa Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu, hao ndio wenye kukhasiri.
translation_en: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allah - it is those who are the losers.

arabic_text: قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأْمُرُوٓنِّىٓ أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلْجَٰهِلُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Je! Mnaniamrisha nimuabudu asiye kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu, enyi majaahili?
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Is it other than Allah that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na kwa yakini yamefunuliwa kwako na kwa walio kuwa kabla yako: Bila ya shaka ukimshirikisha Mwenyezi Mungu a'mali zako zitaanguka, na lazima utakuwa miongoni mwa wenye kukhasiri.
translation_en: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allah, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers."

arabic_text: بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعْبُدْ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
translation_sw: Bali muabudu Mwenyezi Mungu tu, na uwe miongoni mwa wenye kushukuru.
translation_en: Rather, worship [only] Allah and be among the grateful.

arabic_text: وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦ وَٱلْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًۭا قَبْضَتُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ مَطْوِيَّٰتٌۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Na wala hawakumhishimu Mwenyezi Mungu kama anavyo stahiki kadiri yake. Na Siku ya Kiyama ardhi yote itakuwa mkononi mwake, na mbingu zitakunjwa katika mkono wake wa kuume. Subhanahu wa Taa'la Ametakasika na Ametukuka na hayo wanayo mshirikisha nayo.
translation_en: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

arabic_text: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخْرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌۭ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na litapulizwa barugumu, wazimie waliomo mbinguni na waliomo katika ardhi, isipo kuwa aliye mtaka Mwenyezi Mungu. Kisha litapulizwa mara nyengine. Hapo watainuka wawe wanangojea.
translation_en: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allah wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.

arabic_text: وَأَشْرَقَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ وَجِا۟ىٓءَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
