translation_sw: Na ardhi itang'ara kwa Nuru ya Mola wake Mlezi, na Kitabu kitawekwa, na wataletwa Manabii na mashahidi, na patahukumiwa baina yao kwa haki, wala hawatadhulumiwa.
translation_en: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.

arabic_text: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na kila nafsi italipwa kwa yale iliyo yafanya, na Yeye anayajua sana wanayo yatenda.
translation_en: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.

arabic_text: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌۭ مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا ۚ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru wataongozwa kuendea Jahannamu kwa makundi. Mpaka watakapo ifikia itafunguliwa milango yake, na walinzi wake watawaambia: Kwani hawakukujilieni Mitume miongoni mwenu wakikusomeeni Aya za Mola wenu Mlezi na kukuonyeni mkutano wa siku yenu hii? Watasema: Kwani! Lakini limekwisha thibiti neno la adhabu juu ya makafiri.
translation_en: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers.

arabic_text: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
translation_sw: Itasemwa: Ingieni milango ya Jahannamu mdumu humo. Basi nayo ni ubaya ulioje wa makaazi ya wanao takabari!
translation_en: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

arabic_text: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوهَا خَٰلِدِينَ
translation_sw: Na walio mcha Mola wao Mlezi wataongozwa kuendea Peponi kwa makundi, mpaka watakapo fikilia, nayo milango yake imekwisha funguliwa. Walinzi wake watawaambia: Salaam Alaikum, Amani iwe juu yenu! Mmet'ahirika. Basi ingieni humu mkae milele.
translation_en: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter].

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُۥ وَأَوْرَثَنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَآءُ ۖ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ
translation_sw: Nao watasema: Alhamdulillah, Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu aliye tutimizia ahadi yake, na akaturithisha ardhi, tunakaa katika Bustani popote tupendapo. Basi ni malipo mazuri yaliyoje ya watendao!
translation_en: And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers."

arabic_text: وَتَرَى ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ ٱلْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na utawaona Malaika wakizunguka pembeni mwa Kiti cha enzi cha Mwenyezi Mungu, wakimtakasa na kumsifu Mola wao Mlezi. Na patahukumiwa baina yao kwa haki na patasemwa: Sifa zote njema ni za Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa viumbe vyote!
translation_en: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [Allah] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds."

arabic_text: حمٓ
translation_sw: H'a, Mim.
translation_en: Ha, Meem.

arabic_text: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
translation_sw: Uteremsho wa Kitabu umetoka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

arabic_text: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلْعِقَابِ ذِى ٱلطَّوْلِ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Anaye samehe dhambi na anaye pokea toba, Mkali wa kuadhibu, Mwenye ukarimu, hakuna mungu ila Yeye; marejeo ni kwake.
translation_en: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.

arabic_text: مَا يُجَٰدِلُ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
translation_sw: Hawazibishi Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu ila walio kufuru; basi kusikughuri wewe kutanga tanga kwao katika nchi.
translation_en: No one disputes concerning the signs of Allah except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.

arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۖ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ ۖ وَجَٰدَلُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
translation_sw: Kabla yao walikadhibisha kaumu ya Nuhu na makundi mengine baada yao. Na kila taifa lilikuwa na hamu juu ya Mtume wao wamkamate. Na walibishana kwa upotovu ili kuipindua haki. Kwa hivyo niliwakamata. Basi ilikuwaje adhabu yangu!
translation_en: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.

arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
translation_sw: Namna hivi limewathibitikia makafiri neno la Mola wako Mlezi ya kwamba wao ni watu wa Motoni.
translation_en: And thus has the word of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ ٱلْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ رَّحْمَةًۭ وَعِلْمًۭا فَٱغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_sw: Wale wanao beba A'rshi, na wanao izunguka, wanamsabihi na kumhimidi Mola wao Mlezi, na wanamuamini, na wanawaombea msamaha walio amini kwa kusema: Mola wetu Mlezi! Umekienea kila kitu kwa rehema na ujuzi. Basi wasamehe walio tubu na wakaifuata Njia yako, na waepushe na adhabu ya Jahannamu.
translation_en: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.

arabic_text: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Mola wetu Mlezi! Na waingize katika Bustani za Milele ulizo waahidi. Na uwape haya pia wale walio fanya mema miongoni mwa wazee wao na wake zao na dhuriya zao. Hakika Wewe ni Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُۥ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_sw: Na waepushe na maovu; kwani umwepushaye maovu siku hiyo, hakika umemrehemu; na huko ndiko kufuzu kukubwa.
translation_en: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment."

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika wale walio kufuru watanadiwa: Bila ya shaka kukuchukieni Mwenyezi Mungu ni kukubwa kuliko kujichukia nyinyi nafsi zenu, mlipo kuwa mnaitwa kwenye Imani nanyi mkakataa.
translation_en: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allah for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you refused."

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ فَٱعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٍۢ مِّن سَبِيلٍۢ
translation_sw: Watasema: Mola wetu Mlezi! Umetufisha mara mbili, na umetuhuisha mara mbili! Basi tunakiri madhambi yetu. Basi je, ipo njia ya kutoka?
translation_en: They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?"

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُۥ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِۦ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ فَٱلْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْعَلِىِّ ٱلْكَبِيرِ
translation_sw: Hayo ni hivyo kwa sababu mlikuwa akiombwa Mwenyezi Mungu peke yake mnakataa. Na akishirikishwa mnaamini. Basi hukumu ni ya Mwenyezi Mungu Mtukufu Mkuu.
translation_en: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allah was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allah, the Most High, the Grand."

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقًۭا ۚ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye anaye kuonyesheni Ishara zake, na anakuteremshieni kutoka mbinguni riziki. Na hapana anaye kumbuka ila anaye rejea.
translation_en: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].

arabic_text: فَٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Basi mwombeni Mwenyezi Mungu mkimsafia Dini Yeye tu, na wangachukia makafiri.
translation_en: So invoke Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.

arabic_text: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye Mwenye vyeo vya juu, Mwenye A'rshi. Hupeleka Roho kwa amri yake juu ya amtakaye katika waja wake, ili kuonya kwa Siku ya Mkutano.
translation_en: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَ ۖ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَىْءٌۭ ۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ
translation_sw: Siku watakayo dhihiri wao. Hapana kitacho fichikana chochote chao kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Ufalme ni wa nani leo? Ni wa Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja Mtenda nguvu.
translation_en: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allah. To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To Allah, the One, the Prevailing.

arabic_text: ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۚ لَا ظُلْمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_sw: Leo kila nafsi italipwa kwa iliyo chuma. Hapana dhulma leo. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwepesi wa kuhisabu.
translation_en: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allah is swift in account.

arabic_text: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْءَازِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلْحَنَاجِرِ كَٰظِمِينَ ۚ مَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍۢ وَلَا شَفِيعٍۢ يُطَاعُ
translation_sw: Na waonye siku inayo kurubia, wakati nyoyo zitakapo fika kooni, nao wamejaa huzuni. Madhaalimu hawatakuwa na rafiki, wala mwombezi wa kuitikiwa.
translation_en: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.

arabic_text: يَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِى ٱلصُّدُورُ
translation_sw: (Mwenyezi Mungu) anajua khiyana ya macho na yanayo ficha vifua.
translation_en: He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal.

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ يَقْضِى بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَىْءٍ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu huhukumu kwa haki; lakini hao wanao waomba badala yake hawahukumu chochote. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mwenye kusikia Mwenye kuona.
translation_en: And Allah judges with truth, while those they invoke besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, Allah - He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

arabic_text: ۞ أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ وَءَاثَارًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwani hawatembei katika ardhi wakaona jinsi ulivyo kuwa mwisho wa walio kuwa kabla yao? Hao walikuwa wamewazidi hawa kwa nguvu na athari katika nchi. Na Mwenyezi Mungu aliwatia mkononi kwa sababu ya madhambi yao. Na wala hapakuwa wa kuwalinda na Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but Allah seized them for their sins. And they had not from Allah any protector.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَكَفَرُوا۟ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِىٌّۭ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa sababu walikuwa wanawajia Mitume wao kwa hoja zilizo wazi, lakini wakawakataa, ndipo Mwenyezi Mungu akawakamata. Bila ya shaka Yeye ni Mwenye nguvu, Mkali wa kuadhibu.
translation_en: That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allah seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
translation_sw: Na kwa yakini tulimtuma Musa pamoja na Ishara zetu na uthibitisho ulio wazi,
translation_en: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority

arabic_text: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَقَٰرُونَ فَقَالُوا۟ سَٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌۭ
translation_sw: Kumwendea Firauni na Hamana na Qaruni, wakasema: Huyu ni mchawi, mwongo mkubwa.
translation_en: To Pharaoh, Haman and Qarun; but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَبْنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسْتَحْيُوا۟ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi alipo waletea Haki inayo toka kwetu, walisema: Waueni watoto wanaume wa wale walio muamini na wawacheni hai wanawake wao. Na haviwi vitimbi vya makafiri ila katika upotovu.
translation_en: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِىٓ أَقْتُلْ مُوسَىٰ وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُۥٓ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ أَوْ أَن يُظْهِرَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْفَسَادَ
translation_sw: Na Firauni akasema: Niachieni nimuuwe Musa, naye amwite Mola wake Mlezi! Mimi nachelea asije kubadilishieni dini yenu, au akatangaza uharibifu katika nchi.
translation_en: And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption in the land."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_sw: Na Musa akasema: Mimi najikinga kwa Mola wangu Mlezi na Mola wenu Mlezi anilinde na kila mwenye jeuri asiye iamini Siku ya Hisabu.
translation_en: But Moses said, "Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌۭ مُّؤْمِنٌۭ مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّىَ ٱللَّهُ وَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَكُ كَٰذِبًۭا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُۥ ۖ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقًۭا يُصِبْكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى يَعِدُكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ كَذَّابٌۭ
translation_sw: Na akasema mtu mmoja Muumini, aliye kuwa mmoja katika watu wa Firauni aliye ficha Imani yake: Mtamuuwa mtu kwa sababu anasema Mola wangu Mlezi ni Mwenyezi Mungu? Na hali naye amekujieni na hoja zilizo wazi? Na akiwa yeye mwongo basi uwongo wake ni juu yake mwenyewe, na akiwa mkweli yatakufikieni baadhi ya hayo anayo kuahidini. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu hamwongoi apindukiaye mipaka, mwongo mkubwa.
translation_en: And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "Do you kill a man [merely] because he says, 'My Lord is Allah' while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. Indeed, Allah does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar.

arabic_text: يَٰقَوْمِ لَكُمُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ظَٰهِرِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأْسِ ٱللَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَا ۚ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَآ أَرَىٰ وَمَآ أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
translation_sw: Enyi watu wangu! Leo mna ufalme, mmeshinda katika nchi; basi ni nani atakaye nisaidia kutuokoa na adhabu ya Mwenyezi Mungu kama ikitufikia? Firauni akasema: Sikupeni shauri ila ile niliyo iona, wala sikuongozeni ila kwenye njia ya uwongofu.
translation_en: O my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of Allah if it came to us?" Pharaoh said, "I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُم مِّثْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
translation_sw: Na akasema yule aliye amini: Enyi watu wangu! Hakika mimi nakukhofieni mfano wa siku za makundi,
translation_en: And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies -

arabic_text: مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٍۢ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ
translation_sw: Mfano wa hali ya watu wa Nuhu na A'di na Thamudi na wale wa baada yao. Na Mwenyezi Mungu hataki kuwadhulumu waja.
translation_en: Like the custom of the people of Noah and of 'Aad and Thamud and those after them. And Allah wants no injustice for [His] servants.

arabic_text: وَيَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّنَادِ
translation_sw: Na enyi watu wangu! Hakika mimi nakukhofieni Siku ya mayowe.
translation_en: And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍۢ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍۢ
translation_sw: Siku mtakapo geuka kurudi nyuma. Hamtakuwa na wa kukulindeni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Na mwenye kuhukumiwa na Mwenyezi Mungu kupotea, basi huyo hana wa kumwongoa.
translation_en: The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from Allah any protector. And whoever Allah leaves astray - there is not for him any guide.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
translation_sw: Na alikwisha wajieni Yusuf zamani kwa dalili zilizo wazi, lakini nyinyi mliendelea katika shaka kwa yale aliyo kuleteeni; mpaka alipo kufa mkasema: Mwenyezi Mungu hataleta kabisa Mtume baada yake. Kama hivyo Mwenyezi Mungu humwacha kupotea anaye pindukia mipaka katika maasi anaye jitia shaka.
translation_en: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allah send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allah leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic."

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ ۖ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍۢ جَبَّارٍۢ
translation_sw: Hao ambao wanajadiliana katika Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu pasipo ushahidi wowote ulio wafikia, ni chukizo kubwa mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu na mbele ya walio amini. Hivi ndivyo Mwenyezi Mungu apigavyo muhuri juu ya kila moyo wa jeuri anaye jivuna.
translation_en: Those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah without an authority having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does Allah seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ ٱبْنِ لِى صَرْحًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ أَبْلُغُ ٱلْأَسْبَٰبَ
translation_sw: Na Firauni akasema: Ewe Hamana! Nijengee mnara ili nipate kuzifikia njia,
translation_en: And Pharaoh said, "O Haman, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways -

arabic_text: أَسْبَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
translation_sw: Njia za mbinguni ili nikamwone Mungu wa Musa. Na kwa hakika mimi bila ya shaka namjua kuwa ni mwongo tu. Na hivi ndivyo Firauni alivyo pambiwa ubaya wa vitendo vyake, na akazuiliwa Njia. Na vitimbi vya Firauni havikuwa ila katika kuangamia tu.
translation_en: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
translation_sw: Na yule aliye amini alisema: Enyi watu wangu! Nifuateni mimi, nitakuongozeni njia ya uwongozi mwema.
translation_en: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me, I will guide you to the way of right conduct.

arabic_text: يَٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَتَٰعٌۭ وَإِنَّ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ هِىَ دَارُ ٱلْقَرَارِ
translation_sw: Enyi watu wangu! Hakika haya maisha ya dunia ni starehe ipitayo tu, na hakika Akhera ndiyo nyumba ya daima.
translation_en: O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.

arabic_text: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةًۭ فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
translation_sw: Mwenye kutenda uovu hatalipwa ila sawa na huo uwovu wake, na anaye tenda wema, akiwa mwanamume au mwanamke, naye ni Muumini, basi hao wataingia Peponi, waruzukiwe humo bila ya hisabu.
translation_en: Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account.

arabic_text: ۞ وَيَٰقَوْمِ مَا لِىٓ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
translation_sw: Na enyi watu wangu! Kwa nini mimi nakuiteni kwenye uwokofu, nanyi mnaniita kwenye Moto?
translation_en: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?

arabic_text: تَدْعُونَنِى لِأَكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ وَأَنَا۠ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْغَفَّٰرِ
translation_sw: Mnaniita nimkufuru Mwenyezi Mungu na nimshirikishe na yule ambaye simjui, nami nakuiteni kwa Mwenye nguvu Mwenye kusamehe?
translation_en: You invite me to disbelieve in Allah and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

arabic_text: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَعْوَةٌۭ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
translation_sw: Bila ya shaka mnaye niitia kumuabudu hastahiki wito duniani wala Akhera. Na hakika marejeo yetu ni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Na wanao pindukia mipaka ndio watu wa Motoni!
translation_en: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allah, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.

arabic_text: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
translation_sw: Basi mtayakumbuka ninayo kuambieni. Nami namkabidhi Mwenyezi Mungu mambo yangu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anawaona waja wake.
translation_en: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of [His] servants."

arabic_text: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
translation_sw: Basi Mwenyezi Mungu akamlinda na ubaya wa hila walizo zifanya. Na adhabu mbaya itawazunguka watu wa Firauni.
translation_en: So Allah protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -

arabic_text: ٱلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّۭا وَعَشِيًّۭا ۖ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلْعَذَابِ
translation_sw: Wanaonyeshwa Moto asubuhi na jioni. Na itapo fika Saa ya Kiyama patasemwa: Waingizeni watu wa Firauni katika adhabu kali kabisa!
translation_en: The Fire, they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."

arabic_text: وَإِذْ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ فَيَقُولُ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًۭا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ
translation_sw: Na watapo hojiana huko Motoni, wanyonge watawaambia walio jitukuza: Hakika sisi tulikuwa wafuasi wenu, basi je, hamtuondolei sehemu ya huu Moto?
translation_en: And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?"

arabic_text: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُلٌّۭ فِيهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ ٱلْعِبَادِ
translation_sw: Watasema walio jitukuza: Hakika sote sisi tumo humo humo! Kwani Mwenyezi Mungu kesha hukumu baina ya waja!
translation_en: Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all [of us] are in it. Indeed, Allah has judged between the servants."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ
translation_sw: Na walio Motoni watawaambia walinzi wa Jahannamu: Mwombeni Mola wenu Mlezi atupunguzie walau siku moja ya adhabu.
translation_en: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment."

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ ۚ قَالُوا۟ فَٱدْعُوا۟ ۗ وَمَا دُعَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ
translation_sw: Nao watasema: Je! Hawakuwa wakikufikieni Mitume wenu kwa hoja zilio wazi? Watasema: Kwani? Watasema: Basi ombeni! Na maombi ya makafiri hayawi ila ni kupotea bure.
translation_en: They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate [yourselves], but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error."

arabic_text: إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ
translation_sw: Hakika bila ya shaka Sisi tunawanusuru Mitume wetu na walio amini katika uhai wa duniani na siku watapo simama Mashahidi,
translation_en: Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمُ ٱللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ
translation_sw: Siku ambayo hautawafaa madhaalimu udhuru wao, nao watapata laana, na watapata makaazi mabaya kabisa.
translation_en: The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika tulimpa Musa uwongofu, na tukawarithisha Wana wa Israili Kitabu,
translation_en: And We had certainly given Moses guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture

arabic_text: هُدًۭى وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
translation_sw: Ambacho ni Uwongofu na Ukumbusho kwa wenye akili.
translation_en: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.

arabic_text: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَٰرِ
translation_sw: Basi subiri. Hakika ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni kweli. Na omba msamaha kwa dhambi zako, na umtakase Mola wako Mlezi kwa kumhimidi jioni na asubuhi.
translation_en: So be patient, [O Muhammad]. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ ۙ إِن فِى صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌۭ مَّا هُم بِبَٰلِغِيهِ ۚ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Hakika hao wanao bishana katika Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu bila ya uthibitisho wowote uliyo wajia, hawana vifuani mwao ila kutaka ukubwa tu, na wala huo hawaufikilii. Basi jikinge kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kusikia, Mwenye kuona.
translation_en: Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah without [any] authority having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride, [the extent of] which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing.

arabic_text: لَخَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Bila ya shaka kuumba mbingu na ardhi ni kukubwa zaidi kuliko kuwaumba watu. Lakini watu wengi hawajui.
translation_en: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.

arabic_text: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَلَا ٱلْمُسِىٓءُ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Na kipofu na mwenye kuona hawalingani; na walio amini na watendao mema hawalingani na muovu. Ni machache mnayo yakumbuka.
translation_en: And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Saa (ya Kiyama) itafika, nayo haina shaka. Lakini watu wengi hawaamini.
translation_en: Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na Mola wenu Mlezi anasema: Niombeni nitakuitikieni. Kwa hakika wale ambao wanajivuna na kuniabudu Mimi wataingia Jahannamu wadhalilike.
translation_en: And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu aliye kufanyieni usiku ili mpate kutulia humo, na mchana wa kuonea. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu bila ya shaka ni Mwenye fadhila juu ya watu, lakini watu wengi hawashukuru.
translation_en: It is Allah who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight. Indeed, Allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of the people are not grateful.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
translation_sw: Huyo ndiye Mwenyezi Mungu Mola wenu Mlezi, Muumba wa kila kitu. Hapana mungu ila Yeye; basi mnageuzwa wapi?
translation_en: That is Allah, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
translation_sw: Namna hivi ndivyo walivyo geuzwa walio kuwa wakizikataa Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: Thus were those [before you] deluded who were rejecting the signs of Allah.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًۭا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءًۭ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Ni Mwenyezi Mungu aliye kufanyieni ardhi kuwa ni pahala pa kukaa, na mbingu kuwa dari. Na akakutieni sura, na akazifanya nzuri sura zenu, na akakuruzukuni vitu vizuri. Huyo ndiye Mwenyezi Mungu Mola wenu Mlezi. Basi ametukuka Mwenyezi Mungu Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: It is Allah who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a ceiling and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is Allah, your Lord; then blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱدْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ ۗ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye aliye Hai - hapana mungu isipo kuwa Yeye. Basi muabuduni Yeye mkimsafishia Dini Yeye. Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: He is the Ever-Living; there is no deity except Him, so call upon Him, [being] sincere to Him in religion. [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: ۞ قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِىَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ مِن رَّبِّى وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Mimi nimekatazwa kuwaabudu hao mnao waomba badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu, zilipo nijia hoja zilizo dhaahiri kutokana na Mola wangu Mlezi. Na nimeamrishwa nisilimu kwa Mola wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides Allah once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds."

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍۢ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًۭا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا۟ شُيُوخًۭا ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَجَلًۭا مُّسَمًّۭى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye aliye kuumbeni kwa udongo, kisha kwa tone la manii, kisha kwa pande la damu, kisha akakutoeni katika hali ya mtoto mchanga, kisha mpate kufikilia utu uzima, kisha mpate kuwa wazee. Na kati yenu wapo wanao kufa kabla, na ili mfikie muda ulio kwisha wekwa, na ili mpate kufahamu.
translation_en: It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then [He develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term; and perhaps you will use reason.

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ فَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye anaye huisha na anaye fisha. Akihukumu jambo liwe, basi huliambia: Kuwa! Likawa.
translation_en: He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصْرَفُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Huwaoni wale wanao bishana katika Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu? Wanageuziwa wapi?
translation_en: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah - how are they averted?

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَبِمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِۦ رُسُلَنَا ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao wamekanusha Kitabu na yale tuliyo watuma Mitume wetu. Basi watakuja jua.
translation_en: Those who deny the Book and that with which We sent Our messengers - they are going to know,

arabic_text: إِذِ ٱلْأَغْلَٰلُ فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ وَٱلسَّلَٰسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ
translation_sw: Zitakapo kuwa pingu shingoni mwao na minyororo, huku wanabururwa
translation_en: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged

arabic_text: فِى ٱلْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ
translation_sw: Katika maji ya moto, kisha wanaunguzwa Motoni,
translation_en: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame].

arabic_text: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Tena wataambiwa: Wako wapi mlio kuwa mkiwashirikisha
translation_en: Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]

arabic_text: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنَّا بَل لَّمْ نَكُن نَّدْعُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu? Watasema: Wametupotea, bali tangu zamani hatukuwa tukiomba kitu! Hivyo ndivyo Mwenyezi Mungu anawaachia makafiri wapotelee mbali.
translation_en: Other than Allah?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allah put astray the disbelievers.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ
translation_sw: Haya ni kwa sababu mlikuwa mkijitapa katika ardhi pasipo haki, na kwa sababu mlikuwa mkijishaua.
translation_en: [The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently.

arabic_text: ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
translation_sw: Ingieni kwenye milango ya Jahannamu, mdumu humo milele. Basi ni maovu yaliyoje makaazi ya wanao takabari!
translation_en: Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

arabic_text: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۚ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Basi subiri, hakika ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni ya kweli. Na ama tukikuonyesha baadhi ya yale tuliyo waahidi au tukikufisha, lakini wao watarudishwa kwetu tu.
translation_en: So be patient, [O Muhammad]; indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًۭا مِّن قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُم مَّن قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ ۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قُضِىَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka tuliwatuma Mitume kabla yako. Wengine katika hao tumekusimulia khabari zao, na wengine hatukukusimulia. Na haiwi Mtume alete Ishara yoyote ila kwa idhini ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Basi ikija amri ya Mwenyezi Mungu huhukumiwa kwa Haki, na hapo wapotofu watakhasiri.
translation_en: And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those [whose stories] We have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign [or verse] except by permission of Allah. So when the command of Allah comes, it will be concluded in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose [all].

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمَ لِتَرْكَبُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu aliye kujaalieni nyama hoa, mifugo, ili muwapande baadhi yao, na muwale baadhi yao.
translation_en: It is Allah who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat.

arabic_text: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا حَاجَةًۭ فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na katika hao mnayo manufaa kadhaa wa kadhaa, na mnapata kwao haja ziliomo vifuani mwenu; na mnachukuliwa juu yao, na juu ya marikebu.
translation_en: And for you therein are [other] benefits and that you may realize upon them a need which is in your breasts; and upon them and upon ships you are carried.

arabic_text: وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَأَىَّ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُنكِرُونَ
translation_sw: Naye anakuonyesheni Ishara zake. Basi Ishara gani za Mwenyezi Mungu mnazo zikataa?
translation_en: And He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of Allah do you deny?

arabic_text: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓا۟ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةًۭ وَءَاثَارًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_sw: Kwani hawatembei katika ardhi wakaona ulikuwaje mwisho wa walio kuwa kabla yao? Wao walikuwa wengi kuliko hawa, na wamewashinda kwa nguvu na athari katika nchi. Wala hayakuwafaa hayo waliyo kuwa wakiyachuma.
translation_en: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation_sw: Walipo wajia Mitume wao kwa dalili zilizo wazi walijitapa kwa ilimu waliyo kuwa nayo. Basi yakawazunguka waliyo kuwa wakiyafanyia maskhara.
translation_en: And when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they [merely] rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, but they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِۦ مُشْرِكِينَ
translation_sw: Walipo iona adhabu yetu walisema: Tumemuamini Mwenyezi Mungu kuwa ni wa pekee, na tunaikataa miungu tuliyo kuwa tukiishirikisha naye.
translation_en: And when they saw Our punishment, they said," We believe in Allah alone and disbelieve in that which we used to associate with Him."

arabic_text: فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمْ إِيمَٰنُهُمْ لَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا ۖ سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ فِى عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini imani yao haikuwa yenye kuwafaa kitu wakati ambao wamekwisha iona adhabu yetu. Huu ndio mwendo wa Mwenyezi Mungu ulio kuwa kwa waja wake. Na hapo walio kufuru walikhasiri.
translation_en: But never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment. [It is] the established way of Allah which has preceded among His servants. And the disbelievers thereupon lost [all].

arabic_text: حمٓ
translation_sw: H'a Mim
translation_en: Ha, Meem.

arabic_text: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_sw: Uteremsho huu umetoka kwa Mwingi wa rehema, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: [This is] a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful -

arabic_text: كِتَٰبٌۭ فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Hichi ni Kitabu kilicho pambanuliwa Aya zake, cha kusomwa kwa Kiarabu kwa watu wanao jua.
translation_en: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur'an for a people who know,

arabic_text: بَشِيرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
translation_sw: Kitoacho khabari njema, na chenye kuonya. Lakini wengi katika wao wamepuuza; kwa hivyo hawasikii.
translation_en: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ قُلُوبُنَا فِىٓ أَكِنَّةٍۢ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِنَا وَقْرٌۭ وَمِنۢ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌۭ فَٱعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَٰمِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na wakasema: Nyoyo zetu zimo katika vifuniko kwa hayo unayo tuitia, na masikio yetu yana uziwi, na baina yetu na wewe lipo pazia. Basi wewe tenda, nasi tunatenda.
translation_en: And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work; indeed, we are working."

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ فَٱسْتَقِيمُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ۗ وَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُشْرِكِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Hakika mimi ni mtu kama nyinyi; inafunuliwa kwangu ya kwamba Mungu wenu ni Mungu Mmoja tu. Basi nyookeni sawa kumwendea Yeye, na mumtake msamaha, na ole wao wanao mshirikisha,
translation_en: Say, O [Muhammad], "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allah -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao hawatoi Zaka na wanaikataa Akhera.
translation_en: Those who do not give zakah, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika wanao amini na wakatenda mema watakuwa na ujira usio na ukomo.
translation_en: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.

arabic_text: ۞ قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Hivyo nyinyi mnamkataa aliye umba ardhi katika siku mbili, na mnamfanyia washirika? Huyu ndiye Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."

arabic_text: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَبَٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقْوَٰتَهَا فِىٓ أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍۢ سَوَآءًۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
translation_sw: Na akaweka humo milima juu yake, na akabarikia humo na akakadiria humo chakula chake katika siku nne. Haya ni sawa kabisa kwa wanao uliza.
translation_en: And He placed on the earth firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction - for [the information] of those who ask.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِىَ دُخَانٌۭ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ٱئْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًۭا قَالَتَآ أَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha akazielekea mbingu, na zilikuwa moshi, akaziambia hizo na ardhi: Njooni, kwa khiari au kwa nguvu! Vyote viwili vikasema: Tumekuja nasi ni wat'iifu.
translation_en: Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being], willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."

arabic_text: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَاتٍۢ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمْرَهَا ۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
translation_sw: Basi akazifanya mbingu saba kwa siku mbili, na akazipangia kila mbingu mambo yake. Na tukaipamba mbingu ya chini kwa mataa na kwa ulinzi. Hichi ndicho kipimo cha Mwenyezi Mungu Mwenye Kujua.
translation_en: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps and as protection. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

arabic_text: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَقُلْ أَنذَرْتُكُمْ صَٰعِقَةًۭ مِّثْلَ صَٰعِقَةِ عَادٍۢ وَثَمُودَ
translation_sw: Basi wakipuuza wewe sema: Nakuhadharisheni adhabu mfano wa adhabu ya A'di na Thamudi,
translation_en: But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] 'Aad and Thamud.

arabic_text: إِذْ جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلرُّسُلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ فَإِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Walipo wajia Mitume mbele yao na nyuma yao wakawaambia: Msimuabudu ila Mwenyezi Mungu! Wakasema: Angeli taka Mola wetu Mlezi bila ya shaka angeli wateremsha Malaika. Basi sisi hakika tunayakataa hayo mliyo tumwa.
translation_en: [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "Worship not except Allah." They said, "If our Lord had willed, He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers."

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
translation_sw: Ama kina A'di walijivuna katika nchi bila ya haki, na wakasema: Nani aliye kuwa na nguvu kushinda sisi? Kwani wao hawakuona kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu aliye waumba ni Mwenye nguvu kushinda wao? Na wao wakawa wanazikataa Ishara zetu!
translation_en: As for 'Aad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allah who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs.

arabic_text: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِىٓ أَيَّامٍۢ نَّحِسَاتٍۢ لِّنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَخْزَىٰ ۖ وَهُمْ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
translation_sw: Basi tuliwapelekea upepo wa kimbunga katika siku za ukorofi, ili tuwaonjeshe adhabu ya kuwahizi katika uhai wa duniani, na bila ya shaka adhabu ya Akhera ina hizaya zaidi, na wala wao hawatanusuriwa.
translation_en: So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped.

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَٰهُمْ فَٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْعَمَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَٰعِقَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_sw: Na ama Thamudi tuliwaongoza, lakini walipenda upofu kuliko uwongofu. Basi uliwachukua moto wa adhabu ya kuwafedhehi kwa sababu ya yale waliyo kuwa wakiyachuma.
translation_en: And as for Thamud, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn.

arabic_text: وَنَجَّيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
translation_sw: Na tukawaokoa walio amini na wakawa wanamcha-mngu.
translation_en: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ أَعْدَآءُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na siku watakapo kusanywa maadui wa Mwenyezi Mungu kwenye Moto, nao wakikgawanywa kwa makundi.
translation_en: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day when the enemies of Allah will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven] assembled in rows,

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصَٰرُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Hata watakapo ufikia Moto yatawashuhudia masikio yao, na macho yao na ngozi zao kwa waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda.
translation_en: Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na wao wataziambia ngozi zao: Kwa nini mmetushuhudilia? Nazo zitasema: Ametutamkisha Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye ametamkisha kila kitu! Na Yeye ndiye aliye kuumbeni mara ya kwanza, na kwake Yeye tu mtarejeshwa.
translation_en: And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allah, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned.

arabic_text: وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَن يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَٰرُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَٰكِن ظَنَنتُمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًۭا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na hamkuwa wenye kujificha hata masikio yenu, na macho yenu, na ngozi zenu, zisikushuhudilieni. Lakini mlidhani kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu hayajui mengi katika mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda.
translation_en: And you were not covering yourselves, lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allah does not know much of what you do.

arabic_text: وَذَٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَىٰكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
translation_sw: Basi hiyo dhana yenu mliyo kuwa mkimdhania Mola wenu Mlezi. Imekuangamizeni; na mmekuwa miongoni mwa walio khasiri.
translation_en: And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers."

arabic_text: فَإِن يَصْبِرُوا۟ فَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًۭى لَّهُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَسْتَعْتِبُوا۟ فَمَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُعْتَبِينَ
translation_sw: Basi wakisubiri Moto ndio maskani yao. Na wakiomba radhi hawakubaliwi.
translation_en: So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [Allah], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease.

arabic_text: ۞ وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُوا۟ لَهُم مَّا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍۢ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na tukawawekea marafiki, na wakawapambia yaliyo mbele yao na nyuma yao. Basi ikawathibitikia kauli wawe pamoja na mataifa yaliyo pita kabla yao, miongoni mwa majini na watu. Hakika hao wamekuwa ni wenye kukhasirika.
translation_en: And We appointed for them companions who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَسْمَعُوا۟ لِهَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَٱلْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru walisema: Msiisikilize Qur'ani hii, na timueni zogo, huenda mkashinda.
translation_en: And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur'an and speak noisily during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome."

arabic_text: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Basi hapana shaka tutawaonjesha hao walio kufuru adhabu kali, na hapana shaka tutawalipa malipo mabaya ya yale waliyo kuwa wakiyafanya.
translation_en: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ أَعْدَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ۖ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
translation_sw: Hayo ndiyo malipo ya Maadui wa Mwenyezi Mungu - Moto! Humo watakuwa na maskani ya kudumu, ndiyo malipo yao kwa sababu walikuwa wakizikataa Ishara zetu.
translation_en: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَرِنَا ٱلَّذَيْنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru watasema: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tuonyeshe walio tupoteza miongoni mwa majini na watu ili tuwaweke chini ya miguu yetu, wapate kuwa miongoni wa walio chini kabisa.
translation_en: And those who disbelieved will [then] say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we may put them under our feet that they will be among the lowest."

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَبْشِرُوا۟ بِٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika walio sema: Mola wetu Mlezi ni Mwenyezi Mungu! Kisha wakanyooka sawa, hao huwateremkia Malaika wakawaambia: Msiogope, wala msihuzunike; nanyi furahini kwa Pepo mliyo kuwa mkiahidiwa.
translation_en: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah " and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.

arabic_text: نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَآؤُكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِىٓ أَنفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ
translation_sw: Sisi ni vipenzi vyenu katika maisha ya dunia na katika Akhera, na humo mtapata kinacho tamaniwa na nafsi zenu, na humo mtapata mtakavyo vitaka.
translation_en: We [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]

arabic_text: نُزُلًۭا مِّنْ غَفُورٍۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Ni takrima itokayo kwa Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful."

arabic_text: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًۭا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na ni nani mbora wa kusema kuliko aitaye kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na akatenda mema, na akasema: Hakika mimi ni katika Waislamu?
translation_en: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allah and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."

arabic_text: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى ٱلْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ ۚ ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٌۭ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Mema na maovu hayalingani. Pinga uovu kwa lilio jema zaidi. Hapo yule ambaye baina yako naye pana uadui atakuwa kama rafiki jamaa wa kukuonea uchungu.
translation_en: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.

arabic_text: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Lakini hawapewi wema huu ila wanao subiri, wala hawapewi ila wenye bahati kubwa.
translation_en: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].

arabic_text: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ نَزْغٌۭ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Na Shet'ani akikuchochea kwa uchochezi wewe jikinge kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kusikia, Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

arabic_text: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ ۚ لَا تَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_sw: Na katika Ishara zake ni usiku na mchana, na jua na mwezi. Basi msilisujudie jua wala mwezi, bali msujudieni Mwenyezi Mungu aliye viumba, ikiwa nyinyi mnamuabudu Yeye tu.
translation_en: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostate to Allah, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship.

arabic_text: فَإِنِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فَٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُۥ بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔمُونَ ۩
translation_sw: Na ikiwa watajivuna, basi hao walioko kwa Mola wako Mlezi wanamtakasa Yeye usiku na mchana, na wao hawachoki.
translation_en: But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary.

arabic_text: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ خَٰشِعَةًۭ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
translation_sw: Na katika Ishara zake ni kwamba unaiona ardhi nyonge, lakini tunapo iteremshia maji mara unaiona inataharaki na kuumuka. Bila ya shaka aliye ihuisha ardhi ndiye atakaye huisha wafu. Hakika Yeye ni Muweza wa kila kitu.
translation_en: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَآ ۗ أَفَمَن يُلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلنَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّن يَأْتِىٓ ءَامِنًۭا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
translation_sw: Hakika wale wanao upotoa ukweli uliomo katika Ishara zetu hawatufichikii Sisi. Je! Atakaye tupwa Motoni ni bora au atakaye kuja kwa amani Siku ya Kiyama? Tendeni mpendavyo, kwa hakika Yeye anayaona mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَٰبٌ عَزِيزٌۭ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika wanayo yakataa mawaidha haya yanapo wajia (wataangamia), na haya bila ya shaka ni Kitabu chenye nguvu na utukufu.
translation_en: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message after it has come to them... And indeed, it is a mighty Book.

arabic_text: لَّا يَأْتِيهِ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ ۖ تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Hautakifikia upotovu mbele yake wala nyuma yake. Kimeteremshwa na Mwenye hikima, Msifiwa.
translation_en: Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy.

arabic_text: مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Huambiwi ila yale yale waliyo ambiwa Mitume wa kabla yako. Hakika Mola wako Mlezi bila ya shaka ni Mwenye maghfira, na ni Mwenye adhabu chungu.
translation_en: Nothing is said to you, [O Muhammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا أَعْجَمِيًّۭا لَّقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓ ۖ ءَا۬عْجَمِىٌّۭ وَعَرَبِىٌّۭ ۗ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هُدًۭى وَشِفَآءٌۭ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌۭ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Na lau tungeli ifanya Qur'ani kwa lugha ya kigeni wangeli sema: Kwanini Aya zake haziku pambanuliwa? Yawaje lugha ya kigeni na Mtume Mwaarabu? Sema: Hii Qur'ani ni uwongofu na poza kwa wenye kuamini. Na wasio amini umo uziwi katika masikio yao, nayo kwao imezibwa hawaioni. Hao wanaitwa nao wako pahala mbali.
translation_en: And if We had made it a non-Arabic Qur'an, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۗ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌۭ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّۢ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍۢ
translation_sw: Na hakika tulimpa Musa Kitabu, lakini pakatokea khitilafu kati yake. Na lau kuwa halikwisha tangulia neno la Mola wako Mlezi wangeli hukumiwa. Na hakika wao wamo katika shaka yenye kuwatia wasiwasi.
translation_en: And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt.

arabic_text: مَّنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۗ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
translation_sw: Anaye tenda mema basi anajitendea mwenyewe nafsi yake, na mwenye kutenda uovu basi ni juu ya nafsi yake vile vile; wala Mola wako Mlezi si mwenye kuwadhulumu waja.
translation_en: Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants.

arabic_text: ۞ إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ ۚ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٍۢ مِّنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَاذَنَّٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: UJUZI wa kuijua Saa ya Kiyama unarudishwa kwake tu Mwenyezi Mungu. Na matunda hayatoki katika mafumba yake, wala mwanamke hachukui mimba, wala hazai, ila kwa kujua kwake. Na siku atakayo waita, akawaambia: Wako wapi washirika wangu? Hapo watasema: Tunakiri kwako ya kwamba hapana miongoni mwetu anaye shuhudia hayo.
translation_en: To him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that]."

arabic_text: وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَدْعُونَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَظَنُّوا۟ مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍۢ
translation_sw: Na wakawapotea wale walio kuwa wakiwaomba hapo kwanza, na wakawa na yakini kuwa hawana pa kukimbilia.
translation_en: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape.

arabic_text: لَّا يَسْـَٔمُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ ٱلْخَيْرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسٌۭ قَنُوطٌۭ
translation_sw: Mwanaadamu hachoki kuomba dua za kheri, na inapo mpata shari, mara huvunjika moyo akakata tamaa.
translation_en: Man is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing.

arabic_text: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَٰذَا لِى وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةًۭ وَلَئِن رُّجِعْتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّ لِى عِندَهُۥ لَلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍۢ
translation_sw: Na pindi tukimwonjesha rehema itokayo kwetu baada ya kumgusa dhara, bila ya shaka husema: Haya nayastahiki mimi, wala sidhani kuwa Kiyama kitakuja. Na hata nikirudishwa kwa Mola wangu Mlezi bila ya shaka nina mema yangu kwake! Basi kwa yakini tutawaelezea walio kufuru hayo waliyo yatenda, na kwa yakini tutawaonjesha adhabu ngumu.
translation_en: And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is [due] to me, and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment.

arabic_text: وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضٍۢ
translation_sw: Na tukimneemesha mwanaadamu hugeuka na kujitenga upande, na inapo mgusa shari, huwa na madua marefu marefu.
translation_en: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.

arabic_text: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Sema: Mnaonaje! Ikiwa haya yanatoka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, nanyi ikawa ndio mmeyakataa, ni nani aliye potea zaidi kuliko aliye katika upinzani wa mbali?
translation_en: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an is from Allah and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?"

arabic_text: سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فِى ٱلْءَافَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
translation_sw: Tutawaonyesha Ishara zetu katika upeo wa mbali na katika nafsi zao wenyewe mpaka iwabainikie kwamba haya ni kweli. Je! Haikutoshi kwamba Mola wako Mlezi kuwa Yeye ni Shahidi wa kila kitu?
translation_en: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?

arabic_text: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ فِى مِرْيَةٍۢ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مُّحِيطٌۢ
translation_sw: Ama wao wamo katika shaka ya kukutana na Mola wao Mlezi! Ama hakika Yeye amekizunguka kila kitu.
translation_en: Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing.

arabic_text: حمٓ
translation_sw: H'a Mim
translation_en: Ha, Meem.

arabic_text: عٓسٓقٓ
translation_sw: A'yn Sin Qaf
translation_en: 'Ayn, Seen, Qaf.

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِىٓ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Hivi ndivyo Mwenyezi Mungu Mwenye nguvu na Mwenye hikima anavyo kuletea Wahyi wewe na walio kabla yako.
translation_en: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and to those before you - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_sw: Ni vyake viliomo mbinguni, na viliomo katika ardhi. Na Yeye ndiye Mtukufu, Mkuu.
translation_en: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.

arabic_text: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِن فَوْقِهِنَّ ۚ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Zinakaribia mbingu kupasuka juu huko, na Malaika wakimtakasa Mola wao Mlezi na kumhimidi, na wakiwaombea maghfira waliomo kwenye ardhi. Ama hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: The heavens almost break from above them, and the angels exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allah who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍۢ
translation_sw: Na wale walio wafanya walinzi wengine badala yake Yeye, Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwangalizi juu yao. Wala wewe si wakili juu yao.
translation_en: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allah is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muhammad], are not over them a manager.

arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ فَرِيقٌۭ فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌۭ فِى ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation_sw: Na namna hivi tumekufunulia Qur'ani kwa Kiarabu ili uwaonye watu wa Mama wa Miji na walio pembezoni mwake. Na uhadharishe na Siku ya Mkutano, haina shaka hiyo. Kundi moja litakuwa Peponi, na kundi jengine Motoni.
translation_en: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur'an that you may warn the Mother of Cities [Makkah] and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَلَٰكِن يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu angeli penda ange wafanya wote umma mmoja, lakini anamwingiza katika rehema yake amtakaye. Na wenye kudhulumu hawana mlinzi wala msaidizi.
translation_en: And if Allah willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper.

arabic_text: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ وَهُوَ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Au wamechukua walinzi wengine badala yake! Lakini Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mlinzi khasa. Na Yeye ndiye anaye huisha wafu. Na Yeye ndiye Mweza wa kila kitu.
translation_en: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides him? But Allah - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

arabic_text: وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فَحُكْمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
translation_sw: Na mkikhitalifiana katika jambo lolote, basi hukumu yake iko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Huyo Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mola wangu Mlezi, ninaye mtegemea na kwake Yeye narejea.
translation_en: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allah. [Say], "That is Allah, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."

arabic_text: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ۖ يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ ۚ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye Muumba mbingu na ardhi, amekujaalieni mke na mume katika nafsi zenu, na katika nyama hoa dume na jike, anakuzidishieni namna hii. Hapana kitu kama mfano wake. Naye ni Mwenye kusikia Mwenye kuona.
translation_en: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

arabic_text: لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye Mwenye funguo za mbingu na ardhi. Humkunjulia riziki amtakaye, na humpimia amtakaye. Hakika Yeye ni Mjuzi wa kila kitu.
translation_en: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.

arabic_text: ۞ شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًۭا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ
translation_sw: Amekuamrisheni Dini ile ile aliyo muusia Nuhu na tuliyo kufunulia wewe, na tuliyo wausia Ibrahim na Musa na Isa, kwamba shikeni Dini wala msifarikiane kwayo. Ni magumu kwa washirikina hayo unayo waitia. Mwenyezi Mungu humteua kwake amtakaye, na humwongoa kwake aelekeaye.
translation_en: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allah is that to which you invite them. Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].

arabic_text: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌۭ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّۢ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍۢ
translation_sw: Na hawakufarikiana ila baada ya kuwajia ilimu kwa sababu ya husuda iliyo kuwa baina yao. Na lau kuwa haikwisha tangulia kauli kutoka kwa Mola wako Mlezi ya kuakhirisha mpaka muda maalumu, basi bila ya shaka palingeli hukumiwa baina yao. Na hakika walio rithishwa Kitabu baada yao wanakitilia shaka inayo wahangaisha.
translation_en: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.

arabic_text: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَٱدْعُ ۖ وَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۖ وَقُلْ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَٰبٍۢ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ ۖ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ ۖ لَنَآ أَعْمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ ۖ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ۖ ٱللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Basi kwa haya waite! Nawe simama sawa sawa kama ulivyo amrishwa, wala usiyafuate matamanio yao. Na sema: Naamini aliyo teremsha Mwenyezi Mungu katika Vitabu. Na nimeamrishwa nifanye uadilifu baina yenu. Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mola wetu Mlezi, na Mola wenu Mlezi. Sisi tuna jukumu kwa vitendo vyetu, na nyinyi mna jukumu kwa vitendo vyenu. Hapana kuhojiana baina yetu na nyinyi. Na Mwenyezi Mungu atatukusanya pamoja, na marejeo ni kwake.
translation_en: So to that [religion of Allah] invite, [O Muhammad], and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allah has revealed of the Qur'an, and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds. There is no [need for] argument between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination."

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ٱسْتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌۭ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌ
translation_sw: Na wanao hojiana juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu baada ya kukubaliwa, hoja za hawa ni baat'ili mbele ya Mola wao Mlezi, na juu yao ipo ghadhabu, na itakuwa kwao adhabu kali.
