translation_en: And those who argue concerning Allah after He has been responded to - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ ۗ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌۭ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye aliye teremsha Kitabu kwa Haki, na Mizani. Na nini kitakacho kujuulisha ya kwamba pengine Saa ya Kiyama ipo karibu?
translation_en: It is Allah who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.

arabic_text: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِى ٱلسَّاعَةِ لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
translation_sw: Wasio amini huihimiza hiyo Saa ifike upesi; lakini wanao amini wanaiogopa, na wanajua kwamba hakika hiyo ni kweli. Ama kwa hakika hao wanao bishana katika khabari za hiyo Saa wamo katika upotofu wa mbali kabisa.
translation_en: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it, but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mpole kwa waja wake. Humruzuku ampendaye. Naye ni Mwenye nguvu, Mtukufu.
translation_en: Allah is Subtle with His servants; He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.

arabic_text: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهُۥ فِى حَرْثِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ
translation_sw: Mwenye kutaka mavuno ya Akhera tutamzidishia katika mavuno yake, na mwenye kutaka mavuno ya duniani tutampa katika hayo, lakini katika Akhera hana fungu.
translation_en: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest. And whoever desires the harvest of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.

arabic_text: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَٰٓؤُا۟ شَرَعُوا۟ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنۢ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ ٱلْفَصْلِ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Au hao wana miungu ya kishirikina walio watungia dini asiyo itolea idhini Mwenyezi Mungu? Na lau lisinge kuwako neno la kupambanua basi wangeli katiwa hukumu baina yao. Na hakika wenye kudhulumu watapata adhabu chungu.
translation_en: Or have they other deities who have ordained for them a religion to which Allah has not consented? But if not for the decisive word, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.

arabic_text: تَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِى رَوْضَاتِ ٱلْجَنَّاتِ ۖ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation_sw: Utawaona hao madhaalimu wanavyo kuwa na khofu kwa sababu ya waliyo yachuma, nayo yatawafika tu. Na walio amini na wakatenda mema watakuwamo katika mabustani ya Peponi. Humo watapata wayatakayo kwa Mola wao Mlezi. Hiyo ndiyo fadhila kubwa.
translation_en: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يُبَشِّرُ ٱللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ ۗ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ ۗ وَمَن يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةًۭ نَّزِدْ لَهُۥ فِيهَا حُسْنًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌ
translation_sw: Hayo ndiyo aliyo wabashiria Mwenyezi Mungu waja wake walio amini na wakatenda mema. Sema: Sikuombeni malipo yoyote kwenu ila mapenzi katika kujikurubisha. Na anaye fanya wema tutamzidishia wema. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Msamehevu Mwenye shukrani.
translation_en: It is that of which Allah gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for this message any payment [but] only good will through kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Appreciative.

arabic_text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا ۖ فَإِن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ ۗ وَيَمْحُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_sw: Ati wanasema: Amemzulia Mwenyezi Mungu uwongo? Mwenyezi Mungu akipenda atapiga muhuri juu ya moyo wako. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anaufuta upotofu na anaithibitisha Haki kwa maneno yake. Hakika Yeye anayajua yaliomo vifuani.
translation_en: Or do they say, "He has invented about Allah a lie"? But if Allah willed, He could seal over your heart. And Allah eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Naye ndiye anaye pokea toba kwa waja wake, na anasamehe makosa, na anayajua mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: And it is He who accepts repentance from his servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.

arabic_text: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Na anawaitikia wanao amini na wakatenda mema, na anawazidishia fadhila zake. Na makafiri watakuwa na adhabu chungu.
translation_en: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment.

arabic_text: ۞ وَلَوْ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Na lau kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu angeli wakunjulia riziki waja wake, basi bila ya shaka wangeli panda kiburi katika dunia. Lakini anaiteremsha kwa kipimo akitakacho. Hakika Yeye anawajua vyema waja wake na anawaona.
translation_en: And if Allah had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Acquainted and Seeing.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا۟ وَيَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُۥ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
translation_sw: Naye ndiye anaye iteremsha mvua baada ya wao kwisha kata tamaa, na hueneza rehema yake. Naye ndiye Mlinzi Mwenye kuhimidiwa.
translation_en: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.

arabic_text: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Na katika Ishara zake ni kuumba mbingu na ardhi, na wanyama alio waeneza. Naye ni Mwenye uweza wa kuwakusanya apendapo.
translation_en: And of his signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَصَٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍۢ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَن كَثِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na misiba inayo kusibuni ni kwa sababu ya vitendo vya mikono yenu. Naye anasamehe mengi.
translation_en: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na nyinyi hamwezi kushinda katika ardhi. Na wala nyinyi hamna mlinzi wala msaidizi badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allah any protector or helper.

arabic_text: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلْجَوَارِ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
translation_sw: Na katika Ishara zake ni vyombo vinavyo kwenda na kurejea baharini kama vilima.
translation_en: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.

arabic_text: إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍ
translation_sw: Akitaka, huutuliza upepo navyo hivyo vyombo husimama tutwe juu ya bahari. Hakika katika hayo zipo Ishara kwa kila mwenye kusubiri akashukuru.
translation_en: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

arabic_text: أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Au huviangamiza hivyo vyombo kwa sababu ya waliyo yatenda hao watu. Naye husamehe mengi.
translation_en: Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much.

arabic_text: وَيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍۢ
translation_sw: Na ili wajue wanao jadiliana katika Ishara zetu kwamba hawana pahala pa kukimbilia.
translation_en: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.

arabic_text: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
translation_sw: Basi vyote mlivyo pewa ni starehe ya maisha ya dunia tu, lakini kilichoko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ni bora, na cha kudumu kwa ajili ya walio amini, na wakawa wanamtegemea Mola wao Mlezi,
translation_en: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوا۟ هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanayo yaepuka madhambi makubwa na mambo machafu, na wanapo kasirika wao husamehe,
translation_en: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanao mwitikia Mola wao Mlezi, na wakashika Sala, na mambo yao yakawa ni kwa kushauriana baina yao, na kutokana na tulicho waruzuku wakawa wanatoa,
translation_en: And those who have responded to their lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلْبَغْىُ هُمْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambao wanapo fanyiwa jeuri hujitetea.
translation_en: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they defend themselves,

arabic_text: وَجَزَٰٓؤُا۟ سَيِّئَةٍۢ سَيِّئَةٌۭ مِّثْلُهَا ۖ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na malipo ya uovu ni uovu mfano wa huo. Lakini mwenye kusamehe, na akasuluhisha, basi huyo malipo yake yapo kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Yeye hawapendi wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allah. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.

arabic_text: وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ
translation_sw: Na wanao jitetea baada ya kudhulumiwa, hao hapana njia ya kuwalaumu.
translation_en: And whoever avenges himself after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Bali lawama ipo kwa wale wanao wadhulumu watu, na wanafanya jeuri katika nchi bila ya haki. Hao watapata adhabu iliyo chungu.
translation_en: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.

arabic_text: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
translation_sw: Na anaye subiri, na akasamehe, hakika hayo ni katika mambo ya kuazimiwa.
translation_en: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [requiring] determination.

arabic_text: وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۗ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَىٰ مَرَدٍّۢ مِّن سَبِيلٍۢ
translation_sw: Na ambaye Mwenyezi Mungu amemwacha kupotea, hana mlinzi baada yake. Na utawaona wenye kudhulumu watakapo iona adhabu wanasema: Je! Ipo njia ya kurudi?
translation_en: And he whom Allah sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"

arabic_text: وَتَرَىٰهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِىٍّۢ ۗ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِى عَذَابٍۢ مُّقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Na utawaona wanapelekwa kwenye Moto, nao wamenyenyekea kwa unyonge, wanatazama kwa mtazamo wa kificho. Na walio amini watasema: Hakika wapatao khasara ni hao walio khasiri nafsi zao na ahali zao Siku ya Kiyama. Ama hakika wenye kudhulumu watakuwa katika adhabu ya daima.
translation_en: And you will see them being exposed to the Fire, humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."

arabic_text: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ
translation_sw: Wala hawatakuwa na walinzi wa kuwanusuru mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na ambaye Mwenyezi Mungu amemwacha kupotea, hana njia yoyote.
translation_en: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allah. And whoever Allah sends astray - for him there is no way.

arabic_text: ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍۢ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Muitikieni Mola wenu Mlezi kabla haijafika siku isiyo epukika itokayo kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Siku hiyo hamtakuwa pa kukimbilia wala hamtakuwa na cha kukingia.
translation_en: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that day, nor for you will there be any denial.

arabic_text: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا ۖ إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ۗ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةًۭ فَرِحَ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ كَفُورٌۭ
translation_sw: Na wakipuuza, basi Sisi hatukukupeleka ili uwe mwangalizi wao. Si juu yako ila kufikisha Ujumbe tu. Na hakika Sisi tukimwonjesha mtu rehema kutoka kwetu, huifurahia. Na akisibiwa na ovu kwa sababu ya iliyo yatanguliza mikono yao, basi hakika mtu huyu anakufuru.
translation_en: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.

arabic_text: لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَٰثًۭا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ
translation_sw: Ufalme wa mbingu na ardhi ni wa Mwenyezi Mungu; anaumba apendavyo, anamtunukia amtakaye watoto wa kike, na anamtunukia amtakaye watoto wa kiume,
translation_en: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what he wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.

arabic_text: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًۭا وَإِنَٰثًۭا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۭ قَدِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Au huwachanganya wanaume na wanawake, na akamfanya amtakaye tasa. Hakika Yeye ni Mjuzi Mwenye uweza.
translation_en: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.

arabic_text: ۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًۭا فَيُوحِىَ بِإِذْنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na haikuwa kwa mwanaadamu kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu amsemeze ila kwa Wahyi (Ufunuo), au kwa nyuma ya pazia, au kumtuma Mjumbe. Naye humfunulia ayatakayo kwa idhini yake. Hakika Yeye ni Mtukufu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.

arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ رُوحًۭا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِى مَا ٱلْكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُورًۭا نَّهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Na namna hivi tumekufunulia Qur'ani kwa amri yetu. Ulikuwa hujui Kitabu ni nini, wala Imani. Lakini tumekifanya kuwa ni Nuru ambayo kwayo tunammwongoa tumtakaye katika waja wetu. Na hakika wewe unaongoa kwenye Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path -

arabic_text: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
translation_sw: Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye ni vyake Yeye tu viliomo mbinguni na katika ardhi. Jueni kuwa mambo yote yanarudi kwa Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: The path of Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allah do [all] matters evolve.

arabic_text: حمٓ
translation_sw: H'a Mim
translation_en: Ha, Meem.

arabic_text: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa Kitabu kinacho bainisha.
translation_en: By the clear Book,

arabic_text: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumeifanya Qur'ani kwa Kiarabu ili mfahamu.
translation_en: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
translation_sw: Na hakika hiyo imo katika Asili ya Maandiko yalioko kwetu, ni tukufu na yenye hikima.
translation_en: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.

arabic_text: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا مُّسْرِفِينَ
translation_sw: Je! Tuache kukukumbusheni kabisa kwa kuwa nyinyi ni watu mlio pita mipaka kwa ukafiri?
translation_en: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?

arabic_text: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّۢ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Na Manabii wangapi tuliwatuma kwa watu wa zamani!
translation_en: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,

arabic_text: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation_sw: Na hawajii Nabii yeyote ila walikuwa wakimkejeli.
translation_en: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.

arabic_text: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Na tuliwaangamiza walio kuwa na nguvu kushinda wao. Na mfano wa watu wa zamani umekwisha pita.
translation_en: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.

arabic_text: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Na ukiwauliza: Nani aliye ziumba mbingu na ardhi? Bila ya shaka watasema: Kaziumba Mwenye nguvu, Mjuzi,
translation_en: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing."

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Ambaye amekufanyieni ardhi kama tandiko, na akakufanyieni ndani yake njia mpate kuongoka.
translation_en: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambaye ndiye aliye teremsha kutoka mbinguni maji kwa kiasi, na kwa hayo tukaifufua nchi iliyo kufa. Na namna hivi ndivyo mtakavyo tolewa.
translation_en: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambaye ndiye aliye umba katika kila kitu jike na dume, na akakufanyieni marikebu na wanyama mnao wapanda.
translation_en: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount.

arabic_text: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
translation_sw: Ili mkae vizuri migongoni mwao, kisha mkumbuke neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnapokaa sawa sawa juu yao na mseme: Ametakasika aliye mfanya huyu atutumikie, na tusingeli weza kufanya haya wenyewe.
translation_en: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika sisi tutarudi kwa Mola wetu Mlezi.
translation_en: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."

arabic_text: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
translation_sw: Na wanamfanyia katika waja wake fungu. Kwa hakika mwanaadamu ni mtovu wa fadhila aliye dhaahiri.
translation_en: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.

arabic_text: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍۢ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ
translation_sw: Au amejichukulia watoto wanawake katika vile alivyo viumba, na akakuteulieni nyinyi watoto wanaume?
translation_en: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?

arabic_text: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ مَثَلًۭا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
translation_sw: Na anapo bashiriwa mmoja wao kwa yale aliyo mpigia mfano Mwenyezi Mungu, uso wake husawijika na hujaa hasira.
translation_en: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.

arabic_text: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Ati aliye lelewa katika mapambo, na katika mabishano hawezi kusema kwa bayana...?
translation_en: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?

arabic_text: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ
translation_sw: Na wakawafanya Malaika, ambao ni waja wa Mwingi wa Rehema, ni wanawake! Kwani wameshuhudia kuumbwa kwao? Ushahidi wao utaandikwa na wao watahojiwa!
translation_en: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
translation_sw: Nao husema: Angeli penda Mwingi wa Rehema tusingeli waabudu sisi. Hawana ujuzi wowote wa hayo! Hawana ila kusema uwongo tu!
translation_en: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying.

arabic_text: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
translation_sw: Kwani tuliwapa Kitabu kabla ya hichi, na ikawa wao wanakishikilia hicho?
translation_en: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering?

arabic_text: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Bali wanasema: Hakika sisi tuliwakuta baba zetu wanashika dini makhsusi, basi na sisi tunaongoza nyayo zao.
translation_en: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."

arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Na kadhaalika hatukumtuma mwonyaji kwenye mji wowote ila watu wake walio deka kwa starehe walisema: Hakika sisi tuliwakuta baba zetu wanashika dini makhsusi, na sisi tunafuata nyayo zao.
translation_en: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."

arabic_text: ۞ قَٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema (Mwonyaji): Hata nikikuleteeni yenye uwongofu bora kuliko mlio wakuta nao baba zenu? Wakasema: Sisi tunayakataa tu hayo mliyo tumwa.
translation_en: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

arabic_text: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Basi tukawalipizia. Angalia ulikuwaje mwisho wa walio kadhibisha!
translation_en: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_sw: Na pale Ibrahim alipo mwambia baba yake na kaumu yake: Hakika mimi ninajitenga mbali na hayo mnayo yaabudu,
translation_en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa yule aliye niumba, kwani Yeye ataniongoa.
translation_en: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."

arabic_text: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةًۭ فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_sw: Na akalifanya hili liwe neno lenye kubaki katika vizazi vyake ili warejee.
translation_en: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].

arabic_text: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Bali tuliwastarehesha hawa na baba zao mpaka ikawafikia Haki na Mtume aliye bainisha.
translation_en: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.

arabic_text: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na ilipo wafikia Haki wakasema: Huu ni uchawi, na sisi hakika tunaukataa.
translation_en: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
translation_sw: Na walisema: Kwa nini Qur'ani hii haikuteremshwa kwa mtu mkubwa katika miji miwili hii?
translation_en: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"

arabic_text: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍۢ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًۭا سُخْرِيًّۭا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
translation_sw: Kwani wao ndio wanao gawa rehema za Mola wako Mlezi? Sisi tumewagawanyia baina yao maisha yao katika uhai wa duniani, na tukawanyanyua baadhi yao juu ya wengine kwa daraja nyingi; kwa hivyo baadhi yao wanawafanya wenginewe wawatumikie. Na rehema za Mwenyezi Mungu ni bora kuliko hayo wanayo yakusanya.
translation_en: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.

arabic_text: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًۭا مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
translation_sw: Na lau isinge kuwa watu watakuwa kundi moja tungeli wajaalia wanao mkufuru Rahmani wana nyumba zao zina dari ya fedha, na ngazi zao pia wanazo pandia,
translation_en: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount

arabic_text: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
translation_sw: Na milango ya nyumba zao na vitanda wanavyo egemea juu yake,
translation_en: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline

arabic_text: وَزُخْرُفًۭا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_sw: Na mapambo. Lakini hayo si chochote ila ni starehe ya maisha ya dunia tu, na Akhera iliyoko kwa Mola wako Mlezi ni ya wenye kumchamngu.
translation_en: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.

arabic_text: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَٰنًۭا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Anaye yafanyia upofu maneno ya Rahmani tunamwekea Shet'ani kuwa ndiye rafiki yake.
translation_en: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika wao wanawazuilia Njia na wenyewe wanadhani kuwa wameongoka.
translation_en: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ
translation_sw: Hata atakapo tujia atasema: Laiti ungeli kuwako baina yangu na wewe kama umbali baina ya mashariki na magharibi. Rafiki mwovu mno wewe!
translation_en: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion."

arabic_text: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Na kwa kuwa mlidhulumu, haitakufaeni kitu leo kwamba nyinyi mnashirikiana katika adhabu.
translation_en: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.

arabic_text: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Je! Unaweza kuwasikilizisha viziwi, au unaweza kuwaongoa vipofu na waliomo katika upotofu ulio wazi?
translation_en: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?

arabic_text: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na hata tukikuondoa, Sisi tutalipiza kisasi chetu kwao.
translation_en: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.

arabic_text: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
translation_sw: Au tutakuonyesha tulio waahidi. Nasi bila ya shaka tuna uweza juu yao.
translation_en: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.

arabic_text: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi wewe yashike yaliyo funuliwa kwako. Hakika wewe uko kwenye Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌۭ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika haya ni ukumbusho kwako na kwa kaumu yako. Na mtakuja ulizwa.
translation_en: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.

arabic_text: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةًۭ يُعْبَدُونَ
translation_sw: Na waulize Mitume wetu tulio watuma kabla yako: Je! Tulifanya miungu mingine iabudiwe badala ya Rah'mani?
translation_en: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka tulimtuma Musa kwa Ishara zetu ende kwa Firauni na waheshimiwa wake, na akasema: Hakika mimi ni Mtume wa Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote!
translation_en: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini alipo wajia na Ishara zetu wakaingia kuzicheka.
translation_en: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.

arabic_text: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_sw: Na hatukuwaonyesha Ishara yoyote ila hiyo ilikuwa kubwa zaidi kuliko nyenginewe. Na tukawakamata kwa adhabu ili warejee.
translation_en: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
translation_sw: Na wakasema: Ewe mchawi! Tuombee kwa Mola wako Mlezi kwa ile ahadi aliyo kuahidi; hakika sisi tutakuwa wenye kuongoka.
translation_en: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
translation_sw: Basi tulipo waondolea adhabu hiyo, mara wakaingia kuvunja ahadi.
translation_en: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.

arabic_text: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na Firauni alitangaza kwa watu wake, akisema: Enyi watu wangu! Kwani mimi sinao huu ufalme wa Misri, na hii mito inapita chini yangu? Je! Hamwoni?
translation_en: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?

arabic_text: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌۭ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
translation_sw: Au mimi si bora kuliko huyu aliye mnyonge, wala hawezi kusema waziwazi?
translation_en: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?

arabic_text: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌۭ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
translation_sw: Basi mbona hakuvikwa vikuku vya dhahabu, au hawakuja Malaika pamoja naye wakamwandama?
translation_en: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"

arabic_text: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
translation_sw: Basi aliwachezea watu wake, na wakamt'ii. Kwa hakika hao walikuwa watu wapotovu.
translation_en: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah].

arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Walipo tukasirisha tuliwapatiliza tukawazamisha wote!
translation_en: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.

arabic_text: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ سَلَفًۭا وَمَثَلًۭا لِّلْءَاخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukawafanya kuwa watangulizi na mfano kwa wa baadaye.
translation_en: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.

arabic_text: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
translation_sw: Na alipo pigiwa mfano Mwana wa Mariamu, watu wako waliupiga ukelele.
translation_en: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Miungu yetu kwani si bora kuliko huyu? Hawakukupigia mfano huo ila kwa ubishi tu. Bali hao ni watu wagomvi!
translation_en: And they said, "Are your gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.

arabic_text: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_sw: Hakuwa yeye (Isa) ila ni Mtumwa tuliye mneemesha na tukamfanya ni mfano kwa Wana wa Israili.
translation_en: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
translation_sw: Na tungeli penda tungeli wafanyia miongoni mwenu Malaika katika ardhi wakifuatana.
translation_en: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌۭ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika yeye ni alama ya Saa ya Kiyama. Basi usiitilie shaka, na nifuateni. Hii ndiyo Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.

arabic_text: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Wala asikuzuilieni Shet'ani. Hakika yeye ni adui yenu wa dhaahiri.
translation_en: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.

arabic_text: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_sw: Na alipo kuja Isa na dalili zilizo wazi, alisema: Nimekujieni na hikima, na ili nikuelezeni baadhi ya yale mliyo khitalifiana. Basi mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu, na mnit'ii mimi.
translation_en: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mola wangu Mlezi, na ni Mola wenu Mlezi. Basi Muabuduni Yeye tu. Hii ndiyo Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."

arabic_text: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_sw: Lakini makundi kwa makundi yao yalikhitalifiana wao kwa wao. Ole wao walio dhulumu kwa adhabu ya siku chungu.
translation_en: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.

arabic_text: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Nini wanangojea ila Saa iwajie kwa ghafla na wala wao hawatambui?
translation_en: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?

arabic_text: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo marafiki watakuwa ni maadui, wao kwa wao, isipo kuwa wachamngu.
translation_en: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous

arabic_text: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
translation_sw: Enyi waja wangu! Hamtakuwa na khofu siku hiyo, wala hamtahuzunika.
translation_en: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Ambao waliziamini Ishara zangu na walikuwa Waislamu.
translation_en: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.

arabic_text: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
translation_sw: Ingieni Peponi, nyinyi na wake zenu; mtafurahishwa humo.
translation_en: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."

arabic_text: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍۢ مِّن ذَهَبٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation_sw: Watakuwa wanapitishiwa sahani za dhahabu na vikombe; na vitakuwamo ambavyo nafsi zinavipenda na macho yanavifurahia, na nyinyi mtakaa humo milele.
translation_en: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.

arabic_text: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na hiyo ni Pepo mliyo rithishwa kwa hayo mliyo kuwa mkiyafanya.
translation_en: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.

arabic_text: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ كَثِيرَةٌۭ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_sw: Mnayo humo matunda mengi mtakayo yala.
translation_en: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika wakosefu watakaa katika adhabu ya Jahannamu.
translation_en: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.

arabic_text: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
translation_sw: Hawatapumzishwa nayo na humo watakata tamaa.
translation_en: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.

arabic_text: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Wala Sisi hatukuwadhulumu, bali wao ndio walio kuwa madhaalimu.
translation_en: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.

arabic_text: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ
translation_sw: Nao watapiga kelele waseme: Ewe Malik! Na atufishe Mola wako Mlezi! Naye aseme: Hakika nyinyi mtakaa humo humo!
translation_en: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."

arabic_text: لَقَدْ جِئْنَٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa yakini tulikuleteeni Haki, lakini wengi katika nyinyi mlikuwa mnaichukia Haki.
translation_en: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.

arabic_text: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
translation_sw: Au waliweza kupitisha amri yao? Bali ni Sisi ndio tunao pitisha.
translation_en: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].

arabic_text: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
translation_sw: Au wanadhani kwamba hatusikii siri zao na minong'ono yao? Wapi! Na wajumbe wetu wapo karibu nao, wanayaandika.
translation_en: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording.

arabic_text: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدٌۭ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَٰبِدِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Ingeli kuwa Rahmani ana mwana, basi mimi ningeli kuwa wa kwanza kumuabudu.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."

arabic_text: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_sw: Ametakasika Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na ardhi, Mola Mlezi wa A'rshi, na hayo wanayo msifia.
translation_en: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

arabic_text: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Basi waache wapige porojo wakicheza mpaka wakutwe na hiyo siku yao waliyo ahidiwa.
translation_en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَٰهٌۭ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Na Yeye ndiye Mungu mbinguni, na ndiye Mungu katika ardhi. Naye ndiye Mwenye hikima, Mwenye ujuzi.
translation_en: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.

arabic_text: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na ametukuka Mwenye ufalme wa mbingu na ardhi na viliomo ndani yake. Na uko kwake ujuzi wa Saa ya Kiyama, na kwake Yeye mtarudishwa.
translation_en: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.

arabic_text: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Wala hao mnao waomba badala yake Yeye hawana uweza wa kumwombea mtu, isipo kuwa anaye shuhudia kwa haki, na wao wanajua.
translation_en: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.

arabic_text: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
translation_sw: Na ukiwauliza ni nani aliye waumba? Bila ya shaka watasema: Mwenyezi Mungu! Basi ni wapi wanako geuziwa?
translation_en: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded?

arabic_text: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Na usemi wake (Mtume) ni: Ewe Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika hawa ni watu wasio amini.
translation_en: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."

arabic_text: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌۭ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Basi wasamehe, na uwambie maneno ya salama. Watakuja jua.
translation_en: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.

arabic_text: حمٓ
translation_sw: H'a Mim
translation_en: Ha, Meem.

arabic_text: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa Kitabu kinacho bainisha,
translation_en: By the clear Book,

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika tumekiteremsha katika usiku ulio barikiwa. Hakika Sisi ni Waonyaji.
translation_en: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

arabic_text: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
translation_sw: Katika usiku huu hubainishwa kila jambo la hikima,
translation_en: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -

arabic_text: أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
translation_sw: Jambo litokalo kwetu. Hakika Sisi ndio wenye kutuma.
translation_en: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

arabic_text: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Ni rehema itokayo kwa Mola wako Mlezi. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kusikia Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

arabic_text: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation_sw: Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na ardhi na vilio baina yao, ikiwa nyinyi mna yakini.
translation_en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

arabic_text: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Hakuna mungu ila Yeye; anahuisha na anafisha- Mola Mlezi wenu na Mola Mlezi wa baba zenu wa mwanzo.
translation_en: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

arabic_text: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini wao wanacheza katika shaka.
translation_en: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

arabic_text: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi ingoje siku ambayo mbingu zitakapo leta moshi ulio dhaahiri,
translation_en: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.

arabic_text: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Utakao wafunika watu: Hii ni adhabu chungu!
translation_en: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

arabic_text: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tuondolee adhabu hii. Hakika tutaamini.
translation_en: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

arabic_text: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Nini faida ya kukumbuka kwao? Na alikwisha wafikia Mtume mwenye kubainisha.
translation_en: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ
translation_sw: Na wao wakamgeuzia uso, na wakasema: Huyu amefunzwa, naye ni mwendawazimu.
translation_en: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

arabic_text: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika sisi tutaiondoa adhabu kidogo, lakini nyinyi kwa yakini mtarejea vile vile!
translation_en: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

arabic_text: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
translation_sw: Siku tutayo yashambulia mashambulio makubwa, bila ya shaka Sisi ni wenye kutesa.
translation_en: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

arabic_text: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
translation_sw: Na hakika kabla ya hawa tuliwafanyia mtihani watu wa Firauni, na aliwafikia Mtume Mtukufu.
translation_en: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,

arabic_text: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Akasema: Nipeni waja wa Mwenyezi Mungu; kwa hakika mimi kwenu ni Mtume Muaminifu.
translation_en: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"

arabic_text: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Na msimfanyie kiburi Mwenyezi Mungu; hakika mimi nitakuleteeni uthibitisho ulio wazi.
translation_en: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.

arabic_text: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
translation_sw: Nami najikinga kwa Mola wangu Mlezi na ndiye Mola wenu Mlezi pia, ili msinipige mawe.
translation_en: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

arabic_text: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
translation_sw: Na ikiwa hamniamini, basi jitengeni nami.
translation_en: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

arabic_text: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_sw: Ndipo akamwomba Mola wake Mlezi: Hakika watu hawa ni wakosefu.
translation_en: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

arabic_text: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu akasema: Basi nenda na waja wangu usiku. Kwa yakini mtafuatwa.
translation_en: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

arabic_text: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ
translation_sw: Na iache bahari vivyo hivyo imeachana, hakika wao hao ni jeshi litakalo zamishwa.
translation_en: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."

arabic_text: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Mabustani mangapi, na chemchem ngapi waliziacha!
translation_en: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

arabic_text: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Na mimea na vyeo vitukufu!
translation_en: And crops and noble sites

arabic_text: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
translation_sw: Na neema walizo kuwa wakijistareheshea!
translation_en: And comfort wherein they were amused.

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation_sw: Ndio hivyo! Na tukawarithisha haya watu wenginewe.
translation_en: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

arabic_text: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
translation_sw: La mbingu wala ardhi hazikuwalilia, wala hawakupewa muhula.
translation_en: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka tuliwaokoa Wana wa Israili katika adhabu ya kuwadhalilisha,
translation_en: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

arabic_text: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_sw: Ya Firauni. Hakika yeye alikuwa jeuri katika wenye kupindukia mipaka.
translation_en: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na tuliwakhiari kwa ujuzi wetu kuliko walimwengu wenginewe.
translation_en: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

arabic_text: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌۭا۟ مُّبِينٌ
translation_sw: Na tukawapa katika ishara zenye majaribio yaliyo wazi.
translation_en: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika hawa wanasema:
translation_en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,

arabic_text: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
translation_sw: Hapana ila kufa kwetu mara ya kwanza tu, wala sisi hatufufuliwi.
translation_en: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

arabic_text: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Basi warudisheni baba zetu, ikiwa nyinyi mnasema kweli.
translation_en: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

arabic_text: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Je! Ni wao bora au watu wa Tubbaa' na walio kuwa kabla yao? Tuliwaangamiza. Hakika hao walikuwa wakosefu.
translation_en: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.

arabic_text: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
translation_sw: Na hatukuziumba mbingu na ardhi na vilivyomo baina yake kwa mchezo.
translation_en: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

arabic_text: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Hatukuviumba hivyo ila kwa Haki, lakini wengi wao hawajui.
translation_en: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

arabic_text: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika siku ya Uamuzi ni wakati ulio wekwa kwa wao wote.
translation_en: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_sw: Siku ambayo rafiki hatamfaa rafiki yake kwa chochote, wala hawatanusuriwa.
translation_en: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

arabic_text: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa atakaye mrehemu Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Yeye ndiye Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

arabic_text: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_sw: Hakika Mti wa Zaqqum,
translation_en: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum

arabic_text: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
translation_sw: Ni chakula cha mwenye dhambi.
translation_en: Is food for the sinful.

arabic_text: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
translation_sw: Kama shaba iliyo yayushwa, hutokota matumboni
translation_en: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

arabic_text: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_sw: Kama kutokota kwa maji ya moto.
translation_en: Like the boiling of scalding water.

arabic_text: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_sw: (Itasemwa:) Mkamateni na mtupeni katikati ya Jahannamu!
translation_en: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

arabic_text: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_sw: Kisha mmwagieni juu ya kichwa chake adhabu ya maji yanayo chemka.
translation_en: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

arabic_text: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
translation_sw: Onja! Ati wewe ndiye mwenye nguvu, mtukufu!
translation_en: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika haya ndiyo mliyo kuwa mkiyatilia shaka.
translation_en: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika wachamngu watakuwa katika mahali pa amani,
translation_en: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;

arabic_text: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Katika mabustani na chemchem,
translation_en: Within gardens and springs,

arabic_text: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
translation_sw: Watavaa hariri nyepesi na hariri nzito wakikabiliana,
translation_en: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Hivi ndivyo itakavyo kuwa, na tutawaoza mahurilaini.
translation_en: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

arabic_text: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_sw: Humo watataka kila aina ya matunda, na wakae kwa amani.
translation_en: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

arabic_text: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_sw: Humo hawataonja mauti ila mauti yale ya kwanza, na (Mwenyezi Mungu) atawalinda na adhabu ya Jahannamu,
translation_en: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

arabic_text: فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_sw: Kuwa ni fadhila zitokazo kwa Mola wako Mlezi. Huko ndiko kufuzu kukubwa.
translation_en: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

arabic_text: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Basi tumeifanya nyepesi hii Qur'ani kwa ulimi wako, ili wapate kukumbuka.
translation_en: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.

arabic_text: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
translation_sw: Ngoja tu, na wao wangoje pia.
translation_en: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].

arabic_text: حمٓ
translation_sw: H'a Mim
translation_en: Ha, Meem.

arabic_text: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
translation_sw: Uteremsho wa Kitabu umetoka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika katika mbingu na ardhi ziko Ishara kwa Waumini.
translation_en: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.

arabic_text: وَفِى خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ
translation_sw: Na katika umbo lenu na katika wanyama alio watawanya zimo Ishara kwa watu wenye yakini.
translation_en: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].

arabic_text: وَٱخْتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزْقٍۢ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na kupishana usiku na mchana, na riziki anayo iteremsha Mwenyezi Mungu kutoka mbinguni, na kwayo akaifufua ardhi baada ya kufa kwake, na mabadiliko ya upepo, ni Ishara kwa watu wenye akili.
translation_en: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.

arabic_text: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Hizi Aya za Mwenyezi Mungu tunakusomea kwa haki; basi hadithi gani watakayo iamini baada ya Mwenyezi Mungu na Aya zake?
translation_en: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Ole wake kila mzushi mwenye dhambi!
translation_en: Woe to every sinful liar

arabic_text: يَسْمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًۭا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Anaye sikia Aya za Mwenyezi Mungu akisomewa, kisha anashikilia yale yale aliyo katazwa, na anajivuna, kama kwamba hakuzisikia. Basi mbashirie adhabu chungu!
translation_en: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Na anapo kijua kitu kidogo katika Aya zetu hukifanyia mzaha. Watu hao ndio watakao kuwa na adhabu ya kufedhehesha.
translation_en: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.

arabic_text: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُوا۟ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
translation_sw: Na nyuma yao ipo Jahannamu. Na walio yachuma hayatawafaa hata kidogo, wala walinzi walio washika badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na watapata adhabu kubwa.
translation_en: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا هُدًۭى ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ
translation_sw: Huu ni uwongofu. Na wale wale walio zikataa Ishara za Mola wao Mlezi watapata adhabu inayo tokana na ghadhabu iliyo chungu.
translation_en: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.

arabic_text: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye aliye ifanya bahari ikutumikieni, ili humo zipite marikebu kwa amri yake, na ili mtafute fadhila yake, na mpate kushukuru.
translation_en: It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

arabic_text: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Na amefanya vikutumikieni vilivyomo mbinguni na vilivyomo katika ardhi, vyote vimetoka kwake. Hakika katika hayo zimo Ishara kwa watu wanao fikiri.
translation_en: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

arabic_text: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَغْفِرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجْزِىَ قَوْمًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_sw: Waambie walio amini wawasamehe wale wasio zitaraji siku za Mwenyezi Mungu, ili awalipe kwa waliyo kuwa wakiyachuma.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.

arabic_text: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenye kutenda mema basi ni kwa ajili ya nafsi yake, na mwenye kutenda uovu ni juu yake mwenyewe. Kisha mtarudishwa kwa Mola wenu Mlezi.
translation_en: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tuliwapa Wana wa Israili Kitabu na hukumu na Unabii, na tukawaruzuku vitu vizuri vizuri, na tukawafadhilisha kuliko walimwengu wote.
translation_en: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.

arabic_text: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
translation_sw: Na tukawapa maelezo wazi ya amri. Basi hawakukhitalifiana ila baada ya kuwajia ujuzi, kwa ajili ya uhasidi uliyo kuwa baina yao. Hakika Mola wako Mlezi atahukumu baina yao Siku ya Kiyama katika mambo waliyo kuwa wakikhitalifiana.
translation_en: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukakuweka wewe juu ya Njia ya haya mambo, basi ifuate, wala usifuate matamanio ya wasio jua kitu.
translation_en: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُوا۟ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika hao hawatakufaa kitu mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na hakika wenye kudhulumu ni marafiki wao kwa wao. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni rafiki wa wamchao.
translation_en: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ
translation_sw: Hizi ni dalili zilizo wazi kwa watu wote, na ni uwongofu, na rehema kwa watu wanao yakinisha.
translation_en: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].

arabic_text: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءًۭ مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Wanadhani wanao tenda maovu kuwa tutawafanya kama walio amini, na wakatenda mema, sawa sawa uhai wao na kufa kwao? Ni hukumu mbaya wanayo ihukumu!
translation_en: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.

arabic_text: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu ameziumba mbingu na ardhi kwa haki, na ili kila nafsi ilipwe yale iliyo yachuma. Nao hawatadhulumiwa.
translation_en: And Allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۢ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِۦ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةًۭ فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Umemwona aliye fanya matamanio yake kuwa ndiye mungu wake, na Mwenyezi Mungu akamwacha apotee pamoja na kuwa ana ujuzi, na akapiga muhuri juu ya masikio yake, na moyo wake, na akambandika vitanga machoni mwake? Basi nani atamwongoa huyo baada ya Mwenyezi Mungu? Hamkumbuki?
translation_en: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allah? Then will you not be reminded?

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهْرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
translation_sw: Na walisema: Hapana ila huu uhai wetu wa duniani - twafa na twaishi, na hapana kinacho tuhiliki isipo kuwa dahari. Lakini wao hawana ilimu ya hayo, ila wao wanadhani tu.
translation_en: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na wakisomewa Aya zetu zilizo wazi hawana hoja ila kusema: Waleteni baba zetu, ikiwa nyinyi ni wasemao kweli.
translation_en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

arabic_text: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Mwenyezi Mungu anakuhuisheni, kisha anakufisheni, kisha anakukusanyeni Siku ya Kiyama isiyo na shaka. Lakini watu wengi hawajui.
translation_en: Say, "Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."

arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَخْسَرُ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mwenye ufalme wa mbingu na ardhi. Na siku itapo simama Saa ya Kiyama, siku hiyo wataangamia wenye kushikamana na upotovu.
translation_en: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.

arabic_text: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍۢ جَاثِيَةًۭ ۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۢ تُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Na utauona kila umma umepiga magoti, na kila umma utaitwa kwenda soma kitabu chake: Leo mtalipwa mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda.
translation_en: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا كِتَٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Hichi kitabu chetu kinasema juu yenu kwa haki. Hakika Sisi tulikuwa tukiyaandika mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda.
translation_en: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Ama walio amini na wakatenda mema, Mola wao Mlezi atawatia katika rehema yake. Huko ndiko kufuzu kulio wazi.
translation_en: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na ama walio kufuru, wataambiwa: Kwani hamkuwa mkisomewa Aya zangu nanyi mkapanda kichwa, na mkawa watu wakosefu?
translation_en: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a people of criminals?

arabic_text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُم مَّا نَدْرِى مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na ikisemwa: Hakika ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni kweli, na Saa haina shaka, nyinyi mkisema: Hatuijui hiyo Saa, tunadhania dhana tu, wala hatuna yakini.
translation_en: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.' "

arabic_text: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation_sw: Basi ubaya wa waliyo yatenda utawadhihirikia, na yatawazunguka waliyo yafanyia maskhara.
translation_en: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

arabic_text: وَقِيلَ ٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na itasemwa: Leo tunakusahauni kama nyinyi mlivyo sahau mkutano wa siku yenu hii; na mahali penu ni Motoni, wala hamna wa kukunusuruni.
translation_en: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذْتُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوًۭا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa sababu nyinyi mlizifanyia mzaha Aya za Mwenyezi Mungu; na maisha ya dunia yakakudanganyeni. Basi leo hawatatolewa humo wala hao hawatakubaliwa udhuru wao.
translation_en: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].

arabic_text: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحَمْدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Basi sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa mbingu, na Mola Mlezi wa ardhi, na Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: وَلَهُ ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Na ukubwa ni wake Yeye tu, mbinguni na katika ardhi, naye ni Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: حمٓ
translation_sw: H'A MIM
translation_en: Ha, Meem.

arabic_text: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
translation_sw: Uteremsho wa Kitabu umetoka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: مَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُوا۟ مُعْرِضُونَ
translation_sw: Hatukuziumba mbingu na ardhi wala yaliyomo baina yake ila kwa haki na kwa muda maalumu. Na walio kufuru wanayapuuza yale wanayo onywa.
translation_en: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.

arabic_text: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌۭ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ۖ ٱئْتُونِى بِكِتَٰبٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ هَٰذَآ أَوْ أَثَٰرَةٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Je! Mwawaona wale mnao waomba badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu? Nionyesheni wameumba nini katika ardhi; au hao wanayo shirika katika mbingu? Nileteeni Kitabu kilicho kuwa kabla ya hiki, au alama yoyote ya ilimu, ikiwa mnasema kweli.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
