arabic_text: وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَهُمْ عَن دُعَآئِهِمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
translation_sw: Na nani mpotofu mkubwa kuliko hao wanao waomba, badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu, ambao hawatawaitikia mpaka Siku ya Kiyama, na wala hawatambui maombi yao.
translation_en: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, and they, of their invocation, are unaware.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ ٱلنَّاسُ كَانُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَعْدَآءًۭ وَكَانُوا۟ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na ambao watu watakapo kusanywa watakuwa maadui zao, na wataikataa ibada yao.
translation_en: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
translation_sw: Na wanapo somewa Aya zetu zilizo wazi, walio kufuru husema juu ya haki inapo wajia: Huu ni uchawi dhaahiri.
translation_en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."

arabic_text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ إِنِ ٱفْتَرَيْتُهُۥ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ ۖ كَفَىٰ بِهِۦ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Au wanasema: Ameizua mwenyewe! Sema: Ikiwa nimeizua mimi, basi nyinyi hamwezi kunifaa chochote mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Yeye anajua zaidi hayo mnayo ropokwa; anatosha kuwa shahidi baina yangu na nyinyi. Na Yeye ndiye Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Or do they say, "He has invented it?" Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allah at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving the Merciful."

arabic_text: قُلْ مَا كُنتُ بِدْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَمَآ أَدْرِى مَا يُفْعَلُ بِى وَلَا بِكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Sema: Mimi si kiroja miongoni mwa Mitume. Wala sijui nitakavyo fanywa wala nyinyi. Mimi nafuata niliyo funuliwa tu kwa Wahyi, wala mimi si chochote ila ni mwonyaji mwenye kudhihirisha wazi.
translation_en: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."

arabic_text: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِۦ فَـَٔامَنَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Mwaonaje yakiwa haya ni kweli yametoka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, nanyi mmeyakataa, na akashuhudia shahidi miongoni mwa Wana wa Israili juu ya mfano wa haya, na akaamini, na nyinyi mnafanya kiburi? Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu hawaongoi watu wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an was from Allah, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًۭا مَّا سَبَقُونَآ إِلَيْهِ ۚ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَٰذَآ إِفْكٌۭ قَدِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru waliwaambia walio amini: Lau kuwa hii ni kheri, wasingeli tutangulia. Na walipo kosa kuongoka wakasema: Huu ni uzushi wa zamani.
translation_en: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."

arabic_text: وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًۭا وَرَحْمَةًۭ ۚ وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌۭ مُّصَدِّقٌۭ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لِّيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na kabla yake kilikuwapo Kitabu cha Musa, kuwa chenye uwongozi na rehema. Na hichi ni Kitabu cha kusadikisha na kilicho kuja kwa lugha ya Kiarabu, ili kiwaonye walio dhulumu, na kiwe ni bishara kwa watendao mema.
translation_en: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika walio sema: Mola wetu Mlezi ni Mwenyezi Mungu; kisha wakatengenea, hawatakuwa na khofu, wala hawatahuzunika.
translation_en: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Hao ndio watu wa Peponi, watadumu humo, kuwa ni malipo kwa waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda.
translation_en: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.

arabic_text: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ إِحْسَٰنًا ۖ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ كُرْهًۭا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًۭا ۖ وَحَمْلُهُۥ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ ثَلَٰثُونَ شَهْرًا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةًۭ قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na tumemuusia mwanaadamu awatendee wema wazazi wake wawili. Mama yake amechukua mimba yake kwa taabu, na akamzaa kwa taabu. Na kuchukua mimba kwake hata kumwachisha ziwa ni miezi thalathini. Hata anapo fika utu uzima wake, na akafikilia miaka arubaini, husema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Niwezeshe nishukuru neema zako ulizo nineemesha mimi na wazazi wangu, na nitende mema unayo yapenda. Na unitengenezee dhuriya zangu. Hakika mimi nimetubu kwako, na mimi ni miongoni mwa Waislamu.
translation_en: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱلصِّدْقِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Hao ndio tunao wapokelea bora ya vitendo vyao walivyo vitenda, na tunayasamehe makosa yao. Watakuwa miongoni mwa watu wa Peponi. Miadi ya kweli hiyo walio ahidiwa.
translation_en: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِى قَالَ لِوَٰلِدَيْهِ أُفٍّۢ لَّكُمَآ أَتَعِدَانِنِىٓ أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلْقُرُونُ مِن قَبْلِى وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ ٱللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ ءَامِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Na ambaye amewafyonya wazazi wake na akawaambia: Ati ndio mnanitisha kuwa nitafufuliwa, na hali vizazi vingi vimekwisha pita kabla yangu! Na hao wazazi humwomba msaada Mwenyezi Mungu (na humwambia mtoto wao): Ole wako! Amini! Hakika ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni kweli. Na yeye husema: Hayakuwa haya ila ni visa vya watu wa kale.
translation_en: But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allah for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former people" -

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍۢ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ
translation_sw: Hao ndio ambao imehakikikishwa hukumu juu yao kama mataifa yaliyo kwisha pita kabla yao miongoni mwa majini na watu. Hakika hao wamekuwa wenye kukhasiri.
translation_en: Those are the ones upon whom the word has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.

arabic_text: وَلِكُلٍّۢ دَرَجَٰتٌۭ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟ ۖ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na wote watakuwa na daraja zao mbali mbali kwa waliyo yatenda, na ili awalipe kwa vitendo vyao, na wala hawatadhulumiwa.
translation_en: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَٰتِكُمْ فِى حَيَاتِكُمُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهَا فَٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ
translation_sw: Na siku watakapo letwa walio kufuru kwenye Moto wataambiwa: Nyinyi mlitwaa vitu vyenu vizuri katika uhai wa duniani, na mkastareheshwa navyo. Basi leo ndio mnalipwa adhabu ya fedheha kwa mlivyo kuwa mkitakabari katika ardhi bila ya haki, na kwa sababu mlikuwa mkifanya upotovu.
translation_en: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."

arabic_text: ۞ وَٱذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنذَرَ قَوْمَهُۥ بِٱلْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلنُّذُرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦٓ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Na mtaje ndugu wa kina A'di, alipo waonya watu wake kwenye vilima vya mchanga. Na kwa yakini waonyaji wengi walitokea kabla yake na baada yake kuwaambia: Msimuabudu isipo kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika mimi nakukhofieni isikupateni adhabu ya siku iliyo kuu.
translation_en: And mention, [O Muhammad], the brother of 'Aad, when he warned his people in the [region of] al-Ahqaf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Je! Umetujia ili ututenge mbali na miungu yetu? Basi tuletee hayo unayo tuahidi ikiwa wewe ni miongoni mwa wasemao kweli.
translation_en: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦ وَلَٰكِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُمْ قَوْمًۭا تَجْهَلُونَ
translation_sw: Akasema: Hakika ujuzi uko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu. Mimi nakufikishieni niliyo tumwa. Lakini nakuoneni kuwa nyinyi mnafanya ujinga.
translation_en: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allah, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًۭا مُّسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا عَارِضٌۭ مُّمْطِرُنَا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ مَا ٱسْتَعْجَلْتُم بِهِۦ ۖ رِيحٌۭ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi walipo liona wingu likielekea kwenye mabonde yao, walisema: Wingu hili la kutunyeshea mvua! Kumbe sivyo, haya ni hayo mliyo yahimiza, upepo ambao ndani yake imo adhabu chungu!
translation_en: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment,

arabic_text: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Unaangamiza kila kitu kwa amri ya Mola wake Mlezi. Wakawa hawaonekani ila nyumba zao tu. Hivyo ndivyo tuwalipavyo wakosefu!
translation_en: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِيمَآ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰكُمْ فِيهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًۭا وَأَبْصَٰرًۭا وَأَفْـِٔدَةًۭ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ وَلَآ أَفْـِٔدَتُهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ إِذْ كَانُوا۟ يَجْحَدُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka tuliwaweka vizuri sio kama tulivyo kuwekeni nyinyi; na tuliwapa masikio, na macho, na nyoyo. Na hayakuwafaa kitu masikio yao, wala macho yao, wala nyoyo zao kwa lolote. Kwani hao walikuwa wakizikataa Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu, na yale waliyo kuwa wakiyafanyia maskhara ndiyo yakawazunguka.
translation_en: And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts. But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything [of the punishment] when they were [continually] rejecting the signs of Allah; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَصَرَّفْنَا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika tuliiangamiza miji ilio jirani zenu, na tulizitumia Ishara ili wapate kurejea.
translation_en: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief].

arabic_text: فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا ءَالِهَةًۢ ۖ بَلْ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنْهُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
translation_sw: Basi mbona wale walio washika badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu, kuwa ati hao ndio wawakurubishe, hawakuwanusuru? Bali waliwapotea! Na huo ndio uwongo walio kuwa wakiuzua.
translation_en: Then why did those they took besides Allah as deities by which to approach [Him] not aid them? But they had strayed from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَآ إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنصِتُوا۟ ۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِىَ وَلَّوْا۟ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na wakati tulipo waleta kundi la majini kuja kwako kusikiliza Qur'ani. Basi walipo ihudhuria walisema: Sikilizeni! Na ilipo kwisha somwa, walirudi kwa kaumu yao kwenda kuwaonya.
translation_en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur'an. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen quietly." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ يَٰقَوْمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Enyi kaumu yetu! Sisi tumesikia Kitabu kilicho teremshwa baada ya Musa, kinacho sadikisha yaliyo kuwa kabla yake, na kinacho ongoza kwenye Haki na kwenye Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.

arabic_text: يَٰقَوْمَنَآ أَجِيبُوا۟ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Enyi kaumu yetu! Muitikieni Mwenye kuitia kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, na muaminini, Mwenyezi Mungu atakusameheni, na atakukingeni na adhabu chungu.
translation_en: O our people, respond to the Messenger of Allah and believe in him; Allah will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.

arabic_text: وَمَن لَّا يُجِبْ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءُ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
translation_sw: Na wasio mwitikia Mwitaji wa Mwenyezi Mungu basi hao hawatashinda katika ardhi, wala hawatakuwa na walinzi mbele yake. Hao wamo katika upotovu ulio dhaahiri.
translation_en: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allah will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error."

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْىَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۚ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Je! Hawaoni ya kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu, aliye ziumba mbingu na ardhi, na hakuchoka kwa kuziumba, kuwa ni Muweza wa kuwafufua wafu? Kwani? Hakika Yeye ni Muweza wa kila kitu.
translation_en: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.

arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا ۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
translation_sw: Na siku watakapo letwa makafiri Motoni wakaambiwa: Je! Haya si kweli? Watasema: Kwani? Tunaapa kwa Mola wetu Mlezi, ni kweli! Atasema: Basi onjeni adhabu kwa sababu ya kule kukataa kwenu.
translation_en: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve."

arabic_text: فَٱصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعَزْمِ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِل لَّهُمْ ۚ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا سَاعَةًۭ مِّن نَّهَارٍۭ ۚ بَلَٰغٌۭ ۚ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
translation_sw: Basi subiri, kama walivyo subiri Mitume wenye stahmala kubwa, wala usiwafanyie haraka. Siku watakayo yaona waliyo ahidiwa itakuwa kama kwamba hawakukaa ulimwenguni ila saa moja ya mchana. Huu ndio ufikisho! Kwani huangamizwa wengine isipo kuwa walio waovu tu?
translation_en: So be patient, [O Muhammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
translation_sw: Walio kufuru na wakazuilia njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu, Yeye atavipotoa vitendo vyao.
translation_en: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَءَامَنُوا۟ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍۢ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۙ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ
translation_sw: Na walio amini, na wakatenda mema, na wakaamini aliyo teremshiwa Muhammad - nayo ni Haki iliyo toka kwa Mola wao Mlezi - atawafutia makosa yao na ataitengeneza hali yao.
translation_en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa sababu walio kufuru wamefuata upotovu, na walio amini wamefuata Haki iliyo toka kwa Mola wao Mlezi. Hivyo ndivyo Mwenyezi Mungu anavyo wapigia watu mifano yao.
translation_en: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allah present to the people their comparisons.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَضَرْبَ ٱلرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَثْخَنتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوا۟ ٱلْوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّۢا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ ٱلْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَٱنتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَا۟ بَعْضَكُم بِبَعْضٍۢ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
translation_sw: Basi mnapo wakuta walio kufuru wapigeni shingoni mwao, mpaka mkiwadhoofisha wafungeni pingu. Tena waachilieni kwa hisani au wajikomboe, mpaka vita vipoe. Ndio hivyo. Na lau angeli taka Mwenyezi Mungu angeli washinda mwenyewe, lakini haya ni kwa sababu akutieni mitihani nyinyi kwa nyinyi. Na walio uliwa katika njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu hatazipoteza a'mali zao.
translation_en: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure their bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allah - never will He waste their deeds.

arabic_text: سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ
translation_sw: Atawaongoza na awatengezee hali yao.
translation_en: He will guide them and amend their condition

arabic_text: وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ
translation_sw: Na atawaingiza katika Pepo aliyo wajuulisha.
translation_en: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَنصُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Mkimnusuru Mwenyezi Mungu naye atakunusuruni na ataithibitisha miguu yenu.
translation_en: O you who have believed, if you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَتَعْسًۭا لَّهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru, basi kwao ni maangamizo, na atavipoteza vitendo vyao.
translation_en: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa sababu waliyachukia aliyo yateremsha Mwenyezi Mungu, basi akaviangusha vitendo vyao.
translation_en: That is because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

arabic_text: ۞ أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ دَمَّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْثَٰلُهَا
translation_sw: Kwani hawakutembea katika ardhi wakaona ulikuwaje mwisho wa walio kuwa kabla yao? Mwenyezi Mungu aliwaangamiza, na kwa makafiri hawa itakuwa mfano wa hayo.
translation_en: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَأَنَّ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa sababu Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mlinzi wa walio amini. Na makafiri hawana mlinzi.
translation_en: That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمُ وَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًۭى لَّهُمْ
translation_sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu atawaingiza walio amini na wakatenda mema katika Bustani zipitiwazo na mito kati yake. Na walio kufuru hujifurahisha na hula kama walavyo wanyama, na Moto ndio makaazi yao.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.

arabic_text: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ هِىَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةًۭ مِّن قَرْيَتِكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَخْرَجَتْكَ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ
translation_sw: Na miji mingapi iliyo kuwa na nguvu zaidi kuliko mji wako huu ulio kutoa; nao tuliwateketeza na wala hawakuwa wa kuwanusuru.
translation_en: And how many a city was stronger than your city [Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.

arabic_text: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم
translation_sw: Je! Mwenye kuwa na bayana kutoka kwa Mola wake Mlezi ni kama aliye pambiwa uovu wa vitendo vyake, na wakafuata pumbao lao?
translation_en: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?

arabic_text: مَّثَلُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ فِيهَآ أَنْهَٰرٌۭ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيْرِ ءَاسِنٍۢ وَأَنْهَٰرٌۭ مِّن لَّبَنٍۢ لَّمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُۥ وَأَنْهَٰرٌۭ مِّنْ خَمْرٍۢ لَّذَّةٍۢ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ وَأَنْهَٰرٌۭ مِّنْ عَسَلٍۢ مُّصَفًّۭى ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَٰلِدٌۭ فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُوا۟ مَآءً حَمِيمًۭا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَآءَهُمْ
translation_sw: Mfano wa Pepo walio ahidiwa wachamngu ina mito ya maji yasiyo vunda, na mito ya maziwa isiyo haribika ladha yake, na mito ya mvinyo yenye ladha kwa wanywao, na mito ya asali iliyo safishwa. Na wao humo watakuwa na kila namna ya matunda, na maghfira kutoka kwa Mola wao Mlezi. Basi hao ni kama watakao dumu Motoni na wakinyweshwa maji yanayo chemka ya kuwakata matumbo yao?
translation_en: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?

arabic_text: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُوا۟ مِنْ عِندِكَ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ
translation_sw: Na wapo miongoni mwao wanao kusikiliza, mpaka wakiondoka kwako huwauliza walio pewa ilimu: Amesema nini sasa hivi? Hao ndio ambao Mwenyezi Mungu amepiga muhuri juu ya nyoyo zao, na wakafuata pumbao lao.
translation_en: And among them, [O Muhammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allah has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ زَادَهُمْ هُدًۭى وَءَاتَىٰهُمْ تَقْوَىٰهُمْ
translation_sw: Na wale walio ongoka anawazidishia uongofu na anawapa uchamngu wao.
translation_en: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.

arabic_text: فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا ۚ فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمْ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَىٰهُمْ
translation_sw: Kwani wanangojea jengine isipo kuwa iwafikie Saa (ya Kiyama) kwa ghafla? Na hakika alama zake zimekwisha kuja. Na itapo wajia kutawafaa wapi kukumbuka hapo?
translation_en: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then what good to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?

arabic_text: فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَىٰكُمْ
translation_sw: Basi jua ya kwamba hapana mungu ila Mwenyezi Mungu, na omba maghufira kwa dhambi zako na za Waumini wanaume na Waumini wanawake. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anajua mahali penu pa kwenda na kurudi, na mahali penu pa kukaa.
translation_en: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows of your movement and your resting place.

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌۭ ۖ فَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌۭ مُّحْكَمَةٌۭ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا ٱلْقِتَالُ ۙ رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ ٱلْمَغْشِىِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ فَأَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ
translation_sw: Na Waumini wanasema: Kwa nini haiteremshwi Sura? Na inapo teremshwa Sura madhubuti na ikatajwa ndani yake khabari ya vita, utawaona wenye maradhi katika nyoyo zao wanakutazama mtazamo wa anaye zimia kwa mauti. Basi ni bora kwao
translation_en: Those who believe say, "Why has a surah not been sent down? But when a precise surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]

arabic_text: طَاعَةٌۭ وَقَوْلٌۭ مَّعْرُوفٌۭ ۚ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ ٱلْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًۭا لَّهُمْ
translation_sw: Ut'iifu na kauli njema. Na jambo likisha azimiwa, basi wakiwa ni wakweli kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, bila ya shaka itakuwa ni kheri kwao.
translation_en: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them.

arabic_text: فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَن تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوٓا۟ أَرْحَامَكُمْ
translation_sw: Basi yanayo tarajiwa kwenu mkitawala ndio mfisidi katika nchi na mwatupe jamaa zenu?
translation_en: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَىٰٓ أَبْصَٰرَهُمْ
translation_sw: Hao ndio Mwenyezi Mungu alio walaani, na akawatia uziwi, na akawapofoa macho yao.
translation_en: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allah has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.

arabic_text: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ أَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَآ
translation_sw: Je! Hawaizingatii hii Qur'ani? Au kwenye nyoyo (zao) zipo kufuli?
translation_en: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَٰرِهِم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَى ۙ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ وَأَمْلَىٰ لَهُمْ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika wanao rudi nyuma baada ya kwisha wabainikia uwongofu, Shetani huyo amewashawishi na amewaghuri.
translation_en: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُوا۟ مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمْ فِى بَعْضِ ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِسْرَارَهُمْ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa sababu waliwaambia walio chukia aliyo yateremsha Mwenyezi Mungu: Tutakut'iini katika baadhi ya mambo. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anajua siri zao.
translation_en: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allah sent down, "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allah knows what they conceal.

arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَٰرَهُمْ
translation_sw: Basi itakuwaje Malaika watakapo wafisha wakawa wanawapiga nyuso zao na migongo yao!
translation_en: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَآ أَسْخَطَ ٱللَّهَ وَكَرِهُوا۟ رِضْوَٰنَهُۥ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa sababu wao waliyafuata yaliyo mchukiza Mwenyezi Mungu na wakachukia yanayo mridhisha, basi akaviangusha vitendo vyao.
translation_en: That is because they followed what angered Allah and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

arabic_text: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخْرِجَ ٱللَّهُ أَضْغَٰنَهُمْ
translation_sw: Je! Wenye maradhi nyoyoni mwao wanadhani kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu hatazidhihirisha chuki zao?
translation_en: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?

arabic_text: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَأَرَيْنَٰكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُم بِسِيمَٰهُمْ ۚ وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِى لَحْنِ ٱلْقَوْلِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَعْمَٰلَكُمْ
translation_sw: Na tungeli penda tungeli kuonyesha hao na ungeli watambua kwa alama zao; lakini bila ya shaka utawajua kwa namna ya msemo wao. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anavijua vitendo vyenu.
translation_en: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allah knows your deeds.

arabic_text: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَعْلَمَ ٱلْمُجَٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَا۟ أَخْبَارَكُمْ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka tutakujaribuni mpaka tuwadhihirishe wapignao Jihadi katika nyinyi na wanao subiri. Nasi tutazifanyia mtihani khabari zenu.
translation_en: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allah] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَشَآقُّوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ لَن يَضُرُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika walio kufuru na wakazuilia njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu na wakapinzana na Mtume baada ya kwisha wabainikia uwongofu, hao hawatamdhuru Mwenyezi Mungu kwa lolote. Naye ataviangusha vitendo vyao.
translation_en: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allah at all, and He will render worthless their deeds.

arabic_text: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبْطِلُوٓا۟ أَعْمَٰلَكُمْ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Mt'iini Mwenyezi Mungu, na mt'iini Mtume, wala msiviharibu vitendo vyenu.
translation_en: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌۭ فَلَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ
translation_sw: Hakika walio kufuru na wakazuilia njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu, kisha wakafa na hali ni makafiri, Mwenyezi Mungu hatawasamehe makosa yao.
translation_en: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allah forgive them.

arabic_text: فَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَتَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّلْمِ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلَكُمْ
translation_sw: Basi msiregee na kutaka suluhu, maana nyinyi ndio mtakao shinda. Na Mwenyezi Mungu yu pamoja nanyi, wala hatakunyimeni malipo ya vitendo vyenu.
translation_en: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allah is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهْوٌۭ ۚ وَإِن تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمْ أُجُورَكُمْ وَلَا يَسْـَٔلْكُمْ أَمْوَٰلَكُمْ
translation_sw: Hakika uhai wa duniani ni mchezo na pumbao. Na mkiamini na mkamchamngu Mwenyezi Mungu atakupeni ujira wenu, wala hakutakeni mali yenu.
translation_en: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allah, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.

arabic_text: إِن يَسْـَٔلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوا۟ وَيُخْرِجْ أَضْغَٰنَكُمْ
translation_sw: Na akikutakeni hayo na kukushikilieni mtafanya ubakhili, na atatoa undani wa chuki zenu.
translation_en: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your unwillingness.

arabic_text: هَٰٓأَنتُمْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبْخَلُ ۖ وَمَن يَبْخَلْ فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلْغَنِىُّ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ ۚ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوٓا۟ أَمْثَٰلَكُم
translation_sw: Angalieni! Nyinyi mnaitwa mtumie katika njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu, na wapo katika nyinyi wanao fanya ubakhili. Na anaye fanya ubakhili basi anajifanyia ubakhili mwenyewe. Na Mwenyezi Mungu si mhitaji, na nyinyi ndio wahitaji. Na mkigeuka atawaleta watu wengine badala yenu, nao hawatakuwa kama nyinyi.
translation_en: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allah - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allah is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.

arabic_text: إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًۭا مُّبِينًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika tumekufungulia Ushindi wa dhaahiri
translation_en: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muhammad], a clear conquest

arabic_text: لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَٰطًۭا مُّسْتَقِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Ili Mwenyezi Mungu akusamehe makosa yako yaliyo tangulia na yajayo, na akutimizie neema zake, na akuongoe katika Njia Iliyo Nyooka,
translation_en: That Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path

arabic_text: وَيَنصُرَكَ ٱللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu akunusuru nusura yenye nguvu -
translation_en: And [that] Allah may aid you with a mighty victory.

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمْ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye aliye teremsha utulivu katika nyoyo za Waumini ili wazidi Imani juu ya Imani yao. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye mwenye majeshi ya mbingu na ardhi. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye ujuzi, Mwenye hikima -
translation_en: It is He who sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allah Knowing and Wise.

arabic_text: لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Ili awaingize Waumini wanaume na Waumini wanawake katika Bustani zipitazo mito kati yake, wadumu humo, na awafutie makosa yao. Na huko ndiko kufuzu kukubwa mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: [And] that He may admit the believing men and the believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein eternally and remove from them their misdeeds - and ever is that, in the sight of Allah, a great attainment -

arabic_text: وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۖ وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَسَآءَتْ مَصِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na awape adhabu wanaafiki wanaume na wanaafiki wanawake, na washirikina wanaume na washirikina wanawake, wanao mdhania Mwenyezi Mungu dhana mbaya. Utawafikia mgeuko mbaya, na Mwenyezi Mungu awakasirikie, na awalaani, na awaandalie Jahannamu. Na hayo ni marudio maovu kabisa.
translation_en: And [that] He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women - those who assume about Allah an assumption of evil nature. Upon them is a misfortune of evil nature; and Allah has become angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell, and evil it is as a destination.

arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu ana majeshi ya mbingu na ardhi. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ شَٰهِدًۭا وَمُبَشِّرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika tumekutuma wewe uwe Shahidi, na Mbashiri, na Mwonyaji,
translation_en: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

arabic_text: لِّتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًا
translation_sw: Ili mumuamini Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake, na mumsaidie, na mumhishimu, na mumtakase asubuhi na jioni.
translation_en: That you [people] may believe in Allah and His Messenger and honor him and respect the Prophet and exalt Allah morning and afternoon.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ عَلَيْهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Bila ya shaka wanao fungamana nawe, kwa hakika wanafungamana na Mwenyezi Mungu. Mkono wa Mwenyezi Mungu uko juu ya mikono yao. Basi avunjaye ahadi hizi anavunja kwa kuidhuru nafsi yake; na anaye tekeleza aliyo muahadi Mwenyezi Mungu, Mwenyezi Mungu atamlipa ujira mkubwa.
translation_en: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muhammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to Allah. The hand of Allah is over their hands. So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised Allah - He will give him a great reward.

arabic_text: سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَآ أَمْوَٰلُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًۢا ۚ بَلْ كَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًۢا
translation_sw: Watakuambia mabedui walio baki nyuma: Yametushughulisha mali yetu na ahali zetu, basi tuombee msamaha. Wanasema kwa ndimi zao yasiyo kuwamo katika nyoyo zao. Sema: Ni nani awezaye kukusaidieni chochote kwa Mwenyezi Mungu akitaka Yeye kukudhuruni au akitaka kukunufaisheni? Bali Mwenyezi Mungu anazo khabari za mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: Those who remained behind of the bedouins will say to you, "Our properties and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us." They say with their tongues what is not within their hearts. Say, "Then who could prevent Allah at all if He intended for you harm or intended for you benefit? Rather, ever is Allah, with what you do, Acquainted.

arabic_text: بَلْ ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًۭا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنتُمْ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۢا بُورًۭا
translation_sw: Lakini mlidhani kwamba Mtume na Waumini hawatarudi kabisa kwa ahali zao, na mkapambiwa hayo katika nyoyo zenu, na mkadhania dhana mbaya, na mkawa watu wanao angamia.
translation_en: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, ever, and that was made pleasing in your hearts. And you assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined."

arabic_text: وَمَن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ فَإِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَعِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na asiye muamini Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake, basi kwa hakika Sisi tumewaandalia makafiri Moto mkali.
translation_en: And whoever has not believed in Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blaze.

arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye mwenye ufalme wa mbingu na ardhi. Humsamehe amtakaye, na humuadhibu amtakaye. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: سَيَقُولُ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ ۖ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُوا۟ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Walio baki nyuma watasema: Mtapo kwenda kuchukua ngawira, tuacheni tukufuateni! Wanataka kuyabadili maneno ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Sema: Hamtatufuata kabisa. Mwenyezi Mungu alikwisha sema kama hivi zamani. Hapo watasema: Bali nyinyi mnatuhusudu. Siyo, bali walikuwa hawafahamu ila kidogo.
translation_en: Those who remained behind will say when you set out toward the war booty to take it, "Let us follow you." They wish to change the words of Allah. Say, "Never will you follow us. Thus did Allah say before." So they will say, "Rather, you envy us." But [in fact] they were not understanding except a little.

arabic_text: قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ تُقَٰتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ ۖ فَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا ۖ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Waambie walio achwa nyuma katika mabedui: Mtakuja itwa kwenda pigana na watu wakali kwa vita, mpigane nao au wasalimu amri. Basi mkimt'ii, Mwenyezi Mungu atakupeni ujira mzuri. Na mkigeuka kama mlivyo geuka kwanza, atakuadhibuni kwa adhabu iliyo chungu.
translation_en: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allah will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."

arabic_text: لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌۭ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Kipofu hana lawama, wala kiguru hana lawama, wala mgonjwa hana lawama. Na mwenye kumt'ii Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake, atamuingiza katika Mabustani yapitayo mito kati yake. Na atakaye geuka upande atamuadhibu kwa adhabu chungu.
translation_en: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.

arabic_text: ۞ لَّقَدْ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَٰبَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًۭا
translation_sw: Kwa hakika Mwenyezi Mungu amewapa radhi Waumini walipo fungamana nawe chini ya mti, na alijua yaliyomo nyoyoni mwao. Basi akateremsha utulivu juu yao, na akawalipa kwa Ushindi wa karibu.
translation_en: Certainly was Allah pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muhammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquillity upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest

arabic_text: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةًۭ يَأْخُذُونَهَا ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Na ngawira nyingi watakazo zichukua. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise.

arabic_text: وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةًۭ تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِىَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَٰطًۭا مُّسْتَقِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu anakuahidini ngawira nyingi mtakazo zichukua, basi amekutangulizieni hizi kwanza, na akaizuia mikono ya watu isikufikieni, na ili hayo yawe ni Ishara kwa Waumini, na akakuongozeni Njia Iliyo Nyooka.
translation_en: Allah has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.

arabic_text: وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na mengine hamwezi kuyapata bado, Mwenyezi Mungu amekwisha yazingia. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Muweza wa kila kitu.
translation_en: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which Allah has already encompassed. And ever is Allah, over all things, competent.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ قَٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوَلَّوُا۟ ٱلْأَدْبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّۭا وَلَا نَصِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na lau makafiri wangeli pigana nanyi basi bila ya shaka wangeli geuza migongo, kisha wasingeli pata mlinzi wala msaidizi.
translation_en: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.

arabic_text: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Huo ndio mwendo wa Mwenyezi Mungu ulio kwisha pita zamani, wala hutapata mabadiliko katika mwendo wa Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: [This is] the established way of Allah which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allah any change.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
translation_sw: Na Yeye ndiye aliyeizuia mikono yao kwenu, na mikono yenu kwao, katika bonde la Makka baada ya kukupeni Ushindi juu yao. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kuyaona myatendayo.
translation_en: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allah of what you do, Seeing.

arabic_text: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْهَدْىَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌۭ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌۭ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٌۭ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌۢ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا۟ لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
translation_sw: Hao ndio walio kufuru na wakakuzuieni msiingie Msikiti Mtakatifu, na wakawazuilia dhabihu kufika mahala pao. Na lau si wanaume Waumini na wanawake Waumini msio wajua mkawasaga na mkaingia makosani kutokana nao bila ya kujua... Mwenyezi Mungu (amefanya haya) ili amuingize amtakaye katika rehema yake. Lau wangeli tengana bila ya shaka tungeli waadhibu walio kufuru kwa adhabu chungu.
translation_en: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allah might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment

arabic_text: إِذْ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Pale walio kufuru walipo tia katika nyoyo zao hasira, hasira za kijinga, Mwenyezi Mungu aliteremsha utulivu juu ya Mtume wake na juu ya Waumini, na akawalazimisha neno la kuchamngu. Na wao walikuwa ndio wenye haki nalo na wenye kustahili. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mjuzi wa kila kitu.
translation_en: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allah sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allah, of all things, Knowing.

arabic_text: لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا۟ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًا
translation_sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu amemtimizia Mtume wake ndoto ya haki. Bila ya shaka nyinyi mtauingia Msikiti Mtakatifu, Inshallah, kwa amani, na hali mmenyoa vichwa vyenu na mmepunguza nywele. Hamtakuwa na khofu. Yeye anajua msiyo yajua. Basi atakupeni kabla ya haya Ushindi karibuni.
translation_en: Certainly has Allah showed to His Messenger the vision in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Haram, if Allah wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۭا
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye aliye mtuma Mtume wake kwa uwongofu na Dini ya Haki, ili aitukuze juu ya dini zote. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anatosha kuwa Shahidi.
translation_en: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allah as Witness.

arabic_text: مُّحَمَّدٌۭ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًۭا سُجَّدًۭا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًۭا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةًۭ وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًۢا
translation_sw: Muhammad ni Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu. Na walio pamoja naye wana nguvu mbele ya makafiri, na wanahurumiana wao kwa wao. Utawaona wakiinama na kusujudu wakitafuta fadhila na radhi za Mwenyezi Mungu. Alama zao zi katika nyuso zao, kwa athari ya kusujudu. Huu ndio mfano wao katika Taurati. Na mfano wao katika Injili ni kama mmea ulio toa chipukizi lake, kisha ukalitia nguvu, ukawa mnene, ukasimama sawa juu ya ubuwa wake, ukawafurahisha wakulima, ili kuwakasirisha kwa ajili yao makafiri. Mwenyezi Mungu amewaahidi walio amini na wakatenda mema katika wao msamaha na ujira mkubwa.
translation_en: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allah and [His] pleasure. Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that Allah may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Msitangulie mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake, na mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusikia, Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allah and His Messenger but fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَرْفَعُوٓا۟ أَصْوَٰتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا۟ لَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Msinyanyue sauti zenu kuliko sauti ya Nabii, wala msiseme naye kwa kelele kama mnavyo semezana nyinyi kwa nyinyi, visije vitendo vyenu vikaharibika, na hali hamtambui.
translation_en: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمْتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika wanao teremsha sauti zao mbele ya Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu, hao ndio Mwenyezi Mungu amezisafisha nyoyo zao kwa uchamngu. Hao watakuwa na maghfira na ujira mkubwa.
translation_en: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah - they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika hao wanao kuita nawe uko nyuma ya vyumba, wengi wao hawana akili.
translation_en: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muhammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًۭا لَّهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Na lau wao wangeli ngojea mpaka uwatokee ingeli kuwa kheri kwao. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye maghfira, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍۢ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍۢ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَٰدِمِينَ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Akikujieni mpotovu na khabari yoyote, ichunguzeni, msije mkawasibu watu kwa kuto jua, na mkawa tena wenye kujuta kwa mliyo yatenda.
translation_en: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.

arabic_text: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَٱلْفُسُوقَ وَٱلْعِصْيَانَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ
translation_sw: Na jueni kuwa Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu yuko nanyi. Lau angeli kut'iini katika mambo mengi, bila ya shaka mngeli taabika. Lakini Mwenyezi Mungu amekupendezeeni Imani, na akaipamba katika nyoyo zenu, na amekufanyeni muuchukie ukafiri, na upotovu, na uasi. Hao ndio walio ongoka,
translation_en: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allah. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allah has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.

arabic_text: فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةًۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Kwa fadhila za Mwenyezi Mungu na neema zake. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kujua, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: [It is] as bounty from Allah and favor. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.

arabic_text: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن فَآءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
translation_sw: Na ikiwa makundi mawili katika Waumini yanapigana, basi yapatanisheni. Na likiwa moja la hao linamdhulumu mwenzie, basi lipigeni linalo dhulumu mpaka lirejee kwenye amri ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na likirudi basi yapatanisheni kwa uadilifu. Na hukumuni kwa haki. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anawapenda wanao hukumu kwa haki.
translation_en: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌۭ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Waumini ni ndugu, basi patanisheni baina ya ndugu zenu, na mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu ili mrehemewe.
translation_en: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allah that you may receive mercy.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌۭ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌۭ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُنَّ ۖ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَٰبِ ۖ بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Wanaume wasiwadharau wanaume wenzao, wala wanawake wasiwadharau wanawake wenzao. Huenda hao wakawa bora kuliko wao. Wala msivunjiane hishima, wala msiitane kwa majina ya kejeli. Ni uovu kutumia jina baya baada ya kwisha amini. Na wasio tubu, hao ndio wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌۭ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًۭا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Jiepusheni na dhana nyingi, kwani baadhi ya dhana ni dhambi. Wala msipelelezane, wala msisengenyane nyinyi kwa nyinyi. Je! Yupo katika nyinyi anaye penda kuila nyama ya nduguye aliye kufa? Mnalichukia hilo! Na mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kupokea toba, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is Accepting of repentance and Merciful.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍۢ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ شُعُوبًۭا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Enyi watu! Hakika Sisi tumekuumbeni kutokana na mwanamume na mwanamke. Na tumekujaalieni kuwa ni mataifa na makabila ili mjuane. Hakika aliye mtukufu zaidi kati yenu kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ni huyo aliye mchamngu zaidi katika nyinyi. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kujua, Mwenye khabari.
translation_en: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Acquainted.

arabic_text: ۞ قَالَتِ ٱلْأَعْرَابُ ءَامَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓا۟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَٰلِكُمْ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
translation_sw: Mabedui wamesema: Tumeamini. Sema: Hamjaamini, lakini semeni: Tumesilimu. Kwani Imani haijaingia katika nyoyo zenu. Na mkimt'ii Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake, hatakupunguzieni chochote katika vitendo vyenu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Waumini ni wale walio muamini Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake tena wasitie shaka kabisa, na wakapigana Jihadi katika Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu kwa mali yao na nafsi zao. Hao ndio wakweli.
translation_en: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allah and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allah. It is those who are the truthful.

arabic_text: قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Sema: Ati ndio mnamfundisha Mwenyezi Mungu Dini yenu, na hali Mwenyezi Mungu anayajua ya katika mbingu na ardhi, na Mwenyezi Mungu anajua kila kitu?
translation_en: Say, "Would you acquaint Allah with your religion while Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah is Knowing of all things?"

arabic_text: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ ۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا۟ عَلَىَّ إِسْلَٰمَكُم ۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Wanakusimbulia kuwa wamesilimu! Sema: Msinisimbulie kwa kusilimu kwenu. Bali Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye aliye kufanyieni hisani kwa kukuongoeni kwenye Imani, ikiwa nyinyi ni wakweli.
translation_en: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islam. Say, "Do not consider your Islam a favor to me. Rather, Allah has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anajua siri za mbingu na ardhi. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anayaona myatendayo.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.

arabic_text: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
translation_sw: Qaaf. Naapa kwa Qur'ani tukufu!
translation_en: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an...

arabic_text: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
translation_sw: Bali wanastaajabu kwamba amewafikia mwonyaji kutoka miongoni mwao, na wakasema makafiri: Hili ni jambo la ajabu!
translation_en: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.

arabic_text: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Ati tukifa na tukawa udongo...? Kurejea huko kuko mbali!
translation_en: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."

arabic_text: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tunajua kiasi cha kila kinacho punguzwa na ardhi kutokana nao. Na kwetu kipo Kitabu kinacho hifadhi yote.
translation_en: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

arabic_text: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ
translation_sw: Lakini waliikanusha Haki ilipo wajia; kwa hivyo wamo katika mambo ya mkorogo.
translation_en: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

arabic_text: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ
translation_sw: Je! Hawaangalii mbingu zilizo juu yao! Vipi tulivyo zijenga, na tukazipamba. Wala hazina nyufa.
translation_en: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?

arabic_text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ
translation_sw: Na ardhi tumeitandaza na tukaiwekea milima, na tukaiotesha mimea mizuri ya kila namna.
translation_en: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,

arabic_text: تَبْصِرَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ
translation_sw: Yawe haya ni kifumbua macho na ukumbusho kwa kila mja mwenye kuelekea.
translation_en: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah].

arabic_text: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
translation_sw: Na tumeteremsha kutoka mbinguni maji yaliyo barikiwa, na kwa hayo tukaotesha mabustani na nafaka za kuvunwa.
translation_en: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest

arabic_text: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلْعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Na mitende mirefu yenye makole yaliyo zaa kwa wingi,
translation_en: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -

arabic_text: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
translation_sw: Ili iwe ni riziki kwa waja wangu. Na tukaifufua kwa maji nchi iliyo kuwa imekufa. Kama hivyo ndivyo utakavyo kuwa ufufuaji.
translation_en: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.

arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
translation_sw: Kabla yao walikadhibisha kaumu ya Nuhu na wakaazi wa Rassi na Thamudi.
translation_en: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud

arabic_text: وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍۢ
translation_sw: Na A'di na Firauni na kaumu ya Lut'i.
translation_en: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot

arabic_text: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
translation_sw: Na wakaazi wa Machakani, na watu wa Tubbaa'. Wote hao waliwakanusha Mitume, kwa hivyo onyo likathibitika juu yao.
translation_en: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.

arabic_text: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwani tulichoka kwa kuumba mara ya kwanza. Bali wao wamo katika shaka tu juu ya umbo jipya.
translation_en: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
translation_sw: Na hakika tumemuumba mtu, nasi tunayajua yanayo mpitikia katika nafsi yake. Na Sisi tuko karibu naye kuliko mshipa wa shingoni mwake.
translation_en: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein

arabic_text: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Wanapo pokea wapokeaji wawili, wanao kaa kuliani na kushotoni.
translation_en: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.

arabic_text: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Hatamki neno ila karibu yake yupo mwangalizi tayari.
translation_en: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].

arabic_text: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
translation_sw: Na uchungu wa kutoka roho utamjia kwa haki. Hayo ndiyo uliyo kuwa ukiyakimbia.
translation_en: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.

arabic_text: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
translation_sw: Na litapulizwa baragumu. Hiyo ndiyo Siku ya Miadi.
translation_en: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.

arabic_text: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Na kila nafsi itakuja na pamoja nayo mchungaji na shahidi.
translation_en: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.

arabic_text: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: (Aambiwe): Kwa hakika ulikuwa umeghafilika na haya; basi leo tumekuondolea pazia lako, na kwa hivyo kuona kwako leo ni kukali.
translation_en: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."

arabic_text: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
translation_sw: Na mwenzake atasema: Huyu niliye naye mimi kesha tayarishwa.
translation_en: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."

arabic_text: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Mtupeni katika Jahannamu kila kafiri mwenye inda,
translation_en: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,

arabic_text: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ
translation_sw: Akatazaye kheri, arukaye mipaka, mwenye kutia shaka,
translation_en: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
translation_sw: Aliye weka mungu mwengine pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu. Basi mtupeni katika adhabu kali.
translation_en: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."

arabic_text: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Mwenzake aseme: Ee Mola wetu Mlezi! Sikumpoteza mimi, bali yeye mwenyewe alikuwa katika upotovu wa mbali.
translation_en: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."

arabic_text: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
translation_sw: (Mwenyezi Mungu) aseme: Msigombane mbele yangu. Nilikuleteeni mbele onyo langu.
translation_en: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.

arabic_text: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
translation_sw: Mbele yangu haibadilishwi kauli, wala Mimi siwadhulumu waja wangu.
translation_en: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."

arabic_text: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ
translation_sw: Siku tutapo iambia Jahannamu: Je! Umejaa? Nayo itasema: Je! Kuna ziada?
translation_en: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"

arabic_text: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
translation_sw: Na Pepo italetwa karibu kwa ajili ya wachamngu, haitakuwa mbali.
translation_en: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,

arabic_text: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ
translation_sw: Haya ndiyo mnayo ahidiwa kwa kila mwenye kurejea kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na akajilinda.
translation_en: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]

arabic_text: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ
translation_sw: Mwenye kumwogopa Mwingi wa Rehema hali kuwa hamwoni, na akaja kwa moyo ulio elekea-
translation_en: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].

arabic_text: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
translation_sw: (Ataambiwa) ingieni kwa salama. Hiyo ndiyo siku ya daima dawamu.
translation_en: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."

arabic_text: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Humo watapata wakitakacho, na kwetu yako ya ziada.
translation_en: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.

arabic_text: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
translation_sw: Na kaumu ngapi tuliziangamiza kabla yao walio kuwa na nguvu zaidi kuliko hawa! Nao walitanga tanga katika nchi nyingi. Je! Walipata pa kukimbilia?
translation_en: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika katika hayo upo ukumbusho kwa mwenye moyo au akatega sikio naye yupo anashuhudia.
translation_en: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka Sisi tumeziumba mbingu na ardhi na vilio baina yao mnamo siku sita; na wala hayakutugusa machofu.
translation_en: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

arabic_text: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
translation_sw: Basi vumilia kwa hayo wasemayo, na mtakase kwa kumsifu Mola wako Mlezi kabla ya kuchomoza jua na kabla ya kuchwa.
translation_en: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,

arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
translation_sw: Na katika usiku pia mtakase, na baada ya kusujudu.
translation_en: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.

arabic_text: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
translation_sw: Na sikiliza siku atapo nadi mwenye kunadi kutoka pahala karibu.
translation_en: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
translation_sw: Siku watakapo sikia ukelele wa haki. Hiyo ndiyo siku ya kufufuka.
translation_en: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

arabic_text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
