translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tunahuisha na tunafisha, na kwetu Sisi ndio marejeo.
translation_en: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Siku itapo wapasukia ardhi mbio mbio! Mkusanyo huo kwetu ni mwepesi.
translation_en: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.

arabic_text: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
translation_sw: Sisi tunajua kabisa wayasemayo. Wala wewe si mwenye kuwatawalia kwa ujabari. Basi mkumbushe kwa Qur'ani anaye liogopa onyo.
translation_en: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.

arabic_text: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا
translation_sw: Naapa kwa pepo zinazo tawanya,
translation_en: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing

arabic_text: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا
translation_sw: Na zinazo beba mizigo,
translation_en: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

arabic_text: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا
translation_sw: Na zinazo kwenda kwa wepesi.
translation_en: And those [ships] sailing with ease

arabic_text: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_sw: Na zinazo gawanya kwa amri,
translation_en: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika mnayo ahidiwa bila ya shaka ni kweli,
translation_en: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika malipo bila ya shaka yatatokea.
translation_en: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa mbingu zenye njia,
translation_en: By the heaven containing pathways,

arabic_text: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika nyinyi bila ya shaka mmo katika kauli inayo khitalifiana.
translation_en: Indeed, you are in differing speech.

arabic_text: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
translation_sw: Anageuzwa kutokana na haki mwenye kugeuzwa.
translation_en: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.

arabic_text: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
translation_sw: Wazushi wameangamizwa.
translation_en: Destroyed are the falsifiers

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao wameghafilika katika ujinga.
translation_en: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

arabic_text: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Wanauliza: Ni lini hiyo siku ya malipo?
translation_en: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

arabic_text: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
translation_sw: Hiyo ni siku watakayo adhibiwa Motoni.
translation_en: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

arabic_text: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_sw: Onjeni adhabu yenu! Haya ndiyo mliyo kuwa mkiyahimiza.
translation_en: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_sw: Hakika wachamngu watakuwa katika Mabustani na chemchem.
translation_en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

arabic_text: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Wanapokea aliyo wapa Mola wao Mlezi. Kwa hakika hao walikuwa kabla ya haya wakifanya mema.
translation_en: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

arabic_text: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
translation_sw: Walikuwa wakilala kidogo tu usiku.
translation_en: They used to sleep but little of the night,

arabic_text: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na kabla ya alfajiri wakiomba maghfira.
translation_en: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

arabic_text: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_sw: Na katika mali yao ipo haki ya mwenye kuomba na asiye omba.
translation_en: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

arabic_text: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na katika ardhi zipo Ishara kwa wenye yakini.
translation_en: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

arabic_text: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na pia katika nafsi zenu - Je! Hamwoni?
translation_en: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

arabic_text: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Na katika mbingu ziko riziki zenu na mliyo ahidiwa.
translation_en: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

arabic_text: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
translation_sw: Basi naapa kwa Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na ardhi, hakika haya ni kweli kama ilivyo kweli kuwa nyinyi mnasema.
translation_en: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

arabic_text: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
translation_sw: Je! Imekufikia hadithi ya wageni wa Ibrahim wanao hishimiwa?
translation_en: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -

arabic_text: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation_sw: Walipo ingia kwake wakasema: Salama! Na yeye akasema: Salama! Nyinyi ni watu nisio kujueni.
translation_en: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.

arabic_text: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Akenda kwa ahali yake na akaja na ndama aliye nona.
translation_en: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf

arabic_text: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_sw: Akawakaribisha, akasema: Mbona hamli?
translation_en: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

arabic_text: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Akahisi kuwaogopa katika nafsi yake. Wakasema: Usiwe na khofu, nao wakambashiria kupata kijana mwenye ilimu.
translation_en: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

arabic_text: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Ndipo mkewe akawaelekea, na huku anasema na akijipiga usoni kwa mastaajabu, na kusema: Mimi ni kikongwe na tasa!
translation_en: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ndivyo vivyo hivyo alivyo sema Mola wako Mlezi. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye hikima na Mwenye kujua.
translation_en: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

arabic_text: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_sw: AKASEMA: Basi ujumbe wenu ni nini, enyi mlio tumwa?
translation_en: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Hakika sisi tumetumwa kwa watu wakosefu,
translation_en: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals

arabic_text: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Tuwatupie mawe ya udongo,
translation_en: To send down upon them stones of clay,

arabic_text: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_sw: Yaliyo tiwa alama kutoka kwa Mola wako Mlezi kwa ajili ya wanao pindukia mipaka.
translation_en: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

arabic_text: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Kwa hivyo tutawatoa katika hao wale walio amini.
translation_en: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.

arabic_text: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Lakini hatukupata humo ila nyumba moja tu yenye Waislamu!
translation_en: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.

arabic_text: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_sw: Na tukaacha humo Ishara kwa ajili ya wanao iogopa adhabu chungu.
translation_en: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

arabic_text: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Na katika khabari za Musa, tulipo mtuma kwa Firauni na hoja wazi.
translation_en: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.

arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ
translation_sw: Lakini alipuuza kwa sababu ya nguvu zake na akasema: Huyu ni mchawi au mwendawazimu!
translation_en: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."

arabic_text: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi tukamkamata yeye na majeshi yake na tukawatupa baharini, na yeye ndiye wa kulaumiwa.
translation_en: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

arabic_text: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
translation_sw: Na katika khabari za A'di tulipo wapelekea upepo wa kukata uzazi.
translation_en: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.

arabic_text: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
translation_sw: Haukuacha chochote ulicho kifikia ila ulikifanya kama kilio nyambuka.
translation_en: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

arabic_text: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Na katika khabari za Thamudi walipo ambiwa: Jifurahisheni kwa muda mdogo tu.
translation_en: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

arabic_text: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_sw: Wakaasi amri ya Mola wao Mlezi. Basi uliwanyakua moto wa radi nao wanaona.
translation_en: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

arabic_text: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
translation_sw: Basi hawakuweza kusimama wala hawakuwa wenye kujitetea.
translation_en: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

arabic_text: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na kaumu ya Nuhu hapo mbele. Hakika hao walikuwa watu wapotovu.
translation_en: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
translation_sw: Na mbingu tumezifanya kwa nguvu na uwezo na hakika Sisi bila ya shaka ndio twenye uwezo wa kuzitanua.
translation_en: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.

arabic_text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
translation_sw: Na ardhi tumeitandaza; basi watandazaji wazuri namna gani Sisi!
translation_en: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

arabic_text: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Na katika kila kitu tumeumba kwa jozi ili mzingatie.
translation_en: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.

arabic_text: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi kimbilieni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi ni mwonyaji kwenu wa kubainisha nitokae kwake.
translation_en: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

arabic_text: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Wala msifanye kuwa kuna mungu mwengine pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika mimi ni mwonyaji kwenu wa kubainisha nitokae kwake.
translation_en: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
translation_sw: Basi ndio hivyo hivyo, hakuwajia kabla yao Mtume ila walisema: Huyu ni mchawi au mwendawazimu.
translation_en: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

arabic_text: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Wameambizana kwa haya? Bali hawa ni watu waasi.
translation_en: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi waachilie mbali, nawe hulaumiwi.
translation_en: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.

arabic_text: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_sw: Na kumbusha, kwani ukumbusho huwafaa Waumini.
translation_en: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

arabic_text: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
translation_sw: Nami sikuwaumba majini na watu ila waniabudu Mimi.
translation_en: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

arabic_text: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
translation_sw: Na sitaki kwao riziki, wala sitaki wanilishe.
translation_en: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
translation_sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mwenye kuruzuku, Mwenye nguvu, Madhubuti.
translation_en: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.

arabic_text: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
translation_sw: Hakika walio dhulumu wana fungu lao la adhabu kama fungu la wenzao. Basi wasinihimize.
translation_en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.

arabic_text: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Ole wao walio ikanusha siku yao waliyo ahidiwa.
translation_en: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.

arabic_text: وَٱلطُّورِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa mlima wa T'ur,
translation_en: By the mount

arabic_text: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ
translation_sw: Na Kitabu kilicho andikwa
translation_en: And [by] a Book inscribed

arabic_text: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ
translation_sw: Katika ngozi iliyo kunjuliwa,
translation_en: In parchment spread open

arabic_text: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
translation_sw: Na kwa Nyumba iliyo jengwa,
translation_en: And [by] the frequented House

arabic_text: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
translation_sw: Na kwa dari iliyo nyanyuliwa,
translation_en: And [by] the heaven raised high

arabic_text: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
translation_sw: Na kwa bahari iliyo jazwa,
translation_en: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],

arabic_text: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika adhabu ya Mola wako Mlezi hapana shaka itatokea.
translation_en: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

arabic_text: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ
translation_sw: Hapana wa kuizuia.
translation_en: Of it there is no preventer.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا
translation_sw: Siku zitakapo tikisika mbingu kwa mtikiso,
translation_en: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

arabic_text: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا
translation_sw: Na milima iwe inakwenda kwa mwendo mkubwa.
translation_en: And the mountains will pass on, departing -

arabic_text: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Basi ole wao siku hiyo hao wanao kadhibisha,
translation_en: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao wanacheza katika mambo ya upuuzi.
translation_en: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
translation_sw: Siku watapo sukumwa kwenye Moto kwa msukumo wa nguvu,
translation_en: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

arabic_text: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_sw: (Waambiwe): Huu ndio ule Moto mlio kuwa mkiukanusha!
translation_en: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

arabic_text: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Huu ni uchawi, au hamwoni tu?
translation_en: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

arabic_text: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Uingieni, mkistahamili au msistahamili - ni mamoja kwenu. Hakika mnalipwa kwa mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda.
translation_en: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika wachamngu watakuwa katika Mabustani na neema,
translation_en: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

arabic_text: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_sw: Wakifurahi kwa yale aliyo wapa Mola wao Mlezi. Na Mola wao Mlezi atawalinda na adhabu ya Motoni.
translation_en: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

arabic_text: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Kuleni na kunyweni kwa raha kabisa kwa sababu ya mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda.
translation_en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Watakuwa wameegemea juu ya viti vya enzi vilivyo pangwa kwa safu. Na tutawaoza mahuru-l-aini.
translation_en: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Na walio amini na dhuriya zao wakawafuata kwa Imani tutawakutanisha nao dhuriya zao, na wala hatutawapunja hata kidogo katika vitendo vyao. Kila mtu lazima atapata alicho kichuma.
translation_en: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.

arabic_text: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation_sw: Na tutawapa matunda, na nyama kama watavyo penda.
translation_en: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

arabic_text: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Watapeana humo bilauri zisio na vinywaji vya kuleta maneno ya upuuzi wala dhambi.
translation_en: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

arabic_text: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
translation_sw: Iwe wanawapitia watumishi wao kama kwamba ni lulu zilizomo katika chaza.
translation_en: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

arabic_text: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_sw: Wataelekeana wakiulizana.
translation_en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

arabic_text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
translation_sw: Waseme: Tulikuwa zamani pamoja na ahali zetu tukiogopa;
translation_en: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].

arabic_text: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
translation_sw: Basi Mwenyezi Mungu akatufanyia hisani na akatulinda na adhabu ya upepo wa Moto.
translation_en: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

arabic_text: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_sw: Hakika sisi zamani tulikuwa tukimwomba Yeye tu. Hakika Yeye ndiye Mwema Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

arabic_text: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
translation_sw: Basi kumbusha! Kwani wewe, kwa neema ya Mola wako Mlezi, si kuhani wala mwendawazimu.
translation_en: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

arabic_text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
translation_sw: Au wanasema: Huyu ni mtunga mashairi, tunamtarajia kupatilizwa na dahari.
translation_en: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"

arabic_text: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Tarajieni, na mimi pia ni pamoja nanyi katika kutarajia.
translation_en: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

arabic_text: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
translation_sw: Au hizo akili zao ndio zinawaamrisha haya, au wao basi ni watu majeuri tu?
translation_en: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?

arabic_text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Au ndio wanasema: Ameitunga hii! Bali basi tu hawaamini!
translation_en: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

arabic_text: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Basi nawalete masimulizi kama haya ikiwa wao wanasema kweli.
translation_en: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

arabic_text: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
translation_sw: Au wao wameumbwa pasipo kutokana na kitu chochote, au ni wao ndio waumbaji?
translation_en: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

arabic_text: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
translation_sw: Au wao wameziumba mbingu na ardhi? Bali hawana na yakini.
translation_en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

arabic_text: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
translation_sw: Au wanazo khazina za Mola wako Mlezi au wao ndio wenye madaraka?
translation_en: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

arabic_text: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
translation_sw: Au wanazo ngazi za kusikilizia? Basi huyo msikilizaji wao na alete hoja ilio wazi!
translation_en: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.

arabic_text: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
translation_sw: Au Yeye Mwenyezi Mungu ana wasichana, na nyinyi ndio mna wavulana?
translation_en: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

arabic_text: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
translation_sw: Au wewe unawaomba ujira, na kwa hivyo ndio wanaelemewa na uzito wa gharama?
translation_en: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

arabic_text: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
translation_sw: Au wanayo ilimu ya ghaibu, nao wameandika?
translation_en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

arabic_text: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
translation_sw: Au wanataka kufanya vitimbi tu? Lakini hao walio kufuru ndio watakao tegeka.
translation_en: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

arabic_text: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_sw: Au wanae mungu asiye kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu? Subhanallah! Ametaksika Mwenyezi Mungu na hao wanao washirikisha naye.
translation_en: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

arabic_text: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
translation_sw: Na hata wange ona pande linatoka mbinguni linaanguka wange sema: Ni mawingu yaliyo bebana.
translation_en: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

arabic_text: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
translation_sw: Basi waache mpaka wakutane na siku yao watakapo hilikishwa.
translation_en: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_sw: Siku ambayo hila zao hazitawafaa hata kidogo, wala wao hawatanusuriwa.
translation_en: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Na hakika walio dhulumu watapata adhabu nyengine isiyo kuwa hii, lakini wengi wao hawajui.
translation_en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.

arabic_text: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_sw: Na ingojee hukumu ya Mola wako Mlezi. Kwani wewe hakika uko mbele ya macho yetu, na mtakase kwa kumsifu Mola wako Mlezi unapo simama,
translation_en: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.

arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_sw: Na usiku pia mtakase, na zinapo kuchwa nyota.
translation_en: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.

arabic_text: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa nyota inapo tua,
translation_en: By the star when it descends,

arabic_text: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
translation_sw: Mwenzenu huyu hakupotea, wala hakukosea.
translation_en: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,

arabic_text: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Wala hatamki kwa matamanio.
translation_en: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

arabic_text: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌۭ يُوحَىٰ
translation_sw: Hayakuwa haya ila ni ufunuo ulio funuliwa;
translation_en: It is not but a revelation revealed,

arabic_text: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
translation_sw: Amemfundisha aliye mwingi wa nguvu,
translation_en: Taught to him by one intense in strength -

arabic_text: ذُو مِرَّةٍۢ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
translation_sw: Mwenye kutua, akatulia,
translation_en: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form

arabic_text: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_sw: Naye yuko juu kabisa upeo wa macho.
translation_en: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
translation_sw: Kisha akakaribia na akateremka.
translation_en: Then he approached and descended

arabic_text: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
translation_sw: Akawa ni kama baina ya mipinde miwili, au karibu zaidi.
translation_en: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

arabic_text: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
translation_sw: Akamfunulia mja wake (Mwenyezi Mungu) alicho mfunulia.
translation_en: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed.

arabic_text: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Moyo haukusema uwongo uliyo yaona.
translation_en: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.

arabic_text: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
translation_sw: Je! Mnabishana naye kwa aliyo yaona?
translation_en: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Na akamwona mara nyingine,
translation_en: And he certainly saw him in another descent

arabic_text: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_sw: Penye Mkunazi wa mwisho.
translation_en: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -

arabic_text: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Karibu yake ndiyo ipo Bustani inayo kaliwa.
translation_en: Near it is the Garden of Refuge -

arabic_text: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_sw: Kilipo ufunika huo Mkunazi hicho kilicho ufunuika.
translation_en: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].

arabic_text: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
translation_sw: Jicho halikuhangaika wala halikuruka mpaka.
translation_en: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

arabic_text: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Kwa yakini aliona katika Ishara kubwa kabisa za Mola wake Mlezi.
translation_en: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.

arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
translation_sw: Je! Mmemuona Lata na Uzza?
translation_en: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza?

arabic_text: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na Manaat, mwingine wa tatu?
translation_en: And Manat, the third - the other one?

arabic_text: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_sw: Je! Nyinyi mnao wana wanaume na Yeye ndio awe na wanawake?
translation_en: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

arabic_text: تِلْكَ إِذًۭا قِسْمَةٌۭ ضِيزَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Huo ni mgawanyo wa dhulma!
translation_en: That, then, is an unjust division.

arabic_text: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Hayo hayakuwa ila ni majina mliyo wapa nyinyi na baba zenu. Mwenyezi Mungu hakuleta uthibitisho wowote juu ya hayo. Hawafuati ila dhana tu na kipendacho nafsi. Na kwa yakini uwongofu ulikwisha wafikia kutoka kwa Mola wao Mlezi.
translation_en: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.

arabic_text: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
translation_sw: Ati mtu anakipata kila anacho kitamani?
translation_en: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?

arabic_text: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu tu ndiye Mwenye dunia na Akhera.
translation_en: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

arabic_text: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na wako Malaika wangapi mbinguni, ambao uombezi wao hautafaa chochote isipo kuwa baada ya Mwenyezi Mungu kutoa idhini kwa amtakaye na kumridhia.
translation_en: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_sw: Hakika wasio amini Akhera bila ya shaka wao ndio wanawaita Malaika kwa majina ya kike.
translation_en: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

arabic_text: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًۭٔا
translation_sw: Nao hawana ujuzi wowote kwa hayo isipo kuwa wanafuata dhana tu. Na dhana haisaidii chochote mbele ya haki.
translation_en: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.

arabic_text: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_sw: Basi mwachilie mbali anaye upa kisogo ukumbusho wetu, na wala hataki ila maisha ya dunia.
translation_en: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
translation_sw: Huo ndio mwisho wao wa ujuzi. Hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye anaye mjua zaidi mwenye kuipotea njia yake, na Yeye ndiye anaye mjua zaidi mwenye kuongoka.
translation_en: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.

arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
translation_sw: Ni vya Mwenyezi Mungu vyote viliomo mbinguni na viliomo katika ardhi, ili awalipe walio tenda ubaya kwa waliyo yatenda, na walio tenda mema awalipe mema.
translation_en: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Ambao wanajiepusha na madhambi makuu na vitendo vichafu, isipo kuwa makosa khafifu. Hakika Mola wako Mlezi ni Mkunjufu wa maghfira, naye anakujueni sana tangu alipo kuumbeni kutoka kwenye ardhi, na mlipo kuwa mimba matumboni mwa mama zenu. Basi msijisifu usafi. Yeye anamjua sana mwenye kujikinga na maovu.
translation_en: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.

arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
translation_sw: Je! Umemwona yule aliye geuka?
translation_en: Have you seen the one who turned away

arabic_text: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًۭا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na akatoa kidogo, kisha akajizuia?
translation_en: And gave a little and [then] refrained?

arabic_text: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Je! Anayo huyo ilimu ya ghaibu, basi ndio anaona?
translation_en: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?

arabic_text: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
translation_sw: Au hakuambiwa yaliyomo katika Vitabu vya Musa?
translation_en: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

arabic_text: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na vya Ibrahimu aliye timiza ahadi?
translation_en: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -

arabic_text: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Ya kwamba hakika nafsi iliyo beba madhambi haibebi madhambi ya mwengine?
translation_en: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

arabic_text: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_sw: Na ya kwamba hatapata mtu ila aliyo yafanya mwenyewe?
translation_en: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

arabic_text: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
translation_sw: Na kwamba vitendo vyake vitaonekana?
translation_en: And that his effort is going to be seen -

arabic_text: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
translation_sw: Kisha ndio atalipwa malipo yake kwa ukamilifu.
translation_en: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense

arabic_text: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_sw: Na kwamba kwao Mola wako Mlezi ndio mwisho.
translation_en: And that to your Lord is the finality

arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
translation_sw: Na kwamba Yeye ndiye anaye leta kicheko na kilio.
translation_en: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
translation_sw: Na kwamba Yeye ndiye anaye fisha na kuhuisha.
translation_en: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_sw: Na kwamba Yeye ndiye aliye umba jozi, dume na jike
translation_en: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -

arabic_text: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
translation_sw: Kutokana na mbegu ya uzazi inapo miminwa.
translation_en: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

arabic_text: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Na kwamba ni juu yake ufufuo mwengine.
translation_en: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation

arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
translation_sw: Na kwamba ni Yeye ndiye anaye tosheleza na kukinaisha.
translation_en: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Na kwamba hakika Yeye ndiye Mola Mlezi wa nyota ya Shii'ra.
translation_en: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius

arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_sw: Na kwamba Yeye ndiye aliye waangamiza A'di wa kwanza,
translation_en: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad

arabic_text: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
translation_sw: Na Thamudi hakuwabakisha,
translation_en: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them] -

arabic_text: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
translation_sw: Na kabla yao kaumu ya Nuhu. Na hao hakika walikuwa ni madhaalimu zaidi, na waovu zaidi;
translation_en: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

arabic_text: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
translation_sw: Na miji iliyo pinduliwa, ni Yeye aliye ipindua.
translation_en: And the overturned towns He hurled down

arabic_text: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
translation_sw: Vikaifunika vilivyo funika.
translation_en: And covered them by that which He covered.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
translation_sw: Basi neema gani ya Mola wako Mlezi unayo ifanyia shaka?
translation_en: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

arabic_text: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Hili ni Onyo katika maonyo yale yale ya zamani.
translation_en: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners.

arabic_text: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْءَازِفَةُ
translation_sw: Kiyama kimekaribia!
translation_en: The Approaching Day has approached.

arabic_text: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
translation_sw: Hapana wa kukifichua isipo kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover.

arabic_text: أَفَمِنْ هَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Mnayastaajabia maneno haya?
translation_en: Then at this statement do you wonder?

arabic_text: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
translation_sw: Na mnacheka, wala hamlii?
translation_en: And you laugh and do not weep

arabic_text: وَأَنتُمْ سَٰمِدُونَ
translation_sw: Nanyi mmeghafilika?
translation_en: While you are proudly sporting?

arabic_text: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
translation_sw: Basi msujudieni Mwenyezi Mungu, na mumuabudu.
translation_en: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].

arabic_text: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_sw: Saa imekaribia, na mwezi umepasuka!
translation_en: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].

arabic_text: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
translation_sw: Na wakiona Ishara hugeuka upande na husema: Huu uchawi tu unazidi kuendelea.
translation_en: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."

arabic_text: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
translation_sw: Na wamekanusha na wamefuata matamanio yao. Na kila jambo ni lenye kuthibiti.
translation_en: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka zimewajia khabari zenye makaripio.
translation_en: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -

arabic_text: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_sw: Hikima kaamili; lakini maonyo hayafai kitu!
translation_en: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
translation_sw: Basi jiepushe nao. Siku atakapo ita mwitaji kuliendea jambo linalo chusha;
translation_en: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,

arabic_text: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
translation_sw: Macho yao yatainama; watatoka makaburini kama nzige walio tawanyika,
translation_en: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

arabic_text: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
translation_sw: Wanamkimbilia mwitaji, na makafiri wanasema: Hii ni siku ngumu.
translation_en: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

arabic_text: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
translation_sw: Kabla yao kaumu ya Nuhu walikanusha; wakamkanusha mja wetu, na wakasema ni mwendawazimu, na akakaripiwa.
translation_en: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

arabic_text: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
translation_sw: Basi akamwomba Mola wake Mlezi akasema: Kwa hakika mimi nimeshindwa, basi ninusuru!
translation_en: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

arabic_text: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi tukaifungua milango ya mbingu kwa maji yanayo miminika.
translation_en: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

arabic_text: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
translation_sw: Na tukazipasua ardhi kwa chemchem, yakakutana maji kwa jambo lilio kadiriwa.
translation_en: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

arabic_text: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na tukamchukua kwenye safina ya mbao na kamba.
translation_en: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

arabic_text: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
translation_sw: Ikawa inakwenda kwa nadhari yetu, kuwa ni malipo kwa alivyo kuwa amekanushwa.
translation_en: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

arabic_text: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka tuliiacha iwe ni Ishara. Lakini je, yupo anaye kumbuka?
translation_en: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_sw: Basi ilikuwaje adhabu yangu, na maonyo yangu.
translation_en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka Sisi tumeifanya Qur'ani iwe nyepesi kufahamika. Lakini yupo anaye kumbuka?
translation_en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_sw: Kina A'di walikanusha. Basi ilikuwaje adhabu yangu na maonyo yangu?
translation_en: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tuliwapelekea upepo wa kimbunga katika siku korofi mfululizo,
translation_en: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

arabic_text: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
translation_sw: Ukiwang'oa watu kama vigogo vya mitende vilio ng'olewa.
translation_en: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_sw: Basi ilikuwaje adhabu yangu na maonyo yangu?
translation_en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka Sisi tumeifanya Qur'ani nyepesi kufahamika; lakini yupo anaye kumbuka?
translation_en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_sw: Thamudi waliwakanusha Waonyaji.
translation_en: Thamud denied the warning

arabic_text: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ati tumfuate binaadamu mmoja katika sisi? Basi hivyo sisi tutakuwa katika upotofu na kichaa!
translation_en: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

arabic_text: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
translation_sw: Ni yeye tu aliye teremshiwa huo ukumbusho kati yetu sote? Bali huyu ni mwongo mwenye kiburi!
translation_en: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

arabic_text: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
translation_sw: Kesho watajua ni nani huyo mwongo mwenye kiburi.
translation_en: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

arabic_text: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tutawapelekea ngamia jike ili kuwajaribu, basi watazame tu na ustahamili.
translation_en: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.

arabic_text: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
translation_sw: Na waambie kwamba maji yatagawanywa baina yao; kila sehemu ya maji itahudhuriwa na aliye khusika.
translation_en: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].

arabic_text: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
translation_sw: Basi wakamwita mtu wao akaja akamchinja.
translation_en: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].

arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_sw: Basi ilikuwaje adhabu yangu na maonyo yangu!
translation_en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tuliwapelekea ukelele mmoja tu, wakawa kama mabuwa ya kujengea uwa.
translation_en: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka Sisi tumeifanya Qur'ani iwe nyepesi kwa kukumbuka, lakini yupo akumbukaye?
translation_en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_sw: Kaumu Lut'i nao waliwakadhibisha Waonyaji.
translation_en: The people of Lot denied the warning.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tukawapelekea kimbunga cha vijiwe, isipo kuwa wafuasi wa Lut'i. Hao tuliwaokoa karibu na alfajiri.
translation_en: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn

arabic_text: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
translation_sw: Kwa neema inayo toka kwetu. Hivyo ndivyo tumlipavyo anaye shukuru.
translation_en: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_sw: Na hakika yeye aliwaonya adhabu yetu; lakini wao waliyatilia shaka hayo maonyo.
translation_en: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_sw: Na walimtaka awape wageni wake. Tukayapofua macho yao, na tukawaambia: Onjeni basi adhabu na maonyo yangu!
translation_en: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
translation_sw: Na iliwafikia wakati wa asubuhi adhabu yangu ya kuendelea.
translation_en: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

arabic_text: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_sw: Basi onjeni adhabu na maonyo yangu!
translation_en: So taste My punishment and warning.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na hakika tumeisahilisha Qur'ani kuikumbuka. Lakini yupo anaye kumbuka?
translation_en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_sw: Na Waonyaji waliwafikia watu wa Firauni.
translation_en: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

arabic_text: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
translation_sw: Walizikadhibisha Ishara zetu zote, nasi tukawashika kama anavyo shika Mwenye nguvu Mwenye uweza.
translation_en: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

arabic_text: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_sw: Je! Makafiri wenu ni bora kuliko hao, au yameandikwa vitabuni kuwa nyinyi hamtiwi makosani?
translation_en: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?

arabic_text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
translation_sw: Au ndio wanasema: Sisi ni wengi tutashinda tu.
translation_en: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

arabic_text: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
translation_sw: Wingi wao huu utashindwa, na wao watasukumwa nyuma.
translation_en: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].

arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
translation_sw: Bali Saa ya Kiyama ndio miadi yao, na Saa hiyo ni nzito zaidi na chungu zaidi.
translation_en: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika wakosefu wamo katika upotofu na wazimu.
translation_en: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
translation_sw: Siku watakapo kokotwa Motoni kifudifudi waambiwe: Onjeni mguso wa Jahannamu!
translation_en: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."

arabic_text: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika Sisi tumekiumba kila kitu kwa kipimo.
translation_en: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
translation_sw: Na amri yetu haikuwa ila ni moja tu, kama kupepesa jicho.
translation_en: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka tumekwisha waangamiza wenzenu. Lakini yupo anaye kumbuka?
translation_en: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?

arabic_text: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_sw: Na kila jambo walilo lifanya limo vitabuni.
translation_en: And everything they did is in written records.

arabic_text: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
translation_sw: Na kila kidogo na kikubwa kimeandikwa.
translation_en: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika wachamngu watakuwa katika Mabustani na mito.
translation_en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

arabic_text: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
translation_sw: Katika makalio ya haki kwa Mfalme Mwenye uweza.
translation_en: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.

arabic_text: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ
translation_sw: Arrah'man, Mwingi wa Rehema
translation_en: The Most Merciful

arabic_text: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
translation_sw: Amefundisha Qur'ani.
translation_en: Taught the Qur'an,

arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ
translation_sw: Amemuumba mwanaadamu,
translation_en: Created man,

arabic_text: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
translation_sw: Akamfundisha kubaini.
translation_en: [And] taught him eloquence.

arabic_text: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍۢ
translation_sw: Jua na mwezi huenda kwa hisabu.
translation_en: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

arabic_text: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
translation_sw: Na mimea yenye kutambaa, na miti, inanyenyekea.
translation_en: And the stars and trees prostrate.

arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_sw: Na mbingu ameziinua, na ameweka mizani,
translation_en: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

arabic_text: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
translation_sw: Ili msidhulumu katika mizani.
translation_en: That you not transgress within the balance.

arabic_text: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_sw: Na wekeni mizani kwa haki, wala msipunje katika mizani.
translation_en: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

arabic_text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
translation_sw: Na ardhi ameiweka kwa ajili ya viumbe.
translation_en: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

arabic_text: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
translation_sw: Humo yamo matunda na mitende yenye mafumba.
translation_en: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

arabic_text: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
translation_sw: Na nafaka zenye makapi, na rehani.
translation_en: And grain having husks and scented plants.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
translation_sw: Amemuumba mtu kwa udongo wa kinamo..
translation_en: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

arabic_text: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ
translation_sw: Na akawaumba majini kwa ulimi wa moto.
translation_en: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
translation_sw: Mola Mlezi wa mashariki mbili na wa magharibi mbili.
translation_en: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
translation_sw: Anaziendesha bahari mbili zikutane;
translation_en: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];

arabic_text: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌۭ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
translation_sw: Baina yao kipo kizuizi, zisiingiliane.
translation_en: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
translation_sw: Katika hizo bahari mbili zinatoka lulu na marijani.
translation_en: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
translation_sw: Na ni vyake Yeye hivi viendavyo baharini vilivyo undwa kama vilima.
translation_en: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍۢ
translation_sw: Kila kilioko juu yake kitatoweka.
translation_en: Everyone upon the earth will perish,

arabic_text: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_sw: Na atabakia Mwenyewe Mola wako Mlezi Mwenye utukufu na ukarimu.
translation_en: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
translation_sw: Vinamwomba Yeye vilivyomo katika mbingu na ardhi. Kila siku Yeye yumo katika mambo.
translation_en: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
translation_sw: Tutakuhisabuni enyi makundi mawili.
translation_en: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ
translation_sw: Enyi makundi ya majini na watu! Mkiweza kupenya kwenye mbingu na ardhi, basi penyeni! Hamtapenya ila kwa kupewa madaraka.
translation_en: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
translation_sw: Mtapelekewa muwako wa moto na shaba; wala hamtashinda.
translation_en: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
translation_sw: Itakapo pasuka mbingu ikawa nyekundu kama mafuta.
translation_en: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

arabic_text: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo hataulizwa dhambi zake mtu wala jini.
translation_en: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
translation_sw: Watajuulikana wakosefu kwa alama zao, basi watashikwa kwa nywele zao za utosini na kwa miguu.
translation_en: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_sw: Hii ndiyo Jahannamu ambayo wakosefu wakiikanusha.
translation_en: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.

arabic_text: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍۢ
translation_sw: Watakuwa wakizunguka baina ya hiyo na maji ya moto yanayo chemka.
translation_en: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ
translation_sw: Na mwenye kuogopa kusimamishwa mbele ya Mola wake Mlezi atapata Bustani mbili.
translation_en: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

arabic_text: ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍۢ
translation_sw: Bustani zenye matawi yaliyo tanda.
translation_en: Having [spreading] branches.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ
translation_sw: Ndani yake zimo chemchem mbili zinazo pita.
translation_en: In both of them are two springs, flowing.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍۢ زَوْجَانِ
translation_sw: Humo katika kila matunda zimo namna mbili.
translation_en: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ
translation_sw: Wawe wameegemea matandiko yenye bit'ana ya hariri nzito; na matunda ya Bustani hizo yapo karibu.
translation_en: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
translation_sw: Humo watakuwamo wanawake watulizao macho yao; hajawagusa mtu kabla yao wala jini.
translation_en: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni -

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
translation_sw: Kama kwamba wao ni yakuti na marijani.
translation_en: As if they were rubies and coral.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha.
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ
translation_sw: Ati yaweza kuwa malipo ya ihsani ila ihsani?
translation_en: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
translation_sw: Na zaidi ya hizo zipo Bustani nyengine mbili.
translation_en: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

arabic_text: مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ
translation_sw: Za kijani kibivu.
translation_en: Dark green [in color].

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
translation_sw: Na chemchem mbili zinazo furika.
translation_en: In both of them are two springs, spouting.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَنَخْلٌۭ وَرُمَّانٌۭ
translation_sw: Imo humo miti ya matunda, na mitende na mikomamanga.
translation_en: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَٰتٌ حِسَانٌۭ
translation_sw: Humo wamo wanawake wema wazuri.
translation_en: In them are good and beautiful women -

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

arabic_text: حُورٌۭ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌۭ فِى ٱلْخِيَامِ
translation_sw: Wanawake wazuri wanao tawishwa katika makhema.
translation_en: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

arabic_text: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
translation_sw: Hajawagusa mtu wala jini kabla yao.
translation_en: Untouched before them by man or jinni -

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ
translation_sw: Wameegemea juu ya matakia ya kijani na mazulia mazuri.
translation_en: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?
translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

arabic_text: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_sw: Limetukuka jina la Mola wako Mlezi Mwenye utukufu na ukarimu.
translation_en: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

arabic_text: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_sw: Litakapo tukia hilo Tukio
translation_en: When the Occurrence occurs,

arabic_text: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
translation_sw: Hapana cha kukanusha kutukia kwake.
translation_en: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

arabic_text: خَافِضَةٌۭ رَّافِعَةٌ
translation_sw: Literemshalo linyanyualo,
translation_en: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].

arabic_text: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّۭا
translation_sw: Itakapo tikiswa ardhi kwa mtikiso,
translation_en: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

arabic_text: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّۭا
translation_sw: Na milima itapo sagwasagwa,
translation_en: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

arabic_text: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءًۭ مُّنۢبَثًّۭا
translation_sw: Iwe mavumbi yanayo peperushwa,
translation_en: And become dust dispersing.

arabic_text: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ثَلَٰثَةًۭ
translation_sw: Na nyinyi mtakuwa namna tatu:-
translation_en: And you become [of] three kinds:

arabic_text: فَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_sw: Basi watakuwepo wa kuliani; je, ni wepi wa kuliani?
translation_en: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

arabic_text: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_sw: Na wa kushotoni; je, ni wepi wa kushotoni?
translation_en: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

arabic_text: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ
translation_sw: Na wa mbele watakuwa mbele.
translation_en: And the forerunners, the forerunners -

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_sw: Hao ndio watakao karibishwa
translation_en: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]

arabic_text: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_sw: Katika Bustani zenye neema.
translation_en: In the Gardens of Pleasure,

arabic_text: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Fungu kubwa katika wa mwanzo,
translation_en: A [large] company of the former peoples

arabic_text: وَقَلِيلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na wachache katika wa mwisho.
translation_en: And a few of the later peoples,

arabic_text: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّوْضُونَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Watakuwa juu ya viti vya fakhari vilivyo tonewa.
translation_en: On thrones woven [with ornament],

arabic_text: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ
translation_sw: Wakiviegemea wakielekeana.
translation_en: Reclining on them, facing each other.

arabic_text: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
translation_sw: Wakitumikiwa na wavulana wa ujana wa milele,
translation_en: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal

arabic_text: بِأَكْوَابٍۢ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwa vikombe na mabirika na bilauri za vinywaji kutoka chemchem safi.
translation_en: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

arabic_text: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
translation_sw: Hawataumwa kichwa kwa vinywaji hivyo wala hawatoleweshwa.
translation_en: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

arabic_text: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Na matunda wayapendayo,
translation_en: And fruit of what they select

arabic_text: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation_sw: Na nyama za ndege kama wanavyo tamani.
translation_en: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

arabic_text: وَحُورٌ عِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Na Mahurulaini,
translation_en: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,

arabic_text: كَأَمْثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ
translation_sw: Walio kama mfano wa lulu zilio hifadhiwa.
translation_en: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,

arabic_text: جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Ni malipo kwa waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda.
translation_en: As reward for what they used to do.

arabic_text: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
translation_sw: Humo hawatasikia porojo wala maneno ya dhambi,
translation_en: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -

arabic_text: إِلَّا قِيلًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa maneno ya Salama, Salama.
translation_en: Only a saying: "Peace, peace."

arabic_text: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_sw: Na wale wa mkono wa kulia, ni yepi yatakuwa ya wa kuliani?
translation_en: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

arabic_text: فِى سِدْرٍۢ مَّخْضُودٍۢ
translation_sw: Katika mikunazi isiyo na miba,
translation_en: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed

arabic_text: وَطَلْحٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
translation_sw: Na migomba iliyo pangiliwa,
translation_en: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]

arabic_text: وَظِلٍّۢ مَّمْدُودٍۢ
translation_sw: Na kivuli kilicho tanda,
translation_en: And shade extended

arabic_text: وَمَآءٍۢ مَّسْكُوبٍۢ
translation_sw: Na maji yanayo miminika,
translation_en: And water poured out

arabic_text: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Na matunda mengi,
translation_en: And fruit, abundant [and varied],

arabic_text: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍۢ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Hayatindikii wala hayakatazwi,
translation_en: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,

arabic_text: وَفُرُشٍۢ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ
translation_sw: Na matandiko yaliyo nyanyuliwa.
translation_en: And [upon] beds raised high.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءًۭ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tutawaumba (Mahurulaini) upya,
translation_en: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation

arabic_text: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا
translation_sw: Na tutawafanya vijana,
translation_en: And made them virgins,

arabic_text: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًۭا
translation_sw: Wanapendana na waume zao, hirimu moja.
translation_en: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,

arabic_text: لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_sw: Kwa ajili ya watu wa kuliani.
translation_en: For the companions of the right [who are]

arabic_text: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Fungu kubwa katika wa mwanzo,
translation_en: A company of the former peoples

arabic_text: وَثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na fungu kubwa katika wa mwisho.
translation_en: And a company of the later peoples.

arabic_text: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
translation_sw: Na watu wa kushotoni; je ni yepi ya wa kushotoni?
translation_en: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

arabic_text: فِى سَمُومٍۢ وَحَمِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Katika upepo wa moto, na maji yanayo chemka,
translation_en: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

arabic_text: وَظِلٍّۢ مِّن يَحْمُومٍۢ
translation_sw: Na kivuli cha moshi mweusi,
translation_en: And a shade of black smoke,

arabic_text: لَّا بَارِدٍۢ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
translation_sw: Si cha kuburudisha wala kustarehesha.
translation_en: Neither cool nor beneficial.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika hao walikuwa kabla ya haya wakiishi maisha ya anasa.
translation_en: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

arabic_text: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_sw: Na walikuwa wakishikilia kufanya madhambi makubwa,
translation_en: And they used to persist in the great violation,

arabic_text: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_sw: Na walikuwa wakisema: Tutakapo kufa na tukawa udongo na mafupa, ati ndio tutafufuliwa?
translation_en: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

arabic_text: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
translation_sw: Au baba zetu wa zamani?
translation_en: And our forefathers [as well]?"

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Sema: Hakika wa zamani na wa mwisho
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples

arabic_text: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
translation_sw: Bila ya shaka watakusanywa kwa wakati wa siku maalumu.
translation_en: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_sw: Kisha nyinyi, mlio potea, mnao kanusha,
translation_en: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,

arabic_text: لَءَاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍۢ مِّن زَقُّومٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwa yakini mtakula mti wa Zaqqumu.
translation_en: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum

arabic_text: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
translation_sw: Na kwa mti huo mtajaza matumbo.
translation_en: And filling with it your bellies

arabic_text: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_sw: Na juu yake mtakunywa maji yanayo chemka.
translation_en: And drinking on top of it from scalding water

arabic_text: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ
translation_sw: Tena mtakunywa kama wanavyo kunywa ngamia wenye kiu.
translation_en: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Hiyo ndiyo karamu yao Siku ya Malipo.
translation_en: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

arabic_text: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ
translation_sw: Sisi tumekuumbeni; basi hamsadiki?
translation_en: We have created you, so why do you not believe?

arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Mnaiona mbegu ya uzazi mnayo idondokeza?
translation_en: Have you seen that which you emit?

arabic_text: ءَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Mnaiumba nyinyi, au ni Sisi ndio Waumbaji?
translation_en: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

arabic_text: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
translation_sw: Sisi tumekuwekeeni mauti; na wala Sisi hatushindwi
translation_en: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

arabic_text: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Kuwaleta wengine badala yenu na kukuumbeni nyinyi kwa umbo msilo lijua.
translation_en: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka mlikwisha jua umbo la kwanza, basi kwa nini hamkumbuki?
translation_en: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?

arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ
translation_sw: Je! Mnaona makulima mnayo yapanda?
translation_en: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
