translation_sw: Wanapo kujia wanaafiki husema: Tunashuhudia ya kuwa wewe ni Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anajua kuwa wewe ni Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na Mwenyezi Mungu anashuhudia ya kuwa hakika wanaafiki ni waongo.
translation_en: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muhammad], they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allah." And Allah knows that you are His Messenger, and Allah testifies that the hypocrites are liars.

arabic_text: ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةًۭ فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Wamevifanya viapo vyao ni kinga, na wao wakajizuia kuifuata Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika ni mabaya kabisa waliyo kuwa wakiyafanya.
translation_en: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allah. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا۟ فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa sababu ya kuwa waliamini, kisha wakakufuru; kwa hivyo umepigwa muhuri juu ya nyoyo zao. Kwa hivyo hawafahamu lolote.
translation_en: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand.

arabic_text: ۞ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَقُولُوا۟ تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ ۖ كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌۭ مُّسَنَّدَةٌۭ ۖ يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ هُمُ ٱلْعَدُوُّ فَٱحْذَرْهُمْ ۚ قَٰتَلَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
translation_sw: Na unapo waona, miili yao inakupendeza, na wakisema, unasikiliza usemi wao. Lakini wao ni kama magogo yaliyo egemezwa. Wao hudhania kila ukelele unao pigwa ni kwa ajili yao. Hao ni maadui; tahadhari nao. Mwenyezi Mungu awaangamizilie mbali! Vipi wanapotoka na haki?
translation_en: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah destroy them; how are they deluded?

arabic_text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ لَوَّوْا۟ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo ambiwa: Njooni ili Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu akuombeeni maghfira, huvigeuza vichwa vyao, na unawaona wanageuka nao wamejaa kiburi.
translation_en: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.

arabic_text: سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
translation_sw: Sawa sawa kwao, ukiwatakia maghfira au hukuwatakia maghfira, Mwenyezi Mungu hatawaghufiria. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu hawaongoi watu wapotovu.
translation_en: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allah forgive them. Indeed, Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.

arabic_text: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَنْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّوا۟ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ خَزَآئِنُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ
translation_sw: Hao ndio wanao sema: Msitoe mali kwa ajili ya walioko kwa Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu, ili waondokelee mbali! Na Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mwenye khazina za mbingu na ardhi, lakini wanaafiki hawafahamu.
translation_en: They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allah until they disband." And to Allah belongs the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.

arabic_text: يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعْنَآ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ ٱلْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا ٱلْأَذَلَّ ۚ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِۦ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Wanasema: Tukirejea Madina mwenye utukufu zaidi bila ya shaka atamfukuza aliye mnyonge. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mwenye utukufu - Yeye, na Mtume wake, na Waumini. Lakini wanaafiki hawajui.
translation_en: They say, "If we return to al-Madinah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble." And to Allah belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُلْهِكُمْ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Yasikusahaulisheni mali yenu, wala watoto wenu, kumkumbuka Mwenyezi Mungu. Na wenye kufanya hayo ndio walio khasiri.
translation_en: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.

arabic_text: وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِن مَّا رَزَقْنَٰكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَآ أَخَّرْتَنِىٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Na toeni katika tulicho kupeni kabla hayajamfikia mmoja wenu mauti, tena hapo akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Huniakhirishi muda kidogo nipate kutoa sadaka, na niwe katika watu wema?
translation_en: And spend [in the way of Allah] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous."

arabic_text: وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Wala Mwenyezi Mungu hataiakhirisha nafsi yoyote inapo fika ajali yake; na Mwenyezi Mungu anazo khabari za mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: But never will Allah delay a soul when its time has come. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

arabic_text: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
translation_sw: Kinamtakasa Mwenyezi Mungu kila kilichomo katika mbingu na katika ardhi. Ufalme ni wake, na sifa njema ni zake. Na Yeye ni Mwenye uweza juu ya kila kitu.
translation_en: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌۭ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye aliye kuumbeni. Miongoni mwenu yupo aliye kafiri, na yupo aliye Muumini. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anayaona mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.

arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Ameziumba mbingu na ardhi kwa haki, na akakupeni sura, na akazifanya nzuri sura zenu. Na marudio ni kwake.
translation_en: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.

arabic_text: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_sw: Anajua viliomo katika mbingu na ardhi, na anajua mnayo yaficha na mnayo yatangaza. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mjuzi wa yaliomo vifuani.
translation_en: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Kwani haikukujieni khabari ya walio kufuru kabla, wakaonja matokeo mabaya ya mambo yao? Na wao wana adhabu iliyo chungu.
translation_en: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرٌۭ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا۟ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ ۚ وَّٱسْتَغْنَى ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Hayo ni kwa kuwa walikuwa wakiwajia Mitume wao kwa hoja zilizo wazi, nao wakasema: Hivyo binaadamu ndio atuongoe? Basi wakakufuru, na wakageuka upande. Mwenyezi Mungu akawa hana haja nao. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mkwasi, si mhitaji, naye ni Msifiwa.
translation_en: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allah dispensed [with them]; and Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

arabic_text: زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا۟ ۚ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Walio kufuru wanadai kuwa hawatafufuliwa. Sema: Kwani? Naapa kwa Mola wangu Mlezi! Hapana shaka mtafufuliwa, na kisha hapana shaka mtaambiwa mliyo yatenda. Na hayo ni mepesi kwa Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allah, is easy."

arabic_text: فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلْنَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi muaminini Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake, na Nuru tuliyo iteremsha. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anazo khabari za mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: So believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Qur'an which We have sent down. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْجَمْعِ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًۭا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_sw: Siku atakayo kukusanyeni kwa ajili ya Siku ya Mkusanyiko; hiyo ni siku ya kupunjana. Na anaye muamini Mwenyezi Mungu na akatenda mema, atamfutia maovu yake, na atamuingiza katika Mabustani yenye kupitiwa kati yake na mito, watadumu humo milele. Huko ndiko kufuzu kukubwa.
translation_en: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru na wakakadhibisha Ishara zetu, hao ni watu wa Motoni, watadumu humo milele. Na hayo ndiyo marudio mabaya.
translation_en: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.

arabic_text: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Haufiki msiba wowote ila kwa idhini ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na mwenye kumuamini Mwenyezi Mungu huuongoa moyo wake. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mjuzi wa kila kitu.
translation_en: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah. And whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart. And Allah is Knowing of all things.

arabic_text: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_sw: Na mt'iini Mwenyezi Mungu, na mt'iini Mtume. Mkigeuka, basi hakika juu ya Mtume wetu ni kufikisha (Ujumbe wake) kwa uwazi tu.
translation_en: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu, hapana mungu isipo kuwa Yeye. Na juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu nawategemee Waumini.
translation_en: Allah - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّۭا لَّكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا۟ وَتَصْفَحُوا۟ وَتَغْفِرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Hakika miongoni mwa wake zenu na watoto wenu wamo maadui zenu. Basi tahadharini nao. Na mkisamehe, na mkapuuza, na mkaghufiria basi hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwingi wa maghfira, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: O you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika mali yenu na watoto wenu ni jaribio. Na kwa Mwenyezi Mungu upo ujira mkubwa.
translation_en: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward.

arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
translation_sw: Basi mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu kama mwezavyo, na sikieni, na t'iini, na toeni, itakuwa kheri kwa nafsi zenu. Na mwenye kuepushwa na uchoyo wa nafsi yake, basi hao ndio walio fanikiwa.
translation_en: So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allah]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.

arabic_text: إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
translation_sw: Mkimkopesha Mwenyezi Mungu mkopo mzuri, atakuzidishieni mardufu, na atakusameheni. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwingi wa shukra, Mpole.
translation_en: If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allah is Most Appreciative and Forbearing.

arabic_text: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Mwenye kujua siri na dhaahiri, Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا۟ ٱلْعِدَّةَ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ ۖ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأْتِينَ بِفَٰحِشَةٍۢ مُّبَيِّنَةٍۢ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُۥ ۚ لَا تَدْرِى لَعَلَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرًۭا
translation_sw: Ewe Nabii! Mtakapo wapa talaka wanawake, basi wapeni talaka katika wakati wa eda zao. Na fanyeni hisabu ya eda. Na mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola wenu Mlezi. Msiwatoe katika nyumba zao, wala wasitoke wenyewe, ila wakifanya jambo la uchafu ulio wazi. Hiyo ndiyo mipaka ya Mwenyezi Mungu, msiikiuke. Na mwenye kuikiuka mipaka ya Mwenyezi Mungu, basi amejidhulumu nafsi yake. Hujui; labda Mwenyezi Mungu ataleta jambo jengine baada ya haya.
translation_en: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear Allah, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allah. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allah has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allah will bring about after that a [different] matter.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍۢ وَأَشْهِدُوا۟ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًۭا
translation_sw: Basi wanapo fikia muda wao, ima warejeeni muwaweke kwa wema, au farikianeni nao kwa wema. Na mshuhudishe mashahidi wawili waadilifu miongoni mwenu. Na simamisheni ushahidi kwa ajili ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Hivyo ndivyo anavyo agizwa anaye muamini Mwenyezi Mungu na Siku ya Mwisho. Na anaye mcha Mwenyezi Mungu humtengezea njia ya kutokea.
translation_en: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allah. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allah and the Last day. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out

arabic_text: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدْرًۭا
translation_sw: Na humruzuku kwa jiha asiyo tazamia. Na anaye mtegemea Mwenyezi Mungu Yeye humtosha. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anatimiza amri yake. Mwenyezi Mungu kajaalia kila kitu na kipimo chake.
translation_en: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى يَئِسْنَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمْ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشْهُرٍۢ وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى لَمْ يَحِضْنَ ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰتُ ٱلْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ يُسْرًۭا
translation_sw: Na wale walio sita hedhi miongoni mwa wanawake wenu, ikiwa mnayo shaka, basi muda wa eda yao ni miezi mitatu, pamoja na ambao hawapati hedhi. Na wenye mimba eda yao mpaka watakapo zaa. Na anaye mcha Mwenyezi Mungu, Mwenyezi Mungu humfanyia mambo yake kuwa mepesi.
translation_en: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him of his matter ease.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا
translation_sw: Hiyo ni amri ya Mwenyezi Mungu amekuteremshieni. Na anaye mcha Mwenyezi Mungu atamfutia maovu yake, na atampa ujira mkubwa.
translation_en: That is the command of Allah, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allah - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.

arabic_text: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُو۟لَٰتِ حَمْلٍۢ فَأَنفِقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۖ وَأْتَمِرُوا۟ بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍۢ ۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Wawekeni humo humo mnamo kaa nyinyi kwa kadiri ya pato lenu, wala msiwaletee madhara kwa kuwadhiki. Na wakiwa wana mimba, wagharimieni mpaka wajifungue. Na wakikunyonyesheeni, basi wapeni ujira wao, na shaurianeni kwa wema. Na mkiona uzito kati yenu, basi amnyonyeshee mwanamke mwengine.
translation_en: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for the father another woman.

arabic_text: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍۢ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُۥ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَا ۚ سَيَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍۢ يُسْرًۭا
translation_sw: Mwenye wasaa atoe kadiri ya wasaa wake, na mwenye dhiki atoe katika alicho mpa Mwenyezi Mungu. Mwenyezi Mungu hamkalifishi mtu ila kwa kadiri ya alicho mpa. Mwenyezi Mungu atajaalia baada ya dhiki faraji.
translation_en: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allah has given him. Allah does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease.

arabic_text: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبْنَٰهَا حِسَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَعَذَّبْنَٰهَا عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًۭا
translation_sw: Na miji mingapi iliyo vunja amri ya Mola wake Mlezi na Mitume wake, basi tuliihisabia hisabu ngumu na tukaiadhibu kwa adhabu kali.
translation_en: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.

arabic_text: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا
translation_sw: Basi ikauonja ubaya wa mambo yake; na mwisho wa mambo yao ilikuwa khasara.
translation_en: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair, and the outcome of its affair was loss.

arabic_text: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ قَدْ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًۭا
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu aliwaandalia adhabu kali. Basi mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu, enyi wenye akili, mlio amini! Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu amekuteremshieni Ukumbusho,
translation_en: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allah, O you of understanding who have believed. Allah has sent down to you the Qur'an.

arabic_text: رَّسُولًۭا يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لِّيُخْرِجَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًۭا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزْقًا
translation_sw: Mtume anaye kusomeeni Aya za Mwenyezi Mungu zinazo bainisha, ili kuwatoa walio amini na wakatenda mema kutoka gizani kuwapeleka kwenye nuru. Na mwenye kumuamini Mwenyezi Mungu, na akatenda mema, atamwingiza katika Bustani zipitazo mito kati yake, wadumu humo milele. Mwenyezi Mungu amekwisha mpa riziki nzuri.
translation_en: [He sent] a Messenger [Muhammad] reciting to you the distinct verses of Allah that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allah will have perfected for him a provision.

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۢا
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ni yule ambaye ameziumba mbingu saba, na ardhi kwa mfano wa hizo. Amri zake zinashuka baina yao, ili mjue kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye uweza juu ya kila kitu, na kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu amekizunguka kila kitu kukijua vilivyo kwa ilimu yake.
translation_en: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Ewe Nabii! Kwa nini unaharimisha alicho kuhalilishia Mwenyezi Mungu? Unatafuta kuwaridhi wake zako. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allah has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: قَدْ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation_sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu kakupeni Sharia ya kufungua viapo vyenu, na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mola wenu. Na Yeye ni Mwenye kujua, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: Allah has already ordained for you [Muslims] the dissolution of your oaths. And Allah is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثًۭا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِۦ وَأَظْهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُۥ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِىَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
translation_sw: Na Nabii alipo mwambia mmoja wa wake zake jambo la siri. Basi alipo litangaza yule mke, na Mwenyezi Mungu akamdhihirishia Mtume, alimjuvya sehemu na akaacha sehemu nyengine. Alipo mwambia hayo, huyo mke akasema: Nani aliye kwambia haya? Mtume akasema: Kaniambia Mjuzi Mwenye khabari zote!
translation_en: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allah showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Acquainted."

arabic_text: إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَإِن تَظَٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَٰلِحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ
translation_sw: Kama nyinyi wawili hamkutubia kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, basi nyoyo zenu zimekwisha elekea huko. Na mkisaidiana dhidi yake (Mtume), basi hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye kipenzi chake, na Jibrili, na Waumini wema, na zaidi ya hayo Malaika pia watasaidia.
translation_en: If you two [wives] repent to Allah, [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allah is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants.

arabic_text: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُۥٓ أَزْوَٰجًا خَيْرًۭا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَٰتٍۢ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٍۢ قَٰنِتَٰتٍۢ تَٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتٍۢ سَٰٓئِحَٰتٍۢ ثَيِّبَٰتٍۢ وَأَبْكَارًۭا
translation_sw: Asaa Mola wake Mlezi, akikupeni talaka, akampa wake wengine badala yenu nyinyi, walio bora kuliko nyinyi, wanynyekevu, Waumini, wat'awa, walio tubu, wenye kushika ibada, wafanyao kheri, wajane na wanawari.
translation_en: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allah], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًۭا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌۭ شِدَادٌۭ لَّا يَعْصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Jilindeni nafsi zenu na ahali zenu na Moto ambao kuni zake ni watu na mawe. Wanausimamia Malaika wakali, wenye nguvu, hawamuasi Mwenyezi Mungu kwa anayo waamrisha, na wanatenda wanayo amrishwa.
translation_en: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allah in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio kufuru! Msilete udhuru leo. Hakika mnalipwa mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda.
translation_en: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوْبَةًۭ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ ۖ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَىٰ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Enyi mlio amini! Tubuni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu toba iliyo ya kweli! Asaa Mola wenu Mlezi akakufutieni maovu yenu na akakuingizeni katika Pepo zipitazo mito kati yake, siku ambayo Mwenyezi Mungu hatamdhalilisha Nabii na walio amini pamoja naye. Nuru yao inakwenda mbele yao na pande zao za kulia, na huku wanasema: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tutimilizie nuru yetu, na utughufirie! Hakika Wewe ni Mwenye uweza juu ya kila kitu.
translation_en: O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ جَٰهِدِ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Ewe Nabii! Pambana na makafiri na wanaafiki, na kuwa mgumu kwao! Na makaazi yao ni Jahannamu. Na hayo ni marejeo mabaya.
translation_en: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.

arabic_text: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu amewapigia mfano walio kufuru: mke wa Nuhu na mke wa Lut'i. Walikuwa chini ya waja wetu wema wawili miongoni mwa waja wetu. Lakini wakawakhuni waume zao, nao wasiwafae kitu. Na ikasemwa: Ingieni Motoni pamoja na wanao ingia!
translation_en: Allah presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so those prophets did not avail them from Allah at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."

arabic_text: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu amewapigia mfano walio amini - mkewe Firauni, alipo sema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nijengee kwako nyumba Peponi, na uniokoe na Firauni na vitendo vyake, na uniokoe na watu madhaalimu.
translation_en: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."

arabic_text: وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْقَٰنِتِينَ
translation_sw: Na Mariamu binti wa Imrani, aliye linda ubikira wake, na tukampulizia humo kutoka roho yetu, na akayasadiki maneno ya Mola wake Mlezi na Vitabu vyake, na alikuwa miongoni mwa wat'iifu.
translation_en: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.

arabic_text: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
translation_sw: AMETUKUKA ambaye mkononi mwake umo Ufalme wote; na Yeye ni Mwenye uweza juu ya kila kitu.
translation_en: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
translation_sw: Ambaye ameumba mauti na uhai ili kukujaribuni ni nani miongoni mwenu mwenye vitendo vizuri zaidi. Na Yeye ni Mwenye nguvu na Mwenye msamaha.
translation_en: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ
translation_sw: Aliye umba mbingu saba kwa matabaka. Huoni tafauti yoyote katika uumbaji wa Mwingi wa Rehema. Hebu rudisha nadhari! Unaona kosa lolote?
translation_en: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

arabic_text: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Tena rudisha nadhari mara mbili, nadhari yako itakurejea mwenyewe hali ya kuwa imehizika nayo imechoka.
translation_en: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika tumeipamba mbingu ya karibu kwa mataa, na tumeyafanya ili kuwapigia mashetani, na tumewaandalia adhabu ya Moto uwakao kwa nguvu.
translation_en: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

arabic_text: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Na kwa walio mkufuru Mola wao Mlezi ipo adhabu ya Jahannamu. Na ni marejeo maovu yalioje hayo!
translation_en: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

arabic_text: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
translation_sw: Watakapo tupwa humo watausikia mngurumo wake na huku inafoka.
translation_en: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

arabic_text: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Inakaribia kupasuka kwa hasira. Kila mara likitupwa kundi humo walinzi wake huwauliza: Kwani hakukujieni mwonyaji?
translation_en: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Watasema: Kwani! Ametujia mwonyaji, lakini tulimkadhibisha, na tukasema: Mwenyezi Mungu hakuteremsha chochote. Nyinyi hamumo ila katika upotovu mkubwa!
translation_en: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation_sw: Na watasema: Lau kuwa tungeli sikia, au tungeli kuwa na akili, tusingeli kuwa katika watu wa Motoni!
translation_en: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

arabic_text: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation_sw: Wakakiri dhambi zao. Basi kuangamia ni kwa watu wa Motoni!
translation_en: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika wanao mwogopa Mola wao Mlezi kwa ghaibu, watapata maghfira na ujira mkubwa.
translation_en: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

arabic_text: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_sw: Na ficheni kauli zenu, au zitangazeni; hakika Yeye ni Mjuzi wa yaliyomo vifuani.
translation_en: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

arabic_text: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
translation_sw: Asijue aliye umba, naye ndiye Mjua siri, Mwenye khabari?
translation_en: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye aliye idhalilisha ardhi kwa faida yenu, basi tembeeni katika pande zake, na kuleni katika riziki zake. Na kwake Yeye ndio kufufuliwa.
translation_en: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

arabic_text: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
translation_sw: Mnadhani mko salama kwa alioko juu kuwa hatakudidimizeni kwenye ardhi, na tahamaki hiyo inatikisika!
translation_en: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

arabic_text: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
translation_sw: Au mnadhani mko salama kwa alioko juu ya kuwa Yeye hakupelekeeni kimbunga chenye changarawe? Mtajua vipi maonyo yangu?
translation_en: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka walikwisha kanusha walio kuwa kabla yao; basi kulikuwaje kukasirika kwangu?
translation_en: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
translation_sw: Kwani hawawaoni ndege walioko juu yao namna wanavyo zikunjua mbawa zao, na kuzikunja? Hawawashikilii ila Mwingi wa rehema. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kuona kila kitu.
translation_en: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

arabic_text: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
translation_sw: Au ni lipi hilo jeshi lenu la kukunusuruni badala ya Mwingi wa Rehema? Hakika makafiri hawamo ila katika udanganyifu.
translation_en: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

arabic_text: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ
translation_sw: Au ni nani huyo ambaye atakupeni riziki kama Yeye akizuia riziki yake? Bali wao wanakakamia tu katika jeuri na chuki.
translation_en: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

arabic_text: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Je! Anaye kwenda akisinukia juu ya uso wake ni mwongofu zaidi, au yule anaye kwenda sawasawa katika Njia Iliyo Nyooka?
translation_en: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Yeye ndiye aliye kuumbeni tangu mwanzo, na akakupeni masikio na macho, na nyoyo. Ni kidogo kabisa shukrani zenu.
translation_en: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Yeye ndiye aliye kutawanyeni katika ardhi, na kwake mtakusanywa.
translation_en: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanasema: Lini ahadi hii, ikiwa mnasema kweli?
translation_en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Sema: Hakika ujuzi wake uko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu; na hakika mimi ni mwonyaji tu mwenye kubainisha.
translation_en: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini watakapo iona karibu, nyuso za walio kufuru zitahuzunishwa, na itasemwa: Hayo ndiyo mliyo kuwa mkiyaomba.
translation_en: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

arabic_text: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Sema: Mwaonaje, ikiwa Mwenyezi Mungu atanihiliki mimi na walio pamoja nami, au akiturehemu, ni nani atakaye walinda makafiri na adhabu chungu?
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Sema: Yeye ndiye Mwingi wa Rehema; tunamuamini Yeye, na juu yake tunategemea. Mtakuja jua ni nani aliye katika upotovu ulio dhaahiri.
translation_en: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

arabic_text: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_sw: Sema: Mwaonaje, yakiwa maji yenu yamedidimia chini, nani atakueleteeni maji yanayo miminika?
translation_en: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

arabic_text: نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
translation_sw: Nuun. Naapa kwa kalamu na yale wayaandikayo,
translation_en: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe,

arabic_text: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwa neema ya Mola wako Mlezi wewe si mwendawazimu.
translation_en: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika wewe una malipo yasiyo katika.
translation_en: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Na hakika wewe una tabia tukufu.
translation_en: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

arabic_text: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Karibu utaona, na wao wataona,
translation_en: So you will see and they will see

arabic_text: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
translation_sw: Ni nani kati yenu aliye pandwa na wazimu.
translation_en: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].

arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye Yeye ajuaye zaidi nani aliye ipotea Njia yake, na Yeye ndiye anaye wajua zaidi walio ongoka.
translation_en: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.

arabic_text: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Basi usiwat'ii wanao kadhibisha.
translation_en: Then do not obey the deniers.

arabic_text: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
translation_sw: Wanatamani lau unge lainisha ili nao wakulainishie.
translation_en: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].

arabic_text: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍۢ مَّهِينٍ
translation_sw: Wala usimt'ii kila mwingi wa kuapa wa kudharauliwa,
translation_en: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer

arabic_text: هَمَّازٍۢ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Mtapitapi, apitaye akifitini,
translation_en: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -

arabic_text: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_sw: Mwenye kuzuia kheri, dhaalimu, mwingi wa madhambi,
translation_en: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,

arabic_text: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
translation_sw: Mkavu, na juu ya hayo, mshari, amejipachika tu.
translation_en: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.

arabic_text: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
translation_sw: Ati kwa kuwa ana mali na watoto!
translation_en: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,

arabic_text: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Anapo somewa Aya zetu, husema: Hizi ni simulizi za uwongo za watu wa zamani!
translation_en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

arabic_text: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
translation_sw: Tutamtia kovu juu ya pua yake.
translation_en: We will brand him upon the snout.

arabic_text: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika tumewajaribu hawa kama tulivyo wajaribu wale wenye shamba, walipo apa kwamba watayavuna mazao yake itakapo kuwa asubuhi.
translation_en: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning

arabic_text: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
translation_sw: Wala hawakusema: Mungu akipenda!
translation_en: Without making exception.

arabic_text: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
translation_sw: Basi lilitokea tukio juu yake kutoka kwa Mola wako Mlezi, nao wamelala!
translation_en: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.

arabic_text: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
translation_sw: Likawa kama usiku wa giza.
translation_en: And it became as though reaped.

arabic_text: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_sw: Asubuhi wakaitana.
translation_en: And they called one another at morning,

arabic_text: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Ya kwamba nendeni kondeni mwenu ikiwa mnataka kuvuna.
translation_en: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."

arabic_text: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ
translation_sw: Basi walikwenda na huku wakinong'onezana,
translation_en: So they set out, while lowering their voices,

arabic_text: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Ya kuwa leo hata masikini mmoja asikuingilieni.
translation_en: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."

arabic_text: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍۢ قَٰدِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na walikwenda asubuhi, nao wameshikilia azimio hilo.
translation_en: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_sw: Basi walipo liona, wakasema: Hakika tumepotea!
translation_en: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;

arabic_text: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
translation_sw: Bali tumenyimwa!
translation_en: Rather, we have been deprived."

arabic_text: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_sw: Mbora wao akasema: Sikukwambieni, kwa nini hamumtakasi Mwenyezi Mungu?
translation_en: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]?' "

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ametakasika Mola wetu Mlezi! Hakika sisi tulikuwa wenye kudhulumu.
translation_en: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

arabic_text: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ
translation_sw: Basi wakakabiliana kulaumiana wao kwa wao.
translation_en: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ
translation_sw: Wakasema: Ole wetu! Tulikuwa tumeikiuka mipaka!
translation_en: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.

arabic_text: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
translation_sw: Asaa Mola wetu Mlezi akatubadilishia lilio bora kuliko hili. Hakika sisi ni wenye kurejea kwa Mola wetu Mlezi.
translation_en: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Namna hivi yanakuwa mateso, na bila ya shaka mateso ya Akhera ni makubwa zaidi, laiti wangeli jua!
translation_en: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

arabic_text: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_sw: Hakika wachamngu watakuwa na Bustani za neema kwa Mola wao Mlezi.
translation_en: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.

arabic_text: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Kwani tutawafanya Waislamu kama wakosefu?
translation_en: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

arabic_text: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_sw: Mna nini? Mnahukumu vipi?
translation_en: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?

arabic_text: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَٰبٌۭ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
translation_sw: Au mnacho kitabu ambacho ndani yake mnasoma?
translation_en: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn

arabic_text: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Kuwa mtapata humo mnayo yapenda?
translation_en: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?

arabic_text: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_sw: Au mnazo ahadi za viapo juu yetu za kufika Siku ya Kiyama ya kuwa hakika mtapata kila mnayo jihukumia?
translation_en: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?

arabic_text: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
translation_sw: Waulize: Ni nani miongoni mwao dhamini wa haya?
translation_en: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.

arabic_text: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Au wanao washirika? Basi wawalete washirika wao wakiwa wanasema kweli.
translation_en: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍۢ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_sw: Siku utakapo wekwa wazi mundi, na wataitwa kusujudu, lakini hawataweza,
translation_en: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able,

arabic_text: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ
translation_sw: Macho yao yatainama chini, fedheha itawafunika. Na hakika walikuwa wakiitwa wasujudu walipo kuwa wazima -
translation_en: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.

arabic_text: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Basi niache na wanao kadhibisha maneno haya! Tutawavutia kidogo kidogo kwa mahali wasipo pajua.
translation_en: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.

arabic_text: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
translation_sw: Na ninawapururia muhula; hakika hila zangu ni imara.
translation_en: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.

arabic_text: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
translation_sw: Au unawaomba ujira, na wao wanaemewa na gharama hiyo?
translation_en: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

arabic_text: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
translation_sw: Au iko kwao siri, basi wao wanaiandika?
translation_en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

arabic_text: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi ingojee hukumu ya Mola wako Mlezi, wala usiwe kama mmezwa na samaki, alipo nadi naye kazongwa.
translation_en: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed.

arabic_text: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ
translation_sw: Kama isingeli mfikia neema kutoka kwa Mola wake Mlezi, bila ya shaka angeli tupwa ufukweni naye ni mwenye kulaumiwa.
translation_en: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.

arabic_text: فَٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation_sw: Lakini Mola wake Mlezi alimteua na akamfanya miongoni mwa watu wema.
translation_en: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

arabic_text: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
translation_sw: Na walio kufuru hukaribia kukutelezesha kwa macho yao, wanapo sikia mawaidha, na wanasema: Hakika yeye ni mwendawazimu.
translation_en: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."

arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Na hayakuwa haya, ila ni ukumbusho kwa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.

arabic_text: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_sw: Tukio la haki.
translation_en: The Inevitable Reality -

arabic_text: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_sw: Nini hilo Tukio la haki?
translation_en: What is the Inevitable Reality?

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_sw: Na nini kitakujuulisha nini hilo Tukio la haki?
translation_en: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?

arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
translation_sw: Thamudi na A'di waliukadhibisha Msiba unao situsha.
translation_en: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity.

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
translation_sw: Basi Thamudi waliangamizwa kwa balaa kubwa mno.
translation_en: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍۢ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Na ama A'di waliangamizwa kwa upepo mkali usio zuilika.
translation_en: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind

arabic_text: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Alio wapelekea masiku saba, na siku nane, mfululizo bila ya kusita. Utaona watu wamepinduka kama kwamba ni magongo ya mitende yalio wazi ndani.
translation_en: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

arabic_text: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi je! Unamwona mmoja wao aliye baki?
translation_en: Then do you see of them any remains?

arabic_text: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
translation_sw: Na Firauni na walio mtangulia, na miji iliyo pinduliwa chini juu, walileta khatia.
translation_en: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.

arabic_text: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةًۭ رَّابِيَةً
translation_sw: Wakamuasi Mtume wa Mola wao Mlezi, ndipo Yeye Mola akawakamata kwa mkamato ulio zidi nguvu.
translation_en: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].

arabic_text: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
translation_sw: Maji yalipo furika Sisi tulikupandisheni katika safina,
translation_en: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship

arabic_text: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌۭ وَٰعِيَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Ili tuyafanye hayo kuwa ni waadhi kwenu na kila sikio linalo sikia liyahifadhi.
translation_en: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Na litapo pulizwa barugumu mpulizo mmoja tu,
translation_en: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

arabic_text: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ
translation_sw: Na ardhi na milima ikaondolewa, na ikavunjwa kwa mvunjo mmoja,
translation_en: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -

arabic_text: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo ndio Tukio litatukia.
translation_en: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,

arabic_text: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاهِيَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Na mbingu zitapasuka, kwani siku hiyo zitakuwa dhaifu kabisa.
translation_en: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.

arabic_text: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Na Malaika watakuwa pembezoni mwa mbingu; na wanane juu ya hawa watakuwa wamebeba Kiti cha Enzi cha Mola wako Mlezi.
translation_en: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].

arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo mtahudhurishwa - haitafichika siri yoyote yenu.
translation_en: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
translation_sw: Basi ama atakaye pewa kitabu chake kwa mkono wake wa kulia, atasema: Haya someni kitabu changu!
translation_en: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!

arabic_text: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_sw: Hakika nalijua ya kuwa nitapokea hisabu yangu.
translation_en: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."

arabic_text: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi yeye atakuwa katika maisha ya kupendeza,
translation_en: So he will be in a pleasant life -

arabic_text: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Katika Bustani ya juu,
translation_en: In an elevated garden,

arabic_text: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Matunda yake yakaribu.
translation_en: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.

arabic_text: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
translation_sw: Waambiwe: Kuleni na mnywe kwa furaha kwa sababu ya mlivyo tanguliza katika siku zilizo pita.
translation_en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
translation_sw: Na ama atakaye pewa kitabu chake katika mkono wake wa kushoto, basi yeye atasema: Laiti nisingeli pewa kitabu changu!
translation_en: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

arabic_text: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_sw: Wala nisingeli jua nini hisabu yangu.
translation_en: And had not known what is my account.

arabic_text: يَٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
translation_sw: Laiti mauti ndiyo yangeli kuwa ya kunimaliza kabisa.
translation_en: I wish my death had been the decisive one.

arabic_text: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
translation_sw: Mali yangu hayakunifaa kitu.
translation_en: My wealth has not availed me.

arabic_text: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَٰنِيَهْ
translation_sw: Madaraka yangu yamenipotea.
translation_en: Gone from me is my authority."

arabic_text: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
translation_sw: (Pasemwe): Mshikeni! Mtieni pingu!
translation_en: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
translation_sw: Kisha mtupeni Motoni!
translation_en: Then into Hellfire drive him.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
translation_sw: Tena mtatizeni katika mnyororo wenye urefu wa dhiraa sabiini!
translation_en: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_sw: Kwani huyo hakika alikuwa hamuamini Mwenyezi Mungu Mtukufu,
translation_en: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great,

arabic_text: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_sw: Wala hahimizi kulisha masikini.
translation_en: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

arabic_text: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi leo hapa hana jamaa wa kumwonea uchungu,
translation_en: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

arabic_text: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Wala hana chakula ila usaha wa watu wa Motoni.
translation_en: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;

arabic_text: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَٰطِـُٔونَ
translation_sw: Chakula hicho hawakili ila wakosefu.
translation_en: None will eat it except the sinners.

arabic_text: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Basi naapa kwa mnavyo viona,
translation_en: So I swear by what you see

arabic_text: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na msivyo viona,
translation_en: And what you do not see

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika hii ni kauli iliyo letwa na Mjumbe mwenye hishima.
translation_en: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.

arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Wala si kauli ya mtunga mashairi. Ni machache sana mnayo yaamini.
translation_en: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.

arabic_text: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_sw: Wala si kauli ya kuhani. Ni machache mnayo yakumbuka.
translation_en: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.

arabic_text: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Ni uteremsho utokao kwa Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
translation_sw: Na lau kama angeli tuzulia baadhi ya maneno tu,
translation_en: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,

arabic_text: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_sw: Bila ya shaka tungeli mshika kwa mkono wa kulia,
translation_en: We would have seized him by the right hand;

arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha kwa hakika tungeli mkata mshipa mkubwa wa moyo!
translation_en: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.

arabic_text: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
translation_sw: Na hapana yeyote katika nyinyi ambaye angeli weza kutuzuia.
translation_en: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika hii ni mawaidha kwa wachamngu.
translation_en: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika Sisi bila ya shaka tunajua kwamba miongoni mwenu wapo wanao kadhibisha.
translation_en: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika bila ya shaka itakuwa ni majuto kwa wanao kataa.
translation_en: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation_sw: Na hakika hii bila ya shaka ni haki ya yakini.
translation_en: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.

arabic_text: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_sw: Basi litakase jina la Mola wako Mlezi Mtukufu.
translation_en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

arabic_text: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍۢ وَاقِعٍۢ
translation_sw: Muulizaji aliuliza juu ya adhabu itakayo tokea,
translation_en: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen

arabic_text: لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌۭ
translation_sw: Kwa makafiri - ambayo hapana awezaye kuizuia -
translation_en: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.

arabic_text: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
translation_sw: Kutoka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu Mwenye mbingu za daraja.
translation_en: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent.

arabic_text: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Malaika na Roho hupanda kwendea kwake katika siku ambayo kadiri yake ni miaka khamsini elfu!
translation_en: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.

arabic_text: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًۭا جَمِيلًا
translation_sw: Basi subiri kwa subira njema.
translation_en: So be patient with gracious patience.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika wao wanaiona iko mbali,
translation_en: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,

arabic_text: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًۭا
translation_sw: Na Sisi tunaiona iko karibu.
translation_en: But We see it [as] near.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ
translation_sw: Siku ambayo mbingu zitakapo kuwa kama maadeni iliyo yayushwa.
translation_en: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,

arabic_text: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ
translation_sw: Na milima itakuwa kama sufi.
translation_en: And the mountains will be like wool,

arabic_text: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Wala jamaa hatamuuliza jamaa yake.
translation_en: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,

arabic_text: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
translation_sw: Ijapo kuwa wataonyeshwa waonane. Atatamani mkosefu lau ajikomboe na adhabu ya siku hiyo kwa kuwatoa fidia wanawe,
translation_en: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children

arabic_text: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
translation_sw: Na mkewe, na nduguye,
translation_en: And his wife and his brother

arabic_text: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
translation_sw: Na jamaa zake walio kuwa wakimkimu,
translation_en: And his nearest kindred who shelter him

arabic_text: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
translation_sw: Na wote waliomo duniani, kisha aokoke yeye.
translation_en: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.

arabic_text: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
translation_sw: La, hasha! Kwa hakika huo ni Moto mkali kabisa,
translation_en: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],

arabic_text: نَزَّاعَةًۭ لِّلشَّوَىٰ
translation_sw: Unao babua ngozi ya kichwa!
translation_en: A remover of exteriors.

arabic_text: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_sw: Utamwita kila aliye geuza mgongo na akageuka.
translation_en: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]

arabic_text: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na akakusanya mali, kisha akayahifadhi.
translation_en: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.

arabic_text: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
translation_sw: Hakika mtu ameumbwa na papara.
translation_en: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:

arabic_text: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًۭا
translation_sw: Inapo mgusa shari hupapatika.
translation_en: When evil touches him, impatient,

arabic_text: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
translation_sw: Na inapo mgusa kheri huizuilia.
translation_en: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],

arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa wanao sali,
translation_en: Except the observers of prayer -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao wanadumisha Sala zao,
translation_en: Those who are constant in their prayer

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
translation_sw: Na ambao katika mali yao iko haki maalumu
translation_en: And those within whose wealth is a known right

arabic_text: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_sw: Kwa mwenye kuomba na anaye jizuilia kuomba;
translation_en: For the petitioner and the deprived -

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Na ambao wanaisadiki Siku ya Malipo,
translation_en: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambao wanaiogopa adhabu itokayo kwa Mola wao Mlezi.
translation_en: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -

arabic_text: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika adhabu ya Mola wao Mlezi si ya kuaminika nayo.
translation_en: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambao wanahifadhi tupu zao.
translation_en: And those who guard their private parts

arabic_text: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa kwa wake zao, au iliyo wamiliki mikono yao ya kuume, basi hao hawalaumiwi -
translation_en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -

arabic_text: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini wanao taka kinyume ya haya, basi hao ndio wanao ruka mipaka.
translation_en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambao wanazichunga amana zao na ahadi zao,
translation_en: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambao wanasimama imara katika ushahidi wao,
translation_en: And those who are in their testimonies upright

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
translation_sw: Na ambao wanazihifadhi Sala zao.
translation_en: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_sw: Hao ndio watakao hishimiwa Peponi.
translation_en: They will be in gardens, honored.

arabic_text: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
translation_sw: Wana nini wale walio kufuru wanakutumbulia macho tu?
translation_en: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad],

arabic_text: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
translation_sw: Makundi kwa makundi upande wa kulia na upande wa kushoto!
translation_en: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?

arabic_text: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwani kila mmoja wao anatumai kuingizwa katika Pepo ya neema?
translation_en: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?

arabic_text: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: La, hasha! Hakika Sisi tumewaumba kutokana na wanacho kijua.
translation_en: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.

arabic_text: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
translation_sw: Basi naapa kwa Mola Mlezi wa mashariki zote na magharibi zote kwamba Sisi tunaweza
translation_en: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able

arabic_text: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
translation_sw: Kuwabadili kwa walio bora kuliko wao; na Sisi hatushindwi.
translation_en: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.

arabic_text: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Basi waache wapige porojo na wacheze, mpaka wakutane na siku yao wanayo ahidiwa,
translation_en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ
translation_sw: Siku watakapotoka makaburini kwa upesi kama kwamba wanakimbilia mfundo,
translation_en: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.

arabic_text: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_sw: Macho yao yatainama, fedheha itawafunika. Hiyo ndiyo Siku waliyo kuwa wakiahidiwa.
translation_en: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tulimtuma Nuh'u kwa watu wake: Uwaonye kaumu yako kabla ya kuwafikia adhabu chungu.
translation_en: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
translation_sw: Akasema: Enyi watu wangu! Kwa hakika mimi ni mwonyaji wa dhaahiri kwenu,
translation_en: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,

arabic_text: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_sw: Ya kwamba mumuabudu Mwenyezi Mungu, na mumche Yeye, na mumt'ii.
translation_en: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.

arabic_text: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Atakughufirieni madhambi yenu, na atakuakhirisheni mpaka muda ulio wekwa. Hakika muda wa Mwenyezi Mungu utapo fika haucheleweshwi. Laiti mngejua!
translation_en: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
translation_sw: Akasema: Ee Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika mimi nimewaita watu wangu usiku na mchana,
translation_en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

arabic_text: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا
translation_sw: Lakini wito wangu haukuwazidisha ila kukimbia.
translation_en: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.

arabic_text: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا
translation_sw: Na hakika mimi kila nilipo waita ili upate kuwaghufiria, walijiziba masikio yao kwa vidole vyao, na wakajigubika nguo zao, na wakakamia, na wakatakabari vikubwa mno!
translation_en: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًۭا
translation_sw: Tena niliwaita kwa uwazi,
translation_en: Then I invited them publicly.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا
translation_sw: Kisha nikawatangazia kwa kelele, tena nikasema nao kwa siri.
translation_en: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

arabic_text: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا
translation_sw: Nikasema: Ombeni msamaha kwa Mola wenu Mlezi; hakika Yeye ni Mwingi wa kusamehe.
translation_en: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

arabic_text: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا
translation_sw: Atakuleteeni mvua inyeshe mfululizo.
translation_en: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

arabic_text: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًۭا
translation_sw: Na atakupeni mali na wana, na atakupeni mabustani na atakufanyieni mito.
translation_en: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

arabic_text: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا
translation_sw: Mna nini hamweki heshima ya Mwenyezi Mungu?
translation_en: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

arabic_text: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
translation_sw: Na hali Yeye kakuumbeni daraja baada ya daraja?
translation_en: While He has created you in stages?

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا
translation_sw: Kwani hamwoni jinsi Mwenyezi Mungu alivyo ziumba mbingu saba kwa matabaka?
translation_en: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers

arabic_text: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا
translation_sw: Na akaufanya mwezi ndani yake uwe nuru, na akalifanya jua kuwa taa?
translation_en: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu amekuotesheni katika ardhi kama mimea.
translation_en: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًۭا
translation_sw: Kisha atakurudsheni humo na atakutoeni tena.
translation_en: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu amekukunjulieni ardhi kama busati.
translation_en: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse

arabic_text: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا
translation_sw: Ili mtembee humo katika njia zilizo pana.
translation_en: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "

arabic_text: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
translation_sw: Nuh'u akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika hao wameniasi, na wamemfuata yule ambaye mali yake na wanawe hawakumzidishia ila khasara.
translation_en: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

arabic_text: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا كُبَّارًۭا
translation_sw: Na wakapanga vitimbi vikubwa.
translation_en: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا
