translation_sw: Na wakasema: Msiwaache miungu yenu, wala msimwache Wadda wala Suwaa' wala Yaghutha, wala Yau'qa, wala Nasra.
translation_en: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.

arabic_text: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًۭا
translation_sw: Na hao walikwisha wapoteza wengi, wala usiwazidishie walio dhulumu ila kupotea.
translation_en: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."

arabic_text: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
translation_sw: Basi kwa ajili ya makosa yao waligharikishwa wakaingizwa Motoni, wala hawakuwapata wa kuwanusuru badala ya Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.

arabic_text: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
translation_sw: Na Nuh'u akasema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Usimwache juu ya ardhi mkaazi wake yeyote katika makafiri!
translation_en: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.

arabic_text: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika ukiwaacha watawapoteza waja wako, wala wao hawatazaa ila waovu makafiri.
translation_en: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.

arabic_text: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
translation_sw: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nighufirie mimi na wazazi wangu, na kila aliye ingia nyumbani mwangu kuwa ni mwenye kuamini, na Waumini wote wanaume, na Waumini wanawake. Na wala usiwazidishie walio dhulumu ila kupotea.
translation_en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."

arabic_text: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا
translation_sw: Sema: Imefunuliwa kwangu ya kuwa kundi moja la majini lilisikiliza, na likasema: Hakika sisi tumeisikia Qur'ani ya ajabu!
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.

arabic_text: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
translation_sw: Inaongoza kwenye uwongofu, kwa hivyo tumeiamini, wala hatutamshirikisha yeyote na Mola wetu Mlezi.
translation_en: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika utukufu wa Mola wetu Mlezi umetukuka kabisa; hana mke wala mwana.
translation_en: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًۭا
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika wapumbavu miongoni mwetu walikuwa wakisema uwongo ulio pindukia mipaka juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
translation_sw: Nasi tulidhani kuwa watu na majini hawamzulii uwongo Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًۭا
translation_sw: Na hakika walikuwako wanaume katika watu walio kuwa wakitafuta kujikinga kwa wanaume wa kijini; kwa hivyo wakawazidisha madhambi.
translation_en: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًۭا
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika wao walidhani, kama mlivyo dhani nyinyi, ya kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu hatamleta Mtume.
translation_en: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].

arabic_text: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَشُهُبًۭا
translation_sw: Nasi tulizigusa mbingu, na tukaziona zimejaa walinzi wenye nguvu na vimondo.
translation_en: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا
translation_sw: Na hakika tulikuwa tukikaa humo katika baadhi ya makao ili kusikiliza; lakini sasa anaye taka kusikiliza atakuta kimondo kinamvizia!
translation_en: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا
translation_sw: Nasi hatujui kama wanatakiwa shari wale wanao kaa kwenye ardhi au Mola wao Mlezi anawatakia uwongofu.
translation_en: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
translation_sw: Na hakika katika sisi wamo walio wema, na wengine wetu ni kinyume na hivyo. Tumekuwa njia mbali mbali.
translation_en: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا
translation_sw: Nasi tulijua kuwa hatutomshinda Mwenyezi Mungu duniani, wala hatuwezi kumponyoka kwa kukimbia.
translation_en: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًۭا وَلَا رَهَقًۭا
translation_sw: Nasi tulipo usikia uwongofu tuliuamini. Basi mwenye kumuamini Mola wake Mlezi basi haogopi kupunjwa wala kudhulumiwa.
translation_en: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا
translation_sw: Na hakika wamo katika sisi Waislamu, na wamo kati yetu wanao acha haki. Basi walio silimu, hao ndio walio tafuta uwongofu.
translation_en: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا
translation_sw: Na ama wanao acha haki, hao watakuwa kuni za Jahannamu.
translation_en: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

arabic_text: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا
translation_sw: Na lau kama wangeli simama sawasawa juu ya njia tungeli wanywesha maji kwa wingi,
translation_en: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision

arabic_text: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا
translation_sw: Ili tuwajaribu kwa hayo. Na anaye puuza kumkumbuka Mola wake Mlezi atamsukuma kwenye adhabu ngumu.
translation_en: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًۭا
translation_sw: Na hakika misikiti ni ya Mwenyezi Mungu, basi msimuabudu yeyote pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu.
translation_en: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone.

arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا
translation_sw: Na hakika Mja wa Mwenyezi Mungu alipo simama kumwomba, wao walikuwa karibu kumzonga!
translation_en: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا
translation_sw: Sema: Hakika mimi namwomba Mola wangu Mlezi, wala simshirikishi Yeye na yeyote.
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا رَشَدًۭا
translation_sw: Sema: Mimi sina mamlaka ya kukudhuruni wala kukuongozeni.
translation_en: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
translation_sw: Sema: Hakika hapana yeyote awezae kunilinda na Mwenyezi Mungu, wala sitapata pa kukimbilia isipo kuwa kwake Yeye tu.
translation_en: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.

arabic_text: إِلَّا بَلَٰغًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
translation_sw: Ila nifikishe Ujumbe utokao kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na risala zake. Na wenye kumuasi Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake, basi hakika hao watapata Moto wa Jahannamu wadumu humo milele.
translation_en: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا
translation_sw: Hata watakapo yaona wanayo ahidiwa, ndipo watakapo jua ni nani mwenye msaidizi dhaifu, na mchache wa idadi.
translation_en: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
translation_sw: Sema: Sijui kama yapo karibu hayo mnayo ahidiwa, au Mola wangu Mlezi atayawekea muda mrefu.
translation_en: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."

arabic_text: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye Mwenye kujua ya siri, wala hamdhihirishii yeyote siri yake,
translation_en: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

arabic_text: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa Mtume wake aliye mridhia. Naye huyo humwekea walinzi mbele yake na nyuma yake.
translation_en: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers

arabic_text: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
translation_sw: Ili Yeye ajue kwamba wao wamefikisha ujumbe wa Mola wao Mlezi, na Yeye anayajua vyema yote walio nayo, na amedhibiti idadi ya kila kitu.
translation_en: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
translation_sw: Ewe uliye jifunika!
translation_en: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],

arabic_text: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Kesha usiku kucha, ila kidogo tu!
translation_en: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -

arabic_text: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
translation_sw: Nusu yake, au ipunguze kidogo.
translation_en: Half of it - or subtract from it a little

arabic_text: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
translation_sw: Au izidishe - na soma Qur'ani kwa utaratibu na utungo.
translation_en: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.

arabic_text: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tutakuteremshia kauli nzito.
translation_en: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.

arabic_text: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
translation_sw: Hakika kuamka usiku kunawafikiana zaidi na moyo, na maneno yake yanatua zaidi.
translation_en: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.

arabic_text: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Kwani hakika mchana una shughuli nyingi.
translation_en: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.

arabic_text: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Na lidhukuru jina la Mola wako Mlezi, na ujitolee kwake kwa ukamilifu.
translation_en: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.

arabic_text: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Mola Mlezi wa mashariki na magharibi, hapana mungu isipo kuwa Yeye, basi mfanye kuwa Mtegemewa wako.
translation_en: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.

arabic_text: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Na vumilia hayo wayasemayo, na jitenge nao kwa vizuri.
translation_en: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.

arabic_text: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
translation_sw: Na niache Mimi na hao wanao kanusha, walio neemeka; na wape muhula kidogo!
translation_en: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.

arabic_text: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tunazo pingu nzito na Moto unao waka kwa ukali kabisa!
translation_en: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire

arabic_text: وَطَعَامًۭا ذَا غُصَّةٍۢ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Na chakula kinacho kwama kooni, na adhabu inayo umiza.
translation_en: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا
translation_sw: Siku ambayo ardhi itatikiswa na milima pia, na milima itakuwa kama tifutifu la mchanga!
translation_en: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumemtuma kwenu Mtume aliye shahidi juu yenu, kama tulivyo mtuma Mtume kwa Firauni.
translation_en: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

arabic_text: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Lakini Firauni alimuasi huyo Mtume, basi tukamshika mshiko wa mateso.
translation_en: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.

arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
translation_sw: Basi nyinyi mkikufuru, mtawezaje kujikinga na Siku ambayo itawafanya watoto wadogo waote mvi?
translation_en: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?

arabic_text: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
translation_sw: Hapo mbingu zitapasuka! Ahadi yake itakuwa imetekelezwa.
translation_en: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_sw: Kwa hakika hili ni kumbusho. Mwenye kutaka atashika njia ya kwendea kwa Mola wake Mlezi.
translation_en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.

arabic_text: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ
translation_sw: Hakika Mola wako Mlezi anajua ya kuwa hakika wewe unakesha karibu na thuluthi mbili za usiku, na nusu yake, na thuluthi yake. Na baadhi ya watu walio pamoja nawe kadhaalika. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye anaye ukadiria usiku na mchana. Anajua kuwa hamwezi kuweka hisabu, basi amekusameheni. Basi someni kilicho chepesi katika Qur'ani. Anajua ya kuwa baadhi yenu watakuwa wagonjwa, na wengine wanasafiri katika ardhi wakitafuta fadhila ya Mwenyezi Mungu, na wengine wanapigana katika Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Kwa hivyo someni kilicho chepesi humo, na mshike Sala, na toeni Zaka, na mkopesheni Mwenyezi Mungu mkopo mwema. Na kheri yoyote mnayo itanguliza kwa ajili ya nafsi zenu mtaikuta kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, imekuwa bora zaidi, na ina thawabu kubwa sana. Na mtakeni msamaha Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusamehe Mwenye kurehemu.
translation_en: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
translation_sw: Ewe uliye jigubika!
translation_en: O you who covers himself [with a garment],

arabic_text: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
translation_sw: Simama uonye!
translation_en: Arise and warn

arabic_text: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
translation_sw: Na Mola wako Mlezi mtukuze!
translation_en: And your Lord glorify

arabic_text: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
translation_sw: Na nguo zako, zisafishe.
translation_en: And your clothing purify

arabic_text: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
translation_sw: Na yaliyo machafu yahame!
translation_en: And uncleanliness avoid

arabic_text: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
translation_sw: Wala usitoe kwa kutaraji kuzidishiwa.
translation_en: And do not confer favor to acquire more

arabic_text: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
translation_sw: Na kwa ajili ya Mola wako Mlezi, subiri!
translation_en: But for your Lord be patient.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
translation_sw: Basi litapo pulizwa barugumu,
translation_en: And when the trumpet is blown,

arabic_text: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo, basi, itakuwa siku ngumu.
translation_en: That Day will be a difficult day

arabic_text: عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwa makafiri haitakuwa nyepesi.
translation_en: For the disbelievers - not easy.

arabic_text: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًۭا
translation_sw: Niache peke yangu na niliye muumba;
translation_en: Leave Me with the one I created alone

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًۭا مَّمْدُودًۭا
translation_sw: Na nikamjaalia awe na mali mengi,
translation_en: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

arabic_text: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًۭا
translation_sw: Na wana wanao onekana,
translation_en: And children present [with him]

arabic_text: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًۭا
translation_sw: Na nikamtgenezea mambo vizuri kabisa.
translation_en: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].

arabic_text: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
translation_sw: Kisha anatumai nimzidishie!
translation_en: Then he desires that I should add more.

arabic_text: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِءَايَٰتِنَا عَنِيدًۭا
translation_sw: Hasha! Kwani hakika yeye alikuwa akizifanyia inadi Aya zetu!
translation_en: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

arabic_text: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
translation_sw: Nitamtesa kwa mateso yasio wezekana.
translation_en: I will cover him with arduous torment.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
translation_sw: Kwani hakika yeye alifikiri na akapima.
translation_en: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.

arabic_text: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_sw: Basi ameangamia! Vipi alivyo pima!
translation_en: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_sw: Tena ameangamia! Vipi alivyo pima!
translation_en: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
translation_sw: Kisha akatazama,
translation_en: Then he considered [again];

arabic_text: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
translation_sw: Kisha akakunja kipaji, na akanuna.
translation_en: Then he frowned and scowled;

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
translation_sw: Kisha akaipa kisogo haki, na akatakabari.
translation_en: Then he turned back and was arrogant

arabic_text: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ
translation_sw: Na akasema: Haya si chochote ila ni uchawi ulio nukuliwa.
translation_en: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].

arabic_text: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
translation_sw: Haya si chochote ila kauli ya binaadamu.
translation_en: This is not but the word of a human being."

arabic_text: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
translation_sw: Nitakuja mtia kwenye Moto wa Saqar.
translation_en: I will drive him into Saqar.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
translation_sw: Na nini kitakujuulisha ni nini huo Moto wa Saqar?
translation_en: And what can make you know what is Saqar?

arabic_text: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
translation_sw: Haubakishi wala hausazi.
translation_en: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],

arabic_text: لَوَّاحَةٌۭ لِّلْبَشَرِ
translation_sw: Unababua ngozi iwe nyeusi.
translation_en: Blackening the skins.

arabic_text: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
translation_sw: Juu yake wapo kumi na tisa.
translation_en: Over it are nineteen [angels].

arabic_text: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
translation_sw: Na hatukuwafanya walinzi wa Motoni ila ni Malaika, wala hatukuifanya idadi yao hiyo ila kuwatatanisha walio kufuru, wapate kuwa na yakini walio pewa Kitabu, na wazidi Imani wale walio amini, wala wasiwe na shaka walio pewa Kitabu na Waumini, na wapate kusema wenye maradhi katika nyoyo zao na makafiri: Mwenyezi Mungu amekusudia nini kwa mfano huu? Ndio kama hivyo Mwenyezi Mungu humwacha apotee amtakaye, na humwongoa amtakaye. Na hapana yeyote anaye jua majeshi ya Mola wako Mlezi ila Yeye tu. Na haya si chochote ila ni ukumbusho kwa binaadamu.
translation_en: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.

arabic_text: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
translation_sw: Hasha! Naapa kwa mwezi!
translation_en: No! By the moon

arabic_text: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
translation_sw: Na kwa usiku unapo kucha!
translation_en: And [by] the night when it departs

arabic_text: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
translation_sw: Na kwa asubuhi inapo pambazuka!
translation_en: And [by] the morning when it brightens,

arabic_text: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
translation_sw: Hakika huo Moto ni katika mambo yaliyo makubwa kabisa!
translation_en: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]

arabic_text: نَذِيرًۭا لِّلْبَشَرِ
translation_sw: Ni onyo kwa binaadamu,
translation_en: As a warning to humanity -

arabic_text: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
translation_sw: Kwa anaye taka miongoni mwenu kutangulia au kuchelewa.
translation_en: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.

arabic_text: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
translation_sw: Kila nafsi imo rahanini kwa mabaya iliyo yachuma.
translation_en: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained

arabic_text: إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa watu wa kuliani.
translation_en: Except the companions of the right,

arabic_text: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_sw: Hao watakuwa katika Mabustani, wawe wanaulizana
translation_en: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

arabic_text: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Khabari za wakosefu:
translation_en: About the criminals,

arabic_text: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
translation_sw: Ni nini kilicho kupelekeni Motoni?
translation_en: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_sw: Waseme: Hatukuwa miongoni walio kuwa wakisali.
translation_en: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,

arabic_text: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
translation_sw: Wala hatukuwa tukiwalisha masikini.
translation_en: Nor did we used to feed the poor.

arabic_text: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
translation_sw: Na tulikuwa tukizama pamoja na walio zama katika maovu.
translation_en: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],

arabic_text: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Na tulikuwa tukiikanusha siku ya malipo.
translation_en: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
translation_sw: Mpaka yakini ilipo tufikia.
translation_en: Until there came to us the certainty."

arabic_text: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
translation_sw: Basi hautawafaa kitu uombezi wa waombezi.
translation_en: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

arabic_text: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
translation_sw: Basi wana nini hata wanapuuza onyo hili?
translation_en: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away

arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Kama kwamba wao ni mapunda walio timuliwa,
translation_en: As if they were alarmed donkeys

arabic_text: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
translation_sw: Wanao mkimbia simba!
translation_en: Fleeing from a lion?

arabic_text: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ
translation_sw: Ati kila mmoja katika wao anataka apewe nyaraka zilizo funuliwa.
translation_en: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.

arabic_text: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
translation_sw: Hasha! Kwani wao hawaiogopi Akhera?
translation_en: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Hasha! Kwa hakika huu ni ukumbusho!
translation_en: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder

arabic_text: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_sw: Basi anaye taka atakumbuka.
translation_en: Then whoever wills will remember it.

arabic_text: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
translation_sw: Na hawatakumbuka isipo kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu atake. Uchamngu ni kwake Yeye, na msamaha ni wake Yeye.
translation_en: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.

arabic_text: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
translation_sw: Ninaapa kwa Siku ya Kiyama!
translation_en: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

arabic_text: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
translation_sw: Na ninaapa kwa nafsi inayo jilaumu!
translation_en: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].

arabic_text: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
translation_sw: Anadhani mtu kuwa Sisi hatutaikusanya mifupa yake?
translation_en: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

arabic_text: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
translation_sw: Kwani! Sisi tunaweza hata kuziweka sawa sawa ncha za vidole vyake!
translation_en: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.

arabic_text: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
translation_sw: Lakini mtu anataka tu kuendelea na maasi kwa siku zilioko mbele yake.
translation_en: But man desires to continue in sin.

arabic_text: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
translation_sw: Anauliza: Lini itakuwa hiyo Siku ya Kiyama?
translation_en: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

arabic_text: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
translation_sw: Basi jicho litapo dawaa,
translation_en: So when vision is dazzled

arabic_text: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_sw: Na mwezi utapo patwa,
translation_en: And the moon darkens

arabic_text: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_sw: Na likakusanywa jua na mwezi,
translation_en: And the sun and the moon are joined,

arabic_text: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo mtu atasema: Yako wapi makimbilio?
translation_en: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

arabic_text: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
translation_sw: La! Hapana pa kukimbilia!
translation_en: No! There is no refuge.

arabic_text: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo pa kutua ni kwa Mola wako Mlezi tu.
translation_en: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

arabic_text: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo ataambiwa aliyo yatanguliza na aliyo yaakhirisha.
translation_en: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.

arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Bali mtu ni hoja juu ya nafsi yake.
translation_en: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,

arabic_text: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
translation_sw: Na ingawa atatoa chungu ya udhuru.
translation_en: Even if he presents his excuses.

arabic_text: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
translation_sw: Usiutikisie huu wahyi ulimi wako kwa kuufanyia haraka.
translation_en: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.

arabic_text: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_sw: Hakika ni juu yetu kuukusanya na kuusomesha.
translation_en: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_sw: Tunapo usoma, basi nawe fuatiliza kusoma kwake.
translation_en: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
translation_sw: Kisha ni juu yetu kuubainisha.
translation_en: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].

arabic_text: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
translation_sw: Hasha! Bali nyinyi mnapenda maisha ya duniani,
translation_en: No! But you love the immediate

arabic_text: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
translation_sw: Na mnaacha maisha ya Akhera.
translation_en: And leave the Hereafter.

arabic_text: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاضِرَةٌ
translation_sw: Zipo nyuso siku hiyo zitao ng'ara,
translation_en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,

arabic_text: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Zinamwangallia Mola wao Mlezi.
translation_en: Looking at their Lord.

arabic_text: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Na zipo nyuso siku hiyo zitakao kunjana.
translation_en: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,

arabic_text: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Zitajua ya kuwa zitafikiwa na livunjalo uti wa mgongo.
translation_en: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.

arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
translation_sw: La, hasha! (Roho) itakapo fikia kwenye mafupa ya koo,
translation_en: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones

arabic_text: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍۢ
translation_sw: Na pakasemwa: Nani wa kumganga?
translation_en: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"

arabic_text: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
translation_sw: Na mwenyewe akajua kwa hakika kuwa huko ndiko kufariki;
translation_en: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation

arabic_text: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
translation_sw: Na utapo ambatishwa muundi kwa muundi,
translation_en: And the leg is wound about the leg,

arabic_text: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo ndiyo kuchungwa kupelekwa kwa Mola wako Mlezi!
translation_en: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.

arabic_text: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
translation_sw: Kwa sababu hakusadiki, wala hakusali.
translation_en: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.

arabic_text: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_sw: Bali alikanusha, na akageuka.
translation_en: But [instead], he denied and turned away.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
translation_sw: Kisha akenda kwa ahali zake kwa matao.
translation_en: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].

arabic_text: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
translation_sw: Ole wako, ole wako!
translation_en: Woe to you, and woe!

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Kisha Ole wako, ole wako!
translation_en: Then woe to you, and woe!

arabic_text: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
translation_sw: Ati anadhani binaadamu kuwa ataachwa bure?
translation_en: Does man think that he will be left neglected?

arabic_text: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ
translation_sw: Kwani hakuwa yeye tone ya manii lilio shushwa?
translation_en: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?

arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_sw: Kisha akawa kidonge cha damu, tena Mwenyezi Mungu akamuumba na akamtengeneza vilivyo.
translation_en: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]

arabic_text: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Kisha akamfanya namna mbili, mwanamume na mwanamke.
translation_en: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

arabic_text: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
translation_sw: Je! Huyo hakuwa ni Muweza wa kufufua wafu?
translation_en: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?

arabic_text: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
translation_sw: Hakika kilimpitia binaadamu kipindi katika zama ambacho kwamba hakuwa kitu kinacho tajwa.
translation_en: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

arabic_text: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumemuumba mtu kutokana na mbegu ya uhai iliyo changanyika, tumfanyie mtihani. Kwa hivyo tukamfanya mwenye kusikia, mwenye kuona.
translation_en: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

arabic_text: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumembainishia Njia. Ama ni mwenye kushukuru, au mwenye kukufuru.
translation_en: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumewaandalia makafiri minyororo na pingu na Moto mkali.
translation_en: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
translation_sw: Hakika watu wema watakunywa katika vinywaji vilivyo changanyika na kafuri,
translation_en: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,

arabic_text: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Ni chemchem watakao inywa waja wa Mwenyezi Mungu, wakiifanya imiminike kwa wingi.
translation_en: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

arabic_text: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Wanatimiza ahadi, na wanaiogopa siku ambayo shari yake inaenea sana,
translation_en: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

arabic_text: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
translation_sw: Na huwalisha chakula, juu ya kukipenda kwake, masikini, na yatima, na wafungwa.
translation_en: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
translation_sw: Hakika sisi tunakulisheni kwa wajihi wa Mwenyezi Mungu. Hatutaki kwenu malipo wala shukrani.
translation_en: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

arabic_text: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika sisi tunaiogopa kwa Mola wetu Mlezi hiyo siku yenye shida na taabu.
translation_en: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

arabic_text: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
translation_sw: Basi Mwenyezi Mungu atawalinda na shari ya siku hiyo, na atawakutanisha na raha na furaha.
translation_en: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

arabic_text: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Na atawajazi Bustani za Peponi na maguo ya hariri kwa vile walivyo subiri.
translation_en: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

arabic_text: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Humo wataegemea juu ya viti vya enzi, hawataona humo jua kali wala baridi kali.
translation_en: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

arabic_text: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Na vivuli vyake vitakuwa karibu yao, na mashada ya matunda yataning'inia mpaka chini.
translation_en: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

arabic_text: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
translation_sw: Na watapitishiwa vyombo vya fedha na vikombe vya vigae,
translation_en: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

arabic_text: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Vya fedha safi kama kiyoo, wamevipima kwa vipimo.
translation_en: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

arabic_text: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
translation_sw: Na humo watanyweshwa kinywaji kilicho changanyika na tangawizi.
translation_en: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

arabic_text: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Hiyo ni chemchem iliyo humo inaitwa Salsabil.
translation_en: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.

arabic_text: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na watawazungukia kuwatumikia wavulana wasio pevuka, ukiwaona utawafikiri ni lulu zilizo tawanywa.
translation_en: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
translation_sw: Na utakapo yaona, utakuwa umeona neema na ufalme mkubwa.
translation_en: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

arabic_text: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
translation_sw: Juu yao zipo nguo za hariri laini za kijani kibichi, na hariri nzito ya at'ilasi. Na watavikwa vikuku vya fedha, na Mola wao Mlezi atawanywesha kinywaji safi kabisa.
translation_en: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
translation_sw: Hakika haya ni malipo yenu; na juhudi zenu zimekubaliwa.
translation_en: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

arabic_text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumekuteremshia Qur'ani kidogo kidogo.
translation_en: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.

arabic_text: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
translation_sw: Basi ngojea hukumu ya Mola wako Mlezi wala usimt'ii miongoni mwao mwenye dhambi au mwenye kufuru.
translation_en: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

arabic_text: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Na likumbuke jina la Mola wako Mlezi asubuhi na jioni;
translation_en: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
translation_sw: Na usiku msujudie Yeye, na umtakase usiku, wakati mrefu.
translation_en: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Kwa hakika watu hawa wanapenda maisha ya kidunia, na wanaiacha nyuma yao siku nzito.
translation_en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.

arabic_text: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
translation_sw: Sisi tumewaumba, na tukavitia nguvu viungo vyao. Na tukitaka tutawabadilisha mfano wao wawe badala yao.
translation_en: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika haya ni mawaidha; basi anaye taka atashika Njia ya kwenda kwa Mola wake Mlezi.
translation_en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

arabic_text: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
translation_sw: Wala hamwezi kutaka ila atakapo Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye ilimu, Mwenye hikima.
translation_en: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.

arabic_text: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
translation_sw: Humuingiza amtakaye katika rehema yake. Na wenye kudhulumu amewawekea adhabu iliyo chungu.
translation_en: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

arabic_text: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًۭا
translation_sw: Naapa kwa zinazo tumwa kwa upole!
translation_en: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts

arabic_text: فَٱلْعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصْفًۭا
translation_sw: Na zinazo vuma kwa kasi!
translation_en: And the winds that blow violently

arabic_text: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًۭا
translation_sw: Na zikaeneza maeneo yote!
translation_en: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]

arabic_text: فَٱلْفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرْقًۭا
translation_sw: Na zinazo farikisha zikatawanya!
translation_en: And those [angels] who bring criterion

arabic_text: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_sw: Na zinazo peleka mawaidha!
translation_en: And those [angels] who deliver a message

arabic_text: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
translation_sw: Kwa kuudhuru au kuonya,
translation_en: As justification or warning,

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika mnayo ahidiwa bila ya shaka yatakuwa!
translation_en: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
translation_sw: Wakati nyota zitakapo futwa,
translation_en: So when the stars are obliterated

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
translation_sw: Na mbingu zitakapo pasuliwa,
translation_en: And when the heaven is opened

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
translation_sw: Na milima itakapo peperushwa,
translation_en: And when the mountains are blown away

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
translation_sw: Na Mitume watakapo wekewa wakati wao,
translation_en: And when the messengers' time has come...

arabic_text: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
translation_sw: Kwa siku gani hiyo wamewekewa muda huo?
translation_en: For what Day was it postponed?

arabic_text: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_sw: Kwa siku ya kupambanua!
translation_en: For the Day of Judgement.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_sw: Na nini kitakacho kujuulisha siku ya kupambanua ni nini?
translation_en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Ole wao, siku hiyo hao wanao kanusha!
translation_en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Kwani hatukuwaangamiza walio tangulia?
translation_en: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

arabic_text: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukawafuatilizia walio fuatia?
translation_en: Then We will follow them with the later ones.

arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_sw: Ndio kama hivi tuwatendavyo wakosefu!
translation_en: Thus do We deal with the criminals.

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Ole wao siku hiyo hao wanao kanusha!
translation_en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwani hatukukuumbeni kwa maji ya kudharauliwa?
translation_en: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?

arabic_text: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍ
translation_sw: Kisha tukayaweka mahali pa utulivu madhubuti?
translation_en: And We placed it in a firm lodging

arabic_text: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
translation_sw: Mpaka muda maalumu?
translation_en: For a known extent.

arabic_text: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَٰدِرُونَ
translation_sw: Tukakadiria na Sisi ni wabora wa kukadiria.
translation_en: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Ole wao siku hiyo hao wanao kanusha!
translation_en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
translation_sw: Kwani hatukuifanya ardhi yenye kukusanya
translation_en: Have We not made the earth a container

arabic_text: أَحْيَآءًۭ وَأَمْوَٰتًۭا
translation_sw: Walio hai na maiti?
translation_en: Of the living and the dead?

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍۢ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءًۭ فُرَاتًۭا
translation_sw: Na ndani yake tukaweka milima mirefu yenye kuthibiti, na tunakunywesheni maji matamu?
translation_en: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Ole wao siku hiyo hao wanao kanusha!
translation_en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic_text: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_sw: Nendeni kwenye adhabu mliyo kuwa mkiikanusha!
translation_en: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.

arabic_text: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّۢ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍۢ
translation_sw: Nendeni kwenye kivuli chenye mapande matatu!
translation_en: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns

arabic_text: لَّا ظَلِيلٍۢ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
translation_sw: Hakikingi moto, wala hakiwaepushi na mwako.
translation_en: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."

arabic_text: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍۢ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
translation_sw: Hakika Moto huo unatoa macheche kama majumba!
translation_en: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,

arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٌۭ صُفْرٌۭ
translation_sw: Kama kwamba ni ngamia wa rangi ya manjano!
translation_en: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Ole wao siku hiyo hao wanao kanusha!
translation_en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
translation_sw: Hii ni siku ambayo hawatatamka kitu,
translation_en: This is a Day they will not speak,

arabic_text: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
translation_sw: Wala hawataruhusiwa kutoa udhuru.
translation_en: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Ole wao siku hiyo hao walio kanusha!
translation_en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic_text: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Hii ndiyo siku ya kupambanua. Tumekukusanyeni nyinyi na walio tangulia.
translation_en: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.

arabic_text: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌۭ فَكِيدُونِ
translation_sw: Ikiwa mnayo hila, nifanyieni hila Mimi!
translation_en: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Ole wao siku hiyo hao walio kanusha!
translation_en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَٰلٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika wachamngu watakuwa katika vivuli na chemchem,
translation_en: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

arabic_text: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation_sw: Na matunda wanayo yapenda,
translation_en: And fruits from whatever they desire,

arabic_text: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_sw: Kuleni na kunyweni kwa furaha kwa yale mliyo kuwa mkiyatenda.
translation_en: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_sw: Hakika ndio kama hivyo tunavyo walipa watendao mema.
translation_en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Ole wao siku hiyo hao wanao kanusha!
translation_en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic_text: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_sw: Kuleni na mjifurahishe kidogo tu. Hakika nyinyi ni wakosefu!
translation_en: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Ole wao siku hiyo hao wanao kanusha!
translation_en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
translation_sw: Na wakiambiwa: Inameni! Hawainami.
translation_en: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Ole wao siku hiyo hao wanao kanusha!
translation_en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic_text: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Basi maneno gani baada ya haya watayaamini?
translation_en: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?

arabic_text: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_sw: WANAULIZANA nini?
translation_en: About what are they asking one another?

arabic_text: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_sw: Ile khabari kuu,
translation_en: About the great news -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
translation_sw: Ambayo kwayo wanakhitalifiana.
translation_en: That over which they are in disagreement.

arabic_text: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: La! Karibu watakuja jua.
translation_en: No! They are going to know.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Tena la! Karibu watakuja jua.
translation_en: Then, no! They are going to know.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا
translation_sw: Kwani hatukuifanya ardhi kama tandiko?
translation_en: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

arabic_text: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا
translation_sw: Na milima kama vigingi?
translation_en: And the mountains as stakes?

arabic_text: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا
translation_sw: Na tukakuumbeni kwa jozi?
translation_en: And We created you in pairs

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا
translation_sw: Na tukakufanya kulala kwenu ni mapumziko?
translation_en: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا
translation_sw: Na tukaufanya usiku ni nguo?
translation_en: And made the night as clothing

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا
translation_sw: Na tukaufanya mchana ni wa kuchumia maisha?
translation_en: And made the day for livelihood

arabic_text: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا
translation_sw: Na tukajenga juu yenu saba zenye nguvu?
translation_en: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا
translation_sw: Na tukaifanya taa yenye mwanga na joto;
translation_en: And made [therein] a burning lamp

arabic_text: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا
translation_sw: Na tukateremsha maji yanayo anguka kwa kasi kutoka mawinguni,
translation_en: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water

arabic_text: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا
translation_sw: Ili tutoe kwayo nafaka na mimea,
translation_en: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation

arabic_text: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
translation_sw: Na mabustani yenye miti iliyo kamatana.
translation_en: And gardens of entwined growth.

arabic_text: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika siku ya uamuzi imewekewa wakati wake,
translation_en: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
translation_sw: Siku litapo pulizwa barugumu, nanyi mtakuja kwa makundi,
translation_en: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

arabic_text: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا
translation_sw: Na mbingu zitafunguliwa, ziwe milango,
translation_en: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways

arabic_text: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
translation_sw: Na milima itaondolewa na itakuwa kama sarabi.
translation_en: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.

arabic_text: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika Jahannamu inangojea!
translation_en: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

arabic_text: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا
translation_sw: Kwa walio asi ndio makaazi yao,
translation_en: For the transgressors, a place of return,

arabic_text: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا
translation_sw: Wakae humo karne baada ya karne,
translation_en: In which they will remain for ages [unending].

arabic_text: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
translation_sw: Hawataonja humo chochote kibaridi wala kinywaji,
translation_en: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink

arabic_text: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا
translation_sw: Ila maji yamoto sana na usaha,
translation_en: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -

arabic_text: جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا
translation_sw: Ndio jaza muwafaka.
translation_en: An appropriate recompense.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika hao hawakuwa wakitaraji kuwa kuna hisabu.
translation_en: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

arabic_text: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا
translation_sw: Na wakikanusha Aya zetu kwa nguvu.
translation_en: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

arabic_text: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا
translation_sw: Na kila kitu Sisi tumekidhibiti kwa kukiandika.
translation_en: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

arabic_text: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
translation_sw: Basi onjeni! Nasi hatutakuzidishieni ila adhabu!
translation_en: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."

arabic_text: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
translation_sw: Hakika wachamngu wanastahiki kufuzu,
translation_en: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

arabic_text: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا
translation_sw: Mabustani na mizabibu,
translation_en: Gardens and grapevines

arabic_text: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا
translation_sw: Na wake walio lingana nao,
translation_en: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age

arabic_text: وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا
translation_sw: Na bilauri zilizo jaa,
translation_en: And a full cup.

arabic_text: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
translation_sw: Hawatasikia humo upuuzi wala uwongo -
translation_en: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

arabic_text: جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا
translation_sw: Malipo kutoka kwa Mola wako Mlezi, kipawa cha kutosha.
translation_en: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,

arabic_text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
translation_sw: Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na ardhi na vilio baina yao, Arrahman, Mwingi wa rehema; hawamiliki usemi mbele yake!
translation_en: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
translation_sw: Siku atakapo simama Roho na Malaika kwa safu. Hawatasema ila Mwingi wa rehema aliye mruhusu, na atasema yaliyo sawa tu.
translation_en: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
translation_sw: Hiyo ndiyo Siku ya haki. Basi anaye taka na ashike njia arejee kwa Mola wake Mlezi.
translation_en: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
translation_sw: Hakika tumekuhadharisheni adhabu iliyo karibu kufika; Siku ambayo mtu atakapo ona yaliyo tangulizwa na mikono yake; na kafiri atasema: Laiti ningeli kuwa udongo!
translation_en: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"

arabic_text: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا
translation_sw: Naapa kwa wanao komoa kwa nguvu,
translation_en: By those [angels] who extract with violence

arabic_text: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا
translation_sw: Na kwa wanao toa kwa upole,
translation_en: And [by] those who remove with ease

arabic_text: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا
translation_sw: Na wanao ogelea,
translation_en: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming

arabic_text: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا
translation_sw: Wakishindana mbio,
translation_en: And those who race each other in a race

arabic_text: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا
translation_sw: Wakidabiri mambo.
translation_en: And those who arrange [each] matter,

arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
translation_sw: Siku kitapo tetemeka cha kutetemeka,
translation_en: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

arabic_text: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
translation_sw: Kifuate cha kufuatia.
translation_en: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

arabic_text: قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo nyoyo zitapiga piga,
translation_en: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,

arabic_text: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Macho yatainama chini.
translation_en: Their eyes humbled.

arabic_text: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
translation_sw: Sasa wanasema: Ati kweli tutarudishwa kwenye hali ya kwanza?
translation_en: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

arabic_text: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ
translation_sw: Hata tukiwa mifupa iliyo bunguliwa?
translation_en: Even if we should be decayed bones?

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Wanasema: Basi marejeo hayo ni yenye khasara!
translation_en: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."

arabic_text: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika hayo ni ukelele mmoja tu,
translation_en: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

arabic_text: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
translation_sw: Mara watakuwa kwenye uwanda wa mkutano!
translation_en: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

arabic_text: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Je! Imekufikia hadithi ya Musa?
translation_en: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

arabic_text: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
translation_sw: Mola wake Mlezi alipo mwita katika bonde takatifu la T'uwaa, akamwambia:
translation_en: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,

arabic_text: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
translation_sw: Nenda kwa Firauni. Hakika yeye amezidi jeuri.
translation_en: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

arabic_text: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_sw: Umwambie: Je! Unapenda kujitakasa?
translation_en: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself

arabic_text: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
translation_sw: Nami nitakuongoa ufike kwa Mola wako Mlezi, upate kumcha.
translation_en: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

arabic_text: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Basi alimwonyesha Ishara kubwa.
translation_en: And he showed him the greatest sign,

arabic_text: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
translation_sw: Lakini aliikadhibisha na akaasi.
translation_en: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_sw: Kisha alirudi nyuma, akaingia kufanya juhudi.
translation_en: Then he turned his back, striving.

arabic_text: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
translation_sw: Akakusanya watu akanadi.
translation_en: And he gathered [his people] and called out

arabic_text: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_sw: Akasema: Mimi ndiye Mola wenu Mlezi mkuu kabisa.
translation_en: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

arabic_text: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Basi hapo Mwenyezi Mungu akamshika kumuadhibu kwa la mwisho na la mwanzo.
translation_en: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].

arabic_text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika katika haya yapo mazingatio kwa wanao ogopa.
translation_en: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].

arabic_text: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Je! Ni vigumu zaidi kukuumbeni nyinyi au mbingu? Yeye ndiye aliye ijenga!
translation_en: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.

arabic_text: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_sw: Akainua kimo chake, na akaitengeneza vizuri.
translation_en: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

arabic_text: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Na akautia giza usiku wake, na akautokeza mchana wake.
translation_en: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.

arabic_text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
translation_sw: Na juu ya hivyo ameitandaza ardhi.
translation_en: And after that He spread the earth.

arabic_text: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Akatoa ndani yake maji yake na malisho yake,
translation_en: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

arabic_text: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Na milima akaisimamisha,
translation_en: And the mountains He set firmly

arabic_text: مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
translation_sw: Kwa nafuu yenu na mifugo yenu.
translation_en: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Basi itakapo fika hiyo balaa kubwa,
translation_en: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_sw: Siku ambayo mtu atakumbuka aliyo yafanya,
translation_en: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

arabic_text: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
translation_sw: Na Jahannamu itadhihirishwa kwa mwenye kuona,
translation_en: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
translation_sw: Basi ama yule aliye zidi ujeuri,
translation_en: So as for he who transgressed

arabic_text: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_sw: Na akakhiari maisha ya dunia,
translation_en: And preferred the life of the world,

arabic_text: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika Jahannamu ndiyo makaazi yake!
translation_en: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
translation_sw: Na ama yule anaye ogopa kusimamishwa mbele ya Mola wake Mlezi, na akajizuilia nafsi yake na matamanio,
translation_en: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

arabic_text: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_sw: Basi huyo, Pepo itakuwa ndiyo makaazi yake!
translation_en: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

arabic_text: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Wanakuuliza Saa (ya Kiyama) itakuwa lini?
translation_en: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?

arabic_text: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
translation_sw: Una nini wewe hata uitaje?
translation_en: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?

arabic_text: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
translation_sw: Kwa Mola wako Mlezi ndio mwisho wake.
translation_en: To your Lord is its finality.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Kwa hakika wewe ni mwonyaji tu kwa mwenye kuikhofu.
translation_en: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Ni kama kwamba wao siku watapo iona (hiyo Saa) hawakukaa ila jioni moja tu, au mchana wake.
translation_en: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.

arabic_text: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation_sw: Alikunja kipaji na akageuka,
translation_en: The Prophet frowned and turned away

arabic_text: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
translation_sw: Kwa sababu alimjia kipofu!
translation_en: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].

arabic_text: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na nini kitakujuulisha pengine yeye atatakasika?
translation_en: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified

arabic_text: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Au atawaidhika, na mawaidha yamfae?
translation_en: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

arabic_text: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_sw: Ama ajionaye hana haja,
translation_en: As for he who thinks himself without need,

arabic_text: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
translation_sw: Wewe ndio unamshughulikia?
translation_en: To him you give attention.

arabic_text: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
translation_sw: Na si juu yako kama hakutakasika.
translation_en: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_sw: Ama anaye kujia kwa juhudi,
translation_en: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

arabic_text: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
translation_sw: Naye anaogopa,
translation_en: While he fears [Allah],

arabic_text: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
translation_sw: Ndio wewe unampuuza?
translation_en: From him you are distracted.

arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Sivyo hivyo! Huku ni kukumbushana.
translation_en: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;

arabic_text: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_sw: Basi anaye penda akumbuke.
translation_en: So whoever wills may remember it.

arabic_text: فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Yamo katika kurasa zilizo hishimiwa,
translation_en: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,

arabic_text: مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
translation_sw: Zilizo inuliwa, zilizo takaswa.
translation_en: Exalted and purified,

arabic_text: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Zimo mikononi mwa Malaika waandishi,
translation_en: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,

arabic_text: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Watukufu, wema.
translation_en: Noble and dutiful.

arabic_text: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
translation_sw: Ameangamia mwanaadamu! Nini kinacho mkufurisha?
translation_en: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.

arabic_text: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
translation_sw: Kwa kitu gani amemuumba?
translation_en: From what substance did He create him?

arabic_text: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
translation_sw: Kwa tone la manii, akamuumba na akamkadiria.
translation_en: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;

arabic_text: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
translation_sw: Kisha akamsahilishia njia.
translation_en: Then He eased the way for him;

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
translation_sw: Kisha akamfisha, akamtia kaburini.
translation_en: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
translation_sw: Kisha apendapo atamfufua.
translation_en: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

arabic_text: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
translation_sw: La! Hajamaliza aliyo muamuru.
translation_en: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.

arabic_text: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
translation_sw: Hebu mtu na atazame chakula chake.
translation_en: Then let mankind look at his food -

arabic_text: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumemimina maji kwa nguvu,
translation_en: How We poured down water in torrents,

arabic_text: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا
translation_sw: Tena tukaipasua pasua ardhi kwa nguvu,
translation_en: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

arabic_text: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا
translation_sw: Kisha tukaotesha humo nafaka,
translation_en: And caused to grow within it grain

arabic_text: وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا
translation_sw: Na zabibu, na mimea ya majani,
translation_en: And grapes and herbage

arabic_text: وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا
translation_sw: Na mizaituni, na mitende,
translation_en: And olive and palm trees

arabic_text: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا
translation_sw: Na bustani zenye miti iliyo songana baraabara,
translation_en: And gardens of dense shrubbery

arabic_text: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا
translation_sw: Na matunda, na malisho ya wanyama;
translation_en: And fruit and grass -

arabic_text: مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
translation_sw: Kwa manufaa yenu na mifugo yenu.
translation_en: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
translation_sw: Basi utakapo kuja ukelele,
translation_en: But when there comes the Deafening Blast

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
translation_sw: Siku ambayo mtu atamkimbia nduguye,
translation_en: On the Day a man will flee from his brother

arabic_text: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
translation_sw: Na mamaye na babaye,
translation_en: And his mother and his father

arabic_text: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
translation_sw: Na mkewe na wanawe -
translation_en: And his wife and his children,

arabic_text: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ
translation_sw: Kila mtu miongoni mwao siku hiyo atakuwa na lake la kumtosha.
translation_en: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.

arabic_text: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo ziko nyuso zitazo nawiri,
translation_en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -

arabic_text: ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Zitacheka, zitachangamka;
translation_en: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.

arabic_text: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Na nyuso siku hiyo zitakuwa na mavumbi,
translation_en: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.

arabic_text: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
translation_sw: Giza totoro litazifunika,
translation_en: Blackness will cover them.

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
translation_sw: Hao ndio makafiri watenda maovu.
translation_en: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.

arabic_text: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
translation_sw: Jua litakapo kunjwa,
translation_en: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
translation_sw: Na nyota zikazimwa,
translation_en: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
translation_sw: Na milima ikaondolewa,
translation_en: And when the mountains are removed

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
translation_sw: Na ngamia wenye mimba pevu watakapo achwa wasishughulikiwe,
translation_en: And when full-term she-camels are neglected

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
translation_sw: Na wanyama wa mwituni wakakusanywa,
translation_en: And when the wild beasts are gathered

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
translation_sw: Na bahari zikawaka moto,
translation_en: And when the seas are filled with flame

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
translation_sw: Na nafsi zikaunganishwa,
translation_en: And when the souls are paired

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
translation_sw: Na msichana aliye zikwa hai atapo ulizwa,
translation_en: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

arabic_text: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍۢ قُتِلَتْ
translation_sw: Kwa kosa gani aliuliwa?
translation_en: For what sin she was killed

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
translation_sw: Na madaftari yatakapo enezwa,
translation_en: And when the pages are made public

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
translation_sw: Na mbingu itapo tanduliwa,
translation_en: And when the sky is stripped away

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
translation_sw: Na Jahannamu itapo chochewa,
translation_en: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
translation_sw: Na Pepo ikasogezwa,
translation_en: And when Paradise is brought near,

arabic_text: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
translation_sw: Kila nafsi itajua ilicho kihudhurisha.
translation_en: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].

arabic_text: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa nyota zinapo rejea nyuma,
translation_en: So I swear by the retreating stars -

arabic_text: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
translation_sw: Zinazo kwenda, kisha zikajificha,
translation_en: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -

arabic_text: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
translation_sw: Na kwa usiku unapo pungua,
translation_en: And by the night as it closes in

arabic_text: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
translation_sw: Na kwa asubuhi inapo pambazuka,
translation_en: And by the dawn when it breathes

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwamba hakika bila ya shaka hii ni kauli ya Mjumbe mtukufu,
translation_en: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger

arabic_text: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Mwenye nguvu na mwenye cheo kwa huyo Mwenye Kiti cha Enzi,
translation_en: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

arabic_text: مُّطَاعٍۢ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Anaye t'iiwa, tena muaminifu.
translation_en: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

arabic_text: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Na wala huyu mwenzenu hana wazimu.
translation_en: And your companion is not [at all] mad.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_sw: Na hakika yeye alimwona kwenye upeo wa macho ulio safi.
translation_en: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.

arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Wala yeye si bakhili kwa mambo ya ghaibu.
translation_en: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.

arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Wala hii si kauli ya Shetani maluuni.
translation_en: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

arabic_text: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
translation_sw: Basi mnakwenda wapi?
translation_en: So where are you going?

arabic_text: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Haikuwa hii ila ni ukumbusho kwa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

arabic_text: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
translation_sw: Kwa yule miongoni mwenu anaye taka kwenda sawa.
translation_en: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

arabic_text: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Wala nyinyi hamtataka isipo kuwa atake Mwenyezi Mungu Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
translation_en: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
