translation_sw: Mbingu itapo chanika,
translation_en: When the sky breaks apart

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
translation_sw: Na nyota zitapo tawanyika,
translation_en: And when the stars fall, scattering,

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
translation_sw: Na bahari zitakapo pasuliwa,
translation_en: And when the seas are erupted

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
translation_sw: Na makaburi yatapo fukuliwa,
translation_en: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,

arabic_text: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
translation_sw: Hapo kila nafsi itajua ilicho tanguliza, na ilicho bakisha nyuma.
translation_en: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
translation_sw: Ewe mwanaadamu! Nini kilicho kughuri ukamwacha Mola wako Mlezi Mtukufu?
translation_en: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
translation_sw: Aliye kuumba, akakuweka sawa, akakunyoosha,
translation_en: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

arabic_text: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
translation_sw: Katika sura yoyote aliyo ipenda akakujenga.
translation_en: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

arabic_text: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Sivyo hivyo! Bali nyinyi mnaikanusha Siku ya Malipo.
translation_en: No! But you deny the Recompense.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
translation_sw: Na hakika bila ya shaka wapo walinzi juu yenu,
translation_en: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,

arabic_text: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ
translation_sw: Waandishi wenye hishima,
translation_en: Noble and recording;

arabic_text: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Wanayajua mnayo yatenda.
translation_en: They know whatever you do.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakika wema bila ya shaka watakuwa katika neema,
translation_en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Na hakika waovu bila ya shaka watakuwa Motoni;
translation_en: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

arabic_text: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Wataingia humo Siku ya Malipo.
translation_en: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

arabic_text: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
translation_sw: Na hawatoacha kuwamo humo.
translation_en: And never therefrom will they be absent.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Na nini kitakacho kujuulisha Siku ya Malipo ni siku gani?
translation_en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

arabic_text: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Tena nini kitakacho kujuulisha Siku ya Malipo ni siku gani?
translation_en: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

arabic_text: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
translation_sw: Siku ambayo nafsi haitakuwa na madaraka yoyote juu ya nafsi; na amri yote siku hiyo ni ya Mwenyezi Mungu tu.
translation_en: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
translation_sw: Ole wao hao wapunjao!
translation_en: Woe to those who give less [than due],

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao wanapo jipimia kwa watu hudai watimiziwe.
translation_en: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
translation_sw: Na wao wanapo wapimia watu kwa kipimo au mizani hupunguza.
translation_en: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

arabic_text: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
translation_sw: Kwani hawadhani hao kwamba watafufuliwa
translation_en: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

arabic_text: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Katika Siku iliyo kuu,
translation_en: For a tremendous Day -

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Siku watapo msimamia watu Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote?
translation_en: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
translation_sw: Hasha! Hakika maandiko ya wakosefu bila ya shaka yamo katika Sijjin.
translation_en: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ
translation_sw: Unajua nini Sijjin?
translation_en: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

arabic_text: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
translation_sw: Kitabu kilicho andikwa.
translation_en: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_sw: Ole wao siku hiyo kwa wanao kadhibisha!
translation_en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Ambao wanaikadhibisha Siku ya Malipo.
translation_en: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

arabic_text: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_sw: Wala haikadhibishi ila kila mwenye kuruka mipaka, mwenye dhambi.
translation_en: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

arabic_text: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_sw: Anapo somewa Aya zetu husema: Ni visa vya watu wa kale!
translation_en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

arabic_text: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_sw: Hasha! Bali yametia kutu juu ya nyoyo zao hao walio kuwa wakiyachuma.
translation_en: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.

arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
translation_sw: Hasha! Hakika hao siku hiyo bila ya shaka watazuiliwa na neema za Mola wao Mlezi.
translation_en: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_sw: Kisha wataingia Motoni!
translation_en: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_sw: Kisha waambiwe: Haya ndiyo mliyo kuwa mkiyakadhabisha.
translation_en: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
translation_sw: Hasha! Hakika maandiko ya watu wema bila ya shaka yamo katika I'liyyin.
translation_en: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
translation_sw: Na nini kitakacho kujuvya nini I'liyyin?
translation_en: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?

arabic_text: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
translation_sw: Kitabu kilicho andikwa.
translation_en: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

arabic_text: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_sw: Wanakishuhudia walio karibishwa.
translation_en: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_sw: Hakika watu wema bila ya shaka watakuwa katika neema.
translation_en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

arabic_text: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_sw: Wakae juu ya viti vya enzi wakiangalia.
translation_en: On adorned couches, observing.

arabic_text: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_sw: Utatambua katika nyuso zao mng'aro wa neema,
translation_en: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

arabic_text: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ
translation_sw: Watanyweshwa kinywaji safi kiliyo tiwa muhuri,
translation_en: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

arabic_text: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
translation_sw: Muhuri wake ni miski. Na katika hayo washindanie wenye kushindana.
translation_en: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.

arabic_text: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
translation_sw: Na mchanganyiko wake ni Tasniim,
translation_en: And its mixture is of Tasneem,

arabic_text: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_sw: Chemchem watakayo inywa walio kurubishwa.
translation_en: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_sw: Kwa hakika wale walio kuwa wakosefu walikuwa wakiwacheka walio amini.
translation_en: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo pita karibu yao wakikonyezana.
translation_en: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo rudi kwa watu wao hurudi nao wamefurahi.
translation_en: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_sw: Na wanapo waona husema: Hakika hawa ndio khasa walio potea.
translation_en: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."

arabic_text: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
translation_sw: Na wao hawakutumwa wawe walinzi juu yao.
translation_en: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

arabic_text: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_sw: Basi leo walio amini ndio watawacheka makafiri,
translation_en: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,

arabic_text: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_sw: Nao wako juu ya viti vya enzi wakiangalia.
translation_en: On adorned couches, observing.

arabic_text: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_sw: Je! makafiri wamelipwa malipo ya yale waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda?
translation_en: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?

arabic_text: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
translation_sw: Itapo chanika mbingu,
translation_en: When the sky has split [open]

arabic_text: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_sw: Na ikamsikiliza Mola wake Mlezi, na ikapasiwa kumsikiliza,
translation_en: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
translation_sw: Na ardhi itakapo tanuliwa,
translation_en: And when the earth has been extended

arabic_text: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
translation_sw: Na kuvitoa vilivyo kuwa ndani yake, ikawa tupu,
translation_en: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]

arabic_text: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_sw: Na ikamsikiliza Mola wake Mlezi, na ikapasiwa kumsikiliza,
translation_en: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
translation_sw: Ewe mtu! Hakika wewe unajikusuru kwa juhudi kumwendea Mola wako Mlezi, basi utamkuta.
translation_en: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
translation_sw: Ama atakaye pewa daftari lake kwa mkono wa kulia,
translation_en: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

arabic_text: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Basi huyo atahisabiwa hisabu nyepesi,
translation_en: He will be judged with an easy account

arabic_text: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا
translation_sw: Na arudi kwa ahali zake na furaha.
translation_en: And return to his people in happiness.

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
translation_sw: Na ama atakaye pewa daftari lake kwa nyuma ya mgongo wake,
translation_en: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

arabic_text: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا
translation_sw: Basi huyo ataomba kuteketea.
translation_en: He will cry out for destruction

arabic_text: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
translation_sw: Na ataingia Motoni.
translation_en: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_sw: Hakika alikuwa furahani kati ya jamaa zake.
translation_en: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
translation_sw: Huyo hakika alidhani kuwa hatarejea tena.
translation_en: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].

arabic_text: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا
translation_sw: Kwani? Hakika Mola wake Mlezi alikuwa akimwona!
translation_en: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.

arabic_text: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
translation_sw: Basi ninaapa kwa wekundu wa jua linapo kuchwa,
translation_en: So I swear by the twilight glow

arabic_text: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
translation_sw: Na kwa usiku na unavyo vikusanya,
translation_en: And [by] the night and what it envelops

arabic_text: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
translation_sw: Na kwa mwezi unapo pevuka,
translation_en: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

arabic_text: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ
translation_sw: Lazima mtapanda t'abaka kwa t'abaka!
translation_en: [That] you will surely experience state after state.

arabic_text: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_sw: Basi wana nini hawaamini?
translation_en: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

arabic_text: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
translation_sw: Na wanapo somewa Qur'ani hawasujudu?
translation_en: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?

arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_sw: Bali walio kufuru wanakanusha tu.
translation_en: But those who have disbelieved deny,

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu anajua wanayo yadhamiria.
translation_en: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

arabic_text: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_sw: Basi wabashirie adhabu chungu!
translation_en: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
translation_sw: Isipo kuwa wale walio amini na wakatenda mema; hao watakuwa na ujira usio malizika.
translation_en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.

arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa mbingu yenye Buruji!
translation_en: By the sky containing great stars

arabic_text: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
translation_sw: Na kwa siku iliyo ahidiwa!
translation_en: And [by] the promised Day

arabic_text: وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ
translation_sw: Na kwa shahidi na kinacho shuhudiwa!
translation_en: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

arabic_text: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
translation_sw: Wameangamizwa watu wa makhandaki
translation_en: Cursed were the companions of the trench

arabic_text: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
translation_sw: Yenye moto wenye kuni nyingi,
translation_en: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,

arabic_text: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ
translation_sw: Walipo kuwa wamekaa hapo,
translation_en: When they were sitting near it

arabic_text: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
translation_sw: Na wao ni mashahidi wa yale waliyo kuwa wakiwafanyia Waumini.
translation_en: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.

arabic_text: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation_sw: Nao hawakuona baya lolote kwao ila kuwa wakimuamini Mwenyezi Mungu, Mwenye nguvu, Msifiwa,
translation_en: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
translation_sw: Ambaye anao ufalme wa mbingu na ardhi; na Mwenyezi Mungu ni shaahidi wa kila kitu.
translation_en: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation_sw: Hakika walio wafitini Waumini wanaume na Waumini wanawake, kisha hawakutubu, basi watapata adhabu ya Jahannamu na watapata adhabu ya kuungua.
translation_en: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation_sw: Hakika walio amini na wakatenda mema watapata Bustani zenye mito ipitayo kati yake. Huko ndiko kufuzu kukubwa.
translation_en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

arabic_text: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_sw: Hakika kutesa kwa Mola wako Mlezi ni kukali.
translation_en: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye anaye anzisha na ndiye anaye rejeza tena,
translation_en: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
translation_sw: Naye ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye mapenzi,
translation_en: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

arabic_text: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
translation_sw: Mwenye Kiti cha Enzi, Mtukufu,
translation_en: Honorable Owner of the Throne,

arabic_text: فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
translation_sw: Atendaye ayatakayo.
translation_en: Effecter of what He intends.

arabic_text: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
translation_sw: Je! Zimekuwasilia khabari za majeshi?
translation_en: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -

arabic_text: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
translation_sw: Ya Firauni na Thamudi?
translation_en: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?

arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ
translation_sw: Lakini walio kufuru wamo katika kukadhibisha.
translation_en: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,

arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
translation_sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu nyuma yao amewazunguka.
translation_en: While Allah encompasses them from behind.

arabic_text: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Bali hii ni Qur'ani tukufu
translation_en: But this is an honored Qur'an

arabic_text: فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
translation_sw: Katika Ubao Ulio Hifadhiwa.
translation_en: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.

arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa mbingu na Kinacho kuja usiku!
translation_en: By the sky and the night comer -

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
translation_sw: Na nini kitakacho kujuulisha ni nini hicho Kinacho kuja usiku?
translation_en: And what can make you know what is the night comer?

arabic_text: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
translation_sw: Ni Nyota yenye mwanga mkali.
translation_en: It is the piercing star -

arabic_text: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
translation_sw: Hapana nafsi ila inayo mwangalizi.
translation_en: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

arabic_text: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
translation_sw: Hebu naajitazame mwanaadamu ameumbwa kwa kitu gani?
translation_en: So let man observe from what he was created.

arabic_text: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ
translation_sw: Ameumbwa kwa maji yatokayo kwa kuchupa,
translation_en: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

arabic_text: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
translation_sw: Yatokayo baina ya mifupa ya mgongo na mbavu.
translation_en: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika Yeye ana uweza wa kumrudisha.
translation_en: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.

arabic_text: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
translation_sw: Siku zitakapo dhihirishwa siri.
translation_en: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

arabic_text: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
translation_sw: Basi hatakuwa na nguvu wala msaidizi.
translation_en: Then man will have no power or any helper.

arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa mbingu yenye marejeo!
translation_en: By the sky which returns [rain]

arabic_text: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
translation_sw: Na kwa ardhi inayo pasuka!
translation_en: And [by] the earth which cracks open,

arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika hii ni kauli ya kupambanua.
translation_en: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,

arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
translation_sw: Wala si mzaha.
translation_en: And it is not amusement.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika wao wanapanga mpango.
translation_en: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

arabic_text: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا
translation_sw: Na Mimi napanga mpango.
translation_en: But I am planning a plan.

arabic_text: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
translation_sw: Basi wape muhula makafiri - wape muhula pole pole.
translation_en: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.

arabic_text: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
translation_sw: Litakase jina la Mola wako Mlezi aliye juu kabisa,
translation_en: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_sw: Aliye umba, na akaweka sawa,
translation_en: Who created and proportioned

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
translation_sw: Na ambaye amekadiria na akaongoa,
translation_en: And who destined and [then] guided

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
translation_sw: Na aliye otesha malisho,
translation_en: And who brings out the pasture

arabic_text: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
translation_sw: Kisha akayafanya makavu, meusi.
translation_en: And [then] makes it black stubble.

arabic_text: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Tutakusomesha wala hutasahau,
translation_en: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,

arabic_text: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
translation_sw: Ila akipenda Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika Yeye anayajua yaliyo dhaahiri na yaliyo fichikana.
translation_en: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

arabic_text: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Na tutakusahilishia yawe mepesi.
translation_en: And We will ease you toward ease.

arabic_text: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Basi kumbusha, kama kukumbusha kunafaa.
translation_en: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;

arabic_text: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
translation_sw: Atakumbuka mwenye kuogopa.
translation_en: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.

arabic_text: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_sw: Na atajitenga mbali nayo mpotovu,
translation_en: But the wretched one will avoid it -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Ambaye atauingia Moto mkubwa.
translation_en: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
translation_sw: Tena humo hatakufa wala hawi hai.
translation_en: Neither dying therein nor living.

arabic_text: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_sw: Hakika amekwisha fanikiwa aliye jitakasa.
translation_en: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

arabic_text: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
translation_sw: Na akakumbuka jina la Mola wake Mlezi, na akasali.
translation_en: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

arabic_text: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_sw: Lakini nyinyi mnakhiari maisha ya dunia!
translation_en: But you prefer the worldly life,

arabic_text: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na Akhera ni bora na yenye kudumu zaidi.
translation_en: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_sw: Hakika haya yamo katika Vitabu vya mwanzo,
translation_en: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

arabic_text: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
translation_sw: Vitabu vya Ibrahimu na Musa.
translation_en: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

arabic_text: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ
translation_sw: Je! Imekufikia khabari ya msiba wa kufudikiza?
translation_en: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?

arabic_text: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo nyuso zitainama,
translation_en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,

arabic_text: عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Zikifanya kazi, nazo taabani.
translation_en: Working [hard] and exhausted.

arabic_text: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ
translation_sw: Ziingie katika Moto unao waka -
translation_en: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.

arabic_text: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Zikinyweshwa kutoka chemchem inayo chemka.
translation_en: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

arabic_text: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
translation_sw: Hawatakuwa na chakula isipo kuwa kichungu chenye miba.
translation_en: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

arabic_text: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
translation_sw: Hakinenepeshi wala hakiondoi njaa.
translation_en: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.

arabic_text: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo nyuso nyengine zitakuwa kunjufu.
translation_en: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.

arabic_text: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Zitakuwa radhi kwa juhudi yao,
translation_en: With their effort [they are] satisfied

arabic_text: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Katika Bustani ya juu.
translation_en: In an elevated garden,

arabic_text: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ
translation_sw: Hawatasikia humo upuuzi.
translation_en: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.

arabic_text: فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Humo imo chemchem inayo miminika.
translation_en: Within it is a flowing spring.

arabic_text: فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Humo vimo viti vilivyo nyanyuliwa,
translation_en: Within it are couches raised high

arabic_text: وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Na bilauri zilizo pangwa,
translation_en: And cups put in place

arabic_text: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Na matakia safu safu,
translation_en: And cushions lined up

arabic_text: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
translation_sw: Na mazulia yaliyo tandikwa.
translation_en: And carpets spread around.

arabic_text: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
translation_sw: Je! Hawamtazami ngamia jinsi alivyo umbwa?
translation_en: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?

arabic_text: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
translation_sw: Na mbingu jinsi ilivyo inuliwa?
translation_en: And at the sky - how it is raised?

arabic_text: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
translation_sw: Na milima jinsi ilivyo thibitishwa?
translation_en: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

arabic_text: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
translation_sw: Na ardhi jinsi ilivyo tandazwa?
translation_en: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

arabic_text: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi kumbusha! Hakika wewe ni Mkumbushaji.
translation_en: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.

arabic_text: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
translation_sw: Wewe si mwenye kuwatawalia.
translation_en: You are not over them a controller.

arabic_text: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
translation_sw: Lakini anaye rudi nyuma na kukataa,
translation_en: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -

arabic_text: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
translation_sw: Basi Mwenyezi Mungu atamuadhibu kwa adhabu iliyo kubwa kabisa!
translation_en: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.

arabic_text: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
translation_sw: Hakika ni kwetu Sisi ndio marejeo yao.
translation_en: Indeed, to Us is their return.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
translation_sw: Kisha hakika ni juu yetu Sisi hisabu yao!
translation_en: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.

arabic_text: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa alfajiri,
translation_en: By the dawn

arabic_text: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ
translation_sw: Na kwa masiku kumi,
translation_en: And [by] ten nights

arabic_text: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
translation_sw: Na kwa viwili viwili na kimoja kimoja,
translation_en: And [by] the even [number] and the odd

arabic_text: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
translation_sw: Na kwa usiku unapo pita,
translation_en: And [by] the night when it passes,

arabic_text: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
translation_sw: Je! Hapana katika haya kiapo kwa mwenye akili?
translation_en: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
translation_sw: Kwani hukuona jinsi Mola wako Mlezi alivyo wafanya kina A'di?
translation_en: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -

arabic_text: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
translation_sw: Wa Iram, wenye majumba marefu?
translation_en: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,

arabic_text: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
translation_sw: Ambao haukuumbwa mfano wake katika nchi?
translation_en: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?

arabic_text: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
translation_sw: Na Thamudi walio chonga majabali huko bondeni?
translation_en: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?

arabic_text: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
translation_sw: Na Firauni mwenye vigingi?
translation_en: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
translation_sw: Ambao walifanya jeuri katika nchi?
translation_en: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands

arabic_text: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
translation_sw: Wakakithirisha humo ufisadi?
translation_en: And increased therein the corruption.

arabic_text: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
translation_sw: Basi Mola wako Mlezi aliwapiga mjeledi wa adhabu.
translation_en: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
translation_sw: Hakika Mola wako Mlezi yupo kwenye mavizio anawavizia.
translation_en: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
translation_sw: Ama mtu anapo jaribiwa na Mola wake Mlezi, akamkirimu na akamneemesha, husema: Mola wangu Mlezi amenikirimu!
translation_en: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."

arabic_text: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
translation_sw: Na ama anapo mjaribu akampunguzia riziki yake, husema: Mola wangu Mlezi amenitia unyonge!
translation_en: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

arabic_text: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_sw: Sivyo hivyo! Bali nyinyi hamuwakirimu mayatima,
translation_en: No! But you do not honor the orphan

arabic_text: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_sw: Wala hamhimizani kulisha masikini;
translation_en: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.

arabic_text: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا
translation_sw: Na mnakula urithi kwa ulaji wa pupa,
translation_en: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,

arabic_text: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا
translation_sw: Na mnapenda mali pendo la kupita kiasi.
translation_en: And you love wealth with immense love.

arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا
translation_sw: Sivyo hivyo! Itakapo vunjwa ardhi vipande vipande,
translation_en: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -

arabic_text: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا
translation_sw: Na akaja Mola wako Mlezi na Malaika safu safu,
translation_en: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,

arabic_text: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Na ikaletwa Jahannamu siku hiyo, siku hiyo mtu atakumbuka! Lakini kukumbuka huko kutamfaa nini?
translation_en: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?

arabic_text: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
translation_sw: Atasema: Laiti ningeli jitangulizia kwa uhai wangu!
translation_en: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."

arabic_text: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
translation_sw: Basi siku hiyo hataadhibu yeyote namna ya kuadhibu kwake.
translation_en: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,

arabic_text: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
translation_sw: Wala hatafunga yeyote kama kufunga kwake.
translation_en: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].

arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
translation_sw: Ewe nafsi iliyo tua!
translation_en: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,

arabic_text: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ
translation_sw: Rejea kwa Mola wako Mlezi umeridhika, na umemridhisha.
translation_en: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],

arabic_text: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى
translation_sw: Basi ingia miongoni mwa waja wangu,
translation_en: And enter among My [righteous] servants

arabic_text: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
translation_sw: Na ingia katika Pepo yangu.
translation_en: And enter My Paradise."

arabic_text: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa Mji huu!
translation_en: I swear by this city, Makkah -

arabic_text: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_sw: Nawe unaukaa Mji huu.
translation_en: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -

arabic_text: وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ
translation_sw: Na naapa kwa mzazi na alicho kizaa.
translation_en: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],

arabic_text: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
translation_sw: Hakika tumemuumba mtu katika taabu.
translation_en: We have certainly created man into hardship.

arabic_text: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
translation_sw: Ati anadhani hapana yeyote ataye muweza?
translation_en: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?

arabic_text: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا
translation_sw: Anasema: Nimeteketeza chungu ya mali.
translation_en: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."

arabic_text: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_sw: Ati anadhani ya kuwa hapana yeyote anaye mwona?
translation_en: Does he think that no one has seen him?

arabic_text: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
translation_sw: Kwani hatukumpa macho mawili?
translation_en: Have We not made for him two eyes?

arabic_text: وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
translation_sw: Na ulimi, na midomo miwili?
translation_en: And a tongue and two lips?

arabic_text: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
translation_sw: Na tukambainishia zote njia mbili?
translation_en: And have shown him the two ways?

arabic_text: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
translation_sw: Lakini hakujitoma kwenye njia ya vikwazo vya milimani.
translation_en: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
translation_sw: Na nini kitakujuvya ni nini njia ya vikwazo vya milimani?
translation_en: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?

arabic_text: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
translation_sw: Kumkomboa mtumwa;
translation_en: It is the freeing of a slave

arabic_text: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Au kumlisha siku ya njaa
translation_en: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

arabic_text: يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
translation_sw: Yatima aliye jamaa,
translation_en: An orphan of near relationship

arabic_text: أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Au masikini aliye vumbini.
translation_en: Or a needy person in misery

arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
translation_sw: Tena awe miongoni mwa walio amini na wakausiana kusubiri na wakausiana kuhurumiana.
translation_en: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.

arabic_text: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_sw: Hao ndio watu wa kheri wa kuliani.
translation_en: Those are the companions of the right.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_sw: Lakini walio zikataa Ishara zetu, hao ndio watu wa shari wa kushotoni.
translation_en: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.

arabic_text: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
translation_sw: Juu yao utakuwa Moto ulio fungiwa kila upande.
translation_en: Over them will be fire closed in.

arabic_text: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Naapa kwa jua na mwangaza wake!
translation_en: By the sun and its brightness

arabic_text: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Na kwa mwezi unapo lifuatia!
translation_en: And [by] the moon when it follows it

arabic_text: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
translation_sw: Na kwa mchana unapo lidhihirisha!
translation_en: And [by] the day when it displays it

arabic_text: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Na kwa usiku unapo lifunika!
translation_en: And [by] the night when it covers it

arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Na kwa mbingu na kwa aliye ijenga!
translation_en: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

arabic_text: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Na kwa ardhi na kwa aliye itandaza!
translation_en: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

arabic_text: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
translation_sw: Na kwa nafsi na kwa aliye itengeneza!
translation_en: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

arabic_text: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Kisha akaifahamisha uovu wake na wema wake,
translation_en: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

arabic_text: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
translation_sw: Hakika amefanikiwa aliye itakasa,
translation_en: He has succeeded who purifies it,

arabic_text: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
translation_sw: Na hakika amekhasiri aliye iviza.
translation_en: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
translation_sw: Kina Thamudi walikadhibisha kwa sababu ya upotofu wao,
translation_en: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

arabic_text: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
translation_sw: Alipo simama mwovu wao mkubwa,
translation_en: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.

arabic_text: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
translation_sw: Hapo Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu alipo waambia: Huyu ni ngamia wa Mwenyezi Mungu, mwacheni anywe maji fungu lake.
translation_en: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."

arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_sw: Lakini walimkadhibisha na wakamchinja ngamia, kwa hivyo Mola wao Mlezi aliwaangamiza kwa sababu ya dhambi zao na akawafuta kabisa.
translation_en: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].

arabic_text: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا
translation_sw: Wala Yeye haogopi matokeo yake.
translation_en: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.

arabic_text: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa usiku unapo funika!
translation_en: By the night when it covers

arabic_text: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
translation_sw: Na mchana unapo dhihiri!
translation_en: And [by] the day when it appears

arabic_text: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na kwa Aliye umba dume na jike!
translation_en: And [by] He who created the male and female,

arabic_text: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
translation_sw: Hakika juhudi zenu bila ya shaka ni mbali mbali.
translation_en: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
translation_sw: Ama mwenye kutoa na akamchamngu,
translation_en: As for he who gives and fears Allah

arabic_text: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_sw: Na akaliwafiki lilio jema,
translation_en: And believes in the best [reward],

arabic_text: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Tutamsahilishia yawe mepesi.
translation_en: We will ease him toward ease.

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_sw: Na ama mwenye kufanya ubakhili, na asiwe na haja ya wenzake,
translation_en: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

arabic_text: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_sw: Na akakanusha lilio jema,
translation_en: And denies the best [reward],

arabic_text: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
translation_sw: Tutamsahilishia yawe mazito!
translation_en: We will ease him toward difficulty.

arabic_text: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na mali yake yatamfaa nini atapo kuwa anadidimia?
translation_en: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?

arabic_text: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
translation_sw: Hakika ni juu yetu kuonyesha uwongofu.
translation_en: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_sw: Na hakika ni yetu Sisi Akhera na dunia.
translation_en: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

arabic_text: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ
translation_sw: Basi nakuonyeni na Moto unao waka!
translation_en: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.

arabic_text: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_sw: Hatauingia ila mwovu kabisa!
translation_en: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_sw: Anaye kadhibisha na kupa mgongo.
translation_en: Who had denied and turned away.

arabic_text: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
translation_sw: Na mchamngu ataepushwa nao,
translation_en: But the righteous one will avoid it -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
translation_sw: Ambaye hutoa mali yake kwa ajili ya kujitakasa.
translation_en: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

arabic_text: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na wala si kwa kuwa yupo yeyote aliye mfanyia hisani ndio anamlipa.
translation_en: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded

arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_sw: Ila ni kutaka radhi ya Mola wake Mlezi aliye juu kabisa.
translation_en: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.

arabic_text: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
translation_sw: Naye atakuja ridhika!
translation_en: And he is going to be satisfied.

arabic_text: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa mchana!
translation_en: By the morning brightness

arabic_text: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
translation_sw: Na kwa usiku unapo tanda!
translation_en: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

arabic_text: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
translation_sw: Mola wako Mlezi hakukuacha, wala hakukasirika nawe.
translation_en: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].

arabic_text: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka wakati ujao utakuwa bora kwako kuliko ulio tangulia.
translation_en: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].

arabic_text: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Na Mola wako Mlezi atakupa mpaka uridhike.
translation_en: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
translation_sw: Kwani hakukukuta yatima akakupa makaazi?
translation_en: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

arabic_text: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ
translation_sw: Na akakukuta umepotea akakuongoa?
translation_en: And He found you lost and guided [you],

arabic_text: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ
translation_sw: Akakukuta mhitaji akakutosheleza?
translation_en: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
translation_sw: Basi yatima usimwonee!
translation_en: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
translation_sw: Na anaye omba au kuuliza usimkaripie!
translation_en: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
translation_sw: Na neema za Mola wako Mlezi zisimlie.
translation_en: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].

arabic_text: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
translation_sw: Hatukukunjulia kifua chako?
translation_en: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?

arabic_text: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
translation_sw: Na tukakuondolea mzigo wako,
translation_en: And We removed from you your burden

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
translation_sw: Ulio vunja mgongo wako?
translation_en: Which had weighed upon your back

arabic_text: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
translation_sw: Na tukakunyanyulia utajo wako?
translation_en: And raised high for you your repute.

arabic_text: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_sw: Basi kwa hakika pamoja na uzito upo wepesi,
translation_en: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

arabic_text: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا
translation_sw: Hakika pamoja na uzito upo wepesi.
translation_en: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

arabic_text: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
translation_sw: Na ukipata faragha, fanya juhudi.
translation_en: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].

arabic_text: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
translation_sw: Na Mola wako Mlezi ndio mshughulikie.
translation_en: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

arabic_text: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa tini na zaituni!
translation_en: By the fig and the olive

arabic_text: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
translation_sw: Na kwa Mlima wa Sinai!
translation_en: And [by] Mount Sinai

arabic_text: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
translation_sw: Na kwa mji huu wenye amani!
translation_en: And [by] this secure city [Makkah],

arabic_text: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Bila ya shaka tumemuumba mtu kwa umbo lilio bora kabisa.
translation_en: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;

arabic_text: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
translation_sw: Kisha tukamrudisha kuwa chini kuliko walio chini!
translation_en: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,

arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
translation_sw: Lakini wale walio amini na wakatenda mema, hao watapata ujira usio kwisha.
translation_en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

arabic_text: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Basi ni kipi baadaye kitacho kukukadhibishia malipo?
translation_en: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?

arabic_text: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
translation_sw: Kwani Mwenyezi Mungu si muadilifu kuliko mahakimu wote?
translation_en: Is not Allah the most just of judges?

arabic_text: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
translation_sw: Soma kwa jina la Mola wako Mlezi aliye umba,
translation_en: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -

arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
translation_sw: Amemuumba binaadamu kwa tone la damu,
translation_en: Created man from a clinging substance.

arabic_text: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
translation_sw: Soma! Na Mola wako Mlezi ni Karimu kushinda wote!
translation_en: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
translation_sw: Ambaye amefundisha kwa kalamu.
translation_en: Who taught by the pen -

arabic_text: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
translation_sw: Kamfundisha mtu aliyo kuwa hayajui.
translation_en: Taught man that which he knew not.

arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Kwani! Hakika mtu bila ya shaka huwa jeuri
translation_en: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses

arabic_text: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Akijiona katajirika.
translation_en: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.

arabic_text: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Hakika kwa Mola wako Mlezi ndio marejeo.
translation_en: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.

arabic_text: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
translation_sw: Umemwona yule anaye mkataza
translation_en: Have you seen the one who forbids

arabic_text: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
translation_sw: Mja anapo sali?
translation_en: A servant when he prays?

arabic_text: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Umeona kama yeye yuko juu ya uwongofu?
translation_en: Have you seen if he is upon guidance

arabic_text: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
translation_sw: Au anaamrisha uchamngu?
translation_en: Or enjoins righteousness?

arabic_text: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation_sw: Umeona kama yeye akikanusha na anarudi nyuma?
translation_en: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -

arabic_text: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
translation_sw: Hajui ya kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu anaona?
translation_en: Does he not know that Allah sees?

arabic_text: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
translation_sw: Kwani! Kama haachi, tutamkokota kwa shungi la nywele!
translation_en: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -

arabic_text: نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Shungi la uwongo, lenye makosa!
translation_en: A lying, sinning forelock.

arabic_text: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
translation_sw: Basi na awaite wenzake!
translation_en: Then let him call his associates;

arabic_text: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
translation_sw: Nasi tutawaita Mazabania!
translation_en: We will call the angels of Hell.

arabic_text: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
translation_sw: Hasha! Usimt'ii! Nawe sujudu na ujongee!
translation_en: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].

arabic_text: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_sw: Hakika Sisi tumeiteremsha Qur'ani katika Laylatul Qadri, Usiku wa Cheo Kitukufu.
translation_en: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_sw: Na nini kitacho kujuulisha nini Laylatul Qadri?
translation_en: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

arabic_text: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
translation_sw: Laylatul Qadri ni bora kuliko miezi elfu.
translation_en: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
translation_sw: Huteremka Malaika na Roho katika usiku huo kwa idhini ya Mola wao Mlezi kwa kila jambo.
translation_en: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.

arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
translation_sw: Amani usiku huo mpaka mapambazuko ya alfajiri.
translation_en: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

arabic_text: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_sw: Hawakuwa walio kufuru miongoni mwa Watu wa Kitabu na washirikina waache walio nayo mpaka iwajie bayana,
translation_en: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -

arabic_text: رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ
translation_sw: Yaani Mtume aliye toka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu anaye wasomea kurasa zilizo takasika,
translation_en: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures

arabic_text: فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Ndani yake mna maandiko yaliyo nyooka.
translation_en: Within which are correct writings.

arabic_text: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_sw: Wala hawakufarikiana walio pewa Kitabu ila baada ya kuwajia hiyo bayana.
translation_en: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
translation_sw: Nao hawakuamrishwa kitu ila wamuabudu Mwenyezi Mungu kwa kumtakasia Dini, wawe waongofu, na washike Sala, na watoe Zaka. Na hiyo ndiyo Dini madhubuti.
translation_en: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_sw: Hakika walio kufuru miongoni mwa Watu wa Kitabu na washirikina wataingia katika Moto wa Jahannamu wadumu milele humo. Hao ndio viumbe waovu kabisa.
translation_en: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_sw: Hakika walio amini na wakatenda mema, hao ndio bora wa viumbe.
translation_en: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.

arabic_text: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
translation_sw: Malipo yao kwa Mola wao Mlezi ni Bustani za daima, zipitazo mito kati yake. Wakae humo milele. Mwenyezi Mungu yu radhi nao, na wao waradhi naye. Hayo ni kwa anaye mwogopa Mola wake Mlezi.
translation_en: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.

arabic_text: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
translation_sw: Itakapo tetemeshwa ardhi kwa mtetemeko wake!
translation_en: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake

arabic_text: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
translation_sw: Na itakapo toa ardhi mizigo yake!
translation_en: And the earth discharges its burdens

arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
translation_sw: Na mtu akasema: Ina nini?
translation_en: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -

arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
translation_sw: Siku hiyo itahadithia khabari zake.
translation_en: That Day, it will report its news

arabic_text: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
translation_sw: Kwa sababu Mola wake Mlezi ameifunulia!
translation_en: Because your Lord has commanded it.

arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
translation_sw: Siku hiyo watu watatoka kwa mfarakano wakaonyweshwe vitendo vyao!
translation_en: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.

arabic_text: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
translation_sw: Basi anaye tenda chembe ya wema, atauona!
translation_en: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,

arabic_text: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
translation_sw: Na anaye tenda chembe ya uovu atauona!
translation_en: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

arabic_text: وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا
translation_sw: Naapa kwa farasi wendao mbio wakipumua,
translation_en: By the racers, panting,

arabic_text: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا
translation_sw: Na wakitoa moto kwa kupiga kwato zao chini,
translation_en: And the producers of sparks [when] striking

arabic_text: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا
translation_sw: Wakishambulia wakati wa asubuhi,
translation_en: And the chargers at dawn,

arabic_text: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا
translation_sw: Huku wakitimua vumbi,
translation_en: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,

arabic_text: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
translation_sw: Na wakijitoma kati ya kundi,
translation_en: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika mwanaadamu ni mtovu wa fadhila kwa Mola wake Mlezi!
translation_en: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ
translation_sw: Na hakika yeye mwenyewe bila ya shaka ni shahidi wa hayo!
translation_en: And indeed, he is to that a witness.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_sw: Naye hakika bila ya shaka ana nguvu za kupenda mali!
translation_en: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.

arabic_text: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation_sw: Kwani hajui watakapo fufuliwa waliomo makaburini?
translation_en: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered

arabic_text: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_sw: Na yakakusanywa yaliomo vifuani?
translation_en: And that within the breasts is obtained,

arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
translation_sw: Kuwa hakika Mola wao Mlezi siku hiyo bila ya shaka atakuwa na khabari zao wote!
translation_en: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.

arabic_text: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_sw: Inayo gonga!
translation_en: The Striking Calamity -

arabic_text: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_sw: Nini Inayo gonga?
translation_en: What is the Striking Calamity?

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_sw: Na nini kitacho kujuilisha nini Inayo gonga?
translation_en: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
translation_sw: Siku ambayo watu watakuwa kama nondo walio tawanyika;
translation_en: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,

arabic_text: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
translation_sw: Na milima itakuwa kama sufi zilizo chambuliwa!
translation_en: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
translation_sw: Basi yule ambaye mizani yake itakuwa nzito,
translation_en: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],

arabic_text: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
translation_sw: Huyo atakuwa katika maisha ya kupendeza.
translation_en: He will be in a pleasant life.

arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
translation_sw: Na yule ambaye mizani yake itakuwa khafifu,
translation_en: But as for one whose scales are light,

arabic_text: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Huyo maskani yake yatakuwa Moto wa Hawiya!
translation_en: His refuge will be an abyss.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
translation_sw: Na nini kitacho kujuilisha nini hiyo?
translation_en: And what can make you know what that is?

arabic_text: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
translation_sw: Ni Moto mkali!
translation_en: It is a Fire, intensely hot.

arabic_text: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
translation_sw: Kumekushughulisheni kutafuta wingi,
translation_en: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
translation_sw: Mpaka mje makaburini!
translation_en: Until you visit the graveyards.

arabic_text: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Sivyo hivyo! Mtakuja jua!
translation_en: No! You are going to know.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_sw: Tena sivyo hivyo! Mtakuja jua!
translation_en: Then no! You are going to know.

arabic_text: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation_sw: Sivyo hivyo! Lau mngeli jua kwa ujuzi wa yakini,
translation_en: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...

arabic_text: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
translation_sw: Basi bila ya shaka mtaiona Jahannamu!
translation_en: You will surely see the Hellfire.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation_sw: Tena, bila ya shaka, mtaiona kwa jicho la yakini.
translation_en: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_sw: Tena bila ya shaka mtaulizwa siku hiyo juu ya neema.
translation_en: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.

arabic_text: وَٱلْعَصْرِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa Zama!
translation_en: By time,

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
translation_sw: Hakika binaadamu bila ya shaka yumo katika khasara,
translation_en: Indeed, mankind is in loss,

arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
translation_sw: Ila wale walio amini, na wakatenda mema, na wakausiana kwa haki, na wakausiana kusubiri.
translation_en: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ
translation_sw: Ole wake kila safihi, msengenyaji!
translation_en: Woe to every scorner and mocker

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
translation_sw: Aliye kusanya mali na kuyahisabu.
translation_en: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.

arabic_text: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
translation_sw: Anadhani ya kuwa mali yake yatambakisha milele!
translation_en: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.

arabic_text: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ
translation_sw: Hasha! Atavurumishwa katika H'ut'ama.
translation_en: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.

arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ
translation_sw: Na nani atakujuvya ni nini H'ut'ama?
translation_en: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?

arabic_text: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ
translation_sw: Moto wa Mwenyezi Mungu ulio washwa.
translation_en: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,

arabic_text: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ
translation_sw: Ambao unapanda nyoyoni.
translation_en: Which mounts directed at the hearts.

arabic_text: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika huo utafungiwa nao
translation_en: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them

arabic_text: فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
translation_sw: Kwenye nguzo zilio nyooshwa.
translation_en: In extended columns.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
translation_sw: Kwani hukuona jinsi Mola wako Mlezi alivyo watenda wale wenye tembo?
translation_en: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?

arabic_text: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ
translation_sw: Kwani hakujaalia vitimbi vyao kuharibika?
translation_en: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?

arabic_text: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
translation_sw: Na akawapelekea ndege makundi kwa makundi,
translation_en: And He sent against them birds in flocks,

arabic_text: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ
translation_sw: Wakiwatupia mawe ya udongo wa Motoni,
translation_en: Striking them with stones of hard clay,

arabic_text: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
translation_sw: Akawafanya kama majani yaliyo liwa!
translation_en: And He made them like eaten straw.

arabic_text: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
translation_sw: Kwa walivyo zoea Maqureshi,
translation_en: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -

arabic_text: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
translation_sw: Kuzoea kwao safari za siku za baridi na siku za joto.
translation_en: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -

arabic_text: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
translation_sw: Basi nawamuabudu Mola Mlezi wa Nyumba hii,
translation_en: Let them worship the Lord of this House,

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
translation_sw: Ambaye anawalisha wasipate njaa, na anawalinda na khofu.
translation_en: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.

arabic_text: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Je! Umemwona anaye kadhibisha Malipo?
translation_en: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?

arabic_text: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_sw: Huyo ndiye anaye msukuma yatima,
translation_en: For that is the one who drives away the orphan

arabic_text: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_sw: Wala hahimizi kumlisha masikini.
translation_en: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

arabic_text: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_sw: Basi, ole wao wanao sali,
translation_en: So woe to those who pray

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao wanapuuza Sala zao;
translation_en: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
translation_sw: Ambao wanajionyesha,
translation_en: Those who make show [of their deeds]

arabic_text: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
translation_sw: Nao huku wanazuia msaada.
translation_en: And withhold [simple] assistance.

arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
translation_sw: Hakika tumekupa kheri nyingi.
translation_en: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
translation_sw: Basi sali na uchinje kwa ajili ya Mola wako Mlezi.
translation_en: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].

arabic_text: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
translation_sw: Hakika anaye kuchukia ndiye aliye mpungufu.
translation_en: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.

arabic_text: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Enyi makafiri!
translation_en: Say, "O disbelievers,

arabic_text: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_sw: Siabudu mnacho kiabudu;
translation_en: I do not worship what you worship.

arabic_text: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_sw: Wala nyinyi hamuabudu ninaye muabudu.
translation_en: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.

arabic_text: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
translation_sw: Wala sitaabudu mnacho abudu.
translation_en: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.

arabic_text: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_sw: Wala nyinyi hamuabudu ninaye muabudu.
translation_en: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.

arabic_text: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
translation_sw: Nyinyi mna dini yenu, nami nina Dini yangu.
translation_en: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."

arabic_text: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
translation_sw: Itakapo kuja nusura ya Mwenyezi Mungu na ushindi,
translation_en: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,

arabic_text: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
translation_sw: Na ukaona watu wanaingia katika Dini ya Mwenyezi Mungu kwa makundi,
translation_en: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,

arabic_text: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
translation_sw: Zitakase sifa za Mola wako Mlezi, na umwombe msamaha; hakika Yeye ndiye anaye pokea toba.
translation_en: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.

arabic_text: تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ
translation_sw: Imeangamia mikono ya Abu Lahab, na yeye pia ameangamia.
translation_en: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.

arabic_text: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
translation_sw: Hayatamfaa mali yake, wala alivyo vichuma.
translation_en: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.

arabic_text: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ
translation_sw: Atauingia Moto wenye mwako.
translation_en: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame

arabic_text: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ
translation_sw: Na mkewe, mchukuzi wa kuni,
translation_en: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.

arabic_text: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ
translation_sw: Shingoni mwake iko kamba iliyo sokotwa.
translation_en: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.

arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
translation_sw: Sema: Yeye Mwenyezi Mungu ni wa pekee.
translation_en: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One,

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu Mkusudiwa.
translation_en: Allah, the Eternal Refuge.

arabic_text: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
translation_sw: Hakuzaa wala hakuzaliwa.
translation_en: He neither begets nor is born,

arabic_text: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
translation_sw: Wala hana anaye fanana naye hata mmoja.
translation_en: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

arabic_text: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
translation_sw: Sema: Najikinga kwa Mola Mlezi wa mapambazuko,
translation_en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

arabic_text: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
translation_sw: Na shari ya alivyo viumba,
translation_en: From the evil of that which He created

arabic_text: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
translation_sw: Na shari ya giza la usiku liingiapo,
translation_en: And from the evil of darkness when it settles

arabic_text: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
translation_sw: Na shari ya wanao pulizia mafundoni,
translation_en: And from the evil of the blowers in knots

arabic_text: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
translation_sw: Na shari ya hasidi anapo husudu.
translation_en: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

arabic_text: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation_sw: Sema: Ninajikinga kwa Mola Mlezi wa wanaadamu,
translation_en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

arabic_text: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation_sw: Mfalme wa wanaadamu,
translation_en: The Sovereign of mankind.

arabic_text: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation_sw: Mungu wa wanaadamu,
translation_en: The God of mankind,

arabic_text: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
translation_sw: Na shari ya wasiwasi wa Shetani, Khannas,
translation_en: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation_sw: Anaye tia wasiwasi katika vifua vya watu,
translation_en: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

arabic_text: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
translation_sw: Kutokana na majini na wanaadamu.
translation_en: From among the jinn and mankind."
